Fields.Name: ADCBSY
Fields.Description: ADC忙碌状态。
Fields.Values: 0：可接受下一通道采样；1：ADC正在处理转换。
Fields.Notes:
原文：13    ADC busy signal；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第531页；原文字段表：ADC Busy

Set when ADC SOC is generated, cleared per below. Used by the ADC state machine to determine if 
ADC is available to sample.
Sequential Mode: Cleared 4 ADC clocks after negative edge of S+H pulse
Simultaneous Mode: Cleared 14 ADC clocks after negative edge of S+H pulse；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: RESET
Fields.Description: ADC 主机 复位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ADC 模块 软件 复位. 此 位 causes 主机 复位 开启 entire ADC 模块. 全部 寄存器 位 及 状态 machines are 复位 至 initial 状态 作为 发生 当 device 复位 引脚 为 pulled 低 (或 after power-on 复位). 此 为 one-time-ef fect 位, meaning 此 位 为 self-cleared immediately after it 为 置位 至 1. 读取 的 此 位 always returns 0. Also, 复位 的 ADC has latency 的 two 时钟 cycles (that 为, other ADC 控制 寄存器 位 should 不 be modified until two 时钟 cycles after instruction that resets ADC.
Fields.Notes:
原文：15    ADC master reset；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第531页；原文字段表：ADC module software reset. This bit causes a master reset on the entire ADC module. All register bits 

and state machines are reset to the initial state as occurs when the device reset pin is pulled low (or 
after a power-on reset). This is a one-time-ef
fect bit, meaning this bit is self-cleared immediately after it 
is set to 1. Read of this bit always returns a 0. Also, the reset of ADC has a latency of two clock cycles 
(that is, other ADC control register bits should not be modified until two clock cycles after the instruction 
that resets the ADC.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SOCPRIORITY
Fields.Description: 启动转换 优先级
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SOC转换启动 优先级. 决定 cutoff point 用于 优先级 模式 及 round robin 仲裁 用于 SOCx 00h SOC转换启动 优先级 为 handled 中 round robin 模式 用于 全部 channels. 01h SOC0 为 高 优先级, rest 的 channels are 中 round robin 模式. 02h SOC0-SOC1 are 高 优先级, SOC2-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 03h SOC0-SOC2 are 高 优先级, SOC3-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 04h SOC0-SOC3 are 高 优先级, SOC4-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 05h SOC0-SOC4 are 高 优先级, SOC5-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 06h SOC0-SOC5 are 高 优先级, SOC6-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 07h SOC0-SOC6 are 高 优先级, SOC7-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 08h SOC0-SOC7 are 高 优先级, SOC8-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 09h SOC0-SOC8 are 高 优先级, SOC9-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 0Ah SOC0-SOC9 are 高 优先级, SOC10-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 0Bh SOC0-SOC10 are 高 优先级, SOC11-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 0Ch SOC0-SOC11 are 高 优先级, SOC12-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 0Dh SOC0-SOC12 are 高 优先级, SOC13-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 0Eh SOC0-SOC13 are 高 优先级, SOC14-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 0Fh SOC0-SOC14 are 高 优先级, SOC15 为 中 round robin 模式. 10h 全部 SOCs are 中 高 优先级 模式, arbitrated 通过 SOC转换启动 数量 Others Invalid 选择. (1) 此 寄存器 为 EALLOW 受保护. 模数转换 Converter (ADC) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：4:0    Start-of-conversion Priority；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第542页；原文字段表：SOC Priority.

Determines the cutoff point for priority mode and round robin arbitration for SOCx
00h SOC priority is handled in round robin mode for all channels.
01h SOC0 is high priority, rest of channels are in round robin mode.
02h SOC0-SOC1 are high priority, SOC2-SOC15 are in round robin mode.
03h SOC0-SOC2 are high priority, SOC3-SOC15 are in round robin mode.
04h SOC0-SOC3 are high priority, SOC4-SOC15 are in round robin mode.
05h SOC0-SOC4 are high priority, SOC5-SOC15 are in round robin mode.

Fields.Name: TDDR
Fields.Description: 分频 低
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：CPU定时器 分频. Every (TDDRH:TDDR + 1) 定时器 时钟 来源 cycles, 定时器 计数器 寄存器 (TIMH:TIM) decrements 通过 单次. 在 复位, TDDRH:TDDR 位 are cleared 至 0. T o increase overall 定时器 计数 通过 整数 factor, 写入 此 factor minus 单次 至 TDDRH:TDDR 位. 当 预分频器 计数器 (PSCH:PSC) 值 为 0, 单次 定时器 时钟 来源 周期 later, 内容 的 TDDRH:TDDR 重装载 PSCH:PSC, 及 TIMH:TIM decrements 通过 单次. TDDRH:TDDR also reloads PSCH:PSC whenever 定时器 重装载 位 (TRB) 为 置位 通过 软件.
Fields.Notes:
原文：7:0   Divide-down low；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第94页；原文字段表：CPU-Timer Divide-Down. Every (TDDRH:TDDR + 1) timer clock source cycles, the timer counter register 

(TIMH:TIM) decrements by one. At reset, the TDDRH:TDDR bits are cleared to 0. T
o increase the overall 
timer count by an integer factor, write this factor minus one to the TDDRH:TDDR bits. When the prescaler 
counter (PSCH:PSC) value is 0, one timer clock source cycle later, the contents of the TDDRH:TDDR reload 
the PSCH:PSC, and the TIMH:TIM decrements by one. TDDRH:TDDR also reloads the PSCH:PSC whenever 
the timer reload bit (TRB) is set by software.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: PSC
Fields.Description: 预分频 计数器 低
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：CPU定时器 预分频 计数器. These 位 保持 当前 预分频 计数 用于 定时器. 用于 every 定时器 时钟 来源 周期 that PSCH:PSC 值 为 greater than 0, PSCH:PSC decrements 通过 单次. 单次 定时器 时钟 (输出 的 定时器 预分频器) 周期 after PSCH:PSC reaches 0, PSCH:PSC 为 loaded 带 内容 的 TDDRH:TDDR, 及 定时器 计数器 寄存器 (TIMH:TIM) decrements 通过 单次. PSCH:PSC 为 also reloaded whenever 定时器 重装载 位 (TRB) 为 置位 通过 软件. PSCH:PSC CAN be checked 通过 reading 寄存器 , but it cannot be 置位 directly. It must get its 值 来自 定时器 分频 寄存器 (TDDRH:TDDR). 在 复位, PSCH:PSC 为 置位 至 0.
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:8  Prescale counter low；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第94页；原文字段表：CPU-Timer Prescale Counter. These bits hold the current prescale count for the timer. For every timer clock 

source cycle that the PSCH:PSC value is greater than 0, the PSCH:PSC decrements by one. One timer 
clock (output of the timer prescaler) cycle after the PSCH:PSC reaches 0, the PSCH:PSC is loaded with the 
contents of the TDDRH:TDDR, and the timer counter register (TIMH:TIM) decrements by one. The PSCH:PSC 
is also reloaded whenever the timer reload bit (TRB) is set by software. The PSCH:PSC can be checked 
by reading the register
, but it cannot be set directly. It must get its value from the timer divide-down register 
(TDDRH:TDDR). At reset, the PSCH:PSC is set to 0.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TDDR
Fields.Description: 分频 低
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：CPU定时器 分频. Every (TDDRH:TDDR + 1) 定时器 时钟 来源 cycles, 定时器 计数器 寄存器 (TIMH:TIM) decrements 通过 单次. 在 复位, TDDRH:TDDR 位 are cleared 至 0. T o increase overall 定时器 计数 通过 整数 factor, 写入 此 factor minus 单次 至 TDDRH:TDDR 位. 当 预分频器 计数器 (PSCH:PSC) 值 为 0, 单次 定时器 时钟 来源 周期 later, 内容 的 TDDRH:TDDR 重装载 PSCH:PSC, 及 TIMH:TIM decrements 通过 单次. TDDRH:TDDR also reloads PSCH:PSC whenever 定时器 重装载 位 (TRB) 为 置位 通过 软件.
Fields.Notes:
原文：7:0   Divide-down low；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第94页；原文字段表：CPU-Timer Divide-Down. Every (TDDRH:TDDR + 1) timer clock source cycles, the timer counter register 

(TIMH:TIM) decrements by one. At reset, the TDDRH:TDDR bits are cleared to 0. T
o increase the overall 
timer count by an integer factor, write this factor minus one to the TDDRH:TDDR bits. When the prescaler 
counter (PSCH:PSC) value is 0, one timer clock source cycle later, the contents of the TDDRH:TDDR reload 
the PSCH:PSC, and the TIMH:TIM decrements by one. TDDRH:TDDR also reloads the PSCH:PSC whenever 
the timer reload bit (TRB) is set by software.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: PSC
Fields.Description: 预分频 计数器 低
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：CPU定时器 预分频 计数器. These 位 保持 当前 预分频 计数 用于 定时器. 用于 every 定时器 时钟 来源 周期 that PSCH:PSC 值 为 greater than 0, PSCH:PSC decrements 通过 单次. 单次 定时器 时钟 (输出 的 定时器 预分频器) 周期 after PSCH:PSC reaches 0, PSCH:PSC 为 loaded 带 内容 的 TDDRH:TDDR, 及 定时器 计数器 寄存器 (TIMH:TIM) decrements 通过 单次. PSCH:PSC 为 also reloaded whenever 定时器 重装载 位 (TRB) 为 置位 通过 软件. PSCH:PSC CAN be checked 通过 reading 寄存器 , but it cannot be 置位 directly. It must get its 值 来自 定时器 分频 寄存器 (TDDRH:TDDR). 在 复位, PSCH:PSC 为 置位 至 0.
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:8  Prescale counter low；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第94页；原文字段表：CPU-Timer Prescale Counter. These bits hold the current prescale count for the timer. For every timer clock 

source cycle that the PSCH:PSC value is greater than 0, the PSCH:PSC decrements by one. One timer 
clock (output of the timer prescaler) cycle after the PSCH:PSC reaches 0, the PSCH:PSC is loaded with the 
contents of the TDDRH:TDDR, and the timer counter register (TIMH:TIM) decrements by one. The PSCH:PSC 
is also reloaded whenever the timer reload bit (TRB) is set by software. The PSCH:PSC can be checked 
by reading the register
, but it cannot be set directly. It must get its value from the timer divide-down register 
(TDDRH:TDDR). At reset, the PSCH:PSC is set to 0.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

contents of the TDDRH:TDDR, and the timer counter register (TIMH:TIM) decrements by one. The PSCH:PSC 
is also reloaded whenever the timer reload bit (TRB) is set by software. The PSCH:PSC can be checked 
by reading the register
, but it cannot be set directly. It must get its value from the timer divide-down register 
(TDDRH:TDDR). At reset, the PSCH:PSC is set to 0.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TSEG2REG
Fields.Access: 所有模式可读；初始化且EALLOW时可写
Fields.Description: CAN时间段2编码，即相位缓冲段2。
Fields.Values: TSEG2=TSEG2REG+1 TQ；TSEG2须不小于IPT，并不大于TSEG1。BRP>1时IPT=2 TQ。
Fields.Notes:
原文：2:0   TSEG2 register value；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第877页；原文字段表：Time Segment 2. TSEG2 defines the length of PHASE_SEG2 segment in TQ units:

TSEG2 is programmable in the range of 1 TQ to 8 TQ and has to fulfill the following timing rule:
TSEG2 must be smaller than or equal to TSEG1 and must be greater than or equal to IPT.
TSEG2reg denotes the "register value" of "time segment 2;" that is, the value written into bits 2:0 of 
the CANBTC register
. This value is automatically enhanced by 1 when the CAN module accesses 
it. This enhanced value is denoted by the symbol TSEG2.
TSEG2 = TSEG2reg + 1；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: TSEG1REG
Fields.Access: 所有模式可读；初始化且EALLOW时可写
Fields.Description: CAN时间段1编码，包括传播段和相位缓冲段1。
Fields.Values: TSEG1=TSEG1REG+1 TQ；TSEG1须不小于TSEG2和IPT。
Fields.Notes:
原文：6:3   TSEG1 register value；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第877页；原文字段表：Time segment 1. The length of a bit on the CAN bus is determined by the parameters TSEG1, 

TSEG2, and BRP
. All controllers on the CAN bus must have the same baud rate and bit length. For 
different clock frequencies of the individual controllers, the baud rate has to be adjusted by the said 
parameters.
This parameter specifies the length of the TSEG1 segment in TQ units. TSEG1 combines 
PROP_SEG and PHASE_SEG1 segments:
TSEG1 = PROP_SEG + PHASE_SEG1
where PROP_SEG and PHASE_SEG1 are the length of these two segments in TQ units.
TSEG1reg denotes the "register value" of "time segment 1;" that is, the value written into bits 6:3 of 
the CANBTC register
. This value is automatically enhanced by 1 when the CAN module accesses 
it. This enhanced value is denoted by the symbol TSEG1.
TSEG1 = TSEG1reg + 1
TSEG1 value should be chosen such that TSEG1 is greater than or equal to TSEG2 and IPT. For 
more information on IPT
, see Section 14.7.1.1.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: SAM
Fields.Access: 所有模式可读；初始化且EALLOW时可写
Fields.Description: CAN总线电平采样次数。
Fields.Values: 0：单次采样；1：3次采样多数表决。3次采样仅允许BRP>4。
Fields.Notes:
原文：7     Sample-point setting；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第877页；原文字段表：This parameter sets the number of samples used by the CAN module to determine the actual level 

of the CAN bus. When the SAM bit is set, the level determined by the CAN bus corresponds to the 
result from the majority decision of the last three values. The sample points are at the sample point 
and twice before with a distance of ½ TQ.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: SJWREG
Fields.Access: 所有模式可读；初始化且EALLOW时可写
Fields.Description: 重同步跳转宽度编码。
Fields.Values: SJW=SJWREG+1 TQ；SJW不得大于TSEG2，且最大4 TQ。
Fields.Notes:
原文：9:8   Synchroniztion Jump Width register value；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第876页；原文字段表：1:0 Synchronization jump width. The parameter SJW indicates, by how many units of TQ a bit is 

allowed to be lengthened or shortened when resynchronizing.
SJWreg denotes the "register value" of the "resynchronization jump width;" that is, the value written 
into bits 9:8 of the CANBTC register
. This value is automatically enhanced by 1 when the CAN 
module accesses it. This enhanced value is denoted by the symbol SJW.
SJW = SJWreg + 1
SJW is programmable from 1 to 4 TQ. The maximum value of SJW is determined by the minimum 
value of TSEG2 and 4 TQ.
SJW(max) = min [4 TQ, TSEG2]
Controller Area Network (CAN) www.ti.com；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: BRPREG
Fields.Access: 所有模式可读；初始化且EALLOW时可写
Fields.Description: CAN位时间量子的预分频编码。
Fields.Values: 实际分频BRP=BRPREG+1。TI基线不允许BRP=1，故BRPREG应至少为1；CAN时钟=SYSCLKOUT/2。
Fields.Notes:
原文：23:16 Baudrate prescaler register value；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第876页；原文字段表：Baud rate prescaler. This register sets the prescaler for the baud rate settings. The length of one 

TQ is defined by:
/c40 /c41 12 /
1 /c43 /c180/c61 regBRPSYSCLKOUTTQ
where SYSCLKOUT /2 is the frequency of the CAN module clock.
BRPreg denotes the "register value" of the prescaler; that is, value written into bits 23:16 of the 
CANBTC register
. This value is automatically enhanced by 1 when the CAN module accesses it. 
The enhanced value is denoted by the symbol BRP (BRP = BRPreg + 1). BRP is programmable 
from 1 to 256.
Note: For the special case of BRP = 1, the Information Processing Time (IPT) is equal to 3 time 
quanta (TQ). This is not compliant to the ISO 11898 Standard, where the IPT is defined to be less 
than or equal to 2 TQ. Thus the usage of this mode (BRPreg
 = 0) is not allowed.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: CTRMODE
Fields.Description: 时基计数模式。
Fields.Values: 0：向上计数；1：向下计数；2：上下计数；3：停止/冻结。
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    Counter Mode；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第317页；原文字段表：Counter Mode

The time-base counter mode is normally configured once and not changed during normal 
operation. If you change the mode of the counter
, the change will take effect at the next TBCLK 
edge and the current counter value shall increment or decrement from the value before the mode 
change.
These bits set the time-base counter mode of operation as follows:
00 Up-count mode
01 Down-count mode
10 Up-down-count mode
11 Stop-freeze counter operation (default on reset)；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: PHSEN
Fields.Description: 相位加载使能。
Fields.Values: 0：禁用相位加载；1：收到同步事件时将TBPHS载入TBCTR。
Fields.Notes: 原文：2      Phase load enable；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第317页；原文字段表：Counter Register Load From Phase Register Enable；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: PRDLD
Fields.Description: 周期寄存器的影子加载模式。
Fields.Values: 0：使用影子寄存器，计数器归零时装载；1：直接写活动寄存器。
Fields.Notes: 原文：3      Active period load；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第317页；原文字段表：Active Period Register Load From Shadow Register Select；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: SYNCOSEL
Fields.Description: 同步 输出 选择
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：同步 输出 选择. These 位 选择 来源 的 EPWMxSYNCO 信号. 00 EPWMxSYNC:
Fields.Notes:
原文：5:4    Sync output select；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第317页；原文字段表：Synchronization Output Select. These bits select the source of the EPWMxSYNCO signal.

00 EPWMxSYNC:；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SWFSYNC
Fields.Description: 软件强制同步。
Fields.Values: 写1产生软件同步脉冲；硬件清零。
Fields.Notes: 原文：6      Software force sync pulse；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第317页；原文字段表：Software Forced Synchronization Pulse；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: HSPCLKDIV
Fields.Description: 时基高速预分频选择。
Fields.Notes:
原文：9:7    High speed time pre-scale；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第317页；原文字段表：High Speed Time-base Clock Prescale Bits

These bits determine part of the time-base clock prescale value.
TBCLK = SYSCLKOUT / (HSPCLKDIV × CLKDIV)
This divisor emulates the HSPCLK in the TMS320x281x system as used on the Event Manager 
(EV) peripheral.
000 /1
001 /2 (default on reset)
010 /4
011 /6
100 /8
101 /10
110 /12
111 /14；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: CLKDIV
Fields.Description: 时基低速预分频选择。
Fields.Notes:
原文：12:10  Timebase clock pre-scale；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第316页；原文字段表：Time-base Clock Prescale Bits

These bits determine part of the time-base clock prescale value.
TBCLK = SYSCLKOUT / (HSPCLKDIV × CLKDIV)
000 /1 (default on reset)
001 /2
010 /4
011 /8
100 /16
101 /32
110 /64
111 /128
Enhanced Pulse Width Modulator (ePWM) Module www.ti.com；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: PHSDIR
Fields.Description: 上下计数模式下，同步载入相位后的计数方向。
Fields.Values: 0：同步后向下计数；1：同步后向上计数。
Fields.Notes:
原文：13     Phase Direction；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第316页；原文字段表：Phase Direction Bit.

This bit is only used when the time-base counter is configured in the up-down-count mode. 
The PHSDIR bit indicates the direction the time-base counter (TBCTR) will count after a 
synchronization event occurs and a new phase value is loaded from the phase (TBPHS) register
. 
This is irrespective of the direction of the counter before the synchronization event..
In the up-count and down-count modes this bit is ignored.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: TBPRD
Fields.Description: 时基周期计数值。
Fields.Values: 向上/向下计数：频率=TBCLK/(TBPRD+1)；上下计数：频率=TBCLK/(2×TBPRD)。
Fields.Notes:
原文：Time Base Period register set；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第320页；原文字段表：0000-

FFFFh
These bits determine the period of the time-base counter. This sets the PWM frequency.
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the TBCTL[PRDLD] bit. By default this 
register is shadowed.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go 
to the shadow register
. In this case, the active register will be loaded from the shadow register 
when the time-base counter equals zero.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 1, then the shadow is disabled and any write or read will go directly to the 
active register
, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• The active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.

Fields.Name: CMPB
Fields.Description: 比较 B reg
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：值 中 活动 CMPB 寄存器 为 continuously compared 至 时基 计数器 (TBCTR). 当 values are equal, counter-compare 模块 产生 "时基 计数器 equal 至 计数器 比较 B" 事件. 此 事件 为 sent 至 action-qualifier where it 为 限定后 及 converted it 进入 单次 或 more actions. These actions CAN be applied 至 either EPWMxA 或 EPWMxB 输出 depending 开启 配置 的 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器. actions that CAN be defined 中 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器 include: • 执行 nothing. 事件 为 忽略. • 清除: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 低 • 置位: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 高 • 翻转 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 Shadowing 的 此 寄存器 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能 及 any 写入 或 读取 will automatically go 至 影子 寄存器 . 中 此 case, CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] 位 field 决定 which 事件 will 加载 活动 寄存器 来自 影子 寄存器: • Before 写入, CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] 位 CAN be 读取 至 determine 如果 影子 寄存器 为 currently 满. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用 及 any 写入 或 读取 will go directly 至 活动 寄存器 , that 为 寄存器 actively controlling 硬件. • 中 either 模式, 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：Compare B reg；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第327页；原文字段表：The value in the active CMPB register is continuously compared to the time-base counter (TBCTR). When the 

values are equal, the counter-compare module generates a "time-base counter equal to counter compare B" 
event. This event is sent to the action-qualifier where it is qualified and converted it into one or more actions. 
These actions can be applied to either the EPWMxA or the EPWMxB output depending on the configuration of 
the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers. The actions that can be defined in the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers 
include:
• Do nothing. event is ignored.
• Clear: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal low
• Set: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal high
• Toggle the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] bit. By default this register is 
shadowed.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go to 
the shadow register
. In this case, the CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] bit field determines which event will load the 
active register from the shadow register:
• Before a write, the CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] bit can be read to determine if the shadow register is currently 
full.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is disabled and any write or read will go directly to 
the active register
, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• In either mode, the active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OUT_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输出 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 输出 模式 控制 位 1 控制 S1 switch 及 位 0 控制 S0 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively 使能 或 bypass 死区 产生 用于 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟 . 00 死区 产生 为 bypassed 用于 both 输出 信号. 中 此 模式, both EPWMxA 及 EPWMxB 输出 信号 来自 action-qualifier are passed directly 至 PWM-chopper submodule. 中 此 模式, POLSEL 及 中_模式 位 have no effect.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    Dead Band Output Mode Control；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第336页；原文字段表：Dead-band Output Mode Control

Bit 1 controls the S1 switch and bit 0 controls the S0 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively enable or bypass the dead-band generation for the falling-edge and 
rising-edge delay
.
00 Dead-band generation is bypassed for both output signals. In this mode, both the EPWMxA 
and EPWMxB output signals from the action-qualifier are passed directly to the PWM-chopper 
submodule.
In this mode, the POLSEL and IN_MODE bits have no effect.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: POLSEL
Fields.Description: 极性 选择 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：极性 选择 控制 位 3 控制 S3 switch 及 位 2 控制 S2 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively invert 单次 的 delayed 信号 before it 为 sent out 的 死区 submodule. following descriptions correspond 至 classical upper/lower switch 控制 作为 found 中 单次 leg 的 数字 motor 控制 inverter . These assume that DBCTL[OUT_模式] = 1,1 及 DBCTL[中_模式] = 0,0. Other enhanced modes are also possible, but 不 regarded 作为 typical usage modes.
Fields.Notes:
原文：3:2    Polarity Select Control；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第335页；原文字段表：Polarity Select Control

Bit 3 controls the S3 switch and bit 2 controls the S2 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively invert one of the delayed signals before it is sent out of the dead-band 
submodule.
The following descriptions correspond to classical upper/lower switch control as found in one leg of 
a digital motor control inverter
.
These assume that DBCTL[OUT_MODE] = 1,1 and DBCTL[IN_MODE] = 0,0. Other enhanced 
modes are also possible, but not regarded as typical usage modes.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Notes:
原文：5:4    Dead Band Input Select Mode Control；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第335页；原文字段表：Dead Band Input Mode Control

Bit 5 controls the S5 switch and bit 4 controls the S4 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to select the input source to the falling-edge and rising-edge delay.
To produce classical dead-band waveforms the default is EPWMxA In is the source for both falling 
and rising-edge delays.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INTPRD
Fields.Description: EPWMxINTn 周期 选择
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ePWM 中断 (ePWMx_中断) 周期 选择 These 位 determine how many 已选 ETSEL[INTSEL] events need 至 occur before 中断 为 已产生. T o be 已产生, 中断 must be 已使能 (ETSEL[中断] = 1). 如果 中断 状态 标志 为 置位 来自 前次 中断 (ETFLG[中断] = 1) then no 中断 will be 已产生 until 标志 为 cleared via ETCLR[中断] 位. 此 allows 用于 单次 中断 至 be 待处理 期间 another 为 still being serviced. Once 中断 为 已产生, ETPS[INTCNT] 位 will automatically be cleared. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 same 作为 当前 计数器 值 will 触发 中断 如果 it 为 已使能 及 状态 标志 为 清除 . Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 less than 当前 计数器 值 will 结果 中 undefined 状态. 如果 计数器 事件 发生 在 same instant 作为 new 零 或 non-zero INTPRD 值 为 written, 计数器 为 incremented.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    EPWMxINTn Period Select；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第349页；原文字段表：ePWM Interrupt (EPWMx_INT) Period Select

These bits determine how many selected ETSEL[INTSEL] events need to occur before an interrupt 
is generated. T
o be generated, the interrupt must be enabled (ETSEL[INT] = 1). If the interrupt 
status flag is set from a previous interrupt (ETFLG[INT] = 1) then no interrupt will be generated until 
the flag is cleared via the ETCLR[INT] bit. This allows for one interrupt to be pending while another 
is still being serviced. Once the interrupt is generated, the ETPS[INTCNT] bits will automatically be 
cleared.
Writing a INTPRD value that is the same as the current counter value will trigger an interrupt if it is 
enabled and the status flag is clear
.
Writing a INTPRD value that is less than the current counter value will result in an undefined state.
If a counter event occurs at the same instant as a new zero or non-zero INTPRD value is written, 
the counter is incremented.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: DCCAP
Fields.Description: 资料未提供用途说明；保留原字段名供查阅。
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：-FFFFh 数字 比较 时基 计数器 捕获 至 使能 时基 计数器 捕获, 置位 DCCAPCLT[CAPE] 位 至 1. 如果 已使能, 反映 值 的 时基 计数器 (TBCTR) 开启 低 至 高 边沿 transition 的 filtered (DCEVTFL T) 事件. Further 捕获 events are 忽略 until 下次 周期 或 零 作为 已选 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. Shadowing 的 DCCAP 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. • 如果 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能. 中 此 模式, 活动 寄存器 为 copied 至 影子 寄存器 开启 TBCTR = TBPRD 或 TBCTR = 零 作为 defined 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. CPU reads 的 此 寄存器 will return 影子 寄存器 值. • 如果 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用. 中 此 模式, CPU reads will return 活动 寄存器 值. 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第363页；原文字段表：0000-FFFFh Digital Compare Time-Base Counter Capture

To enable time-base counter capture, set the DCCAPCLT[CAPE] bit to 1.
If enabled, reflects the value of the time-base counter (TBCTR) on the low to high edge transition 
of a filtered (DCEVTFL
T) event. Further capture events are ignored until the next period or zero 
as selected by the DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit.
Shadowing of DCCAP is enabled and disabled by the DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] bit. By default 
this register is shadowed.
• If DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled. In this mode, the active 
register is copied to the shadow register on the TBCTR = TBPRD or TBCTR = zero as 
defined by the DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit. CPU reads of this register will return the shadow 
register value.
• If DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is disabled. In this mode, CPU 
reads will return the active register value.
The active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

原文：1:0    Counter Mode；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第317页；原文字段表：Counter Mode

The time-base counter mode is normally configured once and not changed during normal 
operation. If you change the mode of the counter
, the change will take effect at the next TBCLK 
edge and the current counter value shall increment or decrement from the value before the mode 
change.
These bits set the time-base counter mode of operation as follows:
00 Up-count mode
01 Down-count mode
10 Up-down-count mode

Fields.Name: TBPRD
Fields.Description: 时基周期计数值。
Fields.Values: 向上/向下计数：频率=TBCLK/(TBPRD+1)；上下计数：频率=TBCLK/(2×TBPRD)。
Fields.Notes:
原文：Time Base Period register set；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第320页；原文字段表：0000-

FFFFh
These bits determine the period of the time-base counter. This sets the PWM frequency.
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the TBCTL[PRDLD] bit. By default this 
register is shadowed.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go 
to the shadow register
. In this case, the active register will be loaded from the shadow register 
when the time-base counter equals zero.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 1, then the shadow is disabled and any write or read will go directly to the 
active register
, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• The active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.

Fields.Name: CMPB
Fields.Description: 比较 B reg
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：值 中 活动 CMPB 寄存器 为 continuously compared 至 时基 计数器 (TBCTR). 当 values are equal, counter-compare 模块 产生 "时基 计数器 equal 至 计数器 比较 B" 事件. 此 事件 为 sent 至 action-qualifier where it 为 限定后 及 converted it 进入 单次 或 more actions. These actions CAN be applied 至 either EPWMxA 或 EPWMxB 输出 depending 开启 配置 的 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器. actions that CAN be defined 中 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器 include: • 执行 nothing. 事件 为 忽略. • 清除: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 低 • 置位: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 高 • 翻转 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 Shadowing 的 此 寄存器 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能 及 any 写入 或 读取 will automatically go 至 影子 寄存器 . 中 此 case, CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] 位 field 决定 which 事件 will 加载 活动 寄存器 来自 影子 寄存器: • Before 写入, CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] 位 CAN be 读取 至 determine 如果 影子 寄存器 为 currently 满. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用 及 any 写入 或 读取 will go directly 至 活动 寄存器 , that 为 寄存器 actively controlling 硬件. • 中 either 模式, 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：Compare B reg；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第327页；原文字段表：The value in the active CMPB register is continuously compared to the time-base counter (TBCTR). When the 

values are equal, the counter-compare module generates a "time-base counter equal to counter compare B" 
event. This event is sent to the action-qualifier where it is qualified and converted it into one or more actions. 
These actions can be applied to either the EPWMxA or the EPWMxB output depending on the configuration of 
the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers. The actions that can be defined in the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers 
include:
• Do nothing. event is ignored.
• Clear: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal low
• Set: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal high
• Toggle the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] bit. By default this register is 
shadowed.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go to 
the shadow register
. In this case, the CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] bit field determines which event will load the 
active register from the shadow register:
• Before a write, the CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] bit can be read to determine if the shadow register is currently 
full.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is disabled and any write or read will go directly to 
the active register
, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• In either mode, the active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OUT_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输出 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 输出 模式 控制 位 1 控制 S1 switch 及 位 0 控制 S0 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively 使能 或 bypass 死区 产生 用于 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟 . 00 死区 产生 为 bypassed 用于 both 输出 信号. 中 此 模式, both EPWMxA 及 EPWMxB 输出 信号 来自 action-qualifier are passed directly 至 PWM-chopper submodule. 中 此 模式, POLSEL 及 中_模式 位 have no effect.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    Dead Band Output Mode Control；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第336页；原文字段表：Dead-band Output Mode Control

Bit 1 controls the S1 switch and bit 0 controls the S0 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively enable or bypass the dead-band generation for the falling-edge and 
rising-edge delay
.
00 Dead-band generation is bypassed for both output signals. In this mode, both the EPWMxA 
and EPWMxB output signals from the action-qualifier are passed directly to the PWM-chopper 
submodule.
In this mode, the POLSEL and IN_MODE bits have no effect.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: POLSEL
Fields.Description: 极性 选择 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：极性 选择 控制 位 3 控制 S3 switch 及 位 2 控制 S2 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively invert 单次 的 delayed 信号 before it 为 sent out 的 死区 submodule. following descriptions correspond 至 classical upper/lower switch 控制 作为 found 中 单次 leg 的 数字 motor 控制 inverter . These assume that DBCTL[OUT_模式] = 1,1 及 DBCTL[中_模式] = 0,0. Other enhanced modes are also possible, but 不 regarded 作为 typical usage modes.
Fields.Notes:
原文：3:2    Polarity Select Control；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第335页；原文字段表：Polarity Select Control

Bit 3 controls the S3 switch and bit 2 controls the S2 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively invert one of the delayed signals before it is sent out of the dead-band 
submodule.
The following descriptions correspond to classical upper/lower switch control as found in one leg of 
a digital motor control inverter
.
These assume that DBCTL[OUT_MODE] = 1,1 and DBCTL[IN_MODE] = 0,0. Other enhanced 
modes are also possible, but not regarded as typical usage modes.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: IN_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输入 选择 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 带 输入 模式 控制 位 5 控制 S5 switch 及 位 4 控制 S4 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 选择 输入 来源 至 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟. 至 produce classical 死区 waveforms 默认 为 EPWMxA 中 为 来源 用于 both 下降沿 及 rising-edge delays.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5:4    Dead Band Input Select Mode Control；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第335页；原文字段表：Dead Band Input Mode Control

Bit 5 controls the S5 switch and bit 4 controls the S4 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to select the input source to the falling-edge and rising-edge delay.
To produce classical dead-band waveforms the default is EPWMxA In is the source for both falling 
and rising-edge delays.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INTPRD
Fields.Description: EPWMxINTn 周期 选择
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ePWM 中断 (ePWMx_中断) 周期 选择 These 位 determine how many 已选 ETSEL[INTSEL] events need 至 occur before 中断 为 已产生. T o be 已产生, 中断 must be 已使能 (ETSEL[中断] = 1). 如果 中断 状态 标志 为 置位 来自 前次 中断 (ETFLG[中断] = 1) then no 中断 will be 已产生 until 标志 为 cleared via ETCLR[中断] 位. 此 allows 用于 单次 中断 至 be 待处理 期间 another 为 still being serviced. Once 中断 为 已产生, ETPS[INTCNT] 位 will automatically be cleared. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 same 作为 当前 计数器 值 will 触发 中断 如果 it 为 已使能 及 状态 标志 为 清除 . Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 less than 当前 计数器 值 will 结果 中 undefined 状态. 如果 计数器 事件 发生 在 same instant 作为 new 零 或 non-zero INTPRD 值 为 written, 计数器 为 incremented.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    EPWMxINTn Period Select；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第349页；原文字段表：ePWM Interrupt (EPWMx_INT) Period Select

These bits determine how many selected ETSEL[INTSEL] events need to occur before an interrupt 
is generated. T
o be generated, the interrupt must be enabled (ETSEL[INT] = 1). If the interrupt 
status flag is set from a previous interrupt (ETFLG[INT] = 1) then no interrupt will be generated until 
the flag is cleared via the ETCLR[INT] bit. This allows for one interrupt to be pending while another 
is still being serviced. Once the interrupt is generated, the ETPS[INTCNT] bits will automatically be 
cleared.
Writing a INTPRD value that is the same as the current counter value will trigger an interrupt if it is 
enabled and the status flag is clear
.
Writing a INTPRD value that is less than the current counter value will result in an undefined state.
If a counter event occurs at the same instant as a new zero or non-zero INTPRD value is written, 
the counter is incremented.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Notes:
原文：2      TBPHSHR Load Enable Bit；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第392页；原文字段表：TBPHSHR Load Enable

Fields.Name: DCCAP
Fields.Description: 资料未提供用途说明；保留原字段名供查阅。
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：-FFFFh 数字 比较 时基 计数器 捕获 至 使能 时基 计数器 捕获, 置位 DCCAPCLT[CAPE] 位 至 1. 如果 已使能, 反映 值 的 时基 计数器 (TBCTR) 开启 低 至 高 边沿 transition 的 filtered (DCEVTFL T) 事件. Further 捕获 events are 忽略 until 下次 周期 或 零 作为 已选 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. Shadowing 的 DCCAP 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. • 如果 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能. 中 此 模式, 活动 寄存器 为 copied 至 影子 寄存器 开启 TBCTR = TBPRD 或 TBCTR = 零 作为 defined 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. CPU reads 的 此 寄存器 will return 影子 寄存器 值. • 如果 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用. 中 此 模式, CPU reads will return 活动 寄存器 值. 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第363页；原文字段表：0000-FFFFh Digital Compare Time-Base Counter Capture

To enable time-base counter capture, set the DCCAPCLT[CAPE] bit to 1.
If enabled, reflects the value of the time-base counter (TBCTR) on the low to high edge transition 
of a filtered (DCEVTFL
T) event. Further capture events are ignored until the next period or zero 
as selected by the DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit.
Shadowing of DCCAP is enabled and disabled by the DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] bit. By default 
this register is shadowed.
• If DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled. In this mode, the active 
register is copied to the shadow register on the TBCTR = TBPRD or TBCTR = zero as 
defined by the DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit. CPU reads of this register will return the shadow 
register value.
• If DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is disabled. In this mode, CPU 
reads will return the active register value.
The active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CTRMODE

Fields.Values: 0：向上计数；1：向下计数；2：上下计数；3：停止/冻结。
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    Counter Mode；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第317页；原文字段表：Counter Mode

The time-base counter mode is normally configured once and not changed during normal 
operation. If you change the mode of the counter
, the change will take effect at the next TBCLK 
edge and the current counter value shall increment or decrement from the value before the mode 
change.
These bits set the time-base counter mode of operation as follows:
00 Up-count mode
01 Down-count mode
10 Up-down-count mode
11 Stop-freeze counter operation (default on reset)；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: PHSDIR
Fields.Description: 上下计数模式下，同步载入相位后的计数方向。
Fields.Values: 0：同步后向下计数；1：同步后向上计数。
Fields.Notes:
原文：13     Phase Direction；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第316页；原文字段表：Phase Direction Bit.

This bit is only used when the time-base counter is configured in the up-down-count mode. 
The PHSDIR bit indicates the direction the time-base counter (TBCTR) will count after a 
synchronization event occurs and a new phase value is loaded from the phase (TBPHS) register
. 
This is irrespective of the direction of the counter before the synchronization event..
In the up-count and down-count modes this bit is ignored.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: TBPRD
Fields.Description: 时基周期计数值。
Fields.Values: 向上/向下计数：频率=TBCLK/(TBPRD+1)；上下计数：频率=TBCLK/(2×TBPRD)。
Fields.Notes:
原文：Time Base Period register set；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第320页；原文字段表：0000-

FFFFh
These bits determine the period of the time-base counter. This sets the PWM frequency.
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the TBCTL[PRDLD] bit. By default this 
register is shadowed.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go 
to the shadow register
. In this case, the active register will be loaded from the shadow register 
when the time-base counter equals zero.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 1, then the shadow is disabled and any write or read will go directly to the 
active register
, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• The active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.
 
Enhanced Pulse Width Modulator (ePWM) Module www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CMPB
Fields.Description: 比较 B reg
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：值 中 活动 CMPB 寄存器 为 continuously compared 至 时基 计数器 (TBCTR). 当 values are equal, counter-compare 模块 产生 "时基 计数器 equal 至 计数器 比较 B" 事件. 此 事件 为 sent 至 action-qualifier where it 为 限定后 及 converted it 进入 单次 或 more actions. These actions CAN be applied 至 either EPWMxA 或 EPWMxB 输出 depending 开启 配置 的 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器. actions that CAN be defined 中 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器 include: • 执行 nothing. 事件 为 忽略. • 清除: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 低 • 置位: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 高 • 翻转 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 Shadowing 的 此 寄存器 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能 及 any 写入 或 读取 will automatically go 至 影子 寄存器 . 中 此 case, CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] 位 field 决定 which 事件 will 加载 活动 寄存器 来自 影子 寄存器: • Before 写入, CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] 位 CAN be 读取 至 determine 如果 影子 寄存器 为 currently 满. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用 及 any 写入 或 读取 will go directly 至 活动 寄存器 , that 为 寄存器 actively controlling 硬件. • 中 either 模式, 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：Compare B reg；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第327页；原文字段表：The value in the active CMPB register is continuously compared to the time-base counter (TBCTR). When the 

values are equal, the counter-compare module generates a "time-base counter equal to counter compare B" 
event. This event is sent to the action-qualifier where it is qualified and converted it into one or more actions. 
These actions can be applied to either the EPWMxA or the EPWMxB output depending on the configuration of 
the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers. The actions that can be defined in the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers 
include:
• Do nothing. event is ignored.
• Clear: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal low
• Set: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal high
• Toggle the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] bit. By default this register is 
shadowed.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go to 
the shadow register
. In this case, the CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] bit field determines which event will load the 
active register from the shadow register:
• Before a write, the CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] bit can be read to determine if the shadow register is currently 
full.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is disabled and any write or read will go directly to 
the active register
, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• In either mode, the active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OUT_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输出 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 输出 模式 控制 位 1 控制 S1 switch 及 位 0 控制 S0 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively 使能 或 bypass 死区 产生 用于 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟 . 00 死区 产生 为 bypassed 用于 both 输出 信号. 中 此 模式, both EPWMxA 及 EPWMxB 输出 信号 来自 action-qualifier are passed directly 至 PWM-chopper submodule. 中 此 模式, POLSEL 及 中_模式 位 have no effect.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    Dead Band Output Mode Control；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第336页；原文字段表：Dead-band Output Mode Control

Bit 1 controls the S1 switch and bit 0 controls the S0 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively enable or bypass the dead-band generation for the falling-edge and 
rising-edge delay
.
00 Dead-band generation is bypassed for both output signals. In this mode, both the EPWMxA 
and EPWMxB output signals from the action-qualifier are passed directly to the PWM-chopper 
submodule.
In this mode, the POLSEL and IN_MODE bits have no effect.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: POLSEL
Fields.Description: 极性 选择 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：极性 选择 控制 位 3 控制 S3 switch 及 位 2 控制 S2 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively invert 单次 的 delayed 信号 before it 为 sent out 的 死区 submodule. following descriptions correspond 至 classical upper/lower switch 控制 作为 found 中 单次 leg 的 数字 motor 控制 inverter . These assume that DBCTL[OUT_模式] = 1,1 及 DBCTL[中_模式] = 0,0. Other enhanced modes are also possible, but 不 regarded 作为 typical usage modes.
Fields.Notes:
原文：3:2    Polarity Select Control；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第335页；原文字段表：Polarity Select Control

Bit 3 controls the S3 switch and bit 2 controls the S2 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively invert one of the delayed signals before it is sent out of the dead-band 
submodule.
The following descriptions correspond to classical upper/lower switch control as found in one leg of 
a digital motor control inverter
.
These assume that DBCTL[OUT_MODE] = 1,1 and DBCTL[IN_MODE] = 0,0. Other enhanced 
modes are also possible, but not regarded as typical usage modes.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: IN_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输入 选择 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 带 输入 模式 控制 位 5 控制 S5 switch 及 位 4 控制 S4 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 选择 输入 来源 至 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟. 至 produce classical 死区 waveforms 默认 为 EPWMxA 中 为 来源 用于 both 下降沿 及 rising-edge delays.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5:4    Dead Band Input Select Mode Control；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第335页；原文字段表：Dead Band Input Mode Control

Bit 5 controls the S5 switch and bit 4 controls the S4 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to select the input source to the falling-edge and rising-edge delay.
To produce classical dead-band waveforms the default is EPWMxA In is the source for both falling 
and rising-edge delays.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ePWM 中断 (ePWMx_中断) 周期 选择 These 位 determine how many 已选 ETSEL[INTSEL] events need 至 occur before 中断 为 已产生. T o be 已产生, 中断 must be 已使能 (ETSEL[中断] = 1). 如果 中断 状态 标志 为 置位 来自 前次 中断 (ETFLG[中断] = 1) then no 中断 will be 已产生 until 标志 为 cleared via ETCLR[中断] 位. 此 allows 用于 单次 中断 至 be 待处理 期间 another 为 still being serviced. Once 中断 为 已产生, ETPS[INTCNT] 位 will automatically be cleared. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 same 作为 当前 计数器 值 will 触发 中断 如果 it 为 已使能 及 状态 标志 为 清除 . Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 less than 当前 计数器 值 will 结果 中 undefined 状态. 如果 计数器 事件 发生 在 same instant 作为 new 零 或 non-zero INTPRD 值 为 written, 计数器 为 incremented.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    EPWMxINTn Period Select；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第349页；原文字段表：ePWM Interrupt (EPWMx_INT) Period Select

These bits determine how many selected ETSEL[INTSEL] events need to occur before an interrupt 
is generated. T
o be generated, the interrupt must be enabled (ETSEL[INT] = 1). If the interrupt 
status flag is set from a previous interrupt (ETFLG[INT] = 1) then no interrupt will be generated until 
the flag is cleared via the ETCLR[INT] bit. This allows for one interrupt to be pending while another 
is still being serviced. Once the interrupt is generated, the ETPS[INTCNT] bits will automatically be 
cleared.
Writing a INTPRD value that is the same as the current counter value will trigger an interrupt if it is 
enabled and the status flag is clear
.
Writing a INTPRD value that is less than the current counter value will result in an undefined state.
If a counter event occurs at the same instant as a new zero or non-zero INTPRD value is written, 
the counter is incremented.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: DCCAP
Fields.Description: 资料未提供用途说明；保留原字段名供查阅。
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：-FFFFh 数字 比较 时基 计数器 捕获 至 使能 时基 计数器 捕获, 置位 DCCAPCLT[CAPE] 位 至 1. 如果 已使能, 反映 值 的 时基 计数器 (TBCTR) 开启 低 至 高 边沿 transition 的 filtered (DCEVTFL T) 事件. Further 捕获 events are 忽略 until 下次 周期 或 零 作为 已选 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. Shadowing 的 DCCAP 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. • 如果 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能. 中 此 模式, 活动 寄存器 为 copied 至 影子 寄存器 开启 TBCTR = TBPRD 或 TBCTR = 零 作为 defined 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. CPU reads 的 此 寄存器 will return 影子 寄存器 值. • 如果 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用. 中 此 模式, CPU reads will return 活动 寄存器 值. 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第363页；原文字段表：0000-FFFFh Digital Compare Time-Base Counter Capture

To enable time-base counter capture, set the DCCAPCLT[CAPE] bit to 1.
If enabled, reflects the value of the time-base counter (TBCTR) on the low to high edge transition 
of a filtered (DCEVTFL
T) event. Further capture events are ignored until the next period or zero 
as selected by the DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit.
Shadowing of DCCAP is enabled and disabled by the DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] bit. By default 
this register is shadowed.
• If DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled. In this mode, the active 
register is copied to the shadow register on the TBCTR = TBPRD or TBCTR = zero as 
defined by the DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit. CPU reads of this register will return the shadow 
register value.
• If DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is disabled. In this mode, CPU 
reads will return the active register value.
The active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CTRMODE
Fields.Description: 时基计数模式。
Fields.Values: 0：向上计数；1：向下计数；2：上下计数；3：停止/冻结。
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    Counter Mode；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第317页；原文字段表：Counter Mode

The time-base counter mode is normally configured once and not changed during normal 
operation. If you change the mode of the counter
, the change will take effect at the next TBCLK 
edge and the current counter value shall increment or decrement from the value before the mode 
change.
These bits set the time-base counter mode of operation as follows:
00 Up-count mode
01 Down-count mode
10 Up-down-count mode
11 Stop-freeze counter operation (default on reset)；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

原文：9:7    High speed time pre-scale；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第317页；原文字段表：High Speed Time-base Clock Prescale Bits

These bits determine part of the time-base clock prescale value.
TBCLK = SYSCLKOUT / (HSPCLKDIV × CLKDIV)
This divisor emulates the HSPCLK in the TMS320x281x system as used on the Event Manager

Fields.Name: PHSDIR
Fields.Description: 上下计数模式下，同步载入相位后的计数方向。
Fields.Values: 0：同步后向下计数；1：同步后向上计数。
Fields.Notes:
原文：13     Phase Direction；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第316页；原文字段表：Phase Direction Bit.

This bit is only used when the time-base counter is configured in the up-down-count mode. 
The PHSDIR bit indicates the direction the time-base counter (TBCTR) will count after a 
synchronization event occurs and a new phase value is loaded from the phase (TBPHS) register
. 
This is irrespective of the direction of the counter before the synchronization event..
In the up-count and down-count modes this bit is ignored.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

原文：Time Base Counter；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第320页；原文字段表：0000-

FFFF
Reading these bits gives the current time-base counter value.
Writing to these bits sets the current time-base counter value. The update happens as soon as the write

Fields.Name: TBPRD
Fields.Description: 时基周期计数值。
Fields.Values: 向上/向下计数：频率=TBCLK/(TBPRD+1)；上下计数：频率=TBCLK/(2×TBPRD)。
Fields.Notes:
原文：Time Base Period register set；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第320页；原文字段表：0000-

FFFFh
These bits determine the period of the time-base counter. This sets the PWM frequency.
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the TBCTL[PRDLD] bit. By default this 
register is shadowed.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go 
to the shadow register
. In this case, the active register will be loaded from the shadow register 
when the time-base counter equals zero.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 1, then the shadow is disabled and any write or read will go directly to the 
active register
, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• The active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.
 
Enhanced Pulse Width Modulator (ePWM) Module www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CMPB
Fields.Description: 比较 B reg
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：值 中 活动 CMPB 寄存器 为 continuously compared 至 时基 计数器 (TBCTR). 当 values are equal, counter-compare 模块 产生 "时基 计数器 equal 至 计数器 比较 B" 事件. 此 事件 为 sent 至 action-qualifier where it 为 限定后 及 converted it 进入 单次 或 more actions. These actions CAN be applied 至 either EPWMxA 或 EPWMxB 输出 depending 开启 配置 的 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器. actions that CAN be defined 中 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器 include: • 执行 nothing. 事件 为 忽略. • 清除: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 低 • 置位: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 高 • 翻转 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 Shadowing 的 此 寄存器 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能 及 any 写入 或 读取 will automatically go 至 影子 寄存器 . 中 此 case, CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] 位 field 决定 which 事件 will 加载 活动 寄存器 来自 影子 寄存器: • Before 写入, CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] 位 CAN be 读取 至 determine 如果 影子 寄存器 为 currently 满. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用 及 any 写入 或 读取 will go directly 至 活动 寄存器 , that 为 寄存器 actively controlling 硬件. • 中 either 模式, 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：Compare B reg；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第327页；原文字段表：The value in the active CMPB register is continuously compared to the time-base counter (TBCTR). When the 

values are equal, the counter-compare module generates a "time-base counter equal to counter compare B" 
event. This event is sent to the action-qualifier where it is qualified and converted it into one or more actions. 
These actions can be applied to either the EPWMxA or the EPWMxB output depending on the configuration of 
the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers. The actions that can be defined in the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers 
include:
• Do nothing. event is ignored.
• Clear: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal low
• Set: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal high
• Toggle the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] bit. By default this register is 
shadowed.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go to 
the shadow register
. In this case, the CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] bit field determines which event will load the 
active register from the shadow register:
• Before a write, the CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] bit can be read to determine if the shadow register is currently 
full.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is disabled and any write or read will go directly to 
the active register
, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• In either mode, the active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OUT_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输出 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 输出 模式 控制 位 1 控制 S1 switch 及 位 0 控制 S0 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively 使能 或 bypass 死区 产生 用于 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟 . 00 死区 产生 为 bypassed 用于 both 输出 信号. 中 此 模式, both EPWMxA 及 EPWMxB 输出 信号 来自 action-qualifier are passed directly 至 PWM-chopper submodule. 中 此 模式, POLSEL 及 中_模式 位 have no effect.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    Dead Band Output Mode Control；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第336页；原文字段表：Dead-band Output Mode Control

Bit 1 controls the S1 switch and bit 0 controls the S0 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively enable or bypass the dead-band generation for the falling-edge and 
rising-edge delay
.
00 Dead-band generation is bypassed for both output signals. In this mode, both the EPWMxA 
and EPWMxB output signals from the action-qualifier are passed directly to the PWM-chopper 
submodule.
In this mode, the POLSEL and IN_MODE bits have no effect.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: POLSEL
Fields.Description: 极性 选择 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：极性 选择 控制 位 3 控制 S3 switch 及 位 2 控制 S2 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively invert 单次 的 delayed 信号 before it 为 sent out 的 死区 submodule. following descriptions correspond 至 classical upper/lower switch 控制 作为 found 中 单次 leg 的 数字 motor 控制 inverter . These assume that DBCTL[OUT_模式] = 1,1 及 DBCTL[中_模式] = 0,0. Other enhanced modes are also possible, but 不 regarded 作为 typical usage modes.
Fields.Notes:
原文：3:2    Polarity Select Control；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第335页；原文字段表：Polarity Select Control

Bit 3 controls the S3 switch and bit 2 controls the S2 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively invert one of the delayed signals before it is sent out of the dead-band 
submodule.
The following descriptions correspond to classical upper/lower switch control as found in one leg of 
a digital motor control inverter
.
These assume that DBCTL[OUT_MODE] = 1,1 and DBCTL[IN_MODE] = 0,0. Other enhanced 
modes are also possible, but not regarded as typical usage modes.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: IN_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输入 选择 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 带 输入 模式 控制 位 5 控制 S5 switch 及 位 4 控制 S4 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 选择 输入 来源 至 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟. 至 produce classical 死区 waveforms 默认 为 EPWMxA 中 为 来源 用于 both 下降沿 及 rising-edge delays.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5:4    Dead Band Input Select Mode Control；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第335页；原文字段表：Dead Band Input Mode Control

Bit 5 controls the S5 switch and bit 4 controls the S4 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to select the input source to the falling-edge and rising-edge delay.
To produce classical dead-band waveforms the default is EPWMxA In is the source for both falling 
and rising-edge delays.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INTPRD
Fields.Description: EPWMxINTn 周期 选择
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ePWM 中断 (ePWMx_中断) 周期 选择 These 位 determine how many 已选 ETSEL[INTSEL] events need 至 occur before 中断 为 已产生. T o be 已产生, 中断 must be 已使能 (ETSEL[中断] = 1). 如果 中断 状态 标志 为 置位 来自 前次 中断 (ETFLG[中断] = 1) then no 中断 will be 已产生 until 标志 为 cleared via ETCLR[中断] 位. 此 allows 用于 单次 中断 至 be 待处理 期间 another 为 still being serviced. Once 中断 为 已产生, ETPS[INTCNT] 位 will automatically be cleared. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 same 作为 当前 计数器 值 will 触发 中断 如果 it 为 已使能 及 状态 标志 为 清除 . Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 less than 当前 计数器 值 will 结果 中 undefined 状态. 如果 计数器 事件 发生 在 same instant 作为 new 零 或 non-zero INTPRD 值 为 written, 计数器 为 incremented.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    EPWMxINTn Period Select；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第349页；原文字段表：ePWM Interrupt (EPWMx_INT) Period Select

These bits determine how many selected ETSEL[INTSEL] events need to occur before an interrupt 
is generated. T
o be generated, the interrupt must be enabled (ETSEL[INT] = 1). If the interrupt 
status flag is set from a previous interrupt (ETFLG[INT] = 1) then no interrupt will be generated until 
the flag is cleared via the ETCLR[INT] bit. This allows for one interrupt to be pending while another 
is still being serviced. Once the interrupt is generated, the ETPS[INTCNT] bits will automatically be 
cleared.
Writing a INTPRD value that is the same as the current counter value will trigger an interrupt if it is 
enabled and the status flag is clear
.
Writing a INTPRD value that is less than the current counter value will result in an undefined state.
If a counter event occurs at the same instant as a new zero or non-zero INTPRD value is written, 
the counter is incremented.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: DCCAP
Fields.Description: 资料未提供用途说明；保留原字段名供查阅。
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：-FFFFh 数字 比较 时基 计数器 捕获 至 使能 时基 计数器 捕获, 置位 DCCAPCLT[CAPE] 位 至 1. 如果 已使能, 反映 值 的 时基 计数器 (TBCTR) 开启 低 至 高 边沿 transition 的 filtered (DCEVTFL T) 事件. Further 捕获 events are 忽略 until 下次 周期 或 零 作为 已选 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. Shadowing 的 DCCAP 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. • 如果 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能. 中 此 模式, 活动 寄存器 为 copied 至 影子 寄存器 开启 TBCTR = TBPRD 或 TBCTR = 零 作为 defined 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. CPU reads 的 此 寄存器 will return 影子 寄存器 值. • 如果 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用. 中 此 模式, CPU reads will return 活动 寄存器 值. 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第363页；原文字段表：0000-FFFFh Digital Compare Time-Base Counter Capture

To enable time-base counter capture, set the DCCAPCLT[CAPE] bit to 1.
If enabled, reflects the value of the time-base counter (TBCTR) on the low to high edge transition 
of a filtered (DCEVTFL
T) event. Further capture events are ignored until the next period or zero 
as selected by the DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit.
Shadowing of DCCAP is enabled and disabled by the DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] bit. By default 
this register is shadowed.
• If DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled. In this mode, the active 
register is copied to the shadow register on the TBCTR = TBPRD or TBCTR = zero as 
defined by the DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit. CPU reads of this register will return the shadow 
register value.
• If DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is disabled. In this mode, CPU 
reads will return the active register value.
The active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

原文：1:0    Counter Mode；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第317页；原文字段表：Counter Mode

The time-base counter mode is normally configured once and not changed during normal 
operation. If you change the mode of the counter
, the change will take effect at the next TBCLK 
edge and the current counter value shall increment or decrement from the value before the mode 
change.
These bits set the time-base counter mode of operation as follows:
00 Up-count mode
01 Down-count mode
10 Up-down-count mode

Fields.Name: TBPRD
Fields.Description: 时基周期计数值。
Fields.Values: 向上/向下计数：频率=TBCLK/(TBPRD+1)；上下计数：频率=TBCLK/(2×TBPRD)。
Fields.Notes:
原文：Time Base Period register set；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第320页；原文字段表：0000-

FFFFh
These bits determine the period of the time-base counter. This sets the PWM frequency.
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the TBCTL[PRDLD] bit. By default this 
register is shadowed.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go 
to the shadow register
. In this case, the active register will be loaded from the shadow register 
when the time-base counter equals zero.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 1, then the shadow is disabled and any write or read will go directly to the 
active register
, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• The active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.

Fields.Name: CMPB
Fields.Description: 比较 B reg
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：值 中 活动 CMPB 寄存器 为 continuously compared 至 时基 计数器 (TBCTR). 当 values are equal, counter-compare 模块 产生 "时基 计数器 equal 至 计数器 比较 B" 事件. 此 事件 为 sent 至 action-qualifier where it 为 限定后 及 converted it 进入 单次 或 more actions. These actions CAN be applied 至 either EPWMxA 或 EPWMxB 输出 depending 开启 配置 的 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器. actions that CAN be defined 中 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器 include: • 执行 nothing. 事件 为 忽略. • 清除: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 低 • 置位: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 高 • 翻转 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 Shadowing 的 此 寄存器 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能 及 any 写入 或 读取 will automatically go 至 影子 寄存器 . 中 此 case, CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] 位 field 决定 which 事件 will 加载 活动 寄存器 来自 影子 寄存器: • Before 写入, CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] 位 CAN be 读取 至 determine 如果 影子 寄存器 为 currently 满. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用 及 any 写入 或 读取 will go directly 至 活动 寄存器 , that 为 寄存器 actively controlling 硬件. • 中 either 模式, 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：Compare B reg；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第327页；原文字段表：The value in the active CMPB register is continuously compared to the time-base counter (TBCTR). When the 

values are equal, the counter-compare module generates a "time-base counter equal to counter compare B" 
event. This event is sent to the action-qualifier where it is qualified and converted it into one or more actions. 
These actions can be applied to either the EPWMxA or the EPWMxB output depending on the configuration of 
the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers. The actions that can be defined in the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers 
include:
• Do nothing. event is ignored.
• Clear: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal low
• Set: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal high
• Toggle the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] bit. By default this register is 
shadowed.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go to 
the shadow register
. In this case, the CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] bit field determines which event will load the 
active register from the shadow register:
• Before a write, the CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] bit can be read to determine if the shadow register is currently 
full.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is disabled and any write or read will go directly to 
the active register
, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• In either mode, the active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OUT_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输出 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 输出 模式 控制 位 1 控制 S1 switch 及 位 0 控制 S0 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively 使能 或 bypass 死区 产生 用于 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟 . 00 死区 产生 为 bypassed 用于 both 输出 信号. 中 此 模式, both EPWMxA 及 EPWMxB 输出 信号 来自 action-qualifier are passed directly 至 PWM-chopper submodule. 中 此 模式, POLSEL 及 中_模式 位 have no effect.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    Dead Band Output Mode Control；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第336页；原文字段表：Dead-band Output Mode Control

Bit 1 controls the S1 switch and bit 0 controls the S0 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively enable or bypass the dead-band generation for the falling-edge and 
rising-edge delay
.
00 Dead-band generation is bypassed for both output signals. In this mode, both the EPWMxA 
and EPWMxB output signals from the action-qualifier are passed directly to the PWM-chopper 
submodule.
In this mode, the POLSEL and IN_MODE bits have no effect.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: POLSEL
Fields.Description: 极性 选择 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：极性 选择 控制 位 3 控制 S3 switch 及 位 2 控制 S2 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively invert 单次 的 delayed 信号 before it 为 sent out 的 死区 submodule. following descriptions correspond 至 classical upper/lower switch 控制 作为 found 中 单次 leg 的 数字 motor 控制 inverter . These assume that DBCTL[OUT_模式] = 1,1 及 DBCTL[中_模式] = 0,0. Other enhanced modes are also possible, but 不 regarded 作为 typical usage modes.
Fields.Notes:
原文：3:2    Polarity Select Control；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第335页；原文字段表：Polarity Select Control

Bit 3 controls the S3 switch and bit 2 controls the S2 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively invert one of the delayed signals before it is sent out of the dead-band 
submodule.
The following descriptions correspond to classical upper/lower switch control as found in one leg of 
a digital motor control inverter
.
These assume that DBCTL[OUT_MODE] = 1,1 and DBCTL[IN_MODE] = 0,0. Other enhanced 
modes are also possible, but not regarded as typical usage modes.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: IN_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输入 选择 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 带 输入 模式 控制 位 5 控制 S5 switch 及 位 4 控制 S4 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 选择 输入 来源 至 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟. 至 produce classical 死区 waveforms 默认 为 EPWMxA 中 为 来源 用于 both 下降沿 及 rising-edge delays.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5:4    Dead Band Input Select Mode Control；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第335页；原文字段表：Dead Band Input Mode Control

Bit 5 controls the S5 switch and bit 4 controls the S4 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to select the input source to the falling-edge and rising-edge delay.
To produce classical dead-band waveforms the default is EPWMxA In is the source for both falling 
and rising-edge delays.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INTPRD
Fields.Description: EPWMxINTn 周期 选择
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ePWM 中断 (ePWMx_中断) 周期 选择 These 位 determine how many 已选 ETSEL[INTSEL] events need 至 occur before 中断 为 已产生. T o be 已产生, 中断 must be 已使能 (ETSEL[中断] = 1). 如果 中断 状态 标志 为 置位 来自 前次 中断 (ETFLG[中断] = 1) then no 中断 will be 已产生 until 标志 为 cleared via ETCLR[中断] 位. 此 allows 用于 单次 中断 至 be 待处理 期间 another 为 still being serviced. Once 中断 为 已产生, ETPS[INTCNT] 位 will automatically be cleared. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 same 作为 当前 计数器 值 will 触发 中断 如果 it 为 已使能 及 状态 标志 为 清除 . Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 less than 当前 计数器 值 will 结果 中 undefined 状态. 如果 计数器 事件 发生 在 same instant 作为 new 零 或 non-zero INTPRD 值 为 written, 计数器 为 incremented.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    EPWMxINTn Period Select；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第349页；原文字段表：ePWM Interrupt (EPWMx_INT) Period Select

These bits determine how many selected ETSEL[INTSEL] events need to occur before an interrupt 
is generated. T
o be generated, the interrupt must be enabled (ETSEL[INT] = 1). If the interrupt 
status flag is set from a previous interrupt (ETFLG[INT] = 1) then no interrupt will be generated until 
the flag is cleared via the ETCLR[INT] bit. This allows for one interrupt to be pending while another 
is still being serviced. Once the interrupt is generated, the ETPS[INTCNT] bits will automatically be 
cleared.
Writing a INTPRD value that is the same as the current counter value will trigger an interrupt if it is 
enabled and the status flag is clear
.
Writing a INTPRD value that is less than the current counter value will result in an undefined state.
If a counter event occurs at the same instant as a new zero or non-zero INTPRD value is written, 
the counter is incremented.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: DCCAP
Fields.Description: 资料未提供用途说明；保留原字段名供查阅。
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：-FFFFh 数字 比较 时基 计数器 捕获 至 使能 时基 计数器 捕获, 置位 DCCAPCLT[CAPE] 位 至 1. 如果 已使能, 反映 值 的 时基 计数器 (TBCTR) 开启 低 至 高 边沿 transition 的 filtered (DCEVTFL T) 事件. Further 捕获 events are 忽略 until 下次 周期 或 零 作为 已选 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. Shadowing 的 DCCAP 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. • 如果 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能. 中 此 模式, 活动 寄存器 为 copied 至 影子 寄存器 开启 TBCTR = TBPRD 或 TBCTR = 零 作为 defined 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. CPU reads 的 此 寄存器 will return 影子 寄存器 值. • 如果 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用. 中 此 模式, CPU reads will return 活动 寄存器 值. 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第363页；原文字段表：0000-FFFFh Digital Compare Time-Base Counter Capture

To enable time-base counter capture, set the DCCAPCLT[CAPE] bit to 1.
If enabled, reflects the value of the time-base counter (TBCTR) on the low to high edge transition 
of a filtered (DCEVTFL
T) event. Further capture events are ignored until the next period or zero 
as selected by the DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit.
Shadowing of DCCAP is enabled and disabled by the DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] bit. By default 
this register is shadowed.
• If DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled. In this mode, the active 
register is copied to the shadow register on the TBCTR = TBPRD or TBCTR = zero as 
defined by the DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit. CPU reads of this register will return the shadow 
register value.
• If DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is disabled. In this mode, CPU 
reads will return the active register value.
The active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CTRMODE

Fields.Values: 0：向上计数；1：向下计数；2：上下计数；3：停止/冻结。
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    Counter Mode；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第317页；原文字段表：Counter Mode

The time-base counter mode is normally configured once and not changed during normal 
operation. If you change the mode of the counter
, the change will take effect at the next TBCLK 
edge and the current counter value shall increment or decrement from the value before the mode 
change.
These bits set the time-base counter mode of operation as follows:
00 Up-count mode
01 Down-count mode
10 Up-down-count mode
11 Stop-freeze counter operation (default on reset)；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: PHSDIR
Fields.Description: 上下计数模式下，同步载入相位后的计数方向。
Fields.Values: 0：同步后向下计数；1：同步后向上计数。
Fields.Notes:
原文：13     Phase Direction；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第316页；原文字段表：Phase Direction Bit.

This bit is only used when the time-base counter is configured in the up-down-count mode. 
The PHSDIR bit indicates the direction the time-base counter (TBCTR) will count after a 
synchronization event occurs and a new phase value is loaded from the phase (TBPHS) register
. 
This is irrespective of the direction of the counter before the synchronization event..
In the up-count and down-count modes this bit is ignored.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: TBPRD
Fields.Description: 时基周期计数值。
Fields.Values: 向上/向下计数：频率=TBCLK/(TBPRD+1)；上下计数：频率=TBCLK/(2×TBPRD)。
Fields.Notes:
原文：Time Base Period register set；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第320页；原文字段表：0000-

FFFFh
These bits determine the period of the time-base counter. This sets the PWM frequency.
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the TBCTL[PRDLD] bit. By default this 
register is shadowed.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go 
to the shadow register
. In this case, the active register will be loaded from the shadow register 
when the time-base counter equals zero.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 1, then the shadow is disabled and any write or read will go directly to the 
active register
, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• The active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.
 
Enhanced Pulse Width Modulator (ePWM) Module www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CMPB
Fields.Description: 比较 B reg
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：值 中 活动 CMPB 寄存器 为 continuously compared 至 时基 计数器 (TBCTR). 当 values are equal, counter-compare 模块 产生 "时基 计数器 equal 至 计数器 比较 B" 事件. 此 事件 为 sent 至 action-qualifier where it 为 限定后 及 converted it 进入 单次 或 more actions. These actions CAN be applied 至 either EPWMxA 或 EPWMxB 输出 depending 开启 配置 的 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器. actions that CAN be defined 中 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器 include: • 执行 nothing. 事件 为 忽略. • 清除: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 低 • 置位: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 高 • 翻转 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 Shadowing 的 此 寄存器 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能 及 any 写入 或 读取 will automatically go 至 影子 寄存器 . 中 此 case, CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] 位 field 决定 which 事件 will 加载 活动 寄存器 来自 影子 寄存器: • Before 写入, CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] 位 CAN be 读取 至 determine 如果 影子 寄存器 为 currently 满. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用 及 any 写入 或 读取 will go directly 至 活动 寄存器 , that 为 寄存器 actively controlling 硬件. • 中 either 模式, 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：Compare B reg；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第327页；原文字段表：The value in the active CMPB register is continuously compared to the time-base counter (TBCTR). When the 

values are equal, the counter-compare module generates a "time-base counter equal to counter compare B" 
event. This event is sent to the action-qualifier where it is qualified and converted it into one or more actions. 
These actions can be applied to either the EPWMxA or the EPWMxB output depending on the configuration of 
the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers. The actions that can be defined in the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers 
include:
• Do nothing. event is ignored.
• Clear: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal low
• Set: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal high
• Toggle the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] bit. By default this register is 
shadowed.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go to 
the shadow register
. In this case, the CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] bit field determines which event will load the 
active register from the shadow register:
• Before a write, the CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] bit can be read to determine if the shadow register is currently 
full.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is disabled and any write or read will go directly to 
the active register
, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• In either mode, the active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OUT_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输出 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 输出 模式 控制 位 1 控制 S1 switch 及 位 0 控制 S0 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively 使能 或 bypass 死区 产生 用于 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟 . 00 死区 产生 为 bypassed 用于 both 输出 信号. 中 此 模式, both EPWMxA 及 EPWMxB 输出 信号 来自 action-qualifier are passed directly 至 PWM-chopper submodule. 中 此 模式, POLSEL 及 中_模式 位 have no effect.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    Dead Band Output Mode Control；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第336页；原文字段表：Dead-band Output Mode Control

Bit 1 controls the S1 switch and bit 0 controls the S0 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively enable or bypass the dead-band generation for the falling-edge and 
rising-edge delay
.
00 Dead-band generation is bypassed for both output signals. In this mode, both the EPWMxA 
and EPWMxB output signals from the action-qualifier are passed directly to the PWM-chopper 
submodule.
In this mode, the POLSEL and IN_MODE bits have no effect.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: POLSEL
Fields.Description: 极性 选择 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：极性 选择 控制 位 3 控制 S3 switch 及 位 2 控制 S2 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively invert 单次 的 delayed 信号 before it 为 sent out 的 死区 submodule. following descriptions correspond 至 classical upper/lower switch 控制 作为 found 中 单次 leg 的 数字 motor 控制 inverter . These assume that DBCTL[OUT_模式] = 1,1 及 DBCTL[中_模式] = 0,0. Other enhanced modes are also possible, but 不 regarded 作为 typical usage modes.
Fields.Notes:
原文：3:2    Polarity Select Control；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第335页；原文字段表：Polarity Select Control

Bit 3 controls the S3 switch and bit 2 controls the S2 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively invert one of the delayed signals before it is sent out of the dead-band 
submodule.
The following descriptions correspond to classical upper/lower switch control as found in one leg of 
a digital motor control inverter
.
These assume that DBCTL[OUT_MODE] = 1,1 and DBCTL[IN_MODE] = 0,0. Other enhanced 
modes are also possible, but not regarded as typical usage modes.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: IN_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输入 选择 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 带 输入 模式 控制 位 5 控制 S5 switch 及 位 4 控制 S4 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 选择 输入 来源 至 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟. 至 produce classical 死区 waveforms 默认 为 EPWMxA 中 为 来源 用于 both 下降沿 及 rising-edge delays.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5:4    Dead Band Input Select Mode Control；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第335页；原文字段表：Dead Band Input Mode Control

Bit 5 controls the S5 switch and bit 4 controls the S4 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to select the input source to the falling-edge and rising-edge delay.
To produce classical dead-band waveforms the default is EPWMxA In is the source for both falling 
and rising-edge delays.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ePWM 中断 (ePWMx_中断) 周期 选择 These 位 determine how many 已选 ETSEL[INTSEL] events need 至 occur before 中断 为 已产生. T o be 已产生, 中断 must be 已使能 (ETSEL[中断] = 1). 如果 中断 状态 标志 为 置位 来自 前次 中断 (ETFLG[中断] = 1) then no 中断 will be 已产生 until 标志 为 cleared via ETCLR[中断] 位. 此 allows 用于 单次 中断 至 be 待处理 期间 another 为 still being serviced. Once 中断 为 已产生, ETPS[INTCNT] 位 will automatically be cleared. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 same 作为 当前 计数器 值 will 触发 中断 如果 it 为 已使能 及 状态 标志 为 清除 . Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 less than 当前 计数器 值 will 结果 中 undefined 状态. 如果 计数器 事件 发生 在 same instant 作为 new 零 或 non-zero INTPRD 值 为 written, 计数器 为 incremented.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    EPWMxINTn Period Select；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第349页；原文字段表：ePWM Interrupt (EPWMx_INT) Period Select

These bits determine how many selected ETSEL[INTSEL] events need to occur before an interrupt 
is generated. T
o be generated, the interrupt must be enabled (ETSEL[INT] = 1). If the interrupt 
status flag is set from a previous interrupt (ETFLG[INT] = 1) then no interrupt will be generated until 
the flag is cleared via the ETCLR[INT] bit. This allows for one interrupt to be pending while another 
is still being serviced. Once the interrupt is generated, the ETPS[INTCNT] bits will automatically be 
cleared.
Writing a INTPRD value that is the same as the current counter value will trigger an interrupt if it is 
enabled and the status flag is clear
.
Writing a INTPRD value that is less than the current counter value will result in an undefined state.
If a counter event occurs at the same instant as a new zero or non-zero INTPRD value is written, 
the counter is incremented.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。
