Fields.Name: DCCAP
Fields.Description: 资料未提供用途说明；保留原字段名供查阅。
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：-FFFFh 数字 比较 时基 计数器 捕获 至 使能 时基 计数器 捕获, 置位 DCCAPCLT[CAPE] 位 至 1. 如果 已使能, 反映 值 的 时基 计数器 (TBCTR) 开启 低 至 高 边沿 transition 的 filtered (DCEVTFL T) 事件. Further 捕获 events are 忽略 until 下次 周期 或 零 作为 已选 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. Shadowing 的 DCCAP 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. • 如果 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能. 中 此 模式, 活动 寄存器 为 copied 至 影子 寄存器 开启 TBCTR = TBPRD 或 TBCTR = 零 作为 defined 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. CPU reads 的 此 寄存器 will return 影子 寄存器 值. • 如果 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用. 中 此 模式, CPU reads will return 活动 寄存器 值. 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第363页；原文字段表：0000-FFFFh Digital Compare Time-Base Counter Capture

To enable time-base counter capture, set the DCCAPCLT[CAPE] bit to 1.
If enabled, reflects the value of the time-base counter (TBCTR) on the low to high edge transition 
of a filtered (DCEVTFL
T) event. Further capture events are ignored until the next period or zero 
as selected by the DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit.
Shadowing of DCCAP is enabled and disabled by the DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] bit. By default 
this register is shadowed.
• If DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled. In this mode, the active 
register is copied to the shadow register on the TBCTR = TBPRD or TBCTR = zero as 
defined by the DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit. CPU reads of this register will return the shadow 
register value.
• If DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is disabled. In this mode, CPU 
reads will return the active register value.
The active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CTRMODE
Fields.Description: 时基计数模式。
Fields.Values: 0：向上计数；1：向下计数；2：上下计数；3：停止/冻结。
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    Counter Mode；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第317页；原文字段表：Counter Mode

The time-base counter mode is normally configured once and not changed during normal 
operation. If you change the mode of the counter
, the change will take effect at the next TBCLK 
edge and the current counter value shall increment or decrement from the value before the mode 
change.
These bits set the time-base counter mode of operation as follows:
00 Up-count mode
01 Down-count mode
10 Up-down-count mode
11 Stop-freeze counter operation (default on reset)；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

原文：9:7    High speed time pre-scale；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第317页；原文字段表：High Speed Time-base Clock Prescale Bits

These bits determine part of the time-base clock prescale value.
TBCLK = SYSCLKOUT / (HSPCLKDIV × CLKDIV)
This divisor emulates the HSPCLK in the TMS320x281x system as used on the Event Manager

Fields.Name: PHSDIR
Fields.Description: 上下计数模式下，同步载入相位后的计数方向。
Fields.Values: 0：同步后向下计数；1：同步后向上计数。
Fields.Notes:
原文：13     Phase Direction；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第316页；原文字段表：Phase Direction Bit.

This bit is only used when the time-base counter is configured in the up-down-count mode. 
The PHSDIR bit indicates the direction the time-base counter (TBCTR) will count after a 
synchronization event occurs and a new phase value is loaded from the phase (TBPHS) register
. 
This is irrespective of the direction of the counter before the synchronization event..
In the up-count and down-count modes this bit is ignored.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Notes:
原文：Time Base Counter；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第320页；原文字段表：0000-

FFFF
Reading these bits gives the current time-base counter value.
Writing to these bits sets the current time-base counter value. The update happens as soon as the write

Fields.Name: TBPRD
Fields.Description: 时基周期计数值。
Fields.Values: 向上/向下计数：频率=TBCLK/(TBPRD+1)；上下计数：频率=TBCLK/(2×TBPRD)。
Fields.Notes:
原文：Time Base Period register set；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第320页；原文字段表：0000-

FFFFh
These bits determine the period of the time-base counter. This sets the PWM frequency.
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the TBCTL[PRDLD] bit. By default this 
register is shadowed.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go 
to the shadow register
. In this case, the active register will be loaded from the shadow register 
when the time-base counter equals zero.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 1, then the shadow is disabled and any write or read will go directly to the 
active register
, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• The active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.
 
Enhanced Pulse Width Modulator (ePWM) Module www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CMPB
Fields.Description: 比较 B reg
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：值 中 活动 CMPB 寄存器 为 continuously compared 至 时基 计数器 (TBCTR). 当 values are equal, counter-compare 模块 产生 "时基 计数器 equal 至 计数器 比较 B" 事件. 此 事件 为 sent 至 action-qualifier where it 为 限定后 及 converted it 进入 单次 或 more actions. These actions CAN be applied 至 either EPWMxA 或 EPWMxB 输出 depending 开启 配置 的 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器. actions that CAN be defined 中 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器 include: • 执行 nothing. 事件 为 忽略. • 清除: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 低 • 置位: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 高 • 翻转 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 Shadowing 的 此 寄存器 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能 及 any 写入 或 读取 will automatically go 至 影子 寄存器 . 中 此 case, CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] 位 field 决定 which 事件 will 加载 活动 寄存器 来自 影子 寄存器: • Before 写入, CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] 位 CAN be 读取 至 determine 如果 影子 寄存器 为 currently 满. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用 及 any 写入 或 读取 will go directly 至 活动 寄存器 , that 为 寄存器 actively controlling 硬件. • 中 either 模式, 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：Compare B reg；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第327页；原文字段表：The value in the active CMPB register is continuously compared to the time-base counter (TBCTR). When the 

values are equal, the counter-compare module generates a "time-base counter equal to counter compare B" 
event. This event is sent to the action-qualifier where it is qualified and converted it into one or more actions. 
These actions can be applied to either the EPWMxA or the EPWMxB output depending on the configuration of 
the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers. The actions that can be defined in the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers 
include:
• Do nothing. event is ignored.
• Clear: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal low
• Set: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal high
• Toggle the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] bit. By default this register is 
shadowed.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go to 
the shadow register
. In this case, the CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] bit field determines which event will load the 
active register from the shadow register:
• Before a write, the CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] bit can be read to determine if the shadow register is currently 
full.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is disabled and any write or read will go directly to 
the active register
, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• In either mode, the active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OUT_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输出 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 输出 模式 控制 位 1 控制 S1 switch 及 位 0 控制 S0 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively 使能 或 bypass 死区 产生 用于 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟 . 00 死区 产生 为 bypassed 用于 both 输出 信号. 中 此 模式, both EPWMxA 及 EPWMxB 输出 信号 来自 action-qualifier are passed directly 至 PWM-chopper submodule. 中 此 模式, POLSEL 及 中_模式 位 have no effect.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    Dead Band Output Mode Control；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第336页；原文字段表：Dead-band Output Mode Control

Bit 1 controls the S1 switch and bit 0 controls the S0 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively enable or bypass the dead-band generation for the falling-edge and 
rising-edge delay
.
00 Dead-band generation is bypassed for both output signals. In this mode, both the EPWMxA 
and EPWMxB output signals from the action-qualifier are passed directly to the PWM-chopper 
submodule.
In this mode, the POLSEL and IN_MODE bits have no effect.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: POLSEL
Fields.Description: 极性 选择 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：极性 选择 控制 位 3 控制 S3 switch 及 位 2 控制 S2 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively invert 单次 的 delayed 信号 before it 为 sent out 的 死区 submodule. following descriptions correspond 至 classical upper/lower switch 控制 作为 found 中 单次 leg 的 数字 motor 控制 inverter . These assume that DBCTL[OUT_模式] = 1,1 及 DBCTL[中_模式] = 0,0. Other enhanced modes are also possible, but 不 regarded 作为 typical usage modes.
Fields.Notes:
原文：3:2    Polarity Select Control；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第335页；原文字段表：Polarity Select Control

Bit 3 controls the S3 switch and bit 2 controls the S2 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively invert one of the delayed signals before it is sent out of the dead-band 
submodule.
The following descriptions correspond to classical upper/lower switch control as found in one leg of 
a digital motor control inverter
.
These assume that DBCTL[OUT_MODE] = 1,1 and DBCTL[IN_MODE] = 0,0. Other enhanced 
modes are also possible, but not regarded as typical usage modes.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: IN_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输入 选择 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 带 输入 模式 控制 位 5 控制 S5 switch 及 位 4 控制 S4 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 选择 输入 来源 至 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟. 至 produce classical 死区 waveforms 默认 为 EPWMxA 中 为 来源 用于 both 下降沿 及 rising-edge delays.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5:4    Dead Band Input Select Mode Control；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第335页；原文字段表：Dead Band Input Mode Control

Bit 5 controls the S5 switch and bit 4 controls the S4 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to select the input source to the falling-edge and rising-edge delay.
To produce classical dead-band waveforms the default is EPWMxA In is the source for both falling 
and rising-edge delays.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INTPRD
Fields.Description: EPWMxINTn 周期 选择
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ePWM 中断 (ePWMx_中断) 周期 选择 These 位 determine how many 已选 ETSEL[INTSEL] events need 至 occur before 中断 为 已产生. T o be 已产生, 中断 must be 已使能 (ETSEL[中断] = 1). 如果 中断 状态 标志 为 置位 来自 前次 中断 (ETFLG[中断] = 1) then no 中断 will be 已产生 until 标志 为 cleared via ETCLR[中断] 位. 此 allows 用于 单次 中断 至 be 待处理 期间 another 为 still being serviced. Once 中断 为 已产生, ETPS[INTCNT] 位 will automatically be cleared. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 same 作为 当前 计数器 值 will 触发 中断 如果 it 为 已使能 及 状态 标志 为 清除 . Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 less than 当前 计数器 值 will 结果 中 undefined 状态. 如果 计数器 事件 发生 在 same instant 作为 new 零 或 non-zero INTPRD 值 为 written, 计数器 为 incremented.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    EPWMxINTn Period Select；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第349页；原文字段表：ePWM Interrupt (EPWMx_INT) Period Select

These bits determine how many selected ETSEL[INTSEL] events need to occur before an interrupt 
is generated. T
o be generated, the interrupt must be enabled (ETSEL[INT] = 1). If the interrupt 
status flag is set from a previous interrupt (ETFLG[INT] = 1) then no interrupt will be generated until 
the flag is cleared via the ETCLR[INT] bit. This allows for one interrupt to be pending while another 
is still being serviced. Once the interrupt is generated, the ETPS[INTCNT] bits will automatically be 
cleared.
Writing a INTPRD value that is the same as the current counter value will trigger an interrupt if it is 
enabled and the status flag is clear
.
Writing a INTPRD value that is less than the current counter value will result in an undefined state.
If a counter event occurs at the same instant as a new zero or non-zero INTPRD value is written, 
the counter is incremented.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: DCCAP
Fields.Description: 资料未提供用途说明；保留原字段名供查阅。
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：-FFFFh 数字 比较 时基 计数器 捕获 至 使能 时基 计数器 捕获, 置位 DCCAPCLT[CAPE] 位 至 1. 如果 已使能, 反映 值 的 时基 计数器 (TBCTR) 开启 低 至 高 边沿 transition 的 filtered (DCEVTFL T) 事件. Further 捕获 events are 忽略 until 下次 周期 或 零 作为 已选 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. Shadowing 的 DCCAP 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. • 如果 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能. 中 此 模式, 活动 寄存器 为 copied 至 影子 寄存器 开启 TBCTR = TBPRD 或 TBCTR = 零 作为 defined 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. CPU reads 的 此 寄存器 will return 影子 寄存器 值. • 如果 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用. 中 此 模式, CPU reads will return 活动 寄存器 值. 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第363页；原文字段表：0000-FFFFh Digital Compare Time-Base Counter Capture

To enable time-base counter capture, set the DCCAPCLT[CAPE] bit to 1.
If enabled, reflects the value of the time-base counter (TBCTR) on the low to high edge transition 
of a filtered (DCEVTFL
T) event. Further capture events are ignored until the next period or zero 
as selected by the DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit.
Shadowing of DCCAP is enabled and disabled by the DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] bit. By default 
this register is shadowed.
• If DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled. In this mode, the active 
register is copied to the shadow register on the TBCTR = TBPRD or TBCTR = zero as 
defined by the DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit. CPU reads of this register will return the shadow 
register value.
• If DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is disabled. In this mode, CPU 
reads will return the active register value.
The active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: ARBL
Fields.Description: 仲裁 丢失 中断
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Arbitration-lost 中断 标志 位 (仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 master-transmitter). ARBL primarily 表示 当 I2C 模块 has 丢失 仲裁 contest 带 another master-transmitter . CPU CAN poll ARBL 或 use ARBL 中断 请求. 0h (R/W) = 仲裁 不 丢失. AL 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - AL 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - CPU reads 中断 来源 寄存器 (I2CISRC) 及 寄存器 包含 编码 用于 AL 中断. 调试 probe reads 的 I2CISRC 执行 不 affect 此 位. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = 仲裁 丢失. AL 为 置位 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2C 模块 senses that it has 丢失 仲裁 带 two 或 more competing transmitters that started 发送 almost simultaneously . - I2C 模块 attempts 至 启动 transfer 期间 BB (总线 忙碌) 位 为 置位 至 1. 当 AL becomes 1, MST 及 STP 位 的 I2CMDR are cleared, 及 I2C 模块 becomes slave-receiver .
Fields.Notes:
原文：0      Arbitration lost interrupt；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第823页；原文字段表：Arbitration-lost interrupt flag bit (only applicable when the I2C module 

is a master-transmitter).
ARBL primarily indicates when the I2C module has lost an arbitration 
contest with another master-transmitter
. The CPU can poll ARBL or 
use the ARBL interrupt request.
0h (R/W) = Arbitration not lost. AL is cleared by any one of the 
following events:
- AL is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The CPU reads the interrupt source register (I2CISRC) and the 
register contains the code for an
AL interrupt. Debug probe reads of the I2CISRC do not affect this bit.
- The I2C module is reset.
1h (R/W) = Arbitration lost. AL is set by any one of the following 
events:
- The I2C module senses that it has lost an arbitration with two 
or more competing transmitters that started a transmission almost 
simultaneously
.
- The I2C module attempts to start a transfer while the BB (bus busy) 
bit is set to 1.
When AL becomes 1, the MST and STP bits of I2CMDR are cleared, 
and the I2C module becomes a slave-receiver
.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: NACK
Fields.Description: No ack 中断
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：No-acknowledgment 中断 标志 位. NACK applies 当 I2C 模块 为 主机 发送器. NACK 表示 是否 I2C 模块 has 已检测 应答 位 (ACK) 或 noacknowledge 位 (NACK) 来自 从机 接收器 . CPU CAN poll NACK 或 use NACK 中断 请求. 0h (R/W) = ACK received/NACK 不 已接收. 此 位 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - 应答 位 (ACK) has been sent 通过 从机 接收器. - NACK 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - CPU reads 中断 来源 寄存器 (I2CISRC) 及 寄存器 包含 编码 用于 NACK 中断. 调试 probe reads 的 I2CISRC 执行 不 af fect 此 位. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = NACK 位 已接收. 硬件 detects that no- 应答 (NACK) 位 has been 已接收. Note: 期间 I2C 模块 performs general call transfer, NACK 为 1, even 如果 单次 或 more slaves send acknowledgment.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1      No ack interrupt；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第823页；原文字段表：No-acknowledgment interrupt flag bit.

NACK applies when the I2C module is a master transmitter. NACK 
indicates whether the I2C module has detected an acknowledge bit 
(ACK) or a noacknowledge bit (NACK) from the slave receiver
. The 
CPU can poll NACK or use the NACK interrupt request.
0h (R/W) = ACK received/NACK not received. This bit is cleared by 
any one of the following events:
- An acknowledge bit (ACK) has been sent by the slave receiver.
- NACK is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The CPU reads the interrupt source register (I2CISRC) and the 
register contains the code for a NACK interrupt. Debug probe reads 
of the I2CISRC do not af
fect this bit.
- The I2C module is reset.
1h (R/W) = NACK bit received. The hardware detects that a no-
acknowledge (NACK) bit has been received.
Note: While the I2C module performs a general call transfer, NACK 
is 1, even if one or more slaves send acknowledgment.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: ARDY
Fields.Description: 寄存器 访问 就绪 中断
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Register-access-ready 中断 标志 位 (仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 中 主机 模式). ARDY 表示 that I2C 模块 寄存器 are 就绪 至 be accessed because previously programmed 地址, 数据, 及 command values have been 使用. CPU CAN poll ARDY 或 use ARDY 中断 请求. 0h (R/W) = 寄存器 are 不 就绪 至 be accessed. ARDY 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2C 模块 starts using 当前 寄存器 内容. - ARDY 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = 寄存器 are 就绪 至 be accessed. 中 nonrepeat 模式 (RM = 0 中 I2CMDR): 如果 STP = 0 中 I2CMDR, ARDY 位 为 置位 当 内部 数据 计数器 counts 下降 至 0. 如果 STP = 1, ARDY 为 不 af fected (instead, I2C 模块 产生 停止 条件 当 计数器 reaches 0). 中 重复 模式 (RM = 1): ARDY 为 置位 在 end 的 每个 字节 已发送 来自 I2CDXR. Inter-Integrated Circuit 模块 (I2C) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：2      Register access ready interrupt；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第822页；原文字段表：Register-access-ready interrupt flag bit (only applicable when the I2C 

module is in the master
mode).
ARDY indicates that the I2C module registers are ready to be 
accessed because the previously programmed address, data, and 
command values have been used. The CPU can poll ARDY or use 
the ARDY interrupt request.
0h (R/W) = The registers are not ready to be accessed. ARDY is 
cleared by any one of the following events:
- The I2C module starts using the current register contents.
- ARDY is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The I2C module is reset.
1h (R/W) = The registers are ready to be accessed.
In the nonrepeat mode (RM = 0 in I2CMDR): If STP = 0 in I2CMDR, 
the ARDY bit is set when the internal data counter counts down to 0. 
If STP = 1, ARDY is not af
fected (instead, the I2C module generates 
a STOP condition when the counter reaches 0).
In the repeat mode (RM = 1): ARDY is set at the end of each byte 
transmitted from I2CDXR.
Inter-Integrated Circuit Module (I2C) www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RRDY
Fields.Description: Recieve 数据 就绪 中断
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Receive-data-ready 中断 标志 位. 当 不 中 FIFO队列 模式, RRDY 表示 that 数据 接收 寄存器 (I2CDRR) 为 就绪 至 be 读取 because 数据 has been copied 来自 接收 shift 寄存器 (I2CRSR) 至 I2CDRR. CPU CAN poll RRDY 或 use RRDY 中断 请求 当 中 FIFO队列 模式, use RXFFINT instead. 0h (R/W) = I2CDRR 不 就绪. RRDY 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2CDRR 为 读取 通过 CPU. 调试 probe reads 的 I2CDRR 执行 不 af fect 此 位. - RRDY 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = I2CDRR 就绪: 数据 has been copied 来自 I2CRSR 至 I2CDRR.
Fields.Notes:
原文：3      Recieve data ready interrupt；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第822页；原文字段表：Receive-data-ready interrupt flag bit.

When not in FIFO mode, RRDY indicates that the data receive 
register (I2CDRR) is ready to be read because data has been copied 
from the receive shift register (I2CRSR) to I2CDRR. The CPU can 
poll RRDY or use the RRDY interrupt request When in FIFO mode, 
use RXFFINT instead.
0h (R/W) = I2CDRR not ready. RRDY is cleared by any one of the 
following events:
- I2CDRR is read by the CPU. Debug probe reads of the I2CDRR do 
not af
fect this bit.
- RRDY is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The I2C module is reset.
1h (R/W) = I2CDRR ready: Data has been copied from I2CRSR to 
I2CDRR.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: XRDY
Fields.Description: 发送 数据 就绪 中断
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Transmit-data-ready 中断 标志 位. 当 不 中 FIFO队列 模式, XRDY 表示 that 数据 发送 寄存器 (I2CDXR) 为 就绪 至 accept new 数据 because 前次 数据 has been copied 来自 I2CDXR 至 发送 shift 寄存器 (I2CXSR). CPU CAN poll XRDY 或 use XRDY 中断 请求 当 中 FIFO队列 模式, use TXFFINT instead. 0h (R/W) = I2CDXR 不 就绪. XRDY 为 cleared 当 数据 为 written 至 I2CDXR. 1h (R/W) = I2CDXR 就绪: 数据 has been copied 来自 I2CDXR 至 I2CXSR. XRDY 为 also forced 至 1 当 I2C 模块 为 复位.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4      Transmit data ready interrupt；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第822页；原文字段表：Transmit-data-ready interrupt flag bit.

When not in FIFO mode, XRDY indicates that the data transmit 
register (I2CDXR) is ready to accept new data because the previous 
data has been copied from I2CDXR to the transmit shift register 
(I2CXSR). The CPU can poll XRDY or use the XRDY interrupt 
request When in FIFO mode, use TXFFINT instead.
0h (R/W) = I2CDXR not ready. XRDY is cleared when data is written 
to I2CDXR.
1h (R/W) = I2CDXR ready: Data has been copied from I2CDXR to 
I2CXSR.
XRDY is also forced to 1 when the I2C module is reset.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SCD
Fields.Description: 停止 条件 检测
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：停止 条件 已检测 位. SCD 为 置位 当 I2C sends 或 receives 停止 条件. I2C 模块 delays clearing 的 I2CMDR[STP] 位 until SCD 位 为 置位. 0h (R/W) = 停止 条件 不 已检测 since SCD was 最后 cleared. SCD 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2CISRC 为 读取 通过 CPU 当 it 包含 值 110b (停止 条件 已检测). 调试 probe reads 的 I2CISRC 执行 不 af fect 此 位. - SCD 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = 停止 条件 has been 已检测 开启 I2C 总线.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5      Stop condition detection；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第821页；原文字段表：Stop condition detected bit.

SCD is set when the I2C sends or receives a STOP condition. The 
I2C module delays clearing of the I2CMDR[STP] bit until the SCD bit 
is set.
0h (R/W) = STOP condition not detected since SCD was last 
cleared. SCD is cleared by any one of the following events:
- I2CISRC is read by the CPU when it contains the value 110b (stop 
condition detected). Debug probe reads of the I2CISRC do not af
fect 
this bit.
- SCD is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The I2C module is reset.
1h (R/W) = A STOP condition has been detected on the I2C bus.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Description: 地址 零

Fields.Notes:
原文：8      Address Zero；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第821页；原文字段表：Address 0 bits

0h (R/W) = AD0 has been cleared by a START or STOP condition.
1h (R/W) = An address of all zeros (general call) is detected.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: AAS
Fields.Description: 地址 作为 从机
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Addressed-as-slave 位 0h (R/W) = 中 7-位 addressing 模式, AAS 位 为 cleared 当 receiving NACK, ST OP 条件, 或 repeated 启动 条件. 中 10-位 addressing 模式, AAS 位 为 cleared 当 receiving NACK, 停止 条件, 或 通过 从机 地址 different 来自 I2C 外设's own 从机 地址. 1h (R/W) = I2C 模块 has recognized its own 从机 地址 或 地址 的 全部 zeros (general call).
Fields.Notes:
原文：9      Address as slave；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第821页；原文字段表：Addressed-as-slave bit

0h (R/W) = In the 7-bit addressing mode, the AAS bit is cleared 
when receiving a NACK, a ST
OP condition, or a repeated START 
condition. In the 10-bit addressing mode, the AAS bit is cleared when 
receiving a NACK, a STOP condition, or by a slave address different 
from the I2C peripheral's own slave address.
1h (R/W) = The I2C module has recognized its own slave address or 
an address of all zeros (general call).；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: XSMT
Fields.Description: XMIT shift 空
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：发送 shift 寄存器 空 位. XSMT = 0 表示 that 发送器 has experienced 下溢. 下溢 发生 当 发送 shift 寄存器 (I2CXSR) 为 空 but 数据 发送 寄存器 (I2CDXR) has 不 been loaded since 最后 I2CDXR-to-I2CXSR transfer . 下次 I2CDXR-to-I2CXSR transfer will 不 occur until new 数据 为 中 I2CDXR. 如果 new 数据 为 不 transferred 中 时间, 前次 数据 may be re-transmitted 开启 SDA 引脚. 0h (R/W) = 下溢 已检测 (空) 1h (R/W) = No 下溢 已检测 (不 空). XSMT 为 置位 通过 单次 的 following events: - 数据 为 written 至 I2CDXR. - I2C 模块 为 复位
Fields.Notes:
原文：10     XMIT shift empty；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第821页；原文字段表：Transmit shift register empty bit.

XSMT = 0 indicates that the transmitter has experienced underflow. 
Underflow occurs when the transmit shift register (I2CXSR) is empty 
but the data transmit register (I2CDXR) has not been loaded since 
the last I2CDXR-to-I2CXSR transfer
. The next I2CDXR-to-I2CXSR 
transfer will not occur until new data is in I2CDXR. If new data is not 
transferred in time, the previous data may be re-transmitted on the 
SDA pin.
0h (R/W) = Underflow detected (empty)
1h (R/W) = No underflow detected (not empty). XSMT is set by one 
of the following events:
- Data is written to I2CDXR.
- The I2C module is reset；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RSFULL
Fields.Description: Recieve shift 满
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：接收 shift 寄存器 满 位. RSFULL 表示 溢出 条件 during 接收. 溢出 发生 当 new 数据 为 已接收 进入 shift 寄存器 (I2CRSR) 及 old 数据 has 不 been 读取 来自 接收 寄存器 (I2CDRR). 作为 new 位 arrive 来自 SDA 引脚, they overwrite 位 中 I2CRSR. new 数据 will 不 be copied 至 ICDRR until 前次 数据 为 读取. 0h (R/W) = No 溢出 已检测. RSFULL 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2CDRR 为 读取 为 读取 通过 CPU. 调试 probe reads 的 I2CDRR 执行 不 af fect 此 位. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = 溢出 已检测
Fields.Notes:
原文：11     Recieve shift full；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第821页；原文字段表：Receive shift register full bit.

RSFULL indicates an overrun condition during reception. Overrun 
occurs when new data is received into the shift register (I2CRSR) 
and the old data has not been read from the receive register 
(I2CDRR). As new bits arrive from the SDA pin, they overwrite the 
bits in I2CRSR. The new data will not be copied to ICDRR until the 
previous data is read.
0h (R/W) = No overrun detected. RSFULL is cleared by any one of 
the following events:
- I2CDRR is read is read by the CPU. Debug probe reads of the 
I2CDRR do not af
fect this bit.
- The I2C module is reset.
1h (R/W) = Overrun detected；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: BB
Fields.Description: 总线 忙碌
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：总线 忙碌 位. BB 表示 是否 I2C-bus 为 忙碌 或 为 自由运行 用于 another 数据 transfer . See paragraph following 表 用于 more information 0h (R/W) = 总线 自由运行. BB 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2C 模块 receives 或 transmits 停止 位 (总线 自由运行). - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = 总线 忙碌: I2C 模块 has 已接收 或 已发送 ST ART 位 开启 总线. Inter-Integrated Circuit 模块 (I2C) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：12     Bus busy；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第820页；原文字段表：Bus busy bit.

BB indicates whether the I2C-bus is busy or is free for another data 
transfer
. See the paragraph following the table for more information
0h (R/W) = Bus free. BB is cleared by any one of the following 
events:
- The I2C module receives or transmits a STOP bit (bus free).
- The I2C module is reset.
1h (R/W) = Bus busy: The I2C module has received or transmitted a 
ST
ART bit on the bus.
Inter-Integrated Circuit Module (I2C) www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Description: 中文释义待整理；原字段说明：no ack sent
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：NACK sent 位. 此 位 为 使用 当 I2C 模块 为 中 接收器 模式. 单次 instance 中 which NACKSNT 为 af fected 为 当 NACK 模式 为 使用 (see description 用于 NACKMOD 中 0h (R/W) = NACK 不 sent. NACKSNT 位 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - It 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - I2C 模块 为 复位 (either 当 0 为 written 至 IRS 位 的 I2CMDR 或 当 whole device 为 复位). 1h (R/W) = NACK sent: no-acknowledge 位 was sent during 应答 周期 开启 I2C-bus.
Fields.Notes:
原文：13     A no ack sent；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第820页；原文字段表：NACK sent bit.

This bit is used when the I2C module is in the receiver mode. One 
instance in which NACKSNT is af
fected is when the NACK mode is 
used (see the description for NACKMOD in
0h (R/W) = NACK not sent. NACKSNT bit is cleared by any one of 
the following events:
- It is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The I2C module is reset (either when 0 is written to the IRS bit of

1h (R/W) = NACK sent: A no-acknowledge bit was sent during the

Fields.Name: SDIR
Fields.Description: 从机 方向
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：从机 方向 位 0h (R/W) = I2C 为 不 addressed 作为 从机 发送器. SDIR 为 cleared 通过 单次 的 following events: - It 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - 数字 loopback 模式 为 已使能. - 启动 或 停止 条件 发生 开启 I2C 总线. 1h (R/W) = I2C 为 addressed 作为 从机 发送器.
Fields.Notes:
原文：14     Slave direction；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第820页；原文字段表：Slave direction bit

0h (R/W) = I2C is not addressed as a slave transmitter. SDIR is 
cleared by one of the following events:
- It is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- Digital loopback mode is enabled.
- A START or STOP condition occurs on the I2C bus.
1h (R/W) = I2C is addressed as a slave transmitter.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

OP condition.

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：位 计数 位. BC 定义 数量 的 位 (1 至 8) 中 下次 数据 字节 that 为 至 be 已接收 或 已发送 通过 I2C 模块. 数量 的 位 已选 带 BC must 匹配 数据 长度 的 other device. Notice that 当 BC = 000b, 数据 字节 has 8 位. Also, 发送 数据 written 至 I2CDXR must be right-justified 0h (R/W) = 8 位 per 数据 字节 1h (R/W) = 1 位 per 数据 字节 2h (R/W) = 2 位 per 数据 字节 3h (R/W) = 3 位 per 数据 字节 4h (R/W) = 4 位 per 数据 字节 5h (R/W) = 5 位 per 数据 字节 6h (R/W) = 6 位 per 数据 字节 7h (R/W) = 7 位 per 数据 字节 Inter-Integrated Circuit 模块 (I2C) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：2:0    Bit count；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第832页；原文字段表：Bit count bits.

BC defines the number of bits (1 to 8) in the next data byte that 
is to be received or transmitted by the I2C module. The number of 
bits selected with BC must match the data size of the other device. 
Notice that when BC = 000b, a data byte has 8 bits. BC does not 
af
fect address bytes, which always have 8 bits.
Note: If the bit count is less than 8, receive data is right-justified in 
I2CDRR(7-0), and the other bits of I2CDRR(7-0) are undefined. Also, 
transmit data written to I2CDXR must be right-justified
0h (R/W) = 8 bits per data byte
1h (R/W) = 1 bit per data byte
2h (R/W) = 2 bits per data byte
3h (R/W) = 3 bits per data byte
4h (R/W) = 4 bits per data byte
5h (R/W) = 5 bits per data byte
6h (R/W) = 6 bits per data byte
7h (R/W) = 7 bits per data byte
Inter-Integrated Circuit Module (I2C) www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: FDF
Fields.Description: 自由运行 数据 格式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：自由运行 数据 格式 模式 位. 0h (R/W) = 自由运行 数据 格式 模式 为 已禁用. Transfers use 7-/10-位 addressing 格式 已选 通过 XA 位. 1h (R/W) = 自由运行 数据 格式 模式 为 已使能. Transfers have 自由运行 数据 (no 地址) 格式 described 中 Section 9.2.5. 自由运行 数据 格式 为 不 supported 中 数字 loopback 模式 (DLB=1).
Fields.Notes:
原文：3      Free data format；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第832页；原文字段表：Free data format mode bit.

0h (R/W) = Free data format mode is disabled. Transfers use the 
7-/10-bit addressing format selected by the XA bit.
1h (R/W) = Free data format mode is enabled. Transfers have the 
free data (no address) format described in Section 9.2.5.
The free data format is not supported in the digital loopback mode 
(DLB=1).；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: STB
Fields.Description: 启动 字节
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：启动 字节 模式 位. 此 位 为 仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 主机 . 作为 described 中 version 2.1 的 Philips Semiconductors I2C-bus specification, 启动 字节 CAN be 使用 至 help 从机 that needs extra 时间 至 检测 启动 条件. 当 I2C 模块 为 从机, it ignores 启动 字节 来自 主机, regardless 的 值 的 STB 位. 0h (R/W) = I2C 模块 为 不 中 启动 字节 模式. 1h (R/W) = I2C 模块 为 中 启动 字节 模式. 当 you 置位 ST ART 条件 位 (STT), I2C 模块 begins transfer 带 more than just 启动 条件. Specifically, it 产生: 1. 启动 条件 2. 启动 字节 (0000 0001b) 3. dummy 应答 时钟 脉冲 4. repeated 启动 条件 Then, 作为 normal, I2C 模块 sends 从机 地址 that 为 中 I2CSAR.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4      Start byte；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第831页；原文字段表：START byte mode bit. This bit is only applicable when the I2C 

module is a master
. As described in version 2.1 of the Philips 
Semiconductors I2C-bus specification, the START byte can be used 
to help a slave that needs extra time to detect a START condition. 
When the I2C module is a slave, it ignores a START byte from a 
master, regardless of the value of the STB bit.
0h (R/W) = The I2C module is not in the START byte mode.
1h (R/W) = The I2C module is in the START byte mode. When 
you set the ST
ART condition bit (STT), the I2C module begins 
the transfer with more than just a START condition. Specifically, it 
generates:
1. A START condition
2. A START byte (0000 0001b)
3. A dummy acknowledge clock pulse
4. A repeated START condition
Then, as normal, the I2C module sends the slave address that is in 
I2CSAR.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: IRS
Fields.Description: I2C 复位 不
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：I2C 模块 复位 位. 0h (R/W) = I2C 模块 为 中 reset/disabled. 当 此 位 为 cleared 至 0, 全部 状态 位 (中 I2CSTR) are 置位 至 their 默认 values. 1h (R/W) = I2C 模块 为 已使能. 此 has effect 的 releasing I2C 总线 如果 I2C 外设 为 holding it.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5      I2C Reset not；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第831页；原文字段表：I2C module reset bit.

0h (R/W) = The I2C module is in reset/disabled. When this bit is 
cleared to 0, all status bits (in I2CSTR) are set to their default values.
1h (R/W) = The I2C module is enabled. This has the effect of 
releasing the I2C bus if the I2C peripheral is holding it.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: DLB
Fields.Description: 数字 loopback
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：数字 loopback 模式 位. 0h (R/W) = 数字 loopback 模式 为 已禁用. 1h (R/W) = 数字 loopback 模式 为 已使能. 用于 proper 操作 中 此 模式, MST 位 must be 1. 中 数字 loopback 模式, 数据 已发送 out 的 I2CDXR 为 已接收 中 I2CDRR after n device cycles 通过 内部 路径, where: n = ((I2C 输入 时钟 frequency/module 时钟 频率) x 8) 发送 时钟 为 also 接收 时钟. 地址 已发送 开启 SDA 引脚 为 地址 中 I2COAR. Note: 自由运行 数据 格式 (FDF = 1) 为 不 supported 中 数字 loopback 模式.
Fields.Notes:
原文：6      Digital loopback；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第831页；原文字段表：Digital loopback mode bit.

0h (R/W) = Digital loopback mode is disabled.
1h (R/W) = Digital loopback mode is enabled. For proper operation in 
this mode, the MST bit must be 1.
In the digital loopback mode, data transmitted out of I2CDXR is 
received in I2CDRR after n device cycles by an internal path, where:
n = ((I2C input clock frequency/module clock frequency) x 8)
The transmit clock is also the receive clock. The address transmitted 
on the SDA pin is the address in I2COAR.
Note: The free data format (FDF = 1) is not supported in the digital 
loopback mode.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RM
Fields.Description: 重复 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：重复 模式 位 (仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 主机- 发送器). RM, STT, 及 STP 位 determine 当 I2C 模块 starts 及 stops 数据 transmissions 0h (R/W) = Nonrepeat 模式. 值 中 数据 计数 寄存器 (I2CCNT) 决定 how many bytes are received/transmitted 通过 I2C 模块. 1h (R/W) = 重复 模式. 数据 字节 为 已发送 每个 时间 I2CDXR 寄存器 为 written 至 (或 until 发送 FIFO队列 为 空 当 中 FIFO队列 模式) until STP 位 为 manually 置位. 值 的 I2CCNT 为 忽略. ARDY bit/interrupt CAN be 使用 至 determine 当 I2CDXR (或 FIFO队列) 为 就绪 用于 more 数据, 或 当 数据 has 全部 been sent 及 CPU 为 allowed 至 写入 至 STP 位.
Fields.Notes:
原文：7      Repeat mode；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第831页；原文字段表：Repeat mode bit (only applicable when the I2C module is a master-

transmitter).
The RM, STT, and STP bits determine when the I2C module starts 
and stops data transmissions
0h (R/W) = Nonrepeat mode. The value in the data count register 
(I2CCNT) determines how many bytes are
received/transmitted by the I2C module.
1h (R/W) = Repeat mode. A data byte is transmitted each time the 
I2CDXR register is written to (or until the transmit FIFO is empty 
when in FIFO mode) until the STP bit is manually set. The value of 
I2CCNT is ignored. The ARDY bit/interrupt can be used to determine 
when the I2CDXR (or FIFO) is ready for more data, or when the data 
has all been sent and the CPU is allowed to write to the STP bit.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: XA
Fields.Description: Expand 地址
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Expanded 地址 使能 位. 0h (R/W) = 7-位 addressing 模式 (normal 地址 模式). I2C 模块 transmits 7-位 从机 addresses (来自 位 6-0 的 I2CSAR), 及 its own 从机 地址 has 7 位 (位 6-0 的 I2COAR). 1h (R/W) = 10-位 addressing 模式 (expanded 地址 模式). I2C 模块 transmits 10-位 从机 addresses (来自 位 9-0 的 I2CSAR), 及 its own 从机 地址 has 10 位 (位 9-0 的 I2COAR). Inter-Integrated Circuit 模块 (I2C) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：8      Expand address；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第830页；原文字段表：Expanded address enable bit.

0h (R/W) = 7-bit addressing mode (normal address mode). The I2C 
module transmits 7-bit slave addresses (from bits 6-0 of I2CSAR), 
and its own slave address has 7 bits (bits 6-0 of I2COAR).
1h (R/W) = 10-bit addressing mode (expanded address mode). 
The I2C module transmits 10-bit slave addresses (from bits 9-0 
of I2CSAR), and its own slave address has 10 bits (bits 9-0 of 
I2COAR).
Inter-Integrated Circuit Module (I2C) www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TRX
Fields.Description: 中文释义待整理；原字段说明：Transmitter/reciever
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：发送器 模式 位. 当 relevant, TRX 选择 是否 I2C 模块 为 中 发送器 模式 或 接收器 模式. 0h (R/W) = 接收器 模式. I2C 模块 为 接收器 及 receives 数据 开启 SDA 引脚. 1h (R/W) = 发送器 模式. I2C 模块 为 发送器 及 transmits 数据 开启 SDA 引脚.
Fields.Notes:
原文：9      Transmitter/reciever；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第830页；原文字段表：Transmitter mode bit.

When relevant, TRX selects whether the I2C module is in the 
transmitter mode or the receiver mode.
0h (R/W) = Receiver mode. The I2C module is a receiver and 
receives data on the SDA pin.
1h (R/W) = Transmitter mode. The I2C module is a transmitter and 
transmits data on the SDA pin.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: MST
Fields.Description: 中文释义待整理；原字段说明：Master/slave
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：主机 模式 位. MST 决定 是否 I2C 模块 为 中 从机 模式 或 主机 模式. MST 为 automatically changed 来自 1 至 0 当 I2C 主机 产生 ST OP 条件 0h (R/W) = 从机 模式. I2C 模块 为 从机 及 receives serial 时钟 来自 主机 . 1h (R/W) = 主机 模式. I2C 模块 为 主机 及 产生 serial 时钟 开启 SCL 引脚.
Fields.Notes:
原文：10     Master/slave；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第830页；原文字段表：Master mode bit.

MST determines whether the I2C module is in the slave mode or the 
master mode. MST is automatically changed from 1 to 0 when the 
I2C master generates a ST
OP condition
0h (R/W) = Slave mode. The I2C module is a slave and receives the 
serial clock from the master
.
1h (R/W) = Master mode. The I2C module is a master and generates 
the serial clock on the SCL pin.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: STP
Fields.Description: 停止 条件
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：停止 条件 位 (仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 主机). 中 主机 模式, RM,STT, 及 STP 位 determine 当 I2C 模块 starts 及 stops 数据 transmissions. Note that STT 及 STP 位 CAN be 使用 至 terminate 重复 模式, 及 that 此 位 为 不 writable 当 IRS=0. 当 中 非- 重复 模式, 在 最低 单次 字节 must be transferred before 停止 条件 CAN be 已产生. I2C 模块 delays clearing 的 此 位 until after I2CSTR[SCD] 位 为 置位. T o avoid disrupting I2C 状态 machine, user must wait until 此 位 为 清除 before initiating new 报文. 0h (R/W) = STP 为 automatically cleared after 停止 条件 has been 已产生 1h (R/W) = STP has been 置位 通过 device 至 产生 停止 条件 当 内部 数据 计数器 的 I2C 模块 counts 下降 至 0.
Fields.Notes:
原文：11     Stop condition；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第830页；原文字段表：STOP condition bit (only applicable when the I2C module is a 

master).
In the master mode, the RM,STT, and STP bits determine when the 
I2C module starts and stops data transmissions.
Note that the STT and STP bits can be used to terminate the repeat 
mode, and that this bit is not writable when IRS=0. When in non-
repeat mode, at least one byte must be transferred before a stop 
condition can be generated. The I2C module delays clearing of this 
bit until after the I2CSTR[SCD] bit is set. T
o avoid disrupting the 
I2C state machine, the user must wait until this bit is clear before 
initiating a new message.
0h (R/W) = STP is automatically cleared after the STOP condition 
has been generated
1h (R/W) = STP has been set by the device to generate a STOP 
condition when the internal data counter of the I2C module counts 
down to 0.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: STT
Fields.Description: 启动 条件
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：启动 条件 位 (仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 主机). RM, STT , 及 STP 位 determine 当 I2C 模块 starts 及 stops 数据 transmissions (see 表 9-6). Note that STT 及 STP 位 CAN be 使用 至 terminate 重复 模式, 及 that 此 位 为 不 writable 当 IRS = 0. 0h (R/W) = 中 主机 模式, STT 为 automatically cleared after ST ART 条件 has been 已产生. 1h (R/W) = 中 主机 模式, 设置 STT 至 1 causes I2C 模块 至 产生 ST ART 条件 开启 I2C-bus
Fields.Notes:
原文：13     Start condition；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第829页；原文字段表：START condition bit (only applicable when the I2C module is a 

master). The RM, STT
, and STP bits determine when the I2C module 
starts and stops data transmissions (see Table 9-6). Note that the 
STT and STP bits can be used to terminate the repeat mode, and 
that this bit is not writable when IRS = 0.
0h (R/W) = In the master mode, STT is automatically cleared after 
the ST
ART condition has been generated.
1h (R/W) = In the master mode, setting STT to 1 causes the I2C 
module to generate a ST
ART condition on the I2C-bus；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: FREE
Fields.Description: 仿真 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：此 位 控制 动作 taken 通过 I2C 模块 当 debugger breakpoint 为 encountered. 0h (R/W) = 当 I2C 模块 为 主机: 如果 SCL 为 低 当 breakpoint 发生, I2C 模块 stops immediately 及 keeps driving SCL 低 , 是否 I2C 模块 为 发送器 或 接收器. 如果 SCL 为 高, I2C 模块 waits until SCL becomes 低 及 then stops. 当 I2C 模块 为 从机: breakpoint forces I2C 模块 至 停止 当 当前 transmission/reception 为 complete. 1h (R/W) = I2C 模块 runs 自由运行 that 为, it continues 至 operate 当 breakpoint 发生.
Fields.Notes:
原文：14     Emulation mode；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第829页；原文字段表：This bit controls the action taken by the I2C module when a 

debugger breakpoint is encountered.
0h (R/W) = When I2C module is master:
If SCL is low when the breakpoint occurs, the I2C module stops 
immediately and keeps driving SCL low
, whether the I2C module is 
the transmitter or the receiver. If SCL is high, the I2C module waits 
until SCL becomes low and then stops.
When I2C module is slave:
A breakpoint forces the I2C module to stop when the current 
transmission/reception is complete.
1h (R/W) = The I2C module runs free
that is, it continues to operate when a breakpoint occurs.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: NACKMOD
Fields.Description: No Ack 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：NACK 模式 位. 此 位 为 仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 acting 作为 接收器 . 0h (R/W) = 中 slave-receiver 模式: I2C 模块 sends 应答 (ACK) 位 至 发送器 during 每个 应答 周期 开启 总线. I2C 模块 仅 sends no-acknowledge (NACK) 位 如果 you 置位 NACKMOD 位. 中 master-receiver 模式: I2C 模块 sends ACK 位 during 每个 应答 周期 until 内部 数据 计数器 counts 下降 至 0. 在 that point, I2C 模块 sends NACK 位 至 发送器 . 至 have NACK 位 sent earlier, you must 置位 NACKMOD 位 1h (R/W) = 中 either slave-receiver 或 master-receiver 模式: I2C 模块 sends NACK 位 至 发送器 during 下次 应答 周期 开启 总线. Once NACK 位 has been sent, NACKMOD 为 cleared. Important: 至 send NACK 位 中 下次 应答 周期, you must 置位 NACKMOD before 上升沿 边沿 的 最后 数据 位.
Fields.Notes:
原文：15     No Ack mode；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第829页；原文字段表：NACK mode bit. This bit is only applicable when the I2C module is 

acting as a receiver
.
0h (R/W) = In the slave-receiver mode: The I2C module sends an 
acknowledge (ACK) bit to the transmitter during each acknowledge 
cycle on the bus. The I2C module only sends a no-acknowledge 
(NACK) bit if you set the NACKMOD bit.
In the master-receiver mode: The I2C module sends an ACK bit 
during each acknowledge cycle until the internal data counter counts 
down to 0. At that point, the I2C module sends a NACK bit to 
the transmitter
. To have a NACK bit sent earlier, you must set the 
NACKMOD bit
1h (R/W) = In either slave-receiver or master-receiver mode: The 
I2C module sends a NACK bit to the transmitter during the next 
acknowledge cycle on the bus. Once the NACK bit has been sent, 
NACKMOD is cleared.
Important: To send a NACK bit in the next acknowledge cycle, you 
must set NACKMOD before the rising edge of the last data bit.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Registers.Name: I2caRegs.I2CISRC
Registers.Description: 中断 来源

Fields.Name: INTCODE
Fields.Description: 中断 编码
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：中断 编码 位. binary 编码 中 INTCODE 表示 事件 that 已产生 I2C 中断. CPU 读取 will 清除 此 field. 如果 another 低位 优先级 中断 为 待处理 及 已使能, 值 corresponding 至 that 中断 will then be loaded. Otherwise, 值 will stay cleared. 中 case 的 仲裁 丢失, no-acknowledgment 条件 已检测, 或 停止 条件 已检测, CPU 读取 will also 清除 associated 中断 标志 位 中 I2CSTR 寄存器 . Inversely, 中 case 的 Register-access-ready (ARDY), Receive-data-ready (RRDY), Transmit-data-ready (XRDY), 或 Adressed-as-slave (AAS) 条件, CPU 读取 will 不 清除 associated 中断 标志 位 中 I2CSTR 寄存器 调试 probe reads will 不 affect 状态 的 此 field 或 的 状态 位 中 I2CSTR 寄存器 . 0h (R/W) = None 1h (R/W) = 仲裁 丢失 2h (R/W) = No-acknowledgment 条件 已检测 3h (R/W) = 寄存器 就绪 至 be accessed 4h (R/W) = 接收 数据 就绪 5h (R/W) = 发送 数据 就绪 6h (R/W) = 停止 条件 已检测 7h (R/W) = Addressed 作为 从机
Fields.Notes:
原文：2:0    Interrupt code；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第833页；原文字段表：Interrupt code bits.

The binary code in INTCODE indicates the event that generated an 
I2C interrupt.
A CPU read will clear this field. If another lower priority interrupt is 
pending and enabled, the value corresponding to that interrupt will 
then be loaded. Otherwise, the value will stay cleared.
In the case of an arbitration lost, a no-acknowledgment condition 
detected, or a stop condition detected, a CPU read will also clear 
the associated interrupt flag bit in the I2CSTR register
. Inversely, in 
the case of a Register-access-ready (ARDY), a Receive-data-ready 
(RRDY), a Transmit-data-ready (XRDY), or an Adressed-as-slave 
(AAS) condition, a CPU read will NOT clear the associated interrupt 
flag bit in the I2CSTR register
Debug probe reads will not affect the state of this field or of the 
status bits in the I2CSTR register
.
0h (R/W) = None
1h (R/W) = Arbitration lost
2h (R/W) = No-acknowledgment condition detected
3h (R/W) = Registers ready to be accessed
4h (R/W) = Receive data ready

Fields.Name: PIEVECT
Fields.Description: Fetched 向量 地址
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：These 位 indicate 地址 within PIE 向量 表 来自 which 向量 was fetched. 最低 有效 位 的 地址 为 忽略 及 仅 位 1 至 15 的 地址 为 shown. Y ou CAN 读取 向量 值 至 determine which 中断 已产生 向量 fetch. 用于 Example: 如果 PIECTRL = 0x0D27 then 向量 来自 地址 0x0D26 (illegal 操作) was fetched.
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:1 Fetched vector address；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第166页；原文字段表：These bits indicate the address within the PIE vector table from which the vector was fetched. The least 

significant bit of the address is ignored and only bits 1 to 15 of the address is shown. Y
ou can read the 
vector value to determine which interrupt generated the vector fetch.
For Example: If PIECTRL = 0x0D27 then the vector from address 0x0D26 (illegal operation) was 
fetched.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: PARITYENA
Fields.Description: SCI奇偶校验使能。
Fields.Values: 0：禁用校验；1：使能校验。
Fields.Notes:
原文：5      Parity enable；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第778页；原文字段表：SCI parity enable.

This bit enables or disables the parity function. If the SCI is in the 
address bit multiprocessor mode (set using bit 3 of this register), the 
address bit is included in the parity calculation (if parity is enabled). 
For characters of less than eight bits, the remaining unused bits 
should be masked out of the parity calculation.
0h (R/W) = Parity disabled
no parity bit is generated during transmission or is expected during 
reception
1h (R/W) = Parity is enabled；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: PARITY
Fields.Description: SCI奇偶校验方式，仅PARITYENA=1时有效。

Fields.Notes:
原文：6      Even or Odd Parity；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第778页；原文字段表：SCI parity odd/even selection.

If the PARITY ENABLE bit (SCICCR, bit 5) is set, PARITY (bit 6) 
designates odd or even parity (odd or even number of bits with the 
value of 1 in both transmitted and received characters).
0h (R/W) = Odd parity
1h (R/W) = Even parity；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: RXENA
Fields.Description: SCI接收使能。
Fields.Values: 0：禁用接收；1：使能接收。
Fields.Notes:
原文：0      SCI receiver enable；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第781页；原文字段表：SCI receiver enable.

Data is received on the SCIRXD pin and is sent to the receiver shift 
register and then the receiver buf
fers. This bit enables or disables 
the receiver (transfer to the buffers).
Clearing RXENA stops received characters from being transferred to 
the two receiver buf
fers and also stops the generation of receiver 
interrupts. However, the receiver shift register can continue to 
assemble characters. Thus, if RXENA is set during the reception of a 
character, the complete character will be transferred into the receiver 
buffer registers, SCIRXEMU and SCIRXBUF.
0h (R/W) = Prevent received characters from transfer into the 
SCIRXEMU and SCIRXBUF receiver buf
fers
1h (R/W) = Send received characters to SCIRXEMU and SCIRXBUF；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: TXENA
Fields.Description: SCI发送使能。
Fields.Values: 0：禁用发送；1：使能发送。
Fields.Notes:
原文：1      SCI transmitter enable；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第781页；原文字段表：SCI transmitter enable.

Data is transmitted through the SCITXD pin only when TXENA is 
set. If reset, transmission is halted but only after all data previously 
written to SCITXBUF has been sent. Data written into SCITXBUF 
when TXENA is disabled will not be transmitted even if the TXENA is 
enabled later
.
0h (R/W) = Transmitter disabled
1h (R/W) = Transmitter enabled；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: SLEEP
Fields.Description: SCI 睡眠
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI 睡眠. TXWAKE 位 控制 选择 的 data-transmit feature, depending 开启 which 发送 模式 (idle-line 或 address-bit) 为 specified 在 ADDR/IDLE 模式 位 (SCICCR, 位 3). 中 multiprocessor 配置, 此 位 控制 接收器 睡眠 功能. Clearing 此 位 brings SCI out 的 睡眠 模式. 接收器 still operates 当 睡眠 位 为 置位 however, 操作 does 不 更新 接收器 缓冲 就绪 位 (SCIRXST , 位 6, RXRDY) 或 错误 状态 位 (SCIRXST, 位 5-2: BRKDT, FE, OE, 及 PE) unless 地址 字节 为 已检测. 睡眠 为 不 cleared 当 地址 字节 为 已检测. 0h (R/W) = 睡眠 模式 已禁用 1h (R/W) = 睡眠 模式 已使能
Fields.Notes:
原文：2      SCI sleep；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第781页；原文字段表：SCI sleep.

The TXWAKE bit controls selection of the data-transmit feature, 
depending on which transmit mode (idle-line or address-bit) is 
specified at the ADDR/IDLE MODE bit (SCICCR, bit 3). In a 
multiprocessor configuration, this bit controls the receiver sleep 
function. Clearing this bit brings the SCI out of the sleep mode.
The receiver still operates when the SLEEP bit is set
however, operation does not update the receiver buffer ready bit 
(SCIRXST
, bit 6, RXRDY) or the error status bits (SCIRXST, bit 
5-2: BRKDT, FE, OE, and PE) unless the address byte is detected. 
SLEEP is not cleared when the address byte is detected.
0h (R/W) = Sleep mode disabled
1h (R/W) = Sleep mode enabled；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SWRESET
Fields.Description: SCI软件复位。
Fields.Values: 0：保持SCI复位；1：释放复位、允许工作。
Fields.Notes:
原文：5      Software reset；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第780页；原文字段表：SCI software reset (active low).

Writing a 0 to this bit initializes the SCI state machines and operating 
flags (registers SCICTL2 and SCIRXST) to the reset condition. The 
SW RESET bit does not af
fect any of the configuration bits.
All affected logic is held in the specified reset state until a 1 is written 
to SW RESET (the bit values following a reset are shown beneath 
each register diagram in this section). Thus, after a system reset, 
re-enable the SCI by writing a 1 to this bit. Clear this bit after a 
receiver break detect (BRKDT flag, bit SCIRXST
, bit 5).
SW RESET affects the operating flags of the SCI, but it neither 
af
fects the configuration bits nor restores the reset values. Once SW 
RESET is asserted, the flags are frozen until the bit is deasserted.
The affected flags are as follows:
Value After SW SCI Flag Register Bit
RESET；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: TXINTENA
Fields.Description: 发送 中断 使能
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCITXBUF-register 中断 使能. 此 位 控制 中断 请求 caused 通过 设置 的 TXRDY 标志 位 (SCICTL2.7). However , it does 不 prevent TXRDY 标志 来自 being 置位 (which 表示 SCITXBUF 为 就绪 至 接收 another 字符).
Fields.Notes:
原文：0      Transmit interrupt enable；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第784页；原文字段表：SCITXBUF-register interrupt enable.

This bit controls the interrupt request caused by the setting of 
TXRDY flag bit (SCICTL2.7). However
, it does not prevent the 
TXRDY flag from being set (which indicates SCITXBUF is ready to 
receive another character).；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RXBKINTENA
Fields.Description: Receiver-buffer 中断帧 使能
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Receiver-buffer/break 中断 使能. 此 位 控制 中断 请求 caused 通过 either RXRDY 标志 或 BRKDT 标志 (位 SCIRXST .6 及 .5) being 置位. However, RX/BK 中断 ENA does 不 prevent 设置 的 these flags. 0h (R/W) = 禁用 RXRDY/BRKDT 中断 1h (R/W) = 使能 RXRDY/BRKDT 中断
Fields.Notes:
原文：1      Receiver-buffer break enable；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第784页；原文字段表：Receiver-buffer/break interrupt enable.

This bit controls the interrupt request caused by either the RXRDY 
flag or the BRKDT flag (bits SCIRXST
.6 and .5) being set. However, 
RX/BK INT ENA does not prevent the setting of these flags.
0h (R/W) = Disable RXRDY/BRKDT interrupt
1h (R/W) = Enable RXRDY/BRKDT interrupt；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TXEMPTY
Fields.Description: 发送器 空 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：发送器 空 标志. 此 标志's 值 表示 内容 的 发送器's 缓冲 寄存器 (SCITXBUF) 及 shift 寄存器 (TXSHF). 活动 软件 复位 (SCICTL1.5), 或 系统 复位, 设置 此 位. 此 位 does 不 cause 中断 请求. 0h (R/W) = 发送器 缓冲 或 shift 寄存器 或 both are loaded 带 数据 1h (R/W) = 发送器 缓冲 及 shift 寄存器 are both 空
Fields.Notes:
原文：6      Transmitter empty flag；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第784页；原文字段表：Transmitter empty flag.

This flag's value indicates the contents of the transmitter's buffer 
register (SCITXBUF) and shift register (TXSHF). An active SW 
RESET (SCICTL1.5), or a system reset, sets this bit. This bit does 
not cause an interrupt request.
0h (R/W) = Transmitter buffer or shift register or both are loaded with 
data
1h (R/W) = Transmitter buffer and shift registers are both empty；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TXRDY
Fields.Description: 发送器 就绪 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：发送器 缓冲 寄存器 就绪 标志. 当 置位, 此 位 表示 that 发送 数据 缓冲 寄存器, SCITXBUF , 为 就绪 至 接收 another 字符. Writing 数据 至 SCITXBUF automatically clears 此 位. 当 置位, 此 标志 asserts 发送器 中断 请求 如果 interrupt-enable 位, TX 中断 ENA (SCICTL2.0), 为 also 置位. TXRDY 为 置位 至 1 通过 enabling 软件 复位 位 (SCICTL1.5) 或 通过 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = SCITXBUF 为 满 1h (R/W) = SCITXBUF 为 就绪 至 接收 下次 字符
Fields.Notes:
原文：7      Transmitter ready flag；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第784页；原文字段表：Transmitter buffer register ready flag.

When set, this bit indicates that the transmit data buffer register, 
SCITXBUF
, is ready to receive another character. Writing data to the 
SCITXBUF automatically clears this bit. When set, this flag asserts 
a transmitter interrupt request if the interrupt-enable bit, TX INT ENA 
(SCICTL2.0), is also set. TXRDY is set to 1 by enabling the SW 
RESET bit (SCICTL1.5) or by a system reset.
0h (R/W) = SCITXBUF is full
1h (R/W) = SCITXBUF is ready to receive the next character；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RXWAKE
Fields.Description: 接收器 唤醒 检测 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：接收器 wake-up-detect 标志 0h (R/W) = No 检测 的 接收器 wake-up 条件 1h (R/W) = 值 的 1 中 此 位 表示 检测 的 接收器 wake-up 条件. 中 address-bit multiprocessor 模式 (SCICCR.3 = 1), RXW AKE 反映 值 的 地址 位 用于 字符 contained 中 SCIRXBUF. 中 idle-line multiprocessor 模式, RXWAKE 为 置位 如果 SCIRXD 数据 线路 为 已检测 作为 空闲. RXWAKE 为 只读 标志, cleared 通过 单次 的 following: - transfer 的 首个 字节 after 地址 字节 至 SCIRXBUF (仅 中 non-FIFO 模式) - reading 的 SCIRXBUF - 活动 软件 复位 - 系统 复位
Fields.Notes:
原文：1      Receiver wakeup detect flag；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第786页；原文字段表：Receiver wake-up-detect flag

0h (R/W) = No detection of a receiver wake-up condition
1h (R/W) = A value of 1 in this bit indicates detection of a 
receiver wake-up condition. In the address-bit multiprocessor mode 
(SCICCR.3 = 1), RXW
AKE reflects the value of the address bit for 
the character contained in SCIRXBUF. In the idle-line multiprocessor 
mode, RXWAKE is set if the SCIRXD data line is detected as idle. 
RXWAKE is a read-only flag, cleared by one of the following:
- The transfer of the first byte after the address byte to SCIRXBUF 
(only in non-FIFO mode)
- The reading of SCIRXBUF
- An active SW RESET
- A system reset；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: PE
Fields.Description: 奇偶校验 错误 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI parity-error 标志. 此 标志 位 为 置位 当 字符 为 已接收 带 mismatch between 数量 的 1s 及 its 奇偶校验 位. 地址 位 为 included 中 calculation. 如果 奇偶校验 产生 及 检测 为 不 已使能, PE 标志 为 已禁用 及 读取 作为 0. PE 位 为 复位 通过 活动 软件 复位 或 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 奇偶校验 错误 或 奇偶校验 为 已禁用 1h (R/W) = 奇偶校验 错误 为 已检测
Fields.Notes:
原文：2      Parity error flag；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第786页；原文字段表：SCI parity-error flag.

This flag bit is set when a character is received with a mismatch 
between the number of 1s and its parity bit. The address bit is 
included in the calculation. If parity generation and detection is not 
enabled, the PE flag is disabled and read as 0. The PE bit is reset by 
an active SW RESET or a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No parity error or parity is disabled
1h (R/W) = Parity error is detected；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OE
Fields.Description: 溢出 错误 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI overrun-error 标志. SCI 设置 此 位 当 字符 为 transferred 进入 寄存器 SCIRXEMU 及 SCIRXBUF before 前次 字符 为 fully 读取 通过 CPU 或 DMAC. 前次 字符 为 overwritten 及 丢失. OE 标志 位 为 复位 通过 活动 软件 复位 或 通过 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 溢出 错误 已检测 1h (R/W) = 溢出 错误 已检测
Fields.Notes:
原文：3      Overrun error flag；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第786页；原文字段表：SCI overrun-error flag.

The SCI sets this bit when a character is transferred into registers 
SCIRXEMU and SCIRXBUF before the previous character is fully 
read by the CPU or DMAC. The previous character is overwritten 
and lost. The OE flag bit is reset by an active SW RESET or by a 
system reset.
0h (R/W) = No overrun error detected
1h (R/W) = Overrun error detected；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: FE
Fields.Description: 帧格式 错误 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI framing-error 标志. SCI 设置 此 位 当 expected 停止 位 为 不 found. 仅 首个 停止 位 为 checked. 丢失 停止 位 表示 that 同步 带 启动 位 has been 丢失 及 that 字符 为 incorrectly framed. FE 位 为 复位 通过 clearing 的 软件 复位 位 或 通过 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 帧格式 错误 已检测 1h (R/W) = 帧格式 错误 已检测
Fields.Notes:
原文：4      Framing error flag；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第786页；原文字段表：SCI framing-error flag.

The SCI sets this bit when an expected stop bit is not found. Only 
the first stop bit is checked. The missing stop bit indicates that 
synchronization with the start bit has been lost and that the character 
is incorrectly framed. The FE bit is reset by a clearing of the SW 
RESET bit or by a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No framing error detected
1h (R/W) = Framing error detected；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: BRKDT
Fields.Description: Break-detect 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI break-detect 标志. SCI 设置 此 位 当 中断帧 条件 发生. 中断帧 条件 发生 当 SCI 接收器 数据 线路 (SCIRXD) remains continuously 低 用于 在 最低 ten 位, beginning after 丢失 首个 停止 位. occurrence 的 中断帧 causes 接收器 中断 至 be 已产生 如果 RX/BK 中断 ENA 位 为 1, but it does 不 cause 接收器 buf fer 至 be loaded. BRKDT 中断 CAN occur even 如果 接收器 睡眠 位 为 置位 至 1. BRKDT 为 cleared 通过 活动 软件 复位 或 通过 系统 复位. It 为 不 cleared 通过 receipt 的 字符 after 中断帧 为 已检测. 中 order 至 接收 more characters, SCI must be 复位 通过 toggling 软件 复位 位 或 通过 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 中断帧 条件 1h (R/W) = 中断帧 条件 occurred
Fields.Notes:
原文：5      Break-detect flag；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第785页；原文字段表：SCI break-detect flag.

The SCI sets this bit when a break condition occurs. A break 
condition occurs when the SCI receiver data line (SCIRXD) remains 
continuously low for at least ten bits,
beginning after a missing first stop bit. The occurrence of a break 
causes a receiver interrupt to be generated if the RX/BK INT ENA 
bit is a 1, but it does not cause the receiver buf
fer to be loaded. A 
BRKDT interrupt can occur even if the receiver SLEEP bit is set to 1. 
BRKDT is cleared by an active SW RESET or by a system reset. It 
is not cleared by receipt of a character after the break is detected. In 
order to receive more characters, the SCI must be reset by toggling 
the SW RESET bit or by a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No break condition
1h (R/W) = Break condition occurred；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RXRDY
Fields.Description: 接收器 就绪 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI receiver-ready 标志. 当 new 字符 为 就绪 至 be 读取 来自 SCIRXBUF 寄存器 , 接收器 设置 此 位, 及 接收器 中断 为 已产生 如果 RX/BK 中断 ENA 位 (SCICTL2.1) 为 1. RXRDY 为 cleared 通过 reading 的 SCIRXBUF 寄存器, 通过 活动 软件 复位, 或 通过 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No new 字符 中 SCIRXBUF 1h (R/W) = 字符 就绪 至 be 读取 来自 SCIRXBUF
Fields.Notes:
原文：6      Receiver ready flag；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第785页；原文字段表：SCI receiver-ready flag.

When a new character is ready to be read from the SCIRXBUF 
register
, the receiver sets this bit, and a receiver interrupt is 
generated if the RX/BK INT ENA bit (SCICTL2.1) is a 1. RXRDY 
is cleared by a reading of the SCIRXBUF register, by an active SW 
RESET, or by a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No new character in SCIRXBUF
1h (R/W) = Character ready to be read from SCIRXBUF；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RXERROR
Fields.Description: 接收器 错误 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI 接收器 错误 标志. RX 错误 标志 表示 that 单次 的 错误 flags 中 接收器 状态 寄存器 为 置位. RX 错误 为 logical 或 的 中断帧 检测, 帧格式 错误 , 溢出, 及 奇偶校验 错误 使能 flags (位 5-2: BRKDT, FE, OE, 及 PE). 1 开启 此 位 will cause 中断 如果 RX ERR 中断 ENA 位 (SCICTL1.6) 为 置位. 此 位 CAN be 使用 用于 fast error-condition checking during 中断 service routine. 此 错误 标志 cannot be cleared directly it 为 cleared 通过 活动 软件 复位 或 通过 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 错误 flags 置位 1h (R/W) = 错误 标志(s) 置位
Fields.Notes:
原文：7      Receiver error flag；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第785页；原文字段表：SCI receiver error flag.

The RX ERROR flag indicates that one of the error flags in the 
receiver status register is set. RX ERROR is a logical OR of the 
break detect, framing error
, overrun, and parity error enable flags 
(bits 5-2: BRKDT, FE, OE, and PE).
A 1 on this bit will cause an interrupt if the RX ERR INT ENA bit 
(SCICTL1.6) is set. This bit can be used for fast error-condition 
checking during the interrupt service routine. This error flag cannot 
be cleared directly
it is cleared by an active SW RESET or by a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No error flags set
1h (R/W) = Error flag(s) set；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TXFFIL
Fields.Description: 中断 电平
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：TXFFIL4-0 发送 FIFO队列 中断 电平 位. 发送 FIFO队列 产生 中断 whenever FIFO队列 状态 位 (TXFFST4-0) are less than 或 equal 至 FIFO队列 电平 位 (TXFFIL4-0). 最大 值 that CAN be assigned 至 these 位 至 产生 中断 cannot be more than depth 的 TX FIFO队列. 默认 值 的 these 位 after 复位 为 00000b. Users should 置位 TXFFIL 至 best fit their application needs 通过 weighing between CPU overhead 至 service ISR 及 best possible usage 的 SCI 总线 bandwidth. Serial Communications Interface (SCI) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：4:0    Interrupt level；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第790页；原文字段表：TXFFIL4-0 Transmit FIFO interrupt level bits.

The transmit FIFO generates an interrupt whenever the FIFO status 
bits (TXFFST4-0) are less than or equal to the FIFO level bits 
(TXFFIL4-0). The maximum value that can be assigned to these bits 
to generate an interrupt cannot be more than the depth of the TX 
FIFO. The default value of these bits after reset is 00000b. Users 
should set TXFFIL to best fit their application needs by weighing 
between the CPU overhead to service the ISR and the best possible 
usage of SCI bus bandwidth.
Serial Communications Interface (SCI) www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: FFTXDLY
Fields.Description: FIFO队列 发送 延迟
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：FIFO队列 transfer 延迟. These 位 define 延迟 between every transfer 来自 FIFO队列 发送 buf fer 至 发送 shift 寄存器. 延迟 为 defined 中 数量 的 SCI serial 波特率 时钟 cycles. 8 位 寄存器 could define 最小 延迟 的 0 波特率 时钟 cycles 及 最大 的 256 波特率 时钟 cycles. 中 FIFO队列 模式, 缓冲 (TXBUF) between shift 寄存器 及 FIFO队列 should be filled 仅 after shift 寄存器 has completed shifting 的 最后 位. 此 为 required 至 pass 开启 延迟 between transfers 至 数据 stream. 中 FIFO队列 模式, TXBUF should 不 be treated 作为 单次 额外 电平 的 buf fer. delayed 发送 feature will help 至 create auto-flow scheme without RTS/CTS 控制 作为 中 标准 UARTS. 当 SCI 为 configured 用于 单次 stop-bit, 延迟 introduced 通过 FFTXDL Y between 单次 帧 及 下次 帧 为 equal 至 数量 的 波特率 时钟 cycles that FFTXDLY 为 置位 至. 当 SCI 为 configured 用于 two stop-bits, 延迟 introduced 通过 FFTXDL Y between 单次 帧 及 下次 帧 为 equal 至 数量 的 波特率 时钟 cycles that FFTXDLY 为 置位 至 minus 1.
Fields.Notes:
原文：7:0    FIFO transmit delay；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第793页；原文字段表：FIFO transfer delay. These bits define the delay between every 

transfer from FIFO transmit buf
fer to transmit shift register. The delay 
is defined in the number of SCI serial baud clock cycles. The 8 bit 
register could define a minimum delay of 0 baud clock cycles and a 
maximum of 256 baud clock cycles.
In FIFO mode, the buffer (TXBUF) between the shift register and 
the FIFO should be filled only after the shift register has completed 
shifting of the last bit. This is required to pass on the delay between 
transfers to the data stream. In FIFO mode, TXBUF should not be 
treated as one additional level of buf
fer. The delayed transmit feature 
will help to create an auto-flow scheme without RTS/CTS controls as 
in standard UARTS.
When SCI is configured for one stop-bit, delay introduced by 
FFTXDL
Y between one frame and the next frame is equal to number 
of baud clock cycles that FFTXDLY is set to.
When SCI is configured for two stop-bits, delay introduced by 
FFTXDL
Y between one frame and the next frame is equal to number 
of baud clock cycles that FFTXDLY is set to minus 1.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CLKPOLARITY
Fields.Description: SPI时钟极性。
Fields.Values: 0：空闲低电平；1：空闲高电平。采样边沿还取决于CLK_PHASE。
Fields.Notes:
原文：6      Clock polarity；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第743页；原文字段表：Shift Clock Polarity

This bit controls the polarity of the SPICLK signal. CLOCK 
POLARITY and POLARITY CLOCK PHASE (SPICTL.3) control four 
clocking schemes on the SPICLK pin.
0h (R/W) = Data is output on rising edge and input on falling edge. 
When no SPI data is sent, SPICLK is at low level. The data input 
and output edges depend on the value of the CLOCK PHASE bit 
(SPICTL.3) as follows:
- CLOCK PHASE = 0: Data is output on the rising edge of the 
SPICLK signal. Input data is latched on the falling edge of the 
SPICLK signal.
- CLOCK PHASE = 1: Data is output one half-cycle before the first 
rising edge of the SPICLK signal and on subsequent falling edges 
of the SPICLK signal. Input data is latched on the rising edge of the 
SPICLK signal.
1h (R/W) = Data is output on falling edge and input on rising edge. 
When no SPI data is sent, SPICLK is at high level. The data input 
and output edges depend on the value of the CLOCK PHASE bit 
(SPICTL.3) as follows:
- CLOCK PHASE = 0: Data is output on the falling edge of the 
SPICLK signal. Input data is latched on the rising edge of the 
SPICLK signal.
- CLOCK PHASE = 1: Data is output one half-cycle before the first 
falling edge of the SPICLK signal and on subsequent rising edges of 
the SPICLK signal. Input data is latched on the falling edge of the 
SPICLK signal.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

When changing configuration, you should clear this bit before the 
changes and set this bit before resuming operation.
0h (R/W) = Initializes the SPI operating flags to the reset condition. 
Specifically
, the RECEIVER OVERRUN Flag bit (SPISTS.7), the 
SPI INT FLAG bit (SPISTS.6), and the TXBUF FULL Flag bit 
(SPISTS.5) are cleared. SPISTE will become inactive. SPICLK will 
be immediately driven to 0 regardless of the clock polarity. The SPI 
configuration remains unchanged.
1h (R/W) = SPI is ready to transmit or receive the next character. 
When the SPI SW RESET bit is a 0, a character written to the 
transmitter will not be shifted out when this bit is set. A new character 
must be written to the serial data register
. SPICLK will be returned to 
its inactive state one SPICLK cycle after this bit is set.

Use FIFO队列 状态, 或 FIFO队列 中断 位 用于 similar functionality . 0h (R/W) = No 满 words have been 已接收 或 已发送. 1h (R/W) = 表示 that SPI has completed sending 或 receiving 最后 位 及 为 就绪 至 be serviced.

原文：6      SPI interrupt flag；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第748页；原文字段表：SPI Interrupt Flag

that the SPI has completed sending or receiving the last bit and is 
ready to be serviced. This flag causes an interrupt to be requested 
if the SPI INT ENA bit (SPICTL.0) is set. The received character is

fer at the same time this bit is set. This bit is

- Resetting the system

internal process of copying the received word from SPIRXBUF to 
the Receive FIFO will clear this bit. Use the FIFO status, or FIFO 
interrupt bits for similar functionality
.

receiving the last bit and is ready to be serviced.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: rsvd2
Fields.Description: 保留位；不要用于用户配置。
Fields.Values: 按该寄存器手册要求保留；不得假定保留位都可写0。
Fields.Notes:
保留位不得用于配置。；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第747页；原文字段表：Reserved

7 *OVERRUN_FLAG W1C 0h SPI Receiver Overrun Flag
This bit is a read/clear-only flag. The SPI hardware sets this bit 
when a receive or transmit operation completes before the previous 
character has been read from the buf
fer. The bit is cleared in one of 
three ways:
- Writing a 1 to this bit
- Writing a 0 to SPI SW RESET (SPICCR.7)
- Resetting the system
If the OVERRUN INT ENA bit (SPICTL.4) is set, the SPI requests 
only one interrupt upon the first occurrence of setting the RECEIVER 
OVERRUN Flag bit. Subsequent overruns will not request additional 
interrupts if this flag bit is already set. This means that in order to 
allow new overrun interrupt requests the user must clear this flag bit 
by writing a 1 to SPISTS.7 each time an overrun condition occurs. 
In other words, if the RECEIVER OVERRUN Flag bit is left set (not 
cleared) by the interrupt service routine, another overrun interrupt will 
not be immediately re-entered when the interrupt service routine is 
exited.
0h (R/W) = A receive overrun condition has not occurred.
1h (R/W) = The last received character has been overwritten 
and therefore lost (when the SPIRXBUF was overwritten by the 
SPI module before the previous character was read by the user 
application).
Writing a '1' will clear this bit. The RECEIVER OVERRUN Flag bit 
should be cleared during the interrupt service routine because the 
RECEIVER OVERRUN Flag bit and SPI INT FLAG bit (SPISTS.6) 
share the same interrupt vector
. This will alleviate any possible doubt 
as to the source of the interrupt when the next byte is received.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TXDLY
Fields.Description: FIFO队列 发送 延迟
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：FIFO队列 发送 延迟 位 These 位 define 延迟 between every transfer 来自 FIFO队列 发送 buf fer 至 发送 shift 寄存器. 延迟 为 defined 中 数量 SPI serial 时钟 cycles. 8-位 寄存器 could define 最小 延迟 的 0 serial 时钟 cycles 及 最大 的 255 serial 时钟 cycles. 中 FIFO队列 模式, 缓冲 (TXBUF) between shift 寄存器 及 FIFO队列 should be filled 仅 after shift 寄存器 has completed shifting 的 最后 位. 此 为 required 至 pass 开启 延迟 between transfers 至 数据 stream. 中 FIFO队列 模式 TXBUF should 不 be treated 作为 单次 额外 电平 的 缓冲. 0h (R/W) = 下次 字 中 TX FIFO队列 缓冲 为 transferred 至 SPITXBUF immediately upon completion 的 发送 的 前次 字. 1h (R/W) = 下次 字 中 TX FIFO队列 缓冲 为 transferred 至 SPITXBUF1 serial 时钟 周期 after completion 的 发送 的 前次 字. 2h (R/W) = 下次 字 中 TX FIFO队列 缓冲 为 transferred 至 SPITXBUF 2 serial 时钟 cycles after completion 的 发送 的 前次 字. FFh (R/W) = 下次 字 中 TX FIFO队列 缓冲 为 transferred 至 SPITXBUF 255 serial 时钟 cycles after completion 的 发送 的 前次 字.
Fields.Notes:
原文：7:0    FIFO transmit delay；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第757页；原文字段表：FIFO Transmit Delay Bits

These bits define the delay between every transfer from FIFO 
transmit buf
fer to transmit shift register. The delay is defined in 
number SPI serial clock cycles. The 8-bit register could define a 
minimum delay of 0 serial clock cycles and a maximum of 255 serial 
clock cycles. In FIFO mode, the buffer (TXBUF) between the shift 
register and the FIFO should be filled only after the shift register 
has completed shifting of the last bit. This is required to pass on 
the delay between transfers to the data stream. In the FIFO mode 
TXBUF should not be treated as one additional level of buffer.
0h (R/W) = The next word in the TX FIFO buffer is transferred 
to SPITXBUF immediately upon completion of transmission of the 
previous word.
1h (R/W) = The next word in the TX FIFO buffer is transferred to 
SPITXBUF1 serial clock cycle after completion of transmission of the 
previous word.
2h (R/W) = The next word in the TX FIFO buffer is transferred to 
SPITXBUF 2 serial clock cycles after completion of transmission of 
the previous word.
FFh (R/W) = The next word in the TX FIFO buffer is transferred to 
SPITXBUF 255 serial clock cycles after completion of transmission of 
the previous word.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: FREE
Fields.Description: 自由运行 仿真 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：仿真 自由运行 Run These 位 determine what 发生 当 仿真 暂停 发生 (用于 example, 当 debugger hits breakpoint). 外设 CAN continue whatever it 为 doing (free-run 模式) 或 , 如果 中 停止 模式, it CAN either 停止 immediately 或 停止 当 当前 操作 ( 当前 receive/transmit sequence) 为 complete. 0h (R/W) = 仿真 模式 为 已选 通过 软 位 1h (R/W) = 自由运行 run, continue SPI 操作 regardless 的 暂停 或 当 暂停 occurred.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4      Free emulation mode control；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第758页；原文字段表：Emulation Free Run

These bits determine what occurs when an emulation suspend 
occurs (for example, when the debugger hits a breakpoint). The 
peripheral can continue whatever it is doing (free-run mode) or
, if in 
stop mode, it can either stop immediately or stop when the current 
operation (the current receive/transmit sequence) is complete.
0h (R/W) = Emulation mode is selected by the SOFT bit
1h (R/W) = Free run, continue SPI operation regardless of suspend 
or when the suspend occurred.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SOFT
Fields.Description: 软 仿真 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：仿真 软 Run 此 位 仅 has effect 当 自由运行 位 为 0. 0h (R/W) = 发送 stops midway 中 位 stream 期间 TSUSPEND 为 已置有效. Once TSUSPEND 为 deasserted without 系统 复位, 余数 的 位 待处理 中 DA TBUF are shifted. Example: 如果 SPIDAT has shifted 3 out 的 8 位, communication freezes right there. However, 如果 TSUSPEND 为 later deasserted without 复位 SPI, SPI starts transmitting 来自 where it had stopped (fourth 位 中 此 case) 及 will 发送 8 位 来自 that point. 1h (R/W) = 如果 仿真 暂停 发生 before 启动 的 发送, (that 为, before 首个 SPICLK 脉冲) then 发送 will 不 occur . 如果 仿真 暂停 发生 after 启动 的 发送, then 数据 will be shifted out 至 completion. 当 启动 的 发送 发生 为 dependent 开启 波特率 速率 使用. 标准 SPI 模式: 停止 after transmitting words 中 shift 寄存器 及 buf fer. That 为, after TXBUF 及 SPIDAT are 空. 中 FIFO队列 模式: 停止 after transmitting words 中 shift 寄存器 及 buf fer. That 为, after TX FIFO队列 及 SPIDAT are 空.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5      Soft emulation mode control；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第758页；原文字段表：Emulation Soft Run

This bit only has an effect when the FREE bit is 0.
0h (R/W) = Transmission stops midway in the bit stream while 
TSUSPEND is asserted. Once TSUSPEND is deasserted without 
a system reset, the remainder of the bits pending in the DA
TBUF 
are shifted. Example: If SPIDAT has shifted 3 out of 8 bits, the 
communication freezes right there. However, if TSUSPEND is later 
deasserted without resetting the SPI, SPI starts transmitting from 
where it had stopped (fourth bit in this case) and will transmit 8 bits 
from that point.
1h (R/W) = If the emulation suspend occurs before the start of 
a transmission, (that is, before the first SPICLK pulse) then the 
transmission will not occur
. If the emulation suspend occurs after 
the start of a transmission, then the data will be shifted out to 
completion. When the start of transmission occurs is dependent on 
the baud rate used.
Standard SPI mode: Stop after transmitting the words in the shift 
register and buf
fer. That is, after TXBUF and SPIDAT are empty.
In FIFO mode: Stop after transmitting the words in the shift register 
and buf
fer. That is, after TX FIFO and SPIDAT are empty.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CLKPOLARITY
Fields.Description: SPI时钟极性。
Fields.Values: 0：空闲低电平；1：空闲高电平。采样边沿还取决于CLK_PHASE。
Fields.Notes:
原文：6      Clock polarity；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第743页；原文字段表：Shift Clock Polarity

This bit controls the polarity of the SPICLK signal. CLOCK 
POLARITY and POLARITY CLOCK PHASE (SPICTL.3) control four 
clocking schemes on the SPICLK pin.
0h (R/W) = Data is output on rising edge and input on falling edge. 
When no SPI data is sent, SPICLK is at low level. The data input 
and output edges depend on the value of the CLOCK PHASE bit 
(SPICTL.3) as follows:
- CLOCK PHASE = 0: Data is output on the rising edge of the 
SPICLK signal. Input data is latched on the falling edge of the 
SPICLK signal.
- CLOCK PHASE = 1: Data is output one half-cycle before the first 
rising edge of the SPICLK signal and on subsequent falling edges 
of the SPICLK signal. Input data is latched on the rising edge of the 
SPICLK signal.
1h (R/W) = Data is output on falling edge and input on rising edge. 
When no SPI data is sent, SPICLK is at high level. The data input 
and output edges depend on the value of the CLOCK PHASE bit 
(SPICTL.3) as follows:
- CLOCK PHASE = 0: Data is output on the falling edge of the 
SPICLK signal. Input data is latched on the rising edge of the 
SPICLK signal.
- CLOCK PHASE = 1: Data is output one half-cycle before the first 
falling edge of the SPICLK signal and on subsequent rising edges of 
the SPICLK signal. Input data is latched on the falling edge of the 
SPICLK signal.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI10A / 2022-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: SPISWRESET
Fields.Description: SPI软件复位。
Fields.Values: 0：保持SPI复位；1：释放复位。
Fields.Notes:
原文：7      SPI SW Reset；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第742页；原文字段表：SPI Software Reset

When changing configuration, you should clear this bit before the 
changes and set this bit before resuming operation.
0h (R/W) = Initializes the SPI operating flags to the reset condition. 
Specifically
, the RECEIVER OVERRUN Flag bit (SPISTS.7), the 
SPI INT FLAG bit (SPISTS.6), and the TXBUF FULL Flag bit 
(SPISTS.5) are cleared. SPISTE will become inactive. SPICLK will 
be immediately driven to 0 regardless of the clock polarity. The SPI 
configuration remains unchanged.
1h (R/W) = SPI is ready to transmit or receive the next character. 
When the SPI SW RESET bit is a 0, a character written to the 
transmitter will not be shifted out when this bit is set. A new character 
must be written to the serial data register
. SPICLK will be returned to 
its inactive state one SPICLK cycle after this bit is set.

ALK

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SPI 时钟 相位 选择 此 位 控制 相位 的 SPICLK 信号. 时钟 相位 及 时钟 极性 (SPICCR.6) make four dif ferent 时钟 schemes possible (see 时钟 figures 中 SPI chapter). 当 工作 带 时钟 相位 高, SPI (主机 或 从机) makes 首个 位 的 数据 available after SPIDAT 为 written 及 before 首个 边沿 的 SPICLK 信号, regardless 的 which SPI 模式 为 being 使用. 0h (R/W) = Normal SPI 时钟 scheme, depending 开启 时钟 极性 位 (SPICCR.6). 1h (R/W) = SPICLK 信号 delayed 通过 单次 半周期. 极性 determined 通过 时钟 极性 位.
