Fields.Name: INT_FLAG
Fields.Description: SPI 中断 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SPI 中断 标志 SPI 中断 标志 为 只读 标志. 硬件 设置 此 位 至 indicate that SPI has completed sending 或 receiving 最后 位 及 为 就绪 至 be serviced. 此 标志 causes 中断 至 be requested 如果 SPI 中断 ENA 位 (SPICTL.0) 为 置位. 已接收 字符 为 placed 中 接收器 buf fer 在 same 时间 此 位 为 置位. 此 位 为 cleared 中 单次 的 three ways: - Reading SPIRXBUF - Writing 0 至 SPI 软件 复位 (SPICCR.7) - 复位 系统 Note: 此 位 should 不 be 使用 如果 FIFO队列 模式 为 已使能. 内部 process 的 copying 已接收 字 来自 SPIRXBUF 至 接收 FIFO队列 will 清除 此 位. Use FIFO队列 状态, 或 FIFO队列 中断 位 用于 similar functionality . 0h (R/W) = No 满 words have been 已接收 或 已发送. 1h (R/W) = 表示 that SPI has completed sending 或 receiving 最后 位 及 为 就绪 至 be serviced.
Fields.Notes:
原文：6      SPI interrupt flag；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第748页；原文字段表：SPI Interrupt Flag

SPI INT FLAG is a read-only flag. Hardware sets this bit to indicate 
that the SPI has completed sending or receiving the last bit and is 
ready to be serviced. This flag causes an interrupt to be requested 
if the SPI INT ENA bit (SPICTL.0) is set. The received character is 
placed in the receiver buf
fer at the same time this bit is set. This bit is 
cleared in one of three ways:
- Reading SPIRXBUF
- Writing a 0 to SPI SW RESET (SPICCR.7)
- Resetting the system
Note: This bit should not be used if FIFO mode is enabled. The 
internal process of copying the received word from SPIRXBUF to 
the Receive FIFO will clear this bit. Use the FIFO status, or FIFO 
interrupt bits for similar functionality
.
0h (R/W) = No full words have been received or transmitted.
1h (R/W) = Indicates that the SPI has completed sending or 
receiving the last bit and is ready to be serviced.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: rsvd2
Fields.Description: 保留位；不要用于用户配置。

7 *OVERRUN_FLAG W1C 0h SPI Receiver Overrun Flag
This bit is a read/clear-only flag. The SPI hardware sets this bit 
when a receive or transmit operation completes before the previous 
character has been read from the buf
fer. The bit is cleared in one of 
three ways:
- Writing a 1 to this bit
- Writing a 0 to SPI SW RESET (SPICCR.7)
- Resetting the system
If the OVERRUN INT ENA bit (SPICTL.4) is set, the SPI requests 
only one interrupt upon the first occurrence of setting the RECEIVER 
OVERRUN Flag bit. Subsequent overruns will not request additional 
interrupts if this flag bit is already set. This means that in order to 
allow new overrun interrupt requests the user must clear this flag bit 
by writing a 1 to SPISTS.7 each time an overrun condition occurs. 
In other words, if the RECEIVER OVERRUN Flag bit is left set (not 
cleared) by the interrupt service routine, another overrun interrupt will 
not be immediately re-entered when the interrupt service routine is 
exited.
0h (R/W) = A receive overrun condition has not occurred.
1h (R/W) = The last received character has been overwritten 
and therefore lost (when the SPIRXBUF was overwritten by the 
SPI module before the previous character was read by the user 
application).
Writing a '1' will clear this bit. The RECEIVER OVERRUN Flag bit 
should be cleared during the interrupt service routine because the 
RECEIVER OVERRUN Flag bit and SPI INT FLAG bit (SPISTS.6) 
share the same interrupt vector
. This will alleviate any possible doubt 
as to the source of the interrupt when the next byte is received.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TXDLY
Fields.Description: FIFO队列 发送 延迟
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：FIFO队列 发送 延迟 位 These 位 define 延迟 between every transfer 来自 FIFO队列 发送 buf fer 至 发送 shift 寄存器. 延迟 为 defined 中 数量 SPI serial 时钟 cycles. 8-位 寄存器 could define 最小 延迟 的 0 serial 时钟 cycles 及 最大 的 255 serial 时钟 cycles. 中 FIFO队列 模式, 缓冲 (TXBUF) between shift 寄存器 及 FIFO队列 should be filled 仅 after shift 寄存器 has completed shifting 的 最后 位. 此 为 required 至 pass 开启 延迟 between transfers 至 数据 stream. 中 FIFO队列 模式 TXBUF should 不 be treated 作为 单次 额外 电平 的 缓冲. 0h (R/W) = 下次 字 中 TX FIFO队列 缓冲 为 transferred 至 SPITXBUF immediately upon completion 的 发送 的 前次 字. 1h (R/W) = 下次 字 中 TX FIFO队列 缓冲 为 transferred 至 SPITXBUF1 serial 时钟 周期 after completion 的 发送 的 前次 字. 2h (R/W) = 下次 字 中 TX FIFO队列 缓冲 为 transferred 至 SPITXBUF 2 serial 时钟 cycles after completion 的 发送 的 前次 字. FFh (R/W) = 下次 字 中 TX FIFO队列 缓冲 为 transferred 至 SPITXBUF 255 serial 时钟 cycles after completion 的 发送 的 前次 字.
Fields.Notes:
原文：7:0    FIFO transmit delay；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第757页；原文字段表：FIFO Transmit Delay Bits

These bits define the delay between every transfer from FIFO 
transmit buf
fer to transmit shift register. The delay is defined in 
number SPI serial clock cycles. The 8-bit register could define a 
minimum delay of 0 serial clock cycles and a maximum of 255 serial 
clock cycles. In FIFO mode, the buffer (TXBUF) between the shift 
register and the FIFO should be filled only after the shift register 
has completed shifting of the last bit. This is required to pass on 
the delay between transfers to the data stream. In the FIFO mode 
TXBUF should not be treated as one additional level of buffer.
0h (R/W) = The next word in the TX FIFO buffer is transferred 
to SPITXBUF immediately upon completion of transmission of the 
previous word.
1h (R/W) = The next word in the TX FIFO buffer is transferred to 
SPITXBUF1 serial clock cycle after completion of transmission of the 
previous word.
2h (R/W) = The next word in the TX FIFO buffer is transferred to 
SPITXBUF 2 serial clock cycles after completion of transmission of 
the previous word.
FFh (R/W) = The next word in the TX FIFO buffer is transferred to 
SPITXBUF 255 serial clock cycles after completion of transmission of 
the previous word.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

原文：0      3-wire mode select bit；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第759页；原文字段表：SPI 3-wire Mode Enable

0h (R/W) = Normal 4-wire SPI mode.

Fields.Name: FREE
Fields.Description: 自由运行 仿真 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：仿真 自由运行 Run These 位 determine what 发生 当 仿真 暂停 发生 (用于 example, 当 debugger hits breakpoint). 外设 CAN continue whatever it 为 doing (free-run 模式) 或 , 如果 中 停止 模式, it CAN either 停止 immediately 或 停止 当 当前 操作 ( 当前 receive/transmit sequence) 为 complete. 0h (R/W) = 仿真 模式 为 已选 通过 软 位 1h (R/W) = 自由运行 run, continue SPI 操作 regardless 的 暂停 或 当 暂停 occurred.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4      Free emulation mode control；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第758页；原文字段表：Emulation Free Run

These bits determine what occurs when an emulation suspend 
occurs (for example, when the debugger hits a breakpoint). The 
peripheral can continue whatever it is doing (free-run mode) or
, if in 
stop mode, it can either stop immediately or stop when the current 
operation (the current receive/transmit sequence) is complete.
0h (R/W) = Emulation mode is selected by the SOFT bit
1h (R/W) = Free run, continue SPI operation regardless of suspend 
or when the suspend occurred.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SOFT
Fields.Description: 软 仿真 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：仿真 软 Run 此 位 仅 has effect 当 自由运行 位 为 0. 0h (R/W) = 发送 stops midway 中 位 stream 期间 TSUSPEND 为 已置有效. Once TSUSPEND 为 deasserted without 系统 复位, 余数 的 位 待处理 中 DA TBUF are shifted. Example: 如果 SPIDAT has shifted 3 out 的 8 位, communication freezes right there. However, 如果 TSUSPEND 为 later deasserted without 复位 SPI, SPI starts transmitting 来自 where it had stopped (fourth 位 中 此 case) 及 will 发送 8 位 来自 that point. 1h (R/W) = 如果 仿真 暂停 发生 before 启动 的 发送, (that 为, before 首个 SPICLK 脉冲) then 发送 will 不 occur . 如果 仿真 暂停 发生 after 启动 的 发送, then 数据 will be shifted out 至 completion. 当 启动 的 发送 发生 为 dependent 开启 波特率 速率 使用. 标准 SPI 模式: 停止 after transmitting words 中 shift 寄存器 及 buf fer. That 为, after TXBUF 及 SPIDAT are 空. 中 FIFO队列 模式: 停止 after transmitting words 中 shift 寄存器 及 buf fer. That 为, after TX FIFO队列 及 SPIDAT are 空.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5      Soft emulation mode control；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第758页；原文字段表：Emulation Soft Run

This bit only has an effect when the FREE bit is 0.
0h (R/W) = Transmission stops midway in the bit stream while 
TSUSPEND is asserted. Once TSUSPEND is deasserted without 
a system reset, the remainder of the bits pending in the DA
TBUF 
are shifted. Example: If SPIDAT has shifted 3 out of 8 bits, the 
communication freezes right there. However, if TSUSPEND is later 
deasserted without resetting the SPI, SPI starts transmitting from 
where it had stopped (fourth bit in this case) and will transmit 8 bits 
from that point.
1h (R/W) = If the emulation suspend occurs before the start of 
a transmission, (that is, before the first SPICLK pulse) then the 
transmission will not occur
. If the emulation suspend occurs after 
the start of a transmission, then the data will be shifted out to 
completion. When the start of transmission occurs is dependent on 
the baud rate used.
Standard SPI mode: Stop after transmitting the words in the shift 
register and buf
fer. That is, after TXBUF and SPIDAT are empty.
In FIFO mode: Stop after transmitting the words in the shift register 
and buf
fer. That is, after TX FIFO and SPIDAT are empty.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OSCCLKSRCSEL
Fields.Description: 振荡器 时钟 来源 选择 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：振荡器 时钟 源 选择 位. 此 位 选择 来源 用于 OSCCLK. 开启 XRS 低 及 after XRS goes 高, 内部 振荡器 1 为 已选 通过 默认. User would need 至 选择 外部 振荡器 或 内部 振荡器 2 during their 初始化 process. Whenever user changes 时钟 来源 using these 位, PLLCR 寄存器 will be automatically forced 至 零. 此 prevents potential PLL overshoot. user will then have 至 写入 至 PLLCR 寄存器 至 configure appropriate PLL 倍频器 值. user CAN also configure PLL 锁定 周期 using PLLLOCKPRD 寄存器 至 reduce 锁定 时间 如果 necessary . 如果 丢失 时钟 检测 circuit detects 丢失 时钟, then 此 位 为 automatically forced 至 0 及 内部 振荡器 1 为 已选. PLLCR 寄存器 will also be automatically forced 至 零 至 prevent any potential overshoot.
Fields.Notes:
原文：0   Oscillator clock source select bit；SPRUI10A / 2022-06 PDF第66页；原文字段表：Oscillator Clock Source Select Bit. This bit selects the source for OSCCLK. On XRS 

low and after XRS goes high, internal oscillator 1 is selected by default. User would 
need to select external oscillator or Internal Oscillator 2 during their initialization process. 
Whenever the user changes the clock source using these bits, the PLLCR register will 
be automatically forced to zero. This prevents potential PLL overshoot. The user will then 
have to write to the PLLCR register to configure the appropriate PLL multiplier value. The 
user can also configure the PLL lock period using the PLLLOCKPRD register to reduce 
the lock time if necessary
. If missing clock detect circuit detects a missing clock, then this 
bit is automatically forced to 0 and internal oscillator 1 is selected. The PLLCR register 
will also be automatically forced to zero to prevent any potential overshoot.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Notes:
原文：4     Cascaded sequencer mode；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第479页；原文字段表：Cascaded sequencer operation. This bit determines whether SEQ1

and SEQ2 operate as two 8-state sequencers or as a single 16-state
sequencer (SEQ).
0h = Dual-sequencer mode. SEQ1 and SEQ2 operate as two 8-state
sequencers.
1h = Cascaded mode. SEQ1 and SEQ2 operate as a single 16-state
sequencer (SEQ).；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SEQ_OVRD
Fields.Description: 中文释义待整理；原字段说明：Sequencer override
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Sequencer override. Provides 额外 sequencer flexibility 中 连续 run 模式 通过 overriding wrapping around 在 end 的 conversions 置位 通过 最大_CONVn. 0h = 已禁用 - Allows sequencer 至 wrap around 在 end 的 conversions 置位 通过 最大_CONVn. 1h = 已使能 - Overrides sequencer 来自 wrapping around 在 end 的 conversions 置位 通过 最大_CONVn. Wraparound 发生 仅 在 end 的 sequencer.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5     Sequencer override；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第479页；原文字段表：Sequencer override. Provides additional sequencer flexibility in

continuous run mode by overriding the wrapping around at the end
of conversions set by MAX_CONVn.
0h = Disabled - Allows the sequencer to wrap around at the end of
conversions set by MAX_CONVn.
1h = Enabled - Overrides the sequencer from wrapping around at
the end of conversions set by MAX_CONVn. Wraparound occurs
only at the end of the sequencer.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CONT_RUN
Fields.Description: 连续 run
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：连续 run. 此 位 决定 是否 sequencer operates 中 连续 转换 模式 或 start-stop 模式. 此 位 CAN be written 期间 当前 转换 sequence 为 活动. 此 位 will take effect 在 end 的 当前 转换 sequence i.e., 软件 CAN set/clear 此 位 until EOS has occurred, 用于 有效 动作 至 be taken. 中 连续 转换 模式, there 为 no need 至 复位 sequencer however, sequencer must be 复位 中 start-stop 模式 至 put converter 中 状态 CONV00. 0h = Start-stop 模式. Sequencer stops after reaching EOS. 开启 下次 SOC转换启动, sequencer starts 来自 状态 where it ended unless sequencer 复位 为 performed. 1h = 连续 转换 模式. After reaching EOS, behavior 的 sequencer depends 开启 状态 的 SEQ_OVRD 位. 如果 此 位 为 cleared, sequencer starts over again 来自 its 复位 状态 (CONV00 用于 SEQ1 及 cascaded, CONV08 用于 SEQ2). 如果 SEQ_OVRD 为 置位, sequencer starts again 来自 its 当前 位置, without 复位.
Fields.Notes:
原文：6     Continuous run；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第479页；原文字段表：Continuous run. This bit determines whether the sequencer operates

in continuous conversion mode or start-stop mode. This bit can be
written while a current conversion sequence is active. This bit will
take effect at the end of the current conversion sequence i.e.,
software can set/clear this bit until EOS has occurred, for valid action
to be taken. In the continuous conversion mode, there is no need to
reset the sequencer however, the sequencer must be reset in the
start-stop mode to put the converter in state CONV00.
0h = Start-stop mode. Sequencer stops after reaching EOS. On the
next SOC, the sequencer starts from the state where it ended unless
a sequencer reset is performed.
1h = Continuous conversion mode. After reaching EOS, the behavior
of the sequencer depends on the state of the SEQ_OVRD bit. If this
bit is cleared, the sequencer starts over again from its reset state
(CONV00 for SEQ1 and cascaded, CONV08 for SEQ2). If
SEQ_OVRD is set, the sequencer starts again from its current
position, without resetting.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Notes:
原文：13    Start of conversion trigger for SEQ1；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第481页；原文字段表：Start-of-conversion (SOC) trigger for Sequencer 1 (SEQ1) or the

cascaded sequencer. This bit can be set by the following triggers:
• S/W - Software writing a 1 to this bit
• ePWM SOCA
• ePWM SOCB (only in cascaded mode)
• EXT - External pin (i.e., GPIO Port A pin (GPIO31-0) configured
as XINT2 in the GPIOxINT2SEL register.
See the TMS320x2833x System Control and Interrupts Reference
Guide (literature number SPRUFB0) for details on how to configure a
GPIO pin as XINT2. When a trigger occurs, there are three
possibilities:
Case 1: SEQ1 idle and SOC bit clear SEQ1 starts immediately
(under arbiter control). This bit is set and cleared, allowing for any
"pending" trigger requests.
Case 2: SEQ1 busy and SOC bit clear Bit is set signifying a trigger
request is pending. When SEQ1 finally starts after completing
current conversion, this bit is cleared.
Case 3: SEQ1 busy and SOC bit set Any trigger occurring in this
case is ignored (lost).
0h = Clears a pending SOC trigger. Note: If the sequencer has
already started, this bit is automatically cleared, and hence, writing a
zero has no effect; i.e., an already started sequencer cannot be
stopped by clearing this bit.
1h = Software trigger - Start SEQ1 from currently stopped position
(i.e., Idle mode)
Note: The RST_SEQ1 (ADCTRL2.14) and the SOC_SEQ1
(ADCTRL2.13) bits should not be set in the same instruction. This
resets the sequencer, but does not start the sequence. The correct
sequence of operation is to set the RST_SEQ1 bit first, and the
SOC_SEQ1 bit in the following instruction. This makes certain that
the sequencer is reset and a new sequence started. This sequence
applies to the RST_SEQ2 (ADCTRL2.6) and SOC_SEQ2
(ADCTRL2.5) bits also.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Case 1: Dual 模式 SEQ1 及 cascaded 模式 Sequencer goes 来自 CONV00 至 CONV04, 及 five 转换 results are stored 中 寄存器 结果 00 至 结果 04 的 转换 结果 缓冲. Case 2: Dual 模式 SEQ2 Sequencer goes 来自 CONV08 至 CONV12, 及 five 转换 results are stored 中 寄存器 结果 08 至 结果 12 的 转换 结果 缓冲. 最大_CONV1 数值 >7 用于 Dual-Sequencer 模式 如果 值 用于 最大_CONV1, which 为 greater than 7, 为 chosen 用于 dual-sequencer 模式 (i.e., two separate 8-状态 sequencers), then SEQ_CNTR will continue counting past seven, causing sequencer 至 wrap around 至 CONV00 及 continue counting. 表 7-13. 位 Selections 用于 最大_CONV1 用于 Various 数量 的 Conversions ADCMAXCONV[3-0] 数量 的 Conversions 0000 1 0001 2 0010 3 0011 4 0100 5 0101 6 0110 7 0111 8 1000 9 1001 10 1010 11 1011 12
Fields.Notes:
原文：3:0   Max number of conversions；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第483页；原文字段表：MAX_CONV1 bit field defines the maximum number of conversions

executed in an autoconversion session for sequencer 1 (SEQ1). The
bit fields and their operation vary according to the sequencer modes
(dual/cascaded).
For SEQ1 operation, bits MAX_CONV1[2:0] are used.
For SEQ operation, bits MAX_CONV1[3:0] are used.
An autoconversion session always starts with the initial state and
continues sequentially until the end state if allowed. The result buffer
is filled in a sequential order. Any number of conversions between 1
and (MAX_CONVn +1) can be programmed for a session.
ADCMAXCONV Register Bit Programming
If only five conversions are required, then MAX_CONVn is set to four.
Case 1: Dual mode SEQ1 and cascaded mode Sequencer goes from CONV00 to CONV04, and the five
conversion results are stored in the registers Result 00 to Result 04 of the Conversion Result Buffer.
Case 2: Dual mode SEQ2 Sequencer goes from CONV08 to CONV12, and the five conversion results are
stored in the registers Result 08 to Result 12 of the Conversion Result Buffer.
MAX_CONV1 Value >7 for Dual-Sequencer Mode
If a value for MAX_CONV1, which is greater than 7, is chosen for the dual-sequencer mode (i.e., two
separate 8-state sequencers), then SEQ_CNTR will continue counting past seven, causing the sequencer
to wrap around to CONV00 and continue counting.

used by SEQ1, SEQ2, and the cascaded sequencer. SEQ2 is
irrelevant in cascaded mode. The Sequencer Counter bit field,
SEQ_CNTR[3:0], is initialized to the value in MAX_CONV at the start
of a conversion sequence. After each conversion (or a pair of
conversions in simultaneous sampling mode) in an auto conversion
sequence, the Sequencer Counter decreases by 1.The SEQ_CNTR
bits can be read at any time during the countdown process to check
status of the sequencer. This value, together with the SEQ1 and

See Section 7.2.4用于 power-up sequence requirements. 0h = 全部 模拟 circuitry inside core except bandgap 及 参考 circuitry 为 powered 下降. 1h = 模拟 circuitry inside core 为 powered 上升. 4-1 ADCCLKPS[3:0] R/W 0h Core 时钟 分频器. 28x 外设 时钟, HSPCLK, 为 divided 通过 2*ADCCLKPS[3-0], except 当 ADCCLKPS[3-0] 为 0000, 中 which case HSPCLK 为 directly passed 开启. divided 时钟 为 further divided 通过 ADCTRL1[7]+1 至 产生 core 时钟, ADCLK. 原文：0      SEQ1 Interrupt flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第492页；原文字段表：SEQ1 interrupt flag bit. Write to this bit has no effect. In interrupt

mode 0, i.e. when ADCTRL2[10]=0, this bit is set on every end of
sequence of Seq 1. In interrupt mode 1, i.e., when ADCTRL2[10]=1,
this bit is set on an end of sequence of Seq 1 if EOS_BUF1 is set.
0h = No SEQ1 interrupt event.
1h = SEQ1 interrupt event occurred.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INT_SEQ1_CLR
Fields.Description: SEQ1 中断 清除
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：中断 清除 位. 读取 的 此 位 always returns 0. 清除 动作 为 单次 事件 following 写入 的 1 至 此 位. 0h = Writing 零 至 此 位 has no effect. 1h = Writing 1 至 此 位 clears SEQ1 中断 标志 位, 中断_SEQ1. 此 位 does 不 affect EOS_BUF1 位.

1h = Writing a 1 to this bit clears the SEQ1 interrupt flag bit,

TDDRH:TDDR also reloads PSCH:PSC whenever 定时器 重装载 位 (TRB) 为 置位 通过 软件. Figure 1-39. TIMERxTPRH 寄存器 (x = 0, 1, 2) 15 8 7 0 PSCH TDDRH R-0 R/W-0 LEGEND: R/W = 读写; R = 读取 仅; -n = 值 after 复位

count by an integer factor, write this factor minus one to the TDDRH:TDDR bits. When the prescaler counter
(PSCH:PSC) value is 0, one timer clock source cycle later, the contents of the TDDRH:TDDR reload the
PSCH:PSC, and the TIMH:TIM decrements by one. TDDRH:TDDR also reloads the PSCH:PSC whenever the

Fields.Name: PSC
Fields.Description: 预分频 计数器 低
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：CPU定时器 预分频 计数器. These 位 保持 当前 预分频 计数 用于 定时器. 用于 every 定时器 时钟 来源 周期 that PSCH:PSC 值 为 greater than 0, PSCH:PSC decrements 通过 单次. 单次 定时器 时钟 (输出 的 定时器 预分频器) 周期 after PSCH:PSC reaches 0, PSCH:PSC 为 loaded 带 内容 的 TDDRH:TDDR, 及 定时器 计数器 寄存器 (TIMH:TIM) decrements 通过 单次. PSCH:PSC 为 also reloaded whenever 定时器 重装载 位 (TRB) 为 置位 通过 软件. PSCH:PSC CAN be checked 通过 reading 寄存器, but it cannot be 置位 directly. It must get its 值 来自 定时器 分频 寄存器 (TDDRH:TDDR). 在 复位, PSCH:PSC 为 置位 至 0.
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:8  Prescale counter low；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第85页；原文字段表：CPU-Timer Prescale Counter. These bits hold the current prescale count for the timer. For every timer clock

source cycle that the PSCH:PSC value is greater than 0, the PSCH:PSC decrements by one. One timer clock
(output of the timer prescaler) cycle after the PSCH:PSC reaches 0, the PSCH:PSC is loaded with the contents
of the TDDRH:TDDR, and the timer counter register (TIMH:TIM) decrements by one. The PSCH:PSC is also
reloaded whenever the timer reload bit (TRB) is set by software. The PSCH:PSC can be checked by reading
the register, but it cannot be set directly. It must get its value from the timer divide-down register
(TDDRH:TDDR). At reset, the PSCH:PSC is set to 0.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TDDR
Fields.Description: 分频 低
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：CPU定时器 分频. Every (TDDRH:TDDR + 1) 定时器 时钟 来源 cycles, 定时器 计数器 寄存器 (TIMH:TIM) decrements 通过 单次. 在 复位, TDDRH:TDDR 位 are cleared 至 0. 至 increase overall 定时器 计数 通过 整数 factor, 写入 此 factor minus 单次 至 TDDRH:TDDR 位. 当 预分频器 计数器 (PSCH:PSC) 值 为 0, 单次 定时器 时钟 来源 周期 later, 内容 的 TDDRH:TDDR 重装载 PSCH:PSC, 及 TIMH:TIM decrements 通过 单次. TDDRH:TDDR also reloads PSCH:PSC whenever 定时器 重装载 位 (TRB) 为 置位 通过 软件. Figure 1-39. TIMERxTPRH 寄存器 (x = 0, 1, 2) 15 8 7 0 PSCH TDDRH R-0 R/W-0 LEGEND: R/W = 读写; R = 读取 仅; -n = 值 after 复位
Fields.Notes:
原文：7:0   Divide-down low；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第85页；原文字段表：CPU-Timer Divide-Down. Every (TDDRH:TDDR + 1) timer clock source cycles, the timer counter register

(TIMH:TIM) decrements by one. At reset, the TDDRH:TDDR bits are cleared to 0. To increase the overall timer
count by an integer factor, write this factor minus one to the TDDRH:TDDR bits. When the prescaler counter
(PSCH:PSC) value is 0, one timer clock source cycle later, the contents of the TDDRH:TDDR reload the
PSCH:PSC, and the TIMH:TIM decrements by one. TDDRH:TDDR also reloads the PSCH:PSC whenever the
timer reload bit (TRB) is set by software.
Figure 1-39. TIMERxTPRH Register (x = 0, 1, 2)
15 8 7 0
PSCH TDDRH
R-0 R/W-0
LEGEND: R/W = Read/Write; R = Read only; -n = value after reset；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: PSC
Fields.Description: 预分频 计数器 低
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：CPU定时器 预分频 计数器. These 位 保持 当前 预分频 计数 用于 定时器. 用于 every 定时器 时钟 来源 周期 that PSCH:PSC 值 为 greater than 0, PSCH:PSC decrements 通过 单次. 单次 定时器 时钟 (输出 的 定时器 预分频器) 周期 after PSCH:PSC reaches 0, PSCH:PSC 为 loaded 带 内容 的 TDDRH:TDDR, 及 定时器 计数器 寄存器 (TIMH:TIM) decrements 通过 单次. PSCH:PSC 为 also reloaded whenever 定时器 重装载 位 (TRB) 为 置位 通过 软件. PSCH:PSC CAN be checked 通过 reading 寄存器, but it cannot be 置位 directly. It must get its 值 来自 定时器 分频 寄存器 (TDDRH:TDDR). 在 复位, PSCH:PSC 为 置位 至 0.
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:8  Prescale counter low；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第85页；原文字段表：CPU-Timer Prescale Counter. These bits hold the current prescale count for the timer. For every timer clock

source cycle that the PSCH:PSC value is greater than 0, the PSCH:PSC decrements by one. One timer clock
(output of the timer prescaler) cycle after the PSCH:PSC reaches 0, the PSCH:PSC is loaded with the contents
of the TDDRH:TDDR, and the timer counter register (TIMH:TIM) decrements by one. The PSCH:PSC is also
reloaded whenever the timer reload bit (TRB) is set by software. The PSCH:PSC can be checked by reading
the register, but it cannot be set directly. It must get its value from the timer divide-down register
(TDDRH:TDDR). At reset, the PSCH:PSC is set to 0.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Registers.Notes: 地址单位：16位字（C28x），非字节。基于TI寄存器头文件；尚未完成进芯实板验证。

Fields.Name: TSEG2REG
Fields.Access: 所有模式可读；初始化且EALLOW时可写
Fields.Description: CAN时间段2编码，即相位缓冲段2。
Fields.Values: TSEG2=TSEG2REG+1 TQ；TSEG2须不小于IPT，并不大于TSEG1。BRP>1时IPT=2 TQ。
Fields.Notes:
原文：2:0   TSEG2 register value；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第813页；原文字段表：Time Segment 2. TSEG2 defines the length of PHASE_SEG2 segment in TQ units:

TSEG2 is programmable in the range of 1 TQ to 8 TQ and has to fulfill the following timing rule:
TSEG2 must be smaller than or equal to TSEG1 and must be greater than or equal to IPT.
TSEG2reg denotes the "register value" of "time segment 2;" that is, the value written into bits 2:0 of
the CANBTC register. This value is automatically enhanced by 1 when the CAN module accesses
it. This enhanced value is denoted by the symbol TSEG2.
TSEG2 = TSEG2reg + 1；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: TSEG1REG
Fields.Access: 所有模式可读；初始化且EALLOW时可写
Fields.Description: CAN时间段1编码，包括传播段和相位缓冲段1。
Fields.Values: TSEG1=TSEG1REG+1 TQ；TSEG1须不小于TSEG2和IPT。
Fields.Notes:
原文：6:3   TSEG1 register value；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第813页；原文字段表：Time segment 1. The length of a bit on the CAN bus is determined by the parameters TSEG1,

TSEG2, and BRP. All controllers on the CAN bus must have the same baud rate and bit length. For
different clock frequencies of the individual controllers, the baud rate has to be adjusted by the said
parameters.
This parameter specifies the length of the TSEG1 segment in TQ units. TSEG1 combines
PROP_SEG and PHASE_SEG1 segments:
TSEG1 = PROP_SEG + PHASE_SEG1
where PROP_SEG and PHASE_SEG1 are the length of these two segments in TQ units.
TSEG1reg denotes the "register value" of "time segment 1;" that is, the value written into bits 6:3 of
the CANBTC register. This value is automatically enhanced by 1 when the CAN module accesses
it. This enhanced value is denoted by the symbol TSEG1.
TSEG1 = TSEG1reg + 1
TSEG1 value should be chosen such that TSEG1 is greater than or equal to TSEG2 and IPT. For
more information on IPT, see Section 13.7.1.1.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: SAM
Fields.Access: 所有模式可读；初始化且EALLOW时可写
Fields.Description: CAN总线电平采样次数。
Fields.Values: 0：单次采样；1：3次采样多数表决。3次采样仅允许BRP>4。
Fields.Notes:
原文：7     Sample-point setting；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第812页；原文字段表：This parameter sets the number of samples used by the CAN module to determine the actual level

of the CAN bus. When the SAM bit is set, the level determined by the CAN bus corresponds to the
result from the majority decision of the last three values. The sample points are at the sample point
and twice before with a distance of ½ TQ.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: SJWREG
Fields.Access: 所有模式可读；初始化且EALLOW时可写
Fields.Description: 重同步跳转宽度编码。
Fields.Values: SJW=SJWREG+1 TQ；SJW不得大于TSEG2，且最大4 TQ。
Fields.Notes:
原文：9:8   Synchroniztion Jump Width register value；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第812页；原文字段表：1:0 Synchronization jump width. The parameter SJW indicates, by how many units of TQ a bit is

allowed to be lengthened or shortened when resynchronizing.
SJWreg denotes the "register value" of the "resynchronization jump width;" that is, the value written
into bits 9:8 of the CANBTC register. This value is automatically enhanced by 1 when the CAN
module accesses it. This enhanced value is denoted by the symbol SJW.
SJW = SJWreg + 1
SJW is programmable from 1 to 4 TQ. The maximum value of SJW is determined by the minimum
value of TSEG2 and 4 TQ.
SJW(max) = min [4 TQ, TSEG2]；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: rsvd1
Fields.Description: 保留位；不要用于用户配置。
Fields.Values: 按该寄存器手册要求保留；不得假定保留位都可写0。
Fields.Notes: 保留位不得用于配置。；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第812页；原文字段表：Reads are undefined. Must be written with all zeroes only.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: BRPREG
Fields.Access: 所有模式可读；初始化且EALLOW时可写
Fields.Description: CAN位时间量子的预分频编码。
Fields.Values: 实际分频BRP=BRPREG+1。TI基线不允许BRP=1，故BRPREG应至少为1；CAN时钟=SYSCLKOUT/2。
Fields.Notes:
原文：23:16 Baudrate prescaler register value；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第812页；原文字段表：Baud rate prescaler. This register sets the prescaler for the baud rate settings. The length of one

TQ is defined by:
where SYSCLKOUT is the frequency of the CAN module clock.
BRPreg denotes the "register value" of the prescaler; that is, value written into bits 23:16 of the
CANBTC register. This value is automatically enhanced by 1 when the CAN module accesses it.
The enhanced value is denoted by the symbol BRP (BRP = BRPreg + 1). BRP is programmable
from 1 to 256.
Note: For the special case of BRP = 1, the Information Processing Time (IPT) is equal to 3 time
quanta (TQ). This is not compliant to the ISO 11898 Standard, where the IPT is defined to be less
than or equal to 2 TQ. Thus the usage of this mode (BRPreg = 0) is not allowed.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: SMA
Fields.Description: 暂停 模式 应答
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：暂停 模式 应答. 此 位 为 置位 after latency 的 单次 时钟 周期—上升 至 长度 的 单次 帧—after 暂停 模式 was activated. 暂停 模式 为 activated 带 debugger tool 当 circuit 为 不 中 run 模式. During 暂停 模式, CAN 模块 为 frozen 及 cannot 接收 或 发送 any 帧. However, 如果 CAN 模块 为 transmitting 或 receiving 帧 当 暂停 模式 为 activated, 模块 enters 暂停 模式 仅 在 end 的 帧. Run 模式 为 当 软 模式 为 activated (CANMC.16 = 1).
Fields.Notes:
原文：5     Suspend Mode Acknowledge；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第815页；原文字段表：Suspend mode acknowledge. This bit is set after a latency of one clock cycle—up to the length of

one frame—after the suspend mode was activated. The suspend mode is activated with the
debugger tool when the circuit is not in run mode. During the suspend mode, the CAN module is
frozen and cannot receive or transmit any frame. However, if the CAN module is transmitting or
receiving a frame when the suspend mode is activated, the module enters suspend mode only at
the end of the frame. Run mode is when SOFT mode is activated (CANMC.16 = 1).；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TSEG2REG
Fields.Access: 所有模式可读；初始化且EALLOW时可写
Fields.Description: CAN时间段2编码，即相位缓冲段2。
Fields.Values: TSEG2=TSEG2REG+1 TQ；TSEG2须不小于IPT，并不大于TSEG1。BRP>1时IPT=2 TQ。
Fields.Notes:
原文：2:0   TSEG2 register value；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第813页；原文字段表：Time Segment 2. TSEG2 defines the length of PHASE_SEG2 segment in TQ units:

TSEG2 is programmable in the range of 1 TQ to 8 TQ and has to fulfill the following timing rule:
TSEG2 must be smaller than or equal to TSEG1 and must be greater than or equal to IPT.
TSEG2reg denotes the "register value" of "time segment 2;" that is, the value written into bits 2:0 of
the CANBTC register. This value is automatically enhanced by 1 when the CAN module accesses
it. This enhanced value is denoted by the symbol TSEG2.
TSEG2 = TSEG2reg + 1；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: TSEG1REG
Fields.Access: 所有模式可读；初始化且EALLOW时可写
Fields.Description: CAN时间段1编码，包括传播段和相位缓冲段1。
Fields.Values: TSEG1=TSEG1REG+1 TQ；TSEG1须不小于TSEG2和IPT。
Fields.Notes:
原文：6:3   TSEG1 register value；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第813页；原文字段表：Time segment 1. The length of a bit on the CAN bus is determined by the parameters TSEG1,

TSEG2, and BRP. All controllers on the CAN bus must have the same baud rate and bit length. For
different clock frequencies of the individual controllers, the baud rate has to be adjusted by the said
parameters.
This parameter specifies the length of the TSEG1 segment in TQ units. TSEG1 combines
PROP_SEG and PHASE_SEG1 segments:
TSEG1 = PROP_SEG + PHASE_SEG1
where PROP_SEG and PHASE_SEG1 are the length of these two segments in TQ units.
TSEG1reg denotes the "register value" of "time segment 1;" that is, the value written into bits 6:3 of
the CANBTC register. This value is automatically enhanced by 1 when the CAN module accesses
it. This enhanced value is denoted by the symbol TSEG1.
TSEG1 = TSEG1reg + 1
TSEG1 value should be chosen such that TSEG1 is greater than or equal to TSEG2 and IPT. For
more information on IPT, see Section 13.7.1.1.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: SAM
Fields.Access: 所有模式可读；初始化且EALLOW时可写
Fields.Description: CAN总线电平采样次数。
Fields.Values: 0：单次采样；1：3次采样多数表决。3次采样仅允许BRP>4。
Fields.Notes:
原文：7     Sample-point setting；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第812页；原文字段表：This parameter sets the number of samples used by the CAN module to determine the actual level

of the CAN bus. When the SAM bit is set, the level determined by the CAN bus corresponds to the
result from the majority decision of the last three values. The sample points are at the sample point
and twice before with a distance of ½ TQ.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: SJWREG
Fields.Access: 所有模式可读；初始化且EALLOW时可写
Fields.Description: 重同步跳转宽度编码。
Fields.Values: SJW=SJWREG+1 TQ；SJW不得大于TSEG2，且最大4 TQ。
Fields.Notes:
原文：9:8   Synchroniztion Jump Width register value；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第812页；原文字段表：1:0 Synchronization jump width. The parameter SJW indicates, by how many units of TQ a bit is

allowed to be lengthened or shortened when resynchronizing.
SJWreg denotes the "register value" of the "resynchronization jump width;" that is, the value written
into bits 9:8 of the CANBTC register. This value is automatically enhanced by 1 when the CAN
module accesses it. This enhanced value is denoted by the symbol SJW.
SJW = SJWreg + 1
SJW is programmable from 1 to 4 TQ. The maximum value of SJW is determined by the minimum
value of TSEG2 and 4 TQ.
SJW(max) = min [4 TQ, TSEG2]；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Notes: 保留位不得用于配置。；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第812页；原文字段表：Reads are undefined. Must be written with all zeroes only.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: BRPREG
Fields.Access: 所有模式可读；初始化且EALLOW时可写
Fields.Description: CAN位时间量子的预分频编码。
Fields.Values: 实际分频BRP=BRPREG+1。TI基线不允许BRP=1，故BRPREG应至少为1；CAN时钟=SYSCLKOUT/2。
Fields.Notes:
原文：23:16 Baudrate prescaler register value；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第812页；原文字段表：Baud rate prescaler. This register sets the prescaler for the baud rate settings. The length of one

TQ is defined by:
where SYSCLKOUT is the frequency of the CAN module clock.
BRPreg denotes the "register value" of the prescaler; that is, value written into bits 23:16 of the
CANBTC register. This value is automatically enhanced by 1 when the CAN module accesses it.
The enhanced value is denoted by the symbol BRP (BRP = BRPreg + 1). BRP is programmable
from 1 to 256.
Note: For the special case of BRP = 1, the Information Processing Time (IPT) is equal to 3 time
quanta (TQ). This is not compliant to the ISO 11898 Standard, where the IPT is defined to be less
than or equal to 2 TQ. Thus the usage of this mode (BRPreg = 0) is not allowed.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: CTRMODE
Fields.Description: 时基计数模式。
Fields.Values: 0：向上计数；1：向下计数；2：上下计数；3：停止/冻结。
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    Counter Mode；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第298页；原文字段表：Counter Mode

The time-base counter mode is normally configured once and not changed during normal operation.
If you change the mode of the counter, the change will take effect at the next TBCLK edge and the
current counter value shall increment or decrement from the value before the mode change.
These bits set the time-base counter mode of operation as follows:
00 Up-count mode
01 Down-count mode
10 Up-down-count mode
11 Stop-freeze counter operation (default on reset)；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Notes: 原文：2      Phase load enable；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第298页；原文字段表：Counter Register Load From Phase Register Enable；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: PRDLD

Fields.Values: 0：使用影子寄存器，计数器归零时装载；1：直接写活动寄存器。
Fields.Notes: 原文：3      Active period load；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第298页；原文字段表：Active Period Register Load From Shadow Register Select；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: HSPCLKDIV
Fields.Description: 时基高速预分频选择。
Fields.Notes:
原文：9:7    High speed time pre-scale；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第298页；原文字段表：High Speed Time-base Clock Prescale Bits

These bits determine part of the time-base clock prescale value.
TBCLK = SYSCLKOUT / (HSPCLKDIV × CLKDIV)
This divisor emulates the HSPCLK in the TMS320x281x system as used on the Event Manager
(EV) peripheral.
000 /1
001 /2 (default on reset)
010 /4
011 /6
100 /8
101 /10
110 /12
111 /14；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: CLKDIV
Fields.Description: 时基低速预分频选择。
Fields.Notes:
原文：12:10  Timebase clock pre-scale；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第297页；原文字段表：Time-base Clock Prescale Bits

These bits determine part of the time-base clock prescale value.
TBCLK = SYSCLKOUT / (HSPCLKDIV × CLKDIV)
000 /1 (default on reset)
001 /2
010 /4
011 /8
100 /16
101 /32
110 /64
111 /128；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: PHSDIR
Fields.Description: 上下计数模式下，同步载入相位后的计数方向。
Fields.Values: 0：同步后向下计数；1：同步后向上计数。
Fields.Notes:
原文：13     Phase Direction；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第297页；原文字段表：Phase Direction Bit.

This bit is only used when the time-base counter is configured in the up-down-count mode. The
PHSDIR bit indicates the direction the time-base counter (TBCTR) will count after a synchronization
event occurs and a new phase value is loaded from the phase (TBPHS) register. This is
irrespective of the direction of the counter before the synchronization event..
In the up-count and down-count modes this bit is ignored.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: TBPRD
Fields.Description: 时基周期计数值。
Fields.Values: 向上/向下计数：频率=TBCLK/(TBPRD+1)；上下计数：频率=TBCLK/(2×TBPRD)。
Fields.Notes:
原文：Period register set；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第296页；原文字段表：0000-

FFFFh
These bits determine the period of the time-base counter. This sets the PWM frequency.
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the TBCTL[PRDLD] bit. By default this register is
shadowed.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go to the
shadow register. In this case, the active register will be loaded from the shadow register when the time-
base counter equals zero.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 1, then the shadow is disabled and any write or read will go directly to the active
register, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• The active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.

Fields.Name: CMPB
Fields.Description: 比较 B reg
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：值 中 活动 CMPB 寄存器 为 continuously compared 至 时基 计数器 (TBCTR). 当 values are equal, counter-compare 模块 产生 "时基 计数器 equal 至 计数器 比较 B" 事件. 此 事件 为 sent 至 action-qualifier where it 为 限定后 及 converted it 进入 单次 或 more actions. These actions CAN be applied 至 either EPWMxA 或 EPWMxB 输出 depending 开启 配置 的 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器. actions that CAN be defined 中 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器 include: • 执行 nothing. 事件 为 忽略. • 清除: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 低 • 置位: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 高 • 翻转 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 Shadowing 的 此 寄存器 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能 及 any 写入 或 读取 will automatically go 至 影子 寄存器. 中 此 case, CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] 位 field 决定 which 事件 will 加载 活动 寄存器 来自 影子 寄存器: • Before 写入, CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] 位 CAN be 读取 至 determine 如果 影子 寄存器 为 currently 满. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用 及 any 写入 或 读取 will go directly 至 活动 寄存器, that 为 寄存器 actively controlling 硬件. • 中 either 模式, 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：Compare B reg；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第301页；原文字段表：The value in the active CMPB register is continuously compared to the time-base counter (TBCTR). When the

values are equal, the counter-compare module generates a "time-base counter equal to counter compare B"
event. This event is sent to the action-qualifier where it is qualified and converted it into one or more actions.
These actions can be applied to either the EPWMxA or the EPWMxB output depending on the configuration of
the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers. The actions that can be defined in the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers
include:
• Do nothing. event is ignored.
• Clear: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal low
• Set: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal high
• Toggle the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] bit. By default this register is
shadowed.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go to the
shadow register. In this case, the CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] bit field determines which event will load the active
register from the shadow register:
• Before a write, the CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] bit can be read to determine if the shadow register is currently full.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is disabled and any write or read will go directly to
the active register, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• In either mode, the active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OUT_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输出 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 输出 模式 控制 位 1 控制 S1 switch 及 位 0 控制 S0 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively 使能 或 bypass 死区 产生 用于 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟. 00 死区 产生 为 bypassed 用于 both 输出 信号. 中 此 模式, both EPWMxA 及 EPWMxB 输出 信号 来自 action-qualifier are passed directly 至 PWM-chopper submodule. 中 此 模式, POLSEL 及 中_模式 位 have no effect.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    Dead Band Output Mode Control；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第309页；原文字段表：Dead-band Output Mode Control

Bit 1 controls the S1 switch and bit 0 controls the S0 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively enable or bypass the dead-band generation for the falling-edge and
rising-edge delay.
00 Dead-band generation is bypassed for both output signals. In this mode, both the EPWMxA and
EPWMxB output signals from the action-qualifier are passed directly to the PWM-chopper
submodule.
In this mode, the POLSEL and IN_MODE bits have no effect.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: POLSEL
Fields.Description: 极性 选择 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：极性 选择 控制 位 3 控制 S3 switch 及 位 2 控制 S2 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively invert 单次 的 delayed 信号 before it 为 sent out 的 死区 submodule. following descriptions correspond 至 classical upper/lower switch 控制 作为 found 中 单次 leg 的 数字 motor 控制 inverter. These assume that DBCTL[OUT_模式] = 1,1 及 DBCTL[中_模式] = 0,0. Other enhanced modes are also possible, but 不 regarded 作为 typical usage modes.
Fields.Notes:
原文：3:2    Polarity Select Control；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第308页；原文字段表：Polarity Select Control

Bit 3 controls the S3 switch and bit 2 controls the S2 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively invert one of the delayed signals before it is sent out of the dead-band
submodule.
The following descriptions correspond to classical upper/lower switch control as found in one leg of
a digital motor control inverter.
These assume that DBCTL[OUT_MODE] = 1,1 and DBCTL[IN_MODE] = 0,0. Other enhanced
modes are also possible, but not regarded as typical usage modes.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: IN_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输入 选择 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 带 输入 模式 控制 位 5 控制 S5 switch 及 位 4 控制 S4 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 选择 输入 来源 至 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟. 至 produce classical 死区 waveforms 默认 为 EPWMxA 中 为 来源 用于 both 下降沿 及 rising-edge delays.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5:4    Dead Band Input Select Mode Control；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第308页；原文字段表：Dead Band Input Mode Control

Bit 5 controls the S5 switch and bit 4 controls the S4 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to select the input source to the falling-edge and rising-edge delay.
To produce classical dead-band waveforms the default is EPWMxA In is the source for both falling
and rising-edge delays.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INTPRD
Fields.Description: EPWMxINTn 周期 选择
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ePWM 中断 (ePWMx_中断) 周期 选择 These 位 determine how many 已选 ETSEL[INTSEL] events need 至 occur before 中断 为 已产生. 至 be 已产生, 中断 must be 已使能 (ETSEL[中断] = 1). 如果 中断 状态 标志 为 置位 来自 前次 中断 (ETFLG[中断] = 1) then no 中断 will be 已产生 until 标志 为 cleared via ETCLR[中断] 位. 此 allows 用于 单次 中断 至 be 待处理 期间 another 为 still being serviced. Once 中断 为 已产生, ETPS[INTCNT] 位 will automatically be cleared. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 same 作为 当前 计数器 值 will 触发 中断 如果 it 为 已使能 及 状态 标志 为 清除. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 less than 当前 计数器 值 will 结果 中 undefined 状态. 如果 计数器 事件 发生 在 same instant 作为 new 零 或 non-zero INTPRD 值 为 written, 计数器 为 incremented.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    EPWMxINTn Period Select；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第323页；原文字段表：ePWM Interrupt (EPWMx_INT) Period Select

These bits determine how many selected ETSEL[INTSEL] events need to occur before an interrupt
is generated. To be generated, the interrupt must be enabled (ETSEL[INT] = 1). If the interrupt
status flag is set from a previous interrupt (ETFLG[INT] = 1) then no interrupt will be generated until
the flag is cleared via the ETCLR[INT] bit. This allows for one interrupt to be pending while another
is still being serviced. Once the interrupt is generated, the ETPS[INTCNT] bits will automatically be
cleared.
Writing a INTPRD value that is the same as the current counter value will trigger an interrupt if it is
enabled and the status flag is clear.
Writing a INTPRD value that is less than the current counter value will result in an undefined state.
If a counter event occurs at the same instant as a new zero or non-zero INTPRD value is written,
the counter is incremented.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CTRMODE
Fields.Description: 时基计数模式。
Fields.Values: 0：向上计数；1：向下计数；2：上下计数；3：停止/冻结。
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    Counter Mode；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第298页；原文字段表：Counter Mode

The time-base counter mode is normally configured once and not changed during normal operation.
If you change the mode of the counter, the change will take effect at the next TBCLK edge and the
current counter value shall increment or decrement from the value before the mode change.
These bits set the time-base counter mode of operation as follows:
00 Up-count mode
01 Down-count mode
10 Up-down-count mode
11 Stop-freeze counter operation (default on reset)；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: PHSDIR
Fields.Description: 上下计数模式下，同步载入相位后的计数方向。
Fields.Values: 0：同步后向下计数；1：同步后向上计数。
Fields.Notes:
原文：13     Phase Direction；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第297页；原文字段表：Phase Direction Bit.

This bit is only used when the time-base counter is configured in the up-down-count mode. The
PHSDIR bit indicates the direction the time-base counter (TBCTR) will count after a synchronization
event occurs and a new phase value is loaded from the phase (TBPHS) register. This is
irrespective of the direction of the counter before the synchronization event..
In the up-count and down-count modes this bit is ignored.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Notes:
原文：Period register set；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第296页；原文字段表：0000-

FFFFh
These bits determine the period of the time-base counter. This sets the PWM frequency.
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the TBCTL[PRDLD] bit. By default this register is
shadowed.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go to the
shadow register. In this case, the active register will be loaded from the shadow register when the time-
base counter equals zero.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 1, then the shadow is disabled and any write or read will go directly to the active
register, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• The active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.

Fields.Name: CMPB
Fields.Description: 比较 B reg
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：值 中 活动 CMPB 寄存器 为 continuously compared 至 时基 计数器 (TBCTR). 当 values are equal, counter-compare 模块 产生 "时基 计数器 equal 至 计数器 比较 B" 事件. 此 事件 为 sent 至 action-qualifier where it 为 限定后 及 converted it 进入 单次 或 more actions. These actions CAN be applied 至 either EPWMxA 或 EPWMxB 输出 depending 开启 配置 的 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器. actions that CAN be defined 中 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器 include: • 执行 nothing. 事件 为 忽略. • 清除: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 低 • 置位: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 高 • 翻转 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 Shadowing 的 此 寄存器 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能 及 any 写入 或 读取 will automatically go 至 影子 寄存器. 中 此 case, CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] 位 field 决定 which 事件 will 加载 活动 寄存器 来自 影子 寄存器: • Before 写入, CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] 位 CAN be 读取 至 determine 如果 影子 寄存器 为 currently 满. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用 及 any 写入 或 读取 will go directly 至 活动 寄存器, that 为 寄存器 actively controlling 硬件. • 中 either 模式, 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：Compare B reg；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第301页；原文字段表：The value in the active CMPB register is continuously compared to the time-base counter (TBCTR). When the

values are equal, the counter-compare module generates a "time-base counter equal to counter compare B"
event. This event is sent to the action-qualifier where it is qualified and converted it into one or more actions.
These actions can be applied to either the EPWMxA or the EPWMxB output depending on the configuration of
the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers. The actions that can be defined in the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers
include:
• Do nothing. event is ignored.
• Clear: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal low
• Set: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal high
• Toggle the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] bit. By default this register is
shadowed.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go to the
shadow register. In this case, the CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] bit field determines which event will load the active
register from the shadow register:
• Before a write, the CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] bit can be read to determine if the shadow register is currently full.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is disabled and any write or read will go directly to
the active register, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• In either mode, the active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OUT_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输出 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 输出 模式 控制 位 1 控制 S1 switch 及 位 0 控制 S0 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively 使能 或 bypass 死区 产生 用于 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟. 00 死区 产生 为 bypassed 用于 both 输出 信号. 中 此 模式, both EPWMxA 及 EPWMxB 输出 信号 来自 action-qualifier are passed directly 至 PWM-chopper submodule. 中 此 模式, POLSEL 及 中_模式 位 have no effect.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    Dead Band Output Mode Control；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第309页；原文字段表：Dead-band Output Mode Control

Bit 1 controls the S1 switch and bit 0 controls the S0 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively enable or bypass the dead-band generation for the falling-edge and
rising-edge delay.
00 Dead-band generation is bypassed for both output signals. In this mode, both the EPWMxA and
EPWMxB output signals from the action-qualifier are passed directly to the PWM-chopper
submodule.
In this mode, the POLSEL and IN_MODE bits have no effect.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: POLSEL
Fields.Description: 极性 选择 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：极性 选择 控制 位 3 控制 S3 switch 及 位 2 控制 S2 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively invert 单次 的 delayed 信号 before it 为 sent out 的 死区 submodule. following descriptions correspond 至 classical upper/lower switch 控制 作为 found 中 单次 leg 的 数字 motor 控制 inverter. These assume that DBCTL[OUT_模式] = 1,1 及 DBCTL[中_模式] = 0,0. Other enhanced modes are also possible, but 不 regarded 作为 typical usage modes.
Fields.Notes:
原文：3:2    Polarity Select Control；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第308页；原文字段表：Polarity Select Control

Bit 3 controls the S3 switch and bit 2 controls the S2 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively invert one of the delayed signals before it is sent out of the dead-band
submodule.
The following descriptions correspond to classical upper/lower switch control as found in one leg of
a digital motor control inverter.
These assume that DBCTL[OUT_MODE] = 1,1 and DBCTL[IN_MODE] = 0,0. Other enhanced
modes are also possible, but not regarded as typical usage modes.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: IN_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输入 选择 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 带 输入 模式 控制 位 5 控制 S5 switch 及 位 4 控制 S4 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 选择 输入 来源 至 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟. 至 produce classical 死区 waveforms 默认 为 EPWMxA 中 为 来源 用于 both 下降沿 及 rising-edge delays.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5:4    Dead Band Input Select Mode Control；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第308页；原文字段表：Dead Band Input Mode Control

Bit 5 controls the S5 switch and bit 4 controls the S4 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to select the input source to the falling-edge and rising-edge delay.
To produce classical dead-band waveforms the default is EPWMxA In is the source for both falling
and rising-edge delays.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INTPRD
Fields.Description: EPWMxINTn 周期 选择
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ePWM 中断 (ePWMx_中断) 周期 选择 These 位 determine how many 已选 ETSEL[INTSEL] events need 至 occur before 中断 为 已产生. 至 be 已产生, 中断 must be 已使能 (ETSEL[中断] = 1). 如果 中断 状态 标志 为 置位 来自 前次 中断 (ETFLG[中断] = 1) then no 中断 will be 已产生 until 标志 为 cleared via ETCLR[中断] 位. 此 allows 用于 单次 中断 至 be 待处理 期间 another 为 still being serviced. Once 中断 为 已产生, ETPS[INTCNT] 位 will automatically be cleared. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 same 作为 当前 计数器 值 will 触发 中断 如果 it 为 已使能 及 状态 标志 为 清除. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 less than 当前 计数器 值 will 结果 中 undefined 状态. 如果 计数器 事件 发生 在 same instant 作为 new 零 或 non-zero INTPRD 值 为 written, 计数器 为 incremented.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    EPWMxINTn Period Select；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第323页；原文字段表：ePWM Interrupt (EPWMx_INT) Period Select

These bits determine how many selected ETSEL[INTSEL] events need to occur before an interrupt
is generated. To be generated, the interrupt must be enabled (ETSEL[INT] = 1). If the interrupt
status flag is set from a previous interrupt (ETFLG[INT] = 1) then no interrupt will be generated until
the flag is cleared via the ETCLR[INT] bit. This allows for one interrupt to be pending while another
is still being serviced. Once the interrupt is generated, the ETPS[INTCNT] bits will automatically be
cleared.
Writing a INTPRD value that is the same as the current counter value will trigger an interrupt if it is
enabled and the status flag is clear.
Writing a INTPRD value that is less than the current counter value will result in an undefined state.
If a counter event occurs at the same instant as a new zero or non-zero INTPRD value is written,
the counter is incremented.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CTRMODE
Fields.Description: 时基计数模式。
Fields.Values: 0：向上计数；1：向下计数；2：上下计数；3：停止/冻结。
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    Counter Mode；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第298页；原文字段表：Counter Mode

The time-base counter mode is normally configured once and not changed during normal operation.
If you change the mode of the counter, the change will take effect at the next TBCLK edge and the
current counter value shall increment or decrement from the value before the mode change.
These bits set the time-base counter mode of operation as follows:
00 Up-count mode
01 Down-count mode
10 Up-down-count mode
11 Stop-freeze counter operation (default on reset)；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

原文：9:7    High speed time pre-scale；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第298页；原文字段表：High Speed Time-base Clock Prescale Bits

These bits determine part of the time-base clock prescale value.
TBCLK = SYSCLKOUT / (HSPCLKDIV × CLKDIV)
This divisor emulates the HSPCLK in the TMS320x281x system as used on the Event Manager
(EV) peripheral.
000 /1
001 /2 (default on reset)
010 /4
011 /6
100 /8
101 /10
110 /12

000 /1 (default on reset)
001 /2
010 /4
011 /8
100 /16
101 /32
110 /64
111 /128；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: PHSDIR
Fields.Description: 上下计数模式下，同步载入相位后的计数方向。
Fields.Values: 0：同步后向下计数；1：同步后向上计数。
Fields.Notes:
原文：13     Phase Direction；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第297页；原文字段表：Phase Direction Bit.

This bit is only used when the time-base counter is configured in the up-down-count mode. The
PHSDIR bit indicates the direction the time-base counter (TBCTR) will count after a synchronization
event occurs and a new phase value is loaded from the phase (TBPHS) register. This is
irrespective of the direction of the counter before the synchronization event..
In the up-count and down-count modes this bit is ignored.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: TBPRD
Fields.Description: 时基周期计数值。
Fields.Values: 向上/向下计数：频率=TBCLK/(TBPRD+1)；上下计数：频率=TBCLK/(2×TBPRD)。
Fields.Notes:
原文：Period register set；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第296页；原文字段表：0000-

FFFFh
These bits determine the period of the time-base counter. This sets the PWM frequency.
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the TBCTL[PRDLD] bit. By default this register is
shadowed.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go to the
shadow register. In this case, the active register will be loaded from the shadow register when the time-
base counter equals zero.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 1, then the shadow is disabled and any write or read will go directly to the active
register, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• The active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.

Fields.Name: CMPB
Fields.Description: 比较 B reg
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：值 中 活动 CMPB 寄存器 为 continuously compared 至 时基 计数器 (TBCTR). 当 values are equal, counter-compare 模块 产生 "时基 计数器 equal 至 计数器 比较 B" 事件. 此 事件 为 sent 至 action-qualifier where it 为 限定后 及 converted it 进入 单次 或 more actions. These actions CAN be applied 至 either EPWMxA 或 EPWMxB 输出 depending 开启 配置 的 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器. actions that CAN be defined 中 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器 include: • 执行 nothing. 事件 为 忽略. • 清除: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 低 • 置位: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 高 • 翻转 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 Shadowing 的 此 寄存器 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能 及 any 写入 或 读取 will automatically go 至 影子 寄存器. 中 此 case, CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] 位 field 决定 which 事件 will 加载 活动 寄存器 来自 影子 寄存器: • Before 写入, CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] 位 CAN be 读取 至 determine 如果 影子 寄存器 为 currently 满. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用 及 any 写入 或 读取 will go directly 至 活动 寄存器, that 为 寄存器 actively controlling 硬件. • 中 either 模式, 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：Compare B reg；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第301页；原文字段表：The value in the active CMPB register is continuously compared to the time-base counter (TBCTR). When the

values are equal, the counter-compare module generates a "time-base counter equal to counter compare B"
event. This event is sent to the action-qualifier where it is qualified and converted it into one or more actions.
These actions can be applied to either the EPWMxA or the EPWMxB output depending on the configuration of
the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers. The actions that can be defined in the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers
include:
• Do nothing. event is ignored.
• Clear: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal low
• Set: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal high
• Toggle the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] bit. By default this register is
shadowed.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go to the
shadow register. In this case, the CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] bit field determines which event will load the active
register from the shadow register:
• Before a write, the CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] bit can be read to determine if the shadow register is currently full.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is disabled and any write or read will go directly to
the active register, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• In either mode, the active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OUT_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输出 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 输出 模式 控制 位 1 控制 S1 switch 及 位 0 控制 S0 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively 使能 或 bypass 死区 产生 用于 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟. 00 死区 产生 为 bypassed 用于 both 输出 信号. 中 此 模式, both EPWMxA 及 EPWMxB 输出 信号 来自 action-qualifier are passed directly 至 PWM-chopper submodule. 中 此 模式, POLSEL 及 中_模式 位 have no effect.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    Dead Band Output Mode Control；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第309页；原文字段表：Dead-band Output Mode Control

Bit 1 controls the S1 switch and bit 0 controls the S0 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively enable or bypass the dead-band generation for the falling-edge and
rising-edge delay.
00 Dead-band generation is bypassed for both output signals. In this mode, both the EPWMxA and
EPWMxB output signals from the action-qualifier are passed directly to the PWM-chopper
submodule.
In this mode, the POLSEL and IN_MODE bits have no effect.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: POLSEL
Fields.Description: 极性 选择 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：极性 选择 控制 位 3 控制 S3 switch 及 位 2 控制 S2 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively invert 单次 的 delayed 信号 before it 为 sent out 的 死区 submodule. following descriptions correspond 至 classical upper/lower switch 控制 作为 found 中 单次 leg 的 数字 motor 控制 inverter. These assume that DBCTL[OUT_模式] = 1,1 及 DBCTL[中_模式] = 0,0. Other enhanced modes are also possible, but 不 regarded 作为 typical usage modes.
Fields.Notes:
原文：3:2    Polarity Select Control；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第308页；原文字段表：Polarity Select Control

Bit 3 controls the S3 switch and bit 2 controls the S2 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively invert one of the delayed signals before it is sent out of the dead-band
submodule.
The following descriptions correspond to classical upper/lower switch control as found in one leg of
a digital motor control inverter.
These assume that DBCTL[OUT_MODE] = 1,1 and DBCTL[IN_MODE] = 0,0. Other enhanced
modes are also possible, but not regarded as typical usage modes.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: IN_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输入 选择 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 带 输入 模式 控制 位 5 控制 S5 switch 及 位 4 控制 S4 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 选择 输入 来源 至 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟. 至 produce classical 死区 waveforms 默认 为 EPWMxA 中 为 来源 用于 both 下降沿 及 rising-edge delays.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5:4    Dead Band Input Select Mode Control；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第308页；原文字段表：Dead Band Input Mode Control

Bit 5 controls the S5 switch and bit 4 controls the S4 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to select the input source to the falling-edge and rising-edge delay.
To produce classical dead-band waveforms the default is EPWMxA In is the source for both falling
and rising-edge delays.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INTPRD
Fields.Description: EPWMxINTn 周期 选择
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ePWM 中断 (ePWMx_中断) 周期 选择 These 位 determine how many 已选 ETSEL[INTSEL] events need 至 occur before 中断 为 已产生. 至 be 已产生, 中断 must be 已使能 (ETSEL[中断] = 1). 如果 中断 状态 标志 为 置位 来自 前次 中断 (ETFLG[中断] = 1) then no 中断 will be 已产生 until 标志 为 cleared via ETCLR[中断] 位. 此 allows 用于 单次 中断 至 be 待处理 期间 another 为 still being serviced. Once 中断 为 已产生, ETPS[INTCNT] 位 will automatically be cleared. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 same 作为 当前 计数器 值 will 触发 中断 如果 it 为 已使能 及 状态 标志 为 清除. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 less than 当前 计数器 值 will 结果 中 undefined 状态. 如果 计数器 事件 发生 在 same instant 作为 new 零 或 non-zero INTPRD 值 为 written, 计数器 为 incremented.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    EPWMxINTn Period Select；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第323页；原文字段表：ePWM Interrupt (EPWMx_INT) Period Select

These bits determine how many selected ETSEL[INTSEL] events need to occur before an interrupt
is generated. To be generated, the interrupt must be enabled (ETSEL[INT] = 1). If the interrupt
status flag is set from a previous interrupt (ETFLG[INT] = 1) then no interrupt will be generated until
the flag is cleared via the ETCLR[INT] bit. This allows for one interrupt to be pending while another
is still being serviced. Once the interrupt is generated, the ETPS[INTCNT] bits will automatically be
cleared.
Writing a INTPRD value that is the same as the current counter value will trigger an interrupt if it is
enabled and the status flag is clear.
Writing a INTPRD value that is less than the current counter value will result in an undefined state.
If a counter event occurs at the same instant as a new zero or non-zero INTPRD value is written,
the counter is incremented.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CTRMODE
Fields.Description: 时基计数模式。
Fields.Values: 0：向上计数；1：向下计数；2：上下计数；3：停止/冻结。
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    Counter Mode；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第298页；原文字段表：Counter Mode

The time-base counter mode is normally configured once and not changed during normal operation.
If you change the mode of the counter, the change will take effect at the next TBCLK edge and the
current counter value shall increment or decrement from the value before the mode change.
These bits set the time-base counter mode of operation as follows:
00 Up-count mode
01 Down-count mode
10 Up-down-count mode
11 Stop-freeze counter operation (default on reset)；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: HSPCLKDIV
Fields.Description: 时基高速预分频选择。
Fields.Notes:
原文：9:7    High speed time pre-scale；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第298页；原文字段表：High Speed Time-base Clock Prescale Bits

These bits determine part of the time-base clock prescale value.
TBCLK = SYSCLKOUT / (HSPCLKDIV × CLKDIV)
This divisor emulates the HSPCLK in the TMS320x281x system as used on the Event Manager
(EV) peripheral.
000 /1
001 /2 (default on reset)
010 /4
011 /6
100 /8
101 /10
110 /12
111 /14；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: CLKDIV
Fields.Description: 时基低速预分频选择。
Fields.Notes:
原文：12:10  Timebase clock pre-scale；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第297页；原文字段表：Time-base Clock Prescale Bits

These bits determine part of the time-base clock prescale value.
TBCLK = SYSCLKOUT / (HSPCLKDIV × CLKDIV)
000 /1 (default on reset)
001 /2
010 /4
011 /8
100 /16
101 /32
110 /64
111 /128；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: PHSDIR
Fields.Description: 上下计数模式下，同步载入相位后的计数方向。
Fields.Values: 0：同步后向下计数；1：同步后向上计数。
Fields.Notes:
原文：13     Phase Direction；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第297页；原文字段表：Phase Direction Bit.

This bit is only used when the time-base counter is configured in the up-down-count mode. The
PHSDIR bit indicates the direction the time-base counter (TBCTR) will count after a synchronization
event occurs and a new phase value is loaded from the phase (TBPHS) register. This is
irrespective of the direction of the counter before the synchronization event..
In the up-count and down-count modes this bit is ignored.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

FFFFh
These bits determine the period of the time-base counter. This sets the PWM frequency.
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the TBCTL[PRDLD] bit. By default this register is
shadowed.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go to the
shadow register. In this case, the active register will be loaded from the shadow register when the time-
base counter equals zero.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 1, then the shadow is disabled and any write or read will go directly to the active
register, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• The active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.

Fields.Name: CMPB
Fields.Description: 比较 B reg
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：值 中 活动 CMPB 寄存器 为 continuously compared 至 时基 计数器 (TBCTR). 当 values are equal, counter-compare 模块 产生 "时基 计数器 equal 至 计数器 比较 B" 事件. 此 事件 为 sent 至 action-qualifier where it 为 限定后 及 converted it 进入 单次 或 more actions. These actions CAN be applied 至 either EPWMxA 或 EPWMxB 输出 depending 开启 配置 的 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器. actions that CAN be defined 中 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器 include: • 执行 nothing. 事件 为 忽略. • 清除: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 低 • 置位: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 高 • 翻转 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 Shadowing 的 此 寄存器 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能 及 any 写入 或 读取 will automatically go 至 影子 寄存器. 中 此 case, CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] 位 field 决定 which 事件 will 加载 活动 寄存器 来自 影子 寄存器: • Before 写入, CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] 位 CAN be 读取 至 determine 如果 影子 寄存器 为 currently 满. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用 及 any 写入 或 读取 will go directly 至 活动 寄存器, that 为 寄存器 actively controlling 硬件. • 中 either 模式, 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：Compare B reg；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第301页；原文字段表：The value in the active CMPB register is continuously compared to the time-base counter (TBCTR). When the

values are equal, the counter-compare module generates a "time-base counter equal to counter compare B"
event. This event is sent to the action-qualifier where it is qualified and converted it into one or more actions.
These actions can be applied to either the EPWMxA or the EPWMxB output depending on the configuration of
the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers. The actions that can be defined in the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers
include:
• Do nothing. event is ignored.
• Clear: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal low
• Set: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal high
• Toggle the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] bit. By default this register is
shadowed.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go to the
shadow register. In this case, the CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] bit field determines which event will load the active
register from the shadow register:
• Before a write, the CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] bit can be read to determine if the shadow register is currently full.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is disabled and any write or read will go directly to
the active register, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• In either mode, the active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OUT_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输出 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 输出 模式 控制 位 1 控制 S1 switch 及 位 0 控制 S0 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively 使能 或 bypass 死区 产生 用于 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟. 00 死区 产生 为 bypassed 用于 both 输出 信号. 中 此 模式, both EPWMxA 及 EPWMxB 输出 信号 来自 action-qualifier are passed directly 至 PWM-chopper submodule. 中 此 模式, POLSEL 及 中_模式 位 have no effect.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    Dead Band Output Mode Control；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第309页；原文字段表：Dead-band Output Mode Control

Bit 1 controls the S1 switch and bit 0 controls the S0 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively enable or bypass the dead-band generation for the falling-edge and
rising-edge delay.
00 Dead-band generation is bypassed for both output signals. In this mode, both the EPWMxA and
EPWMxB output signals from the action-qualifier are passed directly to the PWM-chopper
submodule.
In this mode, the POLSEL and IN_MODE bits have no effect.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: POLSEL
Fields.Description: 极性 选择 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：极性 选择 控制 位 3 控制 S3 switch 及 位 2 控制 S2 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively invert 单次 的 delayed 信号 before it 为 sent out 的 死区 submodule. following descriptions correspond 至 classical upper/lower switch 控制 作为 found 中 单次 leg 的 数字 motor 控制 inverter. These assume that DBCTL[OUT_模式] = 1,1 及 DBCTL[中_模式] = 0,0. Other enhanced modes are also possible, but 不 regarded 作为 typical usage modes.
Fields.Notes:
原文：3:2    Polarity Select Control；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第308页；原文字段表：Polarity Select Control

Bit 3 controls the S3 switch and bit 2 controls the S2 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively invert one of the delayed signals before it is sent out of the dead-band
submodule.
The following descriptions correspond to classical upper/lower switch control as found in one leg of
a digital motor control inverter.
These assume that DBCTL[OUT_MODE] = 1,1 and DBCTL[IN_MODE] = 0,0. Other enhanced
modes are also possible, but not regarded as typical usage modes.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: IN_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输入 选择 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 带 输入 模式 控制 位 5 控制 S5 switch 及 位 4 控制 S4 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 选择 输入 来源 至 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟. 至 produce classical 死区 waveforms 默认 为 EPWMxA 中 为 来源 用于 both 下降沿 及 rising-edge delays.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5:4    Dead Band Input Select Mode Control；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第308页；原文字段表：Dead Band Input Mode Control

Bit 5 controls the S5 switch and bit 4 controls the S4 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to select the input source to the falling-edge and rising-edge delay.
To produce classical dead-band waveforms the default is EPWMxA In is the source for both falling
and rising-edge delays.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INTPRD
Fields.Description: EPWMxINTn 周期 选择
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ePWM 中断 (ePWMx_中断) 周期 选择 These 位 determine how many 已选 ETSEL[INTSEL] events need 至 occur before 中断 为 已产生. 至 be 已产生, 中断 must be 已使能 (ETSEL[中断] = 1). 如果 中断 状态 标志 为 置位 来自 前次 中断 (ETFLG[中断] = 1) then no 中断 will be 已产生 until 标志 为 cleared via ETCLR[中断] 位. 此 allows 用于 单次 中断 至 be 待处理 期间 another 为 still being serviced. Once 中断 为 已产生, ETPS[INTCNT] 位 will automatically be cleared. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 same 作为 当前 计数器 值 will 触发 中断 如果 it 为 已使能 及 状态 标志 为 清除. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 less than 当前 计数器 值 will 结果 中 undefined 状态. 如果 计数器 事件 发生 在 same instant 作为 new 零 或 non-zero INTPRD 值 为 written, 计数器 为 incremented.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    EPWMxINTn Period Select；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第323页；原文字段表：ePWM Interrupt (EPWMx_INT) Period Select

These bits determine how many selected ETSEL[INTSEL] events need to occur before an interrupt
is generated. To be generated, the interrupt must be enabled (ETSEL[INT] = 1). If the interrupt
status flag is set from a previous interrupt (ETFLG[INT] = 1) then no interrupt will be generated until
the flag is cleared via the ETCLR[INT] bit. This allows for one interrupt to be pending while another
is still being serviced. Once the interrupt is generated, the ETPS[INTCNT] bits will automatically be
cleared.
Writing a INTPRD value that is the same as the current counter value will trigger an interrupt if it is
enabled and the status flag is clear.
Writing a INTPRD value that is less than the current counter value will result in an undefined state.
If a counter event occurs at the same instant as a new zero or non-zero INTPRD value is written,
the counter is incremented.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CTRMODE
Fields.Description: 时基计数模式。
Fields.Values: 0：向上计数；1：向下计数；2：上下计数；3：停止/冻结。
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    Counter Mode；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第298页；原文字段表：Counter Mode

The time-base counter mode is normally configured once and not changed during normal operation.
If you change the mode of the counter, the change will take effect at the next TBCLK edge and the
current counter value shall increment or decrement from the value before the mode change.
These bits set the time-base counter mode of operation as follows:
00 Up-count mode
01 Down-count mode
10 Up-down-count mode
11 Stop-freeze counter operation (default on reset)；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Notes:
原文：9:7    High speed time pre-scale；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第298页；原文字段表：High Speed Time-base Clock Prescale Bits

These bits determine part of the time-base clock prescale value.
TBCLK = SYSCLKOUT / (HSPCLKDIV × CLKDIV)
This divisor emulates the HSPCLK in the TMS320x281x system as used on the Event Manager
(EV) peripheral.
000 /1
001 /2 (default on reset)
010 /4
011 /6
100 /8
101 /10
110 /12
111 /14；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

001 /2
010 /4
011 /8
100 /16
101 /32
110 /64
111 /128；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: PHSDIR
Fields.Description: 上下计数模式下，同步载入相位后的计数方向。
Fields.Values: 0：同步后向下计数；1：同步后向上计数。
Fields.Notes:
原文：13     Phase Direction；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第297页；原文字段表：Phase Direction Bit.

This bit is only used when the time-base counter is configured in the up-down-count mode. The
PHSDIR bit indicates the direction the time-base counter (TBCTR) will count after a synchronization
event occurs and a new phase value is loaded from the phase (TBPHS) register. This is
irrespective of the direction of the counter before the synchronization event..
In the up-count and down-count modes this bit is ignored.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Notes:
原文：Period register set；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第296页；原文字段表：0000-

FFFFh
These bits determine the period of the time-base counter. This sets the PWM frequency.
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the TBCTL[PRDLD] bit. By default this register is
shadowed.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go to the
shadow register. In this case, the active register will be loaded from the shadow register when the time-
base counter equals zero.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 1, then the shadow is disabled and any write or read will go directly to the active
register, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• The active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.

Fields.Name: CMPB
Fields.Description: 比较 B reg
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：值 中 活动 CMPB 寄存器 为 continuously compared 至 时基 计数器 (TBCTR). 当 values are equal, counter-compare 模块 产生 "时基 计数器 equal 至 计数器 比较 B" 事件. 此 事件 为 sent 至 action-qualifier where it 为 限定后 及 converted it 进入 单次 或 more actions. These actions CAN be applied 至 either EPWMxA 或 EPWMxB 输出 depending 开启 配置 的 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器. actions that CAN be defined 中 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器 include: • 执行 nothing. 事件 为 忽略. • 清除: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 低 • 置位: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 高 • 翻转 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 Shadowing 的 此 寄存器 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能 及 any 写入 或 读取 will automatically go 至 影子 寄存器. 中 此 case, CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] 位 field 决定 which 事件 will 加载 活动 寄存器 来自 影子 寄存器: • Before 写入, CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] 位 CAN be 读取 至 determine 如果 影子 寄存器 为 currently 满. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用 及 any 写入 或 读取 will go directly 至 活动 寄存器, that 为 寄存器 actively controlling 硬件. • 中 either 模式, 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：Compare B reg；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第301页；原文字段表：The value in the active CMPB register is continuously compared to the time-base counter (TBCTR). When the

values are equal, the counter-compare module generates a "time-base counter equal to counter compare B"
event. This event is sent to the action-qualifier where it is qualified and converted it into one or more actions.
These actions can be applied to either the EPWMxA or the EPWMxB output depending on the configuration of
the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers. The actions that can be defined in the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers
include:
• Do nothing. event is ignored.
• Clear: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal low
• Set: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal high
• Toggle the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] bit. By default this register is
shadowed.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go to the
shadow register. In this case, the CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] bit field determines which event will load the active
register from the shadow register:
• Before a write, the CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] bit can be read to determine if the shadow register is currently full.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is disabled and any write or read will go directly to
the active register, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• In either mode, the active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。
