Fields.Name: OUT_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输出 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 输出 模式 控制 位 1 控制 S1 switch 及 位 0 控制 S0 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively 使能 或 bypass 死区 产生 用于 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟. 00 死区 产生 为 bypassed 用于 both 输出 信号. 中 此 模式, both EPWMxA 及 EPWMxB 输出 信号 来自 action-qualifier are passed directly 至 PWM-chopper submodule. 中 此 模式, POLSEL 及 中_模式 位 have no effect.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    Dead Band Output Mode Control；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第309页；原文字段表：Dead-band Output Mode Control

Bit 1 controls the S1 switch and bit 0 controls the S0 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively enable or bypass the dead-band generation for the falling-edge and
rising-edge delay.
00 Dead-band generation is bypassed for both output signals. In this mode, both the EPWMxA and
EPWMxB output signals from the action-qualifier are passed directly to the PWM-chopper
submodule.
In this mode, the POLSEL and IN_MODE bits have no effect.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: POLSEL
Fields.Description: 极性 选择 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：极性 选择 控制 位 3 控制 S3 switch 及 位 2 控制 S2 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively invert 单次 的 delayed 信号 before it 为 sent out 的 死区 submodule. following descriptions correspond 至 classical upper/lower switch 控制 作为 found 中 单次 leg 的 数字 motor 控制 inverter. These assume that DBCTL[OUT_模式] = 1,1 及 DBCTL[中_模式] = 0,0. Other enhanced modes are also possible, but 不 regarded 作为 typical usage modes.
Fields.Notes:
原文：3:2    Polarity Select Control；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第308页；原文字段表：Polarity Select Control

Bit 3 controls the S3 switch and bit 2 controls the S2 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively invert one of the delayed signals before it is sent out of the dead-band
submodule.
The following descriptions correspond to classical upper/lower switch control as found in one leg of
a digital motor control inverter.
These assume that DBCTL[OUT_MODE] = 1,1 and DBCTL[IN_MODE] = 0,0. Other enhanced
modes are also possible, but not regarded as typical usage modes.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: IN_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输入 选择 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 带 输入 模式 控制 位 5 控制 S5 switch 及 位 4 控制 S4 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 选择 输入 来源 至 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟. 至 produce classical 死区 waveforms 默认 为 EPWMxA 中 为 来源 用于 both 下降沿 及 rising-edge delays.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5:4    Dead Band Input Select Mode Control；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第308页；原文字段表：Dead Band Input Mode Control

Bit 5 controls the S5 switch and bit 4 controls the S4 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to select the input source to the falling-edge and rising-edge delay.
To produce classical dead-band waveforms the default is EPWMxA In is the source for both falling
and rising-edge delays.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INTPRD
Fields.Description: EPWMxINTn 周期 选择
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ePWM 中断 (ePWMx_中断) 周期 选择 These 位 determine how many 已选 ETSEL[INTSEL] events need 至 occur before 中断 为 已产生. 至 be 已产生, 中断 must be 已使能 (ETSEL[中断] = 1). 如果 中断 状态 标志 为 置位 来自 前次 中断 (ETFLG[中断] = 1) then no 中断 will be 已产生 until 标志 为 cleared via ETCLR[中断] 位. 此 allows 用于 单次 中断 至 be 待处理 期间 another 为 still being serviced. Once 中断 为 已产生, ETPS[INTCNT] 位 will automatically be cleared. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 same 作为 当前 计数器 值 will 触发 中断 如果 it 为 已使能 及 状态 标志 为 清除. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 less than 当前 计数器 值 will 结果 中 undefined 状态. 如果 计数器 事件 发生 在 same instant 作为 new 零 或 non-zero INTPRD 值 为 written, 计数器 为 incremented.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    EPWMxINTn Period Select；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第323页；原文字段表：ePWM Interrupt (EPWMx_INT) Period Select

These bits determine how many selected ETSEL[INTSEL] events need to occur before an interrupt
is generated. To be generated, the interrupt must be enabled (ETSEL[INT] = 1). If the interrupt
status flag is set from a previous interrupt (ETFLG[INT] = 1) then no interrupt will be generated until
the flag is cleared via the ETCLR[INT] bit. This allows for one interrupt to be pending while another
is still being serviced. Once the interrupt is generated, the ETPS[INTCNT] bits will automatically be
cleared.
Writing a INTPRD value that is the same as the current counter value will trigger an interrupt if it is
enabled and the status flag is clear.
Writing a INTPRD value that is less than the current counter value will result in an undefined state.
If a counter event occurs at the same instant as a new zero or non-zero INTPRD value is written,
the counter is incremented.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CTRMODE
Fields.Description: 时基计数模式。
Fields.Values: 0：向上计数；1：向下计数；2：上下计数；3：停止/冻结。
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    Counter Mode；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第298页；原文字段表：Counter Mode

The time-base counter mode is normally configured once and not changed during normal operation.
If you change the mode of the counter, the change will take effect at the next TBCLK edge and the
current counter value shall increment or decrement from the value before the mode change.
These bits set the time-base counter mode of operation as follows:
00 Up-count mode
01 Down-count mode
10 Up-down-count mode
11 Stop-freeze counter operation (default on reset)；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: HSPCLKDIV
Fields.Description: 时基高速预分频选择。
Fields.Notes:
原文：9:7    High speed time pre-scale；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第298页；原文字段表：High Speed Time-base Clock Prescale Bits

These bits determine part of the time-base clock prescale value.
TBCLK = SYSCLKOUT / (HSPCLKDIV × CLKDIV)
This divisor emulates the HSPCLK in the TMS320x281x system as used on the Event Manager
(EV) peripheral.
000 /1
001 /2 (default on reset)
010 /4
011 /6
100 /8
101 /10
110 /12
111 /14；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: CLKDIV
Fields.Description: 时基低速预分频选择。
Fields.Notes:
原文：12:10  Timebase clock pre-scale；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第297页；原文字段表：Time-base Clock Prescale Bits

These bits determine part of the time-base clock prescale value.
TBCLK = SYSCLKOUT / (HSPCLKDIV × CLKDIV)
000 /1 (default on reset)
001 /2
010 /4
011 /8
100 /16
101 /32
110 /64
111 /128；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: PHSDIR
Fields.Description: 上下计数模式下，同步载入相位后的计数方向。
Fields.Values: 0：同步后向下计数；1：同步后向上计数。
Fields.Notes:
原文：13     Phase Direction；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第297页；原文字段表：Phase Direction Bit.

This bit is only used when the time-base counter is configured in the up-down-count mode. The
PHSDIR bit indicates the direction the time-base counter (TBCTR) will count after a synchronization
event occurs and a new phase value is loaded from the phase (TBPHS) register. This is
irrespective of the direction of the counter before the synchronization event..
In the up-count and down-count modes this bit is ignored.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: TBPRD
Fields.Description: 时基周期计数值。
Fields.Values: 向上/向下计数：频率=TBCLK/(TBPRD+1)；上下计数：频率=TBCLK/(2×TBPRD)。
Fields.Notes:
原文：Period register set；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第296页；原文字段表：0000-

FFFFh
These bits determine the period of the time-base counter. This sets the PWM frequency.
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the TBCTL[PRDLD] bit. By default this register is
shadowed.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go to the
shadow register. In this case, the active register will be loaded from the shadow register when the time-
base counter equals zero.
• If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 1, then the shadow is disabled and any write or read will go directly to the active
register, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• The active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.

Fields.Name: CMPB
Fields.Description: 比较 B reg
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：值 中 活动 CMPB 寄存器 为 continuously compared 至 时基 计数器 (TBCTR). 当 values are equal, counter-compare 模块 产生 "时基 计数器 equal 至 计数器 比较 B" 事件. 此 事件 为 sent 至 action-qualifier where it 为 限定后 及 converted it 进入 单次 或 more actions. These actions CAN be applied 至 either EPWMxA 或 EPWMxB 输出 depending 开启 配置 的 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器. actions that CAN be defined 中 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器 include: • 执行 nothing. 事件 为 忽略. • 清除: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 低 • 置位: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 高 • 翻转 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 Shadowing 的 此 寄存器 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能 及 any 写入 或 读取 will automatically go 至 影子 寄存器. 中 此 case, CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] 位 field 决定 which 事件 will 加载 活动 寄存器 来自 影子 寄存器: • Before 写入, CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] 位 CAN be 读取 至 determine 如果 影子 寄存器 为 currently 满. • 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用 及 any 写入 或 读取 will go directly 至 活动 寄存器, that 为 寄存器 actively controlling 硬件. • 中 either 模式, 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：Compare B reg；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第301页；原文字段表：The value in the active CMPB register is continuously compared to the time-base counter (TBCTR). When the

values are equal, the counter-compare module generates a "time-base counter equal to counter compare B"
event. This event is sent to the action-qualifier where it is qualified and converted it into one or more actions.
These actions can be applied to either the EPWMxA or the EPWMxB output depending on the configuration of
the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers. The actions that can be defined in the AQCTLA and AQCTLB registers
include:
• Do nothing. event is ignored.
• Clear: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal low
• Set: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal high
• Toggle the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] bit. By default this register is
shadowed.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write or read will automatically go to the
shadow register. In this case, the CMPCTL[LOADBMODE] bit field determines which event will load the active
register from the shadow register:
• Before a write, the CMPCTL[SHDWBFULL] bit can be read to determine if the shadow register is currently full.
• If CMPCTL[SHDWBMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is disabled and any write or read will go directly to
the active register, that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
• In either mode, the active and shadow registers share the same memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OUT_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输出 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 输出 模式 控制 位 1 控制 S1 switch 及 位 0 控制 S0 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively 使能 或 bypass 死区 产生 用于 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟. 00 死区 产生 为 bypassed 用于 both 输出 信号. 中 此 模式, both EPWMxA 及 EPWMxB 输出 信号 来自 action-qualifier are passed directly 至 PWM-chopper submodule. 中 此 模式, POLSEL 及 中_模式 位 have no effect.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    Dead Band Output Mode Control；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第309页；原文字段表：Dead-band Output Mode Control

Bit 1 controls the S1 switch and bit 0 controls the S0 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively enable or bypass the dead-band generation for the falling-edge and
rising-edge delay.
00 Dead-band generation is bypassed for both output signals. In this mode, both the EPWMxA and
EPWMxB output signals from the action-qualifier are passed directly to the PWM-chopper
submodule.
In this mode, the POLSEL and IN_MODE bits have no effect.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: POLSEL
Fields.Description: 极性 选择 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：极性 选择 控制 位 3 控制 S3 switch 及 位 2 控制 S2 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 selectively invert 单次 的 delayed 信号 before it 为 sent out 的 死区 submodule. following descriptions correspond 至 classical upper/lower switch 控制 作为 found 中 单次 leg 的 数字 motor 控制 inverter. These assume that DBCTL[OUT_模式] = 1,1 及 DBCTL[中_模式] = 0,0. Other enhanced modes are also possible, but 不 regarded 作为 typical usage modes.
Fields.Notes:
原文：3:2    Polarity Select Control；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第308页；原文字段表：Polarity Select Control

Bit 3 controls the S3 switch and bit 2 controls the S2 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to selectively invert one of the delayed signals before it is sent out of the dead-band
submodule.
The following descriptions correspond to classical upper/lower switch control as found in one leg of
a digital motor control inverter.
These assume that DBCTL[OUT_MODE] = 1,1 and DBCTL[IN_MODE] = 0,0. Other enhanced
modes are also possible, but not regarded as typical usage modes.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: IN_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输入 选择 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 带 输入 模式 控制 位 5 控制 S5 switch 及 位 4 控制 S4 switch shown 中 Figure 3-29. 此 allows you 至 选择 输入 来源 至 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟. 至 produce classical 死区 waveforms 默认 为 EPWMxA 中 为 来源 用于 both 下降沿 及 rising-edge delays.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5:4    Dead Band Input Select Mode Control；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第308页；原文字段表：Dead Band Input Mode Control

Bit 5 controls the S5 switch and bit 4 controls the S4 switch shown in Figure 3-29.
This allows you to select the input source to the falling-edge and rising-edge delay.
To produce classical dead-band waveforms the default is EPWMxA In is the source for both falling
and rising-edge delays.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INTPRD
Fields.Description: EPWMxINTn 周期 选择
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ePWM 中断 (ePWMx_中断) 周期 选择 These 位 determine how many 已选 ETSEL[INTSEL] events need 至 occur before 中断 为 已产生. 至 be 已产生, 中断 must be 已使能 (ETSEL[中断] = 1). 如果 中断 状态 标志 为 置位 来自 前次 中断 (ETFLG[中断] = 1) then no 中断 will be 已产生 until 标志 为 cleared via ETCLR[中断] 位. 此 allows 用于 单次 中断 至 be 待处理 期间 another 为 still being serviced. Once 中断 为 已产生, ETPS[INTCNT] 位 will automatically be cleared. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 same 作为 当前 计数器 值 will 触发 中断 如果 it 为 已使能 及 状态 标志 为 清除. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 less than 当前 计数器 值 will 结果 中 undefined 状态. 如果 计数器 事件 发生 在 same instant 作为 new 零 或 non-zero INTPRD 值 为 written, 计数器 为 incremented.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0    EPWMxINTn Period Select；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第323页；原文字段表：ePWM Interrupt (EPWMx_INT) Period Select

These bits determine how many selected ETSEL[INTSEL] events need to occur before an interrupt
is generated. To be generated, the interrupt must be enabled (ETSEL[INT] = 1). If the interrupt
status flag is set from a previous interrupt (ETFLG[INT] = 1) then no interrupt will be generated until
the flag is cleared via the ETCLR[INT] bit. This allows for one interrupt to be pending while another
is still being serviced. Once the interrupt is generated, the ETPS[INTCNT] bits will automatically be
cleared.
Writing a INTPRD value that is the same as the current counter value will trigger an interrupt if it is
enabled and the status flag is clear.
Writing a INTPRD value that is less than the current counter value will result in an undefined state.
If a counter event occurs at the same instant as a new zero or non-zero INTPRD value is written,
the counter is incremented.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: ARBL
Fields.Description: 仲裁 丢失 中断
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Arbitration-lost 中断 标志 位 (仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 master-transmitter). ARBL primarily 表示 当 I2C 模块 has 丢失 仲裁 contest 带 another mastertransmitter. CPU CAN poll ARBL 或 use ARBL 中断 请求. 0h (R/W) = 仲裁 不 丢失. AL 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - AL 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - CPU reads 中断 来源 寄存器 (I2CISRC) 及 寄存器 包含 编码 用于 AL 中断. 仿真器 reads 的 I2CISRC 执行 不 affect 此 位. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = 仲裁 丢失. AL 为 置位 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2C 模块 senses that it has 丢失 仲裁 带 two 或 more competing transmitters that started 发送 almost simultaneously. - I2C 模块 attempts 至 启动 transfer 期间 BB (总线 忙碌) 位 为 置位 至 1. 当 AL becomes 1, MST 及 STP 位 的 I2CMDR are cleared, 及 I2C 模块 becomes slave-receiver.
Fields.Notes:
原文：0      Arbitration lost interrupt；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第639页；原文字段表：Arbitration-lost interrupt flag bit (only applicable when the I2C

module is a master-transmitter).
ARBL primarily indicates when the I2C module has lost an arbitration
contest with another mastertransmitter. The CPU can poll ARBL or
use the ARBL interrupt request.
0h (R/W) = Arbitration not lost. AL is cleared by any one of the
following events:
- AL is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The CPU reads the interrupt source register (I2CISRC) and the
register contains the code for an
AL interrupt. Emulator reads of the I2CISRC do not affect this bit.
- The I2C module is reset.
1h (R/W) = Arbitration lost. AL is set by any one of the following
events:
- The I2C module senses that it has lost an arbitration with two or
more competing transmitters that started a transmission almost
simultaneously.
- The I2C module attempts to start a transfer while the BB (bus
busy) bit is set to 1.
When AL becomes 1, the MST and STP bits of I2CMDR are
cleared, and the I2C module becomes a slave-receiver.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: NACK
Fields.Description: No ack 中断
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：No-acknowledgment 中断 标志 位. NACK applies 当 I2C 模块 为 发送器 (主机 或 从机). NACK 表示 是否 I2C 模块 has 已检测 应答 位 (ACK) 或 noacknowledge 位 (NACK) 来自 接收器. CPU CAN poll NACK 或 use NACK 中断 请求. 0h (R/W) = ACK received/NACK 不 已接收. 此 位 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - 应答 位 (ACK) has been sent 通过 接收器. - NACK 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - CPU reads 中断 来源 寄存器 (I2CISRC) 及 寄存器 包含 编码 用于 NACK 中断. 仿真器 reads 的 I2CISRC 执行 不 affect 此 位. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = NACK 位 已接收. 硬件 detects that no- 应答 (NACK) 位 has been 已接收. Note: 期间 I2C 模块 performs general call transfer, NACK 为 1, even 如果 单次 或 more slaves send acknowledgment.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1      No ack interrupt；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第639页；原文字段表：No-acknowledgment interrupt flag bit.

NACK applies when the I2C module is a transmitter (master or
slave). NACK indicates whether the I2C module has detected an
acknowledge bit (ACK) or a noacknowledge bit (NACK) from the
receiver. The CPU can poll NACK or use the NACK interrupt
request.
0h (R/W) = ACK received/NACK not received. This bit is cleared by
any one of the following events:
- An acknowledge bit (ACK) has been sent by the receiver.
- NACK is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The CPU reads the interrupt source register (I2CISRC) and the
register contains the code for a NACK interrupt. Emulator reads of
the I2CISRC do not affect this bit.
- The I2C module is reset.
1h (R/W) = NACK bit received. The hardware detects that a no-
acknowledge (NACK) bit has been received.
Note: While the I2C module performs a general call transfer, NACK
is 1, even if one or more slaves send acknowledgment.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: ARDY
Fields.Description: 寄存器 访问 就绪 中断
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Register-access-ready 中断 标志 位 (仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 中 主机 模式). ARDY 表示 that I2C 模块 寄存器 are 就绪 至 be accessed because previously programmed 地址, 数据, 及 command values have been 使用. CPU CAN poll ARDY 或 use ARDY 中断 请求. 0h (R/W) = 寄存器 are 不 就绪 至 be accessed. ARDY 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2C 模块 starts using 当前 寄存器 内容. - ARDY 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = 寄存器 are 就绪 至 be accessed. 中 nonrepeat 模式 (RM = 0 中 I2CMDR): 如果 STP = 0 中 I2CMDR, ARDY 位 为 置位 当 内部 数据 计数器 counts 下降 至 0. 如果 STP = 1, ARDY 为 不 affected (instead, I2C 模块 产生 停止 条件 当 计数器 reaches 0). 中 重复 模式 (RM = 1): ARDY 为 置位 在 end 的 每个 字节 已发送 来自 I2CDXR.
Fields.Notes:
原文：2      Register access ready interrupt；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第638页；原文字段表：Register-access-ready interrupt flag bit (only applicable when the I2C

module is in the master
mode).
ARDY indicates that the I2C module registers are ready to be
accessed because the previously programmed address, data, and
command values have been used. The CPU can poll ARDY or use
the ARDY interrupt request.
0h (R/W) = The registers are not ready to be accessed. ARDY is
cleared by any one of the following events:
- The I2C module starts using the current register contents.
- ARDY is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The I2C module is reset.
1h (R/W) = The registers are ready to be accessed.
In the nonrepeat mode (RM = 0 in I2CMDR): If STP = 0 in
I2CMDR, the ARDY bit is set when the internal data counter counts
down to 0. If STP = 1, ARDY is not affected (instead, the I2C
module generates a STOP condition when the counter reaches 0).
In the repeat mode (RM = 1): ARDY is set at the end of each byte
transmitted from I2CDXR.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RRDY
Fields.Description: Recieve 数据 就绪 中断
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Receive-data-ready 中断 标志 位. 当 不 中 FIFO队列 模式, RRDY 表示 that 数据 接收 寄存器 (I2CDRR) 为 就绪 至 be 读取 because 数据 has been copied 来自 接收 shift 寄存器 (I2CRSR) 至 I2CDRR. CPU CAN poll RRDY 或 use RRDY 中断 请求 当 中 FIFO队列 模式, use RXFFINT instead. 0h (R/W) = I2CDRR 不 就绪. RRDY 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2CDRR 为 读取 通过 CPU. 仿真器 reads 的 I2CDRR 执行 不 affect 此 位. - RRDY 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = I2CDRR 就绪: 数据 has been copied 来自 I2CRSR 至 I2CDRR.
Fields.Notes:
原文：3      Recieve data ready interrupt；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第638页；原文字段表：Receive-data-ready interrupt flag bit.

When not in FIFO mode, RRDY indicates that the data receive
register (I2CDRR) is ready to be read because data has been copied
from the receive shift register (I2CRSR) to I2CDRR. The CPU can
poll RRDY or use the RRDY interrupt request When in FIFO mode,
use RXFFINT instead.
0h (R/W) = I2CDRR not ready. RRDY is cleared by any one of the
following events:
- I2CDRR is read by the CPU. Emulator reads of the I2CDRR do
not affect this bit.
- RRDY is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The I2C module is reset.
1h (R/W) = I2CDRR ready: Data has been copied from I2CRSR to
I2CDRR.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: XRDY
Fields.Description: 发送 数据 就绪 中断
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Transmit-data-ready 中断 标志 位. 当 不 中 FIFO队列 模式, XRDY 表示 that 数据 发送 寄存器 (I2CDXR) 为 就绪 至 accept new 数据 because 前次 数据 has been copied 来自 I2CDXR 至 发送 shift 寄存器 (I2CXSR). CPU CAN poll XRDY 或 use XRDY 中断 请求 当 中 FIFO队列 模式, use TXFFINT instead. 0h (R/W) = I2CDXR 不 就绪. XRDY 为 cleared 当 数据 为 written 至 I2CDXR. 1h (R/W) = I2CDXR 就绪: 数据 has been copied 来自 I2CDXR 至 I2CXSR. XRDY 为 also forced 至 1 当 I2C 模块 为 复位.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4      Transmit data ready interrupt；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第638页；原文字段表：Transmit-data-ready interrupt flag bit.

When not in FIFO mode, XRDY indicates that the data transmit
register (I2CDXR) is ready to accept new data because the previous
data has been copied from I2CDXR to the transmit shift register
(I2CXSR). The CPU can poll XRDY or use the XRDY interrupt
request When in FIFO mode, use TXFFINT instead.
0h (R/W) = I2CDXR not ready. XRDY is cleared when data is
written to I2CDXR.
1h (R/W) = I2CDXR ready: Data has been copied from I2CDXR to
I2CXSR.
XRDY is also forced to 1 when the I2C module is reset.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SCD
Fields.Description: 停止 条件 检测
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：停止 条件 已检测 位. SCD 为 置位 当 I2C sends 或 receives 停止 条件. I2C 模块 delays clearing 的 I2CMDR[STP] 位 until SCD 位 为 置位. 0h (R/W) = 停止 条件 不 已检测 since SCD was 最后 cleared. SCD 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2CISRC 为 读取 通过 CPU 当 it 包含 值 110b (停止 条件 已检测). 仿真器 reads 的 I2CISRC 执行 不 affect 此 位. - SCD 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = 停止 条件 has been 已检测 开启 I2C 总线.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5      Stop condition detection；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第637页；原文字段表：Stop condition detected bit.

SCD is set when the I2C sends or receives a STOP condition. The
I2C module delays clearing of the I2CMDR[STP] bit until the SCD bit
is set.
0h (R/W) = STOP condition not detected since SCD was last
cleared. SCD is cleared by any one of the following events:
- I2CISRC is read by the CPU when it contains the value 110b
(stop condition detected). Emulator reads of the I2CISRC do not
affect this bit.
- SCD is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The I2C module is reset.
1h (R/W) = A STOP condition has been detected on the I2C bus.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Notes:
原文：8      Address Zero；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第637页；原文字段表：Address 0 bits

0h (R/W) = AD0 has been cleared by a START or STOP condition.
1h (R/W) = An address of all zeros (general call) is detected.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: AAS
Fields.Description: 地址 作为 从机
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Addressed-as-slave 位 0h (R/W) = 中 7-位 addressing 模式, AAS 位 为 cleared 当 receiving NACK, 停止 条件, 或 repeated 启动 条件. 中 10-位 addressing 模式, AAS 位 为 cleared 当 receiving NACK, 停止 条件, 或 通过 从机 地址 different 来自 I2C 外设's own 从机 地址. 1h (R/W) = I2C 模块 has recognized its own 从机 地址 或 地址 的 全部 zeros (general call).
Fields.Notes:
原文：9      Address as slave；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第637页；原文字段表：Addressed-as-slave bit

0h (R/W) = In the 7-bit addressing mode, the AAS bit is cleared
when receiving a NACK, a STOP condition, or a repeated START
condition. In the 10-bit addressing mode, the AAS bit is cleared
when receiving a NACK, a STOP condition, or by a slave address
different from the I2C peripheral's own slave address.
1h (R/W) = The I2C module has recognized its own slave address
or an address of all zeros (general call).；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: XSMT
Fields.Description: XMIT shift 空
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：发送 shift 寄存器 空 位. XSMT = 0 表示 that 发送器 has experienced 下溢. 下溢 发生 当 发送 shift 寄存器 (I2CXSR) 为 空 but 数据 发送 寄存器 (I2CDXR) has 不 been loaded since 最后 I2CDXR-to-I2CXSR transfer. 下次 I2CDXR-to-I2CXSR transfer will 不 occur until new 数据 为 中 I2CDXR. 如果 new 数据 为 不 transferred 中 时间, 前次 数据 may be re-transmitted 开启 SDA 引脚. 0h (R/W) = 下溢 已检测 (空) 1h (R/W) = No 下溢 已检测 (不 空). XSMT 为 置位 通过 单次 的 following events: - 数据 为 written 至 I2CDXR. - I2C 模块 为 复位
Fields.Notes:
原文：10     XMIT shift empty；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第637页；原文字段表：Transmit shift register empty bit.

XSMT = 0 indicates that the transmitter has experienced underflow.
Underflow occurs when the transmit shift register (I2CXSR) is empty
but the data transmit register (I2CDXR) has not been loaded since
the last I2CDXR-to-I2CXSR transfer. The next I2CDXR-to-I2CXSR
transfer will not occur until new data is in I2CDXR. If new data is not
transferred in time, the previous data may be re-transmitted on the
SDA pin.
0h (R/W) = Underflow detected (empty)
1h (R/W) = No underflow detected (not empty). XSMT is set by one
of the following events:
- Data is written to I2CDXR.
- The I2C module is reset；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RSFULL
Fields.Description: Recieve shift 满
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：接收 shift 寄存器 满 位. RSFULL 表示 溢出 条件 during 接收. 溢出 发生 当 new 数据 为 已接收 进入 shift 寄存器 (I2CRSR) 及 old 数据 has 不 been 读取 来自 接收 寄存器 (I2CDRR). 作为 new 位 arrive 来自 SDA 引脚, they overwrite 位 中 I2CRSR. new 数据 will 不 be copied 至 ICDRR until 前次 数据 为 读取. 0h (R/W) = No 溢出 已检测. RSFULL 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2CDRR 为 读取 为 读取 通过 CPU. 仿真器 reads 的 I2CDRR 执行 不 affect 此 位. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = 溢出 已检测
Fields.Notes:
原文：11     Recieve shift full；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第637页；原文字段表：Receive shift register full bit.

RSFULL indicates an overrun condition during reception. Overrun
occurs when new data is received into the shift register (I2CRSR)
and the old data has not been read from the receive register
(I2CDRR). As new bits arrive from the SDA pin, they overwrite the
bits in I2CRSR. The new data will not be copied to ICDRR until the
previous data is read.
0h (R/W) = No overrun detected. RSFULL is cleared by any one of
the following events:
- I2CDRR is read is read by the CPU. Emulator reads of the
I2CDRR do not affect this bit.
- The I2C module is reset.
1h (R/W) = Overrun detected；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: BB
Fields.Description: 总线 忙碌

BB 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2C 模块 receives 或 transmits 停止 位 (总线 自由运行). - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = 总线 忙碌: I2C 模块 has 已接收 或 已发送 启动 位 开启 总线.
Fields.Notes:
原文：12     Bus busy；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第636页；原文字段表：Bus busy bit.

BB indicates whether the I2C-bus is busy or is free for another data
transfer. See the paragraph following the table for more information
0h (R/W) = Bus free. BB is cleared by any one of the following
events:
- The I2C module receives or transmits a STOP bit (bus free).
- The I2C module is reset.
1h (R/W) = Bus busy: The I2C module has received or transmitted
a START bit on the bus.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Description: 中文释义待整理；原字段说明：no ack sent

NACKSNT 位 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - It 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - I2C 模块 为 复位 (either 当 0 为 written 至 IRS 位 的 I2CMDR 或 当 whole device 为 复位). 1h (R/W) = NACK sent: no-acknowledge 位 was sent during 应答 周期 开启 I2C-bus.
Fields.Notes:
原文：13     A no ack sent；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第636页；原文字段表：NACK sent bit.

This bit is used when the I2C module is in the receiver mode. One
instance in which NACKSNT is affected is when the NACK mode is
used (see the description for NACKMOD in
0h (R/W) = NACK not sent. NACKSNT bit is cleared by any one of

0h (R/W) = I2C is not addressed as a slave transmitter. SDIR is

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：位 计数 位. BC 定义 数量 的 位 (1 至 8) 中 下次 数据 字节 that 为 至 be 已接收 或 已发送 通过 I2C 模块. 数量 的 位 已选 带 BC must 匹配 数据 长度 的 other device. Notice that 当 BC = 000b, 数据 字节 has 8 位. BC does 不 affect 地址 bytes, which always have 8 位. Note: 如果 位 计数 为 less than 8, 接收 数据 为 right-justified 中 I2CDRR(7-0), 及 other 位 的 I2CDRR(7-0) are undefined. affect address bytes, which always have 8 bits.

I2CDRR(7-0), and the other bits of I2CDRR(7-0) are undefined. Also,
transmit data written to I2CDXR must be right-justified

Fields.Name: FDF
Fields.Description: 自由运行 数据 格式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：自由运行 数据 格式 模式 位. 0h (R/W) = 自由运行 数据 格式 模式 为 已禁用. Transfers use 7-/10-位 addressing 格式 已选 通过 XA 位. 1h (R/W) = 自由运行 数据 格式 模式 为 已使能. Transfers have 自由运行 数据 (no 地址) 格式 described 中 Section 9.2.5. 自由运行 数据 格式 为 不 supported 中 数字 loopback 模式 (DLB=1).
Fields.Notes:
原文：3      Free data format；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第648页；原文字段表：Free data format mode bit.

0h (R/W) = Free data format mode is disabled. Transfers use the
7-/10-bit addressing format selected by the XA bit.
1h (R/W) = Free data format mode is enabled. Transfers have the
free data (no address) format described in Section 9.2.5.
The free data format is not supported in the digital loopback mode
(DLB=1).；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: STB
Fields.Description: 启动 字节
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：启动 字节 模式 位. 此 位 为 仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 主机. 作为 described 中 version 2.1 的 Philips Semiconductors I2C-bus specification, 启动 字节 CAN be 使用 至 help 从机 that needs extra 时间 至 检测 启动 条件. 当 I2C 模块 为 从机, it ignores 启动 字节 来自 主机, regardless 的 值 的 STB 位. 0h (R/W) = I2C 模块 为 不 中 启动 字节 模式. 1h (R/W) = I2C 模块 为 中 启动 字节 模式. 当 you 置位 启动 条件 位 (STT), I2C 模块 begins transfer 带 more than just 启动 条件. Specifically, it 产生: 1. 启动 条件 2. 启动 字节 (0000 0001b) 3. dummy 应答 时钟 脉冲 4. repeated 启动 条件 Then, 作为 normal, I2C 模块 sends 从机 地址 that 为 中 I2CSAR.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4      Start byte；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第648页；原文字段表：START byte mode bit. This bit is only applicable when the I2C

module is a master. As described in version 2.1 of the Philips
Semiconductors I2C-bus specification, the START byte can be used
to help a slave that needs extra time to detect a START condition.
When the I2C module is a slave, it ignores a START byte from a
master, regardless of the value of the STB bit.
0h (R/W) = The I2C module is not in the START byte mode.
1h (R/W) = The I2C module is in the START byte mode. When you
set the START condition bit (STT), the I2C module begins the
transfer with more than just a START condition. Specifically, it
generates:
1. A START condition
2. A START byte (0000 0001b)
3. A dummy acknowledge clock pulse
4. A repeated START condition
Then, as normal, the I2C module sends the slave address that is in
I2CSAR.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: IRS
Fields.Description: I2C 复位 不
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：I2C 模块 复位 位. 0h (R/W) = I2C 模块 为 中 reset/disabled. 当 此 位 为 cleared 至 0, 全部 状态 位 (中 I2CSTR) are 置位 至 their 默认 values. 1h (R/W) = I2C 模块 为 已使能. 此 has effect 的 releasing I2C 总线 如果 I2C 外设 为 holding it.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5      I2C Reset not；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第648页；原文字段表：I2C module reset bit.

0h (R/W) = The I2C module is in reset/disabled. When this bit is
cleared to 0, all status bits (in I2CSTR) are set to their default
values.
1h (R/W) = The I2C module is enabled. This has the effect of
releasing the I2C bus if the I2C peripheral is holding it.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: DLB
Fields.Description: 数字 loopback
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：数字 loopback 模式 位. 0h (R/W) = 数字 loopback 模式 为 已禁用. 1h (R/W) = 数字 loopback 模式 为 已使能. 用于 proper 操作 中 此 模式, MST 位 must be 1. 中 数字 loopback 模式, 数据 已发送 out 的 I2CDXR 为 已接收 中 I2CDRR after n device cycles 通过 内部 路径, where: n = ((I2C 输入 时钟 frequency/module 时钟 频率) x 8) 发送 时钟 为 also 接收 时钟. 地址 已发送 开启 SDA 引脚 为 地址 中 I2COAR. Note: 自由运行 数据 格式 (FDF = 1) 为 不 supported 中 数字 loopback 模式.
Fields.Notes:
原文：6      Digital loopback；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第648页；原文字段表：Digital loopback mode bit.

0h (R/W) = Digital loopback mode is disabled.
1h (R/W) = Digital loopback mode is enabled. For proper operation
in this mode, the MST bit must be 1.
In the digital loopback mode, data transmitted out of I2CDXR is
received in I2CDRR after n device cycles by an internal path,
where:
n = ((I2C input clock frequency/module clock frequency) x 8)
The transmit clock is also the receive clock. The address
transmitted on the SDA pin is the address in I2COAR.
Note: The free data format (FDF = 1) is not supported in the digital
loopback mode.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RM
Fields.Description: 重复 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：重复 模式 位 (仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 主机- 发送器). RM, STT, 及 STP 位 determine 当 I2C 模块 starts 及 stops 数据 transmissions 0h (R/W) = Nonrepeat 模式. 值 中 数据 计数 寄存器 (I2CCNT) 决定 how many bytes are received/transmitted 通过 I2C 模块. 1h (R/W) = 重复 模式. 数据 字节 为 已发送 每个 时间 I2CDXR 寄存器 为 written 至 (或 until 发送 FIFO队列 为 空 当 中 FIFO队列 模式) until STP 位 为 manually 置位. 值 的 I2CCNT 为 忽略. ARDY bit/interrupt CAN be 使用 至 determine 当 I2CDXR (或 FIFO队列) 为 就绪 用于 more 数据, 或 当 数据 has 全部 been sent 及 CPU 为 allowed 至 写入 至 STP 位.
Fields.Notes:
原文：7      Repeat mode；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第647页；原文字段表：Repeat mode bit (only applicable when the I2C module is a master-

transmitter).
The RM, STT, and STP bits determine when the I2C module starts
and stops data transmissions
0h (R/W) = Nonrepeat mode. The value in the data count register
(I2CCNT) determines how many bytes are
received/transmitted by the I2C module.
1h (R/W) = Repeat mode. A data byte is transmitted each time the
I2CDXR register is written to (or until the transmit FIFO is empty
when in FIFO mode) until the STP bit is manually set. The value of
I2CCNT is ignored. The ARDY bit/interrupt can be used to
determine when the I2CDXR (or FIFO) is ready for more data, or
when the data has all been sent and the CPU is allowed to write to
the STP bit.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: XA
Fields.Description: Expand 地址
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Expanded 地址 使能 位. 0h (R/W) = 7-位 addressing 模式 (normal 地址 模式). I2C 模块 transmits 7-位 从机 addresses (来自 位 6-0 的 I2CSAR), 及 its own 从机 地址 has 7 位 (位 6-0 的 I2COAR). 1h (R/W) = 10-位 addressing 模式 (expanded 地址 模式). I2C 模块 transmits 10-位 从机 addresses (来自 位 9-0 的 I2CSAR), 及 its own 从机 地址 has 10 位 (位 9-0 的 I2COAR).
Fields.Notes:
原文：8      Expand address；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第647页；原文字段表：Expanded address enable bit.

0h (R/W) = 7-bit addressing mode (normal address mode). The I2C
module transmits 7-bit slave addresses (from bits 6-0 of I2CSAR),
and its own slave address has 7 bits (bits 6-0 of I2COAR).
1h (R/W) = 10-bit addressing mode (expanded address mode).
The I2C module transmits 10-bit slave addresses (from bits 9-0 of
I2CSAR), and its own slave address has 10 bits (bits 9-0 of
I2COAR).；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TRX
Fields.Description: 中文释义待整理；原字段说明：Transmitter/reciever
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：发送器 模式 位. 当 relevant, TRX 选择 是否 I2C 模块 为 中 发送器 模式 或 接收器 模式. 0h (R/W) = 接收器 模式. I2C 模块 为 接收器 及 receives 数据 开启 SDA 引脚. 1h (R/W) = 发送器 模式. I2C 模块 为 发送器 及 transmits 数据 开启 SDA 引脚.
Fields.Notes:
原文：9      Transmitter/reciever；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第647页；原文字段表：Transmitter mode bit.

When relevant, TRX selects whether the I2C module is in the
transmitter mode or the receiver mode.
0h (R/W) = Receiver mode. The I2C module is a receiver and
receives data on the SDA pin.
1h (R/W) = Transmitter mode. The I2C module is a transmitter and
transmits data on the SDA pin.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: MST
Fields.Description: 中文释义待整理；原字段说明：Master/slave
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：主机 模式 位. MST 决定 是否 I2C 模块 为 中 从机 模式 或 主机 模式. MST 为 automatically changed 来自 1 至 0 当 I2C 主机 产生 停止 条件 0h (R/W) = 从机 模式. I2C 模块 为 从机 及 receives serial 时钟 来自 主机. 1h (R/W) = 主机 模式. I2C 模块 为 主机 及 产生 serial 时钟 开启 SCL 引脚.
Fields.Notes:
原文：10     Master/slave；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第647页；原文字段表：Master mode bit.

MST determines whether the I2C module is in the slave mode or the
master mode. MST is automatically changed from 1 to 0 when the
I2C master generates a STOP condition
0h (R/W) = Slave mode. The I2C module is a slave and receives
the serial clock from the master.
1h (R/W) = Master mode. The I2C module is a master and
generates the serial clock on the SCL pin.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: STP
Fields.Description: 停止 条件
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：停止 条件 位 (仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 主机). 中 主机 模式, RM,STT, 及 STP 位 determine 当 I2C 模块 starts 及 stops 数据 transmissions. Note that STT 及 STP 位 CAN be 使用 至 terminate 重复 模式, 及 that 此 位 为 不 writable 当 IRS=0. 当 中 非- 重复 模式, 在 最低 单次 字节 must be transferred before 停止 条件 CAN be 已产生. I2C 模块 delays clearing 的 此 位 until after I2CSTR[SCD] 位 为 置位. 至 avoid disrupting I2C 状态 machine, user must wait until 此 位 为 清除 before initiating new 报文. 0h (R/W) = STP 为 automatically cleared after 停止 条件 has been 已产生 1h (R/W) = STP has been 置位 通过 device 至 产生 停止 条件 当 内部 数据 计数器 的 I2C 模块 counts 下降 至 0.
Fields.Notes:
原文：11     Stop condition；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第647页；原文字段表：STOP condition bit (only applicable when the I2C module is a

master).
In the master mode, the RM,STT, and STP bits determine when the
I2C module starts and stops data transmissions.
Note that the STT and STP bits can be used to terminate the repeat
mode, and that this bit is not writable when IRS=0. When in non-
repeat mode, at least one byte must be transferred before a stop
condition can be generated. The I2C module delays clearing of this
bit until after the I2CSTR[SCD] bit is set. To avoid disrupting the I2C
state machine, the user must wait until this bit is clear before
initiating a new message.
0h (R/W) = STP is automatically cleared after the STOP condition
has been generated
1h (R/W) = STP has been set by the device to generate a STOP
condition when the internal data counter of the I2C module counts
down to 0.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: rsvd1
Fields.Description: 保留位；不要用于用户配置。
Fields.Values: 按该寄存器手册要求保留；不得假定保留位都可写0。
Fields.Notes: 保留位不得用于配置。；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第646页；原文字段表：Reserved；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: STT
Fields.Description: 启动 条件
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：启动 条件 位 (仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 主机). RM, STT, 及 STP 位 determine 当 I2C 模块 starts 及 stops 数据 transmissions (see 表 9-6). Note that STT 及 STP 位 CAN be 使用 至 terminate 重复 模式, 及 that 此 位 为 不 writable 当 IRS = 0. 0h (R/W) = 中 主机 模式, STT 为 automatically cleared after 启动 条件 has been 已产生. 1h (R/W) = 中 主机 模式, 设置 STT 至 1 causes I2C 模块 至 产生 启动 条件 开启 I2C-bus
Fields.Notes:
原文：13     Start condition；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第646页；原文字段表：START condition bit (only applicable when the I2C module is a

master). The RM, STT, and STP bits determine when the I2C
module starts and stops data transmissions (see Table 9-6). Note
that the STT and STP bits can be used to terminate the repeat
mode, and that this bit is not writable when IRS = 0.
0h (R/W) = In the master mode, STT is automatically cleared after
the START condition has been generated.
1h (R/W) = In the master mode, setting STT to 1 causes the I2C
module to generate a START condition on the I2C-bus；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: FREE
Fields.Description: 仿真 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：此 位 控制 动作 taken 通过 I2C 模块 当 debugger breakpoint 为 encountered. 0h (R/W) = 当 I2C 模块 为 主机: 如果 SCL 为 低 当 breakpoint 发生, I2C 模块 stops immediately 及 keeps driving SCL 低, 是否 I2C 模块 为 发送器 或 接收器. 如果 SCL 为 高, I2C 模块 waits until SCL becomes 低 及 then stops. 当 I2C 模块 为 从机: breakpoint forces I2C 模块 至 停止 当 当前 transmission/reception 为 complete. 1h (R/W) = I2C 模块 runs 自由运行 that 为, it continues 至 operate 当 breakpoint 发生.
Fields.Notes:
原文：14     Emulation mode；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第646页；原文字段表：This bit controls the action taken by the I2C module when a

debugger breakpoint is encountered.
0h (R/W) = When I2C module is master:
If SCL is low when the breakpoint occurs, the I2C module stops
immediately and keeps driving SCL low, whether the I2C module is
the transmitter or the receiver. If SCL is high, the I2C module waits
until SCL becomes low and then stops.
When I2C module is slave:
A breakpoint forces the I2C module to stop when the current
transmission/reception is complete.
1h (R/W) = The I2C module runs free
that is, it continues to operate when a breakpoint occurs.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: NACKMOD
Fields.Description: No Ack 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：NACK 模式 位. 此 位 为 仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 acting 作为 接收器. 0h (R/W) = 中 slave-receiver 模式: I2C 模块 sends 应答 (ACK) 位 至 发送器 during 每个 应答 周期 开启 总线. I2C 模块 仅 sends no-acknowledge (NACK) 位 如果 you 置位 NACKMOD 位. 中 master-receiver 模式: I2C 模块 sends ACK 位 during 每个 应答 周期 until 内部 数据 计数器 counts 下降 至 0. 在 that point, I2C 模块 sends NACK 位 至 发送器. 至 have NACK 位 sent earlier, you must 置位 NACKMOD 位 1h (R/W) = 中 either slave-receiver 或 master-receiver 模式: I2C 模块 sends NACK 位 至 发送器 during 下次 应答 周期 开启 总线. Once NACK 位 has been sent, NACKMOD 为 cleared. Important: 至 send NACK 位 中 下次 应答 周期, you must 置位 NACKMOD before 上升沿 边沿 的 最后 数据 位.
Fields.Notes:
原文：15     No Ack mode；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第646页；原文字段表：NACK mode bit. This bit is only applicable when the I2C module is

acting as a receiver.
0h (R/W) = In the slave-receiver mode: The I2C module sends an
acknowledge (ACK) bit to the transmitter during each acknowledge
cycle on the bus. The I2C module only sends a no-acknowledge
(NACK) bit if you set the NACKMOD bit.
In the master-receiver mode: The I2C module sends an ACK bit
during each acknowledge cycle until the internal data counter
counts down to 0. At that point, the I2C module sends a NACK bit
to the transmitter. To have a NACK bit sent earlier, you must set
the NACKMOD bit
1h (R/W) = In either slave-receiver or master-receiver mode: The
I2C module sends a NACK bit to the transmitter during the next
acknowledge cycle on the bus. Once the NACK bit has been sent,
NACKMOD is cleared.
Important: To send a NACK bit in the next acknowledge cycle, you
must set NACKMOD before the rising edge of the last data bit.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INTCODE
Fields.Description: 中断 编码
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：中断 编码 位. binary 编码 中 INTCODE 表示 事件 that 已产生 I2C 中断. CPU 读取 will 清除 此 field. 如果 another 低位 优先级 中断 为 待处理 及 已使能, 值 corresponding 至 that 中断 will then be loaded. Otherwise, 值 will stay cleared. 中 case 的 仲裁 丢失, no-acknowledgment 条件 已检测, 或 停止 条件 已检测, CPU 读取 will also 清除 associated 中断 标志 位 中 I2CSTR 寄存器. 仿真器 reads will 不 affect 状态 的 此 field 或 的 状态 位 中 I2CSTR 寄存器. 0h (R/W) = None 1h (R/W) = 仲裁 丢失 2h (R/W) = No-acknowledgment 条件 已检测 3h (R/W) = 寄存器 就绪 至 be accessed 4h (R/W) = 接收 数据 就绪 5h (R/W) = 发送 数据 就绪 6h (R/W) = 停止 条件 已检测 7h (R/W) = Addressed 作为 从机
Fields.Notes:
原文：2:0    Interrupt code；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第650页；原文字段表：Interrupt code bits.

The binary code in INTCODE indicates the event that generated an
I2C interrupt.
A CPU read will clear this field. If another lower priority interrupt is
pending and enabled, the value corresponding to that interrupt will
then be loaded. Otherwise, the value will stay cleared.
In the case of an arbitration lost, a no-acknowledgment condition
detected, or a stop condition detected, a CPU read will also clear the
associated interrupt flag bit in the I2CSTR register.
Emulator reads will not affect the state of this field or of the status
bits in the I2CSTR register.
0h (R/W) = None
1h (R/W) = Arbitration lost
2h (R/W) = No-acknowledgment condition detected
3h (R/W) = Registers ready to be accessed
4h (R/W) = Receive data ready
5h (R/W) = Transmit data ready
6h (R/W) = Stop condition detected
7h (R/W) = Addressed as slave；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：I2C 预分频器 分频 值. IPSC 决定 how much CPU 时钟 为 divided 至 create 模块 时钟 的 I2C 模块: 模块 时钟 频率 = I2C 输入 时钟 频率/(IPSC + 1) Note: IPSC must be initialized 期间 I2C 模块 为 中 复位 (IRS = 0 中 I2CMDR).

原文：7:0    pre-scaler；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第652页；原文字段表：I2C prescaler divide-down value.

IPSC determines how much the CPU clock is divided to create the
module clock of the I2C module:
module clock frequency = I2C input clock frequency/(IPSC + 1)
Note: IPSC must be initialized while the I2C module is in reset (IRS
= 0 in I2CMDR).；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TXFFIL
Fields.Description: FIFO队列 中断 电平
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：发送 FIFO队列 中断 电平. These 位 置位 状态 电平 that will 置位 发送 中断 标志. 当 TXFFST4-0 位 reach 值 equal 至 或 less than these 位, TXFFINT 标志 will be 置位. 此 will 产生 中断 如果 TXFFIENA 位 为 置位. Because I2C 开启 此 device has 16- 电平 发送 FIFO队列, these 位 cannot be configured 用于 中断 的 more than 16 FIFO队列 levels.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4:0    FIFO interrupt level；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第654页；原文字段表：Transmit FIFO interrupt level.

These bits set the status level that will set the transmit interrupt flag.
When the TXFFST4-0 bits reach a value equal to or less than these
bits, the TXFFINT flag will be set. This will generate an interrupt if
the TXFFIENA bit is set. Because the I2C on this device has a 16-
level transmit FIFO, these bits cannot be configured for an interrupt
of more than 16 FIFO levels.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TXFFIENA
Fields.Description: FIFO队列 中断 使能/禁用

Fields.Notes:
原文：5      FIFO interrupt enable/disable；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第653页；原文字段表：Transmit FIFO Interrupt Enable

0h (R/W) = Disabled. TXFFINT flag does not generate an interrupt
when set.
1h (R/W) = Enabled. TXFFINT flag does generate an interrupt
when set.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TXFFINTCLR

Fields.Notes:
原文：6      FIFO clear；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第653页；原文字段表：R-0/W1S 0h Transmit FIFO Interrupt Flag Clear

0h (R/W) = Writes of zeros have no effect. Reads return a 0.
1h (R/W) = Writing a 1 to this bit clears the TXFFINT flag.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TXFFINT

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：发送 FIFO队列 中断 标志. 此 位 cleared 通过 CPU 写入 的 1 至 TXFFINTCLR 位. 如果 TXFFIENA 位 为 置位, 此 位 will 产生 中断 当 it 为 置位. 0h (R/W) = 发送 FIFO队列 中断 条件 has 不 occurred. 1h (R/W) = 发送 FIFO队列 中断 条件 has occurred.
Fields.Notes:
原文：7      FIFO interrupt flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第653页；原文字段表：Transmit FIFO interrupt flag.

This bit cleared by a CPU write of a 1 to the TXFFINTCLR bit. If the
TXFFIENA bit is set, this bit will generate an interrupt when it is set.
0h (R/W) = Transmit FIFO interrupt condition has not occurred.
1h (R/W) = Transmit FIFO interrupt condition has occurred.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RXFFIL
Fields.Description: FIFO队列 中断 电平
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：接收 FIFO队列 中断 电平. These 位 置位 状态 电平 that will 置位 接收 中断 标志. 当 RXFFST4-0 位 reach 值 equal 至 或 greater than these 位, RXFFINT 标志 为 置位. 此 will 产生 中断 如果 RXFFIENA 位 为 置位. Note: Since these 位 are 复位 至 零, 接收 FIFO队列 中断 标志 will be 置位 如果 接收 FIFO队列 操作 为 已使能 及 I2C 为 taken out 的 复位. 此 will 产生 接收 FIFO队列 中断 如果 已使能. 至 avoid 此, modify these 位 开启 same instruction 作为 或 prior 至 设置 RXFFRST 位. Because I2C 开启 此 device has 16-电平 接收 FIFO队列, these 位 cannot be configured 用于 中断 的 more than 16 FIFO队列 levels.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4:0    FIFO interrupt level；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第656页；原文字段表：Receive FIFO interrupt level.

These bits set the status level that will set the receive interrupt flag.
When the RXFFST4-0 bits reach a value equal to or greater than
these bits, the RXFFINT flag is set. This will generate an interrupt if
the RXFFIENA bit is set.
Note: Since these bits are reset to zero, the receive FIFO interrupt
flag will be set if the receive FIFO operation is enabled and the I2C
is taken out of reset. This will generate a receive FIFO interrupt if
enabled. To avoid this, modify these bits on the same instruction as
or prior to setting the RXFFRST bit. Because the I2C on this device
has a 16-level receive FIFO, these bits cannot be configured for an
interrupt of more than 16 FIFO levels.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SCICHAR
Fields.Description: SCI每个字符的数据位数。
Fields.Values: 编码0至7分别对应1至8位数据。
Fields.Notes:
原文：2:0    Character length control；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第598页；原文字段表：Character-length control bits 2-0.

These bits select the SCI character length from one to eight bits.
Characters of less than eight bits are right-justified in SCIRXBUF
and SCIRXEMU and are padded with leading zeros in SCIRXBUF.
SCITXBUF doesn't need to be padded with leading zeros.
0h (R/W) = SCICHAR_LENGTH_1
1h (R/W) = SCICHAR_LENGTH_2
2h (R/W) = SCICHAR_LENGTH_3
3h (R/W) = SCICHAR_LENGTH_4
4h (R/W) = SCICHAR_LENGTH_5
5h (R/W) = SCICHAR_LENGTH_6
6h (R/W) = SCICHAR_LENGTH_7
7h (R/W) = SCICHAR_LENGTH_8；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: ADDRIDLE_MODE
Fields.Description: ADDR/IDLE 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI multiprocessor 模式 控制 位. 此 位 选择 单次 的 multiprocessor protocols.Multiprocessor communication 为 different 来自 other communication modes because it uses 睡眠 及 TXWAKE functions (位 SCICTL1, 位 2 及 SCICTL1, 位 3, respectively). idle-line 模式 为 usually 使用 用于 normal communications because address-bit 模式 adds extra 位 至 帧. idle-line 模式 does 不 add 此 extra 位 及 为 compatible 带 RS-232 类型 communications. 0h (R/W) = Idle-line 模式 protocol 已选 1h (R/W) = Address-bit 模式 protocol 已选
Fields.Notes:
原文：3      ADDR/IDLE Mode control；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第598页；原文字段表：SCI multiprocessor mode control bit.

This bit selects one of the multiprocessor protocols.Multiprocessor
communication is different from the other communication modes
because it uses SLEEP and TXWAKE functions (bits SCICTL1, bit 2
and SCICTL1, bit 3, respectively). The idle-line mode is usually used
for normal communications because the address-bit mode
adds an extra bit to the frame. The idle-line mode does not add this
extra bit and is compatible with RS-232 type communications.
0h (R/W) = Idle-line mode protocol selected
1h (R/W) = Address-bit mode protocol selected；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: LOOPBKENA
Fields.Description: Loop Back 使能
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Loop Back 测试 模式 使能. 此 位 使能 Loop Back 测试 模式 where Tx 引脚 为 internally connected 至 Rx 引脚. 0h (R/W) = Loop Back 测试 模式 已禁用 1h (R/W) = Loop Back 测试 模式 已使能
Fields.Notes:
原文：4      Loop Back enable；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第597页；原文字段表：Loop Back test mode enable.

This bit enables the Loop Back test mode where the Tx pin is
internally connected to the Rx pin.
0h (R/W) = Loop Back test mode disabled
1h (R/W) = Loop Back test mode enabled；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: PARITYENA
Fields.Description: SCI奇偶校验使能。
Fields.Values: 0：禁用校验；1：使能校验。
Fields.Notes:
原文：5      Parity enable；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第597页；原文字段表：SCI parity enable.

This bit enables or disables the parity function. If the SCI is in the
addressbit multiprocessor mode (set using bit 3 of this register), the
address bit is included in the parity calculation (if parity is enabled).
For characters of less than eight bits, the remaining unused bits
should be masked out of the parity calculation.
0h (R/W) = Parity disabled
no parity bit is generated during transmission or is expected during
reception
1h (R/W) = Parity is enabled；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: PARITY
Fields.Description: SCI奇偶校验方式，仅PARITYENA=1时有效。
Fields.Values: 0：奇校验；1：偶校验。
Fields.Notes:
原文：6      Even or Odd Parity；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第597页；原文字段表：SCI parity odd/even selection.

If the PARITY ENABLE bit (SCICCR, bit 5) is set, PARITY (bit 6)
designates odd or even parity (odd or even number of bits with the
value of 1 in both transmitted and received characters).
0h (R/W) = Odd parity
1h (R/W) = Even parity；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: STOPBITS
Fields.Description: SCI停止位数。
Fields.Values: 0：1个停止位；1：2个停止位。
Fields.Notes:
原文：7      Number of Stop Bits；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第597页；原文字段表：SCI number of stop bits.

This bit specifies the number of stop bits transmitted. The receiver
checks for only one stop bit.
0h (R/W) = One stop bit
1h (R/W) = Two stop bits；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: RXENA
Fields.Description: SCI接收使能。
Fields.Values: 0：禁用接收；1：使能接收。
Fields.Notes:
原文：0      SCI receiver enable；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第600页；原文字段表：SCI receiver enable.

Data is received on the SCIRXD pin and is sent to the receiver shift
register and then the receiver buffers. This bit enables or disables
the receiver (transfer to the buffers).
Clearing RXENA stops received characters from being transferred to
the two receiver buffers and also stops the generation of receiver
interrupts. However, the receiver shift register can continue to
assemble characters. Thus, if RXENA is set during the reception of a
character, the complete character will be transferred into the receiver
buffer registers, SCIRXEMU and SCIRXBUF.
0h (R/W) = Prevent received characters from transfer into the
SCIRXEMU and SCIRXBUF receiver buffers
1h (R/W) = Send received characters to SCIRXEMU and
SCIRXBUF；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: TXENA
Fields.Description: SCI发送使能。
Fields.Values: 0：禁用发送；1：使能发送。
Fields.Notes:
原文：1      SCI transmitter enable；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第600页；原文字段表：SCI transmitter enable.

Data is transmitted through the SCITXD pin only when TXENA is
set. If reset, transmission is halted but only after all data previously
written to SCITXBUF has been sent. Data written into SCITXBUF
when TXENA is disabled will not be transmitted even if the TXENA is
enabled later.
0h (R/W) = Transmitter disabled
1h (R/W) = Transmitter enabled；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: SLEEP
Fields.Description: SCI 睡眠
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI 睡眠. TXWAKE 位 控制 选择 的 data-transmit feature, depending 开启 which 发送 模式 (idle-line 或 address-bit) 为 specified 在 ADDR/IDLE 模式 位 (SCICCR, 位 3). 中 multiprocessor 配置, 此 位 控制 接收器 睡眠 功能. Clearing 此 位 brings SCI out 的 睡眠 模式. 接收器 still operates 当 睡眠 位 为 置位 however, 操作 does 不 更新 接收器 缓冲 就绪 位 (SCIRXST, 位 6, RXRDY) 或 错误 状态 位 (SCIRXST, 位 5-2: BRKDT, FE, OE, 及 PE) unless 地址 字节 为 已检测. 睡眠 为 不 cleared 当 地址 字节 为 已检测. 0h (R/W) = 睡眠 模式 已禁用 1h (R/W) = 睡眠 模式 已使能
Fields.Notes:
原文：2      SCI sleep；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第600页；原文字段表：SCI sleep.

The TXWAKE bit controls selection of the data-transmit feature,
depending on which transmit mode (idle-line or address-bit) is
specified at the ADDR/IDLE MODE bit (SCICCR, bit 3). In a
multiprocessor configuration, this bit controls the receiver sleep
function. Clearing this bit brings the SCI out of the sleep mode.
The receiver still operates when the SLEEP bit is set
however, operation does not update the receiver buffer ready bit
(SCIRXST, bit 6, RXRDY) or the error status bits (SCIRXST, bit 5-2:
BRKDT, FE, OE, and PE) unless the address byte is detected.
SLEEP is not cleared when the address byte is detected.
0h (R/W) = Sleep mode disabled
1h (R/W) = Sleep mode enabled；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TXWAKE
Fields.Description: 发送器 唤醒 method
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI 发送器 wake-up method 选择. TXWAKE 位 控制 选择 的 data-transmit feature, depending 开启 which 发送 模式 (idle-line 或 address-bit) 为 specified 在 ADDR/IDLE 模式 位 (SCICCR, 位 3) 0h (R/W) = 发送 feature 为 不 已选. 中 idle-line 模式: 写入 1 至 TXWAKE, then 写入 数据 至 寄存器 SCITXBUF 至 产生 空闲 周期 的 11 数据 位 中 address-bit 模式: 写入 1 至 TXWAKE, then 写入 数据 至 SCITXBUF 至 置位 地址 位 用于 that 帧 至 1 1h (R/W) = 发送 feature 已选 为 dependent 开启 模式, idle-line 或 address-bit: TXWAKE 为 不 cleared 通过 软件 复位 位 (SCICTL1, 位 5) it 为 cleared 通过 系统 复位 或 transfer 的 TXWAKE 至 WUT 标志.
Fields.Notes:
原文：3      Transmitter wakeup method；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第600页；原文字段表：SCI transmitter wake-up method select.

The TXWAKE bit controls selection of the data-transmit feature,
depending on which transmit mode (idle-line or address-bit) is
specified at the ADDR/IDLE MODE bit (SCICCR, bit 3)
0h (R/W) = Transmit feature is not selected. In idle-line mode: write
a 1 to TXWAKE, then write data to register SCITXBUF to generate
an idle period of 11 data bits In address-bit mode: write a 1 to
TXWAKE, then write data to SCITXBUF to set the address bit for
that frame to 1
1h (R/W) = Transmit feature selected is dependent on the mode,
idle-line or address-bit: TXWAKE is not cleared by the SW RESET
bit (SCICTL1, bit 5)
it is cleared by a system reset or the transfer of TXWAKE to the
WUT flag.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SWRESET
Fields.Description: SCI软件复位。
Fields.Values: 0：保持SCI复位；1：释放复位、允许工作。
Fields.Notes:
原文：5      Software reset；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第599页；原文字段表：SCI software reset (active low).

Writing a 0 to this bit initializes the SCI state machines and operating
flags (registers SCICTL2 and SCIRXST) to the reset condition. The
SW RESET bit does not affect any of the configuration bits.
All affected logic is held in the specified reset state until a 1 is written
to SW RESET (the bit values following a reset are shown beneath
each register diagram in this section). Thus, after a system reset, re-
enable the SCI by writing a 1 to this bit. Clear this bit after a receiver
break detect (BRKDT flag, bit SCIRXST, bit 5).
SW RESET affects the operating flags of the SCI, but it neither
affects the configuration bits nor restores the reset values. Once SW
RESET is asserted, the flags are frozen until the bit is deasserted.
The affected flags are as follows:
Value After SW SCI Flag Register Bit
RESET；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: TXINTENA
Fields.Description: 发送 中断 使能

Fields.Notes:
原文：0      Transmit interrupt enable；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第604页；原文字段表：SCITXBUF-register interrupt enable.

This bit controls the interrupt request caused by the setting of
TXRDY flag bit (SCICTL2.7). However, it does not prevent the
TXRDY flag from being set (which indicates SCITXBUF is ready to
receive another character).；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RXBKINTENA
Fields.Description: Receiver-buffer 中断帧 使能
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Receiver-buffer/break 中断 使能. 此 位 控制 中断 请求 caused 通过 either RXRDY 标志 或 BRKDT 标志 (位 SCIRXST.6 及 .5) being 置位. However, RX/BK 中断 ENA does 不 prevent 设置 的 these flags. 0h (R/W) = 禁用 RXRDY/BRKDT 中断 1h (R/W) = 使能 RXRDY/BRKDT 中断
Fields.Notes:
原文：1      Receiver-buffer break enable；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第603页；原文字段表：Receiver-buffer/break interrupt enable.

This bit controls the interrupt request caused by either the RXRDY
flag or the BRKDT flag (bits SCIRXST.6 and .5) being set. However,
RX/BK INT ENA does not prevent the setting of these flags.
0h (R/W) = Disable RXRDY/BRKDT interrupt
1h (R/W) = Enable RXRDY/BRKDT interrupt；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TXEMPTY
Fields.Description: 发送器 空 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：发送器 空 标志. 此 标志's 值 表示 内容 的 发送器's 缓冲 寄存器 (SCITXBUF) 及 shift 寄存器 (TXSHF). 活动 软件 复位 (SCICTL1.5), 或 系统 复位, 设置 此 位. 此 位 does 不 cause 中断 请求. 0h (R/W) = 发送器 缓冲 或 shift 寄存器 或 both are loaded 带 数据 1h (R/W) = 发送器 缓冲 及 shift 寄存器 are both 空
Fields.Notes:
原文：6      Transmitter empty flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第603页；原文字段表：Transmitter empty flag.

This flag's value indicates the contents of the transmitter's buffer
register (SCITXBUF) and shift register (TXSHF). An active SW
RESET (SCICTL1.5), or a system reset, sets this bit. This bit does
not cause an interrupt request.
0h (R/W) = Transmitter buffer or shift register or both are loaded
with data
1h (R/W) = Transmitter buffer and shift registers are both empty；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TXRDY
Fields.Description: 发送器 就绪 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：发送器 缓冲 寄存器 就绪 标志. 当 置位, 此 位 表示 that 发送 数据 缓冲 寄存器, SCITXBUF, 为 就绪 至 接收 another 字符. Writing 数据 至 SCITXBUF automatically clears 此 位. 当 置位, 此 标志 asserts 发送器 中断 请求 如果 interrupt-enable 位, TX 中断 ENA (SCICTL2.0), 为 also 置位. TXRDY 为 置位 至 1 通过 enabling 软件 复位 位 (SCICTL1.5) 或 通过 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = SCITXBUF 为 满 1h (R/W) = SCITXBUF 为 就绪 至 接收 下次 字符
Fields.Notes:
原文：7      Transmitter ready flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第603页；原文字段表：Transmitter buffer register ready flag.

When set, this bit indicates that the transmit data buffer register,
SCITXBUF, is ready to receive another character. Writing data to the
SCITXBUF automatically clears this bit. When set, this flag asserts a
transmitter interrupt request if the interrupt-enable bit, TX INT ENA
(SCICTL2.0), is also set. TXRDY is set to 1 by enabling the SW
RESET bit (SCICTL1.5) or by a system reset.
0h (R/W) = SCITXBUF is full
1h (R/W) = SCITXBUF is ready to receive the next character；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RXWAKE
Fields.Description: 接收器 唤醒 检测 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：接收器 wake-up-detect 标志 0h (R/W) = No 检测 的 接收器 wake-up 条件 1h (R/W) = 值 的 1 中 此 位 表示 检测 的 接收器 wake-up 条件. 中 address-bit multiprocessor 模式 (SCICCR.3 = 1), RXWAKE 反映 值 的 地址 位 用于 字符 contained 中 SCIRXBUF. 中 idle-line multiprocessor 模式, RXWAKE 为 置位 如果 SCIRXD 数据 线路 为 已检测 作为 空闲. RXWAKE 为 只读 标志, cleared 通过 单次 的 following: - transfer 的 首个 字节 after 地址 字节 至 SCIRXBUF (仅 中 non-FIFO 模式) - reading 的 SCIRXBUF - 活动 软件 复位 - 系统 复位
Fields.Notes:
原文：1      Receiver wakeup detect flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第606页；原文字段表：Receiver wake-up-detect flag

0h (R/W) = No detection of a receiver wake-up condition
1h (R/W) = A value of 1 in this bit indicates detection of a receiver
wake-up condition. In the address-bit multiprocessor mode
(SCICCR.3 = 1), RXWAKE reflects the value of the address bit for
the character contained in SCIRXBUF. In the idle-line
multiprocessor mode, RXWAKE is set if the SCIRXD data line is
detected as idle. RXWAKE is a read-only flag, cleared by one of
the following:
- The transfer of the first byte after the address byte to SCIRXBUF
(only in non-FIFO mode)
- The reading of SCIRXBUF
- An active SW RESET
- A system reset；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: PE
Fields.Description: 奇偶校验 错误 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI parity-error 标志. 此 标志 位 为 置位 当 字符 为 已接收 带 mismatch between 数量 的 1s 及 its 奇偶校验 位. 地址 位 为 included 中 calculation. 如果 奇偶校验 产生 及 检测 为 不 已使能, PE 标志 为 已禁用 及 读取 作为 0. PE 位 为 复位 通过 活动 软件 复位 或 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 奇偶校验 错误 或 奇偶校验 为 已禁用 1h (R/W) = 奇偶校验 错误 为 已检测
Fields.Notes:
原文：2      Parity error flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第606页；原文字段表：SCI parity-error flag.

This flag bit is set when a character is received with a mismatch
between the number of 1s and its parity bit. The address bit is
included in the calculation. If parity generation and detection is not
enabled, the PE flag is disabled and read as 0. The PE bit is reset
by an active SW RESET or a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No parity error or parity is disabled
1h (R/W) = Parity error is detected；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OE
Fields.Description: 溢出 错误 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI overrun-error 标志. SCI 设置 此 位 当 字符 为 transferred 进入 寄存器 SCIRXEMU 及 SCIRXBUF before 前次 字符 为 fully 读取 通过 CPU 或 DMAC. 前次 字符 为 overwritten 及 丢失. OE 标志 位 为 复位 通过 活动 软件 复位 或 通过 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 溢出 错误 已检测 1h (R/W) = 溢出 错误 已检测
Fields.Notes:
原文：3      Overrun error flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第606页；原文字段表：SCI overrun-error flag.

The SCI sets this bit when a character is transferred into registers
SCIRXEMU and SCIRXBUF before the previous character is fully
read by the CPU or DMAC. The previous character is overwritten
and lost. The OE flag bit is reset by an active SW RESET or by a
system reset.
0h (R/W) = No overrun error detected
1h (R/W) = Overrun error detected；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: FE
Fields.Description: 帧格式 错误 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI framing-error 标志. SCI 设置 此 位 当 expected 停止 位 为 不 found. 仅 首个 停止 位 为 checked. 丢失 停止 位 表示 that 同步 带 启动 位 has been 丢失 及 that 字符 为 incorrectly framed. FE 位 为 复位 通过 clearing 的 软件 复位 位 或 通过 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 帧格式 错误 已检测 1h (R/W) = 帧格式 错误 已检测
Fields.Notes:
原文：4      Framing error flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第606页；原文字段表：SCI framing-error flag.

The SCI sets this bit when an expected stop bit is not found. Only
the first stop bit is checked. The missing stop bit indicates that
synchronization with the start bit has been lost and that the character
is incorrectly framed. The FE bit is reset by a clearing of the SW
RESET bit or by a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No framing error detected
1h (R/W) = Framing error detected；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: BRKDT
Fields.Description: Break-detect 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI break-detect 标志. SCI 设置 此 位 当 中断帧 条件 发生. 中断帧 conditionoccurs 当 SCI 接收器 数据 线路 (SCIRXD) remains continuously 低 用于 在 最低 ten 位, beginning after 丢失 首个 停止 位. occurrence 的 中断帧 causes 接收器 中断 至 be 已产生 如果 RX/BK 中断 ENA 位 为 1, but it does 不 cause 接收器 缓冲 至 be loaded. BRKDT 中断 CAN occur even 如果 接收器 睡眠 位 为 置位 至 1. BRKDT 为 cleared 通过 活动 软件 复位 或 通过 系统 复位. It 为 不 cleared 通过 receipt 的 字符 after 中断帧 为 已检测. 中 order 至 接收 more characters, SCI must be 复位 通过 toggling 软件 复位 位 或 通过 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 中断帧 条件 1h (R/W) = 中断帧 条件 occurred
Fields.Notes:
原文：5      Break-detect flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第605页；原文字段表：SCI break-detect flag.

The SCI sets this bit when a break condition occurs. A break
conditionoccurs when the SCI receiver data line (SCIRXD) remains
continuously low for at least ten bits,
beginning after a missing first stop bit. The occurrence of a break
causes a receiver interrupt to be generated if the RX/BK INT ENA bit
is a 1, but it does not cause the receiver buffer to be loaded. A
BRKDT interrupt can occur even if the receiver SLEEP bit is set to 1.
BRKDT is cleared by an active SW RESET or by a system reset. It
is not cleared by receipt of a character after the break is detected. In
order to receive more characters, the SCI must be reset by toggling
the SW RESET bit or by a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No break condition
1h (R/W) = Break condition occurred；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RXRDY
Fields.Description: 接收器 就绪 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI receiver-ready 标志. 当 new 字符 为 就绪 至 be 读取 来自 SCIRXBUF 寄存器, 接收器 设置 此 位, 及 接收器 中断 为 已产生 如果 RX/BK 中断 ENA 位 (SCICTL2.1) 为 1. RXRDY 为 cleared 通过 reading 的 SCIRXBUF 寄存器, 通过 活动 软件 复位, 或 通过 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No new 字符 中 SCIRXBUF 1h (R/W) = 字符 就绪 至 be 读取 来自 SCIRXBUF
Fields.Notes:
原文：6      Receiver ready flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第605页；原文字段表：SCI receiver-ready flag.

When a new character is ready to be read from the SCIRXBUF
register, the receiver sets this bit, and a receiver interrupt is
generated if the RX/BK INT ENA bit (SCICTL2.1) is a 1. RXRDY is
cleared by a reading of the SCIRXBUF register, by an active SW
RESET, or by a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No new character in SCIRXBUF
1h (R/W) = Character ready to be read from SCIRXBUF；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RXERROR
Fields.Description: 接收器 错误 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI 接收器 错误 标志. RX 错误 标志 表示 that 单次 的 错误 flags 中 接收器 状态 寄存器 为 置位. RX 错误 为 logical 或 的 中断帧 检测, 帧格式 错误, 溢出, 及 奇偶校验 错误 使能 flags (位 5-2: BRKDT, FE, OE, 及 PE). 1 开启 此 位 will cause 中断 如果 RX ERR 中断 ENA 位 (SCICTL1.6) 为 置位. 此 位 CAN be 使用 用于 fast error-condition checking during 中断 service routine. 此 错误 标志 cannot be cleared directly it 为 cleared 通过 活动 软件 复位 或 通过 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 错误 flags 置位 1h (R/W) = 错误 标志(s) 置位
Fields.Notes:
原文：7      Receiver error flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第605页；原文字段表：SCI receiver error flag.

The RX ERROR flag indicates that one of the error flags in the
receiver status register is set. RX ERROR is a logical OR of the
break detect, framing error, overrun, and parity error enable flags
(bits 5-2: BRKDT, FE, OE, and PE).
A 1 on this bit will cause an interrupt if the RX ERR INT ENA bit
(SCICTL1.6) is set. This bit can be used for fast error-condition
checking during the interrupt service routine. This error flag cannot
be cleared directly
it is cleared by an active SW RESET or by a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No error flags set
1h (R/W) = Error flag(s) set；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TXFFIL
Fields.Description: 中断 电平
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：TXFFIL4-0 发送 FIFO队列 中断 电平 位. 发送 FIFO队列 产生 中断 whenever FIFO队列 状态 位 (TXFFST4-0) are less than 或 equal 至 FIFO队列 电平 位 (TXFFIL4-0). 最大 值 that CAN be assigned 至 these 位 至 产生 中断 cannot be more than depth 的 TX FIFO队列. 默认 值 的 these 位 after 复位 为 00000b. Users should 置位 TXFFIL 至 best fit their application needs 通过 weighing between CPU overhead 至 service ISR 及 best possible usage 的 SCI 总线 bandwidth.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4:0    Interrupt level；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第611页；原文字段表：TXFFIL4-0 Transmit FIFO interrupt level bits.

The transmit FIFO generates an interrupt whenever the FIFO status
bits (TXFFST4-0) are less than or equal to the FIFO level bits
(TXFFIL4-0). The maximum value that can be assigned to these bits
to generate an interrupt cannot be more than the depth of the TX
FIFO. The default value of these bits after reset is 00000b. Users
should set TXFFIL to best fit their application needs by weighing
between the CPU overhead to service the ISR and the best possible
usage of SCI bus bandwidth.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：接收 FIFO队列 中断 电平 位 接收 FIFO队列 产生 中断 whenever FIFO队列 状态 位 (RXFFST4-0) are greater than 或 equal 至 FIFO队列 电平 位 (RXFFIL4-0). 最大 值 that CAN be assigned 至 these 位 至 产生 中断 cannot be more than depth 的 RX FIFO队列. 默认 值 的 these 位 after 复位 为 11111b. Users should 置位 RXFFIL 至 best fit their application needs 通过 weighing between CPU overhead 至 service ISR 及 best possible usage 的 已接收 SCI 数据.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4:0    Interrupt level；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第613页；原文字段表：Receive FIFO interrupt level bits

The receive FIFO generates an interrupt whenever the FIFO status
bits (RXFFST4-0) are greater than or equal to the FIFO level bits
(RXFFIL4-0). The maximum value that can be assigned to these bits
to generate an interrupt cannot be more than the depth of the RX
FIFO. The default value of these bits after reset is 11111b. Users
should set RXFFIL to best fit their application needs by weighing
between the CPU overhead to service the ISR and the best possible
usage of received SCI data.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: FFTXDLY
Fields.Description: FIFO队列 发送 延迟
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：FIFO队列 transfer 延迟. These 位 define 延迟 between every transfer 来自 FIFO队列 发送 bufferto 发送 shift 寄存器. 延迟 为 defined 中 数量 的 SCI serial 波特率 时钟 cycles. 8 位 寄存器 could define 最小 延迟 的 0 波特率 时钟 cycles 及 最大 的 256 波特率 时钟 cycles 中 FIFO队列 模式, 缓冲 (TXBUF) between shift 寄存器 及 FIFO队列 should be filled 仅 after shift 寄存器 has completed shifting 的 最后 位. 此 为 required 至 pass 开启 延迟 between transfers 至 数据 stream. 中 FIFO队列 模式, TXBUF should 不 be treated 作为 单次 额外 电平 的 缓冲. delayed 发送 feature will help 至 create auto-flow scheme without RTS/CTS 控制 作为 中 标准 UARTS. 当 SCI 为 configured 用于 单次 stop-bit, 延迟 introduced 通过 FFTXDLY between 单次 帧 及 下次 帧 为 equal 至 数量 的 波特率 时钟 cycles that FFTXDLY 为 置位 至. 当 SCI 为 configured 用于 two stop-bits, 延迟 introduced 通过 FFTXDLY between 单次 帧 及 下次 帧 为 equal 至 数量 的 波特率 时钟 cycles that FFTXDLY 为 置位 至 minus 1.
Fields.Notes:
原文：7:0    FIFO transmit delay；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第614页；原文字段表：FIFO transfer delay. These bits define the delay between every

transfer from FIFO transmit bufferto transmit shift register. The delay
is defined in the number of SCI serial baud clock cycles. The 8 bit
register could define a minimum delay of 0 baud clock cycles and a
maximum of 256 baud clock cycles
In FIFO mode, the buffer (TXBUF) between the shift register and the
FIFO should be filled only after the shift register has completed
shifting of the last bit. This is required to pass on the delay between
transfers to the data stream. In FIFO mode, TXBUF should not be
treated as one additional level of buffer. The delayed transmit feature
will help to create an auto-flow scheme without RTS/CTS controls as
in standard UARTS.
When SCI is configured for one stop-bit, delay introduced by
FFTXDLY between one frame and the next frame is equal to number
of baud clock cycles that FFTXDLY is set to.
When SCI is configured for two stop-bits, delay introduced by
FFTXDLY between one frame and the next frame is equal to number
of baud clock cycles that FFTXDLY is set to minus 1.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: ADDRIDLE_MODE
Fields.Description: ADDR/IDLE 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI multiprocessor 模式 控制 位. 此 位 选择 单次 的 multiprocessor protocols.Multiprocessor communication 为 different 来自 other communication modes because it uses 睡眠 及 TXWAKE functions (位 SCICTL1, 位 2 及 SCICTL1, 位 3, respectively). idle-line 模式 为 usually 使用 用于 normal communications because address-bit 模式 adds extra 位 至 帧. idle-line 模式 does 不 add 此 extra 位 及 为 compatible 带 RS-232 类型 communications. 0h (R/W) = Idle-line 模式 protocol 已选 1h (R/W) = Address-bit 模式 protocol 已选
Fields.Notes:
原文：3      ADDR/IDLE Mode control；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第598页；原文字段表：SCI multiprocessor mode control bit.

This bit selects one of the multiprocessor protocols.Multiprocessor
communication is different from the other communication modes
because it uses SLEEP and TXWAKE functions (bits SCICTL1, bit 2
and SCICTL1, bit 3, respectively). The idle-line mode is usually used
for normal communications because the address-bit mode
adds an extra bit to the frame. The idle-line mode does not add this
extra bit and is compatible with RS-232 type communications.
0h (R/W) = Idle-line mode protocol selected
1h (R/W) = Address-bit mode protocol selected；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Notes:
原文：5      Parity enable；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第597页；原文字段表：SCI parity enable.

This bit enables or disables the parity function. If the SCI is in the
addressbit multiprocessor mode (set using bit 3 of this register), the
address bit is included in the parity calculation (if parity is enabled).
For characters of less than eight bits, the remaining unused bits

no parity bit is generated during transmission or is expected during
reception

原文：6      Even or Odd Parity；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第597页；原文字段表：SCI parity odd/even selection.

value of 1 in both transmitted and received characters).

1h (R/W) = Even parity；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: RXENA
Fields.Description: SCI接收使能。
Fields.Values: 0：禁用接收；1：使能接收。
Fields.Notes:
原文：0      SCI receiver enable；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第600页；原文字段表：SCI receiver enable.

Data is received on the SCIRXD pin and is sent to the receiver shift
register and then the receiver buffers. This bit enables or disables
the receiver (transfer to the buffers).
Clearing RXENA stops received characters from being transferred to
the two receiver buffers and also stops the generation of receiver
interrupts. However, the receiver shift register can continue to
assemble characters. Thus, if RXENA is set during the reception of a
character, the complete character will be transferred into the receiver
buffer registers, SCIRXEMU and SCIRXBUF.
0h (R/W) = Prevent received characters from transfer into the
SCIRXEMU and SCIRXBUF receiver buffers
1h (R/W) = Send received characters to SCIRXEMU and
SCIRXBUF；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: TXENA
Fields.Description: SCI发送使能。
Fields.Values: 0：禁用发送；1：使能发送。
Fields.Notes:
原文：1      SCI transmitter enable；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第600页；原文字段表：SCI transmitter enable.

Data is transmitted through the SCITXD pin only when TXENA is
set. If reset, transmission is halted but only after all data previously
written to SCITXBUF has been sent. Data written into SCITXBUF
when TXENA is disabled will not be transmitted even if the TXENA is
enabled later.
0h (R/W) = Transmitter disabled
1h (R/W) = Transmitter enabled；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: SLEEP
Fields.Description: SCI 睡眠
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI 睡眠. TXWAKE 位 控制 选择 的 data-transmit feature, depending 开启 which 发送 模式 (idle-line 或 address-bit) 为 specified 在 ADDR/IDLE 模式 位 (SCICCR, 位 3). 中 multiprocessor 配置, 此 位 控制 接收器 睡眠 功能. Clearing 此 位 brings SCI out 的 睡眠 模式. 接收器 still operates 当 睡眠 位 为 置位 however, 操作 does 不 更新 接收器 缓冲 就绪 位 (SCIRXST, 位 6, RXRDY) 或 错误 状态 位 (SCIRXST, 位 5-2: BRKDT, FE, OE, 及 PE) unless 地址 字节 为 已检测. 睡眠 为 不 cleared 当 地址 字节 为 已检测. 0h (R/W) = 睡眠 模式 已禁用 1h (R/W) = 睡眠 模式 已使能
Fields.Notes:
原文：2      SCI sleep；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第600页；原文字段表：SCI sleep.

The TXWAKE bit controls selection of the data-transmit feature,
depending on which transmit mode (idle-line or address-bit) is
specified at the ADDR/IDLE MODE bit (SCICCR, bit 3). In a
multiprocessor configuration, this bit controls the receiver sleep
function. Clearing this bit brings the SCI out of the sleep mode.
The receiver still operates when the SLEEP bit is set
however, operation does not update the receiver buffer ready bit
(SCIRXST, bit 6, RXRDY) or the error status bits (SCIRXST, bit 5-2:
BRKDT, FE, OE, and PE) unless the address byte is detected.
SLEEP is not cleared when the address byte is detected.
0h (R/W) = Sleep mode disabled
1h (R/W) = Sleep mode enabled；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TXWAKE
Fields.Description: 发送器 唤醒 method
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI 发送器 wake-up method 选择. TXWAKE 位 控制 选择 的 data-transmit feature, depending 开启 which 发送 模式 (idle-line 或 address-bit) 为 specified 在 ADDR/IDLE 模式 位 (SCICCR, 位 3) 0h (R/W) = 发送 feature 为 不 已选. 中 idle-line 模式: 写入 1 至 TXWAKE, then 写入 数据 至 寄存器 SCITXBUF 至 产生 空闲 周期 的 11 数据 位 中 address-bit 模式: 写入 1 至 TXWAKE, then 写入 数据 至 SCITXBUF 至 置位 地址 位 用于 that 帧 至 1 1h (R/W) = 发送 feature 已选 为 dependent 开启 模式, idle-line 或 address-bit: TXWAKE 为 不 cleared 通过 软件 复位 位 (SCICTL1, 位 5) it 为 cleared 通过 系统 复位 或 transfer 的 TXWAKE 至 WUT 标志.
Fields.Notes:
原文：3      Transmitter wakeup method；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第600页；原文字段表：SCI transmitter wake-up method select.

The TXWAKE bit controls selection of the data-transmit feature,
depending on which transmit mode (idle-line or address-bit) is
specified at the ADDR/IDLE MODE bit (SCICCR, bit 3)
0h (R/W) = Transmit feature is not selected. In idle-line mode: write
a 1 to TXWAKE, then write data to register SCITXBUF to generate
an idle period of 11 data bits In address-bit mode: write a 1 to
TXWAKE, then write data to SCITXBUF to set the address bit for
that frame to 1
1h (R/W) = Transmit feature selected is dependent on the mode,
idle-line or address-bit: TXWAKE is not cleared by the SW RESET
bit (SCICTL1, bit 5)
it is cleared by a system reset or the transfer of TXWAKE to the
WUT flag.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SWRESET
Fields.Description: SCI软件复位。
Fields.Values: 0：保持SCI复位；1：释放复位、允许工作。
Fields.Notes:
原文：5      Software reset；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第599页；原文字段表：SCI software reset (active low).

Writing a 0 to this bit initializes the SCI state machines and operating
flags (registers SCICTL2 and SCIRXST) to the reset condition. The
SW RESET bit does not affect any of the configuration bits.
All affected logic is held in the specified reset state until a 1 is written
to SW RESET (the bit values following a reset are shown beneath
each register diagram in this section). Thus, after a system reset, re-
enable the SCI by writing a 1 to this bit. Clear this bit after a receiver
break detect (BRKDT flag, bit SCIRXST, bit 5).
SW RESET affects the operating flags of the SCI, but it neither
affects the configuration bits nor restores the reset values. Once SW
RESET is asserted, the flags are frozen until the bit is deasserted.
The affected flags are as follows:
Value After SW SCI Flag Register Bit
RESET；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Description: 发送器 空 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：发送器 空 标志. 此 标志's 值 表示 内容 的 发送器's 缓冲 寄存器 (SCITXBUF) 及 shift 寄存器 (TXSHF). 活动 软件 复位 (SCICTL1.5), 或 系统 复位, 设置 此 位. 此 位 does 不 cause 中断 请求. 0h (R/W) = 发送器 缓冲 或 shift 寄存器 或 both are loaded 带 数据 1h (R/W) = 发送器 缓冲 及 shift 寄存器 are both 空
Fields.Notes:
原文：6      Transmitter empty flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第603页；原文字段表：Transmitter empty flag.

register (SCITXBUF) and shift register (TXSHF). An active SW

Fields.Name: TXRDY
Fields.Description: 发送器 就绪 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：发送器 缓冲 寄存器 就绪 标志. 当 置位, 此 位 表示 that 发送 数据 缓冲 寄存器, SCITXBUF, 为 就绪 至 接收 another 字符.
