TXRDY 为 置位 至 1 通过 enabling 软件 复位 位 (SCICTL1.5) 或 通过 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = SCITXBUF 为 满 1h (R/W) = SCITXBUF 为 就绪 至 接收 下次 字符
Fields.Notes:
原文：7      Transmitter ready flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第603页；原文字段表：Transmitter buffer register ready flag.

When set, this bit indicates that the transmit data buffer register,

RESET bit (SCICTL1.5) or by a system reset.
0h (R/W) = SCITXBUF is full
1h (R/W) = SCITXBUF is ready to receive the next character；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RXWAKE

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：接收器 wake-up-detect 标志 0h (R/W) = No 检测 的 接收器 wake-up 条件 1h (R/W) = 值 的 1 中 此 位 表示 检测 的 接收器 wake-up 条件. 中 address-bit multiprocessor 模式 (SCICCR.3 = 1), RXWAKE 反映 值 的 地址 位 用于 字符 contained 中 SCIRXBUF. 中 idle-line multiprocessor 模式, RXWAKE 为 置位 如果 SCIRXD 数据 线路 为 已检测 作为 空闲. RXWAKE 为 只读 标志, cleared 通过 单次 的 following: - transfer 的 首个 字节 after 地址 字节 至 SCIRXBUF (仅 中 non-FIFO 模式) - reading 的 SCIRXBUF - 活动 软件 复位 - 系统 复位
Fields.Notes:
原文：1      Receiver wakeup detect flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第606页；原文字段表：Receiver wake-up-detect flag

0h (R/W) = No detection of a receiver wake-up condition
1h (R/W) = A value of 1 in this bit indicates detection of a receiver
wake-up condition. In the address-bit multiprocessor mode
(SCICCR.3 = 1), RXWAKE reflects the value of the address bit for
the character contained in SCIRXBUF. In the idle-line
multiprocessor mode, RXWAKE is set if the SCIRXD data line is
detected as idle. RXWAKE is a read-only flag, cleared by one of
the following:
- The transfer of the first byte after the address byte to SCIRXBUF
(only in non-FIFO mode)
- The reading of SCIRXBUF
- An active SW RESET
- A system reset；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: PE
Fields.Description: 奇偶校验 错误 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI parity-error 标志. 此 标志 位 为 置位 当 字符 为 已接收 带 mismatch between 数量 的 1s 及 its 奇偶校验 位. 地址 位 为 included 中 calculation. 如果 奇偶校验 产生 及 检测 为 不 已使能, PE 标志 为 已禁用 及 读取 作为 0. PE 位 为 复位 通过 活动 软件 复位 或 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 奇偶校验 错误 或 奇偶校验 为 已禁用 1h (R/W) = 奇偶校验 错误 为 已检测
Fields.Notes:
原文：2      Parity error flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第606页；原文字段表：SCI parity-error flag.

This flag bit is set when a character is received with a mismatch
between the number of 1s and its parity bit. The address bit is
included in the calculation. If parity generation and detection is not
enabled, the PE flag is disabled and read as 0. The PE bit is reset
by an active SW RESET or a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No parity error or parity is disabled
1h (R/W) = Parity error is detected；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OE
Fields.Description: 溢出 错误 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI overrun-error 标志. SCI 设置 此 位 当 字符 为 transferred 进入 寄存器 SCIRXEMU 及 SCIRXBUF before 前次 字符 为 fully 读取 通过 CPU 或 DMAC. 前次 字符 为 overwritten 及 丢失. OE 标志 位 为 复位 通过 活动 软件 复位 或 通过 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 溢出 错误 已检测 1h (R/W) = 溢出 错误 已检测
Fields.Notes:
原文：3      Overrun error flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第606页；原文字段表：SCI overrun-error flag.

The SCI sets this bit when a character is transferred into registers
SCIRXEMU and SCIRXBUF before the previous character is fully
read by the CPU or DMAC. The previous character is overwritten
and lost. The OE flag bit is reset by an active SW RESET or by a
system reset.
0h (R/W) = No overrun error detected
1h (R/W) = Overrun error detected；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: FE
Fields.Description: 帧格式 错误 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI framing-error 标志. SCI 设置 此 位 当 expected 停止 位 为 不 found. 仅 首个 停止 位 为 checked. 丢失 停止 位 表示 that 同步 带 启动 位 has been 丢失 及 that 字符 为 incorrectly framed. FE 位 为 复位 通过 clearing 的 软件 复位 位 或 通过 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 帧格式 错误 已检测 1h (R/W) = 帧格式 错误 已检测
Fields.Notes:
原文：4      Framing error flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第606页；原文字段表：SCI framing-error flag.

The SCI sets this bit when an expected stop bit is not found. Only
the first stop bit is checked. The missing stop bit indicates that
synchronization with the start bit has been lost and that the character
is incorrectly framed. The FE bit is reset by a clearing of the SW
RESET bit or by a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No framing error detected
1h (R/W) = Framing error detected；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: BRKDT
Fields.Description: Break-detect 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI break-detect 标志. SCI 设置 此 位 当 中断帧 条件 发生. 中断帧 conditionoccurs 当 SCI 接收器 数据 线路 (SCIRXD) remains continuously 低 用于 在 最低 ten 位, beginning after 丢失 首个 停止 位. occurrence 的 中断帧 causes 接收器 中断 至 be 已产生 如果 RX/BK 中断 ENA 位 为 1, but it does 不 cause 接收器 缓冲 至 be loaded. BRKDT 中断 CAN occur even 如果 接收器 睡眠 位 为 置位 至 1. BRKDT 为 cleared 通过 活动 软件 复位 或 通过 系统 复位. It 为 不 cleared 通过 receipt 的 字符 after 中断帧 为 已检测. 中 order 至 接收 more characters, SCI must be 复位 通过 toggling 软件 复位 位 或 通过 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 中断帧 条件 1h (R/W) = 中断帧 条件 occurred
Fields.Notes:
原文：5      Break-detect flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第605页；原文字段表：SCI break-detect flag.

The SCI sets this bit when a break condition occurs. A break
conditionoccurs when the SCI receiver data line (SCIRXD) remains
continuously low for at least ten bits,
beginning after a missing first stop bit. The occurrence of a break
causes a receiver interrupt to be generated if the RX/BK INT ENA bit
is a 1, but it does not cause the receiver buffer to be loaded. A
BRKDT interrupt can occur even if the receiver SLEEP bit is set to 1.
BRKDT is cleared by an active SW RESET or by a system reset. It
is not cleared by receipt of a character after the break is detected. In
order to receive more characters, the SCI must be reset by toggling
the SW RESET bit or by a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No break condition
1h (R/W) = Break condition occurred；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RXRDY
Fields.Description: 接收器 就绪 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI receiver-ready 标志. 当 new 字符 为 就绪 至 be 读取 来自 SCIRXBUF 寄存器, 接收器 设置 此 位, 及 接收器 中断 为 已产生 如果 RX/BK 中断 ENA 位 (SCICTL2.1) 为 1. RXRDY 为 cleared 通过 reading 的 SCIRXBUF 寄存器, 通过 活动 软件 复位, 或 通过 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No new 字符 中 SCIRXBUF 1h (R/W) = 字符 就绪 至 be 读取 来自 SCIRXBUF
Fields.Notes:
原文：6      Receiver ready flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第605页；原文字段表：SCI receiver-ready flag.

When a new character is ready to be read from the SCIRXBUF
register, the receiver sets this bit, and a receiver interrupt is
generated if the RX/BK INT ENA bit (SCICTL2.1) is a 1. RXRDY is
cleared by a reading of the SCIRXBUF register, by an active SW
RESET, or by a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No new character in SCIRXBUF
1h (R/W) = Character ready to be read from SCIRXBUF；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RXERROR
Fields.Description: 接收器 错误 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI 接收器 错误 标志. RX 错误 标志 表示 that 单次 的 错误 flags 中 接收器 状态 寄存器 为 置位. RX 错误 为 logical 或 的 中断帧 检测, 帧格式 错误, 溢出, 及 奇偶校验 错误 使能 flags (位 5-2: BRKDT, FE, OE, 及 PE). 1 开启 此 位 will cause 中断 如果 RX ERR 中断 ENA 位 (SCICTL1.6) 为 置位. 此 位 CAN be 使用 用于 fast error-condition checking during 中断 service routine. 此 错误 标志 cannot be cleared directly it 为 cleared 通过 活动 软件 复位 或 通过 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 错误 flags 置位 1h (R/W) = 错误 标志(s) 置位
Fields.Notes:
原文：7      Receiver error flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第605页；原文字段表：SCI receiver error flag.

The RX ERROR flag indicates that one of the error flags in the
receiver status register is set. RX ERROR is a logical OR of the
break detect, framing error, overrun, and parity error enable flags
(bits 5-2: BRKDT, FE, OE, and PE).
A 1 on this bit will cause an interrupt if the RX ERR INT ENA bit
(SCICTL1.6) is set. This bit can be used for fast error-condition
checking during the interrupt service routine. This error flag cannot
be cleared directly
it is cleared by an active SW RESET or by a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No error flags set
1h (R/W) = Error flag(s) set；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TXFFIL
Fields.Description: 中断 电平
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：TXFFIL4-0 发送 FIFO队列 中断 电平 位. 发送 FIFO队列 产生 中断 whenever FIFO队列 状态 位 (TXFFST4-0) are less than 或 equal 至 FIFO队列 电平 位 (TXFFIL4-0). 最大 值 that CAN be assigned 至 these 位 至 产生 中断 cannot be more than depth 的 TX FIFO队列. 默认 值 的 these 位 after 复位 为 00000b. Users should 置位 TXFFIL 至 best fit their application needs 通过 weighing between CPU overhead 至 service ISR 及 best possible usage 的 SCI 总线 bandwidth.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4:0    Interrupt level；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第611页；原文字段表：TXFFIL4-0 Transmit FIFO interrupt level bits.

The transmit FIFO generates an interrupt whenever the FIFO status
bits (TXFFST4-0) are less than or equal to the FIFO level bits
(TXFFIL4-0). The maximum value that can be assigned to these bits
to generate an interrupt cannot be more than the depth of the TX
FIFO. The default value of these bits after reset is 00000b. Users
should set TXFFIL to best fit their application needs by weighing
between the CPU overhead to service the ISR and the best possible
usage of SCI bus bandwidth.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: FFTXDLY
Fields.Description: FIFO队列 发送 延迟
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：FIFO队列 transfer 延迟. These 位 define 延迟 between every transfer 来自 FIFO队列 发送 bufferto 发送 shift 寄存器. 延迟 为 defined 中 数量 的 SCI serial 波特率 时钟 cycles. 8 位 寄存器 could define 最小 延迟 的 0 波特率 时钟 cycles 及 最大 的 256 波特率 时钟 cycles 中 FIFO队列 模式, 缓冲 (TXBUF) between shift 寄存器 及 FIFO队列 should be filled 仅 after shift 寄存器 has completed shifting 的 最后 位. 此 为 required 至 pass 开启 延迟 between transfers 至 数据 stream. 中 FIFO队列 模式, TXBUF should 不 be treated 作为 单次 额外 电平 的 缓冲. delayed 发送 feature will help 至 create auto-flow scheme without RTS/CTS 控制 作为 中 标准 UARTS. 当 SCI 为 configured 用于 单次 stop-bit, 延迟 introduced 通过 FFTXDLY between 单次 帧 及 下次 帧 为 equal 至 数量 的 波特率 时钟 cycles that FFTXDLY 为 置位 至. 当 SCI 为 configured 用于 two stop-bits, 延迟 introduced 通过 FFTXDLY between 单次 帧 及 下次 帧 为 equal 至 数量 的 波特率 时钟 cycles that FFTXDLY 为 置位 至 minus 1.
Fields.Notes:
原文：7:0    FIFO transmit delay；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第614页；原文字段表：FIFO transfer delay. These bits define the delay between every

transfer from FIFO transmit bufferto transmit shift register. The delay
is defined in the number of SCI serial baud clock cycles. The 8 bit
register could define a minimum delay of 0 baud clock cycles and a
maximum of 256 baud clock cycles
In FIFO mode, the buffer (TXBUF) between the shift register and the
FIFO should be filled only after the shift register has completed
shifting of the last bit. This is required to pass on the delay between
transfers to the data stream. In FIFO mode, TXBUF should not be
treated as one additional level of buffer. The delayed transmit feature
will help to create an auto-flow scheme without RTS/CTS controls as
in standard UARTS.
When SCI is configured for one stop-bit, delay introduced by
FFTXDLY between one frame and the next frame is equal to number
of baud clock cycles that FFTXDLY is set to.
When SCI is configured for two stop-bits, delay introduced by
FFTXDLY between one frame and the next frame is equal to number
of baud clock cycles that FFTXDLY is set to minus 1.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RXENA
Fields.Description: SCI接收使能。
Fields.Values: 0：禁用接收；1：使能接收。
Fields.Notes:
原文：0      SCI receiver enable；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第600页；原文字段表：SCI receiver enable.

Data is received on the SCIRXD pin and is sent to the receiver shift
register and then the receiver buffers. This bit enables or disables
the receiver (transfer to the buffers).
Clearing RXENA stops received characters from being transferred to
the two receiver buffers and also stops the generation of receiver
interrupts. However, the receiver shift register can continue to
assemble characters. Thus, if RXENA is set during the reception of a
character, the complete character will be transferred into the receiver
buffer registers, SCIRXEMU and SCIRXBUF.
0h (R/W) = Prevent received characters from transfer into the
SCIRXEMU and SCIRXBUF receiver buffers
1h (R/W) = Send received characters to SCIRXEMU and
SCIRXBUF；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Notes:
原文：1      SCI transmitter enable；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第600页；原文字段表：SCI transmitter enable.

Data is transmitted through the SCITXD pin only when TXENA is
set. If reset, transmission is halted but only after all data previously
written to SCITXBUF has been sent. Data written into SCITXBUF
when TXENA is disabled will not be transmitted even if the TXENA is
enabled later.
0h (R/W) = Transmitter disabled
1h (R/W) = Transmitter enabled；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: SLEEP
Fields.Description: SCI 睡眠
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI 睡眠. TXWAKE 位 控制 选择 的 data-transmit feature, depending 开启 which 发送 模式 (idle-line 或 address-bit) 为 specified 在 ADDR/IDLE 模式 位 (SCICCR, 位 3). 中 multiprocessor 配置, 此 位 控制 接收器 睡眠 功能. Clearing 此 位 brings SCI out 的 睡眠 模式. 接收器 still operates 当 睡眠 位 为 置位 however, 操作 does 不 更新 接收器 缓冲 就绪 位 (SCIRXST, 位 6, RXRDY) 或 错误 状态 位 (SCIRXST, 位 5-2: BRKDT, FE, OE, 及 PE) unless 地址 字节 为 已检测. 睡眠 为 不 cleared 当 地址 字节 为 已检测. 0h (R/W) = 睡眠 模式 已禁用 1h (R/W) = 睡眠 模式 已使能
Fields.Notes:
原文：2      SCI sleep；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第600页；原文字段表：SCI sleep.

The TXWAKE bit controls selection of the data-transmit feature,
depending on which transmit mode (idle-line or address-bit) is
specified at the ADDR/IDLE MODE bit (SCICCR, bit 3). In a
multiprocessor configuration, this bit controls the receiver sleep
function. Clearing this bit brings the SCI out of the sleep mode.
The receiver still operates when the SLEEP bit is set
however, operation does not update the receiver buffer ready bit
(SCIRXST, bit 6, RXRDY) or the error status bits (SCIRXST, bit 5-2:
BRKDT, FE, OE, and PE) unless the address byte is detected.
SLEEP is not cleared when the address byte is detected.
0h (R/W) = Sleep mode disabled
1h (R/W) = Sleep mode enabled；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TXWAKE
Fields.Description: 发送器 唤醒 method
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI 发送器 wake-up method 选择. TXWAKE 位 控制 选择 的 data-transmit feature, depending 开启 which 发送 模式 (idle-line 或 address-bit) 为 specified 在 ADDR/IDLE 模式 位 (SCICCR, 位 3) 0h (R/W) = 发送 feature 为 不 已选. 中 idle-line 模式: 写入 1 至 TXWAKE, then 写入 数据 至 寄存器 SCITXBUF 至 产生 空闲 周期 的 11 数据 位 中 address-bit 模式: 写入 1 至 TXWAKE, then 写入 数据 至 SCITXBUF 至 置位 地址 位 用于 that 帧 至 1 1h (R/W) = 发送 feature 已选 为 dependent 开启 模式, idle-line 或 address-bit: TXWAKE 为 不 cleared 通过 软件 复位 位 (SCICTL1, 位 5) it 为 cleared 通过 系统 复位 或 transfer 的 TXWAKE 至 WUT 标志.
Fields.Notes:
原文：3      Transmitter wakeup method；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第600页；原文字段表：SCI transmitter wake-up method select.

The TXWAKE bit controls selection of the data-transmit feature,
depending on which transmit mode (idle-line or address-bit) is
specified at the ADDR/IDLE MODE bit (SCICCR, bit 3)
0h (R/W) = Transmit feature is not selected. In idle-line mode: write
a 1 to TXWAKE, then write data to register SCITXBUF to generate
an idle period of 11 data bits In address-bit mode: write a 1 to
TXWAKE, then write data to SCITXBUF to set the address bit for
that frame to 1
1h (R/W) = Transmit feature selected is dependent on the mode,
idle-line or address-bit: TXWAKE is not cleared by the SW RESET
bit (SCICTL1, bit 5)
it is cleared by a system reset or the transfer of TXWAKE to the
WUT flag.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SWRESET
Fields.Description: SCI软件复位。
Fields.Values: 0：保持SCI复位；1：释放复位、允许工作。
Fields.Notes:
原文：5      Software reset；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第599页；原文字段表：SCI software reset (active low).

Writing a 0 to this bit initializes the SCI state machines and operating
flags (registers SCICTL2 and SCIRXST) to the reset condition. The
SW RESET bit does not affect any of the configuration bits.
All affected logic is held in the specified reset state until a 1 is written
to SW RESET (the bit values following a reset are shown beneath
each register diagram in this section). Thus, after a system reset, re-
enable the SCI by writing a 1 to this bit. Clear this bit after a receiver
break detect (BRKDT flag, bit SCIRXST, bit 5).
SW RESET affects the operating flags of the SCI, but it neither
affects the configuration bits nor restores the reset values. Once SW
RESET is asserted, the flags are frozen until the bit is deasserted.
The affected flags are as follows:
Value After SW SCI Flag Register Bit
RESET；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Description: 发送器 空 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：发送器 空 标志. 此 标志's 值 表示 内容 的 发送器's 缓冲 寄存器 (SCITXBUF) 及 shift 寄存器 (TXSHF). 活动 软件 复位 (SCICTL1.5), 或 系统 复位, 设置 此 位. 此 位 does 不 cause 中断 请求. 0h (R/W) = 发送器 缓冲 或 shift 寄存器 或 both are loaded 带 数据 1h (R/W) = 发送器 缓冲 及 shift 寄存器 are both 空
Fields.Notes:
原文：6      Transmitter empty flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第603页；原文字段表：Transmitter empty flag.

This flag's value indicates the contents of the transmitter's buffer
register (SCITXBUF) and shift register (TXSHF). An active SW

not cause an interrupt request.
0h (R/W) = Transmitter buffer or shift register or both are loaded

1h (R/W) = Transmitter buffer and shift registers are both empty；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TXRDY
Fields.Description: 发送器 就绪 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：发送器 缓冲 寄存器 就绪 标志. 当 置位, 此 位 表示 that 发送 数据 缓冲 寄存器, SCITXBUF, 为 就绪 至 接收 another 字符. Writing 数据 至 SCITXBUF automatically clears 此 位. 当 置位, 此 标志 asserts 发送器 中断 请求 如果 interrupt-enable 位, TX 中断 ENA (SCICTL2.0), 为 also 置位. TXRDY 为 置位 至 1 通过 enabling 软件 复位 位 (SCICTL1.5) 或 通过 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = SCITXBUF 为 满 1h (R/W) = SCITXBUF 为 就绪 至 接收 下次 字符
Fields.Notes:
原文：7      Transmitter ready flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第603页；原文字段表：Transmitter buffer register ready flag.

When set, this bit indicates that the transmit data buffer register,
SCITXBUF, is ready to receive another character. Writing data to the
SCITXBUF automatically clears this bit. When set, this flag asserts a
transmitter interrupt request if the interrupt-enable bit, TX INT ENA
(SCICTL2.0), is also set. TXRDY is set to 1 by enabling the SW
RESET bit (SCICTL1.5) or by a system reset.
0h (R/W) = SCITXBUF is full
1h (R/W) = SCITXBUF is ready to receive the next character；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RXWAKE
Fields.Description: 接收器 唤醒 检测 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：接收器 wake-up-detect 标志 0h (R/W) = No 检测 的 接收器 wake-up 条件 1h (R/W) = 值 的 1 中 此 位 表示 检测 的 接收器 wake-up 条件. 中 address-bit multiprocessor 模式 (SCICCR.3 = 1), RXWAKE 反映 值 的 地址 位 用于 字符 contained 中 SCIRXBUF. 中 idle-line multiprocessor 模式, RXWAKE 为 置位 如果 SCIRXD 数据 线路 为 已检测 作为 空闲. RXWAKE 为 只读 标志, cleared 通过 单次 的 following: - transfer 的 首个 字节 after 地址 字节 至 SCIRXBUF (仅 中 non-FIFO 模式) - reading 的 SCIRXBUF - 活动 软件 复位 - 系统 复位
Fields.Notes:
原文：1      Receiver wakeup detect flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第606页；原文字段表：Receiver wake-up-detect flag

0h (R/W) = No detection of a receiver wake-up condition
1h (R/W) = A value of 1 in this bit indicates detection of a receiver
wake-up condition. In the address-bit multiprocessor mode
(SCICCR.3 = 1), RXWAKE reflects the value of the address bit for
the character contained in SCIRXBUF. In the idle-line
multiprocessor mode, RXWAKE is set if the SCIRXD data line is
detected as idle. RXWAKE is a read-only flag, cleared by one of
the following:
- The transfer of the first byte after the address byte to SCIRXBUF
(only in non-FIFO mode)
- The reading of SCIRXBUF
- An active SW RESET
- A system reset；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: PE
Fields.Description: 奇偶校验 错误 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI parity-error 标志. 此 标志 位 为 置位 当 字符 为 已接收 带 mismatch between 数量 的 1s 及 its 奇偶校验 位. 地址 位 为 included 中 calculation. 如果 奇偶校验 产生 及 检测 为 不 已使能, PE 标志 为 已禁用 及 读取 作为 0. PE 位 为 复位 通过 活动 软件 复位 或 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 奇偶校验 错误 或 奇偶校验 为 已禁用 1h (R/W) = 奇偶校验 错误 为 已检测
Fields.Notes:
原文：2      Parity error flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第606页；原文字段表：SCI parity-error flag.

This flag bit is set when a character is received with a mismatch
between the number of 1s and its parity bit. The address bit is
included in the calculation. If parity generation and detection is not
enabled, the PE flag is disabled and read as 0. The PE bit is reset
by an active SW RESET or a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No parity error or parity is disabled
1h (R/W) = Parity error is detected；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OE
Fields.Description: 溢出 错误 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI overrun-error 标志. SCI 设置 此 位 当 字符 为 transferred 进入 寄存器 SCIRXEMU 及 SCIRXBUF before 前次 字符 为 fully 读取 通过 CPU 或 DMAC. 前次 字符 为 overwritten 及 丢失. OE 标志 位 为 复位 通过 活动 软件 复位 或 通过 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 溢出 错误 已检测 1h (R/W) = 溢出 错误 已检测
Fields.Notes:
原文：3      Overrun error flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第606页；原文字段表：SCI overrun-error flag.

The SCI sets this bit when a character is transferred into registers
SCIRXEMU and SCIRXBUF before the previous character is fully
read by the CPU or DMAC. The previous character is overwritten
and lost. The OE flag bit is reset by an active SW RESET or by a
system reset.
0h (R/W) = No overrun error detected
1h (R/W) = Overrun error detected；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: FE
Fields.Description: 帧格式 错误 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI framing-error 标志. SCI 设置 此 位 当 expected 停止 位 为 不 found. 仅 首个 停止 位 为 checked. 丢失 停止 位 表示 that 同步 带 启动 位 has been 丢失 及 that 字符 为 incorrectly framed. FE 位 为 复位 通过 clearing 的 软件 复位 位 或 通过 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 帧格式 错误 已检测 1h (R/W) = 帧格式 错误 已检测
Fields.Notes:
原文：4      Framing error flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第606页；原文字段表：SCI framing-error flag.

The SCI sets this bit when an expected stop bit is not found. Only
the first stop bit is checked. The missing stop bit indicates that
synchronization with the start bit has been lost and that the character
is incorrectly framed. The FE bit is reset by a clearing of the SW
RESET bit or by a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No framing error detected
1h (R/W) = Framing error detected；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: BRKDT
Fields.Description: Break-detect 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI break-detect 标志. SCI 设置 此 位 当 中断帧 条件 发生. 中断帧 conditionoccurs 当 SCI 接收器 数据 线路 (SCIRXD) remains continuously 低 用于 在 最低 ten 位, beginning after 丢失 首个 停止 位. occurrence 的 中断帧 causes 接收器 中断 至 be 已产生 如果 RX/BK 中断 ENA 位 为 1, but it does 不 cause 接收器 缓冲 至 be loaded. BRKDT 中断 CAN occur even 如果 接收器 睡眠 位 为 置位 至 1. BRKDT 为 cleared 通过 活动 软件 复位 或 通过 系统 复位. It 为 不 cleared 通过 receipt 的 字符 after 中断帧 为 已检测. 中 order 至 接收 more characters, SCI must be 复位 通过 toggling 软件 复位 位 或 通过 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 中断帧 条件 1h (R/W) = 中断帧 条件 occurred
Fields.Notes:
原文：5      Break-detect flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第605页；原文字段表：SCI break-detect flag.

The SCI sets this bit when a break condition occurs. A break
conditionoccurs when the SCI receiver data line (SCIRXD) remains
continuously low for at least ten bits,
beginning after a missing first stop bit. The occurrence of a break
causes a receiver interrupt to be generated if the RX/BK INT ENA bit
is a 1, but it does not cause the receiver buffer to be loaded. A
BRKDT interrupt can occur even if the receiver SLEEP bit is set to 1.
BRKDT is cleared by an active SW RESET or by a system reset. It
is not cleared by receipt of a character after the break is detected. In
order to receive more characters, the SCI must be reset by toggling
the SW RESET bit or by a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No break condition
1h (R/W) = Break condition occurred；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Notes:
原文：6      Receiver ready flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第605页；原文字段表：SCI receiver-ready flag.

When a new character is ready to be read from the SCIRXBUF
register, the receiver sets this bit, and a receiver interrupt is
generated if the RX/BK INT ENA bit (SCICTL2.1) is a 1. RXRDY is
cleared by a reading of the SCIRXBUF register, by an active SW
RESET, or by a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No new character in SCIRXBUF

Fields.Name: RXERROR
Fields.Description: 接收器 错误 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI 接收器 错误 标志. RX 错误 标志 表示 that 单次 的 错误 flags 中 接收器 状态 寄存器 为 置位. RX 错误 为 logical 或 的 中断帧 检测, 帧格式 错误, 溢出, 及 奇偶校验 错误 使能 flags (位 5-2: BRKDT, FE, OE, 及 PE). 1 开启 此 位 will cause 中断 如果 RX ERR 中断 ENA 位 (SCICTL1.6) 为 置位. 此 位 CAN be 使用 用于 fast error-condition checking during 中断 service routine. 此 错误 标志 cannot be cleared directly it 为 cleared 通过 活动 软件 复位 或 通过 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 错误 flags 置位 1h (R/W) = 错误 标志(s) 置位
Fields.Notes:
原文：7      Receiver error flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第605页；原文字段表：SCI receiver error flag.

The RX ERROR flag indicates that one of the error flags in the
receiver status register is set. RX ERROR is a logical OR of the
break detect, framing error, overrun, and parity error enable flags
(bits 5-2: BRKDT, FE, OE, and PE).
A 1 on this bit will cause an interrupt if the RX ERR INT ENA bit
(SCICTL1.6) is set. This bit can be used for fast error-condition
checking during the interrupt service routine. This error flag cannot
be cleared directly
it is cleared by an active SW RESET or by a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No error flags set
1h (R/W) = Error flag(s) set；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: FFTXDLY
Fields.Description: FIFO队列 发送 延迟
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：FIFO队列 transfer 延迟. These 位 define 延迟 between every transfer 来自 FIFO队列 发送 bufferto 发送 shift 寄存器. 延迟 为 defined 中 数量 的 SCI serial 波特率 时钟 cycles. 8 位 寄存器 could define 最小 延迟 的 0 波特率 时钟 cycles 及 最大 的 256 波特率 时钟 cycles 中 FIFO队列 模式, 缓冲 (TXBUF) between shift 寄存器 及 FIFO队列 should be filled 仅 after shift 寄存器 has completed shifting 的 最后 位. 此 为 required 至 pass 开启 延迟 between transfers 至 数据 stream. 中 FIFO队列 模式, TXBUF should 不 be treated 作为 单次 额外 电平 的 缓冲. delayed 发送 feature will help 至 create auto-flow scheme without RTS/CTS 控制 作为 中 标准 UARTS. 当 SCI 为 configured 用于 单次 stop-bit, 延迟 introduced 通过 FFTXDLY between 单次 帧 及 下次 帧 为 equal 至 数量 的 波特率 时钟 cycles that FFTXDLY 为 置位 至. 当 SCI 为 configured 用于 two stop-bits, 延迟 introduced 通过 FFTXDLY between 单次 帧 及 下次 帧 为 equal 至 数量 的 波特率 时钟 cycles that FFTXDLY 为 置位 至 minus 1.
Fields.Notes:
原文：7:0    FIFO transmit delay；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第614页；原文字段表：FIFO transfer delay. These bits define the delay between every

transfer from FIFO transmit bufferto transmit shift register. The delay
is defined in the number of SCI serial baud clock cycles. The 8 bit
register could define a minimum delay of 0 baud clock cycles and a
maximum of 256 baud clock cycles
In FIFO mode, the buffer (TXBUF) between the shift register and the
FIFO should be filled only after the shift register has completed
shifting of the last bit. This is required to pass on the delay between
transfers to the data stream. In FIFO mode, TXBUF should not be
treated as one additional level of buffer. The delayed transmit feature
will help to create an auto-flow scheme without RTS/CTS controls as
in standard UARTS.
When SCI is configured for one stop-bit, delay introduced by
FFTXDLY between one frame and the next frame is equal to number
of baud clock cycles that FFTXDLY is set to.
When SCI is configured for two stop-bits, delay introduced by
FFTXDLY between one frame and the next frame is equal to number
of baud clock cycles that FFTXDLY is set to minus 1.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CLKPOLARITY
Fields.Description: SPI时钟极性。
Fields.Values: 0：空闲低电平；1：空闲高电平。采样边沿还取决于CLK_PHASE。
Fields.Notes:
原文：6      Clock polarity；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第564页；原文字段表：Shift Clock Polarity

This bit controls the polarity of the SPICLK signal. CLOCK
POLARITY and POLARITY CLOCK PHASE (SPICTL.3) control four
clocking schemes on the SPICLK pin.
0h (R/W) = Data is output on rising edge and input on falling edge.
When no SPI data is sent, SPICLK is at low level. The data input
and output edges depend on the value of the CLOCK PHASE bit
(SPICTL.3) as follows:
- CLOCK PHASE = 0: Data is output on the rising edge of the
SPICLK signal. Input data is latched on the falling edge of the
SPICLK signal.
- CLOCK PHASE = 1: Data is output one half-cycle before the first
rising edge of the SPICLK signal and on subsequent falling edges
of the SPICLK signal. Input data is latched on the rising edge of
the SPICLK signal.
1h (R/W) = Data is output on falling edge and input on rising edge.
When no SPI data is sent, SPICLK is at high level. The data input
and output edges depend on the value of the CLOCK PHASE bit
(SPICTL.3) as follows:
- CLOCK PHASE = 0: Data is output on the falling edge of the
SPICLK signal. Input data is latched on the rising edge of the
SPICLK signal.
- CLOCK PHASE = 1: Data is output one half-cycle before the first
falling edge of the SPICLK signal and on subsequent rising edges
of the SPICLK signal. Input data is latched on the falling edge of
the SPICLK signal.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: SPISWRESET
Fields.Description: SPI软件复位。
Fields.Values: 0：保持SPI复位；1：释放复位。
Fields.Notes:
原文：7      SPI SW Reset；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第564页；原文字段表：SPI Software Reset

When changing configuration, you should clear this bit before the
changes and set this bit before resuming operation.
0h (R/W) = Initializes the SPI operating flags to the reset condition.
Specifically, the RECEIVER OVERRUN Flag bit (SPISTS.7), the
SPI INT FLAG bit (SPISTS.6), and the TXBUF FULL Flag bit
(SPISTS.5) are cleared. SPISTE will become inactive. SPICLK will
be immediately driven to 0 regardless of the clock polarity. The SPI
configuration remains unchanged.
1h (R/W) = SPI is ready to transmit or receive the next character.
When the SPI SW RESET bit is a 0, a character written to the
transmitter will not be shifted out when this bit is set. A new
character must be written to the serial data register. SPICLK will be
returned to its inactive state one SPICLK cycle after this bit is set.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: TALK
Fields.Description: SPI发送输出使能。
Fields.Values: 0：禁止发送引脚驱动；1：允许发送。
Fields.Notes:
原文：1      Master/Slave transmit enable；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第567页；原文字段表：Transmit Enable

The TALK bit can disable data transmission (master or slave) by
placing the serial data output in the high-impedance state. If this bit
is disabled during a transmission, the transmit shift register
continues to operate until the previous character is shifted out. When
the TALK bit is disabled, the SPI is still able to receive characters
and update the status flags. TALK is cleared (disabled) by a system
reset.
0h (R/W) = Disables transmission:
- Slave mode operation: If not previously configured as a general-
purpose I/O pin, the SPISOMI pin will be put in the high-impedance
state.
- Master mode operation: If not previously configured as a general-
purpose I/O pin, the SPISIMO pin will be put in the high-impedance
state.
1h (R/W) = Enables transmission For the 4-pin option, ensure to
enable the receiver's SPISTEn input pin.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: MASTER_SLAVE

Fields.Notes:
原文：2      Network control mode；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第566页；原文字段表：SPI Network Mode Control

This bit determines whether the SPI is a network master or slave.
SLAVE During reset initialization, the SPI is automatically configured
as a network slave.
0h (R/W) = SPI is configured as a slave.
1h (R/W) = SPI is configured as a master.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI07 / 2020-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: CLK_PHASE
Fields.Description: 时钟 相位 选择
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SPI 时钟 相位 选择 此 位 控制 相位 的 SPICLK 信号. 时钟 相位 及 时钟 极性 (SPICCR.6) make four different 时钟 schemes possible (see 时钟 figures 中 SPI chapter). 当 工作 带 时钟 相位 高, SPI (主机 或 从机) makes 首个 位 的 数据 available after SPIDAT 为 written 及 before 首个 边沿 的 SPICLK 信号, regardless 的 which SPI 模式 为 being 使用. 0h (R/W) = Normal SPI 时钟 scheme, depending 开启 时钟 极性 位 (SPICCR.6). 1h (R/W) = SPICLK 信号 delayed 通过 单次 半周期. 极性 determined 通过 时钟 极性 位.
Fields.Notes:
原文：3      Clock phase select；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第566页；原文字段表：SPI Clock Phase Select

This bit controls the phase of the SPICLK signal. CLOCK PHASE
and CLOCK POLARITY (SPICCR.6) make four different clocking
schemes possible (see clocking figures in SPI chapter). When
operating with CLOCK PHASE high, the SPI (master or slave)
makes the first bit of data available after SPIDAT is written and
before the first edge of the SPICLK signal, regardless of which SPI
mode is being used.
0h (R/W) = Normal SPI clocking scheme, depending on the
CLOCK POLARITY bit (SPICCR.6).
1h (R/W) = SPICLK signal delayed by one half-cycle. Polarity
determined by the CLOCK POLARITY bit.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INT_FLAG
Fields.Description: SPI 中断 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SPI 中断 标志 SPI 中断 标志 为 只读 标志. 硬件 设置 此 位 至 indicate that SPI has completed sending 或 receiving 最后 位 及 为 就绪 至 be serviced. 此 标志 causes 中断 至 be requested 如果 SPI 中断 ENA 位 (SPICTL.0) 为 置位. 已接收 字符 为 placed 中 接收器 缓冲 在 same 时间 此 位 为 置位. 此 位 为 cleared 中 单次 的 three ways: - Reading SPIRXBUF - Writing 0 至 SPI 软件 复位 (SPICCR.7) - 复位 系统 Note: 此 位 should 不 be 使用 如果 FIFO队列 模式 为 已使能. 内部 process 的 copying 已接收 字 来自 SPIRXBUF 至 接收 FIFO队列 will 清除 此 位. Use FIFO队列 状态, 或 FIFO队列 中断 位 用于 similar functionality. 0h (R/W) = No 满 words have been 已接收 或 已发送. 1h (R/W) = 表示 that SPI has completed sending 或 receiving 最后 位 及 为 就绪 至 be serviced.
Fields.Notes:
原文：6      SPI interrupt flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第569页；原文字段表：SPI Interrupt Flag

SPI INT FLAG is a read-only flag. Hardware sets this bit to indicate
that the SPI has completed sending or receiving the last bit and is
ready to be serviced. This flag causes an interrupt to be requested if
the SPI INT ENA bit (SPICTL.0) is set. The received character is
placed in the receiver buffer at the same time this bit is set. This bit
is cleared in one of three ways:
- Reading SPIRXBUF
- Writing a 0 to SPI SW RESET (SPICCR.7)
- Resetting the system
Note: This bit should not be used if FIFO mode is enabled. The
internal process of copying the received word from SPIRXBUF to the
Receive FIFO will clear this bit. Use the FIFO status, or FIFO
interrupt bits for similar functionality.
0h (R/W) = No full words have been received or transmitted.
1h (R/W) = Indicates that the SPI has completed sending or
receiving the last bit and is ready to be serviced.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OVERRUN_FLAG
Fields.Description: SPI reciever 溢出 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SPI 接收器 溢出 标志 此 位 为 read/clear-only 标志. SPI 硬件 设置 此 位 当 接收 或 发送 操作 completes before 前次 字符 has been 读取 来自 缓冲. 位 为 cleared 中 单次 的 three ways: - Writing 1 至 此 位 - Writing 0 至 SPI 软件 复位 (SPICCR.7) - 复位 系统 如果 溢出 中断 ENA 位 (SPICTL.4) 为 置位, SPI requests 仅 单次 中断 upon 首个 occurrence 的 设置 接收器 溢出 标志 位. Subsequent overruns will 不 请求 额外 中断 如果 此 标志 位 为 already 置位. 此 means that 中 order 至 allow new 溢出 中断 requests user must 清除 此 标志 位 通过 writing 1 至 SPISTS.7 每个 时间 溢出 条件 发生. 中 other words, 如果 接收器 溢出 标志 位 为 left 置位 (不 cleared) 通过 中断 service routine, another 溢出 中断 will 不 be immediately re-entered 当 中断 service routine 为 exited. 0h (R/W) = 接收 溢出 条件 has 不 occurred. 1h (R/W) = 最后 已接收 字符 has been overwritten 及 therefore 丢失 (当 SPIRXBUF was overwritten 通过 SPI 模块 before 前次 字符 was 读取 通过 user application). Writing '1' will 清除 此 位. 接收器 溢出 标志 位 should be cleared during 中断 service routine because 接收器 溢出 标志 位 及 SPI 中断 标志 位 (SPISTS.6) share same 中断 向量. 此 will alleviate any possible doubt 作为 至 来源 的 中断 当 下次 字节 为 已接收.
Fields.Notes:
原文：7      SPI reciever overrun flag；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第568页；原文字段表：SPI Receiver Overrun Flag

This bit is a read/clear-only flag. The SPI hardware sets this bit when
a receive or transmit operation completes before the previous
character has been read from the buffer. The bit is cleared in one of
three ways:
- Writing a 1 to this bit
- Writing a 0 to SPI SW RESET (SPICCR.7)
- Resetting the system
If the OVERRUN INT ENA bit (SPICTL.4) is set, the SPI requests
only one interrupt upon the first occurrence of setting the RECEIVER
OVERRUN Flag bit. Subsequent overruns will not request additional
interrupts if this flag bit is already set. This means that in order to
allow new overrun interrupt requests the user must clear this flag bit
by writing a 1 to SPISTS.7 each time an overrun condition occurs. In
other words, if the RECEIVER OVERRUN Flag bit is left set (not
cleared) by the interrupt service routine, another overrun interrupt
will not be immediately re-entered when the interrupt service routine
is exited.
0h (R/W) = A receive overrun condition has not occurred.
1h (R/W) = The last received character has been overwritten and
therefore lost (when the SPIRXBUF was overwritten by the SPI
module before the previous character was read by the user
application).
Writing a '1' will clear this bit. The RECEIVER OVERRUN Flag bit
should be cleared during the interrupt service routine because the
RECEIVER OVERRUN Flag bit and SPI INT FLAG bit (SPISTS.6)
share the same interrupt vector. This will alleviate any possible
doubt as to the source of the interrupt when the next byte is
received.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TXDLY
Fields.Description: FIFO队列 发送 延迟
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：FIFO队列 发送 延迟 位 These 位 define 延迟 between every transfer 来自 FIFO队列 发送 缓冲 至 发送 shift 寄存器. 延迟 为 defined 中 数量 SPI serial 时钟 cycles. 8-位 寄存器 could define 最小 延迟 的 0 serial 时钟 cycles 及 最大 的 255 serial 时钟 cycles. 中 FIFO队列 模式, 缓冲 (TXBUF) between shift 寄存器 及 FIFO队列 should be filled 仅 after shift 寄存器 has completed shifting 的 最后 位. 此 为 required 至 pass 开启 延迟 between transfers 至 数据 stream. 中 FIFO队列 模式 TXBUF should 不 be treated 作为 单次 额外 电平 的 缓冲. 0h (R/W) = 下次 字 中 TX FIFO队列 缓冲 为 transferred 至 SPITXBUF immediately upon completion 的 发送 的 前次 字. 1h (R/W) = 下次 字 中 TX FIFO队列 缓冲 为 transferred 至 SPITXBUF1 serial 时钟 周期 after completion 的 发送 的 前次 字. 2h (R/W) = 下次 字 中 TX FIFO队列 缓冲 为 transferred 至 SPITXBUF 2 serial 时钟 cycles after completion 的 发送 的 前次 字. FFh (R/W) = 下次 字 中 TX FIFO队列 缓冲 为 transferred 至 SPITXBUF 255 serial 时钟 cycles after completion 的 发送 的 前次 字.
Fields.Notes:
原文：7:0    FIFO transmit delay；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第579页；原文字段表：FIFO Transmit Delay Bits

These bits define the delay between every transfer from FIFO
transmit buffer to transmit shift register. The delay is defined in
number SPI serial clock cycles. The 8-bit register could define a
minimum delay of 0 serial clock cycles and a maximum of 255 serial
clock cycles. In FIFO mode, the buffer (TXBUF) between the shift
register and the FIFO should be filled only after the shift register has
completed shifting of the last bit. This is required to pass on the
delay between transfers to the data stream. In the FIFO mode
TXBUF should not be treated as one additional level of buffer.
0h (R/W) = The next word in the TX FIFO buffer is transferred to
SPITXBUF immediately upon completion of transmission of the
previous word.
1h (R/W) = The next word in the TX FIFO buffer is transferred to
SPITXBUF1 serial clock cycle after completion of transmission of
the previous word.
2h (R/W) = The next word in the TX FIFO buffer is transferred to
SPITXBUF 2 serial clock cycles after completion of transmission of
the previous word.
FFh (R/W) = The next word in the TX FIFO buffer is transferred to
SPITXBUF 255 serial clock cycles after completion of transmission
of the previous word.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: FREE
Fields.Description: 自由运行 仿真 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：仿真 自由运行 Run These 位 determine what 发生 当 仿真 暂停 发生 (用于 example, 当 debugger hits breakpoint). 外设 CAN continue whatever it 为 doing (free-run 模式) 或, 如果 中 停止 模式, it CAN either 停止 immediately 或 停止 当 当前 操作 ( 当前 receive/transmit sequence) 为 complete. 0h (R/W) = 仿真 模式 为 已选 通过 软 位 1h (R/W) = 自由运行 run, continue SPI 操作 regardless 的 暂停 或 当 暂停 occurred.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4      Free emulation mode control；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第580页；原文字段表：Emulation Free Run

These bits determine what occurs when an emulation suspend
occurs (for example, when the debugger hits a breakpoint). The
peripheral can continue whatever it is doing (free-run mode) or, if in
stop mode, it can either stop immediately or stop when the current
operation (the current receive/transmit sequence) is complete.
0h (R/W) = Emulation mode is selected by the SOFT bit
1h (R/W) = Free run, continue SPI operation regardless of suspend
or when the suspend occurred.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SOFT
Fields.Description: 软 仿真 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：仿真 软 Run 此 位 仅 has effect 当 自由运行 位 为 0. 0h (R/W) = 发送 stops midway 中 位 stream 期间 TSUSPEND 为 已置有效. Once TSUSPEND 为 deasserted without 系统 复位, 余数 的 位 待处理 中 DATBUF are shifted. Example: 如果 SPIDAT has shifted 3 out 的 8 位, communication freezes right there. However, 如果 TSUSPEND 为 later deasserted without 复位 SPI, SPI starts transmitting 来自 where it had stopped (fourth 位 中 此 case) 及 will 发送 8 位 来自 that point. 1h (R/W) = 如果 仿真 暂停 发生 before 启动 的 发送, (that 为, before 首个 SPICLK 脉冲) then 发送 will 不 occur. 如果 仿真 暂停 发生 after 启动 的 发送, then 数据 will be shifted out 至 completion. 当 启动 的 发送 发生 为 dependent 开启 波特率 速率 使用. 标准 SPI 模式: 停止 after transmitting words 中 shift 寄存器 及 缓冲. That 为, after TXBUF 及 SPIDAT are 空. 中 FIFO队列 模式: 停止 after transmitting words 中 shift 寄存器 及 缓冲. That 为, after TX FIFO队列 及 SPIDAT are 空.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5      Soft emulation mode control；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第580页；原文字段表：Emulation Soft Run

This bit only has an effect when the FREE bit is 0.
0h (R/W) = Transmission stops midway in the bit stream while
TSUSPEND is asserted. Once TSUSPEND is deasserted without a
system reset, the remainder of the bits pending in the DATBUF are
shifted. Example: If SPIDAT has shifted 3 out of 8 bits, the
communication freezes right there. However, if TSUSPEND is later
deasserted without resetting the SPI, SPI starts transmitting from
where it had stopped (fourth bit in this case) and will transmit 8 bits
from that point.
1h (R/W) = If the emulation suspend occurs before the start of a
transmission, (that is, before the first SPICLK pulse) then the
transmission will not occur. If the emulation suspend occurs after
the start of a transmission, then the data will be shifted out to
completion. When the start of transmission occurs is dependent on
the baud rate used.
Standard SPI mode: Stop after transmitting the words in the shift
register and buffer. That is, after TXBUF and SPIDAT are empty.
In FIFO mode: Stop after transmitting the words in the shift register
and buffer. That is, after TX FIFO and SPIDAT are empty.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

See Section 1.1.3.1 用于 more information. See device-specific 数据 manual 用于 最小 时间 required 用于 RANDOM flash 访问. RANDWAIT must be 置位 greater than 0. That 为, 在 最低 1 random wait 状态 must be 使用. 中 addition, you must 置位 RANDWAIT 至 值 greater than 或 equal 至 PAGEWAIT 设置. device will 不 检测 及 correct PAGEWAIT 值 that 为 greater then RANDWAIT.
Fields.Notes:
原文：0-3   Flash Random Read Wait State bits；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第48页；原文字段表：Flash Random Read Wait States. These register bits specify the number of wait states for a random

read operation in CPU clock cycles (1..15 SYSCLKOUT cycles) to the flash bank. See
Section 1.1.3.1 for more information.
See the device-specific data manual for the minimum time required for a RANDOM flash access.
RANDWAIT must be set greater than 0. That is, at least 1 random wait state must be used. In
addition, you must set RANDWAIT to a value greater than or equal to the PAGEWAIT setting. The
device will not detect and correct a PAGEWAIT value that is greater then RANDWAIT.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: PAGEWAIT
Fields.Description: -11 Flash Paged 读取 Wait 状态 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Flash Paged 读取 Wait States. These 寄存器 位 specify 数量 的 wait states 用于 paged 读取 操作 中 CPU 时钟 cycles (0..15 SYSCLKOUT cycles) 至 flash bank. See Section 1.1.3.1 用于 more information. See device-specific 数据 manual 用于 最小 时间 required 用于 PAGED flash 访问. You must 置位 RANDWAIT 至 值 greater than 或 equal 至 PAGEWAIT 设置. No 硬件 为 provided 至 检测 PAGEWAIT 值 that 为 greater then RANDWAIT.
Fields.Notes:
原文：8-11  Flash Paged Read Wait State bits；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第48页；原文字段表：Flash Paged Read Wait States. These register bits specify the number of wait states for a paged

read operation in CPU clock cycles (0..15 SYSCLKOUT cycles) to the flash bank. See
Section 1.1.3.1 for more information.
See the device-specific data manual for the minimum time required for a PAGED flash access.
You must set RANDWAIT to a value greater than or equal to the PAGEWAIT setting. No hardware is
provided to detect a PAGEWAIT value that is greater then RANDWAIT.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OTPWAIT
Fields.Description: -4 OTP 读取 Wait 状态 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：OTP 读取 Wait States. These 寄存器 位 specify 数量 的 wait states 用于 读取 操作 中 CPU 时钟 cycles (1..31 SYSCLKOUT cycles) 至 OTP. See CPU 读取 或 Fetch 访问 来自 flash/OTP section 用于 details. There 为 no PAGE 模式 中 OTP. OTPWAIT must be 置位 greater than 0. That 为, 最小 的 1 wait 状态 must be 使用. See device-specific 数据 manual 用于 最小 时间 required 用于 OTP 访问.
Fields.Notes:
原文：0-4   OTP Read Wait State bits；SPRUI07 / 2020-03 PDF第49页；原文字段表：OTP Read Wait States. These register bits specify the number of wait states for a read operation in

CPU clock cycles (1..31 SYSCLKOUT cycles) to the OTP. See CPU Read Or Fetch Access From
flash/OTP section for details. There is no PAGE mode in the OTP.
OTPWAIT must be set greater than 0. That is, a minimum of 1 wait state must be used. See the
device-specific data manual for the minimum time required for an OTP access.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Notes:
原文：0 Post Processing Block 1 Trip High Flag；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第1985页；原文字段表：Post Processing Block 1 Trip High Flag. When set indicates a digital 

compare trip high event has occurred.
Note: these bits are set even when the corresponding enable in 
ADCEVTINTSEL is not set. Because of this, an ISR may need to 
examine both the ADCEVTSTAT and ADCEVTINTSEL registers to 
determine the source of the interrupt.
Note: If software sets the clear bit on the same cycle that hardware is 
trying to set the flag bit, then hardware has priority；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

the open/shorts detection circuit state.
0h Open/Shorts detection circuit is disabled.
1h Open/Shorts detection circuit is enabled at zero scale.
2h Open/Shorts detection circuit is enabled at full scale.
3h Open/Shorts detection circuit is enabled at (nominal) 5/12 scale.
4h Open/Shorts detection circuit is enabled at (nominal) 7/12 scale.
5h Open/Shorts detection circuit is enabled with a (nominal) 5K 
pulldown to VSSA.
6h Open/Shorts detection circuit is enabled with a (nominal) 5K 
pullup to VDDA.
7h Open/Shorts detection circuit is enabled with a (nominal) 7K 
pulldown to VSSA.

Fields.Name: OFFCAL
Fields.Description: ADC 后置 处理 模块 偏移 Correction
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ADC 后置 处理 模块 1 偏移 Correction. 此 位 field CAN be 使用 至 digitally remove any 系统 电平 偏移 inherent 中 ADCIN circuit. 此 10-位 signed 值 为 subtracted 来自 ADC 输出 before being stored 中 ADCRESULT 寄存器. 000h No change. ADC 输出 为 stored directly 进入 ADCRESULT. 001h ADC 输出 - 1 为 stored 进入 ADCRESULT. 002h ADC 输出 - 2 为 stored 进入 ADCRESULT. ... 200h ADC 输出 + 512 为 stored 进入 ADCRESULT. ... 3FFh ADC 输出 + 1 为 stored 进入 ADCRESULT. NOTE: 中 16-位 模式, subtraction will 饱和 在 0000h 及 FFFFh before being stored 进入 ADCRESULT 寄存器. 中 12-位 模式, subtraction will 饱和 在 0000h 及 0FFFh before being stored 进入 ADCRESULT 寄存器. Note: 中 case that multiple PPBs point 至 same SOC转换启动, 仅 OFFCAL 的 highest numbered PPB will be applied.
Fields.Notes:
原文：9:0 ADC Post Processing Block Offset Correction；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第1999页；原文字段表：ADC Post Processing Block 1 Offset Correction. This bit field can 

be used to digitally remove any system level offset inherent in the 
ADCIN circuit. This 10-bit signed value is subtracted from the ADC 
output before being stored in the ADCRESULT register.
000h No change. The ADC output is stored directly into 
ADCRESULT.
001h ADC output - 1 is stored into ADCRESULT.
002h ADC output - 2 is stored into ADCRESULT.
...
200h ADC output + 512 is stored into ADCRESULT.
...
3FFh ADC output + 1 is stored into ADCRESULT.
NOTE: In 16-bit mode, the subtraction will saturate at 0000h and 
FFFFh before being stored into the ADCRESULT register. In 12-bit 
mode, the subtraction will saturate at 0000h and 0FFFh before being 
stored into the ADCRESULT register.
Note: in the case that multiple PPBs point to the same SOC, only the 
OFFCAL of the highest numbered PPB will be applied.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Description: SOC0 强制 启动转换 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：R-0/W1S 0h SOC0 强制 启动转换 位. Writing 1 will 强制 至 1 SOC0 标志 中 ADCSOCFLG1 寄存器. 此 CAN be 使用 至 initiate 软件 initiated 转换. Writes 的 0 are 忽略. 此 位 will always 读取 作为 0.
Fields.Notes:
原文：0 SOC0 Force Start of Conversion Bit；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第1944页；原文字段表：R-0/W1S 0h SOC0 Force Start of Conversion Bit. Writing a 1 will force to 1 the 

SOC0 flag in the ADCSOCFLG1 register. This can be used to initiate 
a software initiated conversion. Writes of 0 are ignored. This bit will 
always read as a 0.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

signal to the PWM blocks. The flag must be cleared before it can 
produce additional events to the PWM blocks.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: DETECTCFG
Fields.Description: ADC Opens 及 Shorts 检测 配置
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ADC Opens 及 Shorts 检测 配置. 此 位 field 定义 open/shorts 检测 circuit 状态. 0h Open/Shorts 检测 circuit 为 已禁用. 1h Open/Shorts 检测 circuit 为 已使能 在 零 scale. 2h Open/Shorts 检测 circuit 为 已使能 在 满 scale. 3h Open/Shorts 检测 circuit 为 已使能 在 (nominal) 5/12 scale. 4h Open/Shorts 检测 circuit 为 已使能 在 (nominal) 7/12 scale. 5h Open/Shorts 检测 circuit 为 已使能 带 (nominal) 5K pulldown 至 VSSA. 6h Open/Shorts 检测 circuit 为 已使能 带 (nominal) 5K pullup 至 VDDA. 7h Open/Shorts 检测 circuit 为 已使能 带 (nominal) 7K pulldown 至 VSSA. 模数转换 Converter (ADC) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：2:0 ADC Opens and Shorts Detect Configuration；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第1992页；原文字段表：ADC Opens and Shorts Detect Configuration. This bit field defines 

the open/shorts detection circuit state.
0h Open/Shorts detection circuit is disabled.
1h Open/Shorts detection circuit is enabled at zero scale.
2h Open/Shorts detection circuit is enabled at full scale.
3h Open/Shorts detection circuit is enabled at (nominal) 5/12 scale.
4h Open/Shorts detection circuit is enabled at (nominal) 7/12 scale.
5h Open/Shorts detection circuit is enabled with a (nominal) 5K 
pulldown to VSSA.
6h Open/Shorts detection circuit is enabled with a (nominal) 5K 
pullup to VDDA.
7h Open/Shorts detection circuit is enabled with a (nominal) 7K 
pulldown to VSSA.
Analog-to-Digital Converter (ADC)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OFFCAL
Fields.Description: ADC 后置 处理 模块 偏移 Correction
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ADC 后置 处理 模块 1 偏移 Correction. 此 位 field CAN be 使用 至 digitally remove any 系统 电平 偏移 inherent 中 ADCIN circuit. 此 10-位 signed 值 为 subtracted 来自 ADC 输出 before being stored 中 ADCRESULT 寄存器. 000h No change. ADC 输出 为 stored directly 进入 ADCRESULT. 001h ADC 输出 - 1 为 stored 进入 ADCRESULT. 002h ADC 输出 - 2 为 stored 进入 ADCRESULT. ... 200h ADC 输出 + 512 为 stored 进入 ADCRESULT. ... 3FFh ADC 输出 + 1 为 stored 进入 ADCRESULT. NOTE: 中 16-位 模式, subtraction will 饱和 在 0000h 及 FFFFh before being stored 进入 ADCRESULT 寄存器. 中 12-位 模式, subtraction will 饱和 在 0000h 及 0FFFh before being stored 进入 ADCRESULT 寄存器. Note: 中 case that multiple PPBs point 至 same SOC转换启动, 仅 OFFCAL 的 highest numbered PPB will be applied.
Fields.Notes:
原文：9:0 ADC Post Processing Block Offset Correction；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第1999页；原文字段表：ADC Post Processing Block 1 Offset Correction. This bit field can 

be used to digitally remove any system level offset inherent in the 
ADCIN circuit. This 10-bit signed value is subtracted from the ADC 
output before being stored in the ADCRESULT register.
000h No change. The ADC output is stored directly into 
ADCRESULT.
001h ADC output - 1 is stored into ADCRESULT.
002h ADC output - 2 is stored into ADCRESULT.
...
200h ADC output + 512 is stored into ADCRESULT.
...
3FFh ADC output + 1 is stored into ADCRESULT.
NOTE: In 16-bit mode, the subtraction will saturate at 0000h and 
FFFFh before being stored into the ADCRESULT register. In 12-bit 
mode, the subtraction will saturate at 0000h and 0FFFh before being 
stored into the ADCRESULT register.
Note: in the case that multiple PPBs point to the same SOC, only the 
OFFCAL of the highest numbered PPB will be applied.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SOC转换启动 优先级 决定 cutoff point 用于 优先级 模式 及 round robin 仲裁 用于 SOCx 00h SOC转换启动 优先级 为 handled 中 round robin 模式 用于 全部 channels. 01h SOC0 为 高 优先级, rest 的 channels are 中 round robin 模式. 02h SOC0-SOC1 are 高 优先级, SOC2-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 03h SOC0-SOC2 are 高 优先级, SOC3-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 04h SOC0-SOC3 are 高 优先级, SOC4-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 05h SOC0-SOC4 are 高 优先级, SOC5-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 06h SOC0-SOC5 are 高 优先级, SOC6-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 07h SOC0-SOC6 are 高 优先级, SOC7-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 08h SOC0-SOC7 are 高 优先级, SOC8-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 09h SOC0-SOC8 are 高 优先级, SOC9-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 0Ah SOC0-SOC9 are 高 优先级, SOC10-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 0Bh SOC0-SOC10 are 高 优先级, SOC11-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 0Ch SOC0-SOC11 are 高 优先级, SOC12-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 0Dh SOC0-SOC12 are 高 优先级, SOC13-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 0Eh SOC0-SOC13 are 高 优先级, SOC14-SOC15 are 中 round robin 模式. 0Fh SOC0-SOC14 are 高 优先级, SOC15 为 中 round robin 模式. 10h 全部 SOCs are 中 高 优先级 模式, arbitrated 通过 SOC转换启动 数量. Others Invalid 选择.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4:0 SOC Priority；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第1931页；原文字段表：SOC Priority

Determines the cutoff point for priority mode and round robin 
arbitration for SOCx
00h SOC priority is handled in round robin mode for all channels.
01h SOC0 is high priority, rest of channels are in round robin mode.
02h SOC0-SOC1 are high priority, SOC2-SOC15 are in round robin 
mode.
03h SOC0-SOC2 are high priority, SOC3-SOC15 are in round robin 
mode.
04h SOC0-SOC3 are high priority, SOC4-SOC15 are in round robin 
mode.
05h SOC0-SOC4 are high priority, SOC5-SOC15 are in round robin 
mode.
06h SOC0-SOC5 are high priority, SOC6-SOC15 are in round robin 
mode.
07h SOC0-SOC6 are high priority, SOC7-SOC15 are in round robin 
mode.
08h SOC0-SOC7 are high priority, SOC8-SOC15 are in round robin 
mode.
09h SOC0-SOC8 are high priority, SOC9-SOC15 are in round robin 
mode.
0Ah SOC0-SOC9 are high priority, SOC10-SOC15 are in round robin 
mode.
0Bh SOC0-SOC10 are high priority, SOC11-SOC15 are in round 
robin mode.
0Ch SOC0-SOC11 are high priority, SOC12-SOC15 are in round 
robin mode.
0Dh SOC0-SOC12 are high priority, SOC13-SOC15 are in round 
robin mode.
0Eh SOC0-SOC13 are high priority, SOC14-SOC15 are in round 
robin mode.
0Fh SOC0-SOC14 are high priority, SOC15 is in round robin mode.
10h All SOCs are in high priority mode, arbitrated by SOC number.
Others Invalid selection.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RRPOINTER
Fields.Description: 中文释义待整理；原字段说明：Round Robin Pointer
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Round Robin Pointer. Holds 值 的 最后 converted round robin SOCx 至 be 使用 通过 round robin scheme 至 determine order 的 conversions. 00h SOC0 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC1 为 highest round robin 优先级. 01h SOC1 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC2 为 highest round robin 优先级. 02h SOC2 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC3 为 highest round robin 优先级. 03h SOC3 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC4 为 highest round robin 优先级. 04h SOC4 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC5 为 highest round robin 优先级. 05h SOC5 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC6 为 highest round robin 优先级. 06h SOC6 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC7 为 highest round robin 优先级. 07h SOC7 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC8 为 highest round robin 优先级. 08h SOC8 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC9 为 highest round robin 优先级. 09h SOC9 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC10 为 highest round robin 优先级. 0Ah SOC10 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC11 为 highest round robin 优先级. 0Bh SOC11 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC12 为 highest round robin 优先级. 0Ch SOC12 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC13 为 highest round robin 优先级. 0Dh SOC13 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC14 为 highest round robin 优先级. 0Eh SOC14 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC15 为 highest round robin 优先级. 0Fh SOC15 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC0 为 highest round robin 优先级. 10h 复位 值 至 indicate no SOC转换启动 has been converted. SOC0 为 highest round robin 优先级. 置位 至 此 值 当 ADC 模块 为 复位 通过 SOFTPRES 或 当 ADCSOCPRICTL 寄存器 为 written. 中 latter case, 如果 转换 为 currently 中 progress, it will complete 及 then new 优先级 will take effect. Others Invalid 值. 模数转换 Converter (ADC) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：9:5 Round Robin Pointer；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第1930页；原文字段表：Round Robin Pointer. Holds the value of the last converted round 

robin SOCx to be used by the round robin scheme to determine 
order of conversions.
00h SOC0 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC1 is highest 
round robin priority.
01h SOC1 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC2 is highest 
round robin priority.
02h SOC2 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC3 is highest 
round robin priority.
03h SOC3 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC4 is highest 
round robin priority.
04h SOC4 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC5 is highest 
round robin priority.
05h SOC5 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC6 is highest 
round robin priority.
06h SOC6 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC7 is highest 
round robin priority.
07h SOC7 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC8 is highest 
round robin priority.
08h SOC8 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC9 is highest 
round robin priority.
09h SOC9 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC10 is highest 
round robin priority.
0Ah SOC10 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC11 is highest 
round robin priority.
0Bh SOC11 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC12 is highest 
round robin priority.
0Ch SOC12 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC13 is highest 
round robin priority.
0Dh SOC13 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC14 is highest 
round robin priority.
0Eh SOC14 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC15 is highest 
round robin priority.
0Fh SOC15 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC0 is highest 
round robin priority.
10h Reset value to indicate no SOC has been converted. SOC0 is 
highest round robin priority. Set to this value when the ADC module 
is reset by SOFTPRES or when the ADCSOCPRICTL register is 
written. In the latter case, if a conversion is currently in progress, it 
will complete and then the new priority will take effect.
Others Invalid value.

Fields.Name: PPB2TRIPHI
Fields.Description: 后置 处理 模块 2 跳闸 高位 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：后置 处理 模块 2 跳闸 高位 标志. 当 置位 表示 数字 比较 跳闸 高 事件 has occurred. Note: these 位 are 置位 even 当 corresponding 使能 中 ADCEVTINTSEL 为 不 置位. Because 的 此, ISR may need 至 examine both ADCEVTSTAT 及 ADCEVTINTSEL 寄存器 至 determine 来源 的 中断. Note: 如果 软件 设置 清除 位 开启 same 周期 that 硬件 为 trying 至 置位 标志 位, then 硬件 has 优先级
Fields.Notes:
原文：4 Post Processing Block 2 Trip High Flag；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第1984页；原文字段表：Post Processing Block 2 Trip High Flag. When set indicates a digital 

compare trip high event has occurred.
Note: these bits are set even when the corresponding enable in 
ADCEVTINTSEL is not set. Because of this, an ISR may need to 
examine both the ADCEVTSTAT and ADCEVTINTSEL registers to 
determine the source of the interrupt.
Note: If software sets the clear bit on the same cycle that hardware is 
trying to set the flag bit, then hardware has priority；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：后置 处理 模块 1 跳闸 高位 事件 使能. 设置 此 位 allows corresponding 上升沿 跳闸 高 标志 至 activate 事件 信号 至 PWM blocks. 标志 must be cleared before it CAN produce 额外 events 至 PWM blocks.
Fields.Notes:
原文：0 Post Processing Block 1 Trip High Event Enable；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第1989页；原文字段表：Post Processing Block 1 Trip High Event Enable. Setting this bit 

allows the corresponding rising trip high flag to activate the event 
signal to the PWM blocks. The flag must be cleared before it can 
produce additional events to the PWM blocks.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: DETECTCFG
Fields.Description: ADC Opens 及 Shorts 检测 配置
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ADC Opens 及 Shorts 检测 配置. 此 位 field 定义 open/shorts 检测 circuit 状态. 0h Open/Shorts 检测 circuit 为 已禁用. 1h Open/Shorts 检测 circuit 为 已使能 在 零 scale. 2h Open/Shorts 检测 circuit 为 已使能 在 满 scale. 3h Open/Shorts 检测 circuit 为 已使能 在 (nominal) 5/12 scale. 4h Open/Shorts 检测 circuit 为 已使能 在 (nominal) 7/12 scale. 5h Open/Shorts 检测 circuit 为 已使能 带 (nominal) 5K pulldown 至 VSSA. 6h Open/Shorts 检测 circuit 为 已使能 带 (nominal) 5K pullup 至 VDDA. 7h Open/Shorts 检测 circuit 为 已使能 带 (nominal) 7K pulldown 至 VSSA. 模数转换 Converter (ADC) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：2:0 ADC Opens and Shorts Detect Configuration；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第1992页；原文字段表：ADC Opens and Shorts Detect Configuration. This bit field defines 

the open/shorts detection circuit state.
0h Open/Shorts detection circuit is disabled.
1h Open/Shorts detection circuit is enabled at zero scale.
2h Open/Shorts detection circuit is enabled at full scale.
3h Open/Shorts detection circuit is enabled at (nominal) 5/12 scale.
4h Open/Shorts detection circuit is enabled at (nominal) 7/12 scale.
5h Open/Shorts detection circuit is enabled with a (nominal) 5K 
pulldown to VSSA.
6h Open/Shorts detection circuit is enabled with a (nominal) 5K 
pullup to VDDA.
7h Open/Shorts detection circuit is enabled with a (nominal) 7K 
pulldown to VSSA.
Analog-to-Digital Converter (ADC)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ADC 后置 处理 模块 1 延迟 时间 戳. 当 SOC转换启动 starts 采样 值 contained 中 REQSTAMP 为 subtracted 来自 值 中 ADCCOUNTER.FREECOUNT 及 loaded 进入 此 位 field, thereby giving 数量 的 系统 时钟 cycles 延迟 between SOC转换启动 触发 及 actual 启动 的 采样. 模数转换 Converter (ADC) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：11:0 ADC Post Processing Block 1 Delay Time Stamp；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第1998页；原文字段表：ADC Post Processing Block 1 Delay Time Stamp. When an SOC 

starts sampling the value contained in REQSTAMP is subtracted 
from the value in ADCCOUNTER.FREECOUNT and loaded into this 
bit field, thereby giving the number of system clock cycles delay 
between the SOC trigger and the actual start of the sample.
Analog-to-Digital Converter (ADC)

Fields.Name: OFFCAL
Fields.Description: ADC 后置 处理 模块 偏移 Correction
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ADC 后置 处理 模块 1 偏移 Correction. 此 位 field CAN be 使用 至 digitally remove any 系统 电平 偏移 inherent 中 ADCIN circuit. 此 10-位 signed 值 为 subtracted 来自 ADC 输出 before being stored 中 ADCRESULT 寄存器. 000h No change. ADC 输出 为 stored directly 进入 ADCRESULT. 001h ADC 输出 - 1 为 stored 进入 ADCRESULT. 002h ADC 输出 - 2 为 stored 进入 ADCRESULT. ... 200h ADC 输出 + 512 为 stored 进入 ADCRESULT. ... 3FFh ADC 输出 + 1 为 stored 进入 ADCRESULT. NOTE: 中 16-位 模式, subtraction will 饱和 在 0000h 及 FFFFh before being stored 进入 ADCRESULT 寄存器. 中 12-位 模式, subtraction will 饱和 在 0000h 及 0FFFh before being stored 进入 ADCRESULT 寄存器. Note: 中 case that multiple PPBs point 至 same SOC转换启动, 仅 OFFCAL 的 highest numbered PPB will be applied.
Fields.Notes:
原文：9:0 ADC Post Processing Block Offset Correction；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第1999页；原文字段表：ADC Post Processing Block 1 Offset Correction. This bit field can 

be used to digitally remove any system level offset inherent in the 
ADCIN circuit. This 10-bit signed value is subtracted from the ADC 
output before being stored in the ADCRESULT register.
000h No change. The ADC output is stored directly into 
ADCRESULT.
001h ADC output - 1 is stored into ADCRESULT.
002h ADC output - 2 is stored into ADCRESULT.
...
200h ADC output + 512 is stored into ADCRESULT.
...
3FFh ADC output + 1 is stored into ADCRESULT.
NOTE: In 16-bit mode, the subtraction will saturate at 0000h and 
FFFFh before being stored into the ADCRESULT register. In 12-bit 
mode, the subtraction will saturate at 0000h and 0FFFh before being 
stored into the ADCRESULT register.
Note: in the case that multiple PPBs point to the same SOC, only the 
OFFCAL of the highest numbered PPB will be applied.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: PPBRESULT
Fields.Description: ADC 后置 处理 模块 结果
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ADC 后置 处理 模块 结果 1 结果 的 offset/reference subtraction 后置 转换 处理 为 stored 中 此 寄存器. 此 结果 为 available 1 SYSCLK 周期 after associated ADCRESULT 为 available. 如果 ADCINTFLG 为 polled 至 determine 当 至 读取 PPBRESULT, it may be necessary 至 add NOP instruction 至 ensure that updated 后置 转换 处理 结果 has posted 至 寄存器. NOTE: 如果 转换 associated 带 此 后置 处理 模块 为 12-位 转换, PPBRESULT 位 are limited 至 位 12:0.
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:0 ADC Post Processing Block Result；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第1909页；原文字段表：ADC Post Processing Block Result 1

The result of the offset/reference subtraction post conversion 
processing is stored in this register.
This result is available 1 SYSCLK cycle after the associated 
ADCRESULT is available. If ADCINTFLG is polled to determine 
when to read the PPBRESULT, it may be necessary to add a NOP 
instruction to ensure that the updated post conversion processing 
result has posted to the register.
NOTE: If the conversion associated with this Post Processing Block 
is a 12-bit conversion, the PPBRESULT bits are limited to bits 12:0.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：符号 扩展 位. These 位 reflect same 值 作为 位 16. NOTE: 如果 转换 associated 带 此 后置 处理 模块 为 12-位 转换, 符号 位 extend 下降 至 位 12, 及 全部 reflect same 值 作为 位 12.
Fields.Notes:
原文：31:16 Sign Extended Bits；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第1909页；原文字段表：Sign Extended Bits. These bits reflect the same value as bit 16.

NOTE: If the conversion associated with this Post Processing Block 
is a 12-bit conversion, the SIGN bits extend down to bit 12, and all 
reflect the same value as bit 12.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ADC 后置 处理 模块 结果 4 结果 的 offset/reference subtraction 后置 转换 处理 为 stored 中 此 寄存器. 此 结果 为 available 1 SYSCLK 周期 after associated ADCRESULT 为 available. 如果 ADCINTFLG 为 polled 至 determine 当 至 读取 PPBRESULT, it may be necessary 至 add NOP instruction 至 ensure that updated 后置 转换 处理 结果 has posted 至 寄存器. NOTE: 如果 转换 associated 带 此 后置 处理 模块 为 12-位 转换, PPBRESULT 位 are limited 至 位 12:0. 模数转换 Converter (ADC) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:0 ADC Post Processing Block Result；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第1912页；原文字段表：ADC Post Processing Block Result 4

The result of the offset/reference subtraction post conversion 
processing is stored in this register.
This result is available 1 SYSCLK cycle after the associated 
ADCRESULT is available. If ADCINTFLG is polled to determine 
when to read the PPBRESULT, it may be necessary to add a NOP 
instruction to ensure that the updated post conversion processing 
result has posted to the register.
NOTE: If the conversion associated with this Post Processing Block 
is a 12-bit conversion, the PPBRESULT bits are limited to bits 12:0.
Analog-to-Digital Converter (ADC)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

processing is stored in this register.

Fields.Name: INT0ID
Fields.Description: 中断 标识符
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：中断 0 Cause 0x0000 - No 中断 为 待处理. 0x0001 - 0x0020 - 数量 的 报文 对象 which caused 中断. 0x0021 - 0x7FFF - Unused. 0x8000 - 错误与状态 寄存器 值 为 不 0x07. 0x8001 - 0xFFFF - Unused. 如果 several 中断 are 待处理, CAN 中断 寄存器 will point 至 待处理 中断 带 highest 优先级. Note: CANINT0 中断 线路 remains 活动 until INT0ID reaches 值 0 ( cause 的 中断 为 复位) 或 until IE0 为 cleared. 状态 中断 has highest 优先级. Among 报文 中断, 报文 对象's 中断 优先级 decreases 带 increasing 报文 数量. Controller Area Network (CAN) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:0 Interrupt Identifier；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2866页；原文字段表：Interrupt 0 Cause

0x0000 - No interrupt is pending.
0x0001 - 0x0020 - Number of message object which caused the 
interrupt.
0x0021 - 0x7FFF - Unused.
0x8000 - Error and Status Register value is not 0x07.
0x8001 - 0xFFFF - Unused.
If several interrupts are pending, the CAN Interrupt Register will point 
to the pending interrupt with the highest priority.
Note: The CANINT0 interrupt line remains active until INT0ID 
reaches value 0 (the cause of the interrupt is reset) or until IE0 
is cleared. The Status Interrupt has the highest priority. Among the 
message interrupts, the message object's interrupt priority decreases 
with increasing message number.
Controller Area Network (CAN)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INT1ID
Fields.Description: 中断 1 标识符
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：中断 1 Cause 0x00 No 中断 为 待处理. 0x01-0x20 数量 的 报文 对象 (邮箱) which caused 中断. 0x21-0xFF Unused. 如果 several 中断 are 待处理, CAN 中断 寄存器 will point 至 待处理 中断 带 highest 优先级. Note: CANINT1 中断 线路 remains 活动 until INT1ID reaches 值 0 ( cause 的 中断 为 复位) 或 until IE0 为 cleared. 报文 中断 为 cleared 通过 clearing 邮箱's IntPnd 位. Among 报文 中断, 邮箱's 中断 优先级 decreases 带 increasing 报文 数量.
Fields.Notes:
原文：23:16 Interrupt 1 Identifier；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2866页；原文字段表：Interrupt 1 Cause

0x00 No interrupt is pending.
0x01-0x20 Number of message object (mailbox) which caused the 
interrupt.
0x21-0xFF Unused.
If several interrupts are pending, the CAN Interrupt Register will point 
to the pending interrupt with the highest priority.
Note: The CANINT1 interrupt line remains active until INT1ID 
reaches value 0 (the cause of the interrupt is reset) or until IE0 is 
cleared. A message interrupt is cleared by clearing the mailbox's 
IntPnd bit. Among the message interrupts, the mailbox's interrupt 
priority decreases with increasing message number.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TXRQST
Fields.Description: 访问 发送 请求 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：访问 发送 请求 (TxRqst) / New 数据 (NewDat) 位 0 (方向 = 读取): NewDat 位 will 不 be changed. 0 (方向 = 写入): TxRqst/NewDat 位 will be handled according 至 控制 位. 1 (方向 = 读取): Clears NewDat 位 中 报文 对象. 1 (方向 = 写入): 设置 TxRqst/NewDat 中 报文 对象. Note: 如果 CAN 发送 为 requested 通过 设置 TxRqst/NewDat 中 此 寄存器, TxRqst/NewDat 位 中 报文 对象 will be 置位 至 单次 independent 的 values 中 IF1/IF2 报文 控制 寄存器. Note: 读取 访问 至 报文 对象 CAN be combined 带 复位 的 控制 位 IntPnd 及 NewDat. values 的 these 位 transferred 至 IF1/IF2 报文 控制 寄存器 always reflect 状态 before 复位 them. Note: 此 位 为 写入 受保护 通过 忙碌 位.
Fields.Notes:
原文：18 Access Transmission Request Bit；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2885页；原文字段表：Access Transmission Request (TxRqst) / New Data (NewDat) Bit

0 (Direction = Read): NewDat bit will not be changed.
0 (Direction = Write): TxRqst/NewDat bit will be handled according to 
the Control bit.
1 (Direction = Read): Clears NewDat bit in the message object.
1 (Direction = Write): Sets TxRqst/NewDat in message object.
Note: If a CAN transmission is requested by setting TxRqst/NewDat 
in this register, the TxRqst/NewDat bits in the message object will 
be set to one independent of the values in IF1/IF2 Message Control 
Register.
Note: A read access to a message object can be combined with the 
reset of the control bits IntPnd and NewDat. The values of these bits 
transferred to the IF1/IF2 Message Control Register always reflect 
the status before resetting them.
Note: This bit is write protected by Busy bit.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TxRqst
Fields.Description: 访问 发送 请求 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：访问 发送 请求 (TxRqst) / New 数据 (NewDat) 位 0 (方向 = 读取): NewDat 位 will 不 be changed. 0 (方向 = 写入): TxRqst/NewDat 位 will be handled according 至 控制 位. 1 (方向 = 读取): Clears NewDat 位 中 报文 对象. 1 (方向 = 写入): 设置 TxRqst/NewDat 中 报文 对象. Note: 如果 CAN 发送 为 requested 通过 设置 TxRqst/NewDat 中 此 寄存器, TxRqst/NewDat 位 中 报文 对象 will be 置位 至 单次 independent 的 values 中 IF1/IF2 报文 控制 寄存器. Note: 读取 访问 至 报文 对象 CAN be combined 带 复位 的 控制 位 IntPnd 及 NewDat. values 的 these 位 transferred 至 IF1/IF2 报文 控制 寄存器 always reflect 状态 before 复位 them. Note: 此 位 为 写入 受保护 通过 忙碌 位.
Fields.Notes:
原文：18 Access Transmission Request Bit；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2895页；原文字段表：Access Transmission Request (TxRqst) / New Data (NewDat) Bit

0 (Direction = Read): NewDat bit will not be changed.
0 (Direction = Write): TxRqst/NewDat bit will be handled according to 
the Control bit.
1 (Direction = Read): Clears NewDat bit in the message object.
1 (Direction = Write): Sets TxRqst/NewDat in message object.
Note: If a CAN transmission is requested by setting TxRqst/NewDat 
in this register, the TxRqst/NewDat bits in the message object will 
be set to one independent of the values in IF1/IF2 Message Control 
Register.
Note: A read access to a message object can be combined with the 
reset of the control bits IntPnd and NewDat. The values of these bits 
transferred to the IF1/IF2 Message Control Register always reflect 
the status before resetting them.
Note: This bit is write protected by Busy bit.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OSCCLKSRCSEL
Fields.Description: OSCCLK 源 选择 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：振荡器 时钟 源 选择 位: 此 位 选择 来源 用于 OSCCLK. 00 = INTOSC2 (默认 开启 复位) 01 = 外部 振荡器 (XTAL) 10 = INTOSC1 11 = 保留位 (默认 至 INTOSC1) 在 power-up 或 after XRSn, INTOSC2 为 已选 通过 默认. Whenever user changes 时钟 来源 using these 位, SYSPLLMULT[13:0] 寄存器 will be forced 至 零 及 PLL will be bypassed 及 powered 下降. 此 prevents potential PLL overshoot. user will then have 至 写入 至 SYSPLLMULT 寄存器 至 configure appropriate 倍频器. user must wait 10 OSCCLK cycles before writing 至 SYSPLLMULT 或 disabling 前次 时钟 来源 至 allow change 至 complete.. Notes: [1] INTOSC1 为 recommended 至 be 使用 仅 after 丢失 时钟 检测. 如果 user wants 至 re-lock PLL 带 INTOSC1 ( back-up 时钟 来源) after 丢失 时钟 为 已检测, he CAN 执行 MCLKCLR 及 锁定 PLL. 系统 控制 及 中断 www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0 OSCCLK Source Select Bit；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第190页；原文字段表：Oscillator Clock Source Select Bit: This bit selects the source for 

OSCCLK.
00 = INTOSC2 (default on reset)
01 = External Oscillator (XTAL)
10 = INTOSC1
11 = reserved (default to INTOSC1)
At power-up or after an XRSn, INTOSC2 is selected by default. 
Whenever the user changes the clock source using these bits, the 
SYSPLLMULT[13:0] register will be forced to zero and the PLL 
will be bypassed and powered down. This prevents potential PLL 
overshoot. The user will then have to write to the SYSPLLMULT 
register to configure the appropriate multiplier.
The user must wait 10 OSCCLK cycles before writing to 
SYSPLLMULT or disabling the previous clock source to allow the 
change to
complete..
Notes:
[1] INTOSC1 is recommended to be used only after missing clock 
detection. If user wants to re-lock the PLL with INTOSC1 (the 
back-up clock source) after missing clock is detected, he can do a 
MCLKCLR and lock the PLL.
System Control and Interrupts

Fields.Name: TDDR
Fields.Description: CPU定时器 分频.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：CPU定时器 分频. Every (TDDRH:TDDR + 1) 定时器 时钟 来源 cycles, 定时器 计数器 寄存器 (TIMH:TIM) decrements 通过 单次. 在 复位, TDDRH:TDDR 位 are cleared 至 0. 至 increase overall 定时器 计数 通过 整数 factor, 写入 此 factor minus 单次 至 TDDRH:TDDR 位. 当 预分频器 计数器 (PSCH:PSC) 值 为 0, 单次 定时器 时钟 来源 周期 later, 内容 的 TDDRH:TDDR 重装载 PSCH:PSC, 及 TIMH:TIM decrements 通过 单次. TDDRH:TDDR also reloads PSCH:PSC whenever 定时器 重装载 位 (TRB) 为 置位 通过 软件.
Fields.Notes:
原文：7:0 CPU-Timer Divide-Down.；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第259页；原文字段表：CPU-Timer Divide-Down.

Every (TDDRH:TDDR + 1) timer clock source cycles, the timer 
counter register (TIMH:TIM) decrements by one. At reset, the 
TDDRH:TDDR bits are cleared to 0. To increase the overall timer
count by an integer factor, write this factor minus one to the 
TDDRH:TDDR bits. When the prescaler counter (PSCH:PSC) 
value is 0, one timer clock source cycle later, the contents 
of the TDDRH:TDDR reload the PSCH:PSC, and the TIMH:TIM 
decrements by one. TDDRH:TDDR also reloads the PSCH:PSC 
whenever the timer reload bit (TRB) is set by software.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: PSC
Fields.Description: CPU定时器 预分频 计数器.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：CPU定时器 预分频 计数器. These 位 保持 当前 预分频 计数 用于 定时器. 用于 every 定时器 时钟 来源 周期 that PSCH:PSC 值 为 greater than 0, PSCH:PSC decrements 通过 单次. 单次 定时器 时钟 (输出 的 定时器 预分频器) 周期 after PSCH:PSC reaches 0, PSCH:PSC 为 loaded 带 内容 的 TDDRH:TDDR, 及 定时器 计数器 寄存器 (TIMH:TIM) decrements 通过 单次. PSCH:PSC 为 also reloaded whenever 定时器 重装载 位 (TRB) 为 置位 通过 软件. PSCH:PSC CAN be checked 通过 reading 寄存器, but it cannot be 置位 directly. It must get its 值 来自 定时器 分频 寄存器 (TDDRH:TDDR). 在 复位, PSCH:PSC 为 置位 至 0.
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:8 CPU-Timer Prescale Counter.；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第259页；原文字段表：CPU-Timer Prescale Counter.

These bits hold the current prescale count for the timer. For every 
timer clock source cycle that the PSCH:PSC value is greater than 
0, the PSCH:PSC decrements by one. One timer clock (output 
of the timer prescaler) cycle after the PSCH:PSC reaches 0, the 
PSCH:PSC is loaded with the contents of the TDDRH:TDDR, and 
the timer counter register (TIMH:TIM) decrements by one. The 
PSCH:PSC is also reloaded whenever the timer reload bit (TRB) 
is set by software. The PSCH:PSC can be checked by reading the 
register, but it cannot be set directly. It must get its value from the 
timer divide-down register
(TDDRH:TDDR). At reset, the PSCH:PSC is set to 0.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TDDR
Fields.Description: CPU定时器 分频.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：CPU定时器 分频. Every (TDDRH:TDDR + 1) 定时器 时钟 来源 cycles, 定时器 计数器 寄存器 (TIMH:TIM) decrements 通过 单次. 在 复位, TDDRH:TDDR 位 are cleared 至 0. 至 increase overall 定时器 计数 通过 整数 factor, 写入 此 factor minus 单次 至 TDDRH:TDDR 位. 当 预分频器 计数器 (PSCH:PSC) 值 为 0, 单次 定时器 时钟 来源 周期 later, 内容 的 TDDRH:TDDR 重装载 PSCH:PSC, 及 TIMH:TIM decrements 通过 单次. TDDRH:TDDR also reloads PSCH:PSC whenever 定时器 重装载 位 (TRB) 为 置位 通过 软件.
Fields.Notes:
原文：7:0 CPU-Timer Divide-Down.；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第259页；原文字段表：CPU-Timer Divide-Down.

Every (TDDRH:TDDR + 1) timer clock source cycles, the timer 
counter register (TIMH:TIM) decrements by one. At reset, the 
TDDRH:TDDR bits are cleared to 0. To increase the overall timer
count by an integer factor, write this factor minus one to the 
TDDRH:TDDR bits. When the prescaler counter (PSCH:PSC) 
value is 0, one timer clock source cycle later, the contents 
of the TDDRH:TDDR reload the PSCH:PSC, and the TIMH:TIM 
decrements by one. TDDRH:TDDR also reloads the PSCH:PSC 
whenever the timer reload bit (TRB) is set by software.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: PSC
Fields.Description: CPU定时器 预分频 计数器.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：CPU定时器 预分频 计数器. These 位 保持 当前 预分频 计数 用于 定时器. 用于 every 定时器 时钟 来源 周期 that PSCH:PSC 值 为 greater than 0, PSCH:PSC decrements 通过 单次. 单次 定时器 时钟 (输出 的 定时器 预分频器) 周期 after PSCH:PSC reaches 0, PSCH:PSC 为 loaded 带 内容 的 TDDRH:TDDR, 及 定时器 计数器 寄存器 (TIMH:TIM) decrements 通过 单次. PSCH:PSC 为 also reloaded whenever 定时器 重装载 位 (TRB) 为 置位 通过 软件. PSCH:PSC CAN be checked 通过 reading 寄存器, but it cannot be 置位 directly. It must get its 值 来自 定时器 分频 寄存器 (TDDRH:TDDR). 在 复位, PSCH:PSC 为 置位 至 0.
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:8 CPU-Timer Prescale Counter.；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第259页；原文字段表：CPU-Timer Prescale Counter.

These bits hold the current prescale count for the timer. For every 
timer clock source cycle that the PSCH:PSC value is greater than 
0, the PSCH:PSC decrements by one. One timer clock (output 
of the timer prescaler) cycle after the PSCH:PSC reaches 0, the 
PSCH:PSC is loaded with the contents of the TDDRH:TDDR, and 
the timer counter register (TIMH:TIM) decrements by one. The 
PSCH:PSC is also reloaded whenever the timer reload bit (TRB) 
is set by software. The PSCH:PSC can be checked by reading the 
register, but it cannot be set directly. It must get its value from the 
timer divide-down register
(TDDRH:TDDR). At reset, the PSCH:PSC is set to 0.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。
