Fields.Name: TBPHSHRLOADE
Fields.Description: TBPHSHR 加载 使能
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：TBPHSHR 加载 使能 此 位 allows you 至 synchronize ePWM modules 带 高- 分辨率 相位 开启 同步输入, TBCTL[SWFSYNC] 或 数字 比较 事件. 此 allows 用于 multiple ePWM modules 工作 在 same 频率 至 be 相位 aligned 带 high-resolution. 0: 禁用 同步 的 high-resolution 相位 开启 同步输入, TBCTL[SWFSYNC] 或 数字 比较 事件: 1: Synchronize high-resolution 相位 开启 同步输入, TBCTL[SWFSYNC] 或 数字 比较器 同步 事件. 相位 为 synchronized using 内容 的 high-resolution 相位 TBPHSHR 寄存器. TBCTL[PHSEN] 位 which 使能 loading 的 TBCTR 寄存器 带 TBPHS 寄存器 值 开启 同步输入 或 TBCTL[SWFSYNC] 事件 works independently. However, users need 至 使能 此 位 also 如果 they want 至 控制 相位 中 conjunction 带 high-resolution 周期 feature. 此 位 及 TBCTL[PHSEN] 位 must be 置位 至 1 当 high-resolution 周期 为 已使能 用于 up-down 计数 模式 even 如果 TBPHSHR = 0x0000. 此 位 does 不 need 至 be 置位 当 仅 high-resolution 占空 为 已使能.
Fields.Notes:
原文：2 TBPHSHR Load Enable；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2379页；原文字段表：TBPHSHR Load Enable

This bit allows you to synchronize ePWM modules with a high-
resolution phase on a SYNCIN, TBCTL[SWFSYNC] or digital 
compare event. This allows for multiple ePWM modules operating 
at the same frequency to be phase aligned with high-resolution.
0: Disables synchronization of high-resolution phase on a SYNCIN, 
TBCTL[SWFSYNC] or digital compare event:
1: Synchronize the high-resolution phase on a SYNCIN, 
TBCTL[SWFSYNC] or digital comparator synchronization event. The 
phase is synchronized using the contents of the high-resolution 
phase TBPHSHR register. The TBCTL[PHSEN] bit which enables 
the loading of the TBCTR register with TBPHS register value 
on a SYNCIN or TBCTL[SWFSYNC] event works independently. 
However, users need to enable this bit also if they want to control 
phase in conjunction with the high-resolution period feature.
This bit and the TBCTL[PHSEN] bit must be set to 1 when 
high-resolution period is enabled for up-down count mode even if 
TBPHSHR = 0x0000. This bit does not need to be set when only 
high-resolution duty is enabled.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TRREM
Fields.Description: HRPWM 余数 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：HRPWM 余数 位: 此 11-位 值 keeps track 的 余数 portion 的 HRPWM algorithm calculations. 此 值 keeps track 的 余数 portion 的 HRPWM 硬件 calculations. Notes: 1. 低位 8-位 的 TRREM 寄存器 CAN be automatically initialized 带 TBPHSHR 值 开启 同步输入 或 TBCTL[SWFSYNC] 事件 或 DC 事件 (如果 已使能). user CAN also 写入 值 带 CPU. 2. 优先级 的 TRREM 寄存器 updates: 同步 (软件 或 硬件) TBPHSHR copied 至 TRREM : Highest 优先级 HRPWM 硬件 (updates TRREM 寄存器): 下次 优先级 CPU 写入 至 TRREM 寄存器: Lowest 优先级 3. 位 10 的 TRREM 寄存器 为 不 使用 中 asymmetrical 模式. 此 位 CAN be forced 至 零. TRREM will be initialized 至 0x0 及 0x100 中 上升 及 Up-down modes respectively. Asymmetrical 模式: TRREM[7:0] = TBPHSHR[15:8] TRREM[10,9,8] = 0,0,0 Symmetrical 模式: TRREM[7:0] = TBPHSHR[15:8] TRREM[10,9,8] = 0,0,1
Fields.Notes:
原文：10:0 HRPWM Remainder Bits；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2381页；原文字段表：HRPWM Remainder Bits: This 11-bit value keeps track of the 

remainder portion of the HRPWM algorithm calculations.
This value keeps track of the remainder portion of the HRPWM 
hardware calculations.
Notes:
1. The lower 8-bits of the TRREM register can be automatically 
initialized with the TBPHSHR value on a SYNCIN or 
TBCTL[SWFSYNC] event or DC event (if enabled). The user can 
also write a value with the CPU.
2. Priority of TRREM register updates:
Sync (software or hardware) TBPHSHR copied to TRREM : Highest 
Priority
HRPWM Hardware (updates TRREM register): Next priority
CPU Write To TRREM Register: Lowest Priority
3. Bit 10 of TRREM register is not used in asymmetrical mode. This 
bit can be forced to zero.
TRREM will be initialized to 0x0 and 0x100 in Up and Up-down 
modes respectively.
Asymmetrical Mode:
TRREM[7:0] = TBPHSHR[15:8]
TRREM[10,9,8] = 0,0,0
Symmetrical Mode:
TRREM[7:0] = TBPHSHR[15:8]
TRREM[10,9,8] = 0,0,1；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Notes:
原文：31:16 Phase Offset Register；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2400页；原文字段表：Phase Offset Register

These bits set time-base counter phase of the selected ePWM 
relative to the time-base that is supplying the synchronization input 
signal.
- If TBCTL[PHSEN] = 0, then the synchronization event is ignored 
and the time-base counter is not loaded with the phase.
- If TBCTL[PHSEN] = 1, then the time-base counter (TBCTR) will 
be loaded with the phase (TBPHS) when a synchronization event 
occurs. The synchronization event can be initiated by the input 
synchronization signal (EPWMxSYNCI) or by a software forced 
synchronization.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TBPRD
Fields.Description: 时基周期计数值。
Fields.Values: 向上/向下计数：频率=TBCLK/(TBPRD+1)；上下计数：频率=TBCLK/(2×TBPRD)。
Fields.Notes:
原文：Time Base Period Register；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2402页；原文字段表：Time Base Period Register

These bits determine the period of the time-base counter. This 
sets the PWM frequency. Shadowing of this register is enabled 
and disabled by the TBCTL[PRDLD] bit. By default this register is 
shadowed.
- If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write 
or read will automatically go to the shadow register. In this case, 
the active register will be loaded from the shadow register when the 
time-base counter equals zero.
- If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 1, then the shadow is disabled and any write or 
read will go directly to the active register, that is the register actively 
controlling the hardware.
- The active and shadow registers share the same memory map 
address.

Fields.Notes:

The UPPER 8-bits contain the high-resolution portion (most 
significant 8-bits) of the counter-compare A value. CMPA:CMPAHR 
can be accessed in a single 32-bit read/write. Shadowing is enabled 
and disabled by the CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] bit as described for 
the CMPA register.
The lower 8 bits in this register are ignored；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CMPA
Fields.Description: 比较 寄存器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：比较 寄存器 值 中 活动 CMPA 寄存器 为 continuously compared 至 时基 计数器 (TBCTR). 当 values are equal, counter-compare 模块 产生 '时基 计数器 equal 至 计数器 比较 ' 事件. 此 事件 为 sent 至 action-qualifier where it 为 限定后 及 converted it 进入 单次 或 more actions. These actions CAN be applied 至 either EPWMxA 或 EPWMxB 输出 depending 开启 配置 的 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器. actions that CAN be defined 中 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器 include: - 执行 nothing 事件 为 忽略. - 清除: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 低 - 置位: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 高 - 翻转 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 Shadowing 的 此 寄存器 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. - 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能 及 any 写入 或 读取 will automatically go 至 影子 寄存器. 中 此 case, CMPCTL[LOADAMODE] 位 field 决定 which 事件 will 加载 活动 寄存器 来自 影子 寄存器. - Before 写入, CMPCTL[SHDWAFULL] 位 CAN be 读取 至 determine 如果 影子 寄存器 为 currently 满. - 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用 及 any 写入 或 读取 will go directly 至 活动 寄存器, that 为 寄存器 actively controlling 硬件. - 中 either 模式, 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：31:16 Compare A Register；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2403页；原文字段表：Compare A Register

The value in the active CMPA register is continuously compared to 
the time-base counter (TBCTR). When the values are equal, the 
counter-compare module generates a 'time-base counter equal to 
counter compare A' event. This event is sent to the action-qualifier 
where it is qualified and converted it into one or more actions. 
These actions can be applied to either the EPWMxA or the EPWMxB 
output depending on the configuration of the AQCTLA and AQCTLB 
registers. The actions that can be defined in the AQCTLA and 
AQCTLB registers include:
- Do nothing
the event is ignored.
- Clear: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal low
- Set: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal high
- Toggle the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the 
CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] bit. By default this register is shadowed.
- If CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and 
any write or read will automatically go to the shadow register. In this 
case, the CMPCTL[LOADAMODE] bit field determines which event 
will load the active register from the shadow register.
- Before a write, the CMPCTL[SHDWAFULL] bit can be read to 
determine if the shadow register is currently full.
- If CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is 
disabled and any write or read will go directly to the active register, 
that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
- In either mode, the active and shadow registers share the same 
memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OSHTLD
Fields.Description: 使能 重装载 事件 中 单次 触发 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：R-0/W1S 0h 使能 重装载 事件 中 单次 触发 模式 0: Writing 的 0 will be 忽略. Always reads back 0. 1: Turns 单次 触发 锁存 条件 开启. Upon occurrence 的 chosen 加载 选通, 单次 影子 至 活动 重装载 发生 及 锁存 will be cleared. Hence writing 1 至 此 位 would allow 单次 加载 选通 事件 至 pass through 及 模块 further 选通 events.
Fields.Notes:
原文：0 Enable reload event in one shot mode；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2407页；原文字段表：R-0/W1S 0h Enable Reload Event in One Shot Mode

0: Writing of 0 will be ignored. Always reads back a 0.
1: Turns the one shot latch condition ON. Upon occurrence of a 
chosen load strobe, one shadow to active reload occurs and the 
latch will be cleared. Hence writing 1 to this bit would allow one load 
strobe event to pass through and block further strobe events.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Description: TZ1 至 TZ6 跳闸 动作 开启 EPWMxA
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：TZ1 至 TZ6, DCAEVT1/2, DCBEVT1/2 跳闸 动作 开启 EPWMxA 当 跳闸 事件 发生 following 动作 为 taken 开启 输出 EPWMxA. Which 跳闸保护 引脚 CAN cause 事件 为 defined 中 TZSEL 寄存器. 00: High-impedance (EPWMxA = High-impedance 状态) 01: 强制 EPWMxA 至 高 状态 10: 强制 EPWMxA 至 低 状态 11: 执行 nothing, no 动作 为 taken 开启 EPWMxA.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0 TZ1 to TZ6 Trip Action On EPWMxA；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2413页；原文字段表：TZ1 to TZ6, DCAEVT1/2, DCBEVT1/2 Trip Action On EPWMxA

When a trip event occurs the following action is taken on output 
EPWMxA. Which trip-zone pins can cause an event is defined in the 
TZSEL register.
00: High-impedance (EPWMxA = High-impedance state)
01: Force EPWMxA to a high state
10: Force EPWMxA to a low state
11: Do nothing, no action is taken on EPWMxA.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INT
Fields.Description: 全局 中断 状态 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：锁存 跳闸 中断 状态 标志 0: 表示 no 中断 has been 已产生. 1: 表示 ePWMx_TZINT PIE 中断 was 已产生 because 的 跳闸 条件. No further ePWMx_TZINT PIE 中断 will be 已产生 until 此 标志 为 cleared. 如果 中断 标志 为 cleared 当 either CBC 或 OST 为 置位, then another 中断 脉冲 will be 已产生. Clearing 全部 标志 位 will prevent further 中断. 此 位 为 cleared 通过 writing appropriate 值 至 TZCLR 寄存器. Enhanced 脉冲 宽度 Modulator (ePWM) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：0 Global Int Status Flag；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2422页；原文字段表：Latched Trip Interrupt Status Flag

0: Indicates no interrupt has been generated.
1: Indicates an EPWMx_TZINT PIE interrupt was generated because 
of a trip condition.
No further EPWMx_TZINT PIE interrupts will be generated until this 
flag is cleared. If the interrupt flag is cleared when either CBC or 
OST is set, then another interrupt pulse will be generated. Clearing 
all flag bits will prevent further interrupts. This bit is cleared by writing 
the appropriate value to the TZCLR register.
Enhanced Pulse Width Modulator (ePWM)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CBC
Fields.Description: 跳闸 区域 周期 通过 周期 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：锁存 状态 标志 用于 逐周期 跳闸 事件 0: No 逐周期 跳闸 事件 has occurred. 1: 表示 跳闸 事件 has occurred 开启 信号 已选 作为 逐周期 跳闸 来源. TZFLG[CBC] 位 will remain 置位 until it 为 manually cleared 通过 user. 如果 逐周期 跳闸 事件 为 still present 当 CBC 位 为 cleared, then CBC will be immediately 置位 again. specified 条件 开启 信号 为 automatically cleared 当 ePWM 时基 计数器 reaches 零 (TBCTR = 0x00) 如果 跳闸 条件 为 no longer present. 条件 开启 信号 为 仅 cleared 当 TBCTR = 0x00 no matter where 中 周期 CBC 标志 为 cleared. 此 位 为 cleared 通过 writing appropriate 值 至 TZCLR 寄存器.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1 Trip Zones Cycle By Cycle Flag；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2422页；原文字段表：Latched Status Flag for Cycle-By-Cycle Trip Event

0: No cycle-by-cycle trip event has occurred.
1: Indicates a trip event has occurred on a signal selected as a 
cycle-by-cycle trip source. The
TZFLG[CBC] bit will remain set until it is manually cleared by the 
user. If the cycle-by-cycle trip event is still present when the CBC 
bit is cleared, then CBC will be immediately set again. The specified 
condition on the signal is automatically cleared when the ePWM 
time-base counter reaches zero (TBCTR = 0x00) if the trip condition 
is no longer present. The condition on the signal is only cleared 
when the TBCTR = 0x00 no matter where in the cycle the CBC flag 
is cleared.
This bit is cleared by writing the appropriate value to the TZCLR 
register.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INTPRD
Fields.Description: EPWMxINTn 周期 选择
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ePWM 中断 (ePWMx_中断) 周期 选择 These 位 determine how many 已选 ETSEL[INTSEL] events need 至 occur before 中断 为 已产生. 至 be 已产生, 中断 must be 已使能 (ETSEL[中断] = 1). 如果 中断 状态 标志 为 置位 来自 前次 中断 (ETFLG[中断] = 1) then no 中断 will be 已产生 until 标志 为 cleared via ETCLR[中断] 位. 此 allows 用于 单次 中断 至 be 待处理 期间 another 为 still being serviced. Once 中断 为 已产生, ETPS[INTCNT] 位 will automatically be cleared. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 same 作为 当前 计数器 值 will 触发 中断 如果 it 为 已使能 及 状态 标志 为 清除. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 less than 当前 计数器 值 will 结果 中 undefined 状态. 如果 计数器 事件 发生 在 same instant 作为 new 零 或 non-zero INTPRD 值 为 written, 计数器 为 incremented. 00: 禁用 中断 事件 计数器. No 中断 will be 已产生 及 ETFRC[中断] 为 忽略. 01: 产生 中断 开启 首个 事件 INTCNT = 01 (首个 事件) 10: 产生 中断 开启 ETPS[INTCNT] = 1,0 (second 事件) 11: 产生 中断 开启 ETPS[INTCNT] = 1,1 (third 事件)
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0 EPWMxINTn Period Select；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2437页；原文字段表：ePWM Interrupt (EPWMx_INT) Period Select

These bits determine how many selected ETSEL[INTSEL] events 
need to occur before an interrupt is generated. To be generated, 
the interrupt must be enabled (ETSEL[INT] = 1). If the interrupt 
status flag is set from a previous interrupt (ETFLG[INT] = 1) then 
no interrupt will be generated until the flag is cleared via the 
ETCLR[INT] bit. This allows for one interrupt to be pending while 
another is still being serviced. Once the interrupt is generated, the 
ETPS[INTCNT] bits will automatically be cleared.
Writing a INTPRD value that is the same as the current counter value 
will trigger an interrupt if it is enabled and the status flag is clear.
Writing a INTPRD value that is less than the current counter value 
will result in an undefined state. If a counter event occurs at the 
same instant as a new zero or non-zero INTPRD value is written, the 
counter is incremented.
00: Disable the interrupt event counter. No interrupt will be generated 
and ETFRC[INT] is ignored.
01: Generate an interrupt on the first event INTCNT = 01 (first event)
10: Generate interrupt on ETPS[INTCNT] = 1,0 (second event)
11: Generate interrupt on ETPS[INTCNT] = 1,1 (third event)；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Notes:
原文：3:2 EPWMxINTn Counter Register；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2436页；原文字段表：ePWM Interrupt Event (EPWMx_INT) Counter Register

These bits indicate how many selected ETSEL[INTSEL] events have 
occurred. These bits are automatically cleared when an interrupt 
pulse is generated. If interrupts are disabled, ETSEL[INT] = 0 or 
the interrupt flag is set, ETFLG[INT] = 1, the counter will stop 
counting events when it reaches the period value ETPS[INTCNT] 
= ETPS[INTPRD].
00: No events have occurred.
01: 1 event has occurred.
10: 2 events have occurred.
11: 3 events have occurred.

If active mode is enabled, via SHDWMODE bit in DCCAPCTL 
register, CPU reads of this register will return the active register

If shadow mode is enabled, via SHDWMODE bit in DCCAPCTL

and further trip (capture) events are ignored until this bit is cleared. 
CAPSTS can be cleared by writing to CAPCLR bit in DCCAPCTL 
register and it re-triggers the capture mechanism.
If active mode is enabled, via SHDWMODE bit in DCCAPCTL 
register, CPU reads of this register will return the active register 
value.
If shadow mode is enabled, via SHDWMODE bit in DCCAPCTL 
register, the active register is copied to the shadow register on the 
PRD_eq or CNT_zero event (whichever is selected by PULSESEL 
bit in DCFCTL register). CPU reads of this register will return the

Fields.Name: DCFOFFSET
Fields.Description: 数字 比较 滤波器 偏移 寄存器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：消隐 窗口 偏移 These 16-位 specify 数量 的 TBCLK cycles 来自 消隐 窗口 参考 至 point 当 消隐 窗口 为 applied. 消隐 窗口 参考 为 either 周期 或 零 作为 defined 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. 此 偏移 寄存器 为 shadowed 及 活动 寄存器 为 loaded 在 参考 point defined 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL]. 偏移 计数器 为 also initialized 及 begins 至 计数 下降 当 活动 寄存器 为 loaded. 当 计数器 expires, 消隐 窗口 为 applied. 如果 消隐 窗口 为 currently 活动, then 消隐 窗口 计数器 为 restarted. Enhanced 脉冲 宽度 Modulator (ePWM) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：Digital Compare Filter Offset Register；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2456页；原文字段表：Blanking Window Offset

These 16-bits specify the number of TBCLK cycles from the blanking 
window reference to the point when the blanking window is applied. 
The blanking window reference is either period or zero as defined 
by the DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit. This offset register is shadowed 
and the active register is loaded at the reference point defined 
by DCFCTL[PULSESEL]. The offset counter is also initialized and 
begins to count down when the active register is loaded. When 
the counter expires, the blanking window is applied. If the blanking 
window is currently active, then the blanking window counter is 
restarted.

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：消隐 偏移 计数器 These 16-位 are 读取 仅 及 indicate 当前 值 的 偏移 计数器. 计数器 counts 下降 至 零 及 then stops until it 为 re-loaded 开启 下次 周期 或 零 事件 作为 defined 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. 偏移 计数器 为 不 affected 通过 自由/软暂停 仿真 位. That 为, it will always continue 至 计数 下降 如果 device 为 halted 通过 仿真 停止.
Fields.Notes:
原文：Digital Compare Filter Offset Counter Register；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2457页；原文字段表：Blanking Offset Counter

These 16-bits are read only and indicate the current value of the 
offset counter. The counter counts down to zero and then stops until 
it is re-loaded on the next period or zero event as defined by the 
DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit. The offset counter is not affected by the 
free/soft emulation bits. That is, it will always continue to count down 
if the device is halted by a emulation stop.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: DCFWINDOW
Fields.Description: 数字 比较 滤波器 窗口 寄存器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：消隐 窗口 宽度 00h: No 消隐 窗口 为 已产生. 01-FFFFh: 指定 宽度 的 消隐 窗口 中 TBCLK cycles. 消隐 窗口 begins 当 偏移 计数器 expires. 当 此 发生, 窗口 计数器 为 loaded 及 begins 至 计数 下降. 如果 消隐 窗口 为 currently 活动 及 偏移 计数器 expires, 消隐 窗口 计数器 为 不 restarted 及 消隐 窗口 为 cut short prematurely. Care should be taken 至 avoid 此 situation. 消隐 窗口 CAN cross PWM 周期 边界. Enhanced 脉冲 宽度 Modulator (ePWM) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：Digital Compare Filter Window Register；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2458页；原文字段表：Blanking Window Width

00h: No blanking window is generated.
01-FFFFh: Specifies the width of the blanking window in TBCLK 
cycles. The blanking window begins when the offset counter expires. 
When this occurs, the window counter is loaded and begins to 
count down. If the blanking window is currently active and the offset 
counter expires, the blanking window counter is not restarted and the 
blanking window is cut short prematurely. Care should be taken to 
avoid this situation. The blanking window can cross a PWM period 
boundary.
Enhanced Pulse Width Modulator (ePWM)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: DCCAP
Fields.Description: 数字 比较 计数器 捕获 寄存器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：数字 比较 时基 计数器 捕获 至 使能 时基 计数器 捕获, 置位 DCCAPCLT[CAPE] 位 至 1. 如果 已使能, 反映 值 的 时基 计数器 (TBCTR) 开启 低 至 高 边沿 transition 的 filtered (DCEVTFLT) 事件. Further 捕获 events are 忽略 until 下次 周期 或 零 作为 已选 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. Shadowing 的 DCCAP 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. - 如果 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能. 中 此 模式, 活动 寄存器 为 copied 至 影子 寄存器 开启 TBCTR = TBPRD 或 TBCTR = 零 作为 defined 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. CPU reads 的 此 寄存器 will return 影子 寄存器 值. - 如果 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用. 中 此 模式, CPU reads will return 活动 寄存器 值. 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址. Enhanced 脉冲 宽度 Modulator (ePWM) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：Digital Compare Counter Capture Register；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2462页；原文字段表：Digital Compare Time-Base Counter Capture

To enable time-base counter capture, set the DCCAPCLT[CAPE] bit 
to 1. If enabled, reflects the value of the time-base counter (TBCTR) 
on the low to high edge transition of a filtered (DCEVTFLT) event. 
Further capture events are ignored until the next period or zero 
as selected by the DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit. Shadowing of DCCAP 
is enabled and disabled by the DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] bit. By 
default this register is shadowed.
- If DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled. 
In this mode, the active register is copied to the shadow register 
on the TBCTR = TBPRD or TBCTR = zero as defined by the 
DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit. CPU reads of this register will return the 
shadow register value.
- If DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is 
disabled. In this mode, CPU reads will return the active register 
value. The active and shadow registers share the same memory 
map address.
Enhanced Pulse Width Modulator (ePWM)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CTRMODE
Fields.Description: 时基计数模式。
Fields.Values: 0：向上计数；1：向下计数；2：上下计数；3：停止/冻结。
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0 Counter Mode；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2349页；原文字段表：Counter Mode

The time-base counter mode is normally configured once and not 
changed during normal operation. If you change the mode of the 
counter, the change will take effect at the next TBCLK edge and the 
current counter value shall increment or decrement from the value 
before the mode change. These bits set the time-base counter mode 
of operation as follows:
00: Up-count mode
01: Down-count mode
10: Up-down count mode
11: Freeze counter operation (default on reset)；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUIW9C / 2024-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: PHSEN
Fields.Description: 相位加载使能。
Fields.Values: 0：禁用相位加载；1：收到同步事件时将TBPHS载入TBCTR。
Fields.Notes:
原文：2 Phase Load Enable；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2349页；原文字段表：Counter Reg Load from Phase Reg Enable

0: Do not load the time-base counter (TBCTR) from the time-base 
phase register (TBPHS).
1: Allow Counter to be loaded from the Phase register (TBPHS) and 
shadow to active load events when an EPWMxSYNCI input signal 
occurs or a software-forced sync signal, see bit 6.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUIW9C / 2024-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: PRDLD
Fields.Description: 周期寄存器的影子加载模式。
Fields.Values: 0：使用影子寄存器，计数器归零时装载；1：直接写活动寄存器。
Fields.Notes:
原文：3 Active Period Load；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2349页；原文字段表：Active Period Reg Load from Shadow Select

0: The period register (TBPRD) is loaded from its shadow register 
when the time-base counter, TBCTR, is equal to zero and/or a sync 
event as determined by the TBCTL2[PRDLDSYNC] bit.
A write/read to the TBPRD register accesses the shadow register.
1: Immediate Mode (Shadow register bypassed): A write or read to 
the TBPRD register accesses the active register.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUIW9C / 2024-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Description: 软件强制同步。

Fields.Notes:
原文：6 Software Force Sync Pulse；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2349页；原文字段表：R-0/W1S 0h Software Forced Sync Pulse

0: Writing a 0 has no effect and reads always return a 0.
1: Writing a 1 forces a one-time synchronization pulse to be 
generated.
SWFSYNC can be enabled to affect EPWMxSYNCO by setting the 
EPWMSYNCOUTEN.SWEN bit.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUIW9C / 2024-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: HSPCLKDIV
Fields.Description: 时基高速预分频选择。
Fields.Notes:
原文：9:7 High Speed TBCLK Pre-scaler；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2349页；原文字段表：High Speed Time Base Clock Pre-Scale Bits

These bits determine part of the time-base clock prescale value.
TBCLK = EPWMCLK / (HSPCLKDIV x CLKDIV). This divisor 
emulates the HSPCLK in the TMS320x281x system as used on the 
Event Manager (EV) peripheral.
000: /1
001: /2 (default on reset)
010: /4
011: /6
100: /8
101: /10
110: /12
111: /14；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUIW9C / 2024-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: CLKDIV
Fields.Description: 时基低速预分频选择。
Fields.Notes:
原文：12:10 Time Base Clock Pre-scaler；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2348页；原文字段表：Time Base Clock Pre-Scale Bits

These bits select the time base clock pre-scale value (TBCLK = 
EPWMCLK/(HSPCLKDIV * CLKDIV):
000: /1 (default on reset)
001: /2
010: /4
011: /8
100: /16
101: /32
110: /64
111: /128
Enhanced Pulse Width Modulator (ePWM)
 www.ti.com；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUIW9C / 2024-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: PHSDIR
Fields.Description: 上下计数模式下，同步载入相位后的计数方向。
Fields.Values: 0：同步后向下计数；1：同步后向上计数。
Fields.Notes:
原文：13 Phase Direction Bit；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2348页；原文字段表：Phase Direction Bit

This bit is only used when the time-base counter is configured in the 
up-down-count mode. The
PHSDIR bit indicates the direction the time-base counter (TBCTR) 
will count after a synchronization
event occurs and a new phase value is loaded from the phase 
(TBPHS) register. This is
irrespective of the direction of the counter before the synchronization 
event..
In the up-count and down-count modes this bit is ignored.
0: Count down after the synchronization event.
1: Count up after the synchronization event.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUIW9C / 2024-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: FREE_SOFT
Fields.Description: 仿真 模式 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：仿真 模式 位. These 位 选择 behavior 的 ePWM 时基 计数器 during 仿真 events 00: 停止 after 下次 时基 计数器 递增 或 递减 01: 停止 当 计数器 completes whole 周期: - 向上计数 模式: 停止 当 时基 计数器 = 周期 (TBCTR = TBPRD) - 向下计数 模式: 停止 当 时基 计数器 = 0x00 (TBCTR = 0x00) - Up-down-count 模式: 停止 当 时基 计数器 = 0x00 (TBCTR = 0x00) 1x: 自由运行 run
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:14 Emulation Mode Bits；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2348页；原文字段表：Emulation Mode Bits. These bits select the behavior of the ePWM 

time-base counter during emulation events
00: Stop after the next time-base counter increment or decrement
01: Stop when counter completes a whole cycle:
- Up-count mode: stop when the time-base counter = period (TBCTR 
= TBPRD)
- Down-count mode: stop when the time-base counter = 0x00 
(TBCTR = 0x00)
- Up-down-count mode: stop when the time-base counter = 0x00 
(TBCTR = 0x00)
1x: Free run；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OUT_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输出 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 输出 模式 控制 位 1 控制 S1 switch 及 位 0 控制 S0 switch. 00: DBM 为 fully 已禁用 或 by-passed. 中 此 模式 POLSEL 及 IN-MODE 位 have no effect. 01: Apath = InA (延迟 为 by-passed 用于 信号 路径) Bpath = FED (下降沿 边沿 延迟 中 B 信号 路径) 10: Apath = RED (上升沿 边沿 延迟 中 信号 路径) Bpath = InB (延迟 为 by-passed 用于 B 信号 路径) 11: DBM 为 fully 已使能 (i.e. both RED 及 FED 活动)
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0 Dead Band Output Mode Control；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2363页；原文字段表：Dead-Band Output Mode Control

Bit 1 controls the S1 switch and bit 0 controls the S0 switch.
00: DBM is fully disabled or by-passed. In this mode the POLSEL 
and IN-MODE bits have no effect.
01: Apath = InA (delay is by-passed for A signal path)
Bpath = FED (Falling Edge Delay in B signal path)
10: Apath = RED (Rising Edge Delay in A signal path)
Bpath = InB (delay is by-passed for B signal path)
11: DBM is fully enabled (i.e. both RED and FED active)；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: POLSEL
Fields.Description: 极性 选择 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：极性 选择 控制 位 3 控制 S3 switch 及 位 2 控制 S2 switch. 此 allows you 至 selectively invert 单次 的 delayed 信号 before it 为 sent out 的 死区 submodule. following descriptions correspond 至 classical upper/lower switch 控制 作为 found 中 单次 leg 的 数字 motor 控制 inverter. These assume that DBCTL[OUT_模式] = 1,1 及 DBCTL[中_模式] = 0x0. Other enhanced modes are also possible, but 不 regarded 作为 typical usage modes. 00: 活动 高 (AH) 模式. Neither EPWMxA nor EPWMxB 为 反相 (默认). 01: 活动 低 互补 (ALC) 模式. EPWMxA 为 反相. 10: 活动 高 互补 (AHC). EPWMxB 为 反相. 11: 活动 低 (AL) 模式. Both EPWMxA 及 EPWMxB are 反相. Enhanced 脉冲 宽度 Modulator (ePWM) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：3:2 Polarity Select Control；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2362页；原文字段表：Polarity Select Control

Bit 3 controls the S3 switch and bit 2 controls the S2 switch. 
This allows you to selectively invert one of the delayed signals 
before it is sent out of the dead-band submodule. The following 
descriptions correspond to classical upper/lower switch control as 
found in one leg of a digital motor control inverter. These assume 
that DBCTL[OUT_MODE] = 1,1 and DBCTL[IN_MODE] = 0x0. Other 
enhanced modes are also possible, but not regarded as typical 
usage modes.
00: Active high (AH) mode. Neither EPWMxA nor EPWMxB is 
inverted (default).
01: Active low complementary (ALC) mode. EPWMxA is inverted.
10: Active high complementary (AHC). EPWMxB is inverted.
11: Active low (AL) mode. Both EPWMxA and EPWMxB are inverted.
Enhanced Pulse Width Modulator (ePWM)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: IN_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输入 选择 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 输入 模式 控制 位 5 控制 S5 switch 及 位 4 控制 S4 switch shown. 此 allows you 至 选择 输入 来源 至 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟. 至 produce classical 死区 waveforms 默认 为 EPWMxA 中 为 来源 用于 both 下降沿 及 rising-edge delays. 00: EPWMxA 中 (来自 action-qualifier) 为 来源 用于 both falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟. 01: EPWMxB 中 (来自 action-qualifier) 为 来源 用于 上升沿- 边沿 delayed 信号. EPWMxA 中 (来自 action-qualifier) 为 来源 用于 falling-edge delayed 信号. 10: EPWMxA 中 (来自 action-qualifier) 为 来源 用于 上升沿- 边沿 delayed 信号. EPWMxB 中 (来自 action-qualifier) 为 来源 用于 falling-edge delayed 信号. 11: EPWMxB 中 (来自 action-qualifier) 为 来源 用于 both rising-edge 延迟 及 falling-edge delayed 信号.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5:4 Dead Band Input Select Mode Control；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2362页；原文字段表：Dead-Band Input Mode Control

Bit 5 controls the S5 switch and bit 4 controls the S4 switch shown. 
This allows you to select the input source to the falling-edge and 
rising-edge delay. To produce classical dead-band waveforms the 
default is EPWMxA In is the source for both falling and rising-edge 
delays.
00: EPWMxA In (from the action-qualifier) is the source for both 
falling-edge and rising-edge delay.
01: EPWMxB In (from the action-qualifier) is the source for rising-
edge delayed signal.
EPWMxA In (from the action-qualifier) is the source for falling-edge 
delayed signal.
10: EPWMxA In (from the action-qualifier) is the source for rising-
edge delayed signal.
EPWMxB In (from the action-qualifier) is the source for falling-edge 
delayed signal.
11: EPWMxB In (from the action-qualifier) is the source for both 
rising-edge delay and falling-edge delayed signal.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

OutB = B-path 作为 defined 通过 OUT-MODE 位. 11: OutA = B-path 作为 defined 通过 OUT-MODE 位 (下降沿 边沿 延迟 或 delay-bypassed B 信号 路径). OutB = A-path 作为 defined 通过 OUT-MODE 位 (上升沿 边沿 延迟 或 delay-bypassed 信号 路径).

原文：13:12 Dead Band Output Swap Control；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2361页；原文字段表：Dead Band Output Swap Control

00: OutA and OutB signals are as defined by OUT-MODE bits.
01: OutA = A-path as defined by OUT-MODE bits.
OutB = A-path as defined by OUT-MODE bits (rising edge delay or 
delay-bypassed A signal path).
10: OutA = B-path as defined by OUT-MODE bits (falling edge delay 
or delay-bypassed B signal path).
OutB = B-path as defined by OUT-MODE bits.
11: OutA = B-path as defined by OUT-MODE bits (falling edge delay 
or delay-bypassed B signal path).

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 带 Dual-Edge B 模式 控制 (S8 switch) 0: 上升沿 边沿 延迟 applied 至 InA/InB 作为 已选 通过 S4 switch (IN-MODE 位) 开启 信号 路径 仅. 下降沿 边沿 延迟 applied 至 InA/InB 作为 已选 通过 S5 switch (INMODE 位) 开启 B 信号 路径 仅. 1: 上升沿 边沿 延迟 及 下降沿 边沿 延迟 applied 至 来源 已选 通过 S4 switch (INMODE 位) 及 输出 至 B 信号 路径 仅. Note: 当 此 位 为 置位 至 1, user should always either 置位 OUT_模式 位 such that Apath = InA 或 OUTSWAP 位 such that OutA=Bpath otherwise, OutA will be invalid.
Fields.Notes:
原文：14 Dead Band Dual-Edge B Mode Control；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2361页；原文字段表：Dead Band Dual-Edge B Mode Control (S8 switch)

0: Rising edge delay applied to InA/InB as selected by S4 switch 
(IN-MODE bits) on A signal path only. Falling edge delay applied to 
InA/InB as selected by S5 switch (INMODE bits) on B signal path 
only.
1: Rising edge delay and falling edge delay applied to source 
selected by S4 switch (INMODE bits) and output to B signal path 
only. Note: When this bit is set to 1, user should always either set 
OUT_MODE bits such that Apath = InA OR OUTSWAP bits such that 
OutA=Bpath
otherwise, OutA will be invalid.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

SFO library 功能 automatically updates HRMSTEP 寄存器 带 appropriate MEP scale factor. 0: 自动 HRMSTEP scaling 为 已禁用. 1: 自动 HRMSTEP scaling 为 已使能. 如果 application 软件 为 manually scaling 小数 占空 周期, 或 相位 (i.e. 软件 设置 CMPAHR = (fraction(PWMduty * PWMperiod) * MEP Scale Factor)<<8 + 0x080 用于 占空 周期), then 此 模式 must be 已禁用.
Fields.Notes:
原文：6 Autoconversion Bit；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2375页；原文字段表：Auto Convert Delay Line Value

Selects whether the fractional duty cycle/period/phase in the 
CMPAHR/TBPRDHR/TBPHSHR register is automatically scaled by 
the MEP scale factor in the HRMSTEP register or manually scaled 
by calculations in application software. The SFO library function 
automatically updates the HRMSTEP register with the appropriate 
MEP scale factor.
0: Automatic HRMSTEP scaling is disabled.
1: Automatic HRMSTEP scaling is enabled.
If application software is manually scaling the fractional duty cycle,

Fields.Name: TBPHSHRLOADE
Fields.Description: TBPHSHR 加载 使能
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：TBPHSHR 加载 使能 此 位 allows you 至 synchronize ePWM modules 带 高- 分辨率 相位 开启 同步输入, TBCTL[SWFSYNC] 或 数字 比较 事件. 此 allows 用于 multiple ePWM modules 工作 在 same 频率 至 be 相位 aligned 带 high-resolution. 0: 禁用 同步 的 high-resolution 相位 开启 同步输入, TBCTL[SWFSYNC] 或 数字 比较 事件: 1: Synchronize high-resolution 相位 开启 同步输入, TBCTL[SWFSYNC] 或 数字 比较器 同步 事件. 相位 为 synchronized using 内容 的 high-resolution 相位 TBPHSHR 寄存器. TBCTL[PHSEN] 位 which 使能 loading 的 TBCTR 寄存器 带 TBPHS 寄存器 值 开启 同步输入 或 TBCTL[SWFSYNC] 事件 works independently. However, users need 至 使能 此 位 also 如果 they want 至 控制 相位 中 conjunction 带 high-resolution 周期 feature. 此 位 及 TBCTL[PHSEN] 位 must be 置位 至 1 当 high-resolution 周期 为 已使能 用于 up-down 计数 模式 even 如果 TBPHSHR = 0x0000. 此 位 does 不 need 至 be 置位 当 仅 high-resolution 占空 为 已使能.
Fields.Notes:
原文：2 TBPHSHR Load Enable；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2379页；原文字段表：TBPHSHR Load Enable

This bit allows you to synchronize ePWM modules with a high-
resolution phase on a SYNCIN, TBCTL[SWFSYNC] or digital 
compare event. This allows for multiple ePWM modules operating 
at the same frequency to be phase aligned with high-resolution.
0: Disables synchronization of high-resolution phase on a SYNCIN, 
TBCTL[SWFSYNC] or digital compare event:
1: Synchronize the high-resolution phase on a SYNCIN, 
TBCTL[SWFSYNC] or digital comparator synchronization event. The 
phase is synchronized using the contents of the high-resolution 
phase TBPHSHR register. The TBCTL[PHSEN] bit which enables 
the loading of the TBCTR register with TBPHS register value 
on a SYNCIN or TBCTL[SWFSYNC] event works independently. 
However, users need to enable this bit also if they want to control 
phase in conjunction with the high-resolution period feature.
This bit and the TBCTL[PHSEN] bit must be set to 1 when 
high-resolution period is enabled for up-down count mode even if 
TBPHSHR = 0x0000. This bit does not need to be set when only 
high-resolution duty is enabled.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Sync (software or hardware) TBPHSHR copied to TRREM : Highest 
Priority
HRPWM Hardware (updates TRREM register): Next priority
CPU Write To TRREM Register: Lowest Priority
3. Bit 10 of TRREM register is not used in asymmetrical mode. This 
bit can be forced to zero.
TRREM will be initialized to 0x0 and 0x100 in Up and Up-down 
modes respectively.

TRREM[7:0] = TBPHSHR[15:8]
TRREM[10,9,8] = 0,0,0
Symmetrical Mode:
TRREM[7:0] = TBPHSHR[15:8]

Fields.Name: TBPHS
Fields.Description: 相位 偏移 寄存器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：相位 偏移 寄存器 These 位 置位 时基 计数器 相位 的 已选 ePWM relative 至 时基 that 为 supplying 同步 输入 信号. - 如果 TBCTL[PHSEN] = 0, then 同步 事件 为 忽略 及 时基 计数器 为 不 loaded 带 相位. - 如果 TBCTL[PHSEN] = 1, then 时基 计数器 (TBCTR) will be loaded 带 相位 (TBPHS) 当 同步 事件 发生. 同步 事件 CAN be initiated 通过 输入 同步 信号 (EPWMxSYNCI) 或 通过 软件 forced 同步.
Fields.Notes:
原文：31:16 Phase Offset Register；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2400页；原文字段表：Phase Offset Register

These bits set time-base counter phase of the selected ePWM 
relative to the time-base that is supplying the synchronization input 
signal.
- If TBCTL[PHSEN] = 0, then the synchronization event is ignored 
and the time-base counter is not loaded with the phase.
- If TBCTL[PHSEN] = 1, then the time-base counter (TBCTR) will 
be loaded with the phase (TBPHS) when a synchronization event 
occurs. The synchronization event can be initiated by the input 
synchronization signal (EPWMxSYNCI) or by a software forced 
synchronization.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：周期 高位 分辨率 位 高位 8-位 contain high-resolution portion 的 周期 值. TBPRDHR 寄存器 为 不 affected 通过 TBCTL[PRDLD] 位. Reads 来自 此 寄存器 always reflect 影子 寄存器. Likewise writes are also 至 影子 寄存器. TBPRDHR 寄存器 为 仅 使用 当 高 分辨率 周期 feature 为 已使能. 此 寄存器 为 仅 available 带 ePWM modules which support high-resolution 周期 控制. 低位 8 位 中 此 寄存器 are 忽略 - writes are 忽略 及 reads return 零
Fields.Notes:
原文：Time Base Period High Resolution Register；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2401页；原文字段表：Period High Resolution Bits

The upper 8-bits contain the high-resolution portion of the period 
value. The TBPRDHR register is not affected by the TBCTL[PRDLD] 
bit. Reads from this register always reflect the shadow register. 
Likewise writes are also to the shadow register. The TBPRDHR 
register is only used when the high resolution period feature is 
enabled. This register is only available with ePWM modules which 
support high-resolution period control.
The lower 8 bits in this register are ignored - writes are ignored and 
reads return zero；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TBPRD
Fields.Description: 时基周期计数值。
Fields.Values: 向上/向下计数：频率=TBCLK/(TBPRD+1)；上下计数：频率=TBCLK/(2×TBPRD)。
Fields.Notes:
原文：Time Base Period Register；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2402页；原文字段表：Time Base Period Register

These bits determine the period of the time-base counter. This 
sets the PWM frequency. Shadowing of this register is enabled 
and disabled by the TBCTL[PRDLD] bit. By default this register is 
shadowed.
- If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write 
or read will automatically go to the shadow register. In this case, 
the active register will be loaded from the shadow register when the 
time-base counter equals zero.
- If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 1, then the shadow is disabled and any write or 
read will go directly to the active register, that is the register actively 
controlling the hardware.
- The active and shadow registers share the same memory map 
address.
Enhanced Pulse Width Modulator (ePWM)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

significant 8-bits) of the counter-compare A value. CMPA:CMPAHR

Fields.Name: CMPA
Fields.Description: 比较 寄存器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：比较 寄存器 值 中 活动 CMPA 寄存器 为 continuously compared 至 时基 计数器 (TBCTR). 当 values are equal, counter-compare 模块 产生 '时基 计数器 equal 至 计数器 比较 ' 事件. 此 事件 为 sent 至 action-qualifier where it 为 限定后 及 converted it 进入 单次 或 more actions. These actions CAN be applied 至 either EPWMxA 或 EPWMxB 输出 depending 开启 配置 的 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器. actions that CAN be defined 中 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器 include: - 执行 nothing 事件 为 忽略. - 清除: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 低 - 置位: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 高 - 翻转 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 Shadowing 的 此 寄存器 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. - 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能 及 any 写入 或 读取 will automatically go 至 影子 寄存器. 中 此 case, CMPCTL[LOADAMODE] 位 field 决定 which 事件 will 加载 活动 寄存器 来自 影子 寄存器. - Before 写入, CMPCTL[SHDWAFULL] 位 CAN be 读取 至 determine 如果 影子 寄存器 为 currently 满. - 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用 及 any 写入 或 读取 will go directly 至 活动 寄存器, that 为 寄存器 actively controlling 硬件. - 中 either 模式, 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：31:16 Compare A Register；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2403页；原文字段表：Compare A Register

The value in the active CMPA register is continuously compared to 
the time-base counter (TBCTR). When the values are equal, the 
counter-compare module generates a 'time-base counter equal to 
counter compare A' event. This event is sent to the action-qualifier 
where it is qualified and converted it into one or more actions. 
These actions can be applied to either the EPWMxA or the EPWMxB 
output depending on the configuration of the AQCTLA and AQCTLB 
registers. The actions that can be defined in the AQCTLA and 
AQCTLB registers include:
- Do nothing
the event is ignored.
- Clear: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal low
- Set: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal high
- Toggle the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the 
CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] bit. By default this register is shadowed.
- If CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and 
any write or read will automatically go to the shadow register. In this 
case, the CMPCTL[LOADAMODE] bit field determines which event 
will load the active register from the shadow register.
- Before a write, the CMPCTL[SHDWAFULL] bit can be read to 
determine if the shadow register is currently full.
- If CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is 
disabled and any write or read will go directly to the active register, 
that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
- In either mode, the active and shadow registers share the same 
memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OSHTLD
Fields.Description: 使能 重装载 事件 中 单次 触发 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：R-0/W1S 0h 使能 重装载 事件 中 单次 触发 模式 0: Writing 的 0 will be 忽略. Always reads back 0. 1: Turns 单次 触发 锁存 条件 开启. Upon occurrence 的 chosen 加载 选通, 单次 影子 至 活动 重装载 发生 及 锁存 will be cleared. Hence writing 1 至 此 位 would allow 单次 加载 选通 事件 至 pass through 及 模块 further 选通 events.
Fields.Notes:
原文：0 Enable reload event in one shot mode；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2407页；原文字段表：R-0/W1S 0h Enable Reload Event in One Shot Mode

0: Writing of 0 will be ignored. Always reads back a 0.
1: Turns the one shot latch condition ON. Upon occurrence of a 
chosen load strobe, one shadow to active reload occurs and the 
latch will be cleared. Hence writing 1 to this bit would allow one load 
strobe event to pass through and block further strobe events.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: GFRCLD
Fields.Description: 强制 重装载 事件 中 单次 触发 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：R-0/W1S 0h 强制 加载 事件 中 单次 触发 模式 0: Writing 的 0 will be 忽略. Always reads back 0. 1: 强制 单次 加载 事件 在 输入 的 事件 预分频 计数器. 此 位 为 intended 至 be 使用 用于 testing and/or 软件 强制 loading 的 events 中 全局 加载 模式.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1 Force reload event in one shot mode；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2407页；原文字段表：R-0/W1S 0h Force Load Event in One Shot Mode

0: Writing of 0 will be ignored. Always reads back a 0.
1: Force one load event at the input of the event pre-scale counter. 
This bit is intended to be used for testing and/or software force 
loading of the events in global load mode.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

No further ePWMx_TZINT PIE 中断 will be 已产生 until 此 标志 为 cleared. 如果 中断 标志 为 cleared 当 either CBC 或 OST 为 置位, then another 中断 脉冲 will be 已产生. Fields.Notes:
原文：0 Global Int Status Flag；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2422页；原文字段表：Latched Trip Interrupt Status Flag

0: Indicates no interrupt has been generated.
1: Indicates an EPWMx_TZINT PIE interrupt was generated because 
of a trip condition.
No further EPWMx_TZINT PIE interrupts will be generated until this 
flag is cleared. If the interrupt flag is cleared when either CBC or 
OST is set, then another interrupt pulse will be generated. Clearing 
all flag bits will prevent further interrupts. This bit is cleared by writing 
the appropriate value to the TZCLR register.

Fields.Name: CBC

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：锁存 状态 标志 用于 逐周期 跳闸 事件 0: No 逐周期 跳闸 事件 has occurred. 1: 表示 跳闸 事件 has occurred 开启 信号 已选 作为 逐周期 跳闸 来源. TZFLG[CBC] 位 will remain 置位 until it 为 manually cleared 通过 user. 如果 逐周期 跳闸 事件 为 still present 当 CBC 位 为 cleared, then CBC will be immediately 置位 again. specified 条件 开启 信号 为 automatically cleared 当 ePWM 时基 计数器 reaches 零 (TBCTR = 0x00) 如果 跳闸 条件 为 no longer present. 条件 开启 信号 为 仅 cleared 当 TBCTR = 0x00 no matter where 中 周期 CBC 标志 为 cleared. 此 位 为 cleared 通过 writing appropriate 值 至 TZCLR 寄存器.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1 Trip Zones Cycle By Cycle Flag；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2422页；原文字段表：Latched Status Flag for Cycle-By-Cycle Trip Event

0: No cycle-by-cycle trip event has occurred.
1: Indicates a trip event has occurred on a signal selected as a 
cycle-by-cycle trip source. The
TZFLG[CBC] bit will remain set until it is manually cleared by the 
user. If the cycle-by-cycle trip event is still present when the CBC 
bit is cleared, then CBC will be immediately set again. The specified 
condition on the signal is automatically cleared when the ePWM 
time-base counter reaches zero (TBCTR = 0x00) if the trip condition 
is no longer present. The condition on the signal is only cleared 
when the TBCTR = 0x00 no matter where in the cycle the CBC flag 
is cleared.
This bit is cleared by writing the appropriate value to the TZCLR 
register.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INTSEL
Fields.Description: EPWMxINTn 选择
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ePWM 中断 (ePWMx_中断) 选择 选项 000: 保留位 001: 使能 事件 时基 计数器 equal 至 零. (TBCTR = 0x00) 010: 使能 事件 时基 计数器 equal 至 周期 (TBCTR = TBPRD) 011: 使能 事件 时基 计数器 equal 至 零 或 周期 (TBCTR = 0x00 或 TBCTR = TBPRD). 此 模式 为 useful 中 up-down 计数 模式. 100: 使能 事件 时基 计数器 equal 至 CMPA 当 定时器 为 incrementing 或 CMPC 当 定时器 为 incrementing 101: 使能 事件 时基 计数器 equal 至 CMPA 当 定时器 为 decrementing 或 CMPC 当 定时器 为 decrementing 110: 使能 事件: 时基 计数器 equal 至 CMPB 当 定时器 为 incrementing 或 CMPD 当 定时器 为 incrementing 111: 使能 事件: 时基 计数器 equal 至 CMPB 当 定时器 为 decrementing 或 CMPD 当 定时器 为 decrementing (*) 事件 已选 为 determined 通过 INTSELCMP 位. Enhanced 脉冲 宽度 Modulator (ePWM) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：2:0 EPWMxINTn Select；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2434页；原文字段表：ePWM Interrupt (EPWMx_INT) Selection Options

000: Reserved
001: Enable event time-base counter equal to zero. (TBCTR = 0x00)
010: Enable event time-base counter equal to period (TBCTR = 
TBPRD)
011: Enable event time-base counter equal to zero or period (TBCTR 
= 0x00 or TBCTR = TBPRD). This mode is useful in up-down count 
mode.
100: Enable event time-base counter equal to CMPA when the timer 
is incrementing or CMPC when the timer is incrementing
101: Enable event time-base counter equal to CMPA when the timer 
is decrementing or CMPC when the timer is decrementing
110: Enable event: time-base counter equal to CMPB when the timer 
is incrementing or CMPD when the timer is incrementing
111: Enable event: time-base counter equal to CMPB when the timer 
is decrementing or CMPD when the timer is decrementing (*) Event 
selected is determined by INTSELCMP bit.

Fields.Name: INTPRD
Fields.Description: EPWMxINTn 周期 选择
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ePWM 中断 (ePWMx_中断) 周期 选择 These 位 determine how many 已选 ETSEL[INTSEL] events need 至 occur before 中断 为 已产生. 至 be 已产生, 中断 must be 已使能 (ETSEL[中断] = 1). 如果 中断 状态 标志 为 置位 来自 前次 中断 (ETFLG[中断] = 1) then no 中断 will be 已产生 until 标志 为 cleared via ETCLR[中断] 位. 此 allows 用于 单次 中断 至 be 待处理 期间 another 为 still being serviced. Once 中断 为 已产生, ETPS[INTCNT] 位 will automatically be cleared. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 same 作为 当前 计数器 值 will 触发 中断 如果 it 为 已使能 及 状态 标志 为 清除. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 less than 当前 计数器 值 will 结果 中 undefined 状态. 如果 计数器 事件 发生 在 same instant 作为 new 零 或 non-zero INTPRD 值 为 written, 计数器 为 incremented. 00: 禁用 中断 事件 计数器. No 中断 will be 已产生 及 ETFRC[中断] 为 忽略. 01: 产生 中断 开启 首个 事件 INTCNT = 01 (首个 事件) 10: 产生 中断 开启 ETPS[INTCNT] = 1,0 (second 事件) 11: 产生 中断 开启 ETPS[INTCNT] = 1,1 (third 事件)
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0 EPWMxINTn Period Select；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2437页；原文字段表：ePWM Interrupt (EPWMx_INT) Period Select

These bits determine how many selected ETSEL[INTSEL] events 
need to occur before an interrupt is generated. To be generated, 
the interrupt must be enabled (ETSEL[INT] = 1). If the interrupt 
status flag is set from a previous interrupt (ETFLG[INT] = 1) then 
no interrupt will be generated until the flag is cleared via the 
ETCLR[INT] bit. This allows for one interrupt to be pending while 
another is still being serviced. Once the interrupt is generated, the 
ETPS[INTCNT] bits will automatically be cleared.
Writing a INTPRD value that is the same as the current counter value 
will trigger an interrupt if it is enabled and the status flag is clear.
Writing a INTPRD value that is less than the current counter value 
will result in an undefined state. If a counter event occurs at the 
same instant as a new zero or non-zero INTPRD value is written, the 
counter is incremented.
00: Disable the interrupt event counter. No interrupt will be generated 
and ETFRC[INT] is ignored.
01: Generate an interrupt on the first event INTCNT = 01 (first event)
10: Generate interrupt on ETPS[INTCNT] = 1,0 (second event)
11: Generate interrupt on ETPS[INTCNT] = 1,1 (third event)；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

These bits indicate how many selected ETSEL[INTSEL] events have 
occurred. These bits are automatically cleared when an interrupt 
pulse is generated. If interrupts are disabled, ETSEL[INT] = 0 or 
the interrupt flag is set, ETFLG[INT] = 1, the counter will stop 
counting events when it reaches the period value ETPS[INTCNT] 
= ETPS[INTPRD].
00: No events have occurred.
01: 1 event has occurred.
10: 2 events have occurred.
11: 3 events have occurred.

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ePWM ADC 启动转换 B 事件 (EPWMxSOCB) 周期 选择 These 位 determine how many 已选 ETSEL[SOCBSEL] events need 至 occur before EPWMxSOCB 脉冲 为 已产生. 至 be 已产生, 脉冲 must be 已使能 (ETSEL[SOCBEN] = 1). SOCB 脉冲 will be 已产生 even 如果 状态 标志 为 置位 来自 前次 启动 的 转换 (ETFLG[SOCB] = 1). Once SOCB 脉冲 为 已产生, ETPS[SOCBCNT] 位 will automatically be cleared. 00: 禁用 SOCB 事件 计数器. No EPWMxSOCB 脉冲 will be 已产生 01: 产生 EPWMxSOCB 脉冲 开启 首个 事件: ETPS[SOCBCNT] = 0,1 10: 产生 EPWMxSOCB 脉冲 开启 second 事件: ETPS[SOCBCNT] = 1,0 11: 产生 EPWMxSOCB 脉冲 开启 third 事件: ETPS[SOCBCNT] = 1,1
Fields.Notes:
原文：13:12 EPWMxSOCB Period Select；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2435页；原文字段表：ePWM ADC Start-of-Conversion B Event (EPWMxSOCB) Period 

Select
These bits determine how many selected ETSEL[SOCBSEL] events 
need to occur before an EPWMxSOCB pulse is generated. To be 
generated, the pulse must be enabled (ETSEL[SOCBEN] = 1). The 
SOCB pulse will be generated even if the status flag is set from a 
previous start of conversion (ETFLG[SOCB] = 1). Once the SOCB 
pulse is generated, the ETPS[SOCBCNT] bits will automatically be 
cleared.
00: Disable the SOCB event counter. No EPWMxSOCB pulse will be 
generated
01: Generate the EPWMxSOCB pulse on the first event: 
ETPS[SOCBCNT] = 0,1
10: Generate the EPWMxSOCB pulse on the second event: 
ETPS[SOCBCNT] = 1,0
11: Generate the EPWMxSOCB pulse on the third event: 
ETPS[SOCBCNT] = 1,1；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

原文：15:14 EPWMxSOCB Counter；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2435页；原文字段表：ePWM ADC Start-of-Conversion B Event (EPWMxSOCB) Counter 

Register

Fields.Name: INT
Fields.Description: EPWMxINTn 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：锁存 ePWM 中断 (ePWMx_中断) 状态 标志 0: 表示 no 事件 occurred 1: 表示 that ePWMx 中断 (ePWMx_中断) was 已产生. No further 中断 will be 已产生 until 标志 位 为 cleared. 上升 至 单次 中断 CAN be 待处理 期间 ETFLG[中断] 位 为 still 置位. 如果 中断 为 待处理, it will 不 be 已产生 until after ETFLG[中断] 位 为 cleared. Enhanced 脉冲 宽度 Modulator (ePWM) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：0 EPWMxINTn Flag；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2438页；原文字段表：Latched ePWM Interrupt (EPWMx_INT) Status Flag

0: Indicates no event occurred
1: Indicates that an ePWMx interrupt (EPWMx_INT) was generated. 
No further interrupts will be generated until the flag bit is cleared. 
Up to one interrupt can be pending while the ETFLG[INT] bit is still 
set. If an interrupt is pending, it will not be generated until after the 
ETFLG[INT] bit is cleared.

Fields.Description: 数字 比较 滤波器 偏移 寄存器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：消隐 窗口 偏移 These 16-位 specify 数量 的 TBCLK cycles 来自 消隐 窗口 参考 至 point 当 消隐 窗口 为 applied. 消隐 窗口 参考 为 either 周期 或 零 作为 defined 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. 此 偏移 寄存器 为 shadowed 及 活动 寄存器 为 loaded 在 参考 point defined 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL]. 偏移 计数器 为 also initialized 及 begins 至 计数 下降 当 活动 寄存器 为 loaded. 当 计数器 expires, 消隐 窗口 为 applied. 如果 消隐 窗口 为 currently 活动, then 消隐 窗口 计数器 为 restarted. Enhanced 脉冲 宽度 Modulator (ePWM) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：Digital Compare Filter Offset Register；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2456页；原文字段表：Blanking Window Offset

These 16-bits specify the number of TBCLK cycles from the blanking 
window reference to the point when the blanking window is applied. 
The blanking window reference is either period or zero as defined 
by the DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit. This offset register is shadowed 
and the active register is loaded at the reference point defined 
by DCFCTL[PULSESEL]. The offset counter is also initialized and 
begins to count down when the active register is loaded. When 
the counter expires, the blanking window is applied. If the blanking 
window is currently active, then the blanking window counter is 
restarted.
Enhanced Pulse Width Modulator (ePWM)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：消隐 偏移 计数器 These 16-位 are 读取 仅 及 indicate 当前 值 的 偏移 计数器. 计数器 counts 下降 至 零 及 then stops until it 为 re-loaded 开启 下次 周期 或 零 事件 作为 defined 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. 偏移 计数器 为 不 affected 通过 自由/软暂停 仿真 位. That 为, it will always continue 至 计数 下降 如果 device 为 halted 通过 仿真 停止.
Fields.Notes:
原文：Digital Compare Filter Offset Counter Register；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2457页；原文字段表：Blanking Offset Counter

These 16-bits are read only and indicate the current value of the 
offset counter. The counter counts down to zero and then stops until 
it is re-loaded on the next period or zero event as defined by the 
DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit. The offset counter is not affected by the 
free/soft emulation bits. That is, it will always continue to count down 
if the device is halted by a emulation stop.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

原文：Digital Compare Filter Window Register；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2458页；原文字段表：Blanking Window Width

00h: No blanking window is generated.
01-FFFFh: Specifies the width of the blanking window in TBCLK 
cycles. The blanking window begins when the offset counter expires. 
When this occurs, the window counter is loaded and begins to 
count down. If the blanking window is currently active and the offset 
counter expires, the blanking window counter is not restarted and the 
blanking window is cut short prematurely. Care should be taken to 
avoid this situation. The blanking window can cross a PWM period 
boundary.

Fields.Name: DCCAP
Fields.Description: 数字 比较 计数器 捕获 寄存器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：数字 比较 时基 计数器 捕获 至 使能 时基 计数器 捕获, 置位 DCCAPCLT[CAPE] 位 至 1. 如果 已使能, 反映 值 的 时基 计数器 (TBCTR) 开启 低 至 高 边沿 transition 的 filtered (DCEVTFLT) 事件. Further 捕获 events are 忽略 until 下次 周期 或 零 作为 已选 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. Shadowing 的 DCCAP 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. - 如果 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能. 中 此 模式, 活动 寄存器 为 copied 至 影子 寄存器 开启 TBCTR = TBPRD 或 TBCTR = 零 作为 defined 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. CPU reads 的 此 寄存器 will return 影子 寄存器 值. - 如果 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用. 中 此 模式, CPU reads will return 活动 寄存器 值. 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址. Enhanced 脉冲 宽度 Modulator (ePWM) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：Digital Compare Counter Capture Register；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2462页；原文字段表：Digital Compare Time-Base Counter Capture

To enable time-base counter capture, set the DCCAPCLT[CAPE] bit 
to 1. If enabled, reflects the value of the time-base counter (TBCTR) 
on the low to high edge transition of a filtered (DCEVTFLT) event. 
Further capture events are ignored until the next period or zero 
as selected by the DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit. Shadowing of DCCAP 
is enabled and disabled by the DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] bit. By 
default this register is shadowed.
- If DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled. 
In this mode, the active register is copied to the shadow register 
on the TBCTR = TBPRD or TBCTR = zero as defined by the 
DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit. CPU reads of this register will return the 
shadow register value.
- If DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is 
disabled. In this mode, CPU reads will return the active register 
value. The active and shadow registers share the same memory 
map address.
Enhanced Pulse Width Modulator (ePWM)

Fields.Name: GPIO224
Fields.Description: 数据 寄存器 用于 此 引脚
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Reading 此 寄存器 表示 当前 状态 的 此 GPIO 引脚, irrespective 的 which 模式 引脚 为 中. Writing 至 此 寄存器 will 置位 此 GPIO 引脚 高 或 低 如果 引脚 为 已使能 用于 GPIO 输出 模式, otherwise 值 written 为 锁存 but 忽略. 状态 的 输出 寄存器 锁存 will remain 中 its 当前 状态 until 下次 写入 操作. 系统 复位 will 清除 全部 位 及 锁存 values 至 零. DESIGNER NOTE: [1] Reading GPIODAT 寄存器 should reflect 状态 的 引脚 (after 输入限定), 不 状态 的 输出 锁存 的 GPIODAT 寄存器.
Fields.Notes:
原文：0 Data Register for this pin；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第1229页；原文字段表：Reading this register indicates the current status of this GPIO pin, 

irrespective of which mode the pin is in. Writing to this register will 
set this GPIO pin high or low if the pin is enabled for GPIO output 
mode, otherwise the value written is latched but ignored. The state of 
the output register latch will remain in its current state until the next 
write operation. A system reset will clear all bits and latched values 
to zero.
DESIGNER NOTE:
[1] Reading the GPIODAT register should reflect the state of the PIN 
(after qualification), not the state of the output latch of the GPIODAT 
register.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

DESIGNER NOTE: [1] Reading GPIODAT 寄存器 should reflect 状态 的 引脚 (after 输入限定), 不 状态 的 输出 锁存 的 GPIODAT 寄存器. 通用 Input/Output (GPIO) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：5 Data Register for this pin；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第1228页；原文字段表：Reading this register indicates the current status of this GPIO pin, 

irrespective of which mode the pin is in. Writing to this register will 
set this GPIO pin high or low if the pin is enabled for GPIO output 
mode, otherwise the value written is latched but ignored. The state of 
the output register latch will remain in its current state until the next 
write operation. A system reset will clear all bits and latched values 
to zero.
DESIGNER NOTE:
[1] Reading the GPIODAT register should reflect the state of the PIN 
(after qualification), not the state of the output latch of the GPIODAT 
register.

Fields.Name: ARBL
Fields.Description: Arbitration-lost 中断 标志 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Arbitration-lost 中断 标志 位 (仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 master-transmitter). ARBL primarily 表示 当 I2C 模块 has 丢失 仲裁 contest 带 another master/transmitter. CPU CAN poll ARBL 或 use ARBL 中断 请求. 0h (R/W) = 仲裁 不 丢失. AL 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - AL 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - CPU reads 中断 来源 寄存器 (I2CISRC) 及 寄存器 包含 编码 用于 AL 中断. 仿真器 reads 的 I2CISRC 执行 不 affect 此 位. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = 仲裁 丢失. AL 为 置位 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2C 模块 senses that it has 丢失 仲裁 带 two 或 more competing transmitters that started 发送 almost simultaneously. - I2C 模块 attempts 至 启动 transfer 期间 BB (总线 忙碌) 位 为 置位 至 1. 当 AL becomes 1, MST 及 STP 位 的 I2CMDR are cleared, 及 I2C 模块 becomes slave-receiver. Inter-Integrated Circuit 模块 (I2C) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：0 Arbitration-lost interrupt flag bit；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2748页；原文字段表：Arbitration-lost interrupt flag bit (only applicable when the I2C module 

is a master-transmitter).
ARBL primarily indicates when the I2C module has lost an arbitration 
contest with another master/transmitter. The CPU can poll ARBL or 
use the ARBL interrupt request.
0h (R/W) = Arbitration not lost. AL is cleared by any one of the 
following events:
- AL is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The CPU reads the interrupt source register (I2CISRC) and the 
register contains the code for an
AL interrupt. Emulator reads of the I2CISRC do not affect this bit.
- The I2C module is reset. 
1h (R/W) = Arbitration lost. AL is set by any one of the following 
events:
- The I2C module senses that it has lost an arbitration with two 
or more competing transmitters that started a transmission almost 
simultaneously.
- The I2C module attempts to start a transfer while the BB (bus busy) 
bit is set to 1.
When AL becomes 1, the MST and STP bits of I2CMDR are cleared, 
and the I2C module becomes a slave-receiver. 
Inter-Integrated Circuit Module (I2C)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: NACK
Fields.Description: No-acknowledgment 中断 标志 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：No-acknowledgment 中断 标志 位. NACK applies 当 I2C 模块 为 主机 发送器. NACK 表示 是否 I2C 模块 has 已检测 应答 位 (ACK) 或 noacknowledge 位 (NACK) 来自 从机 接收器. CPU CAN poll NACK 或 use NACK 中断 请求. 0h (R/W) = ACK received/NACK 不 已接收. 此 位 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - 应答 位 (ACK) has been sent 通过 从机 接收器. - NACK 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - CPU reads 中断 来源 寄存器 (I2CISRC) 及 寄存器 包含 编码 用于 NACK 中断. 仿真器 reads 的 I2CISRC 执行 不 affect 此 位. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = NACK 位 已接收. 硬件 detects that no- 应答 (NACK) 位 has been 已接收. Note: 期间 I2C 模块 performs general call transfer, NACK 为 1, even 如果 单次 或 more slaves send acknowledgment.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1 No-acknowledgment interrupt flag bit.；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2748页；原文字段表：No-acknowledgment interrupt flag bit.

NACK applies when the I2C module is a master transmitter. NACK 
indicates whether the I2C module has detected an acknowledge bit 
(ACK) or a noacknowledge bit (NACK) from the slave receiver. The 
CPU can poll NACK or use the NACK interrupt request.
0h (R/W) = ACK received/NACK not received. This bit is cleared by 
any one of the following events:
- An acknowledge bit (ACK) has been sent by the slave receiver.
- NACK is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The CPU reads the interrupt source register (I2CISRC) and the 
register contains the code for a NACK interrupt. Emulator reads of 
the I2CISRC do not affect this bit.
- The I2C module is reset. 
1h (R/W) = NACK bit received. The hardware detects that a no-
acknowledge (NACK) bit has been received.
Note: While the I2C module performs a general call transfer, NACK 
is 1, even if one or more slaves send acknowledgment.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: ARDY
Fields.Description: Register-access-ready 中断 标志 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Register-access-ready 中断 标志 位 (仅 Applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 中 主机 模式). ARDY 表示 that I2C 模块 寄存器 are 就绪 至 be accessed because previously programmed 地址, 数据, 及 command values have been 使用. CPU CAN poll ARDY 或 use ARDY 中断 请求 0h (R/W) = 寄存器 are 不 就绪 至 be accessed. ARDY 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2C 模块 starts using 当前 寄存器 内容. - ARDY 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = 寄存器 are 就绪 至 be accessed. 中 nonrepeat 模式 (RM = 0 中 I2CMDR): 如果 STP = 0 中 I2CMDR, ARDY 位 为 置位 当 内部 数据 计数器 counts 下降 至 0. 如果 STP = 1, ARDY 为 不 affected (instead, I2C 模块 产生 停止 条件 当 计数器 reaches 0). 中 重复 模式 (RM = 1): ARDY 为 置位 在 end 的 每个 字节 已发送 来自 I2CDXR.
Fields.Notes:
原文：2 Register-access-ready interrupt flag bit；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2747页；原文字段表：Register-access-ready interrupt flag bit (only Applicable when the 

I2C module is in the master mode).
ARDY indicates that the I2C module registers are ready to be 
accessed because the previously programmed address, data, and 
command values have been used. The CPU can poll ARDY or use 
the ARDY interrupt request
0h (R/W) = The registers are not ready to be accessed. ARDY is 
cleared by any one of the following events:
- The I2C module starts using the current register contents.
- ARDY is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The I2C module is reset. 
1h (R/W) = The registers are ready to be accessed.
In the nonrepeat mode (RM = 0 in I2CMDR): If STP = 0 in I2CMDR, 
the ARDY bit is set when the internal data counter counts down to 0. 
If STP = 1, ARDY is not affected (instead, the I2C module generates 
a STOP condition when the counter reaches 0).
In the repeat mode (RM = 1): ARDY is set at the end of each byte 
transmitted from I2CDXR.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RRDY
Fields.Description: Receive-data-ready 中断 标志 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Receive-data-ready 中断 标志 位. 当 不 中 FIFO队列 模式, RRDY 表示 that 数据 接收 寄存器 (I2CDRR) 为 就绪 至 be 读取 because 数据 has been copied 来自 接收 shift 寄存器 (I2CRSR) 至 I2CDRR. CPU CAN poll RRDY 或 use RRDY 中断 请求 当 中 FIFO队列 模式, use RXFFINT instead. 0h (R/W) = I2CDRR 不 就绪. RRDY 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2CDRR 为 读取 通过 CPU. 仿真器 reads 的 I2CDRR 执行 不 affect 此 位. - RRDY 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = I2CDRR 就绪: 数据 has been copied 来自 I2CRSR 至 I2CDRR.
Fields.Notes:
原文：3 Receive-data-ready interrupt flag bit.；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2747页；原文字段表：Receive-data-ready interrupt flag bit.

When not in FIFO mode, RRDY indicates that the data receive 
register (I2CDRR) is ready to be read because data has been copied 
from the receive shift register (I2CRSR) to I2CDRR. The CPU can 
poll RRDY or use the RRDY interrupt request When in FIFO mode, 
use RXFFINT instead.
0h (R/W) = I2CDRR not ready. RRDY is cleared by any one of the 
following events:
- I2CDRR is read by the CPU. Emulator reads of the I2CDRR do not 
affect this bit.
- RRDY is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The I2C module is reset. 
1h (R/W) = I2CDRR ready: Data has been copied from I2CRSR to 
I2CDRR.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: XRDY
Fields.Description: Transmit-data-ready 中断 标志 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Transmit-data-ready 中断 标志 位. 当 不 中 FIFO队列 模式, XRDY 表示 that 数据 发送 寄存器 (I2CDXR) 为 就绪 至 accept new 数据. FCM=0 : 当 前次 数据 has been copied 来自 I2CDXR 至 发送 shift 寄存器 (I2CXSR). CPU CAN poll XRDY 或 use XRDY 中断 请求 当 中 FIFO队列 模式, use TXFFINT instead. FCM=1: XRDY 为 已置有效 仅 当 下次 数据 为 required it gets deasserted 带 写入 至 I2CDXR. Both Polling 及 中断 based 数据 transfers are allowed 中 FCM 模式. 0h (R/W) = I2CDXR 不 就绪. XRDY 为 cleared 当 数据 为 written 至 I2CDXR. 1h (R/W) = I2CDXR 就绪: 数据 has been copied 来自 I2CDXR 至 I2CXSR. XRDY 为 also forced 至 1 当 I2C 模块 为 复位.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4 Transmit-data-ready interrupt flag bit.；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2747页；原文字段表：Transmit-data-ready interrupt flag bit. When not in FIFO mode, 

XRDY indicates that the data transmit register (I2CDXR) is ready 
to accept new data.
FCM=0 : When the previous data has been copied from I2CDXR 
to the transmit shift register (I2CXSR). The CPU can poll XRDY or 
use the XRDY interrupt request When in FIFO mode, use TXFFINT 
instead.
FCM=1: XRDY is asserted only when next data is required
it gets deasserted with write to I2CDXR. Both Polling and interrupt 
based data transfers are allowed in the FCM mode.
0h (R/W) = I2CDXR not ready. XRDY is cleared when data is written 
to I2CDXR. 
1h (R/W) = I2CDXR ready: Data has been copied from I2CDXR to 
I2CXSR.
XRDY is also forced to 1 when the I2C module is reset.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SCD
Fields.Description: 停止 条件 已检测 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：停止 条件 已检测 位. SCD 为 置位 当 I2C sends 或 receives 停止 条件. I2C 模块 delays clearing 的 I2CMDR[STP] 位 until SCD 位 为 置位. 0h (R/W) = 停止 条件 不 已检测 since SCD was 最后 cleared. SCD 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2CISRC 为 读取 通过 CPU 当 it 包含 值 110b (停止 条件 已检测). 仿真器 reads 的 I2CISRC 执行 不 affect 此 位. - SCD 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = 停止 条件 has been 已检测 开启 I2C 总线.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5 Stop condition detected bit.；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2747页；原文字段表：Stop condition detected bit.

SCD is set when the I2C sends or receives a STOP condition. The 
I2C module delays clearing of the I2CMDR[STP] bit until the SCD bit 
is set.
0h (R/W) = STOP condition not detected since SCD was last 
cleared. SCD is cleared by any one of the following events:
- I2CISRC is read by the CPU when it contains the value 110b (stop 
condition detected). Emulator reads of the I2CISRC do not affect this 
bit.
- SCD is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The I2C module is reset. 
1h (R/W) = A STOP condition has been detected on the I2C bus.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: BYTESENT
Fields.Description: 字节 发送 over 指示
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：字节 发送 over 指示. BYTESENT 为 置位 当 master/slave has successfully sent 字节 开启 SCL/SDA lines. 此 为 diagnostic 寄存器 which needs 至 be explicitly cleared 通过 软件. 中 case 不 cleared stale 状态 would keep reflecting 作为 no automated 清除 incorporated 至 avoid corner 条件. 0h (R/W) = I2C 模块 has 不 finished transmitting 下次 数据 字节. BYTESENT 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - It 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = I2C 模块 has completed 发送 的 字节. Inter-Integrated Circuit 模块 (I2C) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：6 Byte transmit over indication；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2746页；原文字段表：Byte Transmit over indication.

BYTESENT is set when the master/slave has successfully sent the 
byte on SCL/SDA lines. This is diagnostic register which needs to 
be explicitly cleared by Software. In case not cleared the stale status 
would keep reflecting as no automated clear incorporated to avoid 
corner conditions.
0h (R/W) = The I2C module has not finished transmitting the next 
data byte. BYTESENT is cleared by any one of the following events:
- It is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The I2C module is reset. 
1h (R/W) = The I2C module has completed the transmission of a 
byte. 
Inter-Integrated Circuit Module (I2C)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: rsvd1
Fields.Description: 保留位；不要用于用户配置。
Fields.Values: 按该寄存器手册要求保留；不得假定保留位都可写0。
Fields.Notes: 保留位不得用于配置。；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2746页；原文字段表：Reserved；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: AD0
Fields.Description: 地址 0 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：地址 0 位 0h (R/W) = AD0 has been cleared 通过 启动 或 停止 条件. 1h (R/W) = 地址 的 全部 zeros (general call) 为 已检测.
Fields.Notes:
原文：8 Address 0 bits；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2746页；原文字段表：Address 0 bits

0h (R/W) = AD0 has been cleared by a START or STOP condition. 
1h (R/W) = An address of all zeros (general call) is detected.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: AAS
Fields.Description: Addressed-as-slave 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Addressed-as-slave 位 0h (R/W) = 中 7-位 addressing 模式, AAS 位 为 cleared 当 receiving NACK, 停止 条件, 或 repeated 启动 条件. 中 10-位 addressing 模式, AAS 位 为 cleared 当 receiving NACK, 停止 条件, 或 通过 从机 地址 different 来自 I2C 外设's own 从机 地址. 1h (R/W) = I2C 模块 has recognized its own 从机 地址 或 地址 的 全部 zeros (general call).
Fields.Notes:
原文：9 Addressed-as-slave bit；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2746页；原文字段表：Addressed-as-slave bit

0h (R/W) = In the 7-bit addressing mode, the AAS bit is cleared 
when receiving a NACK, a STOP condition, or a repeated START 
condition. In the 10-bit addressing mode, the AAS bit is cleared when 
receiving a NACK, a STOP condition, or by a slave address different 
from the I2C peripheral's own slave address. 
1h (R/W) = The I2C module has recognized its own slave address or 
an address of all zeros (general call).；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: XSMT
Fields.Description: 发送 shift 寄存器 空 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：发送 shift 寄存器 空 位. XSMT = 0 表示 that 发送器 has experienced 下溢. 下溢 发生 当 发送 shift 寄存器 (I2CXSR) 为 空 but 数据 发送 寄存器 (I2CDXR) has 不 been loaded since 最后 I2CDXR-to-I2CXSR transfer. 下次 I2CDXR-to-I2CXSR transfer will 不 occur until new 数据 为 中 I2CDXR. 如果 new 数据 为 不 transferred 中 时间, 前次 数据 may be re-transmitted 开启 SDA 引脚. 0h (R/W) = 下溢 已检测 (空) 1h (R/W) = No 下溢 已检测 (不 空). XSMT 为 置位 通过 单次 的 following events: - 数据 为 written 至 I2CDXR. - I2C 模块 为 复位
Fields.Notes:
原文：10 Transmit shift register empty bit.；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2746页；原文字段表：Transmit shift register empty bit.

XSMT = 0 indicates that the transmitter has experienced underflow. 
Underflow occurs when the transmit shift register (I2CXSR) is empty 
but the data transmit register (I2CDXR) has not been loaded since 
the last I2CDXR-to-I2CXSR transfer. The next I2CDXR-to-I2CXSR 
transfer will not occur until new data is in I2CDXR. If new data is not 
transferred in time, the previous data may be re-transmitted on the 
SDA pin.
0h (R/W) = Underflow detected (empty) 
1h (R/W) = No underflow detected (not empty). XSMT is set by one 
of the following events:
- Data is written to I2CDXR.
- The I2C module is reset；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RSFULL
Fields.Description: 接收 shift 寄存器 满 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：接收 shift 寄存器 满 位. RSFULL 表示 溢出 条件 during 接收. 溢出 发生 当 new 数据 为 已接收 进入 shift 寄存器 (I2CRSR) 及 old 数据 has 不 been 读取 来自 接收 寄存器 (I2CDRR). 作为 new 位 arrive 来自 SDA 引脚, they overwrite 位 中 I2CRSR. new 数据 will 不 be copied 至 ICDRR until 前次 数据 为 读取. 0h (R/W) = No 溢出 已检测. RSFULL 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2CDRR 为 读取 通过 CPU. 仿真器 reads 的 I2CDRR 执行 不 affect 此 位. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = 溢出 已检测
Fields.Notes:
原文：11 Receive shift register full bit.；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2746页；原文字段表：Receive shift register full bit.

RSFULL indicates an overrun condition during reception. Overrun 
occurs when new data is received into the shift register (I2CRSR) 
and the old data has not been read from the receive register 
(I2CDRR). As new bits arrive from the SDA pin, they overwrite the 
bits in I2CRSR. The new data will not be copied to ICDRR until the 
previous data is read.
0h (R/W) = No overrun detected. RSFULL is cleared by any one of 
the following events:
- I2CDRR is read by the CPU. Emulator reads of the I2CDRR do not 
affect this bit.
- The I2C module is reset. 
1h (R/W) = Overrun detected；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: BB
Fields.Description: 总线 忙碌 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：总线 忙碌 位. BB 表示 是否 I2C-bus 为 忙碌 或 为 自由运行 用于 another 数据 transfer. See paragraph following 表 用于 more information 0h (R/W) = 总线 自由运行. BB 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2C 模块 receives 或 transmits 停止 位 (总线 自由运行). - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = 总线 忙碌: I2C 模块 has 已接收 或 已发送 启动 位 开启 总线.
Fields.Notes:
原文：12 Bus busy bit.；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2745页；原文字段表：Bus busy bit.

BB indicates whether the I2C-bus is busy or is free for another data 
transfer. See the paragraph following the table for more information
0h (R/W) = Bus free. BB is cleared by any one of the following 
events:
- The I2C module receives or transmits a STOP bit (bus free).
- The I2C module is reset. 
1h (R/W) = Bus busy: The I2C module has received or transmitted a 
START bit on the bus.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: NACKSNT
Fields.Description: NACK sent 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：NACK sent 位. 此 位 为 使用 当 I2C 模块 为 中 接收器 模式. 单次 instance 中 which NACKSNT 为 affected 为 当 NACK 模式 为 使用 (see description 用于 NACKMOD 中 0h (R/W) = NACK 不 sent. NACKSNT 位 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - It 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - I2C 模块 为 复位 (either 当 0 为 written 至 IRS 位 的 I2CMDR 或 当 whole device 为 复位). 1h (R/W) = NACK sent: no-acknowledge 位 was sent during 应答 周期 开启 I2C-bus.
Fields.Notes:
原文：13 NACK sent bit.；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2745页；原文字段表：NACK sent bit.

This bit is used when the I2C module is in the receiver mode. One 
instance in which NACKSNT is affected is when the NACK mode is 
used (see the description for NACKMOD in
0h (R/W) = NACK not sent. NACKSNT bit is cleared by any one of 
the following events:
- It is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The I2C module is reset (either when 0 is written to the IRS bit of 
I2CMDR or when the whole device is reset). 
1h (R/W) = NACK sent: A no-acknowledge bit was sent during the 
acknowledge cycle on the I2C-bus.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SDIR
Fields.Description: 从机 方向 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：从机 方向 位 0h (R/W) = I2C 为 不 addressed 作为 从机 发送器. SDIR 为 cleared 通过 单次 的 following events: - It 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - 数字 loopback 模式 为 已使能. - 启动 或 停止 条件 发生 开启 I2C 总线. 1h (R/W) = I2C 为 addressed 作为 从机 发送器.
Fields.Notes:
原文：14 Slave direction bit；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2745页；原文字段表：Slave direction bit

0h (R/W) = I2C is not addressed as a slave transmitter. SDIR is 
cleared by one of the following events:
- It is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- Digital loopback mode is enabled.
- A START or STOP condition occurs on the I2C bus. 
1h (R/W) = I2C is addressed as a slave transmitter.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Notes: 保留位不得用于配置。；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2745页；原文字段表：Reserved；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。
