Fields.Name: BC
Fields.Description: 位 计数 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：位 计数 位. BC 定义 数量 的 位 (1 至 8) 中 下次 数据 字节 that 为 至 be 已接收 或 已发送 通过 I2C 模块. 数量 的 位 已选 带 BC must 匹配 数据 长度 的 other device. Notice that 当 BC = 000b, 数据 字节 has 8 位. BC does 不 affect 地址 bytes, which always have 8 位. Note: 如果 位 计数 为 less than 8, 接收 数据 为 right-justified 中 I2CDRR(7-0), 及 other 位 的 I2CDRR(7-0) are undefined. Also, 发送 数据 written 至 I2CDXR must be right-justified 0h (R/W) = 8 位 per 数据 字节 1h (R/W) = 1 位 per 数据 字节 2h (R/W) = 2 位 per 数据 字节 3h (R/W) = 3 位 per 数据 字节 4h (R/W) = 4 位 per 数据 字节 5h (R/W) = 5 位 per 数据 字节 6h (R/W) = 6 位 per 数据 字节 7h (R/W) = 7 位 per 数据 字节 Inter-Integrated Circuit 模块 (I2C) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：2:0 Bit count bits.；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2758页；原文字段表：Bit count bits.

BC defines the number of bits (1 to 8) in the next data byte that 
is to be received or transmitted by the I2C module. The number of 
bits selected with BC must match the data size of the other device. 
Notice that when BC = 000b, a data byte has 8 bits. BC does not 
affect address bytes, which always have 8 bits.
Note: If the bit count is less than 8, receive data is right-justified in 
I2CDRR(7-0), and the other bits of I2CDRR(7-0) are undefined. Also, 
transmit data written to I2CDXR must be right-justified
0h (R/W) = 8 bits per data byte 
1h (R/W) = 1 bit per data byte 
2h (R/W) = 2 bits per data byte 
3h (R/W) = 3 bits per data byte 
4h (R/W) = 4 bits per data byte 
5h (R/W) = 5 bits per data byte 
6h (R/W) = 6 bits per data byte 
7h (R/W) = 7 bits per data byte 
Inter-Integrated Circuit Module (I2C)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: FDF
Fields.Description: 自由运行 数据 格式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：自由运行 数据 格式 模式 位. 0h (R/W) = 自由运行 数据 格式 模式 为 已禁用. Transfers use 7-/10-位 addressing 格式 已选 通过 XA 位. 1h (R/W) = 自由运行 数据 格式 模式 为 已使能. Transfers have 自由运行 数据 (no 地址) 格式 described 中 Section 9.2.5. 自由运行 数据 格式 为 不 supported 中 数字 loopback 模式 (DLB=1).
Fields.Notes:
原文：3 Free Data Format；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2757页；原文字段表：Free data format mode bit.

0h (R/W) = Free data format mode is disabled. Transfers use the 
7-/10-bit addressing format selected by the XA bit. 
1h (R/W) = Free data format mode is enabled. Transfers have the 
free data (no address) format described in Section 9.2.5.
The free data format is not supported in the digital loopback mode 
(DLB=1).；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: STB
Fields.Description: 启动 字节 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：启动 字节 模式 位. 此 位 为 仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 主机. 作为 described 中 version 2.1 的 Philips Semiconductors I2C-bus specification, 启动 字节 CAN be 使用 至 help 从机 that needs extra 时间 至 检测 启动 条件. 当 I2C 模块 为 从机, it ignores 启动 字节 来自 主机, regardless 的 值 的 STB 位. 0h (R/W) = I2C 模块 为 不 中 启动 字节 模式. 1h (R/W) = I2C 模块 为 中 启动 字节 模式. 当 you 置位 启动 条件 位 (STT), I2C 模块 begins transfer 带 more than just 启动 条件. Specifically, it 产生: 1. 启动 条件 2. 启动 字节 (0000 0001b) 3. dummy 应答 时钟 脉冲 4. repeated 启动 条件 Then, 作为 normal, I2C 模块 sends 从机 地址 that 为 中 I2CSAR.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4 START Byte Mode；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2757页；原文字段表：START byte mode bit. This bit is only applicable when the I2C 

module is a master. As described in version 2.1 of the Philips 
Semiconductors I2C-bus specification, the START byte can be used 
to help a slave that needs extra time to detect a START condition. 
When the I2C module is a slave, it ignores a START byte from a 
master, regardless of the value of the STB bit.
0h (R/W) = The I2C module is not in the START byte mode. 
1h (R/W) = The I2C module is in the START byte mode. When 
you set the START condition bit (STT), the I2C module begins 
the transfer with more than just a START condition. Specifically, it 
generates:
1. A START condition
2. A START byte (0000 0001b)
3. A dummy acknowledge clock pulse
4. A repeated START condition
Then, as normal, the I2C module sends the slave address that is in 
I2CSAR.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: IRS
Fields.Description: I2C 模块 复位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：I2C 模块 复位 位. 0h (R/W) = I2C 模块 为 中 reset/disabled. 当 此 位 为 cleared 至 0, 全部 状态 位 (中 I2CSTR) are 置位 至 their 默认 values. 1h (R/W) = I2C 模块 为 已使能. 此 has effect 的 releasing I2C 总线 如果 I2C 外设 为 holding it.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5 I2C Module Reset；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2757页；原文字段表：I2C module reset bit.

0h (R/W) = The I2C module is in reset/disabled. When this bit is 
cleared to 0, all status bits (in I2CSTR) are set to their default values. 
1h (R/W) = The I2C module is enabled. This has the effect of 
releasing the I2C bus if the I2C peripheral is holding it.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: DLB
Fields.Description: 数字 Loopback 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：数字 loopback 模式 位. 0h (R/W) = 数字 loopback 模式 为 已禁用. 1h (R/W) = 数字 loopback 模式 为 已使能. 用于 proper 操作 中 此 模式, MST 位 must be 1. 中 数字 loopback 模式, 数据 已发送 out 的 I2CDXR 为 已接收 中 I2CDRR after n device cycles 通过 内部 路径, where: n = ((I2C 输入 时钟 frequency/module 时钟 频率) x 8) 发送 时钟 为 also 接收 时钟. 地址 已发送 开启 SDA 引脚 为 地址 中 I2COAR. Note: 自由运行 数据 格式 (FDF = 1) 为 不 supported 中 数字 loopback 模式.
Fields.Notes:
原文：6 Digital Loopback Mode；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2757页；原文字段表：Digital loopback mode bit.

0h (R/W) = Digital loopback mode is disabled. 
1h (R/W) = Digital loopback mode is enabled. For proper operation in 
this mode, the MST bit must be 1.
In the digital loopback mode, data transmitted out of I2CDXR is 
received in I2CDRR after n device cycles by an internal path, where:
n = ((I2C input clock frequency/module clock frequency) x 8)
The transmit clock is also the receive clock. The address transmitted 
on the SDA pin is the address in I2COAR.
Note: The free data format (FDF = 1) is not supported in the digital 
loopback mode.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RM
Fields.Description: 重复 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：重复 模式 位 (仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 主机- 发送器 或 master-receiver). RM, STT, 及 STP 位 determine 当 I2C 模块 starts 及 stops 数据 transmissions 0h (R/W) = Nonrepeat 模式. 值 中 数据 计数 寄存器 (I2CCNT) 决定 how many bytes are received/transmitted 通过 I2C 模块. 1h (R/W) = 重复 模式. 数据 字节 为 已发送 每个 时间 I2CDXR 寄存器 为 written 至 (或 until 发送 FIFO队列 为 空 当 中 FIFO队列 模式) until STP 位 为 manually 置位. 值 的 I2CCNT 为 忽略. ARDY bit/interrupt CAN be 使用 至 determine 当 I2CDXR (或 FIFO队列) 为 就绪 用于 more 数据, 或 当 数据 has 全部 been sent 及 CPU 为 allowed 至 写入 至 STP 位. Inter-Integrated Circuit 模块 (I2C) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：7 Repeat Mode；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2756页；原文字段表：Repeat mode bit (only applicable when the I2C module is a master-

transmitter or master-receiver).
The RM, STT, and STP bits determine when the I2C module starts 
and stops data transmissions
0h (R/W) = Nonrepeat mode. The value in the data count register 
(I2CCNT) determines how many bytes are
received/transmitted by the I2C module. 
1h (R/W) = Repeat mode. A data byte is transmitted each time the 
I2CDXR register is written to (or until the transmit FIFO is empty 
when in FIFO mode) until the STP bit is manually set. The value of 
I2CCNT is ignored. The ARDY bit/interrupt can be used to determine 
when the I2CDXR (or FIFO) is ready for more data, or when the data 
has all been sent and the CPU is allowed to write to the STP bit. 
Inter-Integrated Circuit Module (I2C)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: XA
Fields.Description: Expanded 地址 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Expanded 地址 使能 位. 0h (R/W) = 7-位 addressing 模式 (normal 地址 模式). I2C 模块 transmits 7-位 从机 addresses (来自 位 6-0 的 I2CSAR), 及 its own 从机 地址 has 7 位 (位 6-0 的 I2COAR). 1h (R/W) = 10-位 addressing 模式 (expanded 地址 模式). I2C 模块 transmits 10-位 从机 addresses (来自 位 9-0 的 I2CSAR), 及 its own 从机 地址 has 10 位 (位 9-0 的 I2COAR).
Fields.Notes:
原文：8 Expanded Address Mode；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2756页；原文字段表：Expanded address enable bit.

0h (R/W) = 7-bit addressing mode (normal address mode). The I2C 
module transmits 7-bit slave addresses (from bits 6-0 of I2CSAR), 
and its own slave address has 7 bits (bits 6-0 of I2COAR). 
1h (R/W) = 10-bit addressing mode (expanded address mode). 
The I2C module transmits 10-bit slave addresses (from bits 9-0 
of I2CSAR), and its own slave address has 10 bits (bits 9-0 of 
I2COAR).；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TRX
Fields.Description: 发送器 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：发送器 模式 位. 当 relevant, TRX 选择 是否 I2C 模块 为 中 发送器 模式 或 接收器 模式. 0h (R/W) = 接收器 模式. I2C 模块 为 接收器 及 receives 数据 开启 SDA 引脚. 1h (R/W) = 发送器 模式. I2C 模块 为 发送器 及 transmits 数据 开启 SDA 引脚.
Fields.Notes:
原文：9 Transmitter Mode；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2756页；原文字段表：Transmitter mode bit.

When relevant, TRX selects whether the I2C module is in the 
transmitter mode or the receiver mode.
0h (R/W) = Receiver mode. The I2C module is a receiver and 
receives data on the SDA pin. 
1h (R/W) = Transmitter mode. The I2C module is a transmitter and 
transmits data on the SDA pin.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: MST
Fields.Description: 主机 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：主机 模式 位. MST 决定 是否 I2C 模块 为 中 从机 模式 或 主机 模式. MST 为 automatically changed 来自 1 至 0 当 I2C 主机 产生 停止 条件 0h (R/W) = 从机 模式. I2C 模块 为 从机 及 receives serial 时钟 来自 主机. 1h (R/W) = 主机 模式. I2C 模块 为 主机 及 产生 serial 时钟 开启 SCL 引脚.
Fields.Notes:
原文：10 Master Mode；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2756页；原文字段表：Master mode bit.

MST determines whether the I2C module is in the slave mode or the 
master mode. MST is automatically changed from 1 to 0 when the 
I2C master generates a STOP condition
0h (R/W) = Slave mode. The I2C module is a slave and receives the 
serial clock from the master. 
1h (R/W) = Master mode. The I2C module is a master and generates 
the serial clock on the SCL pin.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: STP
Fields.Description: 停止 条件
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：停止 条件 位 (仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 主机). 中 主机 模式, RM,STT, 及 STP 位 determine 当 I2C 模块 starts 及 stops 数据 transmissions. Note that STT 及 STP 位 CAN be 使用 至 terminate 重复 模式, 及 that 此 位 为 不 writable 当 IRS=0. 当 中 非- 重复 模式, 在 最低 单次 字节 must be transferred before 停止 条件 CAN be 已产生. I2C 模块 delays clearing 的 此 位 until after I2CSTR[SCD] 位 为 置位. 至 avoid disrupting I2C 状态 machine, user must wait until 此 位 为 清除 before initiating new 报文. 0h (R/W) = STP 为 automatically cleared after 停止 条件 has been 已产生 1h (R/W) = STP has been 置位 通过 device 至 产生 停止 条件 当 内部 数据 计数器 的 I2C 模块 counts 下降 至 0.
Fields.Notes:
原文：11 STOP Condition；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2756页；原文字段表：STOP condition bit (only applicable when the I2C module is a 

master).
In the master mode, the RM,STT, and STP bits determine when the 
I2C module starts and stops data transmissions.
Note that the STT and STP bits can be used to terminate the repeat 
mode, and that this bit is not writable when IRS=0. When in non-
repeat mode, at least one byte must be transferred before a stop 
condition can be generated. The I2C module delays clearing of this 
bit until after the I2CSTR[SCD] bit is set. To avoid disrupting the 
I2C state machine, the user must wait until this bit is clear before 
initiating a new message.
0h (R/W) = STP is automatically cleared after the STOP condition 
has been generated 
1h (R/W) = STP has been set by the device to generate a STOP 
condition when the internal data counter of the I2C module counts 
down to 0.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: STT
Fields.Description: 启动 条件 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：启动 条件 位 (仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 主机). RM, STT, 及 STP 位 determine 当 I2C 模块 starts 及 stops 数据 transmissions (see 表 9-6). Note that STT 及 STP 位 CAN be 使用 至 terminate 重复 模式, 及 that 此 位 为 不 writable 当 IRS = 0. 0h (R/W) = 中 主机 模式, STT 为 automatically cleared after 启动 条件 has been 已产生. 1h (R/W) = 中 主机 模式, 设置 STT 至 1 causes I2C 模块 至 产生 启动 条件 开启 I2C-bus
Fields.Notes:
原文：13 START condition bit；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2755页；原文字段表：START condition bit (only applicable when the I2C module is a 

master). The RM, STT, and STP bits determine when the I2C module 
starts and stops data transmissions (see Table 9-6). Note that the 
STT and STP bits can be used to terminate the repeat mode, and 
that this bit is not writable when IRS = 0.
0h (R/W) = In the master mode, STT is automatically cleared after 
the START condition has been generated. 
1h (R/W) = In the master mode, setting STT to 1 causes the I2C 
module to generate a START condition on the I2C-bus；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: FREE
Fields.Description: 调试 动作
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：此 位 控制 动作 taken 通过 I2C 模块 当 debugger breakpoint 为 encountered. 0h (R/W) = 当 I2C 模块 为 主机: 如果 SCL 为 低 当 breakpoint 发生, I2C 模块 stops immediately 及 keeps driving SCL 低, 是否 I2C 模块 为 发送器 或 接收器. 如果 SCL 为 高, I2C 模块 waits until SCL becomes 低 及 then stops. 当 I2C 模块 为 从机: breakpoint forces I2C 模块 至 停止 当 当前 transmission/reception 为 complete. 1h (R/W) = I2C 模块 runs 自由运行 that 为, it continues 至 operate 当 breakpoint 发生.
Fields.Notes:
原文：14 Debug Action；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2755页；原文字段表：This bit controls the action taken by the I2C module when a 

debugger breakpoint is encountered.
0h (R/W) = When I2C module is master:
If SCL is low when the breakpoint occurs, the I2C module stops 
immediately and keeps driving SCL low, whether the I2C module is 
the transmitter or the receiver. If SCL is high, the I2C module waits 
until SCL becomes low and then stops.
When I2C module is slave:
A breakpoint forces the I2C module to stop when the current 
transmission/reception is complete. 
1h (R/W) = The I2C module runs free
that is, it continues to operate when a breakpoint occurs.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: NACKMOD
Fields.Description: NACK 模式 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：NACK 模式 位. 此 位 为 仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 acting 作为 接收器. 0h (R/W) = 中 slave-receiver 模式: I2C 模块 sends 应答 (ACK) 位 至 发送器 during 每个 应答 周期 开启 总线. I2C 模块 仅 sends no-acknowledge (NACK) 位 如果 you 置位 NACKMOD 位. 中 master-receiver 模式: I2C 模块 sends ACK 位 during 每个 应答 周期 until 内部 数据 计数器 counts 下降 至 0. 在 that point, I2C 模块 sends NACK 位 至 发送器. 至 have NACK 位 sent earlier, you must 置位 NACKMOD 位 1h (R/W) = 中 either slave-receiver 或 master-receiver 模式: I2C 模块 sends NACK 位 至 发送器 during 下次 应答 周期 开启 总线. Once NACK 位 has been sent, NACKMOD 为 cleared. Important: 至 send NACK 位 中 下次 应答 周期, you must 置位 NACKMOD before 上升沿 边沿 的 最后 数据 位.
Fields.Notes:
原文：15 NACK mode bit；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2755页；原文字段表：NACK mode bit. This bit is only applicable when the I2C module is 

acting as a receiver.
0h (R/W) = In the slave-receiver mode: The I2C module sends an 
acknowledge (ACK) bit to the transmitter during each acknowledge 
cycle on the bus. The I2C module only sends a no-acknowledge 
(NACK) bit if you set the NACKMOD bit.
In the master-receiver mode: The I2C module sends an ACK bit 
during each acknowledge cycle until the internal data counter counts 
down to 0. At that point, the I2C module sends a NACK bit to 
the transmitter. To have a NACK bit sent earlier, you must set the 
NACKMOD bit 
1h (R/W) = In either slave-receiver or master-receiver mode: The 
I2C module sends a NACK bit to the transmitter during the next 
acknowledge cycle on the bus. Once the NACK bit has been sent, 
NACKMOD is cleared.
Important: To send a NACK bit in the next acknowledge cycle, you 
must set NACKMOD before the rising edge of the last data bit.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INTCODE
Fields.Description: 中断 编码 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：中断 编码 位. binary 编码 中 INTCODE 表示 事件 that 已产生 I2C 中断. CPU 读取 will 清除 此 field. 如果 another 低位 优先级 中断 为 待处理 及 已使能, 值 corresponding 至 that 中断 will then be loaded. Otherwise, 值 will stay cleared. 中断 events below are listed 中 descending order 的 优先级. That 为 INTCODE 1 (仲裁 丢失) has highest 优先级 及 INTCODE 7 (Addressed 作为 从机) has lowest 优先级. 中 case 的 仲裁 丢失, no-acknowledgment 条件 已检测, 或 停止 条件 已检测, CPU 读取 will also 清除 associated 中断 标志 位 中 I2CSTR 寄存器. 仿真器 reads will 不 affect 状态 的 此 field 或 的 状态 位 中 I2CSTR 寄存器. 0h (R/W) = None 1h (R/W) = 仲裁 丢失 2h (R/W) = No-acknowledgment 条件 已检测 3h (R/W) = 寄存器 就绪 至 be accessed 4h (R/W) = 接收 数据 就绪 5h (R/W) = 发送 数据 就绪 6h (R/W) = 停止 条件 已检测 7h (R/W) = Addressed 作为 从机
Fields.Notes:
原文：2:0 Interrupt code bits.；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2759页；原文字段表：Interrupt code bits.

The binary code in INTCODE indicates the event that generated an 
I2C interrupt.
A CPU read will clear this field. If another lower priority interrupt is 
pending and enabled, the value corresponding to that interrupt will 
then be loaded. Otherwise, the value will stay cleared.
The interrupt events below are listed in descending order of priority. 
That is INTCODE 1 (Arbitration lost) has the highest priority and 
INTCODE 7 (Addressed as slave) has the lowest priority.
In the case of an arbitration lost, a no-acknowledgment condition 
detected, or a stop condition detected, a CPU read will also clear the 
associated interrupt flag bit in the I2CSTR register.
Emulator reads will not affect the state of this field or of the status 
bits in the I2CSTR register.
0h (R/W) = None 
1h (R/W) = Arbitration lost 
2h (R/W) = No-acknowledgment condition detected 
3h (R/W) = Registers ready to be accessed 
4h (R/W) = Receive data ready 
5h (R/W) = Transmit data ready 
6h (R/W) = Stop condition detected 
7h (R/W) = Addressed as slave；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TXFFIL
Fields.Description: 发送 FIFO队列 中断 电平
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：发送 FIFO队列 中断 电平. These 位 置位 状态 电平 that will 置位 发送 中断 标志. 当 TXFFST4-0 位 reach 值 equal 至 或 less than these 位, TXFFINT 标志 will be 置位. 此 will 产生 中断 如果 TXFFIENA 位 为 置位. Because I2C 开启 此 device has 16-电平 发送 FIFO队列, these 位 cannot be configured 用于 中断 的 more than 16 FIFO队列 levels.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4:0 Transmit FIFO Interrupt Level；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2763页；原文字段表：Transmit FIFO interrupt level.

These bits set the status level that will set the transmit interrupt flag. 
When the TXFFST4-0 bits reach a value equal to or less than these 
bits, the TXFFINT flag will be set. This will generate an interrupt if the 
TXFFIENA bit is set. Because the I2C on this device has a 16-level 
transmit FIFO, these bits cannot be configured for an interrupt of 
more than 16 FIFO levels.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Notes:
原文：4:0 Receive FIFO Interrupt Level；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2764页；原文字段表：Receive FIFO interrupt level.

These bits set the status level that will set the receive interrupt flag. 
When the RXFFST4-0 bits reach a value equal to or greater than 
these bits, the RXFFINT flag is set. This will generate an interrupt if 
the RXFFIENA bit is set.
Note: Since these bits are reset to zero, the receive FIFO interrupt 
flag will be set if the receive FIFO operation is enabled and the I2C 
is taken out of reset. This will generate a receive FIFO interrupt if 
enabled. To avoid this, modify these bits on the same instruction as 
or prior to setting the RXFFRST bit. Because the I2C on this device 
has a 16-level receive FIFO, these bits cannot be configured for an 
interrupt of more than 16 FIFO levels.

Fields.Name: ARBL
Fields.Description: Arbitration-lost 中断 标志 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Arbitration-lost 中断 标志 位 (仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 master-transmitter). ARBL primarily 表示 当 I2C 模块 has 丢失 仲裁 contest 带 another master/transmitter. CPU CAN poll ARBL 或 use ARBL 中断 请求. 0h (R/W) = 仲裁 不 丢失. AL 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - AL 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - CPU reads 中断 来源 寄存器 (I2CISRC) 及 寄存器 包含 编码 用于 AL 中断. 仿真器 reads 的 I2CISRC 执行 不 affect 此 位. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = 仲裁 丢失. AL 为 置位 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2C 模块 senses that it has 丢失 仲裁 带 two 或 more competing transmitters that started 发送 almost simultaneously. - I2C 模块 attempts 至 启动 transfer 期间 BB (总线 忙碌) 位 为 置位 至 1. 当 AL becomes 1, MST 及 STP 位 的 I2CMDR are cleared, 及 I2C 模块 becomes slave-receiver. Inter-Integrated Circuit 模块 (I2C) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：0 Arbitration-lost interrupt flag bit；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2748页；原文字段表：Arbitration-lost interrupt flag bit (only applicable when the I2C module 

is a master-transmitter).
ARBL primarily indicates when the I2C module has lost an arbitration 
contest with another master/transmitter. The CPU can poll ARBL or 
use the ARBL interrupt request.
0h (R/W) = Arbitration not lost. AL is cleared by any one of the 
following events:
- AL is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The CPU reads the interrupt source register (I2CISRC) and the 
register contains the code for an
AL interrupt. Emulator reads of the I2CISRC do not affect this bit.
- The I2C module is reset. 
1h (R/W) = Arbitration lost. AL is set by any one of the following 
events:
- The I2C module senses that it has lost an arbitration with two 
or more competing transmitters that started a transmission almost 
simultaneously.
- The I2C module attempts to start a transfer while the BB (bus busy) 
bit is set to 1.
When AL becomes 1, the MST and STP bits of I2CMDR are cleared, 
and the I2C module becomes a slave-receiver. 
Inter-Integrated Circuit Module (I2C)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: NACK
Fields.Description: No-acknowledgment 中断 标志 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：No-acknowledgment 中断 标志 位. NACK applies 当 I2C 模块 为 主机 发送器. NACK 表示 是否 I2C 模块 has 已检测 应答 位 (ACK) 或 noacknowledge 位 (NACK) 来自 从机 接收器. CPU CAN poll NACK 或 use NACK 中断 请求. 0h (R/W) = ACK received/NACK 不 已接收. 此 位 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - 应答 位 (ACK) has been sent 通过 从机 接收器. - NACK 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - CPU reads 中断 来源 寄存器 (I2CISRC) 及 寄存器 包含 编码 用于 NACK 中断. 仿真器 reads 的 I2CISRC 执行 不 affect 此 位. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = NACK 位 已接收. 硬件 detects that no- 应答 (NACK) 位 has been 已接收. Note: 期间 I2C 模块 performs general call transfer, NACK 为 1, even 如果 单次 或 more slaves send acknowledgment.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1 No-acknowledgment interrupt flag bit.；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2748页；原文字段表：No-acknowledgment interrupt flag bit.

NACK applies when the I2C module is a master transmitter. NACK 
indicates whether the I2C module has detected an acknowledge bit 
(ACK) or a noacknowledge bit (NACK) from the slave receiver. The 
CPU can poll NACK or use the NACK interrupt request.
0h (R/W) = ACK received/NACK not received. This bit is cleared by 
any one of the following events:
- An acknowledge bit (ACK) has been sent by the slave receiver.
- NACK is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The CPU reads the interrupt source register (I2CISRC) and the 
register contains the code for a NACK interrupt. Emulator reads of 
the I2CISRC do not affect this bit.
- The I2C module is reset. 
1h (R/W) = NACK bit received. The hardware detects that a no-
acknowledge (NACK) bit has been received.
Note: While the I2C module performs a general call transfer, NACK 
is 1, even if one or more slaves send acknowledgment.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: ARDY
Fields.Description: Register-access-ready 中断 标志 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Register-access-ready 中断 标志 位 (仅 Applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 中 主机 模式). ARDY 表示 that I2C 模块 寄存器 are 就绪 至 be accessed because previously programmed 地址, 数据, 及 command values have been 使用. CPU CAN poll ARDY 或 use ARDY 中断 请求 0h (R/W) = 寄存器 are 不 就绪 至 be accessed. ARDY 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2C 模块 starts using 当前 寄存器 内容. - ARDY 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = 寄存器 are 就绪 至 be accessed. 中 nonrepeat 模式 (RM = 0 中 I2CMDR): 如果 STP = 0 中 I2CMDR, ARDY 位 为 置位 当 内部 数据 计数器 counts 下降 至 0. 如果 STP = 1, ARDY 为 不 affected (instead, I2C 模块 产生 停止 条件 当 计数器 reaches 0). 中 重复 模式 (RM = 1): ARDY 为 置位 在 end 的 每个 字节 已发送 来自 I2CDXR.
Fields.Notes:
原文：2 Register-access-ready interrupt flag bit；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2747页；原文字段表：Register-access-ready interrupt flag bit (only Applicable when the 

I2C module is in the master mode).
ARDY indicates that the I2C module registers are ready to be 
accessed because the previously programmed address, data, and 
command values have been used. The CPU can poll ARDY or use 
the ARDY interrupt request
0h (R/W) = The registers are not ready to be accessed. ARDY is 
cleared by any one of the following events:
- The I2C module starts using the current register contents.
- ARDY is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The I2C module is reset. 
1h (R/W) = The registers are ready to be accessed.
In the nonrepeat mode (RM = 0 in I2CMDR): If STP = 0 in I2CMDR, 
the ARDY bit is set when the internal data counter counts down to 0. 
If STP = 1, ARDY is not affected (instead, the I2C module generates 
a STOP condition when the counter reaches 0).
In the repeat mode (RM = 1): ARDY is set at the end of each byte 
transmitted from I2CDXR.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RRDY
Fields.Description: Receive-data-ready 中断 标志 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Receive-data-ready 中断 标志 位. 当 不 中 FIFO队列 模式, RRDY 表示 that 数据 接收 寄存器 (I2CDRR) 为 就绪 至 be 读取 because 数据 has been copied 来自 接收 shift 寄存器 (I2CRSR) 至 I2CDRR. CPU CAN poll RRDY 或 use RRDY 中断 请求 当 中 FIFO队列 模式, use RXFFINT instead. 0h (R/W) = I2CDRR 不 就绪. RRDY 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2CDRR 为 读取 通过 CPU. 仿真器 reads 的 I2CDRR 执行 不 affect 此 位. - RRDY 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = I2CDRR 就绪: 数据 has been copied 来自 I2CRSR 至 I2CDRR.
Fields.Notes:
原文：3 Receive-data-ready interrupt flag bit.；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2747页；原文字段表：Receive-data-ready interrupt flag bit.

When not in FIFO mode, RRDY indicates that the data receive 
register (I2CDRR) is ready to be read because data has been copied 
from the receive shift register (I2CRSR) to I2CDRR. The CPU can 
poll RRDY or use the RRDY interrupt request When in FIFO mode, 
use RXFFINT instead.
0h (R/W) = I2CDRR not ready. RRDY is cleared by any one of the 
following events:
- I2CDRR is read by the CPU. Emulator reads of the I2CDRR do not 
affect this bit.
- RRDY is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The I2C module is reset. 
1h (R/W) = I2CDRR ready: Data has been copied from I2CRSR to 
I2CDRR.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: XRDY
Fields.Description: Transmit-data-ready 中断 标志 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Transmit-data-ready 中断 标志 位. 当 不 中 FIFO队列 模式, XRDY 表示 that 数据 发送 寄存器 (I2CDXR) 为 就绪 至 accept new 数据. FCM=0 : 当 前次 数据 has been copied 来自 I2CDXR 至 发送 shift 寄存器 (I2CXSR). CPU CAN poll XRDY 或 use XRDY 中断 请求 当 中 FIFO队列 模式, use TXFFINT instead. FCM=1: XRDY 为 已置有效 仅 当 下次 数据 为 required it gets deasserted 带 写入 至 I2CDXR. Both Polling 及 中断 based 数据 transfers are allowed 中 FCM 模式. 0h (R/W) = I2CDXR 不 就绪. XRDY 为 cleared 当 数据 为 written 至 I2CDXR. 1h (R/W) = I2CDXR 就绪: 数据 has been copied 来自 I2CDXR 至 I2CXSR. XRDY 为 also forced 至 1 当 I2C 模块 为 复位.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4 Transmit-data-ready interrupt flag bit.；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2747页；原文字段表：Transmit-data-ready interrupt flag bit. When not in FIFO mode, 

XRDY indicates that the data transmit register (I2CDXR) is ready 
to accept new data.
FCM=0 : When the previous data has been copied from I2CDXR 
to the transmit shift register (I2CXSR). The CPU can poll XRDY or 
use the XRDY interrupt request When in FIFO mode, use TXFFINT 
instead.
FCM=1: XRDY is asserted only when next data is required
it gets deasserted with write to I2CDXR. Both Polling and interrupt 
based data transfers are allowed in the FCM mode.
0h (R/W) = I2CDXR not ready. XRDY is cleared when data is written 
to I2CDXR. 
1h (R/W) = I2CDXR ready: Data has been copied from I2CDXR to 
I2CXSR.
XRDY is also forced to 1 when the I2C module is reset.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SCD
Fields.Description: 停止 条件 已检测 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：停止 条件 已检测 位. SCD 为 置位 当 I2C sends 或 receives 停止 条件. I2C 模块 delays clearing 的 I2CMDR[STP] 位 until SCD 位 为 置位. 0h (R/W) = 停止 条件 不 已检测 since SCD was 最后 cleared. SCD 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2CISRC 为 读取 通过 CPU 当 it 包含 值 110b (停止 条件 已检测). 仿真器 reads 的 I2CISRC 执行 不 affect 此 位. - SCD 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = 停止 条件 has been 已检测 开启 I2C 总线.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5 Stop condition detected bit.；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2747页；原文字段表：Stop condition detected bit.

SCD is set when the I2C sends or receives a STOP condition. The 
I2C module delays clearing of the I2CMDR[STP] bit until the SCD bit 
is set.
0h (R/W) = STOP condition not detected since SCD was last 
cleared. SCD is cleared by any one of the following events:
- I2CISRC is read by the CPU when it contains the value 110b (stop 
condition detected). Emulator reads of the I2CISRC do not affect this 
bit.
- SCD is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The I2C module is reset. 
1h (R/W) = A STOP condition has been detected on the I2C bus.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: BYTESENT
Fields.Description: 字节 发送 over 指示
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：字节 发送 over 指示. BYTESENT 为 置位 当 master/slave has successfully sent 字节 开启 SCL/SDA lines. 此 为 diagnostic 寄存器 which needs 至 be explicitly cleared 通过 软件. 中 case 不 cleared stale 状态 would keep reflecting 作为 no automated 清除 incorporated 至 avoid corner 条件. 0h (R/W) = I2C 模块 has 不 finished transmitting 下次 数据 字节. BYTESENT 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - It 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = I2C 模块 has completed 发送 的 字节. Inter-Integrated Circuit 模块 (I2C) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：6 Byte transmit over indication；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2746页；原文字段表：Byte Transmit over indication.

BYTESENT is set when the master/slave has successfully sent the 
byte on SCL/SDA lines. This is diagnostic register which needs to 
be explicitly cleared by Software. In case not cleared the stale status 
would keep reflecting as no automated clear incorporated to avoid 
corner conditions.
0h (R/W) = The I2C module has not finished transmitting the next 
data byte. BYTESENT is cleared by any one of the following events:
- It is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The I2C module is reset. 
1h (R/W) = The I2C module has completed the transmission of a 
byte. 
Inter-Integrated Circuit Module (I2C)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: rsvd1
Fields.Description: 保留位；不要用于用户配置。
Fields.Values: 按该寄存器手册要求保留；不得假定保留位都可写0。
Fields.Notes: 保留位不得用于配置。；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2746页；原文字段表：Reserved；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: AD0
Fields.Description: 地址 0 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：地址 0 位 0h (R/W) = AD0 has been cleared 通过 启动 或 停止 条件. 1h (R/W) = 地址 的 全部 zeros (general call) 为 已检测.
Fields.Notes:
原文：8 Address 0 bits；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2746页；原文字段表：Address 0 bits

0h (R/W) = AD0 has been cleared by a START or STOP condition. 
1h (R/W) = An address of all zeros (general call) is detected.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: AAS
Fields.Description: Addressed-as-slave 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Addressed-as-slave 位 0h (R/W) = 中 7-位 addressing 模式, AAS 位 为 cleared 当 receiving NACK, 停止 条件, 或 repeated 启动 条件. 中 10-位 addressing 模式, AAS 位 为 cleared 当 receiving NACK, 停止 条件, 或 通过 从机 地址 different 来自 I2C 外设's own 从机 地址. 1h (R/W) = I2C 模块 has recognized its own 从机 地址 或 地址 的 全部 zeros (general call).
Fields.Notes:
原文：9 Addressed-as-slave bit；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2746页；原文字段表：Addressed-as-slave bit

0h (R/W) = In the 7-bit addressing mode, the AAS bit is cleared 
when receiving a NACK, a STOP condition, or a repeated START 
condition. In the 10-bit addressing mode, the AAS bit is cleared when 
receiving a NACK, a STOP condition, or by a slave address different 
from the I2C peripheral's own slave address. 
1h (R/W) = The I2C module has recognized its own slave address or 
an address of all zeros (general call).；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: XSMT
Fields.Description: 发送 shift 寄存器 空 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：发送 shift 寄存器 空 位. XSMT = 0 表示 that 发送器 has experienced 下溢. 下溢 发生 当 发送 shift 寄存器 (I2CXSR) 为 空 but 数据 发送 寄存器 (I2CDXR) has 不 been loaded since 最后 I2CDXR-to-I2CXSR transfer. 下次 I2CDXR-to-I2CXSR transfer will 不 occur until new 数据 为 中 I2CDXR. 如果 new 数据 为 不 transferred 中 时间, 前次 数据 may be re-transmitted 开启 SDA 引脚. 0h (R/W) = 下溢 已检测 (空) 1h (R/W) = No 下溢 已检测 (不 空). XSMT 为 置位 通过 单次 的 following events: - 数据 为 written 至 I2CDXR. - I2C 模块 为 复位
Fields.Notes:
原文：10 Transmit shift register empty bit.；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2746页；原文字段表：Transmit shift register empty bit.

XSMT = 0 indicates that the transmitter has experienced underflow. 
Underflow occurs when the transmit shift register (I2CXSR) is empty 
but the data transmit register (I2CDXR) has not been loaded since 
the last I2CDXR-to-I2CXSR transfer. The next I2CDXR-to-I2CXSR 
transfer will not occur until new data is in I2CDXR. If new data is not 
transferred in time, the previous data may be re-transmitted on the 
SDA pin.
0h (R/W) = Underflow detected (empty) 
1h (R/W) = No underflow detected (not empty). XSMT is set by one 
of the following events:
- Data is written to I2CDXR.
- The I2C module is reset；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RSFULL
Fields.Description: 接收 shift 寄存器 满 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：接收 shift 寄存器 满 位. RSFULL 表示 溢出 条件 during 接收. 溢出 发生 当 new 数据 为 已接收 进入 shift 寄存器 (I2CRSR) 及 old 数据 has 不 been 读取 来自 接收 寄存器 (I2CDRR). 作为 new 位 arrive 来自 SDA 引脚, they overwrite 位 中 I2CRSR. new 数据 will 不 be copied 至 ICDRR until 前次 数据 为 读取. 0h (R/W) = No 溢出 已检测. RSFULL 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2CDRR 为 读取 通过 CPU. 仿真器 reads 的 I2CDRR 执行 不 affect 此 位. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = 溢出 已检测
Fields.Notes:
原文：11 Receive shift register full bit.；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2746页；原文字段表：Receive shift register full bit.

RSFULL indicates an overrun condition during reception. Overrun 
occurs when new data is received into the shift register (I2CRSR) 
and the old data has not been read from the receive register 
(I2CDRR). As new bits arrive from the SDA pin, they overwrite the 
bits in I2CRSR. The new data will not be copied to ICDRR until the 
previous data is read.
0h (R/W) = No overrun detected. RSFULL is cleared by any one of 
the following events:
- I2CDRR is read by the CPU. Emulator reads of the I2CDRR do not 
affect this bit.
- The I2C module is reset. 
1h (R/W) = Overrun detected；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: BB
Fields.Description: 总线 忙碌 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：总线 忙碌 位. BB 表示 是否 I2C-bus 为 忙碌 或 为 自由运行 用于 another 数据 transfer. See paragraph following 表 用于 more information 0h (R/W) = 总线 自由运行. BB 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2C 模块 receives 或 transmits 停止 位 (总线 自由运行). - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = 总线 忙碌: I2C 模块 has 已接收 或 已发送 启动 位 开启 总线.
Fields.Notes:
原文：12 Bus busy bit.；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2745页；原文字段表：Bus busy bit.

BB indicates whether the I2C-bus is busy or is free for another data 
transfer. See the paragraph following the table for more information
0h (R/W) = Bus free. BB is cleared by any one of the following 
events:
- The I2C module receives or transmits a STOP bit (bus free).
- The I2C module is reset. 
1h (R/W) = Bus busy: The I2C module has received or transmitted a 
START bit on the bus.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: NACKSNT
Fields.Description: NACK sent 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：NACK sent 位. 此 位 为 使用 当 I2C 模块 为 中 接收器 模式. 单次 instance 中 which NACKSNT 为 affected 为 当 NACK 模式 为 使用 (see description 用于 NACKMOD 中 0h (R/W) = NACK 不 sent. NACKSNT 位 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - It 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - I2C 模块 为 复位 (either 当 0 为 written 至 IRS 位 的 I2CMDR 或 当 whole device 为 复位). 1h (R/W) = NACK sent: no-acknowledge 位 was sent during 应答 周期 开启 I2C-bus.
Fields.Notes:
原文：13 NACK sent bit.；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2745页；原文字段表：NACK sent bit.

This bit is used when the I2C module is in the receiver mode. One 
instance in which NACKSNT is affected is when the NACK mode is 
used (see the description for NACKMOD in
0h (R/W) = NACK not sent. NACKSNT bit is cleared by any one of 
the following events:
- It is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The I2C module is reset (either when 0 is written to the IRS bit of 
I2CMDR or when the whole device is reset). 
1h (R/W) = NACK sent: A no-acknowledge bit was sent during the 
acknowledge cycle on the I2C-bus.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SDIR
Fields.Description: 从机 方向 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：从机 方向 位 0h (R/W) = I2C 为 不 addressed 作为 从机 发送器. SDIR 为 cleared 通过 单次 的 following events: - It 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - 数字 loopback 模式 为 已使能. - 启动 或 停止 条件 发生 开启 I2C 总线. 1h (R/W) = I2C 为 addressed 作为 从机 发送器.
Fields.Notes:
原文：14 Slave direction bit；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2745页；原文字段表：Slave direction bit

0h (R/W) = I2C is not addressed as a slave transmitter. SDIR is 
cleared by one of the following events:
- It is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- Digital loopback mode is enabled.
- A START or STOP condition occurs on the I2C bus. 
1h (R/W) = I2C is addressed as a slave transmitter.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: BC
Fields.Description: 位 计数 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：位 计数 位. BC 定义 数量 的 位 (1 至 8) 中 下次 数据 字节 that 为 至 be 已接收 或 已发送 通过 I2C 模块. 数量 的 位 已选 带 BC must 匹配 数据 长度 的 other device. Notice that 当 BC = 000b, 数据 字节 has 8 位. BC does 不 affect 地址 bytes, which always have 8 位. Note: 如果 位 计数 为 less than 8, 接收 数据 为 right-justified 中 I2CDRR(7-0), 及 other 位 的 I2CDRR(7-0) are undefined. Also, 发送 数据 written 至 I2CDXR must be right-justified 0h (R/W) = 8 位 per 数据 字节 1h (R/W) = 1 位 per 数据 字节 2h (R/W) = 2 位 per 数据 字节 3h (R/W) = 3 位 per 数据 字节 4h (R/W) = 4 位 per 数据 字节 5h (R/W) = 5 位 per 数据 字节 6h (R/W) = 6 位 per 数据 字节 7h (R/W) = 7 位 per 数据 字节 Inter-Integrated Circuit 模块 (I2C) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：2:0 Bit count bits.；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2758页；原文字段表：Bit count bits.

BC defines the number of bits (1 to 8) in the next data byte that 
is to be received or transmitted by the I2C module. The number of 
bits selected with BC must match the data size of the other device. 
Notice that when BC = 000b, a data byte has 8 bits. BC does not 
affect address bytes, which always have 8 bits.
Note: If the bit count is less than 8, receive data is right-justified in 
I2CDRR(7-0), and the other bits of I2CDRR(7-0) are undefined. Also, 
transmit data written to I2CDXR must be right-justified
0h (R/W) = 8 bits per data byte 
1h (R/W) = 1 bit per data byte 
2h (R/W) = 2 bits per data byte 
3h (R/W) = 3 bits per data byte 
4h (R/W) = 4 bits per data byte 
5h (R/W) = 5 bits per data byte 
6h (R/W) = 6 bits per data byte 
7h (R/W) = 7 bits per data byte 
Inter-Integrated Circuit Module (I2C)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: FDF
Fields.Description: 自由运行 数据 格式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：自由运行 数据 格式 模式 位. 0h (R/W) = 自由运行 数据 格式 模式 为 已禁用. Transfers use 7-/10-位 addressing 格式 已选 通过 XA 位. 1h (R/W) = 自由运行 数据 格式 模式 为 已使能. Transfers have 自由运行 数据 (no 地址) 格式 described 中 Section 9.2.5. 自由运行 数据 格式 为 不 supported 中 数字 loopback 模式 (DLB=1).
Fields.Notes:
原文：3 Free Data Format；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2757页；原文字段表：Free data format mode bit.

0h (R/W) = Free data format mode is disabled. Transfers use the 
7-/10-bit addressing format selected by the XA bit. 
1h (R/W) = Free data format mode is enabled. Transfers have the 
free data (no address) format described in Section 9.2.5.
The free data format is not supported in the digital loopback mode 
(DLB=1).；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: STB
Fields.Description: 启动 字节 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：启动 字节 模式 位. 此 位 为 仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 主机. 作为 described 中 version 2.1 的 Philips Semiconductors I2C-bus specification, 启动 字节 CAN be 使用 至 help 从机 that needs extra 时间 至 检测 启动 条件. 当 I2C 模块 为 从机, it ignores 启动 字节 来自 主机, regardless 的 值 的 STB 位. 0h (R/W) = I2C 模块 为 不 中 启动 字节 模式. 1h (R/W) = I2C 模块 为 中 启动 字节 模式. 当 you 置位 启动 条件 位 (STT), I2C 模块 begins transfer 带 more than just 启动 条件. Specifically, it 产生: 1. 启动 条件 2. 启动 字节 (0000 0001b) 3. dummy 应答 时钟 脉冲 4. repeated 启动 条件 Then, 作为 normal, I2C 模块 sends 从机 地址 that 为 中 I2CSAR.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4 START Byte Mode；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2757页；原文字段表：START byte mode bit. This bit is only applicable when the I2C 

module is a master. As described in version 2.1 of the Philips 
Semiconductors I2C-bus specification, the START byte can be used 
to help a slave that needs extra time to detect a START condition. 
When the I2C module is a slave, it ignores a START byte from a 
master, regardless of the value of the STB bit.
0h (R/W) = The I2C module is not in the START byte mode. 
1h (R/W) = The I2C module is in the START byte mode. When 
you set the START condition bit (STT), the I2C module begins 
the transfer with more than just a START condition. Specifically, it 
generates:
1. A START condition
2. A START byte (0000 0001b)
3. A dummy acknowledge clock pulse
4. A repeated START condition
Then, as normal, the I2C module sends the slave address that is in 
I2CSAR.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: IRS
Fields.Description: I2C 模块 复位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：I2C 模块 复位 位. 0h (R/W) = I2C 模块 为 中 reset/disabled. 当 此 位 为 cleared 至 0, 全部 状态 位 (中 I2CSTR) are 置位 至 their 默认 values. 1h (R/W) = I2C 模块 为 已使能. 此 has effect 的 releasing I2C 总线 如果 I2C 外设 为 holding it.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5 I2C Module Reset；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2757页；原文字段表：I2C module reset bit.

0h (R/W) = The I2C module is in reset/disabled. When this bit is 
cleared to 0, all status bits (in I2CSTR) are set to their default values. 
1h (R/W) = The I2C module is enabled. This has the effect of 
releasing the I2C bus if the I2C peripheral is holding it.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: DLB
Fields.Description: 数字 Loopback 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：数字 loopback 模式 位. 0h (R/W) = 数字 loopback 模式 为 已禁用. 1h (R/W) = 数字 loopback 模式 为 已使能. 用于 proper 操作 中 此 模式, MST 位 must be 1. 中 数字 loopback 模式, 数据 已发送 out 的 I2CDXR 为 已接收 中 I2CDRR after n device cycles 通过 内部 路径, where: n = ((I2C 输入 时钟 frequency/module 时钟 频率) x 8) 发送 时钟 为 also 接收 时钟. 地址 已发送 开启 SDA 引脚 为 地址 中 I2COAR. Note: 自由运行 数据 格式 (FDF = 1) 为 不 supported 中 数字 loopback 模式.
Fields.Notes:
原文：6 Digital Loopback Mode；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2757页；原文字段表：Digital loopback mode bit.

0h (R/W) = Digital loopback mode is disabled. 
1h (R/W) = Digital loopback mode is enabled. For proper operation in 
this mode, the MST bit must be 1.
In the digital loopback mode, data transmitted out of I2CDXR is 
received in I2CDRR after n device cycles by an internal path, where:
n = ((I2C input clock frequency/module clock frequency) x 8)
The transmit clock is also the receive clock. The address transmitted 
on the SDA pin is the address in I2COAR.
Note: The free data format (FDF = 1) is not supported in the digital 
loopback mode.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RM
Fields.Description: 重复 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：重复 模式 位 (仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 主机- 发送器 或 master-receiver). RM, STT, 及 STP 位 determine 当 I2C 模块 starts 及 stops 数据 transmissions 0h (R/W) = Nonrepeat 模式. 值 中 数据 计数 寄存器 (I2CCNT) 决定 how many bytes are received/transmitted 通过 I2C 模块. 1h (R/W) = 重复 模式. 数据 字节 为 已发送 每个 时间 I2CDXR 寄存器 为 written 至 (或 until 发送 FIFO队列 为 空 当 中 FIFO队列 模式) until STP 位 为 manually 置位. 值 的 I2CCNT 为 忽略. ARDY bit/interrupt CAN be 使用 至 determine 当 I2CDXR (或 FIFO队列) 为 就绪 用于 more 数据, 或 当 数据 has 全部 been sent 及 CPU 为 allowed 至 写入 至 STP 位. Inter-Integrated Circuit 模块 (I2C) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：7 Repeat Mode；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2756页；原文字段表：Repeat mode bit (only applicable when the I2C module is a master-

transmitter or master-receiver).
The RM, STT, and STP bits determine when the I2C module starts 
and stops data transmissions
0h (R/W) = Nonrepeat mode. The value in the data count register 
(I2CCNT) determines how many bytes are
received/transmitted by the I2C module. 
1h (R/W) = Repeat mode. A data byte is transmitted each time the 
I2CDXR register is written to (or until the transmit FIFO is empty 
when in FIFO mode) until the STP bit is manually set. The value of 
I2CCNT is ignored. The ARDY bit/interrupt can be used to determine 
when the I2CDXR (or FIFO) is ready for more data, or when the data 
has all been sent and the CPU is allowed to write to the STP bit. 
Inter-Integrated Circuit Module (I2C)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: XA
Fields.Description: Expanded 地址 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Expanded 地址 使能 位. 0h (R/W) = 7-位 addressing 模式 (normal 地址 模式). I2C 模块 transmits 7-位 从机 addresses (来自 位 6-0 的 I2CSAR), 及 its own 从机 地址 has 7 位 (位 6-0 的 I2COAR). 1h (R/W) = 10-位 addressing 模式 (expanded 地址 模式). I2C 模块 transmits 10-位 从机 addresses (来自 位 9-0 的 I2CSAR), 及 its own 从机 地址 has 10 位 (位 9-0 的 I2COAR).
Fields.Notes:
原文：8 Expanded Address Mode；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2756页；原文字段表：Expanded address enable bit.

0h (R/W) = 7-bit addressing mode (normal address mode). The I2C 
module transmits 7-bit slave addresses (from bits 6-0 of I2CSAR), 
and its own slave address has 7 bits (bits 6-0 of I2COAR). 
1h (R/W) = 10-bit addressing mode (expanded address mode). 
The I2C module transmits 10-bit slave addresses (from bits 9-0 
of I2CSAR), and its own slave address has 10 bits (bits 9-0 of 
I2COAR).；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TRX
Fields.Description: 发送器 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：发送器 模式 位. 当 relevant, TRX 选择 是否 I2C 模块 为 中 发送器 模式 或 接收器 模式. 0h (R/W) = 接收器 模式. I2C 模块 为 接收器 及 receives 数据 开启 SDA 引脚. 1h (R/W) = 发送器 模式. I2C 模块 为 发送器 及 transmits 数据 开启 SDA 引脚.
Fields.Notes:
原文：9 Transmitter Mode；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2756页；原文字段表：Transmitter mode bit.

When relevant, TRX selects whether the I2C module is in the 
transmitter mode or the receiver mode.
0h (R/W) = Receiver mode. The I2C module is a receiver and 
receives data on the SDA pin. 
1h (R/W) = Transmitter mode. The I2C module is a transmitter and 
transmits data on the SDA pin.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: MST
Fields.Description: 主机 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：主机 模式 位. MST 决定 是否 I2C 模块 为 中 从机 模式 或 主机 模式. MST 为 automatically changed 来自 1 至 0 当 I2C 主机 产生 停止 条件 0h (R/W) = 从机 模式. I2C 模块 为 从机 及 receives serial 时钟 来自 主机. 1h (R/W) = 主机 模式. I2C 模块 为 主机 及 产生 serial 时钟 开启 SCL 引脚.
Fields.Notes:
原文：10 Master Mode；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2756页；原文字段表：Master mode bit.

MST determines whether the I2C module is in the slave mode or the 
master mode. MST is automatically changed from 1 to 0 when the 
I2C master generates a STOP condition
0h (R/W) = Slave mode. The I2C module is a slave and receives the 
serial clock from the master. 
1h (R/W) = Master mode. The I2C module is a master and generates 
the serial clock on the SCL pin.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: STP
Fields.Description: 停止 条件
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：停止 条件 位 (仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 主机). 中 主机 模式, RM,STT, 及 STP 位 determine 当 I2C 模块 starts 及 stops 数据 transmissions. Note that STT 及 STP 位 CAN be 使用 至 terminate 重复 模式, 及 that 此 位 为 不 writable 当 IRS=0. 当 中 非- 重复 模式, 在 最低 单次 字节 must be transferred before 停止 条件 CAN be 已产生. I2C 模块 delays clearing 的 此 位 until after I2CSTR[SCD] 位 为 置位. 至 avoid disrupting I2C 状态 machine, user must wait until 此 位 为 清除 before initiating new 报文. 0h (R/W) = STP 为 automatically cleared after 停止 条件 has been 已产生 1h (R/W) = STP has been 置位 通过 device 至 产生 停止 条件 当 内部 数据 计数器 的 I2C 模块 counts 下降 至 0.
Fields.Notes:
原文：11 STOP Condition；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2756页；原文字段表：STOP condition bit (only applicable when the I2C module is a 

master).
In the master mode, the RM,STT, and STP bits determine when the 
I2C module starts and stops data transmissions.
Note that the STT and STP bits can be used to terminate the repeat 
mode, and that this bit is not writable when IRS=0. When in non-
repeat mode, at least one byte must be transferred before a stop 
condition can be generated. The I2C module delays clearing of this 
bit until after the I2CSTR[SCD] bit is set. To avoid disrupting the 
I2C state machine, the user must wait until this bit is clear before 
initiating a new message.
0h (R/W) = STP is automatically cleared after the STOP condition 
has been generated 
1h (R/W) = STP has been set by the device to generate a STOP 
condition when the internal data counter of the I2C module counts 
down to 0.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Notes: 保留位不得用于配置。；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2755页；原文字段表：Reserved；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: STT
Fields.Description: 启动 条件 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：启动 条件 位 (仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 主机). RM, STT, 及 STP 位 determine 当 I2C 模块 starts 及 stops 数据 transmissions (see 表 9-6). Note that STT 及 STP 位 CAN be 使用 至 terminate 重复 模式, 及 that 此 位 为 不 writable 当 IRS = 0. 0h (R/W) = 中 主机 模式, STT 为 automatically cleared after 启动 条件 has been 已产生. 1h (R/W) = 中 主机 模式, 设置 STT 至 1 causes I2C 模块 至 产生 启动 条件 开启 I2C-bus
Fields.Notes:
原文：13 START condition bit；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2755页；原文字段表：START condition bit (only applicable when the I2C module is a 

master). The RM, STT, and STP bits determine when the I2C module 
starts and stops data transmissions (see Table 9-6). Note that the 
STT and STP bits can be used to terminate the repeat mode, and 
that this bit is not writable when IRS = 0.
0h (R/W) = In the master mode, STT is automatically cleared after 
the START condition has been generated. 
1h (R/W) = In the master mode, setting STT to 1 causes the I2C 
module to generate a START condition on the I2C-bus；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: FREE
Fields.Description: 调试 动作
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：此 位 控制 动作 taken 通过 I2C 模块 当 debugger breakpoint 为 encountered. 0h (R/W) = 当 I2C 模块 为 主机: 如果 SCL 为 低 当 breakpoint 发生, I2C 模块 stops immediately 及 keeps driving SCL 低, 是否 I2C 模块 为 发送器 或 接收器. 如果 SCL 为 高, I2C 模块 waits until SCL becomes 低 及 then stops. 当 I2C 模块 为 从机: breakpoint forces I2C 模块 至 停止 当 当前 transmission/reception 为 complete. 1h (R/W) = I2C 模块 runs 自由运行 that 为, it continues 至 operate 当 breakpoint 发生.
Fields.Notes:
原文：14 Debug Action；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2755页；原文字段表：This bit controls the action taken by the I2C module when a 

debugger breakpoint is encountered.
0h (R/W) = When I2C module is master:
If SCL is low when the breakpoint occurs, the I2C module stops 
immediately and keeps driving SCL low, whether the I2C module is 
the transmitter or the receiver. If SCL is high, the I2C module waits 
until SCL becomes low and then stops.
When I2C module is slave:
A breakpoint forces the I2C module to stop when the current 
transmission/reception is complete. 
1h (R/W) = The I2C module runs free
that is, it continues to operate when a breakpoint occurs.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: NACKMOD
Fields.Description: NACK 模式 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：NACK 模式 位. 此 位 为 仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 acting 作为 接收器. 0h (R/W) = 中 slave-receiver 模式: I2C 模块 sends 应答 (ACK) 位 至 发送器 during 每个 应答 周期 开启 总线. I2C 模块 仅 sends no-acknowledge (NACK) 位 如果 you 置位 NACKMOD 位. 中 master-receiver 模式: I2C 模块 sends ACK 位 during 每个 应答 周期 until 内部 数据 计数器 counts 下降 至 0. 在 that point, I2C 模块 sends NACK 位 至 发送器. 至 have NACK 位 sent earlier, you must 置位 NACKMOD 位 1h (R/W) = 中 either slave-receiver 或 master-receiver 模式: I2C 模块 sends NACK 位 至 发送器 during 下次 应答 周期 开启 总线. Once NACK 位 has been sent, NACKMOD 为 cleared. Important: 至 send NACK 位 中 下次 应答 周期, you must 置位 NACKMOD before 上升沿 边沿 的 最后 数据 位.
Fields.Notes:
原文：15 NACK mode bit；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2755页；原文字段表：NACK mode bit. This bit is only applicable when the I2C module is 

acting as a receiver.
0h (R/W) = In the slave-receiver mode: The I2C module sends an 
acknowledge (ACK) bit to the transmitter during each acknowledge 
cycle on the bus. The I2C module only sends a no-acknowledge 
(NACK) bit if you set the NACKMOD bit.
In the master-receiver mode: The I2C module sends an ACK bit 
during each acknowledge cycle until the internal data counter counts 
down to 0. At that point, the I2C module sends a NACK bit to 
the transmitter. To have a NACK bit sent earlier, you must set the 
NACKMOD bit 
1h (R/W) = In either slave-receiver or master-receiver mode: The 
I2C module sends a NACK bit to the transmitter during the next 
acknowledge cycle on the bus. Once the NACK bit has been sent, 
NACKMOD is cleared.
Important: To send a NACK bit in the next acknowledge cycle, you 
must set NACKMOD before the rising edge of the last data bit.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INTCODE
Fields.Description: 中断 编码 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：中断 编码 位. binary 编码 中 INTCODE 表示 事件 that 已产生 I2C 中断. CPU 读取 will 清除 此 field. 如果 another 低位 优先级 中断 为 待处理 及 已使能, 值 corresponding 至 that 中断 will then be loaded. Otherwise, 值 will stay cleared. 中断 events below are listed 中 descending order 的 优先级. That 为 INTCODE 1 (仲裁 丢失) has highest 优先级 及 INTCODE 7 (Addressed 作为 从机) has lowest 优先级. 中 case 的 仲裁 丢失, no-acknowledgment 条件 已检测, 或 停止 条件 已检测, CPU 读取 will also 清除 associated 中断 标志 位 中 I2CSTR 寄存器. 仿真器 reads will 不 affect 状态 的 此 field 或 的 状态 位 中 I2CSTR 寄存器. 0h (R/W) = None 1h (R/W) = 仲裁 丢失 2h (R/W) = No-acknowledgment 条件 已检测 3h (R/W) = 寄存器 就绪 至 be accessed 4h (R/W) = 接收 数据 就绪 5h (R/W) = 发送 数据 就绪 6h (R/W) = 停止 条件 已检测 7h (R/W) = Addressed 作为 从机
Fields.Notes:
原文：2:0 Interrupt code bits.；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2759页；原文字段表：Interrupt code bits.

The binary code in INTCODE indicates the event that generated an 
I2C interrupt.
A CPU read will clear this field. If another lower priority interrupt is 
pending and enabled, the value corresponding to that interrupt will 
then be loaded. Otherwise, the value will stay cleared.
The interrupt events below are listed in descending order of priority. 
That is INTCODE 1 (Arbitration lost) has the highest priority and 
INTCODE 7 (Addressed as slave) has the lowest priority.
In the case of an arbitration lost, a no-acknowledgment condition 
detected, or a stop condition detected, a CPU read will also clear the 
associated interrupt flag bit in the I2CSTR register.
Emulator reads will not affect the state of this field or of the status 
bits in the I2CSTR register.
0h (R/W) = None 
1h (R/W) = Arbitration lost 
2h (R/W) = No-acknowledgment condition detected 
3h (R/W) = Registers ready to be accessed 
4h (R/W) = Receive data ready 
5h (R/W) = Transmit data ready 
6h (R/W) = Stop condition detected 
7h (R/W) = Addressed as slave；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Forward Compatibility 模式. 此 位 当 programmed brings functionality 的 Tx 请求 仅 当 Tx 数据 required regardless 的 数据 状态 中 Tx 缓冲 用于 non-FIFO 模式. 此 寄存器 affects XRDY behavior hence needs 至 be 置位 after releasing IRS (I2CMDR[5]). 0h (R/W) = Legacy functionality 的 requesting Tx 数据 upon 缓冲 copy 至 shift 寄存器 或 upon 启动 条件 为 活动. Fields.Name: TXFFIL
Fields.Description: 发送 FIFO队列 中断 电平
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：发送 FIFO队列 中断 电平. These 位 置位 状态 电平 that will 置位 发送 中断 标志. 当 TXFFST4-0 位 reach 值 equal 至 或 less than these 位, TXFFINT 标志 will be 置位. 此 will 产生 中断 如果 TXFFIENA 位 为 置位. Because I2C 开启 此 device has 16-电平 发送 FIFO队列, these 位 cannot be configured 用于 中断 的 more than 16 FIFO队列 levels.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4:0 Transmit FIFO Interrupt Level；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2763页；原文字段表：Transmit FIFO interrupt level.

These bits set the status level that will set the transmit interrupt flag. 
When the TXFFST4-0 bits reach a value equal to or less than these 
bits, the TXFFINT flag will be set. This will generate an interrupt if the 
TXFFIENA bit is set. Because the I2C on this device has a 16-level 
transmit FIFO, these bits cannot be configured for an interrupt of 
more than 16 FIFO levels.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RXFFIL
Fields.Description: 接收 FIFO队列 中断 电平
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：接收 FIFO队列 中断 电平. These 位 置位 状态 电平 that will 置位 接收 中断 标志. 当 RXFFST4-0 位 reach 值 equal 至 或 greater than these 位, RXFFINT 标志 为 置位. 此 will 产生 中断 如果 RXFFIENA 位 为 置位. Note: Since these 位 are 复位 至 零, 接收 FIFO队列 中断 标志 will be 置位 如果 接收 FIFO队列 操作 为 已使能 及 I2C 为 taken out 的 复位. 此 will 产生 接收 FIFO队列 中断 如果 已使能. 至 avoid 此, modify these 位 开启 same instruction 作为 或 prior 至 设置 RXFFRST 位. Because I2C 开启 此 device has 16-电平 接收 FIFO队列, these 位 cannot be configured 用于 中断 的 more than 16 FIFO队列 levels. Inter-Integrated Circuit 模块 (I2C) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：4:0 Receive FIFO Interrupt Level；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2764页；原文字段表：Receive FIFO interrupt level.

These bits set the status level that will set the receive interrupt flag. 
When the RXFFST4-0 bits reach a value equal to or greater than 
these bits, the RXFFINT flag is set. This will generate an interrupt if 
the RXFFIENA bit is set.
Note: Since these bits are reset to zero, the receive FIFO interrupt 
flag will be set if the receive FIFO operation is enabled and the I2C 
is taken out of reset. This will generate a receive FIFO interrupt if 
enabled. To avoid this, modify these bits on the same instruction as 
or prior to setting the RXFFRST bit. Because the I2C on this device 
has a 16-level receive FIFO, these bits cannot be configured for an 
interrupt of more than 16 FIFO levels.
Inter-Integrated Circuit Module (I2C)

Fields.Notes:

Fields.Name: CLOCKFAIL

1,CLOCKFAIL Condition Generated；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RAMUNCERR
Fields.Description: RAM Uncorrectable 错误 NMI 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：RAM Uncorrectable 错误 NMI 标志: 此 位 表示 如果 uncorrectable 错误 occurred 开启 RAM 访问 (通过 any 主机) 及 that 条件 为 锁存. 此 位 CAN 仅 be cleared 通过 user writing 至 corresponding 清除 位 中 NMIFLGCLR 寄存器 或 通过 SYSRSn 复位: 0,No RAM uncorrectable 错误 条件 待处理 1,RAM uncorrectable 错误 条件 已产生
Fields.Notes:
原文：2 RAM Uncorrectable Error NMI Flag；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第376页；原文字段表：RAM Uncorrectable Error NMI Flag: This bit indicates if an 

uncorrectable error occurred on a RAM access (by any master) and 
that condition is latched. This bit can only be cleared by the user 
writing to the corresponding clear bit in the NMIFLGCLR register or 
by SYSRSn reset:
0,No RAM uncorrectable error condition pending
1,RAM uncorrectable error condition generated；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Notes:

Fields.Name: NMIINT
Fields.Description: NMIINT 标志 清除
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：R-0/W1S 0h Writing 1 至 respective 位 clears corresponding 标志 位 中 NMIFLG 及 NMISHDFLG 寄存器. Writes 的 0 are 忽略. Always reads back 0. Notes: [1] 如果 硬件 为 trying 至 置位 位 至 1 期间 软件 为 trying 至 清除 位 至 0 开启 same 周期, 硬件 has 优先级. [2] Users should 清除 待处理 FAIL 标志 首个 及 then 清除 NMIINT 标志. 系统 控制 及 中断 www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：0 NMIINT Flag Clear；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第378页；原文字段表：R-0/W1S 0h Writing a 1 to the respective bit clears the corresponding flag bit in 

the NMIFLG and NMISHDFLG registers. Writes of 0 are ignored. 
Always reads back 0.
Notes:
[1] If hardware is trying to set a bit to 1 while software is trying to 
clear a bit to 0 on the same cycle, hardware has priority.
[2] Users should clear the pending FAIL flag first and then clear the 
NMIINT flag.

Fields.Name: NMIWDCNT
Fields.Description: NMI 看门狗 计数器 寄存器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：NMI 看门狗 计数器: 此 16-位 incremental 计数器 will 启动 incrementing whenever any 单次 的 已使能 FAIL flags are 置位. 如果 计数器 reaches 周期 值, NMIRSn 信号 为 fired which will then resets 系统. 计数器 will 复位 至 零 当 it reaches 周期 值 及 will then 重新启动 counting 如果 any 的 已使能 FAIL flags are 置位. 如果 no 已使能 FAIL 标志 为 置位, then 计数器 will 复位 至 零 及 remain 在 零 until 已使能 FAIL 标志 为 置位. Normally, 软件 would respond 至 NMI 中断 已产生 及 清除 offending 标志(s) before NMI 看门狗 触发 复位. 中 some situations, 软件 may decide 至 allow 看门狗 至 复位 device anyway. 计数器 为 clocked 在 SYSCLKOUT 速率.
Fields.Notes:
原文：NMI Watchdog Counter Register；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第381页；原文字段表：NMI Watchdog Counter: This 16-bit incremental counter will start 

incrementing whenever any one of the enabled FAIL flags are set. 
If the counter reaches the period value, an NMIRSn signal is fired 
which will then resets the system. The counter will reset to zero 
when it reaches the period value and will then restart counting if any 
of the enabled FAIL flags are set.
If no enabled FAIL flag is set, then the counter will reset to zero and 
remain at zero until an enabled FAIL flag is set.
Normally, the software would respond to the NMI interrupt generated 
and clear the offending FLAG(s) before the NMI watchdog triggers 
a reset. In some situations, the software may decide to allow the 
watchdog to reset the device anyway.
The counter is clocked at the SYSCLKOUT rate.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: NMIWDPRD
Fields.Description: NMI 看门狗 周期 寄存器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：NMI 看门狗 周期: 此 16-位 值 包含 周期 值 在 which 复位 为 已产生 当 看门狗 计数器 matches. 在 复位 此 值 为 置位 在 最大. 软件 CAN decrease 周期 值 在 初始化 时间. Writing 周期 值 that 为 smaller then 当前 计数器 值 will automatically 强制 NMIRSn 及 hence 复位 看门狗 计数器. 系统 控制 及 中断 www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：NMI Watchdog Period Register；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第382页；原文字段表：NMI Watchdog Period: This 16-bit value contains the period value at 

which a reset is generated when the watchdog counter matches. At 
reset this value is set at the maximum. The software can decrease 
the period value at initialization time.
Writing a PERIOD value that is smaller then the current counter 
value will automatically force an NMIRSn and hence reset the 
watchdog counter.

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：,None 的 错误 sources were triggered. 1, 单次 或 more 的 错误 sources triggered, 或 ERRORSTS.错误 was 置位 通过 写入 的 1 至 ERRORSTSFRC.错误 位. Once 置位, 错误 标志 CAN be cleared 通过 writing 1 至 ERRORSTSCLR.错误 位. Following are events/triggers which CAN 置位 此 位: 1. nmi 中断 开启 C28x 2. 看门狗 复位 3. 错误 开启 Pie 向量 fetch 4. Efuse 错误 开启 读取 的 此 位, 引脚 错误 引脚 状态 will be returned.
Fields.Notes:
原文：0 Error flag.；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第385页；原文字段表：0,None of the error sources were triggered.

1, One or more of the error sources triggered, or 
ERRORSTS.ERROR was set by a write of 1 to 
ERRORSTSFRC.ERROR bit. Once set, the ERROR flag can be 
cleared by writing 1 to ERRORSTSCLR.ERROR bit. Following are 
the events/triggers which can set this bit:
1. nmi interrupt on C28x
2. Watchdog reset
3. Error on a Pie vector fetch
4. Efuse error
On a read of this bit, the pin Error pin state will be returned.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: PARITYENA
Fields.Description: SCI奇偶校验使能。
Fields.Values: 0：禁用校验；1：使能校验。
Fields.Notes:
原文：5 Parity enable；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2692页；原文字段表：SCI parity enable.

This bit enables or disables the parity function. If the SCI is in the 
addressbit multiprocessor mode (set using bit 3 of this register), the 
address bit is included in the parity calculation (if parity is enabled). 
For characters of less than eight bits, the remaining unused bits 
should be masked out of the parity calculation.

no parity bit is generated during transmission or is expected during 
reception

Fields.Name: RXENA
Fields.Description: SCI接收使能。
Fields.Values: 0：禁用接收；1：使能接收。
Fields.Notes:
原文：0 SCI receiver enable；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2695页；原文字段表：SCI receiver enable.

Data is received on the SCIRXD pin and is sent to the receiver shift 
register and then the receiver buffers. This bit enables or disables 
the receiver (transfer to the buffers).
Clearing RXENA stops received characters from being transferred 
to the two receiver buffers and also stops the generation of 
receiver interrupts. However, this will not stop RX errors from 
triggering interrupts. To disable interrupts from RX errors use the 
RXERRINTENA bit. To stop propagation of the BRKDT interrupt use 
the RXBKINTENA bit.
The receiver shift register can continue to assemble characters even 
while RXENA is cleared. Thus, if RXENA is set during the reception 
of a character, the complete character will be transferred into the 
receiver buffer registers, SCIRXEMU and SCIRXBUF.
0h (R/W) = Prevent received characters from transfer into the 
SCIRXEMU and SCIRXBUF receiver buffers 
1h (R/W) = Send received characters to SCIRXEMU and SCIRXBUF；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUIW9C / 2024-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: TXENA
Fields.Description: SCI发送使能。
Fields.Values: 0：禁用发送；1：使能发送。
Fields.Notes:
原文：1 SCI transmitter enable；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2695页；原文字段表：SCI transmitter enable.

Data is transmitted through the SCITXD pin only when TXENA is 
set. If reset, transmission is halted but only after all data previously 
written to SCITXBUF has been sent. Data written into SCITXBUF 
when TXENA is disabled will not be transmitted even if the TXENA is 
enabled later.
0h (R/W) = Transmitter disabled 
1h (R/W) = Transmitter enabled；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUIW9C / 2024-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: SLEEP
Fields.Description: SCI 睡眠
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI 睡眠. TXWAKE 位 控制 选择 的 data-transmit feature, depending 开启 which 发送 模式 (idle-line 或 address-bit) 为 specified 在 ADDR/IDLE 模式 位 (SCICCR, 位 3). 中 multiprocessor 配置, 此 位 控制 接收器 睡眠 功能. Fields.Notes:
原文：2 SCI sleep；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2695页；原文字段表：SCI sleep.

The TXWAKE bit controls selection of the data-transmit feature, 
depending on which transmit mode (idle-line or address-bit) is 
specified at the ADDR/IDLE MODE bit (SCICCR, bit 3). In a 
multiprocessor configuration, this bit controls the receiver sleep 
function. Clearing this bit brings the SCI out of the sleep mode.
The receiver still operates when the SLEEP bit is set
however, operation does not update the receiver buffer ready bit 
(SCIRXST, bit 6, RXRDY) or the error status bits (SCIRXST, bit 
5-2: BRKDT, FE, OE, and PE) unless the address byte is detected. 
SLEEP is not cleared when the address byte is detected.
0h (R/W) = Sleep mode disabled 
1h (R/W) = Sleep mode enabled；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

原文：5 Software reset；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2694页；原文字段表：SCI software reset (active low).

Writing a 0 to this bit initializes the SCI state machines and operating 
flags (registers SCICTL2 and SCIRXST) to the reset condition. This 
reset will not reset the FIFO pointers or flush out the data in TX/RX 
FIFO. If you need to clear the FIFO then perform SWRESET + 
TXFFINT + RXFFINT or refer to a channel reset SCIFFTX[SCIRST].
The SW RESET bit does not affect any of the configuration bits. All 
affected logic is held in the specified reset state until a 1 is written 
to SW RESET (the bit values following a reset are shown beneath 
each register diagram in this section). Thus, after a system reset, 
re-enable the SCI by writing a 1 to this bit. Clear this bit after a 
receiver break detect (BRKDT flag, bit SCIRXST, bit 5).
SW RESET affects the operating flags of the SCI, but it neither 
affects the configuration bits nor restores the reset values. Once SW 
RESET is asserted, the flags are frozen until the bit is deasserted.

Fields.Name: BAUD
Fields.Description: SCI 16-位 波特率 选择 寄存器 SCIHBAUD
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI 16-位 波特率 选择 寄存器 SCIHBAUD (MSbyte). internally-generated serial 时钟 为 determined 通过 低 speed 外设 时钟 (LSPCLK) 信号 及 two baud-select 寄存器. SCI uses 16-位 值 的 these 寄存器 至 选择 单次 的 64K serial 时钟 rates 用于 communication modes. BRR = (SCIHBAUD << 8) + (SCILBAUD) SCI 波特率 速率 为 calculated using following equation: SCI 异步 波特率 = LSPCLK / ((BRR + 1) *8) Alternatively, BRR = LSPCLK / (SCI 异步 波特率 * 8) - 1 Note that above formulas are applicable 仅 当 0 < BRR < 65536. 如果 BRR = 0, then SCI 异步 波特率 = LSPCLK / 16 Where: BRR = 16-位 值 (中 decimal) 中 baud-select 寄存器 Serial Communications Interface (SCI) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：7:0 SCI 16-bit baud selection Registers SCIHBAUD；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2696页；原文字段表：SCI 16-bit baud selection Registers SCIHBAUD (MSbyte).

The internally-generated serial clock is determined by the low speed 
peripheral clock (LSPCLK) signal and the two baud-select registers. 
The SCI uses the 16-bit value of these registers to select one of 64K 
serial clock rates for the communication modes.
BRR = (SCIHBAUD << 8) + (SCILBAUD)
The SCI baud rate is calculated using the following equation:
SCI Asynchronous Baud = LSPCLK / ((BRR + 1) *8)
Alternatively,
BRR = LSPCLK / (SCI Asynchronous Baud * 8) - 1
Note that the above formulas are applicable only when 0 < BRR < 
65536. If BRR = 0, then
SCI Asynchronous Baud = LSPCLK / 16
Where: BRR = the 16-bit value (in decimal) in the baud-select 
registers

Fields.Notes:
原文：1 Receiver wakeup detect flag；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2703页；原文字段表：Receiver wake-up-detect flag

0h (R/W) = No detection of a receiver wake-up condition 
1h (R/W) = A value of 1 in this bit indicates detection of a 
receiver wake-up condition. In the address-bit multiprocessor mode 
(SCICCR.3 = 1), RXWAKE reflects the value of the address bit for 
the character contained in SCIRXBUF. In the idle-line multiprocessor 
mode, RXWAKE is set if the SCIRXD data line is detected as idle. 
RXWAKE is a read-only flag, cleared by one of the following:

(only in non-FIFO mode)
- The reading of SCIRXBUF

Fields.Name: PE
Fields.Description: 奇偶校验 错误 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI parity-error 标志. 此 标志 位 为 置位 当 字符 为 已接收 带 mismatch between 数量 的 1s 及 its 奇偶校验 位. 地址 位 为 included 中 calculation. 如果 奇偶校验 产生 及 检测 为 不 已使能, PE 标志 为 已禁用 及 读取 作为 0. PE 位 为 复位 通过 活动 软件 复位, 通道 复位 (SCIRST), 或 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 奇偶校验 错误 或 奇偶校验 为 已禁用 1h (R/W) = 奇偶校验 错误 为 已检测
Fields.Notes:
原文：2 Parity error flag；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2703页；原文字段表：SCI parity-error flag.

This flag bit is set when a character is received with a mismatch 
between the number of 1s and its parity bit. The address bit is 
included in the calculation. If parity generation and detection is not 
enabled, the PE flag is disabled and read as 0. The PE bit is reset by 
an active SW RESET, channel reset (SCIRST), or a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No parity error or parity is disabled 
1h (R/W) = Parity error is detected；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI overrun-error 标志. SCI 设置 此 位 当 字符 为 transferred 进入 寄存器 SCIRXEMU 及 SCIRXBUF before 前次 字符 为 fully 读取 通过 CPU 或 DMAC. 前次 字符 为 overwritten 及 丢失. OE 标志 位 为 复位 通过 活动 软件 复位, 通道 复位 (SCIRST), 或 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 溢出 错误 已检测 1h (R/W) = 溢出 错误 已检测
Fields.Notes:
原文：3 Overrun error flag；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2703页；原文字段表：SCI overrun-error flag.

The SCI sets this bit when a character is transferred into registers 
SCIRXEMU and SCIRXBUF before the previous character is fully 
read by the CPU or DMAC. The previous character is overwritten 
and lost. The OE flag bit is reset by an active SW RESET, channel 
reset (SCIRST), or a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No overrun error detected 
1h (R/W) = Overrun error detected；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Notes:
原文：7 Receiver error flag；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2701页；原文字段表：SCI receiver error flag.

The RX ERROR flag indicates that one of the error flags in the 
receiver status register is set. RX ERROR is a logical OR of the 
break detect, framing error, overrun, and parity error enable flags 
(bits 5-2: BRKDT, FE, OE, and PE).
A 1 on this bit will cause an interrupt if the RX ERR INT ENA bit 
(SCICTL1.6) is set. This bit can be used for fast error-condition 
checking during the interrupt service routine. This error flag cannot 
be cleared directly
it is cleared by an active SW RESET, channel reset (SCIRST), or by 
a system reset.
Note: SCI Module Interrupt Reaction Time - Occasional BRKDT or 
other errors such as FE/PE being triggered could occur if there are 
tight timings occurring in the application.
Interrupts are not triggered until approximately 7/8 of the stop bit has 
been detected (~0.875 bit time). Actual value of this delay before ISR 
entry is: ((7*BAUD_CLK_PERIOD)/8+3*SYSCLK_PERIOD).
The SCI will not begin reading additional bits/characters until the RX 
ISR completes so it is critical to complete the ISR before the next 
byte's start bit begins. This leaves approximately 1/8 bit time (~0.125 
bit time) to complete the entire ISR, regardless of interrupt cause.
If the ISR is not completed before the beginning of the next start 
bit (before the RX line goes low again), the SCI module will begin 
reading the start bit late in the wrong location and therefore may read 
all bits incorrectly until the next correctly aligned start bit (when ISR 
has sufficient time to process before a start bit again).

Fields.Name: SCIFFPE
Fields.Description: 接收器 错误 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCIFFPE. SCI FIFO队列 奇偶校验 错误 标志 位 (applicable 仅 如果 FIFO队列 为 已使能) Note: 'SCIFFPE' 为 meant 至 serve 作为 标志 用于 specific 置位 的 数据 being received/read 中 SCIRXBUF 寄存器. 每个 置位 的 数据 已接收 进入 FIFO队列 will have 此 information. 'PE' 位 within SCIRXST 寄存器 CAN be thought 关闭 作为 高 电平 错误 标志 where 标志 will get 置位 如果 any 数据 that has been 已接收 has 奇偶校验 错误. Note: 如果 奇偶校验 为 changed 中 middle 的 数据 接收, SCI 模块 will 不 reinterpret 数据 带 new 奇偶校验 或 other settings that may have changed. Therefore, changing parameter, FIFO队列 should be cleared 或 user should 应答 that there will 最高 likely be 错误 中 数据 caused 通过 change. Note: 如果 RX 奇偶校验 错误 are occurring intermittently 此 could be due 至 长度 的 SCI ISR. 至 help prevent 此, ensure that 中断 nesting 为 limited, increase SCI 中断 优先级, 及 move 作为 much 的 处理 作为 possible out 的 ISR (至 reduce ISR 时间 至 absolute 最小). 0h (R/W) = No 奇偶校验 错误 occurred 期间 receiving 字符, 中 位 7-0. 此 位 为 associated 带 字符 开启 top 的 FIFO队列. 1h (R/W) = 奇偶校验 错误 occurred 期间 receiving 字符 中 位 7-0. 此 位 为 associated 带 字符 开启 top 的 FIFO队列.
Fields.Notes:
原文：14 Receiver error flag；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2705页；原文字段表：SCIFFPE. SCI FIFO parity error flag bit (applicable only if the FIFO is 

enabled)
Note: 'SCIFFPE' is meant to serve as a flag for the specific set of 
data being received/read in the SCIRXBUF register. Each set of data 
received into the FIFO will have this information. The 'PE' bit within 
the SCIRXST register can be thought off as high level error flag 
where the flag will get set if any data that has been received has a 
parity error.
Note: If the parity is changed in the middle of data reception, the 
SCI module will not reinterpret the data with the new parity or other 
settings that may have changed. Therefore, changing the parameter, 
the FIFO should be cleared or the user should acknowledge that 
there will most likely be errors in the data caused by the change.
Note: If RX parity errors are occurring intermittently this could be 
due to the length of the SCI ISR. To help prevent this, ensure that 
interrupt nesting is limited, increase the SCI interrupt priority, and 
move as much of the processing as possible out of the ISR (to 
reduce ISR time to the absolute minimum).
0h (R/W) = No parity error occurred while receiving the character, in 
bits 7-0. This bit is associated with the character on the top of the 
FIFO. 
1h (R/W) = A parity error occurred while receiving the character in 
bits 7-0. This bit is associated with the character on the top of the 
FIFO.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Notes:
原文：4:0 Interrupt level；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2709页；原文字段表：TXFFIL4-0 Transmit FIFO interrupt level bits.

The transmit FIFO generates an interrupt whenever the FIFO status 
bits (TXFFST4-0) are less than or equal to the FIFO level bits 
(TXFFIL4-0). The maximum value that can be assigned to these bits 
to generate an interrupt cannot be more than the depth of the TX 
FIFO. The default value of these bits after reset is 00000b. Users 
should set TXFFIL to best fit their application needs by weighing 
between the CPU overhead to service the ISR and the best possible 
usage of SCI bus bandwidth.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: FFTXDLY
Fields.Description: FIFO队列 发送 延迟
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：FIFO队列 transfer 延迟. These 位 define 延迟 between every transfer 来自 FIFO队列 发送 bufferto 发送 shift 寄存器. 延迟 为 defined 中 数量 的 SCI serial 波特率 时钟 cycles. 8 位 寄存器 could define 最小 延迟 的 0 波特率 时钟 cycles 及 最大 的 256 波特率 时钟 cycles 中 FIFO队列 模式, 缓冲 (TXBUF) between shift 寄存器 及 FIFO队列 should be filled 仅 after shift 寄存器 has completed shifting 的 最后 位. 此 为 required 至 pass 开启 延迟 between transfers 至 数据 stream. 中 FIFO队列 模式, TXBUF should 不 be treated 作为 单次 额外 电平 的 缓冲. delayed 发送 feature will help 至 create auto-flow scheme without RTS/CTS 控制 作为 中 标准 UARTS. 当 SCI 为 configured 用于 单次 stop-bit, 延迟 introduced 通过 FFTXDLY between 单次 帧 及 下次 帧 为 equal 至 数量 的 波特率 时钟 cycles that FFTXDLY 为 置位 至. 当 SCI 为 configured 用于 two stop-bits, 延迟 introduced 通过 FFTXDLY between 单次 帧 及 下次 帧 为 equal 至 数量 的 波特率 时钟 cycles that FFTXDLY 为 置位 至 minus 1. Serial Communications Interface (SCI) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：7:0 FIFO transmit delay；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2712页；原文字段表：FIFO transfer delay. These bits define the delay between every 

transfer from FIFO transmit bufferto transmit shift register. The delay 
is defined in the number of SCI serial baud clock cycles. The 8 bit 
register could define a minimum delay of 0 baud clock cycles and a 
maximum of 256 baud clock cycles
In FIFO mode, the buffer (TXBUF) between the shift register and 
the FIFO should be filled only after the shift register has completed 
shifting of the last bit. This is required to pass on the delay between 
transfers to the data stream. In FIFO mode, TXBUF should not be 
treated as one additional level of buffer. The delayed transmit feature 
will help to create an auto-flow scheme without RTS/CTS controls as 
in standard UARTS.
When SCI is configured for one stop-bit, delay introduced by 
FFTXDLY between one frame and the next frame is equal to number 
of baud clock cycles that FFTXDLY is set to.
When SCI is configured for two stop-bits, delay introduced by 
FFTXDLY between one frame and the next frame is equal to number 
of baud clock cycles that FFTXDLY is set to minus 1.
Serial Communications Interface (SCI)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RXENA
Fields.Description: SCI接收使能。
Fields.Values: 0：禁用接收；1：使能接收。
Fields.Notes:
原文：0 SCI receiver enable；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2695页；原文字段表：SCI receiver enable.

Data is received on the SCIRXD pin and is sent to the receiver shift 
register and then the receiver buffers. This bit enables or disables 
the receiver (transfer to the buffers).
Clearing RXENA stops received characters from being transferred 
to the two receiver buffers and also stops the generation of 
receiver interrupts. However, this will not stop RX errors from 
triggering interrupts. To disable interrupts from RX errors use the 
RXERRINTENA bit. To stop propagation of the BRKDT interrupt use 
the RXBKINTENA bit.
The receiver shift register can continue to assemble characters even 
while RXENA is cleared. Thus, if RXENA is set during the reception 
of a character, the complete character will be transferred into the 
receiver buffer registers, SCIRXEMU and SCIRXBUF.
0h (R/W) = Prevent received characters from transfer into the 
SCIRXEMU and SCIRXBUF receiver buffers 
1h (R/W) = Send received characters to SCIRXEMU and SCIRXBUF；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUIW9C / 2024-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: TXENA

Fields.Notes:
原文：1 SCI transmitter enable；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2695页；原文字段表：SCI transmitter enable.

Data is transmitted through the SCITXD pin only when TXENA is 
set. If reset, transmission is halted but only after all data previously 
written to SCITXBUF has been sent. Data written into SCITXBUF 
when TXENA is disabled will not be transmitted even if the TXENA is 
enabled later.
0h (R/W) = Transmitter disabled 
1h (R/W) = Transmitter enabled；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUIW9C / 2024-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: SLEEP
Fields.Description: SCI 睡眠
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI 睡眠. TXWAKE 位 控制 选择 的 data-transmit feature, depending 开启 which 发送 模式 (idle-line 或 address-bit) 为 specified 在 ADDR/IDLE 模式 位 (SCICCR, 位 3). 中 multiprocessor 配置, 此 位 控制 接收器 睡眠 功能. Clearing 此 位 brings SCI out 的 睡眠 模式. 接收器 still operates 当 睡眠 位 为 置位 however, 操作 does 不 更新 接收器 缓冲 就绪 位 (SCIRXST, 位 6, RXRDY) 或 错误 状态 位 (SCIRXST, 位 5-2: BRKDT, FE, OE, 及 PE) unless 地址 字节 为 已检测. 睡眠 为 不 cleared 当 地址 字节 为 已检测. 0h (R/W) = 睡眠 模式 已禁用 1h (R/W) = 睡眠 模式 已使能
Fields.Notes:
原文：2 SCI sleep；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2695页；原文字段表：SCI sleep.

The TXWAKE bit controls selection of the data-transmit feature, 
depending on which transmit mode (idle-line or address-bit) is 
specified at the ADDR/IDLE MODE bit (SCICCR, bit 3). In a 
multiprocessor configuration, this bit controls the receiver sleep 
function. Clearing this bit brings the SCI out of the sleep mode.
The receiver still operates when the SLEEP bit is set
however, operation does not update the receiver buffer ready bit 
(SCIRXST, bit 6, RXRDY) or the error status bits (SCIRXST, bit 
5-2: BRKDT, FE, OE, and PE) unless the address byte is detected. 
SLEEP is not cleared when the address byte is detected.
0h (R/W) = Sleep mode disabled 
1h (R/W) = Sleep mode enabled；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Description: SCI软件复位。
