Fields.Notes:
原文：5 Software reset；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2694页；原文字段表：SCI software reset (active low).

Writing a 0 to this bit initializes the SCI state machines and operating 
flags (registers SCICTL2 and SCIRXST) to the reset condition. This 
reset will not reset the FIFO pointers or flush out the data in TX/RX 
FIFO. If you need to clear the FIFO then perform SWRESET + 
TXFFINT + RXFFINT or refer to a channel reset SCIFFTX[SCIRST].
The SW RESET bit does not affect any of the configuration bits. All 
affected logic is held in the specified reset state until a 1 is written 
to SW RESET (the bit values following a reset are shown beneath 
each register diagram in this section). Thus, after a system reset, 
re-enable the SCI by writing a 1 to this bit. Clear this bit after a 
receiver break detect (BRKDT flag, bit SCIRXST, bit 5).
SW RESET affects the operating flags of the SCI, but it neither 
affects the configuration bits nor restores the reset values. Once SW 
RESET is asserted, the flags are frozen until the bit is deasserted.

Fields.Name: BAUD
Fields.Description: SCI 16-位 波特率 选择 寄存器 SCIHBAUD
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI 16-位 波特率 选择 寄存器 SCIHBAUD (MSbyte). internally-generated serial 时钟 为 determined 通过 低 speed 外设 时钟 (LSPCLK) 信号 及 two baud-select 寄存器. SCI uses 16-位 值 的 these 寄存器 至 选择 单次 的 64K serial 时钟 rates 用于 communication modes. BRR = (SCIHBAUD << 8) + (SCILBAUD) SCI 波特率 速率 为 calculated using following equation: SCI 异步 波特率 = LSPCLK / ((BRR + 1) *8) Alternatively, BRR = LSPCLK / (SCI 异步 波特率 * 8) - 1 Note that above formulas are applicable 仅 当 0 < BRR < 65536. 如果 BRR = 0, then SCI 异步 波特率 = LSPCLK / 16 Where: BRR = 16-位 值 (中 decimal) 中 baud-select 寄存器 Serial Communications Interface (SCI) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：7:0 SCI 16-bit baud selection Registers SCIHBAUD；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2696页；原文字段表：SCI 16-bit baud selection Registers SCIHBAUD (MSbyte).

The internally-generated serial clock is determined by the low speed 
peripheral clock (LSPCLK) signal and the two baud-select registers. 
The SCI uses the 16-bit value of these registers to select one of 64K 
serial clock rates for the communication modes.
BRR = (SCIHBAUD << 8) + (SCILBAUD)
The SCI baud rate is calculated using the following equation:
SCI Asynchronous Baud = LSPCLK / ((BRR + 1) *8)
Alternatively,
BRR = LSPCLK / (SCI Asynchronous Baud * 8) - 1
Note that the above formulas are applicable only when 0 < BRR < 
65536. If BRR = 0, then
SCI Asynchronous Baud = LSPCLK / 16
Where: BRR = the 16-bit value (in decimal) in the baud-select 
registers

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：接收器 wake-up-detect 标志 0h (R/W) = No 检测 的 接收器 wake-up 条件 1h (R/W) = 值 的 1 中 此 位 表示 检测 的 接收器 wake-up 条件. 中 address-bit multiprocessor 模式 (SCICCR.3 = 1), RXWAKE 反映 值 的 地址 位 用于 字符 contained 中 SCIRXBUF. 中 idle-line multiprocessor 模式, RXWAKE 为 置位 如果 SCIRXD 数据 线路 为 已检测 作为 空闲. RXWAKE 为 只读 标志, cleared 通过 单次 的 following: - transfer 的 首个 字节 after 地址 字节 至 SCIRXBUF (仅 中 non-FIFO 模式) - reading 的 SCIRXBUF - 活动 软件 复位 - 通道 复位 (SCIRST) - 系统 复位
Fields.Notes:
原文：1 Receiver wakeup detect flag；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2703页；原文字段表：Receiver wake-up-detect flag

0h (R/W) = No detection of a receiver wake-up condition 
1h (R/W) = A value of 1 in this bit indicates detection of a 
receiver wake-up condition. In the address-bit multiprocessor mode 
(SCICCR.3 = 1), RXWAKE reflects the value of the address bit for 
the character contained in SCIRXBUF. In the idle-line multiprocessor 
mode, RXWAKE is set if the SCIRXD data line is detected as idle. 
RXWAKE is a read-only flag, cleared by one of the following:
- The transfer of the first byte after the address byte to SCIRXBUF 
(only in non-FIFO mode)
- The reading of SCIRXBUF
- An active SW RESET
- Channel reset (SCIRST)
- A system reset；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: PE
Fields.Description: 奇偶校验 错误 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI parity-error 标志. 此 标志 位 为 置位 当 字符 为 已接收 带 mismatch between 数量 的 1s 及 its 奇偶校验 位. 地址 位 为 included 中 calculation. 如果 奇偶校验 产生 及 检测 为 不 已使能, PE 标志 为 已禁用 及 读取 作为 0. PE 位 为 复位 通过 活动 软件 复位, 通道 复位 (SCIRST), 或 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 奇偶校验 错误 或 奇偶校验 为 已禁用 1h (R/W) = 奇偶校验 错误 为 已检测
Fields.Notes:
原文：2 Parity error flag；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2703页；原文字段表：SCI parity-error flag.

This flag bit is set when a character is received with a mismatch 
between the number of 1s and its parity bit. The address bit is 
included in the calculation. If parity generation and detection is not 
enabled, the PE flag is disabled and read as 0. The PE bit is reset by 
an active SW RESET, channel reset (SCIRST), or a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No parity error or parity is disabled 
1h (R/W) = Parity error is detected；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OE
Fields.Description: 溢出 错误 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI overrun-error 标志. SCI 设置 此 位 当 字符 为 transferred 进入 寄存器 SCIRXEMU 及 SCIRXBUF before 前次 字符 为 fully 读取 通过 CPU 或 DMAC. 前次 字符 为 overwritten 及 丢失. OE 标志 位 为 复位 通过 活动 软件 复位, 通道 复位 (SCIRST), 或 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 溢出 错误 已检测 1h (R/W) = 溢出 错误 已检测
Fields.Notes:
原文：3 Overrun error flag；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2703页；原文字段表：SCI overrun-error flag.

The SCI sets this bit when a character is transferred into registers 
SCIRXEMU and SCIRXBUF before the previous character is fully 
read by the CPU or DMAC. The previous character is overwritten 
and lost. The OE flag bit is reset by an active SW RESET, channel 
reset (SCIRST), or a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No overrun error detected 
1h (R/W) = Overrun error detected；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Notes:
原文：7 Receiver error flag；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2701页；原文字段表：SCI receiver error flag.

The RX ERROR flag indicates that one of the error flags in the 
receiver status register is set. RX ERROR is a logical OR of the 
break detect, framing error, overrun, and parity error enable flags 
(bits 5-2: BRKDT, FE, OE, and PE).
A 1 on this bit will cause an interrupt if the RX ERR INT ENA bit 
(SCICTL1.6) is set. This bit can be used for fast error-condition 
checking during the interrupt service routine. This error flag cannot 
be cleared directly
it is cleared by an active SW RESET, channel reset (SCIRST), or by 
a system reset.
Note: SCI Module Interrupt Reaction Time - Occasional BRKDT or 
other errors such as FE/PE being triggered could occur if there are 
tight timings occurring in the application.
Interrupts are not triggered until approximately 7/8 of the stop bit has 
been detected (~0.875 bit time). Actual value of this delay before ISR 
entry is: ((7*BAUD_CLK_PERIOD)/8+3*SYSCLK_PERIOD).
The SCI will not begin reading additional bits/characters until the RX 
ISR completes so it is critical to complete the ISR before the next 
byte's start bit begins. This leaves approximately 1/8 bit time (~0.125 
bit time) to complete the entire ISR, regardless of interrupt cause.
If the ISR is not completed before the beginning of the next start 
bit (before the RX line goes low again), the SCI module will begin 
reading the start bit late in the wrong location and therefore may read 
all bits incorrectly until the next correctly aligned start bit (when ISR 
has sufficient time to process before a start bit again).

Fields.Name: SCIFFPE
Fields.Description: 接收器 错误 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCIFFPE. SCI FIFO队列 奇偶校验 错误 标志 位 (applicable 仅 如果 FIFO队列 为 已使能) Note: 'SCIFFPE' 为 meant 至 serve 作为 标志 用于 specific 置位 的 数据 being received/read 中 SCIRXBUF 寄存器. 每个 置位 的 数据 已接收 进入 FIFO队列 will have 此 information. 'PE' 位 within SCIRXST 寄存器 CAN be thought 关闭 作为 高 电平 错误 标志 where 标志 will get 置位 如果 any 数据 that has been 已接收 has 奇偶校验 错误. Note: 如果 奇偶校验 为 changed 中 middle 的 数据 接收, SCI 模块 will 不 reinterpret 数据 带 new 奇偶校验 或 other settings that may have changed. Therefore, changing parameter, FIFO队列 should be cleared 或 user should 应答 that there will 最高 likely be 错误 中 数据 caused 通过 change. Note: 如果 RX 奇偶校验 错误 are occurring intermittently 此 could be due 至 长度 的 SCI ISR. 至 help prevent 此, ensure that 中断 nesting 为 limited, increase SCI 中断 优先级, 及 move 作为 much 的 处理 作为 possible out 的 ISR (至 reduce ISR 时间 至 absolute 最小). 0h (R/W) = No 奇偶校验 错误 occurred 期间 receiving 字符, 中 位 7-0. 此 位 为 associated 带 字符 开启 top 的 FIFO队列. 1h (R/W) = 奇偶校验 错误 occurred 期间 receiving 字符 中 位 7-0. 此 位 为 associated 带 字符 开启 top 的 FIFO队列.
Fields.Notes:
原文：14 Receiver error flag；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2705页；原文字段表：SCIFFPE. SCI FIFO parity error flag bit (applicable only if the FIFO is 

enabled)
Note: 'SCIFFPE' is meant to serve as a flag for the specific set of 
data being received/read in the SCIRXBUF register. Each set of data 
received into the FIFO will have this information. The 'PE' bit within 
the SCIRXST register can be thought off as high level error flag 
where the flag will get set if any data that has been received has a 
parity error.
Note: If the parity is changed in the middle of data reception, the 
SCI module will not reinterpret the data with the new parity or other 
settings that may have changed. Therefore, changing the parameter, 
the FIFO should be cleared or the user should acknowledge that 
there will most likely be errors in the data caused by the change.
Note: If RX parity errors are occurring intermittently this could be 
due to the length of the SCI ISR. To help prevent this, ensure that 
interrupt nesting is limited, increase the SCI interrupt priority, and 
move as much of the processing as possible out of the ISR (to 
reduce ISR time to the absolute minimum).
0h (R/W) = No parity error occurred while receiving the character, in 
bits 7-0. This bit is associated with the character on the top of the 
FIFO. 
1h (R/W) = A parity error occurred while receiving the character in 
bits 7-0. This bit is associated with the character on the top of the 
FIFO.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Description: 中断 电平
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：TXFFIL4-0 发送 FIFO队列 中断 电平 位. 发送 FIFO队列 产生 中断 whenever FIFO队列 状态 位 (TXFFST4-0) are less than 或 equal 至 FIFO队列 电平 位 (TXFFIL4-0). 最大 值 that CAN be assigned 至 these 位 至 产生 中断 cannot be more than depth 的 TX FIFO队列. 默认 值 的 these 位 after 复位 为 00000b. Users should 置位 TXFFIL 至 best fit their application needs 通过 weighing between CPU overhead 至 service ISR 及 best possible usage 的 SCI 总线 bandwidth.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4:0 Interrupt level；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2709页；原文字段表：TXFFIL4-0 Transmit FIFO interrupt level bits.

The transmit FIFO generates an interrupt whenever the FIFO status 
bits (TXFFST4-0) are less than or equal to the FIFO level bits 
(TXFFIL4-0). The maximum value that can be assigned to these bits 
to generate an interrupt cannot be more than the depth of the TX 
FIFO. The default value of these bits after reset is 00000b. Users 
should set TXFFIL to best fit their application needs by weighing 
between the CPU overhead to service the ISR and the best possible 
usage of SCI bus bandwidth.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RXFFIL
Fields.Description: 中断 电平
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：接收 FIFO队列 中断 电平 位 接收 FIFO队列 产生 中断 whenever FIFO队列 状态 位 (RXFFST4-0) are greater than 或 equal 至 FIFO队列 电平 位 (RXFFIL4-0). 最大 值 that CAN be assigned 至 these 位 至 产生 中断 cannot be more than depth 的 RX FIFO队列. 默认 值 的 these 位 after 复位 为 11111b. Users should 置位 RXFFIL 至 best fit their application needs 通过 weighing between CPU overhead 至 service ISR 及 best possible usage 的 已接收 SCI 数据.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4:0 Interrupt level；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2711页；原文字段表：Receive FIFO interrupt level bits

The receive FIFO generates an interrupt whenever the FIFO status 
bits (RXFFST4-0) are greater than or equal to the FIFO level bits 
(RXFFIL4-0). The maximum value that can be assigned to these bits 
to generate an interrupt cannot be more than the depth of the RX 
FIFO. The default value of these bits after reset is 11111b. Users 
should set RXFFIL to best fit their application needs by weighing 
between the CPU overhead to service the ISR and the best possible 
usage of received SCI data.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: FFTXDLY
Fields.Description: FIFO队列 发送 延迟
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：FIFO队列 transfer 延迟. These 位 define 延迟 between every transfer 来自 FIFO队列 发送 bufferto 发送 shift 寄存器. 延迟 为 defined 中 数量 的 SCI serial 波特率 时钟 cycles. 8 位 寄存器 could define 最小 延迟 的 0 波特率 时钟 cycles 及 最大 的 256 波特率 时钟 cycles 中 FIFO队列 模式, 缓冲 (TXBUF) between shift 寄存器 及 FIFO队列 should be filled 仅 after shift 寄存器 has completed shifting 的 最后 位. 此 为 required 至 pass 开启 延迟 between transfers 至 数据 stream. 中 FIFO队列 模式, TXBUF should 不 be treated 作为 单次 额外 电平 的 缓冲. delayed 发送 feature will help 至 create auto-flow scheme without RTS/CTS 控制 作为 中 标准 UARTS. 当 SCI 为 configured 用于 单次 stop-bit, 延迟 introduced 通过 FFTXDLY between 单次 帧 及 下次 帧 为 equal 至 数量 的 波特率 时钟 cycles that FFTXDLY 为 置位 至. 当 SCI 为 configured 用于 two stop-bits, 延迟 introduced 通过 FFTXDLY between 单次 帧 及 下次 帧 为 equal 至 数量 的 波特率 时钟 cycles that FFTXDLY 为 置位 至 minus 1. Serial Communications Interface (SCI) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：7:0 FIFO transmit delay；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2712页；原文字段表：FIFO transfer delay. These bits define the delay between every 

transfer from FIFO transmit bufferto transmit shift register. The delay 
is defined in the number of SCI serial baud clock cycles. The 8 bit 
register could define a minimum delay of 0 baud clock cycles and a 
maximum of 256 baud clock cycles
In FIFO mode, the buffer (TXBUF) between the shift register and 
the FIFO should be filled only after the shift register has completed 
shifting of the last bit. This is required to pass on the delay between 
transfers to the data stream. In FIFO mode, TXBUF should not be 
treated as one additional level of buffer. The delayed transmit feature 
will help to create an auto-flow scheme without RTS/CTS controls as 
in standard UARTS.
When SCI is configured for one stop-bit, delay introduced by 
FFTXDLY between one frame and the next frame is equal to number 
of baud clock cycles that FFTXDLY is set to.
When SCI is configured for two stop-bits, delay introduced by 
FFTXDLY between one frame and the next frame is equal to number 
of baud clock cycles that FFTXDLY is set to minus 1.
Serial Communications Interface (SCI)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CLKPOLARITY
Fields.Description: SPI时钟极性。
Fields.Values: 0：空闲低电平；1：空闲高电平。采样边沿还取决于CLK_PHASE。
Fields.Notes:
原文：6 Shift Clock Polarity；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2649页；原文字段表：Shift Clock Polarity

This bit controls the polarity of the SPICLK signal. CLOCK 
POLARITY and POLARITY CLOCK PHASE (SPICTL.3) control four 
clocking schemes on the SPICLK pin.
0h (R/W) = Data is output on rising edge and input on falling edge. 
When no SPI data is sent, SPICLK is at low level. The data input 
and output edges depend on the value of the CLOCK PHASE bit 
(SPICTL.3) as follows:
- CLOCK PHASE = 0: Data is output on the rising edge of the 
SPICLK signal. Input data is latched on the falling edge of the 
SPICLK signal.
- CLOCK PHASE = 1: Data is output one half-cycle before the first 
rising edge of the SPICLK signal and on subsequent falling edges 
of the SPICLK signal. Input data is latched on the rising edge of the 
SPICLK signal. 
1h (R/W) = Data is output on falling edge and input on rising edge. 
When no SPI data is sent, SPICLK is at high level. The data input 
and output edges depend on the value of the CLOCK PHASE bit 
(SPICTL.3) as follows:
- CLOCK PHASE = 0: Data is output on the falling edge of the 
SPICLK signal. Input data is latched on the rising edge of the 
SPICLK signal.
- CLOCK PHASE = 1: Data is output one half-cycle before the first 
falling edge of the SPICLK signal and on subsequent rising edges of 
the SPICLK signal. Input data is latched on the falling edge of the 
SPICLK signal.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUIW9C / 2024-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: SPISWRESET
Fields.Description: SPI软件复位。
Fields.Values: 0：保持SPI复位；1：释放复位。
Fields.Notes:
原文：7 SPI Software Reset；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2649页；原文字段表：SPI Software Reset

When changing configuration, you should clear this bit before the 
changes and set this bit before resuming operation.
0h (R/W) = Initializes the SPI operating flags to the reset condition. 
Specifically, the RECEIVER OVERRUN Flag bit (SPISTS.7), the 
SPI INT FLAG bit (SPISTS.6), and the TXBUF FULL Flag bit 
(SPISTS.5) are cleared. SPISTE will become inactive. SPICLK will 
be immediately driven to 0 regardless of the clock polarity. The SPI 
configuration remains unchanged. 
1h (R/W) = SPI is ready to transmit or receive the next character. 
When the SPI SW RESET bit is a 0, a character written to the 
transmitter will not be shifted out when this bit is set. A new character 
must be written to the serial data register. SPICLK will be returned to 
its inactive state one SPICLK cycle after this bit is set.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUIW9C / 2024-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: TALK
Fields.Description: SPI发送输出使能。
Fields.Values: 0：禁止发送引脚驱动；1：允许发送。
Fields.Notes:
原文：1 Master/Slave Transmit Enable；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2652页；原文字段表：Transmit Enable

The TALK bit can disable data transmission (master or slave) by 
placing the serial data output in the high-impedance state. If this bit 
is disabled during a transmission, the transmit shift register continues 
to operate until the previous character is shifted out. When the TALK 
bit is disabled, the SPI is still able to receive characters and update 
the status flags. TALK is cleared (disabled) by a system reset.
0h (R/W) = Disables transmission:
- Slave mode operation: If not previously configured as a general-
purpose I/O pin, the SPISOMI pin will be put in the high-impedance 
state.
- Master mode operation: If not previously configured as a general-
purpose I/O pin, the SPISIMO pin will be put in the high-impedance 
state. 
1h (R/W) = Enables transmission For the 4-pin option, ensure to 
enable the receiver's SPISTEn input pin.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUIW9C / 2024-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: CLK_PHASE
Fields.Description: SPI 时钟 相位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SPI 时钟 相位 选择 此 位 控制 相位 的 SPICLK 信号. 时钟 相位 及 时钟 极性 (SPICCR.6) make four different 时钟 schemes possible (see 时钟 figures 中 SPI chapter). 当 工作 带 时钟 相位 高, SPI (主机 或 从机) makes 首个 位 的 数据 available after SPIDAT 为 written 及 before 首个 边沿 的 SPICLK 信号, regardless 的 which SPI 模式 为 being 使用. 0h (R/W) = Normal SPI 时钟 scheme, depending 开启 时钟 极性 位 (SPICCR.6). 1h (R/W) = SPICLK 信号 delayed 通过 单次 半周期. 极性 determined 通过 时钟 极性 位.
Fields.Notes:
原文：3 SPI Clock Phase；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2651页；原文字段表：SPI Clock Phase Select

This bit controls the phase of the SPICLK signal. CLOCK PHASE 
and CLOCK POLARITY (SPICCR.6) make four different clocking 
schemes possible (see clocking figures in SPI chapter). When 
operating with CLOCK PHASE high, the SPI (master or slave) 
makes the first bit of data available after SPIDAT is written and 
before the first edge of the SPICLK signal, regardless of which SPI 
mode is being used.
0h (R/W) = Normal SPI clocking scheme, depending on the CLOCK 
POLARITY bit (SPICCR.6). 
1h (R/W) = SPICLK signal delayed by one half-cycle. Polarity 
determined by the CLOCK POLARITY bit.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

原文：4 Overrun Interrupt Enable；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2651页；原文字段表：Overrun Interrupt Enable

Flag bit and the SPI INT FLAG bit (SPISTS.6) share the same 
interrupt vector.
0h (R/W) = Disable RECEIVER OVERRUN interrupts. 
1h (R/W) = Enable RECEIVER_OVERRUN interrupts.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INT_FLAG
Fields.Description: SPI 中断 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SPI 中断 标志 SPI 中断 标志 为 只读 标志. 硬件 设置 此 位 至 indicate that SPI has completed sending 或 receiving 最后 位 及 为 就绪 至 be serviced. 此 标志 causes 中断 至 be requested 如果 SPI 中断 ENA 位 (SPICTL.0) 为 置位. 已接收 字符 为 placed 中 接收器 缓冲 在 same 时间 此 位 为 置位. 此 位 为 cleared 中 单次 的 three ways: - Reading SPIRXBUF - Writing 0 至 SPI 软件 复位 (SPICCR.7) - 复位 系统 Note: 此 位 should 不 be 使用 如果 FIFO队列 模式 为 已使能. 内部 process 的 copying 已接收 字 来自 SPIRXBUF 至 接收 FIFO队列 will 清除 此 位. Use FIFO队列 状态, 或 FIFO队列 中断 位 用于 similar functionality. 0h (R/W) = No 满 words have been 已接收 或 已发送. 1h (R/W) = 表示 that SPI has completed sending 或 receiving 最后 位 及 为 就绪 至 be serviced.
Fields.Notes:
原文：6 SPI Interrupt Flag；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2654页；原文字段表：SPI Interrupt Flag

SPI INT FLAG is a read-only flag. Hardware sets this bit to indicate 
that the SPI has completed sending or receiving the last bit and is 
ready to be serviced. This flag causes an interrupt to be requested 
if the SPI INT ENA bit (SPICTL.0) is set. The received character is 
placed in the receiver buffer at the same time this bit is set. This bit is 
cleared in one of three ways:
- Reading SPIRXBUF
- Writing a 0 to SPI SW RESET (SPICCR.7)
- Resetting the system
Note: This bit should not be used if FIFO mode is enabled. The 
internal process of copying the received word from SPIRXBUF to 
the Receive FIFO will clear this bit. Use the FIFO status, or FIFO 
interrupt bits for similar functionality.
0h (R/W) = No full words have been received or transmitted. 
1h (R/W) = Indicates that the SPI has completed sending or 
receiving the last bit and is ready to be serviced.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OVERRUN_FLAG
Fields.Description: SPI 接收器 溢出 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SPI 接收器 溢出 标志 此 位 为 read/clear-only 标志. SPI 硬件 设置 此 位 当 接收 或 发送 操作 completes before 前次 字符 has been 读取 来自 缓冲. 位 为 cleared 中 单次 的 three ways: - Writing 1 至 此 位 - Writing 0 至 SPI 软件 复位 (SPICCR.7) - 复位 系统 如果 溢出 中断 ENA 位 (SPICTL.4) 为 置位, SPI requests 仅 单次 中断 upon 首个 occurrence 的 设置 接收器 溢出 标志 位. Subsequent overruns will 不 请求 额外 中断 如果 此 标志 位 为 already 置位. 此 means that 中 order 至 allow new 溢出 中断 requests user must 清除 此 标志 位 通过 writing 1 至 SPISTS.7 每个 时间 溢出 条件 发生. 中 other words, 如果 接收器 溢出 标志 位 为 left 置位 (不 cleared) 通过 中断 service routine, another 溢出 中断 will 不 be immediately re-entered 当 中断 service routine 为 exited. 0h (R/W) = 接收 溢出 条件 has 不 occurred. 1h (R/W) = 最后 已接收 字符 has been overwritten 及 therefore 丢失 (当 SPIRXBUF was overwritten 通过 SPI 模块 before 前次 字符 was 读取 通过 user application). Writing '1' will 清除 此 位. 接收器 溢出 标志 位 should be cleared during 中断 service routine because 接收器 溢出 标志 位 及 SPI 中断 标志 位 (SPISTS.6) share same 中断 向量. 此 will alleviate any possible doubt 作为 至 来源 的 中断 当 下次 字节 为 已接收.
Fields.Notes:
原文：7 SPI Receiver Overrun Flag；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2653页；原文字段表：SPI Receiver Overrun Flag

This bit is a read/clear-only flag. The SPI hardware sets this bit 
when a receive or transmit operation completes before the previous 
character has been read from the buffer. The bit is cleared in one of 
three ways:
- Writing a 1 to this bit
- Writing a 0 to SPI SW RESET (SPICCR.7)
- Resetting the system
If the OVERRUN INT ENA bit (SPICTL.4) is set, the SPI requests 
only one interrupt upon the first occurrence of setting the RECEIVER 
OVERRUN Flag bit. Subsequent overruns will not request additional 
interrupts if this flag bit is already set. This means that in order to 
allow new overrun interrupt requests the user must clear this flag bit 
by writing a 1 to SPISTS.7 each time an overrun condition occurs. 
In other words, if the RECEIVER OVERRUN Flag bit is left set (not 
cleared) by the interrupt service routine, another overrun interrupt will 
not be immediately re-entered when the interrupt service routine is 
exited.
0h (R/W) = A receive overrun condition has not occurred. 
1h (R/W) = The last received character has been overwritten 
and therefore lost (when the SPIRXBUF was overwritten by the 
SPI module before the previous character was read by the user 
application).
Writing a '1' will clear this bit. The RECEIVER OVERRUN Flag bit 
should be cleared during the interrupt service routine because the 
RECEIVER OVERRUN Flag bit and SPI INT FLAG bit (SPISTS.6) 
share the same interrupt vector. This will alleviate any possible doubt 
as to the source of the interrupt when the next byte is received.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SPI_BIT_RATE
Fields.Description: SPI 位 速率 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SPI 波特率 速率 控制 These 位 determine 位 transfer 速率 如果 SPI 为 network SPI 位 速率 0 主机. There are 125 data-transfer rates (每个 功能 的 CPU 时钟, LSPCLK) that CAN be 已选. 单次 数据 位 为 shifted per SPICLK 周期. (SPICLK 为 波特率 速率 时钟 输出 开启 SPICLK 引脚.) 如果 SPI 为 network 从机, 模块 receives 时钟 开启 SPICLK 引脚 来自 network 主机. Therefore, these 位 have no effect 开启 SPICLK 信号. 频率 的 输入 时钟 来自 主机 should 不 超过 从机 SPI's LSPCLK 信号 divided 通过 4. 中 主机 模式, SPI 时钟 为 已产生 通过 SPI 及 为 输出 开启 SPICLK 引脚. SPI 波特率 rates are determined 通过 following formula: 用于 SPIBRR = 3 至 127: SPI 波特率 速率 = LSPCLK / (SPIBRR + 1) 用于 SPIBRR = 0, 1, 或 2: SPI 波特率 速率 = LSPCLK / 4 3h (R/W) = SPI 波特率 速率 = LSPCLK/4 4h (R/W) = SPI 波特率 速率 = LSPCLK/5 7Eh (R/W) = SPI 波特率 速率 = LSPCLK/127 7Fh (R/W) = SPI 波特率 速率 = LSPCLK/128
Fields.Notes:
原文：6:0 SPI Bit Rate Control；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2655页；原文字段表：SPI Baud Rate Control

These bits determine the bit transfer rate if the SPI is the network 
SPI BIT RATE 0 master. There are 125 data-transfer rates (each 
a function of the CPU clock, LSPCLK) that can be selected. One 
data bit is shifted per SPICLK cycle. (SPICLK is the baud rate clock 
output on the SPICLK pin.)
If the SPI is a network slave, the module receives a clock on the 
SPICLK pin from the network master. Therefore, these bits have no 
effect on the SPICLK signal. The frequency of the input clock from 
the master should not exceed the slave SPI's LSPCLK signal divided 
by 4.
In master mode, the SPI clock is generated by the SPI and is output 
on the SPICLK pin. The SPI baud rates are determined by the 
following formula:
For SPIBRR = 3 to 127: SPI Baud Rate = LSPCLK / (SPIBRR + 1)
For SPIBRR = 0, 1, or 2: SPI Baud Rate = LSPCLK / 4
3h (R/W) = SPI Baud Rate = LSPCLK/4 
4h (R/W) = SPI Baud Rate = LSPCLK/5 
7Eh (R/W) = SPI Baud Rate = LSPCLK/127 
7Fh (R/W) = SPI Baud Rate = LSPCLK/128；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

(TXFFST4-0) and FIFO level bits (TXFFIL4-0 ) match (less than or 
equal to).

no words remaining in the TX buffer.

Fields.Name: TXDLY
Fields.Description: FIFO队列 发送 延迟 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：FIFO队列 发送 延迟 位 These 位 define 延迟 between every transfer 来自 FIFO队列 发送 缓冲 至 发送 shift 寄存器. 延迟 为 defined 中 数量 SPI serial 时钟 cycles. 8-位 寄存器 could define 最小 延迟 的 0 serial 时钟 cycles 及 最大 的 255 serial 时钟 cycles. 中 FIFO队列 模式, 缓冲 (TXBUF) between shift 寄存器 及 FIFO队列 should be filled 仅 after shift 寄存器 has completed shifting 的 最后 位. 此 为 required 至 pass 开启 延迟 between transfers 至 数据 stream. 中 FIFO队列 模式 TXBUF should 不 be treated 作为 单次 额外 电平 的 缓冲. 0h (R/W) = 下次 字 中 TX FIFO队列 缓冲 为 transferred 至 SPITXBUF immediately upon completion 的 发送 的 前次 字. 1h (R/W) = 下次 字 中 TX FIFO队列 缓冲 为 transferred 至 SPITXBUF1 serial 时钟 周期 after completion 的 发送 的 前次 字. 2h (R/W) = 下次 字 中 TX FIFO队列 缓冲 为 transferred 至 SPITXBUF 2 serial 时钟 cycles after completion 的 发送 的 前次 字. FFh (R/W) = 下次 字 中 TX FIFO队列 缓冲 为 transferred 至 SPITXBUF 255 serial 时钟 cycles after completion 的 发送 的 前次 字. Serial 外设 Interface (SPI) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：7:0 FIFO Transmit Delay Bits；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2664页；原文字段表：FIFO Transmit Delay Bits

These bits define the delay between every transfer from FIFO 
transmit buffer to transmit shift register. The delay is defined in 
number SPI serial clock cycles. The 8-bit register could define a 
minimum delay of 0 serial clock cycles and a maximum of 255 serial 
clock cycles. In FIFO mode, the buffer (TXBUF) between the shift 
register and the FIFO should be filled only after the shift register 
has completed shifting of the last bit. This is required to pass on 
the delay between transfers to the data stream. In the FIFO mode 
TXBUF should not be treated as one additional level of buffer.
0h (R/W) = The next word in the TX FIFO buffer is transferred 
to SPITXBUF immediately upon completion of transmission of the 
previous word. 
1h (R/W) = The next word in the TX FIFO buffer is transferred to 
SPITXBUF1 serial clock cycle after completion of transmission of the 
previous word. 
2h (R/W) = The next word in the TX FIFO buffer is transferred to 
SPITXBUF 2 serial clock cycles after completion of transmission of 
the previous word. 
FFh (R/W) = The next word in the TX FIFO buffer is transferred to 
SPITXBUF 255 serial clock cycles after completion of transmission of 
the previous word. 
Serial Peripheral Interface (SPI)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: FREE
Fields.Description: 自由运行 仿真 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：仿真 自由运行 Run These 位 determine what 发生 当 仿真 暂停 发生 (用于 example, 当 debugger hits breakpoint). 外设 CAN continue whatever it 为 doing (free-run 模式) 或, 如果 中 停止 模式, it CAN either 停止 immediately 或 停止 当 当前 操作 ( 当前 receive/transmit sequence) 为 complete. 0h (R/W) = 仿真 模式 为 已选 通过 软 位 1h (R/W) = 自由运行 run, continue SPI 操作 regardless 的 暂停 或 当 暂停 occurred.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4 Free emulation mode；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2665页；原文字段表：Emulation Free Run

These bits determine what occurs when an emulation suspend 
occurs (for example, when the debugger hits a breakpoint). The 
peripheral can continue whatever it is doing (free-run mode) or, if in 
stop mode, it can either stop immediately or stop when the current 
operation (the current receive/transmit sequence) is complete.
0h (R/W) = Emulation mode is selected by the SOFT bit 
1h (R/W) = Free run, continue SPI operation regardless of suspend 
or when the suspend occurred.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SOFT
Fields.Description: 软 仿真 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：仿真 软 Run 此 位 仅 has effect 当 自由运行 位 为 0. 0h (R/W) = 发送 stops midway 中 位 stream 期间 TSUSPEND 为 已置有效. Once TSUSPEND 为 deasserted without 系统 复位, 余数 的 位 待处理 中 DATBUF are shifted. Example: 如果 SPIDAT has shifted 3 out 的 8 位, communication freezes right there. However, 如果 TSUSPEND 为 later deasserted without 复位 SPI, SPI starts transmitting 来自 where it had stopped (fourth 位 中 此 case) 及 will 发送 8 位 来自 that point. 1h (R/W) = 如果 仿真 暂停 发生 before 启动 的 发送, (that 为, before 首个 SPICLK 脉冲) then 发送 will 不 occur. 如果 仿真 暂停 发生 after 启动 的 发送, then 数据 will be shifted out 至 completion. 当 启动 的 发送 发生 为 dependent 开启 波特率 速率 使用. 标准 SPI 模式: 停止 after transmitting words 中 shift 寄存器 及 缓冲. That 为, after TXBUF 及 SPIDAT are 空. 中 FIFO队列 模式: 停止 after transmitting words 中 shift 寄存器 及 缓冲. That 为, after TX FIFO队列 及 SPIDAT are 空.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5 Soft emulation mode；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2665页；原文字段表：Emulation Soft Run

This bit only has an effect when the FREE bit is 0.
0h (R/W) = Transmission stops midway in the bit stream while 
TSUSPEND is asserted. Once TSUSPEND is deasserted without 
a system reset, the remainder of the bits pending in the DATBUF 
are shifted. Example: If SPIDAT has shifted 3 out of 8 bits, the 
communication freezes right there. However, if TSUSPEND is later 
deasserted without resetting the SPI, SPI starts transmitting from 
where it had stopped (fourth bit in this case) and will transmit 8 bits 
from that point. 
1h (R/W) = If the emulation suspend occurs before the start of 
a transmission, (that is, before the first SPICLK pulse) then the 
transmission will not occur. If the emulation suspend occurs after 
the start of a transmission, then the data will be shifted out to 
completion. When the start of transmission occurs is dependent on 
the baud rate used.
Standard SPI mode: Stop after transmitting the words in the shift 
register and buffer. That is, after TXBUF and SPIDAT are empty.
In FIFO mode: Stop after transmitting the words in the shift register 
and buffer. That is, after TX FIFO and SPIDAT are empty.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CLKPOLARITY
Fields.Description: SPI时钟极性。
Fields.Values: 0：空闲低电平；1：空闲高电平。采样边沿还取决于CLK_PHASE。
Fields.Notes:
原文：6 Shift Clock Polarity；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2649页；原文字段表：Shift Clock Polarity

This bit controls the polarity of the SPICLK signal. CLOCK 
POLARITY and POLARITY CLOCK PHASE (SPICTL.3) control four 
clocking schemes on the SPICLK pin.
0h (R/W) = Data is output on rising edge and input on falling edge. 
When no SPI data is sent, SPICLK is at low level. The data input 
and output edges depend on the value of the CLOCK PHASE bit 
(SPICTL.3) as follows:
- CLOCK PHASE = 0: Data is output on the rising edge of the 
SPICLK signal. Input data is latched on the falling edge of the 
SPICLK signal.
- CLOCK PHASE = 1: Data is output one half-cycle before the first 
rising edge of the SPICLK signal and on subsequent falling edges 
of the SPICLK signal. Input data is latched on the rising edge of the 
SPICLK signal. 
1h (R/W) = Data is output on falling edge and input on rising edge. 
When no SPI data is sent, SPICLK is at high level. The data input 
and output edges depend on the value of the CLOCK PHASE bit 
(SPICTL.3) as follows:
- CLOCK PHASE = 0: Data is output on the falling edge of the 
SPICLK signal. Input data is latched on the rising edge of the 
SPICLK signal.
- CLOCK PHASE = 1: Data is output one half-cycle before the first 
falling edge of the SPICLK signal and on subsequent rising edges of 
the SPICLK signal. Input data is latched on the falling edge of the 
SPICLK signal.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUIW9C / 2024-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: SPISWRESET
Fields.Description: SPI软件复位。
Fields.Values: 0：保持SPI复位；1：释放复位。
Fields.Notes:
原文：7 SPI Software Reset；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2649页；原文字段表：SPI Software Reset

When changing configuration, you should clear this bit before the 
changes and set this bit before resuming operation.
0h (R/W) = Initializes the SPI operating flags to the reset condition. 
Specifically, the RECEIVER OVERRUN Flag bit (SPISTS.7), the 
SPI INT FLAG bit (SPISTS.6), and the TXBUF FULL Flag bit 
(SPISTS.5) are cleared. SPISTE will become inactive. SPICLK will 
be immediately driven to 0 regardless of the clock polarity. The SPI 
configuration remains unchanged. 
1h (R/W) = SPI is ready to transmit or receive the next character. 
When the SPI SW RESET bit is a 0, a character written to the 
transmitter will not be shifted out when this bit is set. A new character 
must be written to the serial data register. SPICLK will be returned to 
its inactive state one SPICLK cycle after this bit is set.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUIW9C / 2024-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: TALK
Fields.Description: SPI发送输出使能。
Fields.Values: 0：禁止发送引脚驱动；1：允许发送。
Fields.Notes:
原文：1 Master/Slave Transmit Enable；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2652页；原文字段表：Transmit Enable

The TALK bit can disable data transmission (master or slave) by 
placing the serial data output in the high-impedance state. If this bit 
is disabled during a transmission, the transmit shift register continues 
to operate until the previous character is shifted out. When the TALK 
bit is disabled, the SPI is still able to receive characters and update 
the status flags. TALK is cleared (disabled) by a system reset.
0h (R/W) = Disables transmission:
- Slave mode operation: If not previously configured as a general-
purpose I/O pin, the SPISOMI pin will be put in the high-impedance 
state.
- Master mode operation: If not previously configured as a general-
purpose I/O pin, the SPISIMO pin will be put in the high-impedance 
state. 
1h (R/W) = Enables transmission For the 4-pin option, ensure to 
enable the receiver's SPISTEn input pin.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUIW9C / 2024-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: MASTER_SLAVE
Fields.Description: SPI主从模式选择。
Fields.Values: 0：从机；1：主机。
Fields.Notes:
原文：2 SPI Network Mode Control；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2651页；原文字段表：SPI Network Mode Control

This bit determines whether the SPI is a network master or slave. 
SLAVE During reset initialization, the SPI is automatically configured

Fields.Name: CLK_PHASE
Fields.Description: SPI 时钟 相位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SPI 时钟 相位 选择 此 位 控制 相位 的 SPICLK 信号. 时钟 相位 及 时钟 极性 (SPICCR.6) make four different 时钟 schemes possible (see 时钟 figures 中 SPI chapter). 当 工作 带 时钟 相位 高, SPI (主机 或 从机) makes 首个 位 的 数据 available after SPIDAT 为 written 及 before 首个 边沿 的 SPICLK 信号, regardless 的 which SPI 模式 为 being 使用. 0h (R/W) = Normal SPI 时钟 scheme, depending 开启 时钟 极性 位 (SPICCR.6). 1h (R/W) = SPICLK 信号 delayed 通过 单次 半周期. 极性 determined 通过 时钟 极性 位.
Fields.Notes:
原文：3 SPI Clock Phase；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2651页；原文字段表：SPI Clock Phase Select

This bit controls the phase of the SPICLK signal. CLOCK PHASE 
and CLOCK POLARITY (SPICCR.6) make four different clocking 
schemes possible (see clocking figures in SPI chapter). When 
operating with CLOCK PHASE high, the SPI (master or slave) 
makes the first bit of data available after SPIDAT is written and 
before the first edge of the SPICLK signal, regardless of which SPI 
mode is being used.
0h (R/W) = Normal SPI clocking scheme, depending on the CLOCK 
POLARITY bit (SPICCR.6). 
1h (R/W) = SPICLK signal delayed by one half-cycle. Polarity 
determined by the CLOCK POLARITY bit.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INT_FLAG
Fields.Description: SPI 中断 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SPI 中断 标志 SPI 中断 标志 为 只读 标志. 硬件 设置 此 位 至 indicate that SPI has completed sending 或 receiving 最后 位 及 为 就绪 至 be serviced. 此 标志 causes 中断 至 be requested 如果 SPI 中断 ENA 位 (SPICTL.0) 为 置位. 已接收 字符 为 placed 中 接收器 缓冲 在 same 时间 此 位 为 置位. 此 位 为 cleared 中 单次 的 three ways: - Reading SPIRXBUF - Writing 0 至 SPI 软件 复位 (SPICCR.7) - 复位 系统 Note: 此 位 should 不 be 使用 如果 FIFO队列 模式 为 已使能. 内部 process 的 copying 已接收 字 来自 SPIRXBUF 至 接收 FIFO队列 will 清除 此 位. Use FIFO队列 状态, 或 FIFO队列 中断 位 用于 similar functionality. 0h (R/W) = No 满 words have been 已接收 或 已发送. 1h (R/W) = 表示 that SPI has completed sending 或 receiving 最后 位 及 为 就绪 至 be serviced.
Fields.Notes:
原文：6 SPI Interrupt Flag；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2654页；原文字段表：SPI Interrupt Flag

SPI INT FLAG is a read-only flag. Hardware sets this bit to indicate 
that the SPI has completed sending or receiving the last bit and is 
ready to be serviced. This flag causes an interrupt to be requested 
if the SPI INT ENA bit (SPICTL.0) is set. The received character is 
placed in the receiver buffer at the same time this bit is set. This bit is 
cleared in one of three ways:
- Reading SPIRXBUF
- Writing a 0 to SPI SW RESET (SPICCR.7)
- Resetting the system
Note: This bit should not be used if FIFO mode is enabled. The 
internal process of copying the received word from SPIRXBUF to 
the Receive FIFO will clear this bit. Use the FIFO status, or FIFO 
interrupt bits for similar functionality.
0h (R/W) = No full words have been received or transmitted. 
1h (R/W) = Indicates that the SPI has completed sending or 
receiving the last bit and is ready to be serviced.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OVERRUN_FLAG
Fields.Description: SPI 接收器 溢出 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SPI 接收器 溢出 标志 此 位 为 read/clear-only 标志. SPI 硬件 设置 此 位 当 接收 或 发送 操作 completes before 前次 字符 has been 读取 来自 缓冲. 位 为 cleared 中 单次 的 three ways: - Writing 1 至 此 位 - Writing 0 至 SPI 软件 复位 (SPICCR.7) - 复位 系统 如果 溢出 中断 ENA 位 (SPICTL.4) 为 置位, SPI requests 仅 单次 中断 upon 首个 occurrence 的 设置 接收器 溢出 标志 位. Subsequent overruns will 不 请求 额外 中断 如果 此 标志 位 为 already 置位. 此 means that 中 order 至 allow new 溢出 中断 requests user must 清除 此 标志 位 通过 writing 1 至 SPISTS.7 每个 时间 溢出 条件 发生. 中 other words, 如果 接收器 溢出 标志 位 为 left 置位 (不 cleared) 通过 中断 service routine, another 溢出 中断 will 不 be immediately re-entered 当 中断 service routine 为 exited. 0h (R/W) = 接收 溢出 条件 has 不 occurred. 1h (R/W) = 最后 已接收 字符 has been overwritten 及 therefore 丢失 (当 SPIRXBUF was overwritten 通过 SPI 模块 before 前次 字符 was 读取 通过 user application). Writing '1' will 清除 此 位. 接收器 溢出 标志 位 should be cleared during 中断 service routine because 接收器 溢出 标志 位 及 SPI 中断 标志 位 (SPISTS.6) share same 中断 向量. 此 will alleviate any possible doubt 作为 至 来源 的 中断 当 下次 字节 为 已接收.
Fields.Notes:
原文：7 SPI Receiver Overrun Flag；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2653页；原文字段表：SPI Receiver Overrun Flag

This bit is a read/clear-only flag. The SPI hardware sets this bit 
when a receive or transmit operation completes before the previous 
character has been read from the buffer. The bit is cleared in one of 
three ways:
- Writing a 1 to this bit
- Writing a 0 to SPI SW RESET (SPICCR.7)
- Resetting the system
If the OVERRUN INT ENA bit (SPICTL.4) is set, the SPI requests 
only one interrupt upon the first occurrence of setting the RECEIVER 
OVERRUN Flag bit. Subsequent overruns will not request additional 
interrupts if this flag bit is already set. This means that in order to 
allow new overrun interrupt requests the user must clear this flag bit 
by writing a 1 to SPISTS.7 each time an overrun condition occurs. 
In other words, if the RECEIVER OVERRUN Flag bit is left set (not 
cleared) by the interrupt service routine, another overrun interrupt will 
not be immediately re-entered when the interrupt service routine is 
exited.
0h (R/W) = A receive overrun condition has not occurred. 
1h (R/W) = The last received character has been overwritten 
and therefore lost (when the SPIRXBUF was overwritten by the 
SPI module before the previous character was read by the user 
application).
Writing a '1' will clear this bit. The RECEIVER OVERRUN Flag bit 
should be cleared during the interrupt service routine because the 
RECEIVER OVERRUN Flag bit and SPI INT FLAG bit (SPISTS.6) 
share the same interrupt vector. This will alleviate any possible doubt 
as to the source of the interrupt when the next byte is received.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SPI_BIT_RATE
Fields.Description: SPI 位 速率 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SPI 波特率 速率 控制 These 位 determine 位 transfer 速率 如果 SPI 为 network SPI 位 速率 0 主机. There are 125 data-transfer rates (每个 功能 的 CPU 时钟, LSPCLK) that CAN be 已选. 单次 数据 位 为 shifted per SPICLK 周期. (SPICLK 为 波特率 速率 时钟 输出 开启 SPICLK 引脚.) 如果 SPI 为 network 从机, 模块 receives 时钟 开启 SPICLK 引脚 来自 network 主机. Therefore, these 位 have no effect 开启 SPICLK 信号. 频率 的 输入 时钟 来自 主机 should 不 超过 从机 SPI's LSPCLK 信号 divided 通过 4. 中 主机 模式, SPI 时钟 为 已产生 通过 SPI 及 为 输出 开启 SPICLK 引脚. SPI 波特率 rates are determined 通过 following formula: 用于 SPIBRR = 3 至 127: SPI 波特率 速率 = LSPCLK / (SPIBRR + 1) 用于 SPIBRR = 0, 1, 或 2: SPI 波特率 速率 = LSPCLK / 4 3h (R/W) = SPI 波特率 速率 = LSPCLK/4 4h (R/W) = SPI 波特率 速率 = LSPCLK/5 7Eh (R/W) = SPI 波特率 速率 = LSPCLK/127 7Fh (R/W) = SPI 波特率 速率 = LSPCLK/128
Fields.Notes:
原文：6:0 SPI Bit Rate Control；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2655页；原文字段表：SPI Baud Rate Control

These bits determine the bit transfer rate if the SPI is the network 
SPI BIT RATE 0 master. There are 125 data-transfer rates (each 
a function of the CPU clock, LSPCLK) that can be selected. One 
data bit is shifted per SPICLK cycle. (SPICLK is the baud rate clock 
output on the SPICLK pin.)
If the SPI is a network slave, the module receives a clock on the 
SPICLK pin from the network master. Therefore, these bits have no 
effect on the SPICLK signal. The frequency of the input clock from 
the master should not exceed the slave SPI's LSPCLK signal divided 
by 4.
In master mode, the SPI clock is generated by the SPI and is output 
on the SPICLK pin. The SPI baud rates are determined by the 
following formula:
For SPIBRR = 3 to 127: SPI Baud Rate = LSPCLK / (SPIBRR + 1)
For SPIBRR = 0, 1, or 2: SPI Baud Rate = LSPCLK / 4
3h (R/W) = SPI Baud Rate = LSPCLK/4 
4h (R/W) = SPI Baud Rate = LSPCLK/5 
7Eh (R/W) = SPI Baud Rate = LSPCLK/127 
7Fh (R/W) = SPI Baud Rate = LSPCLK/128；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TXDLY
Fields.Description: FIFO队列 发送 延迟 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：FIFO队列 发送 延迟 位 These 位 define 延迟 between every transfer 来自 FIFO队列 发送 缓冲 至 发送 shift 寄存器. 延迟 为 defined 中 数量 SPI serial 时钟 cycles. 8-位 寄存器 could define 最小 延迟 的 0 serial 时钟 cycles 及 最大 的 255 serial 时钟 cycles. 中 FIFO队列 模式, 缓冲 (TXBUF) between shift 寄存器 及 FIFO队列 should be filled 仅 after shift 寄存器 has completed shifting 的 最后 位. 此 为 required 至 pass 开启 延迟 between transfers 至 数据 stream. 中 FIFO队列 模式 TXBUF should 不 be treated 作为 单次 额外 电平 的 缓冲. 0h (R/W) = 下次 字 中 TX FIFO队列 缓冲 为 transferred 至 SPITXBUF immediately upon completion 的 发送 的 前次 字. 1h (R/W) = 下次 字 中 TX FIFO队列 缓冲 为 transferred 至 SPITXBUF1 serial 时钟 周期 after completion 的 发送 的 前次 字. 2h (R/W) = 下次 字 中 TX FIFO队列 缓冲 为 transferred 至 SPITXBUF 2 serial 时钟 cycles after completion 的 发送 的 前次 字. FFh (R/W) = 下次 字 中 TX FIFO队列 缓冲 为 transferred 至 SPITXBUF 255 serial 时钟 cycles after completion 的 发送 的 前次 字. Serial 外设 Interface (SPI) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：7:0 FIFO Transmit Delay Bits；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2664页；原文字段表：FIFO Transmit Delay Bits

These bits define the delay between every transfer from FIFO 
transmit buffer to transmit shift register. The delay is defined in 
number SPI serial clock cycles. The 8-bit register could define a 
minimum delay of 0 serial clock cycles and a maximum of 255 serial 
clock cycles. In FIFO mode, the buffer (TXBUF) between the shift 
register and the FIFO should be filled only after the shift register 
has completed shifting of the last bit. This is required to pass on 
the delay between transfers to the data stream. In the FIFO mode 
TXBUF should not be treated as one additional level of buffer.
0h (R/W) = The next word in the TX FIFO buffer is transferred 
to SPITXBUF immediately upon completion of transmission of the 
previous word. 
1h (R/W) = The next word in the TX FIFO buffer is transferred to 
SPITXBUF1 serial clock cycle after completion of transmission of the 
previous word. 
2h (R/W) = The next word in the TX FIFO buffer is transferred to 
SPITXBUF 2 serial clock cycles after completion of transmission of 
the previous word. 
FFh (R/W) = The next word in the TX FIFO buffer is transferred to 
SPITXBUF 255 serial clock cycles after completion of transmission of 
the previous word. 
Serial Peripheral Interface (SPI)

Fields.Name: FREE
Fields.Description: 自由运行 仿真 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：仿真 自由运行 Run These 位 determine what 发生 当 仿真 暂停 发生 (用于 example, 当 debugger hits breakpoint). 外设 CAN continue whatever it 为 doing (free-run 模式) 或, 如果 中 停止 模式, it CAN either 停止 immediately 或 停止 当 当前 操作 ( 当前 receive/transmit sequence) 为 complete. 0h (R/W) = 仿真 模式 为 已选 通过 软 位 1h (R/W) = 自由运行 run, continue SPI 操作 regardless 的 暂停 或 当 暂停 occurred.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4 Free emulation mode；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2665页；原文字段表：Emulation Free Run

These bits determine what occurs when an emulation suspend 
occurs (for example, when the debugger hits a breakpoint). The 
peripheral can continue whatever it is doing (free-run mode) or, if in 
stop mode, it can either stop immediately or stop when the current 
operation (the current receive/transmit sequence) is complete.
0h (R/W) = Emulation mode is selected by the SOFT bit 
1h (R/W) = Free run, continue SPI operation regardless of suspend 
or when the suspend occurred.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SOFT
Fields.Description: 软 仿真 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：仿真 软 Run 此 位 仅 has effect 当 自由运行 位 为 0. 0h (R/W) = 发送 stops midway 中 位 stream 期间 TSUSPEND 为 已置有效. Once TSUSPEND 为 deasserted without 系统 复位, 余数 的 位 待处理 中 DATBUF are shifted. Example: 如果 SPIDAT has shifted 3 out 的 8 位, communication freezes right there. However, 如果 TSUSPEND 为 later deasserted without 复位 SPI, SPI starts transmitting 来自 where it had stopped (fourth 位 中 此 case) 及 will 发送 8 位 来自 that point. 1h (R/W) = 如果 仿真 暂停 发生 before 启动 的 发送, (that 为, before 首个 SPICLK 脉冲) then 发送 will 不 occur. 如果 仿真 暂停 发生 after 启动 的 发送, then 数据 will be shifted out 至 completion. 当 启动 的 发送 发生 为 dependent 开启 波特率 速率 使用. 标准 SPI 模式: 停止 after transmitting words 中 shift 寄存器 及 缓冲. That 为, after TXBUF 及 SPIDAT are 空. 中 FIFO队列 模式: 停止 after transmitting words 中 shift 寄存器 及 缓冲. That 为, after TX FIFO队列 及 SPIDAT are 空.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5 Soft emulation mode；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第2665页；原文字段表：Emulation Soft Run

This bit only has an effect when the FREE bit is 0.
0h (R/W) = Transmission stops midway in the bit stream while 
TSUSPEND is asserted. Once TSUSPEND is deasserted without 
a system reset, the remainder of the bits pending in the DATBUF 
are shifted. Example: If SPIDAT has shifted 3 out of 8 bits, the 
communication freezes right there. However, if TSUSPEND is later 
deasserted without resetting the SPI, SPI starts transmitting from 
where it had stopped (fourth bit in this case) and will transmit 8 bits 
from that point. 
1h (R/W) = If the emulation suspend occurs before the start of 
a transmission, (that is, before the first SPICLK pulse) then the 
transmission will not occur. If the emulation suspend occurs after 
the start of a transmission, then the data will be shifted out to 
completion. When the start of transmission occurs is dependent on 
the baud rate used.
Standard SPI mode: Stop after transmitting the words in the shift 
register and buffer. That is, after TXBUF and SPIDAT are empty.
In FIFO mode: Stop after transmitting the words in the shift register 
and buffer. That is, after TX FIFO and SPIDAT are empty.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

WDDIS bit cannot be modified by the user. Writing a 0 will have 
no effect. If this bit is cleared, then it will remain in this state until a

Fields.Notes:

This bit determines whether the watchdog triggers an interrupt 
(WAKE/WDOG) or a reset (WDRS) when the counter expires.
0h (R/W) = Counter expiration triggers a reset. This is the default 
state on power-up and after any system reset.

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：看门狗 中断 状态 此 位 表示 状态 的 active-low 看门狗 中断 信号 (synchronized 至 SYSCLK). 如果 看门狗 中断 为 使用 至 唤醒 系统 来自 low-power 模式, then that 模式 should 仅 be entered 期间 此 位 为 高. Likewise, 此 位 must go 高 before 看门狗 CAN be safely 已禁用 及 re-enabled. 0h (R/W) = 看门狗 中断 信号 为 活动. 1h (R/W) = 看门狗 中断 信号 为 非活动.
Fields.Notes:
原文：2 WD Interrupt Status；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第516页；原文字段表：Watchdog Interrupt Status

This bit indicates the state of the active-low watchdog interrupt signal 
(synchronized to SYSCLK). If the watchdog interrupt is used to wake 
the system from a low-power mode, then that mode should only be 
entered while this bit is high. Likewise, this bit must go high before 
the watchdog can be safely disabled and re-enabled.
0h (R/W) = The watchdog interrupt signal is active. 
1h (R/W) = The watchdog interrupt signal is inactive.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: WDCNTR
Fields.Description: WD 计数器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：看门狗 计数器 These 位 contain 当前 值 的 看门狗 计数器. 此 计数器 increments 带 每个 WDCLK (INTOSC1) 周期. 如果 计数器 overflows, either 中断 或 复位 为 已产生 based 开启 值 的 WDINTEN 位 中 SCSR 寄存器. 如果 correct 值 为 written 至 WDKEY 寄存器, 此 计数器 为 复位 至 零.
Fields.Notes:
原文：7:0 WD Counter；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第517页；原文字段表：Watchdog Counter

These bits contain the current value of the watchdog counter. This 
counter increments with each WDCLK (INTOSC1) cycle. If the 
counter overflows, either an interrupt or a reset is generated based 
on the value of the WDINTEN bit in the SCSR register. If the correct 
value is written to the WDKEY register, this counter is reset to zero.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: WDPS
Fields.Description: 看门狗预分频选择。
Fields.Notes:
原文：2:0 WD Clock Prescalar；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第520页；原文字段表：Watchdog Clock Prescaler

These bits determine the watchdog clock prescaler, which is the 
second of the two dividers between INTOSC1 and the watchdog 
counter clock (WDCLK). The frequency of WDCLK is given by the 
formulas:
PREDIVCLK = INTOSC1 / Pre-divider
WDCLK = PREDIVCLK / Prescaler
The watchdog reset or interrupt pulse is 512 INTOSC1 cycles long, 
so the counter period must be longer. To guarantee this, the product 
of the prescaler and pre-divider must be greater than or equal to four. 
The default prescaler value is 1.
0h (R/W) = WDCLK = PREDIVCLK / 1 
1h (R/W) = WDCLK = PREDIVCLK / 1 
2h (R/W) = WDCLK = PREDIVCLK / 2 
3h (R/W) = WDCLK = PREDIVCLK / 4 
4h (R/W) = WDCLK = PREDIVCLK / 8 
5h (R/W) = WDCLK = PREDIVCLK / 16 
6h (R/W) = WDCLK = PREDIVCLK / 32 
7h (R/W) = WDCLK = PREDIVCLK / 64 
System Control and Interrupts
 www.ti.com；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUIW9C / 2024-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: WDCHK
Fields.Description: 看门狗控制寄存器写入校验位。
Fields.Values: 写WDCR时必须写入二进制101；其他值可能立即触发复位。
Fields.Notes:
原文：5:3 WD Check Bits；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第520页；原文字段表：R-0/W 0h Watchdog Check Bits

During any write to this register, these bits must be written with the 
value 101 (binary). Writing any other value will immediately trigger 
the watchdog reset or interrupt.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUIW9C / 2024-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: WDDIS
Fields.Description: 看门狗禁用控制。
Fields.Values: 0：使能看门狗；1：禁用看门狗，能否禁用还受SCSR.WDOVERRIDE约束。
Fields.Notes:
原文：6 WD Disable；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第519页；原文字段表：Watchdog Disable

Setting this bit disables the watchdog module. Clearing this bit 
enables the watchdog module. This bit can be locked by the 
WDOVERRIDE bit in the SCSR register. The watchdog is enabled 
on reset.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUIW9C / 2024-03对应字段表核对。

Fields.Notes:
原文：11:8 WD Pre Clock Divider；SPRUIW9C / 2024-03 PDF第519页；原文字段表：Watchdog Clock Pre-divider

These bits determine the watchdog clock pre-divider, which is the 
first of the two dividers between INTOSC1 and the watchdog counter 
clock (WDCLK). The frequency of WDCLK is given by the formulas:
PREDIVCLK = INTOSC1 / Pre-divider

always read as a 0.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Values: 采样窗口长度为ACQPS+1个采样时钟周期；必须核对该型号时钟定义及最小采样时间，不能跨系列套用。
Fields.Notes:
原文：8:0 SOC0 Acquisition Prescale；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第1637页；原文字段表：SOC0 Acquisition Prescale. Controls the sample and hold window 

for this SOC. The configured acquisition time must be at least as 
long as one ADCCLK cycle for correct ADC operation. The device 
datasheet will also specify a minimum sample and hold window 
duration.
000h Sample window is 1 system clock cycle wide
001h Sample window is 2 system clock cycles wide
002h Sample window is 3 system clock cycles wide
...
1FFh Sample window is 512 system clock cycles wide；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI33H / 2024-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: TRIGSEL
Fields.Description: SOC0 触发 源 选择
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SOC0 触发 源 选择. Along 带 SOC0 field 中 ADCINTSOCSEL1 寄存器, 此 位 field configures which 触发 will 置位 SOC0 标志 中 ADCSOCFLG1 寄存器 至 initiate 转换 至 启动 once 优先级 为 given 至 it. 00h ADCTRIG0 - 软件 仅 01h ADCTRIG1 - CPU1 定时器 0, TINT0n 02h ADCTRIG2 - CPU1 定时器 1, TINT1n 03h ADCTRIG3 - CPU1 定时器 2, TINT2n 04h ADCTRIG4 - GPIO, ADCEXTSOC 05h ADCTRIG5 - ePWM1, ADCSOCA 06h ADCTRIG6 - ePWM1, ADCSOCB 07h ADCTRIG7 - ePWM2, ADCSOCA 08h ADCTRIG8 - ePWM2, ADCSOCB 09h ADCTRIG9 - ePWM3, ADCSOCA 0Ah ADCTRIG10 - ePWM3, ADCSOCB 0Bh ADCTRIG11 - ePWM4, ADCSOCA 0Ch ADCTRIG12 - ePWM4, ADCSOCB 0Dh ADCTRIG13 - ePWM5, ADCSOCA 0Eh ADCTRIG14 - ePWM5, ADCSOCB 0Fh ADCTRIG15 - ePWM6, ADCSOCA 10h ADCTRIG16 - ePWM6, ADCSOCB 11h ADCTRIG17 - ePWM7, ADCSOCA 12h ADCTRIG18 - ePWM7, ADCSOCB 13h ADCTRIG19 - ePWM8, ADCSOCA 14h ADCTRIG20 - ePWM8, ADCSOCB 15h - 1Fh - 保留位
Fields.Notes:
原文：24:20 SOC0 Trigger Source Select；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第1636页；原文字段表：SOC0 Trigger Source Select. Along with the SOC0 field in the 

ADCINTSOCSEL1 register, this bit field configures which trigger 
will set the SOC0 flag in the ADCSOCFLG1 register to initiate a 
conversion to start once priority is given to it.
00h ADCTRIG0 - Software only
01h ADCTRIG1 - CPU1 Timer 0, TINT0n
02h ADCTRIG2 - CPU1 Timer 1, TINT1n
03h ADCTRIG3 - CPU1 Timer 2, TINT2n
04h ADCTRIG4 - GPIO, ADCEXTSOC
05h ADCTRIG5 - ePWM1, ADCSOCA
06h ADCTRIG6 - ePWM1, ADCSOCB
07h ADCTRIG7 - ePWM2, ADCSOCA
08h ADCTRIG8 - ePWM2, ADCSOCB
09h ADCTRIG9 - ePWM3, ADCSOCA
0Ah ADCTRIG10 - ePWM3, ADCSOCB
0Bh ADCTRIG11 - ePWM4, ADCSOCA
0Ch ADCTRIG12 - ePWM4, ADCSOCB
0Dh ADCTRIG13 - ePWM5, ADCSOCA
0Eh ADCTRIG14 - ePWM5, ADCSOCB
0Fh ADCTRIG15 - ePWM6, ADCSOCA
10h ADCTRIG16 - ePWM6, ADCSOCB
11h ADCTRIG17 - ePWM7, ADCSOCA
12h ADCTRIG18 - ePWM7, ADCSOCB
13h ADCTRIG19 - ePWM8, ADCSOCA
14h ADCTRIG20 - ePWM8, ADCSOCB
15h - 1Fh - Reserved；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RRPOINTER
Fields.Description: 中文释义待整理；原字段说明：Round Robin Pointer
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Round Robin Pointer. Holds 值 的 最后 converted round robin SOCx 至 be 使用 通过 round robin scheme 至 determine order 的 conversions. 00h SOC0 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC1 为 highest round robin 优先级. 01h SOC1 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC2 为 highest round robin 优先级. 02h SOC2 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC3 为 highest round robin 优先级. 03h SOC3 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC4 为 highest round robin 优先级. 04h SOC4 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC5 为 highest round robin 优先级. 05h SOC5 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC6 为 highest round robin 优先级. 06h SOC6 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC7 为 highest round robin 优先级. 07h SOC7 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC8 为 highest round robin 优先级. 08h SOC8 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC9 为 highest round robin 优先级. 09h SOC9 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC10 为 highest round robin 优先级. 0Ah SOC10 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC11 为 highest round robin 优先级. 0Bh SOC11 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC12 为 highest round robin 优先级. 0Ch SOC12 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC13 为 highest round robin 优先级. 0Dh SOC13 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC14 为 highest round robin 优先级. 0Eh SOC14 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC15 为 highest round robin 优先级. 0Fh SOC15 was 最后 round robin SOC转换启动 至 convert, SOC0 为 highest round robin 优先级. 10h 复位 值 至 indicate no SOC转换启动 has been converted. SOC0 为 highest round robin 优先级. 置位 至 此 值 当 ADC 模块 为 复位 通过 SOFTPRES 或 当 ADCSOCPRICTL 寄存器 为 written. 中 latter case, 如果 转换 为 currently 中 progress, it will complete 及 then new 优先级 will take effect. Others Invalid 值.
Fields.Notes:
原文：9:5 Round Robin Pointer；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第1615页；原文字段表：Round Robin Pointer. Holds the value of the last converted round 

robin SOCx to be used by the round robin scheme to determine 
order of conversions.
00h SOC0 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC1 is highest 
round robin priority.
01h SOC1 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC2 is highest 
round robin priority.

round robin priority.

round robin priority.

round robin priority.
05h SOC5 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC6 is highest 
round robin priority.
06h SOC6 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC7 is highest 
round robin priority.
07h SOC7 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC8 is highest 
round robin priority.
08h SOC8 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC9 is highest 
round robin priority.
09h SOC9 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC10 is highest 
round robin priority.
0Ah SOC10 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC11 is highest 
round robin priority.
0Bh SOC11 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC12 is highest 
round robin priority.
0Ch SOC12 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC13 is highest 
round robin priority.
0Dh SOC13 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC14 is highest 
round robin priority.
0Eh SOC14 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC15 is highest 
round robin priority.
0Fh SOC15 was last round robin SOC to convert, SOC0 is highest 
round robin priority.
10h Reset value to indicate no SOC has been converted. SOC0 is 
highest round robin priority. Set to this value when the ADC module 
is reset by SOFTPRES or when the ADCSOCPRICTL register is 
written. In the latter case, if a conversion is currently in progress, it 
will complete and then the new priority will take effect.

Fields.Name: PPBRESULT
Fields.Description: ADC 后置 处理 模块 结果
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ADC 后置 处理 模块 结果 1 结果 的 offset/reference subtraction 后置 转换 处理 为 stored 中 此 寄存器. 此 结果 为 available 1 SYSCLK 周期 after associated ADCRESULT 为 available. 如果 ADCINTFLG 为 polled 至 determine 当 至 读取 PPBRESULT, it may be necessary 至 add NOP instruction 至 ensure that updated 后置 转换 处理 结果 has posted 至 寄存器. NOTE: 如果 转换 associated 带 此 后置 处理 模块 为 12-位 转换, PPBRESULT 位 are limited 至 位 12:0. 模数转换 Converter (ADC) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:0 ADC Post Processing Block Result；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第1594页；原文字段表：ADC Post Processing Block Result 1

The result of the offset/reference subtraction post conversion 
processing is stored in this register.
This result is available 1 SYSCLK cycle after the associated 
ADCRESULT is available. If ADCINTFLG is polled to determine 
when to read the PPBRESULT, it may be necessary to add a NOP 
instruction to ensure that the updated post conversion processing 
result has posted to the register.
NOTE: If the conversion associated with this Post Processing Block 
is a 12-bit conversion, the PPBRESULT bits are limited to bits 12:0.
Analog-to-Digital Converter (ADC)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: PPBRESULT
Fields.Description: ADC 后置 处理 模块 结果
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ADC 后置 处理 模块 结果 1 结果 的 offset/reference subtraction 后置 转换 处理 为 stored 中 此 寄存器. 此 结果 为 available 1 SYSCLK 周期 after associated ADCRESULT 为 available. 如果 ADCINTFLG 为 polled 至 determine 当 至 读取 PPBRESULT, it may be necessary 至 add NOP instruction 至 ensure that updated 后置 转换 处理 结果 has posted 至 寄存器. NOTE: 如果 转换 associated 带 此 后置 处理 模块 为 12-位 转换, PPBRESULT 位 are limited 至 位 12:0. 模数转换 Converter (ADC) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:0 ADC Post Processing Block Result；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第1594页；原文字段表：ADC Post Processing Block Result 1

The result of the offset/reference subtraction post conversion 
processing is stored in this register.
This result is available 1 SYSCLK cycle after the associated 
ADCRESULT is available. If ADCINTFLG is polled to determine 
when to read the PPBRESULT, it may be necessary to add a NOP 
instruction to ensure that the updated post conversion processing 
result has posted to the register.
NOTE: If the conversion associated with this Post Processing Block 
is a 12-bit conversion, the PPBRESULT bits are limited to bits 12:0.
Analog-to-Digital Converter (ADC)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: PPBRESULT
Fields.Description: ADC 后置 处理 模块 结果
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ADC 后置 处理 模块 结果 1 结果 的 offset/reference subtraction 后置 转换 处理 为 stored 中 此 寄存器. 此 结果 为 available 1 SYSCLK 周期 after associated ADCRESULT 为 available. 如果 ADCINTFLG 为 polled 至 determine 当 至 读取 PPBRESULT, it may be necessary 至 add NOP instruction 至 ensure that updated 后置 转换 处理 结果 has posted 至 寄存器. NOTE: 如果 转换 associated 带 此 后置 处理 模块 为 12-位 转换, PPBRESULT 位 are limited 至 位 12:0. 模数转换 Converter (ADC) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:0 ADC Post Processing Block Result；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第1594页；原文字段表：ADC Post Processing Block Result 1

The result of the offset/reference subtraction post conversion 
processing is stored in this register.
This result is available 1 SYSCLK cycle after the associated 
ADCRESULT is available. If ADCINTFLG is polled to determine 
when to read the PPBRESULT, it may be necessary to add a NOP 
instruction to ensure that the updated post conversion processing 
result has posted to the register.
NOTE: If the conversion associated with this Post Processing Block 
is a 12-bit conversion, the PPBRESULT bits are limited to bits 12:0.
Analog-to-Digital Converter (ADC)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ADC 后置 处理 模块 结果 3 结果 的 offset/reference subtraction 后置 转换 处理 为 stored 中 此 寄存器. 此 结果 为 available 1 SYSCLK 周期 after associated ADCRESULT 为 available. 如果 ADCINTFLG 为 polled 至 determine 当 至 读取 PPBRESULT, it may be necessary 至 add NOP instruction 至 ensure that updated 后置 转换 处理 结果 has posted 至 寄存器. NOTE: 如果 转换 associated 带 此 后置 处理 模块 为 12-位 转换, PPBRESULT 位 are limited 至 位 12:0. 模数转换 Converter (ADC) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:0 ADC Post Processing Block Result；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第1596页；原文字段表：ADC Post Processing Block Result 3

The result of the offset/reference subtraction post conversion 
processing is stored in this register.
This result is available 1 SYSCLK cycle after the associated 
ADCRESULT is available. If ADCINTFLG is polled to determine 
when to read the PPBRESULT, it may be necessary to add a NOP 
instruction to ensure that the updated post conversion processing 
result has posted to the register.
NOTE: If the conversion associated with this Post Processing Block 
is a 12-bit conversion, the PPBRESULT bits are limited to bits 12:0.
Analog-to-Digital Converter (ADC)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

(reception or transmission) without error. This field will be reset to '7' 
whenever the CPU reads the register.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INT0ID
Fields.Description: 中断 标识符
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：中断 0 Cause 0x0000 - No 中断 为 待处理. 0x0001 - 0x0020 - 数量 的 报文 对象 which caused 中断. 0x0021 - 0x7FFF - Unused. 0x8000 - 错误与状态 寄存器 值 为 不 0x07. 0x8001 - 0xFFFF - Unused. 如果 several 中断 are 待处理, CAN 中断 寄存器 will point 至 待处理 中断 带 highest 优先级. Note: CANINT0 中断 线路 remains 活动 until INT0ID reaches 值 0 ( cause 的 中断 为 复位) 或 until IE0 为 cleared. 状态 中断 has highest 优先级. Among 报文 中断, 报文 对象's 中断 优先级 decreases 带 increasing 报文 数量.
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:0 Interrupt Identifier；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2521页；原文字段表：Interrupt 0 Cause

0x0000 - No interrupt is pending.
0x0001 - 0x0020 - Number of message object which caused the 
interrupt.
0x0021 - 0x7FFF - Unused.
0x8000 - Error and Status Register value is not 0x07.
0x8001 - 0xFFFF - Unused.
If several interrupts are pending, the CAN Interrupt Register will point 
to the pending interrupt with the highest priority.
Note: The CANINT0 interrupt line remains active until INT0ID 
reaches value 0 (the cause of the interrupt is reset) or until IE0 
is cleared. The Status Interrupt has the highest priority. Among the 
message interrupts, the message object's interrupt priority decreases 
with increasing message number.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INT1ID
Fields.Description: 中断 1 标识符
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：中断 1 Cause 0x00 No 中断 为 待处理. 0x01-0x20 数量 的 报文 对象 (邮箱) which caused 中断. 0x21-0xFF Unused. 如果 several 中断 are 待处理, CAN 中断 寄存器 will point 至 待处理 中断 带 highest 优先级. Note: CANINT1 中断 线路 remains 活动 until INT1ID reaches 值 0 ( cause 的 中断 为 复位) 或 until IE0 为 cleared. 报文 中断 为 cleared 通过 clearing 邮箱's IntPnd 位. Among 报文 中断, 邮箱's 中断 优先级 decreases 带 increasing 报文 数量.
Fields.Notes:
原文：23:16 Interrupt 1 Identifier；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2521页；原文字段表：Interrupt 1 Cause

0x00 No interrupt is pending.
0x01-0x20 Number of message object (mailbox) which caused the 
interrupt.
0x21-0xFF Unused.
If several interrupts are pending, the CAN Interrupt Register will point 
to the pending interrupt with the highest priority.
Note: The CANINT1 interrupt line remains active until INT1ID 
reaches value 0 (the cause of the interrupt is reset) or until IE0 is 
cleared. A message interrupt is cleared by clearing the mailbox's 
IntPnd bit. Among the message interrupts, the mailbox's interrupt 
priority decreases with increasing message number.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TXRQST
Fields.Description: 访问 发送 请求 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：访问 发送 请求 (TxRqst) / New 数据 (NewDat) 位 0 (方向 = 读取): NewDat 位 will 不 be changed. 0 (方向 = 写入): TxRqst/NewDat 位 will be handled according 至 控制 位. 1 (方向 = 读取): Clears NewDat 位 中 报文 对象. 1 (方向 = 写入): 设置 TxRqst/NewDat 中 报文 对象. Note: 如果 CAN 发送 为 requested 通过 设置 TxRqst/NewDat 中 此 寄存器, TxRqst/NewDat 位 中 报文 对象 will be 置位 至 单次 independent 的 values 中 IF1/IF2 报文 控制 寄存器. Note: 读取 访问 至 报文 对象 CAN be combined 带 复位 的 控制 位 IntPnd 及 NewDat. values 的 these 位 transferred 至 IF1/IF2 报文 控制 寄存器 always reflect 状态 before 复位 them. Note: 此 位 为 写入 受保护 通过 忙碌 位. Controller Area Network (CAN) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：18 Access Transmission Request Bit；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2540页；原文字段表：Access Transmission Request (TxRqst) / New Data (NewDat) Bit

0 (Direction = Read): NewDat bit will not be changed.
0 (Direction = Write): TxRqst/NewDat bit will be handled according to 
the Control bit.
1 (Direction = Read): Clears NewDat bit in the message object.
1 (Direction = Write): Sets TxRqst/NewDat in message object.
Note: If a CAN transmission is requested by setting TxRqst/NewDat 
in this register, the TxRqst/NewDat bits in the message object will 
be set to one independent of the values in IF1/IF2 Message Control 
Register.
Note: A read access to a message object can be combined with the 
reset of the control bits IntPnd and NewDat. The values of these bits 
transferred to the IF1/IF2 Message Control Register always reflect 
the status before resetting them.
Note: This bit is write protected by Busy bit.
Controller Area Network (CAN)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TxRqst
Fields.Description: 访问 发送 请求 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：访问 发送 请求 (TxRqst) / New 数据 (NewDat) 位 0 (方向 = 读取): NewDat 位 will 不 be changed. 0 (方向 = 写入): TxRqst/NewDat 位 will be handled according 至 控制 位. 1 (方向 = 读取): Clears NewDat 位 中 报文 对象. 1 (方向 = 写入): 设置 TxRqst/NewDat 中 报文 对象. Note: 如果 CAN 发送 为 requested 通过 设置 TxRqst/NewDat 中 此 寄存器, TxRqst/NewDat 位 中 报文 对象 will be 置位 至 单次 independent 的 values 中 IF1/IF2 报文 控制 寄存器. Note: 读取 访问 至 报文 对象 CAN be combined 带 复位 的 控制 位 IntPnd 及 NewDat. values 的 these 位 transferred 至 IF1/IF2 报文 控制 寄存器 always reflect 状态 before 复位 them. Note: 此 位 为 写入 受保护 通过 忙碌 位. Controller Area Network (CAN) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：18 Access Transmission Request Bit；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2550页；原文字段表：Access Transmission Request (TxRqst) / New Data (NewDat) Bit

0 (Direction = Read): NewDat bit will not be changed.
0 (Direction = Write): TxRqst/NewDat bit will be handled according to 
the Control bit.
1 (Direction = Read): Clears NewDat bit in the message object.
1 (Direction = Write): Sets TxRqst/NewDat in message object.
Note: If a CAN transmission is requested by setting TxRqst/NewDat 
in this register, the TxRqst/NewDat bits in the message object will 
be set to one independent of the values in IF1/IF2 Message Control 
Register.
Note: A read access to a message object can be combined with the 
reset of the control bits IntPnd and NewDat. The values of these bits 
transferred to the IF1/IF2 Message Control Register always reflect 
the status before resetting them.
Note: This bit is write protected by Busy bit.
Controller Area Network (CAN)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INT0ID
Fields.Description: 中断 标识符
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：中断 0 Cause 0x0000 - No 中断 为 待处理. 0x0001 - 0x0020 - 数量 的 报文 对象 which caused 中断. 0x0021 - 0x7FFF - Unused. 0x8000 - 错误与状态 寄存器 值 为 不 0x07. 0x8001 - 0xFFFF - Unused. 如果 several 中断 are 待处理, CAN 中断 寄存器 will point 至 待处理 中断 带 highest 优先级. Note: CANINT0 中断 线路 remains 活动 until INT0ID reaches 值 0 ( cause 的 中断 为 复位) 或 until IE0 为 cleared. 状态 中断 has highest 优先级. Among 报文 中断, 报文 对象's 中断 优先级 decreases 带 increasing 报文 数量.
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:0 Interrupt Identifier；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2521页；原文字段表：Interrupt 0 Cause

0x0000 - No interrupt is pending.
0x0001 - 0x0020 - Number of message object which caused the 
interrupt.
0x0021 - 0x7FFF - Unused.
0x8000 - Error and Status Register value is not 0x07.
0x8001 - 0xFFFF - Unused.
If several interrupts are pending, the CAN Interrupt Register will point 
to the pending interrupt with the highest priority.
Note: The CANINT0 interrupt line remains active until INT0ID 
reaches value 0 (the cause of the interrupt is reset) or until IE0 
is cleared. The Status Interrupt has the highest priority. Among the 
message interrupts, the message object's interrupt priority decreases 
with increasing message number.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INT1ID
Fields.Description: 中断 1 标识符
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：中断 1 Cause 0x00 No 中断 为 待处理. 0x01-0x20 数量 的 报文 对象 (邮箱) which caused 中断. 0x21-0xFF Unused. 如果 several 中断 are 待处理, CAN 中断 寄存器 will point 至 待处理 中断 带 highest 优先级. Note: CANINT1 中断 线路 remains 活动 until INT1ID reaches 值 0 ( cause 的 中断 为 复位) 或 until IE0 为 cleared. 报文 中断 为 cleared 通过 clearing 邮箱's IntPnd 位. Among 报文 中断, 邮箱's 中断 优先级 decreases 带 increasing 报文 数量.
Fields.Notes:
原文：23:16 Interrupt 1 Identifier；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2521页；原文字段表：Interrupt 1 Cause

0x00 No interrupt is pending.
0x01-0x20 Number of message object (mailbox) which caused the 
interrupt.
0x21-0xFF Unused.
If several interrupts are pending, the CAN Interrupt Register will point 
to the pending interrupt with the highest priority.
Note: The CANINT1 interrupt line remains active until INT1ID 
reaches value 0 (the cause of the interrupt is reset) or until IE0 is 
cleared. A message interrupt is cleared by clearing the mailbox's 
IntPnd bit. Among the message interrupts, the mailbox's interrupt 
priority decreases with increasing message number.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TXRQST
Fields.Description: 访问 发送 请求 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：访问 发送 请求 (TxRqst) / New 数据 (NewDat) 位 0 (方向 = 读取): NewDat 位 will 不 be changed. 0 (方向 = 写入): TxRqst/NewDat 位 will be handled according 至 控制 位. 1 (方向 = 读取): Clears NewDat 位 中 报文 对象. 1 (方向 = 写入): 设置 TxRqst/NewDat 中 报文 对象. Note: 如果 CAN 发送 为 requested 通过 设置 TxRqst/NewDat 中 此 寄存器, TxRqst/NewDat 位 中 报文 对象 will be 置位 至 单次 independent 的 values 中 IF1/IF2 报文 控制 寄存器. Note: 读取 访问 至 报文 对象 CAN be combined 带 复位 的 控制 位 IntPnd 及 NewDat. values 的 these 位 transferred 至 IF1/IF2 报文 控制 寄存器 always reflect 状态 before 复位 them. Note: 此 位 为 写入 受保护 通过 忙碌 位. Controller Area Network (CAN) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：18 Access Transmission Request Bit；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2540页；原文字段表：Access Transmission Request (TxRqst) / New Data (NewDat) Bit

0 (Direction = Read): NewDat bit will not be changed.
0 (Direction = Write): TxRqst/NewDat bit will be handled according to 
the Control bit.
1 (Direction = Read): Clears NewDat bit in the message object.
1 (Direction = Write): Sets TxRqst/NewDat in message object.
Note: If a CAN transmission is requested by setting TxRqst/NewDat 
in this register, the TxRqst/NewDat bits in the message object will 
be set to one independent of the values in IF1/IF2 Message Control 
Register.
Note: A read access to a message object can be combined with the 
reset of the control bits IntPnd and NewDat. The values of these bits 
transferred to the IF1/IF2 Message Control Register always reflect 
the status before resetting them.
Note: This bit is write protected by Busy bit.
Controller Area Network (CAN)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TxRqst
Fields.Description: 访问 发送 请求 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：访问 发送 请求 (TxRqst) / New 数据 (NewDat) 位 0 (方向 = 读取): NewDat 位 will 不 be changed. 0 (方向 = 写入): TxRqst/NewDat 位 will be handled according 至 控制 位. 1 (方向 = 读取): Clears NewDat 位 中 报文 对象. 1 (方向 = 写入): 设置 TxRqst/NewDat 中 报文 对象. Note: 如果 CAN 发送 为 requested 通过 设置 TxRqst/NewDat 中 此 寄存器, TxRqst/NewDat 位 中 报文 对象 will be 置位 至 单次 independent 的 values 中 IF1/IF2 报文 控制 寄存器. Note: 读取 访问 至 报文 对象 CAN be combined 带 复位 的 控制 位 IntPnd 及 NewDat. values 的 these 位 transferred 至 IF1/IF2 报文 控制 寄存器 always reflect 状态 before 复位 them. Note: 此 位 为 写入 受保护 通过 忙碌 位. Controller Area Network (CAN) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：18 Access Transmission Request Bit；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2550页；原文字段表：Access Transmission Request (TxRqst) / New Data (NewDat) Bit

0 (Direction = Read): NewDat bit will not be changed.
0 (Direction = Write): TxRqst/NewDat bit will be handled according to 
the Control bit.
1 (Direction = Read): Clears NewDat bit in the message object.
1 (Direction = Write): Sets TxRqst/NewDat in message object.
Note: If a CAN transmission is requested by setting TxRqst/NewDat 
in this register, the TxRqst/NewDat bits in the message object will 
be set to one independent of the values in IF1/IF2 Message Control 
Register.
Note: A read access to a message object can be combined with the 
reset of the control bits IntPnd and NewDat. The values of these bits 
transferred to the IF1/IF2 Message Control Register always reflect 
the status before resetting them.
Note: This bit is write protected by Busy bit.
Controller Area Network (CAN)

Fields.Name: OSCCLKSRCSEL
Fields.Description: OSCCLK 源 选择 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：振荡器 时钟 源 选择 位: 此 位 选择 来源 用于 OSCCLK. 00 = INTOSC2 (默认 开启 复位) 01 = 外部 振荡器 (XTAL) 10 = INTOSC1 11 = 保留位 (默认 至 INTOSC1) 在 power-up 或 after XRSn, INTOSC2 为 已选 通过 默认. Whenever user changes 时钟 来源 using these 位, SYSPLLMULT 寄存器 will be forced 至 零 及 PLL will be bypassed 及 powered 下降. 此 prevents potential PLL overshoot. user will then have 至 写入 至 SYSPLLMULT 寄存器 至 configure appropriate 倍频器. user must wait 10 OSCCLK cycles before writing 至 SYSPLLMULT 或 disabling 前次 时钟 来源 至 allow change 至 complete.. Notes: [1] 保留位 选择 defaults 至 00 配置 [2] INTOSC1 为 recommended 至 be 使用 仅 after 丢失 时钟 检测. 如果 user wants 至 re-lock PLL 带 INTOSC1 ( back-up 时钟 来源) after 丢失 时钟 为 已检测, he CAN 执行 MCLKCLR 及 锁定 PLL.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0 OSCCLK Source Select Bit；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第277页；原文字段表：Oscillator Clock Source Select Bit: This bit selects the source for 

OSCCLK.
00 = INTOSC2 (default on reset)
01 = External Oscillator (XTAL)
10 = INTOSC1
11 = reserved (default to INTOSC1)
At power-up or after an XRSn, INTOSC2 is selected by default. 
Whenever the user changes the clock source using these bits, 
the SYSPLLMULT register will be forced to zero and the PLL 
will be bypassed and powered down. This prevents potential PLL 
overshoot. The user will then have to write to the SYSPLLMULT 
register to configure the appropriate multiplier.
The user must wait 10 OSCCLK cycles before writing to 
SYSPLLMULT or disabling the previous clock source to allow the 
change to
complete..
Notes:
[1] Reserved selection defaults to 00 configuration
[2] INTOSC1 is recommended to be used only after missing clock 
detection. If user wants to re-lock the PLL with INTOSC1 (the 
back-up clock source) after missing clock is detected, he can do a 
MCLKCLR and lock the PLL.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

INTOSC2 are powered-down when system enters HALT mode
1 = WD is functional in the HALT mode. Clock to WD is not gated

Fields.Name: LSW
Fields.Description: CPU定时器 计数器 寄存器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：CPU定时器 计数器 寄存器 TIM 寄存器 holds 低 16 位 的 当前 32-位 计数 的 定时器. TIMH:TIM decrements 通过 单次 every (TDDRH:TDDR+1) 时钟 cycles, where TDDRH:TDDR 为 定时器 预分频 dividedown 值. 当 TIMH:TIM decrements 至 零, TIMH:TIM 寄存器 为 reloaded 带 周期 值 contained 中 PRDH:PRD 寄存器. 定时器 中断 (TINT) 信号 为 已产生.
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:0 CPU-Timer Counter Registers；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第155页；原文字段表：CPU-Timer Counter Registers

The TIM register holds the low 16 bits of the current 32-bit 
count of the timer. The TIMH:TIM decrements by one every 
(TDDRH:TDDR+1) clock cycles, where TDDRH:TDDR is the timer 
prescale dividedown value. When the TIMH:TIM decrements to zero, 
the TIMH:TIM register is reloaded with the period value contained 
in the PRDH:PRD registers. The timer interrupt (TINT) signal is 
generated.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

原文：15:0 CPU-Timer Period Registers；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第156页；原文字段表：CPU-Timer Period Registers

the TIMH:TIM decrements to zero, the TIMH:TIM register is reloaded 
with the period value contained in the PRDH:PRD registers, at the 
start of the next timer input clock cycle (the output of the prescaler). 
The PRDH:PRD contents are also loaded into the TIMH:TIM when 
you set the timer reload bit (TRB) in the Timer Control Register 
(TCR).

Fields.Name: TSS
Fields.Description: CPU定时器停止控制。
Fields.Values: 0：运行；1：停止。
Fields.Notes:
原文：4 CPU-Timer stop status bit.；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第158页；原文字段表：CPU-Timer stop status bit.

TSS is a 1-bit flag that stops or starts the CPU-timer.
0h (R/W) = Reads of 0 indicate the CPU-timer is running.
To start or restart the CPU-timer, set TSS to 0. At reset, TSS is 
cleared to 0 and the
CPU-timer immediately starts. 
1h (R/W) = Reads of 1 indicate that the CPU-timer is stopped.
To stop the CPU-timer, set TSS to 1.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI33H / 2024-06对应字段表核对。
