Fields.Name: TDDR
Fields.Description: CPU定时器 分频.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：CPU定时器 分频. Every (TDDRH:TDDR + 1) 定时器 时钟 来源 cycles, 定时器 计数器 寄存器 (TIMH:TIM) decrements 通过 单次. 在 复位, TDDRH:TDDR 位 are cleared 至 0. 至 increase overall 定时器 计数 通过 整数 factor, 写入 此 factor minus 单次 至 TDDRH:TDDR 位. 当 预分频器 计数器 (PSCH:PSC) 值 为 0, 单次 定时器 时钟 来源 周期 later, 内容 的 TDDRH:TDDR 重装载 PSCH:PSC, 及 TIMH:TIM decrements 通过 单次. TDDRH:TDDR also reloads PSCH:PSC whenever 定时器 重装载 位 (TRB) 为 置位 通过 软件.
Fields.Notes:
原文：7:0 CPU-Timer Divide-Down.；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第159页；原文字段表：CPU-Timer Divide-Down.

Every (TDDRH:TDDR + 1) timer clock source cycles, the timer 
counter register (TIMH:TIM) decrements by one. At reset, the 
TDDRH:TDDR bits are cleared to 0. To increase the overall timer
count by an integer factor, write this factor minus one to the 
TDDRH:TDDR bits. When the prescaler counter (PSCH:PSC) 
value is 0, one timer clock source cycle later, the contents 
of the TDDRH:TDDR reload the PSCH:PSC, and the TIMH:TIM 
decrements by one. TDDRH:TDDR also reloads the PSCH:PSC 
whenever the timer reload bit (TRB) is set by software.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: PSC
Fields.Description: CPU定时器 预分频 计数器.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：CPU定时器 预分频 计数器. These 位 保持 当前 预分频 计数 用于 定时器. 用于 every 定时器 时钟 来源 周期 that PSCH:PSC 值 为 greater than 0, PSCH:PSC decrements 通过 单次. 单次 定时器 时钟 (输出 的 定时器 预分频器) 周期 after PSCH:PSC reaches 0, PSCH:PSC 为 loaded 带 内容 的 TDDRH:TDDR, 及 定时器 计数器 寄存器 (TIMH:TIM) decrements 通过 单次. PSCH:PSC 为 also reloaded whenever 定时器 重装载 位 (TRB) 为 置位 通过 软件. PSCH:PSC CAN be checked 通过 reading 寄存器, but it cannot be 置位 directly. It must get its 值 来自 定时器 分频 寄存器 (TDDRH:TDDR). 在 复位, PSCH:PSC 为 置位 至 0.
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:8 CPU-Timer Prescale Counter.；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第159页；原文字段表：CPU-Timer Prescale Counter.

These bits hold the current prescale count for the timer. For every 
timer clock source cycle that the PSCH:PSC value is greater than 
0, the PSCH:PSC decrements by one. One timer clock (output 
of the timer prescaler) cycle after the PSCH:PSC reaches 0, the 
PSCH:PSC is loaded with the contents of the TDDRH:TDDR, and 
the timer counter register (TIMH:TIM) decrements by one. The 
PSCH:PSC is also reloaded whenever the timer reload bit (TRB) 
is set by software. The PSCH:PSC can be checked by reading the 
register, but it cannot be set directly. It must get its value from the 
timer divide-down register
(TDDRH:TDDR). At reset, the PSCH:PSC is set to 0.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: LSW
Fields.Description: CPU定时器 计数器 寄存器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：CPU定时器 计数器 寄存器 TIM 寄存器 holds 低 16 位 的 当前 32-位 计数 的 定时器. TIMH:TIM decrements 通过 单次 every (TDDRH:TDDR+1) 时钟 cycles, where TDDRH:TDDR 为 定时器 预分频 dividedown 值. 当 TIMH:TIM decrements 至 零, TIMH:TIM 寄存器 为 reloaded 带 周期 值 contained 中 PRDH:PRD 寄存器. 定时器 中断 (TINT) 信号 为 已产生.
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:0 CPU-Timer Counter Registers；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第155页；原文字段表：CPU-Timer Counter Registers

The TIM register holds the low 16 bits of the current 32-bit 
count of the timer. The TIMH:TIM decrements by one every 
(TDDRH:TDDR+1) clock cycles, where TDDRH:TDDR is the timer 
prescale dividedown value. When the TIMH:TIM decrements to zero, 
the TIMH:TIM register is reloaded with the period value contained 
in the PRDH:PRD registers. The timer interrupt (TINT) signal is 
generated.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：CPU定时器 周期 寄存器 PRD 寄存器 holds 低 16 位 的 32-位 周期. 当 TIMH:TIM decrements 至 零, TIMH:TIM 寄存器 为 reloaded 带 周期 值 contained 中 PRDH:PRD 寄存器, 在 启动 的 下次 定时器 输入 时钟 周期 ( 输出 的 预分频器). PRDH:PRD 内容 are also loaded 进入 TIMH:TIM 当 you 置位 定时器 重装载 位 (TRB) 中 定时器 控制 寄存器 (TCR). 系统 控制 及 中断 www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:0 CPU-Timer Period Registers；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第156页；原文字段表：CPU-Timer Period Registers

The PRD register holds the low 16 bits of the 32-bit period. When 
the TIMH:TIM decrements to zero, the TIMH:TIM register is reloaded 
with the period value contained in the PRDH:PRD registers, at the 
start of the next timer input clock cycle (the output of the prescaler). 
The PRDH:PRD contents are also loaded into the TIMH:TIM when 
you set the timer reload bit (TRB) in the Timer Control Register 
(TCR).

Fields.Name: TSS
Fields.Description: CPU定时器停止控制。
Fields.Values: 0：运行；1：停止。
Fields.Notes:
原文：4 CPU-Timer stop status bit.；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第158页；原文字段表：CPU-Timer stop status bit.

TSS is a 1-bit flag that stops or starts the CPU-timer.
0h (R/W) = Reads of 0 indicate the CPU-timer is running.
To start or restart the CPU-timer, set TSS to 0. At reset, TSS is 
cleared to 0 and the
CPU-timer immediately starts. 
1h (R/W) = Reads of 1 indicate that the CPU-timer is stopped.
To stop the CPU-timer, set TSS to 1.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI33H / 2024-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: TRB
Fields.Description: 定时器重新装载。
Fields.Values: 写1将周期值载入计数器，并重新装载预分频计数器；读取始终为0。
Fields.Notes:
原文：5 Timer reload；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第158页；原文字段表：Timer reload

0h (R/W) = The TRB bit is always read as zero. Writes of 0 are 
ignored. 
1h (R/W) = When you write a 1 to TRB, the TIMH:TIM is loaded with 
the value in the PRDH:PRD,
and the prescaler counter (PSCH:PSC) is loaded with the value in 
the timer dividedown
register (TDDRH:TDDR).；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI33H / 2024-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: TDDR
Fields.Description: CPU定时器 分频.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：CPU定时器 分频. Every (TDDRH:TDDR + 1) 定时器 时钟 来源 cycles, 定时器 计数器 寄存器 (TIMH:TIM) decrements 通过 单次. 在 复位, TDDRH:TDDR 位 are cleared 至 0. 至 increase overall 定时器 计数 通过 整数 factor, 写入 此 factor minus 单次 至 TDDRH:TDDR 位. 当 预分频器 计数器 (PSCH:PSC) 值 为 0, 单次 定时器 时钟 来源 周期 later, 内容 的 TDDRH:TDDR 重装载 PSCH:PSC, 及 TIMH:TIM decrements 通过 单次. TDDRH:TDDR also reloads PSCH:PSC whenever 定时器 重装载 位 (TRB) 为 置位 通过 软件.
Fields.Notes:
原文：7:0 CPU-Timer Divide-Down.；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第159页；原文字段表：CPU-Timer Divide-Down.

Every (TDDRH:TDDR + 1) timer clock source cycles, the timer 
counter register (TIMH:TIM) decrements by one. At reset, the 
TDDRH:TDDR bits are cleared to 0. To increase the overall timer
count by an integer factor, write this factor minus one to the 
TDDRH:TDDR bits. When the prescaler counter (PSCH:PSC) 
value is 0, one timer clock source cycle later, the contents 
of the TDDRH:TDDR reload the PSCH:PSC, and the TIMH:TIM 
decrements by one. TDDRH:TDDR also reloads the PSCH:PSC 
whenever the timer reload bit (TRB) is set by software.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: PSC
Fields.Description: CPU定时器 预分频 计数器.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：CPU定时器 预分频 计数器. These 位 保持 当前 预分频 计数 用于 定时器. 用于 every 定时器 时钟 来源 周期 that PSCH:PSC 值 为 greater than 0, PSCH:PSC decrements 通过 单次. 单次 定时器 时钟 (输出 的 定时器 预分频器) 周期 after PSCH:PSC reaches 0, PSCH:PSC 为 loaded 带 内容 的 TDDRH:TDDR, 及 定时器 计数器 寄存器 (TIMH:TIM) decrements 通过 单次. PSCH:PSC 为 also reloaded whenever 定时器 重装载 位 (TRB) 为 置位 通过 软件. PSCH:PSC CAN be checked 通过 reading 寄存器, but it cannot be 置位 directly. It must get its 值 来自 定时器 分频 寄存器 (TDDRH:TDDR). 在 复位, PSCH:PSC 为 置位 至 0.
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:8 CPU-Timer Prescale Counter.；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第159页；原文字段表：CPU-Timer Prescale Counter.

These bits hold the current prescale count for the timer. For every 
timer clock source cycle that the PSCH:PSC value is greater than 
0, the PSCH:PSC decrements by one. One timer clock (output 
of the timer prescaler) cycle after the PSCH:PSC reaches 0, the 
PSCH:PSC is loaded with the contents of the TDDRH:TDDR, and 
the timer counter register (TIMH:TIM) decrements by one. The 
PSCH:PSC is also reloaded whenever the timer reload bit (TRB) 
is set by software. The PSCH:PSC can be checked by reading the 
register, but it cannot be set directly. It must get its value from the 
timer divide-down register
(TDDRH:TDDR). At reset, the PSCH:PSC is set to 0.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: LSW
Fields.Description: CPU定时器 周期 寄存器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：CPU定时器 周期 寄存器 PRD 寄存器 holds 低 16 位 的 32-位 周期. 当 TIMH:TIM decrements 至 零, TIMH:TIM 寄存器 为 reloaded 带 周期 值 contained 中 PRDH:PRD 寄存器, 在 启动 的 下次 定时器 输入 时钟 周期 ( 输出 的 预分频器). PRDH:PRD 内容 are also loaded 进入 TIMH:TIM 当 you 置位 定时器 重装载 位 (TRB) 中 定时器 控制 寄存器 (TCR). 系统 控制 及 中断 www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:0 CPU-Timer Period Registers；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第156页；原文字段表：CPU-Timer Period Registers

The PRD register holds the low 16 bits of the 32-bit period. When 
the TIMH:TIM decrements to zero, the TIMH:TIM register is reloaded 
with the period value contained in the PRDH:PRD registers, at the 
start of the next timer input clock cycle (the output of the prescaler). 
The PRDH:PRD contents are also loaded into the TIMH:TIM when 
you set the timer reload bit (TRB) in the Timer Control Register 
(TCR).

Fields.Name: TSS
Fields.Description: CPU定时器停止控制。
Fields.Values: 0：运行；1：停止。
Fields.Notes:
原文：4 CPU-Timer stop status bit.；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第158页；原文字段表：CPU-Timer stop status bit.

TSS is a 1-bit flag that stops or starts the CPU-timer.
0h (R/W) = Reads of 0 indicate the CPU-timer is running.
To start or restart the CPU-timer, set TSS to 0. At reset, TSS is 
cleared to 0 and the
CPU-timer immediately starts. 
1h (R/W) = Reads of 1 indicate that the CPU-timer is stopped.
To stop the CPU-timer, set TSS to 1.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI33H / 2024-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: TDDR
Fields.Description: CPU定时器 分频.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：CPU定时器 分频. Every (TDDRH:TDDR + 1) 定时器 时钟 来源 cycles, 定时器 计数器 寄存器 (TIMH:TIM) decrements 通过 单次. 在 复位, TDDRH:TDDR 位 are cleared 至 0. 至 increase overall 定时器 计数 通过 整数 factor, 写入 此 factor minus 单次 至 TDDRH:TDDR 位. 当 预分频器 计数器 (PSCH:PSC) 值 为 0, 单次 定时器 时钟 来源 周期 later, 内容 的 TDDRH:TDDR 重装载 PSCH:PSC, 及 TIMH:TIM decrements 通过 单次. TDDRH:TDDR also reloads PSCH:PSC whenever 定时器 重装载 位 (TRB) 为 置位 通过 软件.
Fields.Notes:
原文：7:0 CPU-Timer Divide-Down.；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第159页；原文字段表：CPU-Timer Divide-Down.

Every (TDDRH:TDDR + 1) timer clock source cycles, the timer 
counter register (TIMH:TIM) decrements by one. At reset, the 
TDDRH:TDDR bits are cleared to 0. To increase the overall timer
count by an integer factor, write this factor minus one to the 
TDDRH:TDDR bits. When the prescaler counter (PSCH:PSC) 
value is 0, one timer clock source cycle later, the contents 
of the TDDRH:TDDR reload the PSCH:PSC, and the TIMH:TIM 
decrements by one. TDDRH:TDDR also reloads the PSCH:PSC 
whenever the timer reload bit (TRB) is set by software.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: PSC
Fields.Description: CPU定时器 预分频 计数器.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：CPU定时器 预分频 计数器. These 位 保持 当前 预分频 计数 用于 定时器. 用于 every 定时器 时钟 来源 周期 that PSCH:PSC 值 为 greater than 0, PSCH:PSC decrements 通过 单次. 单次 定时器 时钟 (输出 的 定时器 预分频器) 周期 after PSCH:PSC reaches 0, PSCH:PSC 为 loaded 带 内容 的 TDDRH:TDDR, 及 定时器 计数器 寄存器 (TIMH:TIM) decrements 通过 单次. PSCH:PSC 为 also reloaded whenever 定时器 重装载 位 (TRB) 为 置位 通过 软件. PSCH:PSC CAN be checked 通过 reading 寄存器, but it cannot be 置位 directly. It must get its 值 来自 定时器 分频 寄存器 (TDDRH:TDDR). 在 复位, PSCH:PSC 为 置位 至 0.
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:8 CPU-Timer Prescale Counter.；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第159页；原文字段表：CPU-Timer Prescale Counter.

These bits hold the current prescale count for the timer. For every 
timer clock source cycle that the PSCH:PSC value is greater than 
0, the PSCH:PSC decrements by one. One timer clock (output 
of the timer prescaler) cycle after the PSCH:PSC reaches 0, the 
PSCH:PSC is loaded with the contents of the TDDRH:TDDR, and 
the timer counter register (TIMH:TIM) decrements by one. The 
PSCH:PSC is also reloaded whenever the timer reload bit (TRB) 
is set by software. The PSCH:PSC can be checked by reading the 
register, but it cannot be set directly. It must get its value from the 
timer divide-down register
(TDDRH:TDDR). At reset, the PSCH:PSC is set to 0.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TMR2CLKPRESCALE
Fields.Description: CPU 定时器 2 时钟 预分频 数值
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：CPU 定时器 2 时钟 预分频 数值: These 位 选择 预分频 值 用于 已选 时钟 来源 用于 CPU 定时器 2: 0,0,0,/1 (默认 开启 复位) 0,0,1,/2, 0,1,0,/4 0,1,1,/8 1,0,0,/16 1,0,1,spare (defaults 至 /16) 1,1,0,spare (defaults 至 /16) 1,1,1,spare (defaults 至 /16) Note: [1] CPU Timer2s 时钟 同步 logic detects 输入 时钟 边沿 当 configured 用于 any 时钟 来源 other than SYSCLK 及 产生 appropriate 时钟 脉冲 至 CPU timer2. 如果 SYSCLK 为 approximately same 或 less then 输入 时钟 来源, then user would need 至 configure 预分频 值 such that SYSCLK 为 在 最低 twice 作为 fast 作为 pre-scaled 值.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5:3 CPU Timer 2 Clock Pre-Scale Value；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第322页；原文字段表：CPU Timer 2 Clock Pre-Scale Value: These bits select the pre-scale 

value for the selected clock source for CPU Timer 2:
0,0,0,/1 (default on reset)
0,0,1,/2,
0,1,0,/4
0,1,1,/8
1,0,0,/16
1,0,1,spare (defaults to /16)
1,1,0,spare (defaults to /16)
1,1,1,spare (defaults to /16)
Note:
[1] The CPU Timer2s Clock sync logic detects an input clock edge 
when configured for any clock source other than SYSCLK and 
generates an appropriate clock pulse to the CPU timer2. If SYSCLK 
is approximately the same or less then the input clock source, then 
the user would need to configure the pre-scale value such that 
SYSCLK is at least twice as fast as the pre-scaled value.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: JTAG_nTRST
Fields.Description: Multi 位 JTAG nTRST
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：: Writing '1010' (along 带 有效 密钥 中 JTAG_nTRST_密钥) takes JTAG TAP 至 测试 Logic 复位 (TLR) 状态. 此 CAN be 使用 至 清除 unwanted JTAG 状态 transitions due 至 系统 noise 或 引脚 transitions during 电源 上升 开启 TCK 及 TMS. Writing 此 field will 复位 CCS debugger 连接. See TAP_状态 寄存器 用于 额外 调试 information 开启 JTAG 状态. Writing any other 值 或 mismatched 密钥 does 不 have any effect 开启 JTAG TAP 复位 behavior. Once 复位 至 JTAG 为 已置有效 then 此 field 为 cleared back 至 0 (JTAG 为 仅 temporarily 复位, 不 held 中 复位).
Fields.Notes:
原文：3:0 Multi Bit JTAG nTRST；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第271页；原文字段表：1010: Writing '1010' (along with valid key in JTAG_nTRST_Key) 

takes JTAG TAP to the Test Logic Reset (TLR) state. This can be 
used to clear unwanted JTAG state transitions due to system noise 
or pin transitions during power up on TCK and TMS. Writing this 
field will reset the CCS debugger connection. See the TAP_STATUS 
register for additional debug information on the JTAG state.
Writing any other value or mismatched key does not have any effect 
on the JTAG TAP reset behavior.
Once reset to JTAG is asserted then this field is cleared back to 0 
(JTAG is only temporarily reset, not held in reset).；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TAP_STATE
Fields.Description: Present JTAG TAP 状态
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：JTAG IEEE 1149 TAP 状态. During normal functional 操作 TAP_状态 should remain 0x0. 如果 any unexpected 状态 为 observed (typically due 至 系统 noise 开启 TMS 及 TCK 引脚), SOFTPRES40 寄存器 CAN be written 至 return TAP_状态 至 测试 Logic 复位 0x0. 0:TLR (测试 Logic 复位) 1:空闲 2:SELECTDR 3:CAPDR 4:SHIFTDR 5:EXIT1DR 6:PAUSEDR 7:EXIT2DR 8:UPDTDR 9:SLECTIR 10:CAPIR 11:SHIFTIR 12:EXIT1IR 13:PAUSEIR 14:EXIT2IR 15:UPDTIR 系统 控制 及 中断 www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:0 Present JTAG TAP State；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第272页；原文字段表：JTAG IEEE 1149 TAP State.

During normal functional operation the TAP_STATE should remain 
0x0. If any unexpected state is observed (typically due to system 
noise on the TMS and TCK pins), the SOFTPRES40 register can be 
written to return the TAP_STATE to Test Logic Reset 0x0.
0:TLR (Test Logic Reset)
1:IDLE
2:SELECTDR
3:CAPDR
4:SHIFTDR
5:EXIT1DR
6:PAUSEDR
7:EXIT2DR
8:UPDTDR
9:SLECTIR
10:CAPIR
11:SHIFTIR
12:EXIT1IR
13:PAUSEIR
14:EXIT2IR
15:UPDTIR

Fields.Name: CTRMODE
Fields.Description: 时基计数模式。
Fields.Values: 0：向上计数；1：向下计数；2：上下计数；3：停止/冻结。
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0 Counter Mode；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2009页；原文字段表：Counter Mode

The time-base counter mode is normally configured once and not 
changed during normal operation. If you change the mode of the 
counter, the change will take effect at the next TBCLK edge and the 
current counter value shall increment or decrement from the value 
before the mode change. These bits set the time-base counter mode 
of operation as follows:
00: Up-count mode
01: Down-count mode
10: Up-down count mode
11: Freeze counter operation (default on reset)；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI33H / 2024-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: PHSEN
Fields.Description: 相位加载使能。
Fields.Values: 0：禁用相位加载；1：收到同步事件时将TBPHS载入TBCTR。
Fields.Notes:
原文：2 Phase Load Enable；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2009页；原文字段表：Counter Reg Load from Phase Reg Enable

0: Do not load the time-base counter (TBCTR) from the time-base 
phase register (TBPHS).
1: Allow Counter to be loaded from the Phase register (TBPHS) and 
shadow to active load events when an EPWMxSYNCI input signal 
occurs or a software-forced sync signal, see bit 6.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI33H / 2024-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: PRDLD
Fields.Description: 周期寄存器的影子加载模式。
Fields.Values: 0：使用影子寄存器，计数器归零时装载；1：直接写活动寄存器。
Fields.Notes:
原文：3 Active Period Load；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2009页；原文字段表：Active Period Reg Load from Shadow Select

0: The period register (TBPRD) is loaded from its shadow register 
when the time-base counter, TBCTR, is equal to zero and/or a sync 
event as determined by the TBCTL2[PRDLDSYNC] bit.
A write/read to the TBPRD register accesses the shadow register.
1: Immediate Mode (Shadow register bypassed): A write or read to 
the TBPRD register accesses the active register.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI33H / 2024-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: SYNCOSEL
Fields.Description: 同步 输出 选择
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：同步 输出 选择 00: EPWMxSYNCI / SWFSYNC 01: CTR = 零: 时基 计数器 equal 至 零 (TBCTR = 0x00) 10: CTR = CMPB : 时基 计数器 equal 至 counter-compare B (TBCTR = CMPB) 11: EPWMXSYNCO 为 defined 通过 TBCTL2[SYNCOSELX]
Fields.Notes:
原文：5:4 Sync Output Select；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2009页；原文字段表：Sync Output Select

00: EPWMxSYNCI / SWFSYNC
01: CTR = zero: Time-base counter equal to zero (TBCTR = 0x00)
10: CTR = CMPB : Time-base counter equal to counter-compare B 
(TBCTR = CMPB)
11: EPWMXSYNCO is defined by TBCTL2[SYNCOSELX]；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SWFSYNC
Fields.Description: 软件强制同步。
Fields.Values: 写1产生软件同步脉冲；硬件清零。
Fields.Notes:
原文：6 Software Force Sync Pulse；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2009页；原文字段表：R-0/W1S 0h Software Forced Sync Pulse

0: Writing a 0 has no effect and reads always return a 0.
1: Writing a 1 forces a one-time synchronization pulse to be 
generated.
SWFSYNC affects EPWMxSYNCO only when SYNCOSEL = 00.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI33H / 2024-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: HSPCLKDIV
Fields.Description: 时基高速预分频选择。
Fields.Notes:
原文：9:7 High Speed TBCLK Pre-scaler；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2009页；原文字段表：High Speed Time Base Clock Pre-Scale Bits

These bits determine part of the time-base clock prescale value.
TBCLK = EPWMCLK / (HSPCLKDIV x CLKDIV). This divisor 
emulates the HSPCLK in the TMS320x281x system as used on the 
Event Manager (EV) peripheral.
000: /1
001: /2 (default on reset)
010: /4
011: /6
100: /8
101: /10
110: /12
111: /14；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI33H / 2024-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: CLKDIV
Fields.Description: 时基低速预分频选择。
Fields.Notes:
原文：12:10 Time Base Clock Pre-scaler；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2008页；原文字段表：Time Base Clock Pre-Scale Bits

These bits select the time base clock pre-scale value (TBCLK = 
EPWMCLK/(HSPCLKDIV * CLKDIV):
000: /1 (default on reset)
001: /2
010: /4
011: /8
100: /16
101: /32
110: /64
111: /128
Enhanced Pulse Width Modulator (ePWM)
 www.ti.com；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI33H / 2024-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: PHSDIR
Fields.Description: 上下计数模式下，同步载入相位后的计数方向。
Fields.Values: 0：同步后向下计数；1：同步后向上计数。
Fields.Notes:
原文：13 Phase Direction Bit；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2008页；原文字段表：Phase Direction Bit

This bit is only used when the time-base counter is configured in the 
up-down-count mode. The
PHSDIR bit indicates the direction the time-base counter (TBCTR) 
will count after a synchronization
event occurs and a new phase value is loaded from the phase 
(TBPHS) register. This is
irrespective of the direction of the counter before the synchronization 
event..
In the up-count and down-count modes this bit is ignored.
0: Count down after the synchronization event.
1: Count up after the synchronization event.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI33H / 2024-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: FREE_SOFT
Fields.Description: 仿真 模式 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：仿真 模式 位. These 位 选择 behavior 的 ePWM 时基 计数器 during 仿真 events 00: 停止 after 下次 时基 计数器 递增 或 递减 01: 停止 当 计数器 completes whole 周期: - 向上计数 模式: 停止 当 时基 计数器 = 周期 (TBCTR = TBPRD) - 向下计数 模式: 停止 当 时基 计数器 = 0x00 (TBCTR = 0x00) - Up-down-count 模式: 停止 当 时基 计数器 = 0x00 (TBCTR = 0x00) 1x: 自由运行 run
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:14 Emulation Mode Bits；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2008页；原文字段表：Emulation Mode Bits. These bits select the behavior of the ePWM 

time-base counter during emulation events
00: Stop after the next time-base counter increment or decrement
01: Stop when counter completes a whole cycle:
- Up-count mode: stop when the time-base counter = period (TBCTR 
= TBPRD)
- Down-count mode: stop when the time-base counter = 0x00 
(TBCTR = 0x00)
- Up-down-count mode: stop when the time-base counter = 0x00 
(TBCTR = 0x00)
1x: Free run；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Description: PRD 影子 至 活动 加载 开启 同步 事件

Fields.Name: OUT_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输出 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 输出 模式 控制 位 1 控制 S1 switch 及 位 0 控制 S0 switch. 00: DBM 为 fully 已禁用 或 by-passed. 中 此 模式 POLSEL 及 IN-MODE 位 have no effect. 01: Apath = InA (延迟 为 by-passed 用于 信号 路径) Bpath = FED (下降沿 边沿 延迟 中 B 信号 路径) 10: Apath = RED (上升沿 边沿 延迟 中 信号 路径) Bpath = InB (延迟 为 by-passed 用于 B 信号 路径) 11: DBM 为 fully 已使能 (i.e. both RED 及 FED 活动)
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0 Dead Band Output Mode Control；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2019页；原文字段表：Dead-Band Output Mode Control

Bit 1 controls the S1 switch and bit 0 controls the S0 switch.
00: DBM is fully disabled or by-passed. In this mode the POLSEL 
and IN-MODE bits have no effect.
01: Apath = InA (delay is by-passed for A signal path)
Bpath = FED (Falling Edge Delay in B signal path)
10: Apath = RED (Rising Edge Delay in A signal path)
Bpath = InB (delay is by-passed for B signal path)
11: DBM is fully enabled (i.e. both RED and FED active)；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: POLSEL
Fields.Description: 极性 选择 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：极性 选择 控制 位 3 控制 S3 switch 及 位 2 控制 S2 switch. 此 allows you 至 selectively invert 单次 的 delayed 信号 before it 为 sent out 的 死区 submodule. following descriptions correspond 至 classical upper/lower switch 控制 作为 found 中 单次 leg 的 数字 motor 控制 inverter. These assume that DBCTL[OUT_模式] = 1,1 及 DBCTL[中_模式] = 0x0. Other enhanced modes are also possible, but 不 regarded 作为 typical usage modes. 00: 活动 高 (AH) 模式. Neither EPWMxA nor EPWMxB 为 反相 (默认). 01: 活动 低 互补 (ALC) 模式. EPWMxA 为 反相. 10: 活动 高 互补 (AHC). EPWMxB 为 反相. 11: 活动 低 (AL) 模式. Both EPWMxA 及 EPWMxB are 反相. Enhanced 脉冲 宽度 Modulator (ePWM) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：3:2 Polarity Select Control；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2018页；原文字段表：Polarity Select Control

Bit 3 controls the S3 switch and bit 2 controls the S2 switch. 
This allows you to selectively invert one of the delayed signals 
before it is sent out of the dead-band submodule. The following 
descriptions correspond to classical upper/lower switch control as 
found in one leg of a digital motor control inverter. These assume 
that DBCTL[OUT_MODE] = 1,1 and DBCTL[IN_MODE] = 0x0. Other 
enhanced modes are also possible, but not regarded as typical 
usage modes.
00: Active high (AH) mode. Neither EPWMxA nor EPWMxB is 
inverted (default).
01: Active low complementary (ALC) mode. EPWMxA is inverted.
10: Active high complementary (AHC). EPWMxB is inverted.
11: Active low (AL) mode. Both EPWMxA and EPWMxB are inverted.
Enhanced Pulse Width Modulator (ePWM)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: IN_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输入 选择 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 输入 模式 控制 位 5 控制 S5 switch 及 位 4 控制 S4 switch shown. 此 allows you 至 选择 输入 来源 至 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟. 至 produce classical 死区 waveforms 默认 为 EPWMxA 中 为 来源 用于 both 下降沿 及 rising-edge delays. 00: EPWMxA 中 (来自 action-qualifier) 为 来源 用于 both falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟. 01: EPWMxB 中 (来自 action-qualifier) 为 来源 用于 上升沿- 边沿 delayed 信号. EPWMxA 中 (来自 action-qualifier) 为 来源 用于 falling-edge delayed 信号. 10: EPWMxA 中 (来自 action-qualifier) 为 来源 用于 上升沿- 边沿 delayed 信号. EPWMxB 中 (来自 action-qualifier) 为 来源 用于 falling-edge delayed 信号. 11: EPWMxB 中 (来自 action-qualifier) 为 来源 用于 both rising-edge 延迟 及 falling-edge delayed 信号.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5:4 Dead Band Input Select Mode Control；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2018页；原文字段表：Dead-Band Input Mode Control

Bit 5 controls the S5 switch and bit 4 controls the S4 switch shown. 
This allows you to select the input source to the falling-edge and 
rising-edge delay. To produce classical dead-band waveforms the 
default is EPWMxA In is the source for both falling and rising-edge 
delays.
00: EPWMxA In (from the action-qualifier) is the source for both 
falling-edge and rising-edge delay.
01: EPWMxB In (from the action-qualifier) is the source for rising-
edge delayed signal.
EPWMxA In (from the action-qualifier) is the source for falling-edge 
delayed signal.
10: EPWMxA In (from the action-qualifier) is the source for rising-
edge delayed signal.
EPWMxB In (from the action-qualifier) is the source for falling-edge 
delayed signal.
11: EPWMxB In (from the action-qualifier) is the source for both 
rising-edge delay and falling-edge delayed signal.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SHDWDBREDMODE
Fields.Description: DBRED 模块 工作 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：RED 死区 加载 模式 0: Immediate 模式. 仅 活动 DBRED 寄存器 为 使用. 全部 writes/reads via CPU directly 访问 活动 寄存器 用于 immediate 'RED 死区 动作.' 1: 影子 模式. Operates 作为 double 缓冲. 全部 writes via CPU 访问 影子 寄存器. 默认 在 复位 为 Immediate 模式 (用于 compatibility 带 legacy).
Fields.Notes:
原文：10 DBRED Block Operating Mode；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2018页；原文字段表：RED Dead-Band Load Mode

0: Immediate mode. Only the active DBRED register is used. All 
writes/reads via the CPU directly access the active register for 
immediate 'RED dead-band action.'
1: Shadow mode. Operates as a double buffer. All writes via the CPU 
access Shadow register. Default at Reset is Immediate mode (for 
compatibility with legacy).；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OUTSWAP
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输出 交换 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 带 输出 交换 控制 位 13 控制 S6 switch 及 位 12 控制 S7 switch. 00: OutA 及 OutB 信号 are 作为 defined 通过 OUT-MODE 位. 01: OutA = A-path 作为 defined 通过 OUT-MODE 位. OutB = A-path 作为 defined 通过 OUT-MODE 位 (上升沿 边沿 延迟 或 delay-bypassed 信号 路径). 10: OutA = B-path 作为 defined 通过 OUT-MODE 位 (下降沿 边沿 延迟 或 delay-bypassed B 信号 路径). OutB = B-path 作为 defined 通过 OUT-MODE 位. 11: OutA = B-path 作为 defined 通过 OUT-MODE 位 (下降沿 边沿 延迟 或 delay-bypassed B 信号 路径). OutB = A-path 作为 defined 通过 OUT-MODE 位 (上升沿 边沿 延迟 或 delay-bypassed 信号 路径).
Fields.Notes:
原文：13:12 Dead Band Output Swap Control；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2017页；原文字段表：Dead Band Output Swap Control

Bit 13 controls the S6 switch and bit 12 controls the S7 switch.
00: OutA and OutB signals are as defined by OUT-MODE bits.
01: OutA = A-path as defined by OUT-MODE bits.
OutB = A-path as defined by OUT-MODE bits (rising edge delay or 
delay-bypassed A signal path).
10: OutA = B-path as defined by OUT-MODE bits (falling edge delay 
or delay-bypassed B signal path).
OutB = B-path as defined by OUT-MODE bits.
11: OutA = B-path as defined by OUT-MODE bits (falling edge delay 
or delay-bypassed B signal path).
OutB = A-path as defined by OUT-MODE bits (rising edge delay or 
delay-bypassed A signal path).；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: DEDB_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 Dual-Edge B 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 带 Dual-Edge B 模式 控制 (S8 switch) 0: 上升沿 边沿 延迟 applied 至 InA/InB 作为 已选 通过 S4 switch (IN-MODE 位) 开启 信号 路径 仅. 下降沿 边沿 延迟 applied 至 InA/InB 作为 已选 通过 S5 switch (INMODE 位) 开启 B 信号 路径 仅. 1: 上升沿 边沿 延迟 及 下降沿 边沿 延迟 applied 至 来源 已选 通过 S4 switch (INMODE 位) 及 输出 至 B 信号 路径 仅. Note: 当 此 位 为 置位 至 1, user should always either 置位 OUT_模式 位 such that Apath = InA 或 OUTSWAP 位 such that OutA=Bpath otherwise, OutA will be invalid.
Fields.Notes:
原文：14 Dead Band Dual-Edge B Mode Control；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2017页；原文字段表：Dead Band Dual-Edge B Mode Control (S8 switch)

0: Rising edge delay applied to InA/InB as selected by S4 switch 
(IN-MODE bits) on A signal path only. Falling edge delay applied to 
InA/InB as selected by S5 switch (INMODE bits) on B signal path 
only.
1: Rising edge delay and falling edge delay applied to source 
selected by S4 switch (INMODE bits) and output to B signal path 
only. Note: When this bit is set to 1, user should always either set 
OUT_MODE bits such that Apath = InA OR OUTSWAP bits such that 
OutA=Bpath
otherwise, OutA will be invalid.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: HALFCYCLE

1: Half cycle clocking enabled. The dead-band counters are clocked

000: Capture sequence is triggered by software via writes to

001: Capture sequence is triggered by CNT_zero event.
010: Capture sequence is triggered by PRD_eq event.
011: Capture sequence is triggered by CNT_zero or PRD_eq event.

101: Capture sequence is triggered by DCAEVT2 event.

111: Capture sequence is triggered by DCBEVT2 event.

register field. Once the chosen event occurs the capture sequence 
is armed. Event captures occur based of the event chosen in 
DCFCTL[SRCSEL] register.

and VCAPCTL[TRIGSEL] registers.

irrespective of the current capture status, capture sequence is 
retriggered.

Fields.Notes:
原文：4:3 ePWMxA Shadow Mode Select Bits；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2031页；原文字段表：Shadow Mode Bit

Selects the time event that loads the CMPAHR shadow value into the 
active register.
00: Load on CTR = Zero: Time-base counter equal to zero (TBCTR = 
0x0000)
01: Load on CTR = PRD: Time-base counter equal to period (TBCTR

10: Load on either CTR = Zero or CTR = PRD

Fields.Name: SELOUTB
Fields.Description: EPWMB 输出 选择 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：EPWMxB 输出 选择 位 此 位 选择 which 信号 为 输出 开启 ePWMxB 通道 输出. 反相 will take 高 分辨率 模式 进入 account 及 反相 信号 will contain any 高 分辨率 modification. 反相 takes place 作为 最后 step 中 modifying ePWMxB 信号. 0: ePWMxB 输出 为 normal. 1: ePWMxB 输出 为 反相 version 的 ePWMxA 信号.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5 EPWMB Output Selection Bit；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2031页；原文字段表：EPWMxB Output Select Bit

This bit selects which signal is output on the ePWMxB channel 
output.
The inversion will take the high resolution mode into account and 
the inverted signal will contain any high resolution modification. The 
inversion takes place as the last step in modifying the ePWMxB 
signal.
0: ePWMxB output is normal.
1: ePWMxB output is inverted version of ePWMxA signal.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: AUTOCONV
Fields.Description: Autoconversion 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：自动 Convert 延迟 线路 数值 选择 是否 小数 占空 cycle/period/phase 中 CMPAHR/TBPRDHR/TBPHSHR 寄存器 为 automatically scaled 通过 MEP scale factor 中 HRMSTEP 寄存器 或 manually scaled 通过 calculations 中 application 软件. SFO library 功能 automatically updates HRMSTEP 寄存器 带 appropriate MEP scale factor. 0: 自动 HRMSTEP scaling 为 已禁用. 1: 自动 HRMSTEP scaling 为 已使能. 如果 application 软件 为 manually scaling 小数 占空 周期, 或 相位 (i.e. 软件 设置 CMPAHR = (fraction(PWMduty * PWMperiod) * MEP Scale Factor)<<8 + 0x080 用于 占空 周期), then 此 模式 must be 已禁用.
Fields.Notes:
原文：6 Autoconversion Bit；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2031页；原文字段表：Auto Convert Delay Line Value

Selects whether the fractional duty cycle/period/phase in the 
CMPAHR/TBPRDHR/TBPHSHR register is automatically scaled by 
the MEP scale factor in the HRMSTEP register or manually scaled 
by calculations in application software. The SFO library function 
automatically updates the HRMSTEP register with the appropriate 
MEP scale factor.
0: Automatic HRMSTEP scaling is disabled.
1: Automatic HRMSTEP scaling is enabled.
If application software is manually scaling the fractional duty cycle, 
or phase (i.e. software sets CMPAHR = (fraction(PWMduty * 
PWMperiod) * MEP Scale Factor)<<8 + 0x080 for duty cycle), then 
this mode must be disabled.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Notes:
原文：7 Swap EPWMA and EPWMB Outputs Bit；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2030页；原文字段表：Swap ePWM A & B Output Signals

This bit enables the swapping of the A & B signal outputs. The 
selection is as follows:
0: ePWMxA and ePWMxB outputs are unchanged.
1: ePWMxA signal appears on ePWMxB output and ePWMxB signal 
appears on ePWMxA output.

Fields.Name: TBPHSHRLOADE
Fields.Description: TBPHSHR 加载 使能
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：TBPHSHR 加载 使能 此 位 allows you 至 synchronize ePWM modules 带 高- 分辨率 相位 开启 同步输入, TBCTL[SWFSYNC] 或 数字 比较 事件. 此 allows 用于 multiple ePWM modules 工作 在 same 频率 至 be 相位 aligned 带 high-resolution. 0: 禁用 同步 的 high-resolution 相位 开启 同步输入, TBCTL[SWFSYNC] 或 数字 比较 事件: 1: Synchronize high-resolution 相位 开启 同步输入, TBCTL[SWFSYNC] 或 数字 比较器 同步 事件. 相位 为 synchronized using 内容 的 high-resolution 相位 TBPHSHR 寄存器. TBCTL[PHSEN] 位 which 使能 loading 的 TBCTR 寄存器 带 TBPHS 寄存器 值 开启 同步输入 或 TBCTL[SWFSYNC] 事件 works independently. However, users need 至 使能 此 位 also 如果 they want 至 控制 相位 中 conjunction 带 high-resolution 周期 feature. 此 位 及 TBCTL[PHSEN] 位 must be 置位 至 1 当 high-resolution 周期 为 已使能 用于 up-down 计数 模式 even 如果 TBPHSHR = 0x0000. 此 位 does 不 need 至 be 置位 当 仅 high-resolution 占空 为 已使能.
Fields.Notes:
原文：2 TBPHSHR Load Enable；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2035页；原文字段表：TBPHSHR Load Enable

This bit allows you to synchronize ePWM modules with a high-
resolution phase on a SYNCIN, TBCTL[SWFSYNC] or digital 
compare event. This allows for multiple ePWM modules operating 
at the same frequency to be phase aligned with high-resolution.
0: Disables synchronization of high-resolution phase on a SYNCIN, 
TBCTL[SWFSYNC] or digital compare event:
1: Synchronize the high-resolution phase on a SYNCIN, 
TBCTL[SWFSYNC] or digital comparator synchronization event. The 
phase is synchronized using the contents of the high-resolution 
phase TBPHSHR register. The TBCTL[PHSEN] bit which enables 
the loading of the TBCTR register with TBPHS register value 
on a SYNCIN or TBCTL[SWFSYNC] event works independently. 
However, users need to enable this bit also if they want to control 
phase in conjunction with the high-resolution period feature.
This bit and the TBCTL[PHSEN] bit must be set to 1 when 
high-resolution period is enabled for up-down count mode even if 
TBPHSHR = 0x0000. This bit does not need to be set when only 
high-resolution duty is enabled.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TRREM
Fields.Description: HRPWM 余数 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：HRPWM 余数 位: 此 11-位 值 keeps track 的 余数 portion 的 HRPWM algorithm calculations. 此 值 keeps track 的 余数 portion 的 HRPWM 硬件 calculations. Notes: 1. 低位 8-位 的 TRREM 寄存器 CAN be automatically initialized 带 TBPHSHR 值 开启 同步输入 或 TBCTL[SWFSYNC] 事件 或 DC 事件 (如果 已使能). user CAN also 写入 值 带 CPU. 2. 优先级 的 TRREM 寄存器 updates: 同步 (软件 或 硬件) TBPHSHR copied 至 TRREM : Highest 优先级 HRPWM 硬件 (updates TRREM 寄存器): 下次 优先级 CPU 写入 至 TRREM 寄存器: Lowest 优先级 3. 位 10 的 TRREM 寄存器 为 不 使用 中 asymmetrical 模式. 此 位 CAN be forced 至 零. TRREM will be initialized 至 0x0 及 0x100 中 上升 及 Up-down modes respectively. Asymmetrical 模式: TRREM[7:0] = TBPHSHR[15:8] TRREM[10,9,8] = 0,0,0 Symmetrical 模式: TRREM[7:0] = TBPHSHR[15:8] TRREM[10,9,8] = 0,0,1
Fields.Notes:
原文：10:0 HRPWM Remainder Bits；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2037页；原文字段表：HRPWM Remainder Bits: This 11-bit value keeps track of the 

remainder portion of the HRPWM algorithm calculations.
This value keeps track of the remainder portion of the HRPWM 
hardware calculations.
Notes:
1. The lower 8-bits of the TRREM register can be automatically 
initialized with the TBPHSHR value on a SYNCIN or 
TBCTL[SWFSYNC] event or DC event (if enabled). The user can 
also write a value with the CPU.
2. Priority of TRREM register updates:
Sync (software or hardware) TBPHSHR copied to TRREM : Highest 
Priority
HRPWM Hardware (updates TRREM register): Next priority
CPU Write To TRREM Register: Lowest Priority
3. Bit 10 of TRREM register is not used in asymmetrical mode. This 
bit can be forced to zero.
TRREM will be initialized to 0x0 and 0x100 in Up and Up-down 
modes respectively.
Asymmetrical Mode:
TRREM[7:0] = TBPHSHR[15:8]
TRREM[10,9,8] = 0,0,0
Symmetrical Mode:
TRREM[7:0] = TBPHSHR[15:8]
TRREM[10,9,8] = 0,0,1；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

原文：0 Global Shadow to Active load event control；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2039页；原文字段表：Global Shadow to Active Load Event Control

as per the individual reload control bits specified (Compatible with

Fields.Notes:
原文：4:1 Shadow to Active Global Load Pulse Selection；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2039页；原文字段表：Global Load Pulse selection for Shadow to Active Mode Reloads

0000: Load on Counter = 0 (CNT_ZRO)

Fields.Name: TBPHS
Fields.Description: 相位 偏移 寄存器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：相位 偏移 寄存器 These 位 置位 时基 计数器 相位 的 已选 ePWM relative 至 时基 that 为 supplying 同步 输入 信号. - 如果 TBCTL[PHSEN] = 0, then 同步 事件 为 忽略 及 时基 计数器 为 不 loaded 带 相位. - 如果 TBCTL[PHSEN] = 1, then 时基 计数器 (TBCTR) will be loaded 带 相位 (TBPHS) 当 同步 事件 发生. 同步 事件 CAN be initiated 通过 输入 同步 信号 (EPWMxSYNCI) 或 通过 软件 forced 同步.
Fields.Notes:
原文：31:16 Phase Offset Register；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2056页；原文字段表：Phase Offset Register

These bits set time-base counter phase of the selected ePWM 
relative to the time-base that is supplying the synchronization input 
signal.
- If TBCTL[PHSEN] = 0, then the synchronization event is ignored 
and the time-base counter is not loaded with the phase.
- If TBCTL[PHSEN] = 1, then the time-base counter (TBCTR) will 
be loaded with the phase (TBPHS) when a synchronization event 
occurs. The synchronization event can be initiated by the input 
synchronization signal (EPWMxSYNCI) or by a software forced 
synchronization.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

原文：Time Base Period High Resolution Register；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2057页；原文字段表：Period High Resolution Bits

Fields.Name: TBPRD
Fields.Description: 时基周期计数值。
Fields.Values: 向上/向下计数：频率=TBCLK/(TBPRD+1)；上下计数：频率=TBCLK/(2×TBPRD)。
Fields.Notes:
原文：Time Base Period Register；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2058页；原文字段表：Time Base Period Register

These bits determine the period of the time-base counter. This 
sets the PWM frequency. Shadowing of this register is enabled 
and disabled by the TBCTL[PRDLD] bit. By default this register is 
shadowed.
- If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write 
or read will automatically go to the shadow register. In this case, 
the active register will be loaded from the shadow register when the 
time-base counter equals zero.
- If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 1, then the shadow is disabled and any write or 
read will go directly to the active register, that is the register actively 
controlling the hardware.
- The active and shadow registers share the same memory map 
address.

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：比较 寄存器 值 中 活动 CMPA 寄存器 为 continuously compared 至 时基 计数器 (TBCTR). 当 values are equal, counter-compare 模块 产生 '时基 计数器 equal 至 计数器 比较 ' 事件. 此 事件 为 sent 至 action-qualifier where it 为 限定后 及 converted it 进入 单次 或 more actions. These actions CAN be applied 至 either EPWMxA 或 EPWMxB 输出 depending 开启 配置 的 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器. actions that CAN be defined 中 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器 include: - 执行 nothing 事件 为 忽略. - 清除: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 低 - 置位: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 高 - 翻转 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 Shadowing 的 此 寄存器 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. - 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能 及 any 写入 或 读取 will automatically go 至 影子 寄存器. 中 此 case, CMPCTL[LOADAMODE] 位 field 决定 which 事件 will 加载 活动 寄存器 来自 影子 寄存器. - Before 写入, CMPCTL[SHDWAFULL] 位 CAN be 读取 至 determine 如果 影子 寄存器 为 currently 满. - 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用 及 any 写入 或 读取 will go directly 至 活动 寄存器, that 为 寄存器 actively controlling 硬件. - 中 either 模式, 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：31:16 Compare A Register；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2059页；原文字段表：Compare A Register

The value in the active CMPA register is continuously compared to 
the time-base counter (TBCTR). When the values are equal, the 
counter-compare module generates a 'time-base counter equal to 
counter compare A' event. This event is sent to the action-qualifier 
where it is qualified and converted it into one or more actions. 
These actions can be applied to either the EPWMxA or the EPWMxB 
output depending on the configuration of the AQCTLA and AQCTLB 
registers. The actions that can be defined in the AQCTLA and 
AQCTLB registers include:
- Do nothing
the event is ignored.
- Clear: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal low
- Set: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal high
- Toggle the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the 
CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] bit. By default this register is shadowed.
- If CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and 
any write or read will automatically go to the shadow register. In this 
case, the CMPCTL[LOADAMODE] bit field determines which event 
will load the active register from the shadow register.
- Before a write, the CMPCTL[SHDWAFULL] bit can be read to 
determine if the shadow register is currently full.
- If CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is 
disabled and any write or read will go directly to the active register, 
that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
- In either mode, the active and shadow registers share the same 
memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OSHTLD
Fields.Description: 使能 重装载 事件 中 单次 触发 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：R-0/W1S 0h 使能 重装载 事件 中 单次 触发 模式 0: Writing 的 0 will be 忽略. Always reads back 0. 1: Turns 单次 触发 锁存 条件 开启. Upon occurrence 的 chosen 加载 选通, 单次 影子 至 活动 重装载 发生 及 锁存 will be cleared. Hence writing 1 至 此 位 would allow 单次 加载 选通 事件 至 pass through 及 模块 further 选通 events.
Fields.Notes:
原文：0 Enable reload event in one shot mode；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2063页；原文字段表：R-0/W1S 0h Enable Reload Event in One Shot Mode

0: Writing of 0 will be ignored. Always reads back a 0.
1: Turns the one shot latch condition ON. Upon occurrence of a 
chosen load strobe, one shadow to active reload occurs and the 
latch will be cleared. Hence writing 1 to this bit would allow one load 
strobe event to pass through and block further strobe events.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TZA
Fields.Description: TZ1 至 TZ6 跳闸 动作 开启 EPWMxA
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：TZ1 至 TZ6, DCAEVT1/2, DCBEVT1/2 跳闸 动作 开启 EPWMxA 当 跳闸 事件 发生 following 动作 为 taken 开启 输出 EPWMxA. Which 跳闸保护 引脚 CAN cause 事件 为 defined 中 TZSEL 寄存器. 00: High-impedance (EPWMxA = High-impedance 状态) 01: 强制 EPWMxA 至 高 状态 10: 强制 EPWMxA 至 低 状态 11: 执行 nothing, no 动作 为 taken 开启 EPWMxA.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0 TZ1 to TZ6 Trip Action On EPWMxA；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2069页；原文字段表：TZ1 to TZ6, DCAEVT1/2, DCBEVT1/2 Trip Action On EPWMxA

When a trip event occurs the following action is taken on output 
EPWMxA. Which trip-zone pins can cause an event is defined in the 
TZSEL register.
00: High-impedance (EPWMxA = High-impedance state)
01: Force EPWMxA to a high state
10: Force EPWMxA to a low state
11: Do nothing, no action is taken on EPWMxA.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INT
Fields.Description: 全局 中断 状态 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：锁存 跳闸 中断 状态 标志 0: 表示 no 中断 has been 已产生. 1: 表示 ePWMx_TZINT PIE 中断 was 已产生 because 的 跳闸 条件. No further ePWMx_TZINT PIE 中断 will be 已产生 until 此 标志 为 cleared. 如果 中断 标志 为 cleared 当 either CBC 或 OST 为 置位, then another 中断 脉冲 will be 已产生. Clearing 全部 标志 位 will prevent further 中断. 此 位 为 cleared 通过 writing appropriate 值 至 TZCLR 寄存器. Enhanced 脉冲 宽度 Modulator (ePWM) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：0 Global Int Status Flag；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2078页；原文字段表：Latched Trip Interrupt Status Flag

0: Indicates no interrupt has been generated.
1: Indicates an EPWMx_TZINT PIE interrupt was generated because 
of a trip condition.
No further EPWMx_TZINT PIE interrupts will be generated until this 
flag is cleared. If the interrupt flag is cleared when either CBC or 
OST is set, then another interrupt pulse will be generated. Clearing 
all flag bits will prevent further interrupts. This bit is cleared by writing 
the appropriate value to the TZCLR register.
Enhanced Pulse Width Modulator (ePWM)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CBC
Fields.Description: 跳闸 区域 周期 通过 周期 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：锁存 状态 标志 用于 逐周期 跳闸 事件 0: No 逐周期 跳闸 事件 has occurred. 1: 表示 跳闸 事件 has occurred 开启 信号 已选 作为 逐周期 跳闸 来源. TZFLG[CBC] 位 will remain 置位 until it 为 manually cleared 通过 user. 如果 逐周期 跳闸 事件 为 still present 当 CBC 位 为 cleared, then CBC will be immediately 置位 again. specified 条件 开启 信号 为 automatically cleared 当 ePWM 时基 计数器 reaches 零 (TBCTR = 0x00) 如果 跳闸 条件 为 no longer present. 条件 开启 信号 为 仅 cleared 当 TBCTR = 0x00 no matter where 中 周期 CBC 标志 为 cleared. 此 位 为 cleared 通过 writing appropriate 值 至 TZCLR 寄存器.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1 Trip Zones Cycle By Cycle Flag；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2078页；原文字段表：Latched Status Flag for Cycle-By-Cycle Trip Event

0: No cycle-by-cycle trip event has occurred.
1: Indicates a trip event has occurred on a signal selected as a 
cycle-by-cycle trip source. The
TZFLG[CBC] bit will remain set until it is manually cleared by the 
user. If the cycle-by-cycle trip event is still present when the CBC 
bit is cleared, then CBC will be immediately set again. The specified 
condition on the signal is automatically cleared when the ePWM 
time-base counter reaches zero (TBCTR = 0x00) if the trip condition 
is no longer present. The condition on the signal is only cleared 
when the TBCTR = 0x00 no matter where in the cycle the CBC flag 
is cleared.
This bit is cleared by writing the appropriate value to the TZCLR 
register.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

原文：2:0 EPWMxINTn Select；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2090页；原文字段表：ePWM Interrupt (EPWMx_INT) Selection Options

000: Reserved
001: Enable event time-base counter equal to zero. (TBCTR = 0x00)
010: Enable event time-base counter equal to period (TBCTR = 
TBPRD)
011: Enable event time-base counter equal to zero or period (TBCTR 
= 0x00 or TBCTR = TBPRD). This mode is useful in up-down count 
mode.
100: Enable event time-base counter equal to CMPA when the timer 
is incrementing or CMPC when the timer is incrementing
101: Enable event time-base counter equal to CMPA when the timer 
is decrementing or CMPC when the timer is decrementing
110: Enable event: time-base counter equal to CMPB when the timer 
is incrementing or CMPD when the timer is incrementing
111: Enable event: time-base counter equal to CMPB when the timer 
is decrementing or CMPD when the timer is decrementing (*) Event 
selected is determined by INTSELCMP bit.

Fields.Description: EPWMxINTn 周期 选择
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ePWM 中断 (ePWMx_中断) 周期 选择 These 位 determine how many 已选 ETSEL[INTSEL] events need 至 occur before 中断 为 已产生. 至 be 已产生, 中断 must be 已使能 (ETSEL[中断] = 1). 如果 中断 状态 标志 为 置位 来自 前次 中断 (ETFLG[中断] = 1) then no 中断 will be 已产生 until 标志 为 cleared via ETCLR[中断] 位. 此 allows 用于 单次 中断 至 be 待处理 期间 another 为 still being serviced. Once 中断 为 已产生, ETPS[INTCNT] 位 will automatically be cleared. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 same 作为 当前 计数器 值 will 触发 中断 如果 it 为 已使能 及 状态 标志 为 清除. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 less than 当前 计数器 值 will 结果 中 undefined 状态. 如果 计数器 事件 发生 在 same instant 作为 new 零 或 non-zero INTPRD 值 为 written, 计数器 为 incremented. 00: 禁用 中断 事件 计数器. No 中断 will be 已产生 及 ETFRC[中断] 为 忽略. 01: 产生 中断 开启 首个 事件 INTCNT = 01 (首个 事件) 10: 产生 中断 开启 ETPS[INTCNT] = 1,0 (second 事件) 11: 产生 中断 开启 ETPS[INTCNT] = 1,1 (third 事件)
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0 EPWMxINTn Period Select；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2093页；原文字段表：ePWM Interrupt (EPWMx_INT) Period Select

These bits determine how many selected ETSEL[INTSEL] events 
need to occur before an interrupt is generated. To be generated, 
the interrupt must be enabled (ETSEL[INT] = 1). If the interrupt 
status flag is set from a previous interrupt (ETFLG[INT] = 1) then 
no interrupt will be generated until the flag is cleared via the 
ETCLR[INT] bit. This allows for one interrupt to be pending while 
another is still being serviced. Once the interrupt is generated, the 
ETPS[INTCNT] bits will automatically be cleared.
Writing a INTPRD value that is the same as the current counter value 
will trigger an interrupt if it is enabled and the status flag is clear.
Writing a INTPRD value that is less than the current counter value 
will result in an undefined state. If a counter event occurs at the 
same instant as a new zero or non-zero INTPRD value is written, the 
counter is incremented.
00: Disable the interrupt event counter. No interrupt will be generated 
and ETFRC[INT] is ignored.
01: Generate an interrupt on the first event INTCNT = 01 (first event)
10: Generate interrupt on ETPS[INTCNT] = 1,0 (second event)
11: Generate interrupt on ETPS[INTCNT] = 1,1 (third event)；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

events need to occur before an interrupt is generated:

0010: Generate interrupt on INTCNT = 2 (second event)
0011: Generate interrupt on INTCNT = 3 (third event)
0100: Generate interrupt on INTCNT = 4 (fourth event)

Fields.Notes:
原文：Digital Compare Filter Offset Register；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2110页；原文字段表：Blanking Window Offset

These 16-bits specify the number of TBCLK cycles from the blanking 
window reference to the point when the blanking window is applied. 
The blanking window reference is either period or zero as defined 
by the DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit. This offset register is shadowed 
and the active register is loaded at the reference point defined 
by DCFCTL[PULSESEL]. The offset counter is also initialized and 
begins to count down when the active register is loaded. When 
the counter expires, the blanking window is applied. If the blanking 
window is currently active, then the blanking window counter is 
restarted.

boundary.

CPU reads 的 此 寄存器 will return 影子 寄存器 值. - 如果 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用. 中 此 模式, CPU reads will return 活动 寄存器 值. 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址. Fields.Notes:
原文：Digital Compare Counter Capture Register；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2114页；原文字段表：Digital Compare Time-Base Counter Capture

To enable time-base counter capture, set the DCCAPCLT[CAPE] bit 
to 1. If enabled, reflects the value of the time-base counter (TBCTR) 
on the low to high edge transition of a filtered (DCEVTFLT) event. 
Further capture events are ignored until the next period or zero 
as selected by the DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit. Shadowing of DCCAP 
is enabled and disabled by the DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] bit. By 
default this register is shadowed.
- If DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled. 
In this mode, the active register is copied to the shadow register 
on the TBCTR = TBPRD or TBCTR = zero as defined by the 
DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit. CPU reads of this register will return the 
shadow register value.
- If DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is 
disabled. In this mode, CPU reads will return the active register 
value. The active and shadow registers share the same memory 
map address.

Fields.Name: CTRMODE
Fields.Description: 时基计数模式。
Fields.Values: 0：向上计数；1：向下计数；2：上下计数；3：停止/冻结。
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0 Counter Mode；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2009页；原文字段表：Counter Mode

The time-base counter mode is normally configured once and not 
changed during normal operation. If you change the mode of the 
counter, the change will take effect at the next TBCLK edge and the 
current counter value shall increment or decrement from the value 
before the mode change. These bits set the time-base counter mode 
of operation as follows:
00: Up-count mode
01: Down-count mode
10: Up-down count mode
11: Freeze counter operation (default on reset)；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI33H / 2024-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: PHSEN
Fields.Description: 相位加载使能。
Fields.Values: 0：禁用相位加载；1：收到同步事件时将TBPHS载入TBCTR。
Fields.Notes:
原文：2 Phase Load Enable；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2009页；原文字段表：Counter Reg Load from Phase Reg Enable

0: Do not load the time-base counter (TBCTR) from the time-base 
phase register (TBPHS).
1: Allow Counter to be loaded from the Phase register (TBPHS) and 
shadow to active load events when an EPWMxSYNCI input signal 
occurs or a software-forced sync signal, see bit 6.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI33H / 2024-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: PRDLD
Fields.Description: 周期寄存器的影子加载模式。
Fields.Values: 0：使用影子寄存器，计数器归零时装载；1：直接写活动寄存器。
Fields.Notes:
原文：3 Active Period Load；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2009页；原文字段表：Active Period Reg Load from Shadow Select

0: The period register (TBPRD) is loaded from its shadow register 
when the time-base counter, TBCTR, is equal to zero and/or a sync 
event as determined by the TBCTL2[PRDLDSYNC] bit.
A write/read to the TBPRD register accesses the shadow register.
1: Immediate Mode (Shadow register bypassed): A write or read to 
the TBPRD register accesses the active register.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI33H / 2024-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: SYNCOSEL
Fields.Description: 同步 输出 选择
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：同步 输出 选择 00: EPWMxSYNCI / SWFSYNC 01: CTR = 零: 时基 计数器 equal 至 零 (TBCTR = 0x00) 10: CTR = CMPB : 时基 计数器 equal 至 counter-compare B (TBCTR = CMPB) 11: EPWMXSYNCO 为 defined 通过 TBCTL2[SYNCOSELX]
Fields.Notes:
原文：5:4 Sync Output Select；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2009页；原文字段表：Sync Output Select

00: EPWMxSYNCI / SWFSYNC
01: CTR = zero: Time-base counter equal to zero (TBCTR = 0x00)
10: CTR = CMPB : Time-base counter equal to counter-compare B 
(TBCTR = CMPB)
11: EPWMXSYNCO is defined by TBCTL2[SYNCOSELX]；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SWFSYNC
Fields.Description: 软件强制同步。
Fields.Values: 写1产生软件同步脉冲；硬件清零。
Fields.Notes:
原文：6 Software Force Sync Pulse；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2009页；原文字段表：R-0/W1S 0h Software Forced Sync Pulse

0: Writing a 0 has no effect and reads always return a 0.
1: Writing a 1 forces a one-time synchronization pulse to be 
generated.
SWFSYNC affects EPWMxSYNCO only when SYNCOSEL = 00.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI33H / 2024-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: HSPCLKDIV
Fields.Description: 时基高速预分频选择。
Fields.Notes:
原文：9:7 High Speed TBCLK Pre-scaler；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2009页；原文字段表：High Speed Time Base Clock Pre-Scale Bits

These bits determine part of the time-base clock prescale value.
TBCLK = EPWMCLK / (HSPCLKDIV x CLKDIV). This divisor 
emulates the HSPCLK in the TMS320x281x system as used on the 
Event Manager (EV) peripheral.
000: /1
001: /2 (default on reset)
010: /4
011: /6
100: /8
101: /10
110: /12
111: /14；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI33H / 2024-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: CLKDIV
Fields.Description: 时基低速预分频选择。
Fields.Notes:
原文：12:10 Time Base Clock Pre-scaler；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2008页；原文字段表：Time Base Clock Pre-Scale Bits

These bits select the time base clock pre-scale value (TBCLK = 
EPWMCLK/(HSPCLKDIV * CLKDIV):
000: /1 (default on reset)
001: /2
010: /4
011: /8
100: /16
101: /32
110: /64
111: /128
Enhanced Pulse Width Modulator (ePWM)
 www.ti.com；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI33H / 2024-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: PHSDIR
Fields.Description: 上下计数模式下，同步载入相位后的计数方向。
Fields.Values: 0：同步后向下计数；1：同步后向上计数。
Fields.Notes:
原文：13 Phase Direction Bit；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2008页；原文字段表：Phase Direction Bit

This bit is only used when the time-base counter is configured in the 
up-down-count mode. The
PHSDIR bit indicates the direction the time-base counter (TBCTR) 
will count after a synchronization
event occurs and a new phase value is loaded from the phase 
(TBPHS) register. This is
irrespective of the direction of the counter before the synchronization 
event..
In the up-count and down-count modes this bit is ignored.
0: Count down after the synchronization event.
1: Count up after the synchronization event.；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI33H / 2024-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: FREE_SOFT
Fields.Description: 仿真 模式 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：仿真 模式 位. These 位 选择 behavior 的 ePWM 时基 计数器 during 仿真 events 00: 停止 after 下次 时基 计数器 递增 或 递减 01: 停止 当 计数器 completes whole 周期: - 向上计数 模式: 停止 当 时基 计数器 = 周期 (TBCTR = TBPRD) - 向下计数 模式: 停止 当 时基 计数器 = 0x00 (TBCTR = 0x00) - Up-down-count 模式: 停止 当 时基 计数器 = 0x00 (TBCTR = 0x00) 1x: 自由运行 run
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:14 Emulation Mode Bits；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2008页；原文字段表：Emulation Mode Bits. These bits select the behavior of the ePWM 

time-base counter during emulation events
00: Stop after the next time-base counter increment or decrement
01: Stop when counter completes a whole cycle:
- Up-count mode: stop when the time-base counter = period (TBCTR 
= TBPRD)
- Down-count mode: stop when the time-base counter = 0x00 
(TBCTR = 0x00)
- Up-down-count mode: stop when the time-base counter = 0x00 
(TBCTR = 0x00)
1x: Free run；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OUT_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输出 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 输出 模式 控制 位 1 控制 S1 switch 及 位 0 控制 S0 switch. 00: DBM 为 fully 已禁用 或 by-passed. 中 此 模式 POLSEL 及 IN-MODE 位 have no effect. 01: Apath = InA (延迟 为 by-passed 用于 信号 路径) Bpath = FED (下降沿 边沿 延迟 中 B 信号 路径) 10: Apath = RED (上升沿 边沿 延迟 中 信号 路径) Bpath = InB (延迟 为 by-passed 用于 B 信号 路径) 11: DBM 为 fully 已使能 (i.e. both RED 及 FED 活动)
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0 Dead Band Output Mode Control；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2019页；原文字段表：Dead-Band Output Mode Control

Bit 1 controls the S1 switch and bit 0 controls the S0 switch.
00: DBM is fully disabled or by-passed. In this mode the POLSEL 
and IN-MODE bits have no effect.
01: Apath = InA (delay is by-passed for A signal path)
Bpath = FED (Falling Edge Delay in B signal path)
10: Apath = RED (Rising Edge Delay in A signal path)
Bpath = InB (delay is by-passed for B signal path)
11: DBM is fully enabled (i.e. both RED and FED active)；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: POLSEL
Fields.Description: 极性 选择 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：极性 选择 控制 位 3 控制 S3 switch 及 位 2 控制 S2 switch. 此 allows you 至 selectively invert 单次 的 delayed 信号 before it 为 sent out 的 死区 submodule. following descriptions correspond 至 classical upper/lower switch 控制 作为 found 中 单次 leg 的 数字 motor 控制 inverter. These assume that DBCTL[OUT_模式] = 1,1 及 DBCTL[中_模式] = 0x0. Other enhanced modes are also possible, but 不 regarded 作为 typical usage modes. 00: 活动 高 (AH) 模式. Neither EPWMxA nor EPWMxB 为 反相 (默认). 01: 活动 低 互补 (ALC) 模式. EPWMxA 为 反相. 10: 活动 高 互补 (AHC). EPWMxB 为 反相. 11: 活动 低 (AL) 模式. Both EPWMxA 及 EPWMxB are 反相. Enhanced 脉冲 宽度 Modulator (ePWM) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：3:2 Polarity Select Control；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2018页；原文字段表：Polarity Select Control

Bit 3 controls the S3 switch and bit 2 controls the S2 switch. 
This allows you to selectively invert one of the delayed signals 
before it is sent out of the dead-band submodule. The following 
descriptions correspond to classical upper/lower switch control as 
found in one leg of a digital motor control inverter. These assume 
that DBCTL[OUT_MODE] = 1,1 and DBCTL[IN_MODE] = 0x0. Other 
enhanced modes are also possible, but not regarded as typical 
usage modes.
00: Active high (AH) mode. Neither EPWMxA nor EPWMxB is 
inverted (default).
01: Active low complementary (ALC) mode. EPWMxA is inverted.
10: Active high complementary (AHC). EPWMxB is inverted.
11: Active low (AL) mode. Both EPWMxA and EPWMxB are inverted.
Enhanced Pulse Width Modulator (ePWM)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: IN_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输入 选择 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 输入 模式 控制 位 5 控制 S5 switch 及 位 4 控制 S4 switch shown. 此 allows you 至 选择 输入 来源 至 falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟. 至 produce classical 死区 waveforms 默认 为 EPWMxA 中 为 来源 用于 both 下降沿 及 rising-edge delays. 00: EPWMxA 中 (来自 action-qualifier) 为 来源 用于 both falling-edge 及 rising-edge 延迟. 01: EPWMxB 中 (来自 action-qualifier) 为 来源 用于 上升沿- 边沿 delayed 信号. EPWMxA 中 (来自 action-qualifier) 为 来源 用于 falling-edge delayed 信号. 10: EPWMxA 中 (来自 action-qualifier) 为 来源 用于 上升沿- 边沿 delayed 信号. EPWMxB 中 (来自 action-qualifier) 为 来源 用于 falling-edge delayed 信号. 11: EPWMxB 中 (来自 action-qualifier) 为 来源 用于 both rising-edge 延迟 及 falling-edge delayed 信号.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5:4 Dead Band Input Select Mode Control；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2018页；原文字段表：Dead-Band Input Mode Control

Bit 5 controls the S5 switch and bit 4 controls the S4 switch shown. 
This allows you to select the input source to the falling-edge and 
rising-edge delay. To produce classical dead-band waveforms the 
default is EPWMxA In is the source for both falling and rising-edge 
delays.
00: EPWMxA In (from the action-qualifier) is the source for both 
falling-edge and rising-edge delay.
01: EPWMxB In (from the action-qualifier) is the source for rising-
edge delayed signal.
EPWMxA In (from the action-qualifier) is the source for falling-edge 
delayed signal.
10: EPWMxA In (from the action-qualifier) is the source for rising-
edge delayed signal.
EPWMxB In (from the action-qualifier) is the source for falling-edge 
delayed signal.
11: EPWMxB In (from the action-qualifier) is the source for both 
rising-edge delay and falling-edge delayed signal.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OUTSWAP
Fields.Description: 死区 带 输出 交换 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 带 输出 交换 控制 位 13 控制 S6 switch 及 位 12 控制 S7 switch. 00: OutA 及 OutB 信号 are 作为 defined 通过 OUT-MODE 位. 01: OutA = A-path 作为 defined 通过 OUT-MODE 位. OutB = A-path 作为 defined 通过 OUT-MODE 位 (上升沿 边沿 延迟 或 delay-bypassed 信号 路径). 10: OutA = B-path 作为 defined 通过 OUT-MODE 位 (下降沿 边沿 延迟 或 delay-bypassed B 信号 路径). OutB = B-path 作为 defined 通过 OUT-MODE 位. 11: OutA = B-path 作为 defined 通过 OUT-MODE 位 (下降沿 边沿 延迟 或 delay-bypassed B 信号 路径). OutB = A-path 作为 defined 通过 OUT-MODE 位 (上升沿 边沿 延迟 或 delay-bypassed 信号 路径).
Fields.Notes:
原文：13:12 Dead Band Output Swap Control；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2017页；原文字段表：Dead Band Output Swap Control

Bit 13 controls the S6 switch and bit 12 controls the S7 switch.
00: OutA and OutB signals are as defined by OUT-MODE bits.
01: OutA = A-path as defined by OUT-MODE bits.
OutB = A-path as defined by OUT-MODE bits (rising edge delay or 
delay-bypassed A signal path).
10: OutA = B-path as defined by OUT-MODE bits (falling edge delay 
or delay-bypassed B signal path).
OutB = B-path as defined by OUT-MODE bits.
11: OutA = B-path as defined by OUT-MODE bits (falling edge delay 
or delay-bypassed B signal path).
OutB = A-path as defined by OUT-MODE bits (rising edge delay or 
delay-bypassed A signal path).；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: DEDB_MODE
Fields.Description: 死区 带 Dual-Edge B 模式 控制
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：死区 带 Dual-Edge B 模式 控制 (S8 switch) 0: 上升沿 边沿 延迟 applied 至 InA/InB 作为 已选 通过 S4 switch (IN-MODE 位) 开启 信号 路径 仅. 下降沿 边沿 延迟 applied 至 InA/InB 作为 已选 通过 S5 switch (INMODE 位) 开启 B 信号 路径 仅. 1: 上升沿 边沿 延迟 及 下降沿 边沿 延迟 applied 至 来源 已选 通过 S4 switch (INMODE 位) 及 输出 至 B 信号 路径 仅. Note: 当 此 位 为 置位 至 1, user should always either 置位 OUT_模式 位 such that Apath = InA 或 OUTSWAP 位 such that OutA=Bpath otherwise, OutA will be invalid.
Fields.Notes:
原文：14 Dead Band Dual-Edge B Mode Control；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2017页；原文字段表：Dead Band Dual-Edge B Mode Control (S8 switch)

0: Rising edge delay applied to InA/InB as selected by S4 switch 
(IN-MODE bits) on A signal path only. Falling edge delay applied to 
InA/InB as selected by S5 switch (INMODE bits) on B signal path 
only.
1: Rising edge delay and falling edge delay applied to source 
selected by S4 switch (INMODE bits) and output to B signal path 
only. Note: When this bit is set to 1, user should always either set 
OUT_MODE bits such that Apath = InA OR OUTSWAP bits such that 
OutA=Bpath
otherwise, OutA will be invalid.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TRIGSEL
Fields.Description: 捕获 触发 选择
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：状态 的 Numbered 的 Captured Events 000: 捕获 sequence 为 triggered 通过 软件 via writes 至 VCAPCTL[VCAPSTART]. 001: 捕获 sequence 为 triggered 通过 计数_零 事件. 010: 捕获 sequence 为 triggered 通过 PRD_eq 事件. 011: 捕获 sequence 为 triggered 通过 计数_零 或 PRD_eq 事件. 100: 捕获 sequence 为 triggered 通过 DCAEVT1 事件. 101: 捕获 sequence 为 triggered 通过 DCAEVT2 事件. 110: 捕获 sequence 为 triggered 通过 DCBEVT1 事件. 111: 捕获 sequence 为 triggered 通过 DCBEVT2 事件. Note: 谷值 捕获 sequence triggered 通过 已选 事件 中 此 寄存器 field. Once chosen 事件 发生 捕获 sequence 为 armed. 事件 captures occur based 的 事件 chosen 中 DCFCTL[SRCSEL] 寄存器. Note: Same 事件 may 不 be chosen 中 both DCFCTL[SRCSEL] 及 VCAPCTL[TRIGSEL] 寄存器. Note: Once chosen 事件 中 VCAPCTL[TRIGSEL] 发生, irrespective 的 当前 捕获 状态, 捕获 sequence 为 retriggered. Enhanced 脉冲 宽度 Modulator (ePWM) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：4:2 Capture Trigger Select；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2026页；原文字段表：Status of Numbered of Captured Events

000: Capture sequence is triggered by software via writes to 
VCAPCTL[VCAPSTART].
001: Capture sequence is triggered by CNT_zero event.
010: Capture sequence is triggered by PRD_eq event.
011: Capture sequence is triggered by CNT_zero or PRD_eq event.
100: Capture sequence is triggered by DCAEVT1 event.
101: Capture sequence is triggered by DCAEVT2 event.
110: Capture sequence is triggered by DCBEVT1 event.
111: Capture sequence is triggered by DCBEVT2 event.
Note: Valley capture sequence triggered by the selected event in this 
register field. Once the chosen event occurs the capture sequence 
is armed. Event captures occur based of the event chosen in 
DCFCTL[SRCSEL] register.
Note: Same event may not be chosen in both DCFCTL[SRCSEL] 
and VCAPCTL[TRIGSEL] registers.
Note: Once the chosen event in VCAPCTL[TRIGSEL] occurs, 
irrespective of the current capture status, capture sequence is 
retriggered.
Enhanced Pulse Width Modulator (ePWM)

Fields.Name: EDGMODE

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：边沿 模式 位 选择 边沿 的 PWM that 为 controlled 通过 micro-edge 位置 (MEP) logic: 00: HRPWM capability 为 已禁用 (默认 开启 复位) 01: MEP 控制 的 上升沿 边沿 (CMPAHR) 10: MEP 控制 的 下降沿 边沿 (CMPAHR) 11: MEP 控制 的 both edges (TBPHSHR 或 TBPRDHR)

原文：1:0 ePWMxA Edge Mode Select Bits；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2031页；原文字段表：Edge Mode Bits

00: HRPWM capability is disabled (default on reset)

10: MEP control of falling edge (CMPAHR)

Fields.Notes:

0: CMPAHR(8) or TBPRDHR(8) Register controls the edge position 
(i.e., this is duty or period control mode). (Default on Reset)
1: TBPHSHR(8) Register controls the edge position (i.e., this is 
phase control mode).；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：影子 模式 位 选择 时间 事件 that loads CMPAHR 影子 值 进入 活动 寄存器. 00: 加载 开启 CTR = 零: 时基 计数器 equal 至 零 (TBCTR = 0x0000) 01: 加载 开启 CTR = PRD: 时基 计数器 equal 至 周期 (TBCTR = TBPRD) 10: 加载 开启 either CTR = 零 或 CTR = PRD 11: 保留位
Fields.Notes:
原文：4:3 ePWMxA Shadow Mode Select Bits；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2031页；原文字段表：Shadow Mode Bit

Selects the time event that loads the CMPAHR shadow value into the 
active register.
00: Load on CTR = Zero: Time-base counter equal to zero (TBCTR = 
0x0000)
01: Load on CTR = PRD: Time-base counter equal to period (TBCTR 
= TBPRD)
10: Load on either CTR = Zero or CTR = PRD
11: Reserved；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SELOUTB
Fields.Description: EPWMB 输出 选择 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：EPWMxB 输出 选择 位 此 位 选择 which 信号 为 输出 开启 ePWMxB 通道 输出. 反相 will take 高 分辨率 模式 进入 account 及 反相 信号 will contain any 高 分辨率 modification. 反相 takes place 作为 最后 step 中 modifying ePWMxB 信号. 0: ePWMxB 输出 为 normal. 1: ePWMxB 输出 为 反相 version 的 ePWMxA 信号.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5 EPWMB Output Selection Bit；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2031页；原文字段表：EPWMxB Output Select Bit

This bit selects which signal is output on the ePWMxB channel 
output.
The inversion will take the high resolution mode into account and 
the inverted signal will contain any high resolution modification. The 
inversion takes place as the last step in modifying the ePWMxB 
signal.
0: ePWMxB output is normal.
1: ePWMxB output is inverted version of ePWMxA signal.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: AUTOCONV
Fields.Description: Autoconversion 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：自动 Convert 延迟 线路 数值 选择 是否 小数 占空 cycle/period/phase 中 CMPAHR/TBPRDHR/TBPHSHR 寄存器 为 automatically scaled 通过 MEP scale factor 中 HRMSTEP 寄存器 或 manually scaled 通过 calculations 中 application 软件. SFO library 功能 automatically updates HRMSTEP 寄存器 带 appropriate MEP scale factor. 0: 自动 HRMSTEP scaling 为 已禁用. 1: 自动 HRMSTEP scaling 为 已使能. 如果 application 软件 为 manually scaling 小数 占空 周期, 或 相位 (i.e. 软件 设置 CMPAHR = (fraction(PWMduty * PWMperiod) * MEP Scale Factor)<<8 + 0x080 用于 占空 周期), then 此 模式 must be 已禁用.
Fields.Notes:
原文：6 Autoconversion Bit；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2031页；原文字段表：Auto Convert Delay Line Value

Selects whether the fractional duty cycle/period/phase in the 
CMPAHR/TBPRDHR/TBPHSHR register is automatically scaled by 
the MEP scale factor in the HRMSTEP register or manually scaled 
by calculations in application software. The SFO library function 
automatically updates the HRMSTEP register with the appropriate 
MEP scale factor.
0: Automatic HRMSTEP scaling is disabled.
1: Automatic HRMSTEP scaling is enabled.
If application software is manually scaling the fractional duty cycle, 
or phase (i.e. software sets CMPAHR = (fraction(PWMduty * 
PWMperiod) * MEP Scale Factor)<<8 + 0x080 for duty cycle), then 
this mode must be disabled.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Notes:
原文：7 Swap EPWMA and EPWMB Outputs Bit；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2030页；原文字段表：Swap ePWM A & B Output Signals

This bit enables the swapping of the A & B signal outputs. The 
selection is as follows:
0: ePWMxA and ePWMxB outputs are unchanged.
1: ePWMxA signal appears on ePWMxB output and ePWMxB signal 
appears on ePWMxA output.

Fields.Name: TBPHSHRLOADE
Fields.Description: TBPHSHR 加载 使能
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：TBPHSHR 加载 使能 此 位 allows you 至 synchronize ePWM modules 带 高- 分辨率 相位 开启 同步输入, TBCTL[SWFSYNC] 或 数字 比较 事件. 此 allows 用于 multiple ePWM modules 工作 在 same 频率 至 be 相位 aligned 带 high-resolution. 0: 禁用 同步 的 high-resolution 相位 开启 同步输入, TBCTL[SWFSYNC] 或 数字 比较 事件: 1: Synchronize high-resolution 相位 开启 同步输入, TBCTL[SWFSYNC] 或 数字 比较器 同步 事件. 相位 为 synchronized using 内容 的 high-resolution 相位 TBPHSHR 寄存器. TBCTL[PHSEN] 位 which 使能 loading 的 TBCTR 寄存器 带 TBPHS 寄存器 值 开启 同步输入 或 TBCTL[SWFSYNC] 事件 works independently. However, users need 至 使能 此 位 also 如果 they want 至 控制 相位 中 conjunction 带 high-resolution 周期 feature. 此 位 及 TBCTL[PHSEN] 位 must be 置位 至 1 当 high-resolution 周期 为 已使能 用于 up-down 计数 模式 even 如果 TBPHSHR = 0x0000. 此 位 does 不 need 至 be 置位 当 仅 high-resolution 占空 为 已使能.
Fields.Notes:
原文：2 TBPHSHR Load Enable；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2035页；原文字段表：TBPHSHR Load Enable

This bit allows you to synchronize ePWM modules with a high-
resolution phase on a SYNCIN, TBCTL[SWFSYNC] or digital 
compare event. This allows for multiple ePWM modules operating 
at the same frequency to be phase aligned with high-resolution.
0: Disables synchronization of high-resolution phase on a SYNCIN, 
TBCTL[SWFSYNC] or digital compare event:
1: Synchronize the high-resolution phase on a SYNCIN, 
TBCTL[SWFSYNC] or digital comparator synchronization event. The 
phase is synchronized using the contents of the high-resolution 
phase TBPHSHR register. The TBCTL[PHSEN] bit which enables 
the loading of the TBCTR register with TBPHS register value 
on a SYNCIN or TBCTL[SWFSYNC] event works independently. 
However, users need to enable this bit also if they want to control 
phase in conjunction with the high-resolution period feature.
This bit and the TBCTL[PHSEN] bit must be set to 1 when 
high-resolution period is enabled for up-down count mode even if 
TBPHSHR = 0x0000. This bit does not need to be set when only 
high-resolution duty is enabled.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Description: HRPWM 余数 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：HRPWM 余数 位: 此 11-位 值 keeps track 的 余数 portion 的 HRPWM algorithm calculations. 此 值 keeps track 的 余数 portion 的 HRPWM 硬件 calculations. Notes: 1. 低位 8-位 的 TRREM 寄存器 CAN be automatically initialized 带 TBPHSHR 值 开启 同步输入 或 TBCTL[SWFSYNC] 事件 或 DC 事件 (如果 已使能). user CAN also 写入 值 带 CPU. 2. 优先级 的 TRREM 寄存器 updates: 同步 (软件 或 硬件) TBPHSHR copied 至 TRREM : Highest 优先级 HRPWM 硬件 (updates TRREM 寄存器): 下次 优先级 CPU 写入 至 TRREM 寄存器: Lowest 优先级 3. 位 10 的 TRREM 寄存器 为 不 使用 中 asymmetrical 模式. 此 位 CAN be forced 至 零. TRREM will be initialized 至 0x0 及 0x100 中 上升 及 Up-down modes respectively. Asymmetrical 模式: TRREM[7:0] = TBPHSHR[15:8] TRREM[10,9,8] = 0,0,0 Symmetrical 模式: TRREM[7:0] = TBPHSHR[15:8] TRREM[10,9,8] = 0,0,1
Fields.Notes:
原文：10:0 HRPWM Remainder Bits；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2037页；原文字段表：HRPWM Remainder Bits: This 11-bit value keeps track of the 

remainder portion of the HRPWM algorithm calculations.
This value keeps track of the remainder portion of the HRPWM 
hardware calculations.
Notes:
1. The lower 8-bits of the TRREM register can be automatically 
initialized with the TBPHSHR value on a SYNCIN or 
TBCTL[SWFSYNC] event or DC event (if enabled). The user can 
also write a value with the CPU.
2. Priority of TRREM register updates:
Sync (software or hardware) TBPHSHR copied to TRREM : Highest 
Priority
HRPWM Hardware (updates TRREM register): Next priority
CPU Write To TRREM Register: Lowest Priority
3. Bit 10 of TRREM register is not used in asymmetrical mode. This 
bit can be forced to zero.
TRREM will be initialized to 0x0 and 0x100 in Up and Up-down 
modes respectively.
Asymmetrical Mode:
TRREM[7:0] = TBPHSHR[15:8]
TRREM[10,9,8] = 0,0,0
Symmetrical Mode:
TRREM[7:0] = TBPHSHR[15:8]
TRREM[10,9,8] = 0,0,1；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：全局 加载 脉冲 选择 用于 影子 至 活动 模式 Reloads 0000: 加载 开启 计数器 = 0 (计数_ZRO) 0001: 加载 开启 计数器 = 周期 (PRD_EQ) 0010: 加载 开启 either 计数器 = 0, 或 计数器 = 周期 0011: 加载 开启 SYNCEVT - 此 为 logical 或 的 DCAEVT1.同步, DCBEVT1.同步, EPWMxSYNCI 及 TBCTL[SWFSYNC] 0100: 加载 开启 SYNCEVT 或 计数_ZRO 0101: 加载 开启 SYNCEVT 或 PRD_EQ 0110: 加载 开启 SYNCEVT 或 计数_ZRO 或 PRD_EQ 1000: 保留位 ... 1110: 保留位 1111: 加载 开启 GLDCTL2[GFRCLD] 写入
Fields.Notes:
原文：4:1 Shadow to Active Global Load Pulse Selection；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2039页；原文字段表：Global Load Pulse selection for Shadow to Active Mode Reloads

0000: Load on Counter = 0 (CNT_ZRO)
0001: Load on Counter = Period (PRD_EQ)

原文：31:16 Phase Offset Register；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2056页；原文字段表：Phase Offset Register

These bits set time-base counter phase of the selected ePWM 
relative to the time-base that is supplying the synchronization input 
signal.

and the time-base counter is not loaded with the phase.
- If TBCTL[PHSEN] = 1, then the time-base counter (TBCTR) will 
be loaded with the phase (TBPHS) when a synchronization event 
occurs. The synchronization event can be initiated by the input 
synchronization signal (EPWMxSYNCI) or by a software forced 
synchronization.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TBPRD
Fields.Description: 时基周期计数值。
Fields.Values: 向上/向下计数：频率=TBCLK/(TBPRD+1)；上下计数：频率=TBCLK/(2×TBPRD)。
Fields.Notes:
原文：Time Base Period Register；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2058页；原文字段表：Time Base Period Register

These bits determine the period of the time-base counter. This 
sets the PWM frequency. Shadowing of this register is enabled 
and disabled by the TBCTL[PRDLD] bit. By default this register is 
shadowed.
- If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write 
or read will automatically go to the shadow register. In this case, 
the active register will be loaded from the shadow register when the 
time-base counter equals zero.
- If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 1, then the shadow is disabled and any write or 
read will go directly to the active register, that is the register actively 
controlling the hardware.
- The active and shadow registers share the same memory map 
address.

These actions CAN be applied 至 either EPWMxA 或 EPWMxB 输出 depending 开启 配置 的 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器. actions that CAN be defined 中 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器 include: - 执行 nothing 事件 为 忽略. - 清除: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 低 - 置位: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 高 - 翻转 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 Shadowing 的 此 寄存器 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. - 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能 及 any 写入 或 读取 will automatically go 至 影子 寄存器. 中 此 case, CMPCTL[LOADAMODE] 位 field 决定 which 事件 will 加载 活动 寄存器 来自 影子 寄存器. - Before 写入, CMPCTL[SHDWAFULL] 位 CAN be 读取 至 determine 如果 影子 寄存器 为 currently 满. - 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用 及 any 写入 或 读取 will go directly 至 活动 寄存器, that 为 寄存器 actively controlling 硬件. - 中 either 模式, 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：31:16 Compare A Register；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2059页；原文字段表：Compare A Register

The value in the active CMPA register is continuously compared to 
the time-base counter (TBCTR). When the values are equal, the 
counter-compare module generates a 'time-base counter equal to 
counter compare A' event. This event is sent to the action-qualifier 
where it is qualified and converted it into one or more actions. 
These actions can be applied to either the EPWMxA or the EPWMxB 
output depending on the configuration of the AQCTLA and AQCTLB 
registers. The actions that can be defined in the AQCTLA and 
AQCTLB registers include:
- Do nothing
the event is ignored.
- Clear: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal low
- Set: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal high
- Toggle the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the 
CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] bit. By default this register is shadowed.
- If CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and 
any write or read will automatically go to the shadow register. In this 
case, the CMPCTL[LOADAMODE] bit field determines which event 
will load the active register from the shadow register.
- Before a write, the CMPCTL[SHDWAFULL] bit can be read to 
determine if the shadow register is currently full.
- If CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is 
disabled and any write or read will go directly to the active register, 
that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
- In either mode, the active and shadow registers share the same 
memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TZA
Fields.Description: TZ1 至 TZ6 跳闸 动作 开启 EPWMxA
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：TZ1 至 TZ6, DCAEVT1/2, DCBEVT1/2 跳闸 动作 开启 EPWMxA 当 跳闸 事件 发生 following 动作 为 taken 开启 输出 EPWMxA. Which 跳闸保护 引脚 CAN cause 事件 为 defined 中 TZSEL 寄存器. 00: High-impedance (EPWMxA = High-impedance 状态) 01: 强制 EPWMxA 至 高 状态 10: 强制 EPWMxA 至 低 状态 11: 执行 nothing, no 动作 为 taken 开启 EPWMxA.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0 TZ1 to TZ6 Trip Action On EPWMxA；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2069页；原文字段表：TZ1 to TZ6, DCAEVT1/2, DCBEVT1/2 Trip Action On EPWMxA

When a trip event occurs the following action is taken on output 
EPWMxA. Which trip-zone pins can cause an event is defined in the 
TZSEL register.
00: High-impedance (EPWMxA = High-impedance state)
01: Force EPWMxA to a high state
10: Force EPWMxA to a low state
11: Do nothing, no action is taken on EPWMxA.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INT
