Fields.Name: HRMSTEP
Fields.Description: 高位 分辨率 Micro Step 数值
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：高位 分辨率 MEP Step 当 自动转换 为 已使能 (HRCNFG[AUTOCONV] = 1), 此 8-位 field 包含 MEP_ScaleFactor (数量 的 MEP steps per coarse steps) 使用 通过 硬件 至 automatically convert 值 中 CMPAHR, CMPBHR, DBFEDHR, DBREDHR , TBPHSHR, 或 TBPRDHR 寄存器 至 scaled micro-edge 延迟 开启 high-resolution ePWM 输出. 值 中 此 寄存器 为 written 通过 SFO 校准 软件 在 end 的 每个 校准 run.
Fields.Notes:
原文：7:0 High Resolution Micro Step Value；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2033页；原文字段表：High Resolution MEP Step

When auto-conversion is enabled (HRCNFG[AUTOCONV] = 1), This 
8-bit field contains the MEP_ScaleFactor (number of MEP steps 
per coarse steps) used by the hardware to automatically convert 
the value in the CMPAHR, CMPBHR, DBFEDHR, DBREDHR , 
TBPHSHR, or TBPRDHR register to a scaled micro-edge delay on 
the high-resolution ePWM output. The value in this register is written 
by the SFO calibration software at the end of each calibration run.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TBPHSHRLOADE
Fields.Description: TBPHSHR 加载 使能
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：TBPHSHR 加载 使能 此 位 allows you 至 synchronize ePWM modules 带 高- 分辨率 相位 开启 同步输入, TBCTL[SWFSYNC] 或 数字 比较 事件. 此 allows 用于 multiple ePWM modules 工作 在 same 频率 至 be 相位 aligned 带 high-resolution. 0: 禁用 同步 的 high-resolution 相位 开启 同步输入, TBCTL[SWFSYNC] 或 数字 比较 事件: 1: Synchronize high-resolution 相位 开启 同步输入, TBCTL[SWFSYNC] 或 数字 比较器 同步 事件. 相位 为 synchronized using 内容 的 high-resolution 相位 TBPHSHR 寄存器. TBCTL[PHSEN] 位 which 使能 loading 的 TBCTR 寄存器 带 TBPHS 寄存器 值 开启 同步输入 或 TBCTL[SWFSYNC] 事件 works independently. However, users need 至 使能 此 位 also 如果 they want 至 控制 相位 中 conjunction 带 high-resolution 周期 feature. 此 位 及 TBCTL[PHSEN] 位 must be 置位 至 1 当 high-resolution 周期 为 已使能 用于 up-down 计数 模式 even 如果 TBPHSHR = 0x0000. 此 位 does 不 need 至 be 置位 当 仅 high-resolution 占空 为 已使能.
Fields.Notes:
原文：2 TBPHSHR Load Enable；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2035页；原文字段表：TBPHSHR Load Enable

This bit allows you to synchronize ePWM modules with a high-
resolution phase on a SYNCIN, TBCTL[SWFSYNC] or digital 
compare event. This allows for multiple ePWM modules operating 
at the same frequency to be phase aligned with high-resolution.
0: Disables synchronization of high-resolution phase on a SYNCIN, 
TBCTL[SWFSYNC] or digital compare event:
1: Synchronize the high-resolution phase on a SYNCIN, 
TBCTL[SWFSYNC] or digital comparator synchronization event. The 
phase is synchronized using the contents of the high-resolution 
phase TBPHSHR register. The TBCTL[PHSEN] bit which enables 
the loading of the TBCTR register with TBPHS register value 
on a SYNCIN or TBCTL[SWFSYNC] event works independently. 
However, users need to enable this bit also if they want to control 
phase in conjunction with the high-resolution period feature.
This bit and the TBCTL[PHSEN] bit must be set to 1 when 
high-resolution period is enabled for up-down count mode even if 
TBPHSHR = 0x0000. This bit does not need to be set when only 
high-resolution duty is enabled.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：HRPWM 余数 位: 此 11-位 值 keeps track 的 余数 portion 的 HRPWM algorithm calculations. 此 值 keeps track 的 余数 portion 的 HRPWM 硬件 calculations. Notes: 1. 低位 8-位 的 TRREM 寄存器 CAN be automatically initialized 带 TBPHSHR 值 开启 同步输入 或 TBCTL[SWFSYNC] 事件 或 DC 事件 (如果 已使能). user CAN also 写入 值 带 CPU. 2. 优先级 的 TRREM 寄存器 updates: 同步 (软件 或 硬件) TBPHSHR copied 至 TRREM : Highest 优先级 HRPWM 硬件 (updates TRREM 寄存器): 下次 优先级 CPU 写入 至 TRREM 寄存器: Lowest 优先级 3. 位 10 的 TRREM 寄存器 为 不 使用 中 asymmetrical 模式. 此 位 CAN be forced 至 零. TRREM will be initialized 至 0x0 及 0x100 中 上升 及 Up-down modes respectively. Asymmetrical 模式: TRREM[7:0] = TBPHSHR[15:8] TRREM[10,9,8] = 0,0,0 Symmetrical 模式: TRREM[7:0] = TBPHSHR[15:8] TRREM[10,9,8] = 0,0,1
Fields.Notes:
原文：10:0 HRPWM Remainder Bits；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2037页；原文字段表：HRPWM Remainder Bits: This 11-bit value keeps track of the 

remainder portion of the HRPWM algorithm calculations.
This value keeps track of the remainder portion of the HRPWM 
hardware calculations.
Notes:
1. The lower 8-bits of the TRREM register can be automatically 
initialized with the TBPHSHR value on a SYNCIN or 
TBCTL[SWFSYNC] event or DC event (if enabled). The user can 
also write a value with the CPU.
2. Priority of TRREM register updates:
Sync (software or hardware) TBPHSHR copied to TRREM : Highest 
Priority
HRPWM Hardware (updates TRREM register): Next priority
CPU Write To TRREM Register: Lowest Priority
3. Bit 10 of TRREM register is not used in asymmetrical mode. This 
bit can be forced to zero.
TRREM will be initialized to 0x0 and 0x100 in Up and Up-down 
modes respectively.
Asymmetrical Mode:
TRREM[7:0] = TBPHSHR[15:8]
TRREM[10,9,8] = 0,0,0
Symmetrical Mode:
TRREM[7:0] = TBPHSHR[15:8]
TRREM[10,9,8] = 0,0,1；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TBPHS
Fields.Description: 相位 偏移 寄存器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：相位 偏移 寄存器 These 位 置位 时基 计数器 相位 的 已选 ePWM relative 至 时基 that 为 supplying 同步 输入 信号. - 如果 TBCTL[PHSEN] = 0, then 同步 事件 为 忽略 及 时基 计数器 为 不 loaded 带 相位. - 如果 TBCTL[PHSEN] = 1, then 时基 计数器 (TBCTR) will be loaded 带 相位 (TBPHS) 当 同步 事件 发生. 同步 事件 CAN be initiated 通过 输入 同步 信号 (EPWMxSYNCI) 或 通过 软件 forced 同步.
Fields.Notes:
原文：31:16 Phase Offset Register；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2056页；原文字段表：Phase Offset Register

These bits set time-base counter phase of the selected ePWM 
relative to the time-base that is supplying the synchronization input 
signal.
- If TBCTL[PHSEN] = 0, then the synchronization event is ignored 
and the time-base counter is not loaded with the phase.
- If TBCTL[PHSEN] = 1, then the time-base counter (TBCTR) will 
be loaded with the phase (TBPHS) when a synchronization event 
occurs. The synchronization event can be initiated by the input 
synchronization signal (EPWMxSYNCI) or by a software forced 
synchronization.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Likewise writes are also 至 影子 寄存器. TBPRDHR 寄存器 为 仅 使用 当 高 分辨率 周期 feature 为 已使能. 此 寄存器 为 仅 available 带 ePWM modules which support high-resolution 周期 控制. 低位 8 位 中 此 寄存器 are 忽略 - writes are 忽略 及 reads return 零
Fields.Notes:
原文：Time Base Period High Resolution Register；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2057页；原文字段表：Period High Resolution Bits

The upper 8-bits contain the high-resolution portion of the period 
value. The TBPRDHR register is not affected by the TBCTL[PRDLD] 
bit. Reads from this register always reflect the shadow register. 
Likewise writes are also to the shadow register. The TBPRDHR 
register is only used when the high resolution period feature is 
enabled. This register is only available with ePWM modules which 
support high-resolution period control.
The lower 8 bits in this register are ignored - writes are ignored and 
reads return zero；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TBPRD
Fields.Description: 时基周期计数值。
Fields.Values: 向上/向下计数：频率=TBCLK/(TBPRD+1)；上下计数：频率=TBCLK/(2×TBPRD)。
Fields.Notes:
原文：Time Base Period Register；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2058页；原文字段表：Time Base Period Register

These bits determine the period of the time-base counter. This 
sets the PWM frequency. Shadowing of this register is enabled 
and disabled by the TBCTL[PRDLD] bit. By default this register is 
shadowed.
- If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and any write 
or read will automatically go to the shadow register. In this case, 
the active register will be loaded from the shadow register when the 
time-base counter equals zero.
- If TBCTL[PRDLD] = 1, then the shadow is disabled and any write or 
read will go directly to the active register, that is the register actively 
controlling the hardware.
- The active and shadow registers share the same memory map 
address.
Enhanced Pulse Width Modulator (ePWM)

Fields.Name: CMPA
Fields.Description: 比较 寄存器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：比较 寄存器 值 中 活动 CMPA 寄存器 为 continuously compared 至 时基 计数器 (TBCTR). 当 values are equal, counter-compare 模块 产生 '时基 计数器 equal 至 计数器 比较 ' 事件. 此 事件 为 sent 至 action-qualifier where it 为 限定后 及 converted it 进入 单次 或 more actions. These actions CAN be applied 至 either EPWMxA 或 EPWMxB 输出 depending 开启 配置 的 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器. actions that CAN be defined 中 AQCTLA 及 AQCTLB 寄存器 include: - 执行 nothing 事件 为 忽略. - 清除: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 低 - 置位: 上拉 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 高 - 翻转 EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB 信号 Shadowing 的 此 寄存器 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. - 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能 及 any 写入 或 读取 will automatically go 至 影子 寄存器. 中 此 case, CMPCTL[LOADAMODE] 位 field 决定 which 事件 will 加载 活动 寄存器 来自 影子 寄存器. - Before 写入, CMPCTL[SHDWAFULL] 位 CAN be 读取 至 determine 如果 影子 寄存器 为 currently 满. - 如果 CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用 及 any 写入 或 读取 will go directly 至 活动 寄存器, that 为 寄存器 actively controlling 硬件. - 中 either 模式, 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：31:16 Compare A Register；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2059页；原文字段表：Compare A Register

The value in the active CMPA register is continuously compared to 
the time-base counter (TBCTR). When the values are equal, the 
counter-compare module generates a 'time-base counter equal to 
counter compare A' event. This event is sent to the action-qualifier 
where it is qualified and converted it into one or more actions. 
These actions can be applied to either the EPWMxA or the EPWMxB 
output depending on the configuration of the AQCTLA and AQCTLB 
registers. The actions that can be defined in the AQCTLA and 
AQCTLB registers include:
- Do nothing
the event is ignored.
- Clear: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal low
- Set: Pull the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal high
- Toggle the EPWMxA and/or EPWMxB signal
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the 
CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] bit. By default this register is shadowed.
- If CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and 
any write or read will automatically go to the shadow register. In this 
case, the CMPCTL[LOADAMODE] bit field determines which event 
will load the active register from the shadow register.
- Before a write, the CMPCTL[SHDWAFULL] bit can be read to 
determine if the shadow register is currently full.
- If CMPCTL[SHDWAMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is 
disabled and any write or read will go directly to the active register, 
that is the register actively controlling the hardware.
- In either mode, the active and shadow registers share the same 
memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CMPC
Fields.Description: 计数器 比较 C 寄存器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：比较 C 寄存器 值 中 活动 CMPC 寄存器 为 continuously compared 至 时基 计数器 (TBCTR). 当 values are equal, counter-compare 模块 产生 '时基 计数器 equal 至 计数器 比较 C' 事件. Shadowing 的 此 寄存器 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 CMPCTL2[SHDWCMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. - 如果 CMPCTL2[SHDWCMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能 及 any 写入 或 读取 will automatically go 至 影子 寄存器. 中 此 case, CMPCTL2[LOADCMODE] 位 field 决定 which 事件 will 加载 活动 寄存器 来自 影子 寄存器: - 如果 CMPCTL2[SHDWCMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用 及 any 写入 或 读取 will go directly 至 活动 寄存器 that 为, 寄存器 actively controlling 硬件. - 中 either 模式, 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址.
Fields.Notes:
原文：Counter Compare C Register；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2061页；原文字段表：Compare C Register

The value in the active CMPC register is continuously compared 
to the time-base counter (TBCTR). When the values are equal, the 
counter-compare module generates a 'time-base counter equal to 
counter compare C' event.
Shadowing of this register is enabled and disabled by the 
CMPCTL2[SHDWCMODE] bit. By default this register is shadowed.
- If CMPCTL2[SHDWCMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled and 
any write or read will automatically go to the shadow register. In this 
case, the CMPCTL2[LOADCMODE] bit field determines which event 
will load the active register from the shadow register:
- If CMPCTL2[SHDWCMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is 
disabled and any write or read will go directly to the active register
that is, the register actively controlling the hardware.
- In either mode, the active and shadow registers share the same 
memory map address.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OSHTLD
Fields.Description: 使能 重装载 事件 中 单次 触发 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：R-0/W1S 0h 使能 重装载 事件 中 单次 触发 模式 0: Writing 的 0 will be 忽略. Always reads back 0. 1: Turns 单次 触发 锁存 条件 开启. Upon occurrence 的 chosen 加载 选通, 单次 影子 至 活动 重装载 发生 及 锁存 will be cleared. Hence writing 1 至 此 位 would allow 单次 加载 选通 事件 至 pass through 及 模块 further 选通 events.
Fields.Notes:
原文：0 Enable reload event in one shot mode；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2063页；原文字段表：R-0/W1S 0h Enable Reload Event in One Shot Mode

0: Writing of 0 will be ignored. Always reads back a 0.
1: Turns the one shot latch condition ON. Upon occurrence of a 
chosen load strobe, one shadow to active reload occurs and the 
latch will be cleared. Hence writing 1 to this bit would allow one load 
strobe event to pass through and block further strobe events.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: GFRCLD
Fields.Description: 强制 重装载 事件 中 单次 触发 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：R-0/W1S 0h 强制 加载 事件 中 单次 触发 模式 0: Writing 的 0 will be 忽略. Always reads back 0. 1: 强制 单次 加载 事件 在 输入 的 事件 预分频 计数器. 此 位 为 intended 至 be 使用 用于 testing and/or 软件 强制 loading 的 events 中 全局 加载 模式.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1 Force reload event in one shot mode；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2063页；原文字段表：R-0/W1S 0h Force Load Event in One Shot Mode

0: Writing of 0 will be ignored. Always reads back a 0.
1: Force one load event at the input of the event pre-scale counter. 
This bit is intended to be used for testing and/or software force 
loading of the events in global load mode.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

原文：1:0 TZ1 to TZ6 Trip Action On EPWMxA；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2069页；原文字段表：TZ1 to TZ6, DCAEVT1/2, DCBEVT1/2 Trip Action On EPWMxA

When a trip event occurs the following action is taken on output 
EPWMxA. Which trip-zone pins can cause an event is defined in the 
TZSEL register.
00: High-impedance (EPWMxA = High-impedance state)
01: Force EPWMxA to a high state
10: Force EPWMxA to a low state
11: Do nothing, no action is taken on EPWMxA.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INT
Fields.Description: 全局 中断 状态 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：锁存 跳闸 中断 状态 标志 0: 表示 no 中断 has been 已产生. 1: 表示 ePWMx_TZINT PIE 中断 was 已产生 because 的 跳闸 条件. No further ePWMx_TZINT PIE 中断 will be 已产生 until 此 标志 为 cleared. 如果 中断 标志 为 cleared 当 either CBC 或 OST 为 置位, then another 中断 脉冲 will be 已产生. Clearing 全部 标志 位 will prevent further 中断. 此 位 为 cleared 通过 writing appropriate 值 至 TZCLR 寄存器. Enhanced 脉冲 宽度 Modulator (ePWM) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：0 Global Int Status Flag；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2078页；原文字段表：Latched Trip Interrupt Status Flag

0: Indicates no interrupt has been generated.
1: Indicates an EPWMx_TZINT PIE interrupt was generated because 
of a trip condition.
No further EPWMx_TZINT PIE interrupts will be generated until this 
flag is cleared. If the interrupt flag is cleared when either CBC or 
OST is set, then another interrupt pulse will be generated. Clearing 
all flag bits will prevent further interrupts. This bit is cleared by writing 
the appropriate value to the TZCLR register.
Enhanced Pulse Width Modulator (ePWM)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CBC
Fields.Description: 跳闸 区域 周期 通过 周期 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：锁存 状态 标志 用于 逐周期 跳闸 事件 0: No 逐周期 跳闸 事件 has occurred. 1: 表示 跳闸 事件 has occurred 开启 信号 已选 作为 逐周期 跳闸 来源. TZFLG[CBC] 位 will remain 置位 until it 为 manually cleared 通过 user. 如果 逐周期 跳闸 事件 为 still present 当 CBC 位 为 cleared, then CBC will be immediately 置位 again. specified 条件 开启 信号 为 automatically cleared 当 ePWM 时基 计数器 reaches 零 (TBCTR = 0x00) 如果 跳闸 条件 为 no longer present. 条件 开启 信号 为 仅 cleared 当 TBCTR = 0x00 no matter where 中 周期 CBC 标志 为 cleared. 此 位 为 cleared 通过 writing appropriate 值 至 TZCLR 寄存器.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1 Trip Zones Cycle By Cycle Flag；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2078页；原文字段表：Latched Status Flag for Cycle-By-Cycle Trip Event

0: No cycle-by-cycle trip event has occurred.
1: Indicates a trip event has occurred on a signal selected as a 
cycle-by-cycle trip source. The
TZFLG[CBC] bit will remain set until it is manually cleared by the 
user. If the cycle-by-cycle trip event is still present when the CBC 
bit is cleared, then CBC will be immediately set again. The specified 
condition on the signal is automatically cleared when the ePWM 
time-base counter reaches zero (TBCTR = 0x00) if the trip condition 
is no longer present. The condition on the signal is only cleared 
when the TBCTR = 0x00 no matter where in the cycle the CBC flag 
is cleared.
This bit is cleared by writing the appropriate value to the TZCLR 
register.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: CBCPULSE
Fields.Description: 清除 脉冲 用于 CBC 跳闸 锁存
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：清除 脉冲 用于 逐周期 (CBC) 跳闸 锁存 此 位 field 决定 which 脉冲 clears CBC 跳闸 锁存. 00: CTR = 零 脉冲 clears CBC 跳闸 锁存. (Same 作为 legacy designs.) 01: CTR = PRD 脉冲 clears CBC 跳闸 锁存. 10: CTR = 零 或 CTR = PRD 脉冲 clears CBC 跳闸 锁存. 11: CBC 跳闸 锁存 为 不 cleared
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:14 Clear Pulse for CBC Trip Latch；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2083页；原文字段表：Clear Pulse for Cycle-By-Cycle (CBC) Trip Latch

This bit field determines which pulse clears the CBC trip latch.
00: CTR = zero pulse clears CBC trip latch. (Same as legacy 
designs.)
01: CTR = PRD pulse clears CBC trip latch.
10: CTR = zero or CTR = PRD pulse clears CBC trip latch.
11: CBC trip latch is not cleared；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INTPRD
Fields.Description: EPWMxINTn 周期 选择
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ePWM 中断 (ePWMx_中断) 周期 选择 These 位 determine how many 已选 ETSEL[INTSEL] events need 至 occur before 中断 为 已产生. 至 be 已产生, 中断 must be 已使能 (ETSEL[中断] = 1). 如果 中断 状态 标志 为 置位 来自 前次 中断 (ETFLG[中断] = 1) then no 中断 will be 已产生 until 标志 为 cleared via ETCLR[中断] 位. 此 allows 用于 单次 中断 至 be 待处理 期间 another 为 still being serviced. Once 中断 为 已产生, ETPS[INTCNT] 位 will automatically be cleared. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 same 作为 当前 计数器 值 will 触发 中断 如果 it 为 已使能 及 状态 标志 为 清除. Writing INTPRD 值 that 为 less than 当前 计数器 值 will 结果 中 undefined 状态. 如果 计数器 事件 发生 在 same instant 作为 new 零 或 non-zero INTPRD 值 为 written, 计数器 为 incremented. 00: 禁用 中断 事件 计数器. No 中断 will be 已产生 及 ETFRC[中断] 为 忽略. 01: 产生 中断 开启 首个 事件 INTCNT = 01 (首个 事件) 10: 产生 中断 开启 ETPS[INTCNT] = 1,0 (second 事件) 11: 产生 中断 开启 ETPS[INTCNT] = 1,1 (third 事件)
Fields.Notes:
原文：1:0 EPWMxINTn Period Select；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2093页；原文字段表：ePWM Interrupt (EPWMx_INT) Period Select

These bits determine how many selected ETSEL[INTSEL] events 
need to occur before an interrupt is generated. To be generated, 
the interrupt must be enabled (ETSEL[INT] = 1). If the interrupt 
status flag is set from a previous interrupt (ETFLG[INT] = 1) then 
no interrupt will be generated until the flag is cleared via the 
ETCLR[INT] bit. This allows for one interrupt to be pending while 
another is still being serviced. Once the interrupt is generated, the 
ETPS[INTCNT] bits will automatically be cleared.
Writing a INTPRD value that is the same as the current counter value 
will trigger an interrupt if it is enabled and the status flag is clear.
Writing a INTPRD value that is less than the current counter value 
will result in an undefined state. If a counter event occurs at the 
same instant as a new zero or non-zero INTPRD value is written, the 
counter is incremented.
00: Disable the interrupt event counter. No interrupt will be generated 
and ETFRC[INT] is ignored.
01: Generate an interrupt on the first event INTCNT = 01 (first event)
10: Generate interrupt on ETPS[INTCNT] = 1,0 (second event)
11: Generate interrupt on ETPS[INTCNT] = 1,1 (third event)；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INTCNT
Fields.Description: EPWMxINTn 计数器 寄存器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：ePWM 中断 事件 (ePWMx_中断) 计数器 寄存器 These 位 indicate how many 已选 ETSEL[INTSEL] events have occurred. These 位 are automatically cleared 当 中断 脉冲 为 已产生. 如果 中断 are 已禁用, ETSEL[中断] = 0 或 中断 标志 为 置位, ETFLG[中断] = 1, 计数器 will 停止 counting events 当 it reaches 周期 值 ETPS[INTCNT] = ETPS[INTPRD]. 00: No events have occurred. 01: 1 事件 has occurred. 10: 2 events have occurred. 11: 3 events have occurred. Enhanced 脉冲 宽度 Modulator (ePWM) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：3:2 EPWMxINTn Counter Register；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2092页；原文字段表：ePWM Interrupt Event (EPWMx_INT) Counter Register

These bits indicate how many selected ETSEL[INTSEL] events have 
occurred. These bits are automatically cleared when an interrupt 
pulse is generated. If interrupts are disabled, ETSEL[INT] = 0 or 
the interrupt flag is set, ETFLG[INT] = 1, the counter will stop 
counting events when it reaches the period value ETPS[INTCNT] 
= ETPS[INTPRD].
00: No events have occurred.
01: 1 event has occurred.
10: 2 events have occurred.
11: 3 events have occurred.

原文：3:0 EPWMxINTn Period Select；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2097页；原文字段表：EPWMxINT Period 2 Select

When ETPS[INTPSSEL] = 1, these bits select how many selected 
events need to occur before an interrupt is generated:
0000: Disable counter
0001: Generate interrupt on INTCNT = 1 (first event)
0010: Generate interrupt on INTCNT = 2 (second event)
0011: Generate interrupt on INTCNT = 3 (third event)
0100: Generate interrupt on INTCNT = 4 (fourth event)
...
1111: Generate interrupt on INTCNT = 15 (fifteenth event)；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：计数器 捕获 模式 0: 当 DCEVTFILT 发生 及 计数器 捕获 为 已使能, then 当前 TBCNT 值 为 captured 中 活动 寄存器. 当 respective 跳闸 事件 发生, further 跳闸 (捕获) events are 忽略 until 下次 PRD_eq 或 计数_零 事件 (作为 已选 通过 PULSESEL 位 中 DCFCTL 寄存器) re-triggers 捕获 mechanism. 如果 活动 模式 为 已使能, via SHDWMODE 位 中 DCCAPCTL 寄存器, CPU reads 的 此 寄存器 will return 活动 寄存器 值. 如果 影子 模式 为 已使能, via SHDWMODE 位 中 DCCAPCTL 寄存器, 活动 寄存器 为 copied 至 影子 寄存器 开启 PRD_eq 或 计数_零 事件 (whichever 为 已选 通过 PULSESEL 位 中 DCFCTL 寄存器). CPU reads 的 此 寄存器 will return 影子 寄存器 值. 1: 当 DCEVTFILT 发生 及 计数器 捕获 为 已使能, then 当前 TBCNT 值 为 captured 中 活动 寄存器. 当 respective 跳闸 事件 发生 - it will 置位 CAPSTS 标志 及 further 跳闸 (捕获) events are 忽略 until 此 位 为 cleared. CAPSTS CAN be cleared 通过 writing 至 CAPCLR 位 中 DCCAPCTL 寄存器 及 it re-triggers 捕获 mechanism. 如果 活动 模式 为 已使能, via SHDWMODE 位 中 DCCAPCTL 寄存器, CPU reads 的 此 寄存器 will return 活动 寄存器 值. 如果 影子 模式 为 已使能, via SHDWMODE 位 中 DCCAPCTL 寄存器, 活动 寄存器 为 copied 至 影子 寄存器 开启 PRD_eq 或 计数_零 事件 (whichever 为 已选 通过 PULSESEL 位 中 DCFCTL 寄存器). CPU reads 的 此 寄存器 will return 影子 寄存器 值.
Fields.Notes:
原文：15 Counter Capture Mode；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2108页；原文字段表：Counter Capture Mode

0: When a DCEVTFILT occurs and the counter capture is enabled, 
then the current TBCNT value is captured in the active register. 
When the respective trip event occurs, further trip (capture) events 
are ignored until the next PRD_eq or CNT_zero event (as selected 
by the PULSESEL bit in the DCFCTL register) re-triggers the capture 
mechanism.
If active mode is enabled, via SHDWMODE bit in DCCAPCTL 
register, CPU reads of this register will return the active register 
value.
If shadow mode is enabled, via SHDWMODE bit in DCCAPCTL 
register, the active register is copied to the shadow register on the 
PRD_eq or CNT_zero event (whichever is selected by PULSESEL 
bit in DCFCTL register). CPU reads of this register will return the 
shadow register value.
1: When a DCEVTFILT occurs and the counter capture is enabled, 
then the current TBCNT value is captured in the active register. 
When the respective trip event occurs - it will set the CAPSTS flag 
and further trip (capture) events are ignored until this bit is cleared. 
CAPSTS can be cleared by writing to CAPCLR bit in DCCAPCTL 
register and it re-triggers the capture mechanism.
If active mode is enabled, via SHDWMODE bit in DCCAPCTL 
register, CPU reads of this register will return the active register 
value.
If shadow mode is enabled, via SHDWMODE bit in DCCAPCTL 
register, the active register is copied to the shadow register on the 
PRD_eq or CNT_zero event (whichever is selected by PULSESEL 
bit in DCFCTL register). CPU reads of this register will return the 
shadow register value.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: DCFOFFSET
Fields.Description: 数字 比较 滤波器 偏移 寄存器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：消隐 窗口 偏移 These 16-位 specify 数量 的 TBCLK cycles 来自 消隐 窗口 参考 至 point 当 消隐 窗口 为 applied. 消隐 窗口 参考 为 either 周期 或 零 作为 defined 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. 此 偏移 寄存器 为 shadowed 及 活动 寄存器 为 loaded 在 参考 point defined 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL]. 偏移 计数器 为 also initialized 及 begins 至 计数 下降 当 活动 寄存器 为 loaded. 当 计数器 expires, 消隐 窗口 为 applied. 如果 消隐 窗口 为 currently 活动, then 消隐 窗口 计数器 为 restarted. Enhanced 脉冲 宽度 Modulator (ePWM) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：Digital Compare Filter Offset Register；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2110页；原文字段表：Blanking Window Offset

These 16-bits specify the number of TBCLK cycles from the blanking 
window reference to the point when the blanking window is applied. 
The blanking window reference is either period or zero as defined 
by the DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit. This offset register is shadowed 
and the active register is loaded at the reference point defined 
by DCFCTL[PULSESEL]. The offset counter is also initialized and 
begins to count down when the active register is loaded. When 
the counter expires, the blanking window is applied. If the blanking 
window is currently active, then the blanking window counter is 
restarted.
Enhanced Pulse Width Modulator (ePWM)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: DCFOFFSETCNT
Fields.Description: 数字 比较 滤波器 偏移 计数器 寄存器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：消隐 偏移 计数器 These 16-位 are 读取 仅 及 indicate 当前 值 的 偏移 计数器. 计数器 counts 下降 至 零 及 then stops until it 为 re-loaded 开启 下次 周期 或 零 事件 作为 defined 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. 偏移 计数器 为 不 affected 通过 自由/软暂停 仿真 位. That 为, it will always continue 至 计数 下降 如果 device 为 halted 通过 仿真 停止.
Fields.Notes:
原文：Digital Compare Filter Offset Counter Register；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2111页；原文字段表：Blanking Offset Counter

These 16-bits are read only and indicate the current value of the 
offset counter. The counter counts down to zero and then stops until 
it is re-loaded on the next period or zero event as defined by the 
DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit. The offset counter is not affected by the 
free/soft emulation bits. That is, it will always continue to count down 
if the device is halted by a emulation stop.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：消隐 窗口 宽度 00h: No 消隐 窗口 为 已产生. 01-FFFFh: 指定 宽度 的 消隐 窗口 中 TBCLK cycles. 消隐 窗口 begins 当 偏移 计数器 expires. 当 此 发生, 窗口 计数器 为 loaded 及 begins 至 计数 下降. 如果 消隐 窗口 为 currently 活动 及 偏移 计数器 expires, 消隐 窗口 计数器 为 不 restarted 及 消隐 窗口 为 cut short prematurely. Fields.Notes:
原文：Digital Compare Filter Window Register；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2112页；原文字段表：Blanking Window Width

00h: No blanking window is generated.
01-FFFFh: Specifies the width of the blanking window in TBCLK 
cycles. The blanking window begins when the offset counter expires. 
When this occurs, the window counter is loaded and begins to 
count down. If the blanking window is currently active and the offset 
counter expires, the blanking window counter is not restarted and the 
blanking window is cut short prematurely. Care should be taken to 
avoid this situation. The blanking window can cross a PWM period 
boundary.
Enhanced Pulse Width Modulator (ePWM)

Fields.Name: DCCAP
Fields.Description: 数字 比较 计数器 捕获 寄存器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：数字 比较 时基 计数器 捕获 至 使能 时基 计数器 捕获, 置位 DCCAPCLT[CAPE] 位 至 1. 如果 已使能, 反映 值 的 时基 计数器 (TBCTR) 开启 低 至 高 边沿 transition 的 filtered (DCEVTFLT) 事件. Further 捕获 events are 忽略 until 下次 周期 或 零 作为 已选 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. Shadowing 的 DCCAP 为 已使能 及 已禁用 通过 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] 位. 通过 默认 此 寄存器 为 shadowed. - 如果 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 0, then 影子 为 已使能. 中 此 模式, 活动 寄存器 为 copied 至 影子 寄存器 开启 TBCTR = TBPRD 或 TBCTR = 零 作为 defined 通过 DCFCTL[PULSESEL] 位. CPU reads 的 此 寄存器 will return 影子 寄存器 值. - 如果 DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 1, then 影子 寄存器 为 已禁用. 中 此 模式, CPU reads will return 活动 寄存器 值. 活动 及 影子 寄存器 share same memory map 地址. Enhanced 脉冲 宽度 Modulator (ePWM) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：Digital Compare Counter Capture Register；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2114页；原文字段表：Digital Compare Time-Base Counter Capture

To enable time-base counter capture, set the DCCAPCLT[CAPE] bit 
to 1. If enabled, reflects the value of the time-base counter (TBCTR) 
on the low to high edge transition of a filtered (DCEVTFLT) event. 
Further capture events are ignored until the next period or zero 
as selected by the DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit. Shadowing of DCCAP 
is enabled and disabled by the DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] bit. By 
default this register is shadowed.
- If DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 0, then the shadow is enabled. 
In this mode, the active register is copied to the shadow register 
on the TBCTR = TBPRD or TBCTR = zero as defined by the 
DCFCTL[PULSESEL] bit. CPU reads of this register will return the 
shadow register value.
- If DCCAPCTL[SHDWMODE] = 1, then the shadow register is 
disabled. In this mode, CPU reads will return the active register 
value. The active and shadow registers share the same memory 
map address.
Enhanced Pulse Width Modulator (ePWM)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

values are updated.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: ARBL
Fields.Description: Arbitration-lost 中断 标志 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Arbitration-lost 中断 标志 位 (仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 master-transmitter). ARBL primarily 表示 当 I2C 模块 has 丢失 仲裁 contest 带 another master/transmitter. CPU CAN poll ARBL 或 use ARBL 中断 请求. 0h (R/W) = 仲裁 不 丢失. AL 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - AL 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - CPU reads 中断 来源 寄存器 (I2CISRC) 及 寄存器 包含 编码 用于 AL 中断. 仿真器 reads 的 I2CISRC 执行 不 affect 此 位. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = 仲裁 丢失. AL 为 置位 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2C 模块 senses that it has 丢失 仲裁 带 two 或 more competing transmitters that started 发送 almost simultaneously. - I2C 模块 attempts 至 启动 transfer 期间 BB (总线 忙碌) 位 为 置位 至 1. 当 AL becomes 1, MST 及 STP 位 的 I2CMDR are cleared, 及 I2C 模块 becomes slave-receiver.
Fields.Notes:
原文：0 Arbitration-lost interrupt flag bit；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2401页；原文字段表：Arbitration-lost interrupt flag bit (only applicable when the I2C module 

is a master-transmitter).
ARBL primarily indicates when the I2C module has lost an arbitration 
contest with another master/transmitter. The CPU can poll ARBL or 
use the ARBL interrupt request.
0h (R/W) = Arbitration not lost. AL is cleared by any one of the 
following events:
- AL is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The CPU reads the interrupt source register (I2CISRC) and the 
register contains the code for an
AL interrupt. Emulator reads of the I2CISRC do not affect this bit.
- The I2C module is reset. 
1h (R/W) = Arbitration lost. AL is set by any one of the following 
events:
- The I2C module senses that it has lost an arbitration with two 
or more competing transmitters that started a transmission almost 
simultaneously.
- The I2C module attempts to start a transfer while the BB (bus busy) 
bit is set to 1.
When AL becomes 1, the MST and STP bits of I2CMDR are cleared, 
and the I2C module becomes a slave-receiver.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: NACK
Fields.Description: No-acknowledgment 中断 标志 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：No-acknowledgment 中断 标志 位. NACK applies 当 I2C 模块 为 主机 发送器. NACK 表示 是否 I2C 模块 has 已检测 应答 位 (ACK) 或 noacknowledge 位 (NACK) 来自 从机 接收器. CPU CAN poll NACK 或 use NACK 中断 请求. 0h (R/W) = ACK received/NACK 不 已接收. 此 位 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - 应答 位 (ACK) has been sent 通过 从机 接收器. - NACK 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - CPU reads 中断 来源 寄存器 (I2CISRC) 及 寄存器 包含 编码 用于 NACK 中断. 仿真器 reads 的 I2CISRC 执行 不 affect 此 位. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = NACK 位 已接收. 硬件 detects that no- 应答 (NACK) 位 has been 已接收. Note: 期间 I2C 模块 performs general call transfer, NACK 为 1, even 如果 单次 或 more slaves send acknowledgment.
Fields.Notes:
原文：1 No-acknowledgment interrupt flag bit.；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2401页；原文字段表：No-acknowledgment interrupt flag bit.

NACK applies when the I2C module is a master transmitter. NACK 
indicates whether the I2C module has detected an acknowledge bit 
(ACK) or a noacknowledge bit (NACK) from the slave receiver. The 
CPU can poll NACK or use the NACK interrupt request.
0h (R/W) = ACK received/NACK not received. This bit is cleared by 
any one of the following events:
- An acknowledge bit (ACK) has been sent by the slave receiver.
- NACK is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The CPU reads the interrupt source register (I2CISRC) and the 
register contains the code for a NACK interrupt. Emulator reads of 
the I2CISRC do not affect this bit.
- The I2C module is reset. 
1h (R/W) = NACK bit received. The hardware detects that a no-
acknowledge (NACK) bit has been received.
Note: While the I2C module performs a general call transfer, NACK 
is 1, even if one or more slaves send acknowledgment.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: ARDY
Fields.Description: Register-access-ready 中断 标志 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Register-access-ready 中断 标志 位 (仅 Applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 中 主机 模式). ARDY 表示 that I2C 模块 寄存器 are 就绪 至 be accessed because previously programmed 地址, 数据, 及 command values have been 使用. CPU CAN poll ARDY 或 use ARDY 中断 请求 0h (R/W) = 寄存器 are 不 就绪 至 be accessed. ARDY 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2C 模块 starts using 当前 寄存器 内容. - ARDY 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = 寄存器 are 就绪 至 be accessed. 中 nonrepeat 模式 (RM = 0 中 I2CMDR): 如果 STP = 0 中 I2CMDR, ARDY 位 为 置位 当 内部 数据 计数器 counts 下降 至 0. 如果 STP = 1, ARDY 为 不 affected (instead, I2C 模块 产生 停止 条件 当 计数器 reaches 0). 中 重复 模式 (RM = 1): ARDY 为 置位 在 end 的 每个 字节 已发送 来自 I2CDXR. Inter-Integrated Circuit 模块 (I2C) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：2 Register-access-ready interrupt flag bit；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2400页；原文字段表：Register-access-ready interrupt flag bit (only Applicable when the 

I2C module is in the master mode).
ARDY indicates that the I2C module registers are ready to be 
accessed because the previously programmed address, data, and 
command values have been used. The CPU can poll ARDY or use 
the ARDY interrupt request
0h (R/W) = The registers are not ready to be accessed. ARDY is 
cleared by any one of the following events:
- The I2C module starts using the current register contents.
- ARDY is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The I2C module is reset. 
1h (R/W) = The registers are ready to be accessed.
In the nonrepeat mode (RM = 0 in I2CMDR): If STP = 0 in I2CMDR, 
the ARDY bit is set when the internal data counter counts down to 0. 
If STP = 1, ARDY is not affected (instead, the I2C module generates 
a STOP condition when the counter reaches 0).
In the repeat mode (RM = 1): ARDY is set at the end of each byte 
transmitted from I2CDXR. 
Inter-Integrated Circuit Module (I2C)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RRDY
Fields.Description: Receive-data-ready 中断 标志 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Receive-data-ready 中断 标志 位. 当 不 中 FIFO队列 模式, RRDY 表示 that 数据 接收 寄存器 (I2CDRR) 为 就绪 至 be 读取 because 数据 has been copied 来自 接收 shift 寄存器 (I2CRSR) 至 I2CDRR. CPU CAN poll RRDY 或 use RRDY 中断 请求 当 中 FIFO队列 模式, use RXFFINT instead. 0h (R/W) = I2CDRR 不 就绪. RRDY 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2CDRR 为 读取 通过 CPU. 仿真器 reads 的 I2CDRR 执行 不 affect 此 位. - RRDY 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = I2CDRR 就绪: 数据 has been copied 来自 I2CRSR 至 I2CDRR.
Fields.Notes:
原文：3 Receive-data-ready interrupt flag bit.；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2400页；原文字段表：Receive-data-ready interrupt flag bit.

When not in FIFO mode, RRDY indicates that the data receive 
register (I2CDRR) is ready to be read because data has been copied 
from the receive shift register (I2CRSR) to I2CDRR. The CPU can 
poll RRDY or use the RRDY interrupt request When in FIFO mode, 
use RXFFINT instead.
0h (R/W) = I2CDRR not ready. RRDY is cleared by any one of the 
following events:
- I2CDRR is read by the CPU. Emulator reads of the I2CDRR do not 
affect this bit.
- RRDY is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The I2C module is reset. 
1h (R/W) = I2CDRR ready: Data has been copied from I2CRSR to 
I2CDRR.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: XRDY
Fields.Description: Transmit-data-ready 中断 标志 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Transmit-data-ready 中断 标志 位. 当 不 中 FIFO队列 模式, XRDY 表示 that 数据 发送 寄存器 (I2CDXR) 为 就绪 至 accept new 数据. FCM=0 : 当 前次 数据 has been copied 来自 I2CDXR 至 发送 shift 寄存器 (I2CXSR). CPU CAN poll XRDY 或 use XRDY 中断 请求 当 中 FIFO队列 模式, use TXFFINT instead. FCM=1: XRDY 为 已置有效 仅 当 下次 数据 为 required it gets deasserted 带 写入 至 I2CDXR. Both Polling 及 中断 based 数据 transfers are allowed 中 FCM 模式. 0h (R/W) = I2CDXR 不 就绪. XRDY 为 cleared 当 数据 为 written 至 I2CDXR. 1h (R/W) = I2CDXR 就绪: 数据 has been copied 来自 I2CDXR 至 I2CXSR. XRDY 为 also forced 至 1 当 I2C 模块 为 复位.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4 Transmit-data-ready interrupt flag bit.；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2400页；原文字段表：Transmit-data-ready interrupt flag bit. When not in FIFO mode, 

XRDY indicates that the data transmit register (I2CDXR) is ready 
to accept new data.
FCM=0 : When the previous data has been copied from I2CDXR 
to the transmit shift register (I2CXSR). The CPU can poll XRDY or 
use the XRDY interrupt request When in FIFO mode, use TXFFINT 
instead.
FCM=1: XRDY is asserted only when next data is required
it gets deasserted with write to I2CDXR. Both Polling and interrupt 
based data transfers are allowed in the FCM mode.
0h (R/W) = I2CDXR not ready. XRDY is cleared when data is written 
to I2CDXR. 
1h (R/W) = I2CDXR ready: Data has been copied from I2CDXR to 
I2CXSR.
XRDY is also forced to 1 when the I2C module is reset.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SCD
Fields.Description: 停止 条件 已检测 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：停止 条件 已检测 位. SCD 为 置位 当 I2C sends 或 receives 停止 条件. I2C 模块 delays clearing 的 I2CMDR[STP] 位 until SCD 位 为 置位. 0h (R/W) = 停止 条件 不 已检测 since SCD was 最后 cleared. SCD 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2CISRC 为 读取 通过 CPU 当 it 包含 值 110b (停止 条件 已检测). 仿真器 reads 的 I2CISRC 执行 不 affect 此 位. - SCD 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = 停止 条件 has been 已检测 开启 I2C 总线.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5 Stop condition detected bit.；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2400页；原文字段表：Stop condition detected bit.

SCD is set when the I2C sends or receives a STOP condition. The 
I2C module delays clearing of the I2CMDR[STP] bit until the SCD bit 
is set.
0h (R/W) = STOP condition not detected since SCD was last 
cleared. SCD is cleared by any one of the following events:
- I2CISRC is read by the CPU when it contains the value 110b (stop 
condition detected). Emulator reads of the I2CISRC do not affect this 
bit.
- SCD is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The I2C module is reset. 
1h (R/W) = A STOP condition has been detected on the I2C bus.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: BYTESENT
Fields.Description: 字节 发送 over 指示
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：字节 发送 over 指示. BYTESENT 为 置位 当 master/slave has successfully sent 字节 开启 SCL/SDA lines. 此 为 diagnostic 寄存器 which needs 至 be explicitly cleared 通过 软件. 中 case 不 cleared stale 状态 would keep reflecting 作为 no automated 清除 incorporated 至 avoid corner 条件. 0h (R/W) = I2C 模块 has 不 finished transmitting 下次 数据 字节. BYTESENT 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - It 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = I2C 模块 has completed 发送 的 字节.
Fields.Notes:
原文：6 Byte transmit over indication；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2399页；原文字段表：Byte Transmit over indication.

BYTESENT is set when the master/slave has successfully sent the 
byte on SCL/SDA lines. This is diagnostic register which needs to 
be explicitly cleared by Software. In case not cleared the stale status 
would keep reflecting as no automated clear incorporated to avoid 
corner conditions.
0h (R/W) = The I2C module has not finished transmitting the next 
data byte. BYTESENT is cleared by any one of the following events:
- It is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The I2C module is reset. 
1h (R/W) = The I2C module has completed the transmission of a 
byte.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: rsvd1
Fields.Description: 保留位；不要用于用户配置。
Fields.Values: 按该寄存器手册要求保留；不得假定保留位都可写0。
Fields.Notes: 保留位不得用于配置。；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2399页；原文字段表：Reserved；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: AD0
Fields.Description: 地址 0 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：地址 0 位 0h (R/W) = AD0 has been cleared 通过 启动 或 停止 条件. 1h (R/W) = 地址 的 全部 zeros (general call) 为 已检测.
Fields.Notes:
原文：8 Address 0 bits；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2399页；原文字段表：Address 0 bits

0h (R/W) = AD0 has been cleared by a START or STOP condition. 
1h (R/W) = An address of all zeros (general call) is detected.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: AAS
Fields.Description: Addressed-as-slave 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Addressed-as-slave 位 0h (R/W) = 中 7-位 addressing 模式, AAS 位 为 cleared 当 receiving NACK, 停止 条件, 或 repeated 启动 条件. 中 10-位 addressing 模式, AAS 位 为 cleared 当 receiving NACK, 停止 条件, 或 通过 从机 地址 different 来自 I2C 外设's own 从机 地址. 1h (R/W) = I2C 模块 has recognized its own 从机 地址 或 地址 的 全部 zeros (general call).
Fields.Notes:
原文：9 Addressed-as-slave bit；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2399页；原文字段表：Addressed-as-slave bit

0h (R/W) = In the 7-bit addressing mode, the AAS bit is cleared 
when receiving a NACK, a STOP condition, or a repeated START 
condition. In the 10-bit addressing mode, the AAS bit is cleared when 
receiving a NACK, a STOP condition, or by a slave address different 
from the I2C peripheral's own slave address. 
1h (R/W) = The I2C module has recognized its own slave address or 
an address of all zeros (general call).；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: XSMT
Fields.Description: 发送 shift 寄存器 空 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：发送 shift 寄存器 空 位. XSMT = 0 表示 that 发送器 has experienced 下溢. 下溢 发生 当 发送 shift 寄存器 (I2CXSR) 为 空 but 数据 发送 寄存器 (I2CDXR) has 不 been loaded since 最后 I2CDXR-to-I2CXSR transfer. 下次 I2CDXR-to-I2CXSR transfer will 不 occur until new 数据 为 中 I2CDXR. 如果 new 数据 为 不 transferred 中 时间, 前次 数据 may be re-transmitted 开启 SDA 引脚. 0h (R/W) = 下溢 已检测 (空) 1h (R/W) = No 下溢 已检测 (不 空). XSMT 为 置位 通过 单次 的 following events: - 数据 为 written 至 I2CDXR. - I2C 模块 为 复位
Fields.Notes:
原文：10 Transmit shift register empty bit.；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2399页；原文字段表：Transmit shift register empty bit.

XSMT = 0 indicates that the transmitter has experienced underflow. 
Underflow occurs when the transmit shift register (I2CXSR) is empty 
but the data transmit register (I2CDXR) has not been loaded since 
the last I2CDXR-to-I2CXSR transfer. The next I2CDXR-to-I2CXSR 
transfer will not occur until new data is in I2CDXR. If new data is not 
transferred in time, the previous data may be re-transmitted on the 
SDA pin.
0h (R/W) = Underflow detected (empty) 
1h (R/W) = No underflow detected (not empty). XSMT is set by one 
of the following events:
- Data is written to I2CDXR.
- The I2C module is reset；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RSFULL
Fields.Description: 接收 shift 寄存器 满 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：接收 shift 寄存器 满 位. RSFULL 表示 溢出 条件 during 接收. 溢出 发生 当 new 数据 为 已接收 进入 shift 寄存器 (I2CRSR) 及 old 数据 has 不 been 读取 来自 接收 寄存器 (I2CDRR). 作为 new 位 arrive 来自 SDA 引脚, they overwrite 位 中 I2CRSR. new 数据 will 不 be copied 至 ICDRR until 前次 数据 为 读取. 0h (R/W) = No 溢出 已检测. RSFULL 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2CDRR 为 读取 通过 CPU. 仿真器 reads 的 I2CDRR 执行 不 affect 此 位. - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = 溢出 已检测
Fields.Notes:
原文：11 Receive shift register full bit.；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2399页；原文字段表：Receive shift register full bit.

RSFULL indicates an overrun condition during reception. Overrun 
occurs when new data is received into the shift register (I2CRSR) 
and the old data has not been read from the receive register 
(I2CDRR). As new bits arrive from the SDA pin, they overwrite the 
bits in I2CRSR. The new data will not be copied to ICDRR until the 
previous data is read.
0h (R/W) = No overrun detected. RSFULL is cleared by any one of 
the following events:
- I2CDRR is read by the CPU. Emulator reads of the I2CDRR do not 
affect this bit.
- The I2C module is reset. 
1h (R/W) = Overrun detected；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: BB
Fields.Description: 总线 忙碌 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：总线 忙碌 位. BB 表示 是否 I2C-bus 为 忙碌 或 为 自由运行 用于 another 数据 transfer. See paragraph following 表 用于 more information 0h (R/W) = 总线 自由运行. BB 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - I2C 模块 receives 或 transmits 停止 位 (总线 自由运行). - I2C 模块 为 复位. 1h (R/W) = 总线 忙碌: I2C 模块 has 已接收 或 已发送 启动 位 开启 总线. Inter-Integrated Circuit 模块 (I2C) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：12 Bus busy bit.；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2398页；原文字段表：Bus busy bit.

BB indicates whether the I2C-bus is busy or is free for another data 
transfer. See the paragraph following the table for more information
0h (R/W) = Bus free. BB is cleared by any one of the following 
events:
- The I2C module receives or transmits a STOP bit (bus free).
- The I2C module is reset. 
1h (R/W) = Bus busy: The I2C module has received or transmitted a 
START bit on the bus. 
Inter-Integrated Circuit Module (I2C)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: NACKSNT
Fields.Description: NACK sent 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：NACK sent 位. 此 位 为 使用 当 I2C 模块 为 中 接收器 模式. 单次 instance 中 which NACKSNT 为 affected 为 当 NACK 模式 为 使用 (see description 用于 NACKMOD 中 0h (R/W) = NACK 不 sent. NACKSNT 位 为 cleared 通过 any 单次 的 following events: - It 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - I2C 模块 为 复位 (either 当 0 为 written 至 IRS 位 的 I2CMDR 或 当 whole device 为 复位). 1h (R/W) = NACK sent: no-acknowledge 位 was sent during 应答 周期 开启 I2C-bus.
Fields.Notes:
原文：13 NACK sent bit.；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2398页；原文字段表：NACK sent bit.

This bit is used when the I2C module is in the receiver mode. One 
instance in which NACKSNT is affected is when the NACK mode is 
used (see the description for NACKMOD in
0h (R/W) = NACK not sent. NACKSNT bit is cleared by any one of 
the following events:
- It is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- The I2C module is reset (either when 0 is written to the IRS bit of 
I2CMDR or when the whole device is reset). 
1h (R/W) = NACK sent: A no-acknowledge bit was sent during the 
acknowledge cycle on the I2C-bus.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SDIR
Fields.Description: 从机 方向 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：从机 方向 位 0h (R/W) = I2C 为 不 addressed 作为 从机 发送器. SDIR 为 cleared 通过 单次 的 following events: - It 为 manually cleared. 至 清除 此 位, 写入 1 至 it. - 数字 loopback 模式 为 已使能. - 启动 或 停止 条件 发生 开启 I2C 总线. 1h (R/W) = I2C 为 addressed 作为 从机 发送器.
Fields.Notes:
原文：14 Slave direction bit；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2398页；原文字段表：Slave direction bit

0h (R/W) = I2C is not addressed as a slave transmitter. SDIR is 
cleared by one of the following events:
- It is manually cleared. To clear this bit, write a 1 to it.
- Digital loopback mode is enabled.
- A START or STOP condition occurs on the I2C bus. 
1h (R/W) = I2C is addressed as a slave transmitter.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: I2CCLKL
Fields.Description: I2C 时钟 low-time 分频器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：时钟 low-time 分频 值. 至 produce 低 时间 duration 的 主机 时钟, 周期 的 模块 时钟 为 multiplied 通过 (ICCL + d). d 为 adjustment factor based 开启 预分频器. See 时钟 分频器 寄存器 section 的 Introduction 用于 details. Note: These 位 must be 置位 至 non-zero 值 用于 proper I2C 时钟 产生. Inter-Integrated Circuit 模块 (I2C) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：I2C Clock low-time divider；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2402页；原文字段表：Clock low-time divide-down value.

To produce the low time duration of the master clock, the period of 
the module clock is multiplied by (ICCL + d). d is an adjustment 
factor based on the prescaler. See the Clock Divider Registers 
section of the Introduction for details.
Note: These bits must be set to a non-zero value for proper I2C clock 
generation.
Inter-Integrated Circuit Module (I2C)

Fields.Name: I2CCLKH
Fields.Description: I2C 时钟 high-time 分频器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：时钟 high-time 分频 值. 至 produce 高 时间 duration 的 主机 时钟, 周期 的 模块 时钟 为 multiplied 通过 (ICCL + d). d 为 adjustment factor based 开启 预分频器. See 时钟 分频器 寄存器 section 的 Introduction 用于 details. Note: These 位 must be 置位 至 non-zero 值 用于 proper I2C 时钟 产生.

原文：I2C Clock high-time divider；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2403页；原文字段表：Clock high-time divide-down value.

To produce the high time duration of the master clock, the period of

Note: These bits must be set to a non-zero value for proper I2C clock

Fields.Name: BC
Fields.Description: 位 计数 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：位 计数 位. BC 定义 数量 的 位 (1 至 8) 中 下次 数据 字节 that 为 至 be 已接收 或 已发送 通过 I2C 模块. 数量 的 位 已选 带 BC must 匹配 数据 长度 的 other device. Notice that 当 BC = 000b, 数据 字节 has 8 位. BC does 不 affect 地址 bytes, which always have 8 位. Note: 如果 位 计数 为 less than 8, 接收 数据 为 right-justified 中 I2CDRR(7-0), 及 other 位 的 I2CDRR(7-0) are undefined. Also, 发送 数据 written 至 I2CDXR must be right-justified 0h (R/W) = 8 位 per 数据 字节 1h (R/W) = 1 位 per 数据 字节 2h (R/W) = 2 位 per 数据 字节 3h (R/W) = 3 位 per 数据 字节 4h (R/W) = 4 位 per 数据 字节 5h (R/W) = 5 位 per 数据 字节 6h (R/W) = 6 位 per 数据 字节 7h (R/W) = 7 位 per 数据 字节
Fields.Notes:
原文：2:0 Bit count bits.；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2411页；原文字段表：Bit count bits.

BC defines the number of bits (1 to 8) in the next data byte that 
is to be received or transmitted by the I2C module. The number of 
bits selected with BC must match the data size of the other device. 
Notice that when BC = 000b, a data byte has 8 bits. BC does not 
affect address bytes, which always have 8 bits.
Note: If the bit count is less than 8, receive data is right-justified in 
I2CDRR(7-0), and the other bits of I2CDRR(7-0) are undefined. Also, 
transmit data written to I2CDXR must be right-justified
0h (R/W) = 8 bits per data byte 
1h (R/W) = 1 bit per data byte 
2h (R/W) = 2 bits per data byte 
3h (R/W) = 3 bits per data byte 
4h (R/W) = 4 bits per data byte 
5h (R/W) = 5 bits per data byte 
6h (R/W) = 6 bits per data byte 
7h (R/W) = 7 bits per data byte；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: FDF
Fields.Description: 自由运行 数据 格式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：自由运行 数据 格式 模式 位. 0h (R/W) = 自由运行 数据 格式 模式 为 已禁用. Transfers use 7-/10-位 addressing 格式 已选 通过 XA 位. 1h (R/W) = 自由运行 数据 格式 模式 为 已使能. Transfers have 自由运行 数据 (no 地址) 格式 described 中 Section 9.2.5. 自由运行 数据 格式 为 不 supported 中 数字 loopback 模式 (DLB=1). Inter-Integrated Circuit 模块 (I2C) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：3 Free Data Format；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2410页；原文字段表：Free data format mode bit.

0h (R/W) = Free data format mode is disabled. Transfers use the 
7-/10-bit addressing format selected by the XA bit. 
1h (R/W) = Free data format mode is enabled. Transfers have the 
free data (no address) format described in Section 9.2.5.
The free data format is not supported in the digital loopback mode 
(DLB=1). 
Inter-Integrated Circuit Module (I2C)
 www.ti.com；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: STB
Fields.Description: 启动 字节 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：启动 字节 模式 位. 此 位 为 仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 主机. 作为 described 中 version 2.1 的 Philips Semiconductors I2C-bus specification, 启动 字节 CAN be 使用 至 help 从机 that needs extra 时间 至 检测 启动 条件. 当 I2C 模块 为 从机, it ignores 启动 字节 来自 主机, regardless 的 值 的 STB 位. 0h (R/W) = I2C 模块 为 不 中 启动 字节 模式. 1h (R/W) = I2C 模块 为 中 启动 字节 模式. 当 you 置位 启动 条件 位 (STT), I2C 模块 begins transfer 带 more than just 启动 条件. Specifically, it 产生: 1. 启动 条件 2. 启动 字节 (0000 0001b) 3. dummy 应答 时钟 脉冲 4. repeated 启动 条件 Then, 作为 normal, I2C 模块 sends 从机 地址 that 为 中 I2CSAR.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4 START Byte Mode；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2410页；原文字段表：START byte mode bit. This bit is only applicable when the I2C 

module is a master. As described in version 2.1 of the Philips 
Semiconductors I2C-bus specification, the START byte can be used 
to help a slave that needs extra time to detect a START condition. 
When the I2C module is a slave, it ignores a START byte from a 
master, regardless of the value of the STB bit.
0h (R/W) = The I2C module is not in the START byte mode. 
1h (R/W) = The I2C module is in the START byte mode. When 
you set the START condition bit (STT), the I2C module begins 
the transfer with more than just a START condition. Specifically, it 
generates:
1. A START condition
2. A START byte (0000 0001b)
3. A dummy acknowledge clock pulse
4. A repeated START condition
Then, as normal, the I2C module sends the slave address that is in 
I2CSAR.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: IRS
Fields.Description: I2C 模块 复位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：I2C 模块 复位 位. 0h (R/W) = I2C 模块 为 中 reset/disabled. 当 此 位 为 cleared 至 0, 全部 状态 位 (中 I2CSTR) are 置位 至 their 默认 values. 1h (R/W) = I2C 模块 为 已使能. 此 has effect 的 releasing I2C 总线 如果 I2C 外设 为 holding it.
Fields.Notes:
原文：5 I2C Module Reset；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2410页；原文字段表：I2C module reset bit.

0h (R/W) = The I2C module is in reset/disabled. When this bit is 
cleared to 0, all status bits (in I2CSTR) are set to their default values. 
1h (R/W) = The I2C module is enabled. This has the effect of 
releasing the I2C bus if the I2C peripheral is holding it.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: DLB
Fields.Description: 数字 Loopback 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：数字 loopback 模式 位. 0h (R/W) = 数字 loopback 模式 为 已禁用. 1h (R/W) = 数字 loopback 模式 为 已使能. 用于 proper 操作 中 此 模式, MST 位 must be 1. 中 数字 loopback 模式, 数据 已发送 out 的 I2CDXR 为 已接收 中 I2CDRR after n device cycles 通过 内部 路径, where: n = ((I2C 输入 时钟 frequency/module 时钟 频率) x 8) 发送 时钟 为 also 接收 时钟. 地址 已发送 开启 SDA 引脚 为 地址 中 I2COAR. Note: 自由运行 数据 格式 (FDF = 1) 为 不 supported 中 数字 loopback 模式.
Fields.Notes:
原文：6 Digital Loopback Mode；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2410页；原文字段表：Digital loopback mode bit.

0h (R/W) = Digital loopback mode is disabled. 
1h (R/W) = Digital loopback mode is enabled. For proper operation in 
this mode, the MST bit must be 1.
In the digital loopback mode, data transmitted out of I2CDXR is 
received in I2CDRR after n device cycles by an internal path, where:
n = ((I2C input clock frequency/module clock frequency) x 8)
The transmit clock is also the receive clock. The address transmitted 
on the SDA pin is the address in I2COAR.
Note: The free data format (FDF = 1) is not supported in the digital 
loopback mode.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RM
Fields.Description: 重复 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：重复 模式 位 (仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 主机- 发送器 或 master-receiver). RM, STT, 及 STP 位 determine 当 I2C 模块 starts 及 stops 数据 transmissions 0h (R/W) = Nonrepeat 模式. 值 中 数据 计数 寄存器 (I2CCNT) 决定 how many bytes are received/transmitted 通过 I2C 模块. 1h (R/W) = 重复 模式. 数据 字节 为 已发送 每个 时间 I2CDXR 寄存器 为 written 至 (或 until 发送 FIFO队列 为 空 当 中 FIFO队列 模式) until STP 位 为 manually 置位. 值 的 I2CCNT 为 忽略. ARDY bit/interrupt CAN be 使用 至 determine 当 I2CDXR (或 FIFO队列) 为 就绪 用于 more 数据, 或 当 数据 has 全部 been sent 及 CPU 为 allowed 至 写入 至 STP 位.
Fields.Notes:
原文：7 Repeat Mode；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2409页；原文字段表：Repeat mode bit (only applicable when the I2C module is a master-

transmitter or master-receiver).
The RM, STT, and STP bits determine when the I2C module starts 
and stops data transmissions
0h (R/W) = Nonrepeat mode. The value in the data count register 
(I2CCNT) determines how many bytes are
received/transmitted by the I2C module. 
1h (R/W) = Repeat mode. A data byte is transmitted each time the 
I2CDXR register is written to (or until the transmit FIFO is empty 
when in FIFO mode) until the STP bit is manually set. The value of 
I2CCNT is ignored. The ARDY bit/interrupt can be used to determine 
when the I2CDXR (or FIFO) is ready for more data, or when the data 
has all been sent and the CPU is allowed to write to the STP bit.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: XA
Fields.Description: Expanded 地址 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Expanded 地址 使能 位. 0h (R/W) = 7-位 addressing 模式 (normal 地址 模式). I2C 模块 transmits 7-位 从机 addresses (来自 位 6-0 的 I2CSAR), 及 its own 从机 地址 has 7 位 (位 6-0 的 I2COAR). 1h (R/W) = 10-位 addressing 模式 (expanded 地址 模式). I2C 模块 transmits 10-位 从机 addresses (来自 位 9-0 的 I2CSAR), 及 its own 从机 地址 has 10 位 (位 9-0 的 I2COAR).
Fields.Notes:
原文：8 Expanded Address Mode；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2409页；原文字段表：Expanded address enable bit.

0h (R/W) = 7-bit addressing mode (normal address mode). The I2C 
module transmits 7-bit slave addresses (from bits 6-0 of I2CSAR), 
and its own slave address has 7 bits (bits 6-0 of I2COAR). 
1h (R/W) = 10-bit addressing mode (expanded address mode). 
The I2C module transmits 10-bit slave addresses (from bits 9-0 
of I2CSAR), and its own slave address has 10 bits (bits 9-0 of 
I2COAR).；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: TRX
Fields.Description: 发送器 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：发送器 模式 位. 当 relevant, TRX 选择 是否 I2C 模块 为 中 发送器 模式 或 接收器 模式. 0h (R/W) = 接收器 模式. I2C 模块 为 接收器 及 receives 数据 开启 SDA 引脚. 1h (R/W) = 发送器 模式. I2C 模块 为 发送器 及 transmits 数据 开启 SDA 引脚.
Fields.Notes:
原文：9 Transmitter Mode；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2409页；原文字段表：Transmitter mode bit.

When relevant, TRX selects whether the I2C module is in the 
transmitter mode or the receiver mode.
0h (R/W) = Receiver mode. The I2C module is a receiver and 
receives data on the SDA pin. 
1h (R/W) = Transmitter mode. The I2C module is a transmitter and 
transmits data on the SDA pin.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: MST
Fields.Description: 主机 模式
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：主机 模式 位. MST 决定 是否 I2C 模块 为 中 从机 模式 或 主机 模式. MST 为 automatically changed 来自 1 至 0 当 I2C 主机 产生 停止 条件 0h (R/W) = 从机 模式. I2C 模块 为 从机 及 receives serial 时钟 来自 主机. 1h (R/W) = 主机 模式. I2C 模块 为 主机 及 产生 serial 时钟 开启 SCL 引脚.
Fields.Notes:
原文：10 Master Mode；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2409页；原文字段表：Master mode bit.

MST determines whether the I2C module is in the slave mode or the 
master mode. MST is automatically changed from 1 to 0 when the 
I2C master generates a STOP condition
0h (R/W) = Slave mode. The I2C module is a slave and receives the 
serial clock from the master. 
1h (R/W) = Master mode. The I2C module is a master and generates 
the serial clock on the SCL pin.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: STP
Fields.Description: 停止 条件
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：停止 条件 位 (仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 主机). 中 主机 模式, RM,STT, 及 STP 位 determine 当 I2C 模块 starts 及 stops 数据 transmissions. Note that STT 及 STP 位 CAN be 使用 至 terminate 重复 模式, 及 that 此 位 为 不 writable 当 IRS=0. 当 中 非- 重复 模式, 在 最低 单次 字节 must be transferred before 停止 条件 CAN be 已产生. I2C 模块 delays clearing 的 此 位 until after I2CSTR[SCD] 位 为 置位. 至 avoid disrupting I2C 状态 machine, user must wait until 此 位 为 清除 before initiating new 报文. 0h (R/W) = STP 为 automatically cleared after 停止 条件 has been 已产生 1h (R/W) = STP has been 置位 通过 device 至 产生 停止 条件 当 内部 数据 计数器 的 I2C 模块 counts 下降 至 0.
Fields.Notes:
原文：11 STOP Condition；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2409页；原文字段表：STOP condition bit (only applicable when the I2C module is a 

master).
In the master mode, the RM,STT, and STP bits determine when the 
I2C module starts and stops data transmissions.
Note that the STT and STP bits can be used to terminate the repeat 
mode, and that this bit is not writable when IRS=0. When in non-
repeat mode, at least one byte must be transferred before a stop 
condition can be generated. The I2C module delays clearing of this 
bit until after the I2CSTR[SCD] bit is set. To avoid disrupting the 
I2C state machine, the user must wait until this bit is clear before 
initiating a new message.
0h (R/W) = STP is automatically cleared after the STOP condition 
has been generated 
1h (R/W) = STP has been set by the device to generate a STOP 
condition when the internal data counter of the I2C module counts 
down to 0.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: STT
Fields.Description: 启动 条件 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：启动 条件 位 (仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 主机). RM, STT, 及 STP 位 determine 当 I2C 模块 starts 及 stops 数据 transmissions (see 表 9-6). Note that STT 及 STP 位 CAN be 使用 至 terminate 重复 模式, 及 that 此 位 为 不 writable 当 IRS = 0. 0h (R/W) = 中 主机 模式, STT 为 automatically cleared after 启动 条件 has been 已产生. 1h (R/W) = 中 主机 模式, 设置 STT 至 1 causes I2C 模块 至 产生 启动 条件 开启 I2C-bus
Fields.Notes:
原文：13 START condition bit；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2408页；原文字段表：START condition bit (only applicable when the I2C module is a 

master). The RM, STT, and STP bits determine when the I2C module 
starts and stops data transmissions (see Table 9-6). Note that the 
STT and STP bits can be used to terminate the repeat mode, and 
that this bit is not writable when IRS = 0.
0h (R/W) = In the master mode, STT is automatically cleared after 
the START condition has been generated. 
1h (R/W) = In the master mode, setting STT to 1 causes the I2C 
module to generate a START condition on the I2C-bus；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: FREE
Fields.Description: 调试 动作
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：此 位 控制 动作 taken 通过 I2C 模块 当 debugger breakpoint 为 encountered. 0h (R/W) = 当 I2C 模块 为 主机: 如果 SCL 为 低 当 breakpoint 发生, I2C 模块 stops immediately 及 keeps driving SCL 低, 是否 I2C 模块 为 发送器 或 接收器. 如果 SCL 为 高, I2C 模块 waits until SCL becomes 低 及 then stops. 当 I2C 模块 为 从机: breakpoint forces I2C 模块 至 停止 当 当前 transmission/reception 为 complete. 1h (R/W) = I2C 模块 runs 自由运行 that 为, it continues 至 operate 当 breakpoint 发生.
Fields.Notes:
原文：14 Debug Action；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2408页；原文字段表：This bit controls the action taken by the I2C module when a 

debugger breakpoint is encountered.
0h (R/W) = When I2C module is master:
If SCL is low when the breakpoint occurs, the I2C module stops 
immediately and keeps driving SCL low, whether the I2C module is 
the transmitter or the receiver. If SCL is high, the I2C module waits 
until SCL becomes low and then stops.
When I2C module is slave:
A breakpoint forces the I2C module to stop when the current 
transmission/reception is complete. 
1h (R/W) = The I2C module runs free
that is, it continues to operate when a breakpoint occurs.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: NACKMOD
Fields.Description: NACK 模式 位
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：NACK 模式 位. 此 位 为 仅 applicable 当 I2C 模块 为 acting 作为 接收器. 0h (R/W) = 中 slave-receiver 模式: I2C 模块 sends 应答 (ACK) 位 至 发送器 during 每个 应答 周期 开启 总线. I2C 模块 仅 sends no-acknowledge (NACK) 位 如果 you 置位 NACKMOD 位. 中 master-receiver 模式: I2C 模块 sends ACK 位 during 每个 应答 周期 until 内部 数据 计数器 counts 下降 至 0. 在 that point, I2C 模块 sends NACK 位 至 发送器. 至 have NACK 位 sent earlier, you must 置位 NACKMOD 位 1h (R/W) = 中 either slave-receiver 或 master-receiver 模式: I2C 模块 sends NACK 位 至 发送器 during 下次 应答 周期 开启 总线. Once NACK 位 has been sent, NACKMOD 为 cleared. Important: 至 send NACK 位 中 下次 应答 周期, you must 置位 NACKMOD before 上升沿 边沿 的 最后 数据 位.
Fields.Notes:
原文：15 NACK mode bit；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2408页；原文字段表：NACK mode bit. This bit is only applicable when the I2C module is 

acting as a receiver.
0h (R/W) = In the slave-receiver mode: The I2C module sends an 
acknowledge (ACK) bit to the transmitter during each acknowledge 
cycle on the bus. The I2C module only sends a no-acknowledge 
(NACK) bit if you set the NACKMOD bit.
In the master-receiver mode: The I2C module sends an ACK bit 
during each acknowledge cycle until the internal data counter counts 
down to 0. At that point, the I2C module sends a NACK bit to 
the transmitter. To have a NACK bit sent earlier, you must set the 
NACKMOD bit 
1h (R/W) = In either slave-receiver or master-receiver mode: The 
I2C module sends a NACK bit to the transmitter during the next 
acknowledge cycle on the bus. Once the NACK bit has been sent, 
NACKMOD is cleared.
Important: To send a NACK bit in the next acknowledge cycle, you 
must set NACKMOD before the rising edge of the last data bit.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: INTCODE
Fields.Description: 中断 编码 位.
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：中断 编码 位. binary 编码 中 INTCODE 表示 事件 that 已产生 I2C 中断. CPU 读取 will 清除 此 field. 如果 another 低位 优先级 中断 为 待处理 及 已使能, 值 corresponding 至 that 中断 will then be loaded. Otherwise, 值 will stay cleared. 中断 events below are listed 中 descending order 的 优先级. That 为 INTCODE 1 (仲裁 丢失) has highest 优先级 及 INTCODE 7 (Addressed 作为 从机) has lowest 优先级. 中 case 的 仲裁 丢失, no-acknowledgment 条件 已检测, 或 停止 条件 已检测, CPU 读取 will also 清除 associated 中断 标志 位 中 I2CSTR 寄存器. 仿真器 reads will 不 affect 状态 的 此 field 或 的 状态 位 中 I2CSTR 寄存器. 0h (R/W) = None 1h (R/W) = 仲裁 丢失 2h (R/W) = No-acknowledgment 条件 已检测 3h (R/W) = 寄存器 就绪 至 be accessed 4h (R/W) = 接收 数据 就绪 5h (R/W) = 发送 数据 就绪 6h (R/W) = 停止 条件 已检测 7h (R/W) = Addressed 作为 从机 Inter-Integrated Circuit 模块 (I2C) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：2:0 Interrupt code bits.；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2412页；原文字段表：Interrupt code bits.

The binary code in INTCODE indicates the event that generated an 
I2C interrupt.
A CPU read will clear this field. If another lower priority interrupt is 
pending and enabled, the value corresponding to that interrupt will 
then be loaded. Otherwise, the value will stay cleared.
The interrupt events below are listed in descending order of priority. 
That is INTCODE 1 (Arbitration lost) has the highest priority and 
INTCODE 7 (Addressed as slave) has the lowest priority.
In the case of an arbitration lost, a no-acknowledgment condition 
detected, or a stop condition detected, a CPU read will also clear the 
associated interrupt flag bit in the I2CSTR register.
Emulator reads will not affect the state of this field or of the status 
bits in the I2CSTR register.
0h (R/W) = None 
1h (R/W) = Arbitration lost 
2h (R/W) = No-acknowledgment condition detected 
3h (R/W) = Registers ready to be accessed 
4h (R/W) = Receive data ready 
5h (R/W) = Transmit data ready 
6h (R/W) = Stop condition detected 
7h (R/W) = Addressed as slave

Fields.Name: FCM
Fields.Description: Forward Compatibility 用于 Tx behav 中 Type1
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：Forward Compatibility 模式. 此 位 当 programmed brings functionality 的 Tx 请求 仅 当 Tx 数据 required regardless 的 数据 状态 中 Tx 缓冲 用于 non-FIFO 模式. 此 寄存器 affects XRDY behavior hence needs 至 be 置位 after releasing IRS (I2CMDR[5]). 0h (R/W) = Legacy functionality 的 requesting Tx 数据 upon 缓冲 copy 至 shift 寄存器 或 upon 启动 条件 为 活动. 原文：1 Forward Compatibility for Tx behav in Type1；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2413页；原文字段表：Forward Compatibility mode.

This bit when programmed brings the functionality of Tx request only 
when Tx data required regardless of data status in Tx buffer for 
non-FIFO mode.

releasing the IRS (I2CMDR[5]).

copy to shift register or upon start condition is active. Stale data is 
reused after illegal start, ARB Lost, NACK conditions. 
1h (R/W) = New functionality of requesting data only upon ACK 
(address/data) is active.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：发送 FIFO队列 中断 电平. These 位 置位 状态 电平 that will 置位 发送 中断 标志. 当 TXFFST4-0 位 reach 值 equal 至 或 less than these 位, TXFFINT 标志 will be 置位. 此 will 产生 中断 如果 TXFFIENA 位 为 置位. Because I2C 开启 此 device has 16-电平 发送 FIFO队列, these 位 cannot be configured 用于 中断 的 more than 16 FIFO队列 levels. Inter-Integrated Circuit 模块 (I2C) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：4:0 Transmit FIFO Interrupt Level；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2416页；原文字段表：Transmit FIFO interrupt level.

These bits set the status level that will set the transmit interrupt flag. 
When the TXFFST4-0 bits reach a value equal to or less than these 
bits, the TXFFINT flag will be set. This will generate an interrupt if the 
TXFFIENA bit is set. Because the I2C on this device has a 16-level 
transmit FIFO, these bits cannot be configured for an interrupt of 
more than 16 FIFO levels.

Fields.Name: RXFFIL
Fields.Description: 接收 FIFO队列 中断 电平
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：接收 FIFO队列 中断 电平. These 位 置位 状态 电平 that will 置位 接收 中断 标志. 当 RXFFST4-0 位 reach 值 equal 至 或 greater than these 位, RXFFINT 标志 为 置位. 此 will 产生 中断 如果 RXFFIENA 位 为 置位. Note: Since these 位 are 复位 至 零, 接收 FIFO队列 中断 标志 will be 置位 如果 接收 FIFO队列 操作 为 已使能 及 I2C 为 taken out 的 复位. 此 will 产生 接收 FIFO队列 中断 如果 已使能. 至 avoid 此, modify these 位 开启 same instruction 作为 或 prior 至 设置 RXFFRST 位. Because I2C 开启 此 device has 16-电平 接收 FIFO队列, these 位 cannot be configured 用于 中断 的 more than 16 FIFO队列 levels.
Fields.Notes:
原文：4:0 Receive FIFO Interrupt Level；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2417页；原文字段表：Receive FIFO interrupt level.

These bits set the status level that will set the receive interrupt flag. 
When the RXFFST4-0 bits reach a value equal to or greater than 
these bits, the RXFFINT flag is set. This will generate an interrupt if 
the RXFFIENA bit is set.
Note: Since these bits are reset to zero, the receive FIFO interrupt 
flag will be set if the receive FIFO operation is enabled and the I2C 
is taken out of reset. This will generate a receive FIFO interrupt if 
enabled. To avoid this, modify these bits on the same instruction as 
or prior to setting the RXFFRST bit. Because the I2C on this device 
has a 16-level receive FIFO, these bits cannot be configured for an 
interrupt of more than 16 FIFO levels.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: NMIWDCNT
Fields.Description: NMI 看门狗 计数器 寄存器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：NMI 看门狗 计数器 此 16-位 计数器 increments once per SYSCLK 周期 whenever any 的 NMIFLG 位 are 置位. 如果 计数器 reaches 周期 值 中 NMIWDPRD 寄存器, NMI 模块 产生 复位 (NMIWDRS). After 此 复位, 计数器 resets 至 零 及 stops counting. 如果 全部 NMI flags are cleared, 计数器 will 复位 至 零 及 停止 counting until another NMI 标志 为 置位. 系统 控制 及 中断 www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：NMI Watchdog Counter Register；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第226页；原文字段表：NMI Watchdog Counter

This 16-bit counter increments once per SYSCLK cycle whenever 
any of the NMIFLG bits are set. If the counter reaches the period 
value in the NMIWDPRD register, the NMI module generates a reset 
(NMIWDRS). After this reset, the counter resets to zero and stops 
counting.
If all NMI flags are cleared, the counter will reset to zero and stop 
counting until another NMI flag is set.
System Control and Interrupts

Fields.Name: NMIWDPRD
Fields.Description: NMI 看门狗 周期 寄存器
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：NMI 看门狗 周期 These 位 specify 周期 的 NMI 看门狗 定时器 中 SYSCLK cycles. Writing 周期 值 that 为 smaller than 当前 计数器 值 will immediately 强制 复位 (NMIWDRS).
Fields.Notes:
原文：NMI Watchdog Period Register；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第227页；原文字段表：NMI Watchdog Period

These bits specify the period of the NMI watchdog timer in SYSCLK 
cycles. Writing a period value that is smaller than the current counter 
value will immediately force a reset (NMIWDRS).；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: PIEVECT
Fields.Description: PIE 向量 地址
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：These 位 indicate 向量 地址 的 向量 fetched 来自 ePIE 向量 表. 最低 有效 位 的 地址 为 忽略 及 仅 位 1 至 15 的 地址 are shown. 向量 值 CAN be 读取 通过 user 至 determine which 中断 已产生 向量 fetch. Note: 当 NMI 为 serviced, PIEVECT bit-field does 不 reflect 向量 作为 it does 用于 other 中断.
Fields.Notes:
原文：15:1 PIE Vector Address；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第163页；原文字段表：These bits indicate the vector address of the vector fetched from the 

ePIE vector table. The least significant bit of the address is ignored 
and only bits 1 to 15 of the address are shown. The vector value 
can be read by the user to determine which interrupt generated the 
vector fetch.
Note: When a NMI is serviced, the PIEVECT bit-field does not reflect 
the vector as it does for other interrupts.；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SCICHAR
Fields.Description: SCI每个字符的数据位数。
Fields.Values: 编码0至7分别对应1至8位数据。
Fields.Notes:
原文：2:0 Character length control；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2349页；原文字段表：Character-length control bits 2-0.

These bits select the SCI character length from one to eight bits. 
Characters of less than eight bits are right-justified in SCIRXBUF 
and SCIRXEMU and are padded with leading zeros in SCIRXBUF. 
SCITXBUF doesn't need to be padded with leading zeros.
0h (R/W) = SCICHAR_LENGTH_1 
1h (R/W) = SCICHAR_LENGTH_2 
2h (R/W) = SCICHAR_LENGTH_3 
3h (R/W) = SCICHAR_LENGTH_4 
4h (R/W) = SCICHAR_LENGTH_5 
5h (R/W) = SCICHAR_LENGTH_6 
6h (R/W) = SCICHAR_LENGTH_7 
7h (R/W) = SCICHAR_LENGTH_8；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI33H / 2024-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: RXENA
Fields.Description: SCI接收使能。
Fields.Values: 0：禁用接收；1：使能接收。
Fields.Notes:
原文：0 SCI receiver enable；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2351页；原文字段表：SCI receiver enable.

Data is received on the SCIRXD pin and is sent to the receiver shift 
register and then the receiver buffers. This bit enables or disables 
the receiver (transfer to the buffers).
Clearing RXENA stops received characters from being transferred 
to the two receiver buffers and also stops the generation of 
receiver interrupts. However, this will not stop RX errors from 
triggering interrupts. To disable interrupts from RX errors use the 
RXERRINTENA bit. To stop propagation of the BRKDT interrupt use 
the RXBKINTENA bit.
The receiver shift register can continue to assemble characters even 
while RXENA is cleared. Thus, if RXENA is set during the reception 
of a character, the complete character will be transferred into the 
receiver buffer registers, SCIRXEMU and SCIRXBUF.
0h (R/W) = Prevent received characters from transfer into the 
SCIRXEMU and SCIRXBUF receiver buffers 
1h (R/W) = Send received characters to SCIRXEMU and SCIRXBUF；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI33H / 2024-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: TXENA

Fields.Values: 0：禁用发送；1：使能发送。
Fields.Notes:
原文：1 SCI transmitter enable；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2351页；原文字段表：SCI transmitter enable.

Data is transmitted through the SCITXD pin only when TXENA is 
set. If reset, transmission is halted but only after all data previously 
written to SCITXBUF has been sent. Data written into SCITXBUF 
when TXENA is disabled will not be transmitted even if the TXENA is 
enabled later.
0h (R/W) = Transmitter disabled 
1h (R/W) = Transmitter enabled；关键字段中文说明已按SPRUI33H / 2024-06对应字段表核对。

Fields.Name: SLEEP
Fields.Description: SCI 睡眠
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI 睡眠. TXWAKE 位 控制 选择 的 data-transmit feature, depending 开启 which 发送 模式 (idle-line 或 address-bit) 为 specified 在 ADDR/IDLE 模式 位 (SCICCR, 位 3). 中 multiprocessor 配置, 此 位 控制 接收器 睡眠 功能. Clearing 此 位 brings SCI out 的 睡眠 模式. 接收器 still operates 当 睡眠 位 为 置位 however, 操作 does 不 更新 接收器 缓冲 就绪 位 (SCIRXST, 位 6, RXRDY) 或 错误 状态 位 (SCIRXST, 位 5-2: BRKDT, FE, OE, 及 PE) unless 地址 字节 为 已检测. 睡眠 为 不 cleared 当 地址 字节 为 已检测. 0h (R/W) = 睡眠 模式 已禁用 1h (R/W) = 睡眠 模式 已使能
Fields.Notes:
原文：2 SCI sleep；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2351页；原文字段表：SCI sleep.

The TXWAKE bit controls selection of the data-transmit feature, 
depending on which transmit mode (idle-line or address-bit) is 
specified at the ADDR/IDLE MODE bit (SCICCR, bit 3). In a 
multiprocessor configuration, this bit controls the receiver sleep 
function. Clearing this bit brings the SCI out of the sleep mode.
The receiver still operates when the SLEEP bit is set
however, operation does not update the receiver buffer ready bit 
(SCIRXST, bit 6, RXRDY) or the error status bits (SCIRXST, bit 
5-2: BRKDT, FE, OE, and PE) unless the address byte is detected. 
SLEEP is not cleared when the address byte is detected.
0h (R/W) = Sleep mode disabled 
1h (R/W) = Sleep mode enabled；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: SWRESET
Fields.Description: SCI软件复位。
Fields.Values: 0：保持SCI复位；1：释放复位、允许工作。
Fields.Notes:
原文：5 Software reset；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2350页；原文字段表：SCI software reset (active low).

Writing a 0 to this bit initializes the SCI state machines and operating 
flags (registers SCICTL2 and SCIRXST) to the reset condition. This 
reset will not reset the FIFO pointers or flush out the data in TX/RX 
FIFO. If you need to clear the FIFO then perform SWRESET + 
TXFFINT + RXFFINT or refer to a channel reset SCIFFTX[SCIRST].
The SW RESET bit does not affect any of the configuration bits. All 
affected logic is held in the specified reset state until a 1 is written 
to SW RESET (the bit values following a reset are shown beneath 
each register diagram in this section). Thus, after a system reset, 
re-enable the SCI by writing a 1 to this bit. Clear this bit after a 
receiver break detect (BRKDT flag, bit SCIRXST, bit 5).
SW RESET affects the operating flags of the SCI, but it neither 
affects the configuration bits nor restores the reset values. Once SW 
RESET is asserted, the flags are frozen until the bit is deasserted.
The affected flags are as follows:
Value After SW SCI Flag Register Bit

Fields.Name: BAUD
Fields.Description: SCI 16-位 波特率 选择 寄存器 SCIHBAUD
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI 16-位 波特率 选择 寄存器 SCIHBAUD (MSbyte). internally-generated serial 时钟 为 determined 通过 低 speed 外设 时钟 (LSPCLK) 信号 及 two baud-select 寄存器. SCI uses 16-位 值 的 these 寄存器 至 选择 单次 的 64K serial 时钟 rates 用于 communication modes. BRR = (SCIHBAUD << 8) + (SCILBAUD) SCI 波特率 速率 为 calculated using following equation: SCI 异步 波特率 = LSPCLK / ((BRR + 1) *8) Alternatively, BRR = LSPCLK / (SCI 异步 波特率 * 8) - 1 Note that above formulas are applicable 仅 当 0 < BRR < 65536. 如果 BRR = 0, then SCI 异步 波特率 = LSPCLK / 16 Where: BRR = 16-位 值 (中 decimal) 中 baud-select 寄存器 Serial Communications Interface (SCI) www.ti.com
Fields.Notes:
原文：7:0 SCI 16-bit baud selection Registers SCIHBAUD；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2352页；原文字段表：SCI 16-bit baud selection Registers SCIHBAUD (MSbyte).

The internally-generated serial clock is determined by the low speed 
peripheral clock (LSPCLK) signal and the two baud-select registers. 
The SCI uses the 16-bit value of these registers to select one of 64K 
serial clock rates for the communication modes.
BRR = (SCIHBAUD << 8) + (SCILBAUD)
The SCI baud rate is calculated using the following equation:
SCI Asynchronous Baud = LSPCLK / ((BRR + 1) *8)
Alternatively,
BRR = LSPCLK / (SCI Asynchronous Baud * 8) - 1
Note that the above formulas are applicable only when 0 < BRR < 
65536. If BRR = 0, then
SCI Asynchronous Baud = LSPCLK / 16
Where: BRR = the 16-bit value (in decimal) in the baud-select 
registers

Fields.Name: RXWAKE
Fields.Description: 接收器 唤醒 检测 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：接收器 wake-up-detect 标志 0h (R/W) = No 检测 的 接收器 wake-up 条件 1h (R/W) = 值 的 1 中 此 位 表示 检测 的 接收器 wake-up 条件. 中 address-bit multiprocessor 模式 (SCICCR.3 = 1), RXWAKE 反映 值 的 地址 位 用于 字符 contained 中 SCIRXBUF. 中 idle-line multiprocessor 模式, RXWAKE 为 置位 如果 SCIRXD 数据 线路 为 已检测 作为 空闲. RXWAKE 为 只读 标志, cleared 通过 单次 的 following: - transfer 的 首个 字节 after 地址 字节 至 SCIRXBUF (仅 中 non-FIFO 模式) - reading 的 SCIRXBUF - 活动 软件 复位 - 通道 复位 (SCIRST) - 系统 复位
Fields.Notes:
原文：1 Receiver wakeup detect flag；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2358页；原文字段表：Receiver wake-up-detect flag

0h (R/W) = No detection of a receiver wake-up condition 
1h (R/W) = A value of 1 in this bit indicates detection of a 
receiver wake-up condition. In the address-bit multiprocessor mode 
(SCICCR.3 = 1), RXWAKE reflects the value of the address bit for 
the character contained in SCIRXBUF. In the idle-line multiprocessor 
mode, RXWAKE is set if the SCIRXD data line is detected as idle. 
RXWAKE is a read-only flag, cleared by one of the following:
- The transfer of the first byte after the address byte to SCIRXBUF 
(only in non-FIFO mode)
- The reading of SCIRXBUF
- An active SW RESET
- Channel reset (SCIRST)
- A system reset；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: PE
Fields.Description: 奇偶校验 错误 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI parity-error 标志. 此 标志 位 为 置位 当 字符 为 已接收 带 mismatch between 数量 的 1s 及 its 奇偶校验 位. 地址 位 为 included 中 calculation. 如果 奇偶校验 产生 及 检测 为 不 已使能, PE 标志 为 已禁用 及 读取 作为 0. PE 位 为 复位 通过 活动 软件 复位, 通道 复位 (SCIRST), 或 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 奇偶校验 错误 或 奇偶校验 为 已禁用 1h (R/W) = 奇偶校验 错误 为 已检测
Fields.Notes:
原文：2 Parity error flag；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2358页；原文字段表：SCI parity-error flag.

This flag bit is set when a character is received with a mismatch 
between the number of 1s and its parity bit. The address bit is 
included in the calculation. If parity generation and detection is not 
enabled, the PE flag is disabled and read as 0. The PE bit is reset by 
an active SW RESET, channel reset (SCIRST), or a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No parity error or parity is disabled 
1h (R/W) = Parity error is detected；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: OE
Fields.Description: 溢出 错误 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI overrun-error 标志. SCI 设置 此 位 当 字符 为 transferred 进入 寄存器 SCIRXEMU 及 SCIRXBUF before 前次 字符 为 fully 读取 通过 CPU 或 DMAC. 前次 字符 为 overwritten 及 丢失. OE 标志 位 为 复位 通过 活动 软件 复位, 通道 复位 (SCIRST), 或 系统 复位. 0h (R/W) = No 溢出 错误 已检测 1h (R/W) = 溢出 错误 已检测
Fields.Notes:
原文：3 Overrun error flag；SPRUI33H / 2024-06 PDF第2358页；原文字段表：SCI overrun-error flag.

The SCI sets this bit when a character is transferred into registers 
SCIRXEMU and SCIRXBUF before the previous character is fully 
read by the CPU or DMAC. The previous character is overwritten 
and lost. The OE flag bit is reset by an active SW RESET, channel 
reset (SCIRST), or a system reset.
0h (R/W) = No overrun error detected 
1h (R/W) = Overrun error detected；中文按原文术语整理，尚未完成逐句人工复核。

Fields.Name: RXRDY
Fields.Description: 接收器 就绪 标志
Fields.Values: TRM术语译注（未逐句人工复核）：SCI receiver-ready 标志. 当 new 字符 为 就绪 至 be 读取 来自 SCIRXBUF 寄存器, 接收器 设置 此 位, 及 接收器 中断 为 已产生 如果 RX/BK 中断 ENA 位 (SCICTL2.1) 为 1.
